/ /gu44bsabs yabangangosagung thang bstan pa'i sgon me'i gsung 'bum/dpar sgrig dpe skrun mi sna/blo 'dri sa/ bse tshang blo bzang dpal ldan/dor zhi gdong drug snyems blo/gling rgya bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho/gung thang thub bstan/bsod nams rgya mtsho/gtso sgrig pa/gtso sgrig pa gzhon pa/ 'jam dga'/sbyikhubacas 'god pa/ tsha lag tshe ring rgyal/rtsom sgrigakhongs mi/ mgon po dar rgyas/ phur kho/ rta mgrin rdo rje/'phrin las rgyal mtshan/ pan de mkhar/ting 'dzin bkra shis/ rta rdo/lag bstar rtsom sgrig pa/ 'brug mo skyid/

/ /gung pa'imibar+yā 4dkon ྾yo da4 'jig medad4 bar+sha/ /༄da bar+yāpa'i rkaphar ca ༄raban/ /lung rtoganya zazang gi mer+yā/ /skyer+yā'i rmongs maselaba'adi rmadabyung /go da4 mang pajil ྾da pa'i ྾ 4da ma 4na ༄ te mkha grub thos kyi ga4 ma — 4na dkon mdza ༄na pa'i sgron me'i khrung 4ma dpespan byed par 4 ma spyar mal a ri'i 4 pa'i thes ma7parajag chetha/ khu dhe 4 7ཿ

༄ gedape sgrun gsal bshad/de yang gung thang bstan pa'i sgon me'am mtshan yongs gung thang dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron me dbang phyug sder 'bod pa'i dam pa de nyid rab byung bcu gsum pa'i chu pho rta lo ste spyi lo 1762lor mdo smad shar lho'i mdzod dge'i smad kyi yul du yab the bo lcags po byams pa dang / yum bo chog gnyis kyi sras su sku 'khrungs/ khong dgung lo bdun par phebs dus kun mkhyen 'jigs med dbang pos khri chen dge 'dun phun tshogs kyi yang srid du ngos 'dzin mdzad de bla brang bkra shis 'khyil du gdan drangs/ khong gis kun mkhyen 'jigs med dbang po'i drung nas dge bsnyen dang rab byung dge tshul bcas dkyus gcig tu zhus shing mtshan la dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgon me zhes gsol/ de nas rdo rams pa blo bzang rin chen slob dpon du bsten nas yi ge'i sbyor klog dang blo 'dzin sogs legs par sbyangs pa ma zad/rim gyis rgya dang sog po'i skad yig sbyangs pas thugs su chud/ dgung lo bcu bdun par dbus su phebs nas 'bras spungs sgo mang grwa tshang gi chos grwar zhugs/ hor skal bzang dngos grub dge rgan du bsten nas dbu ma dang /mdzod/ 'dul ba/ tshad ma/ phar phyin bcas gzhung bka' pod lnga la brdar sha chod par sbyangs/ dgung lo nyer gcig par rgyal ba blo bzang 'jam dpal rgya mtsho'i sku mdun nas bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa mnos/dgung lo nyer gnyis par dge bshes lha rams pa'i mtshan btags blangs/1

/dbus su lo brgyad tsam bzhugs pa'i ring la mdo sngags rig gnas kyi gzhung kun la mkhyen pa thogs med du gyur cing / dbus gtsang gi mkhas mang dkyil na rgyal mtshan gyi tog ltar kun gyis gtsug tu bkur ba'i gnas su gyur/dgung lo nyer lnga bar yul mdo smad bla brang bkra shis 'khyil du phebs/dgung lo sum cu bar chos sde chen po bla brang bkra shis 'khyil gye khri chen du 'khod pas gdan rabs nyer gcig pa yin/ de nas bzung yul mdo smad lho byang gi chos grwa chen po rnams su 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi bya ba'i yo lang kho nas dus 'da' bar mdzad cing / rab byung bcu bzhi pa'i chu mo lug lo ste spyi lo 1823lor dgongs pa chos dbyings su 'thim/ dbal mang paṇ+ḍi ta dkon mchog rgyal mtshan sogs slob ma mkhas chen mang du byung ngo / /khong gi gsung rtsom ni phar phyin sdom dang / mdzod sdom/ 'dul ba sdom/ sgra dang snyan ngag sman dang rtsis/ lha ris thig tshad sogs sgyu rtsal skor gye bstan bcos rnams gcig tu bsdus te po ti bcu gcig byas nas shing paradu brkos yod pa de dag kun kyang tshad mar 'dzin pa'i legs bshad sha stagayin pas nged cag dpe skrun khang gis bla brang gi shing par gzhir bzung nas dpar du btab pa'i dge ba 'di yis thams cad bkra shis bde legs su gyur cig /mi rigs dpe skrun khang /2

༄4//rjeja blo rabayos kyi khru'igasabagasum rmad du byubaba'i mdzadajazab 'dababargya'i dga' tshal gyi chatsam gtam du byas pa rtogasabarjod pad+ma dkaralashes byajabazhugs so//smad chami rigs dpe skrun khang /

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'isgroname'i gsung 'bum/༄7/ / 'dab ma bzu gnyis pa/ mdo sngags kyi 'chad spel gtso bor gnang pa'i tshul/de nas tas thung dgon chen gyi spyi gnyer sogs kyis gyo mi go nas bsus shing / zan yan chang gi rgya sgo la rgya yag dgon gyi slob chung las zur gnyis/'bri gung nang so rnams tsho ba'i sbyin bdag 'ga' zhig bcas dang / pe thi shu la zhag bab thog stag lung dgon gyi mtshan nyid bla ma dang bla ma gzhung las pa ngo g.yog rnams rim gyis chibs bsur 'byor cing / dgon lung spyi dang rgya yagadagon/ thar pa gling so so nas bsu ston zhus/ bcu drug la gan gu thang nas zhwa dmar bra ti dgon gyi khri ba bla ma/ sku rten chos rje/ rgyud pa zhabs drung / spyi ba'i gnyer ba/ chen hu dpon po sogs rta pa lnga bcu skor dang / tsong shan du zhag bab thog stag lung sprul sku dpon g.yog dang /'bri gung zhabs drung rnam gnyis/ dgon pa so so'i las sne bcas rim gyis 'byor nas so sos bsu ston zhus/ bcu bdun gyi zhog ka 'bri gung zhabs drung rnam gnyis la rab byung gi sdom pa stsal te bstan pa'i sgor bcugaphebs lam du rab rgyas dgon gyi zhabs drung ngo g.yog dang / dgon lung khri ba bla brang gi phyag mdzod/ bkra shis chos gling gi spyi gnyer dang / khri ba'i mtshams zhus pa rnams rim gyis 'byor/ phing chen por zhag bab thog rab rgyas zhabs drung gis thab bsu zhus/ bco brgyad la lam bar du rgyud pa bla zur dpa' rin chos rje/ bde du chos mdzad sogs dad mos kyi chibs bsu zhu mkhan dka' ram grwa rkyang mang po dang / se ra lung gi tas thung zhabs 536

༄/ /rjebatsug bzapachosakyi gakhu pabadakuracod༄ngakadrung / mā yang dgon gyi r+sā rgan/ a kya sgar gyi nang so/ thar pa gling gi grwa rgan dang tsho ba so so'i mgo pa/ yar lung dgon pa'i bla ma dbu mdzad/tas thung dgon chen gyi rgyud pa bla ma sogs chibs bsu pa zam ma chad par byung zhing / grong lang du zhag bab thog dgon lung gi khri pa wang bla brang /yar lung dgon dang tas thung dgon bla spyo so sos bsu ston zhus/ bcu dgu la shin dran du dgon lung gi dka' ram dge tshul slong slob ma sbyin bdag mang po dang / lo dkar sogs ri khrod 'ga' zhig gi grwa rgan/ mchod gzhi'i mgo pa rnams dang bcas 'byor cing / sho'u ling zir bzhugs/ nyi shu'i nyin dgon lung rgyud pa bla zur sum pa chos rje/ se ra lung gi do ba zhabs drung / dgon lung gi li kyā chos rje sogs chibs bsu pa mang po rim gyis 'byor te/ sum pa chos rje sogs se ra lung dang / srog mkhar ri khrod pa rnams kyis rgya tshang zhig tu gdan drangs nas gsol ston zhus/ mo'u tha lar zhag bab thog klu skyabs dpon po chung ba 'ongs nas sgar thog tu gsol ja drangs shing / dmag mi rnams mngags te skyel bsu dang mtshan mo mel tshe byed pa sogs sri zhu yang dag zhus/ nyer gcig la lo dkar ri khrod kyi nang so dang / ser lding / rog shu'u tsho ba'i mgo pa rnams kyis ping gu den nas thab bsu dang / gro tshang mkhan po dang / ka ring zhabs drung dpon g.yog gisapeng gu la sgang du thab bsu zhus shing gsung gleng 'phel/ de nas rim gyis dgon lung rgyud pa bla ma rgya tig zhabs drung / ri khrod bla ma sems nyid zhabs drung / spyi gnyer chung ba sogs dka' ram dge tshul slong mang po dang /'brug lung dgon gyi sems nyid sku skye/ a kyā sku skye/ chan tsong bra ti sku skye/dmar tshang dpon tshang sogs sbyin bdag 'ga' zhig / bsam gtan rtse'i khri pa/ ling hwa thas dgon pa'i dge gnyer dka' ram 'ga' zhig sogs 537

༄/ /gung thang bstan ba'isgroname'igasung 'bum/chibs bsu ba du ma mu mthud nas 'byor/ a kyā sgar du zhag bab thog /li kyā ha bo dpon po dang / shing po dpon po'i bu ngo g.yog 'byor nas mtshams zhus phul/ thar pa gling / mā yang / a kyā ri khrod/ ling hwa thas dgon pa so so nas thab bsu zhus shing / a kyā sgar nang sos kyang gzhis len bsnyen bkur gzabs/ nyer gnyis la phebs lam du bkra shis chos gling gi khri pa dang grwa rgan 'ga' zhig / tshang kyā sku 'bum gyi slob chung /'brug lung dgon pa'i spyi gnyer dang dge bsgos/ gra rgan/ mang 'dus ri khrod kyi khri ba hu kyā chos rje/ chos bzang ri khrod kyi slob chung rnams so so'i mchod gzhis mi skya mang po bcas dang / bde rgu sku rten nang so sogs rgya tig tsho ba brgyad kyi rgan po rnams dang / gzhan yang dgon mchod gzhi'i nang nas dad mos kyis chibs bsu zhu mkhan dka' ram dge tshul slong / mi skya mang po bar ma chad du byung / ni ma pe'i mkhar gyi shin ba'i ye/ tsong ye/zi lo ye/ chi kyā dpon po rnams kyis lam nas chibs bsu dang / rkan den du gdan drangs nas gsol ston zhus/ mkhar gyi nye 'dabs su sgar btab/bkra shis chos gling / bsam gtan rtse/ 'brug lung dgon/ chan tsong ri khrod/ chos bzang ri khrod rnams dang / rgya tig tsho ba brgyad so so nas bsu ston zhus/ nyer gsum la rta dzi lung pa'i mdar dgon lung khri ba wang paṇ+ḍi ta zhabs drung / bla ma sgom pa ngag dbang rab brtan/ bde rgu mkhan po/dpa' rin sku skye/ rgyud pa bla zur tshing kyā chos rje sogs dka' ram dge tshul slongs ba sum brgya skor gyis chibs bsu zhus/ mar tshang la zhag bab thog 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa rin po ches gtong ba gnang ba'i gsol dpon dpal ldan ngo g.yog 'byor nas mtshams zhus phul/ nyer bzhi'i zhog ka bla chen gyi lha khang du phebs nas mchod sprin rgya mtsho spros te dpon g.yog tshang mas 538

ra / /rjebadza gas ཿshadasachabad nayan lag bdun pa dang / lam rim gsol 'debs bzang spyod rnams gsungs/ phebs lam du hor rdum/ shang zi/ lo'u ye grong / lcang skya/māying / ba yan gong 'og sogs rgya dang hor gyi grong sde so so nas chibs bsu dang / rang rang gi grong du gdan drangs nas gsol ston dang mjal kha zhus/ 'dul ba dgon gyi rong bo zhabs drung / gan chen dgon gyi slob chung / dgon lung gi ser lding zhabs drung / o'u shi zhabs drung / hor skyod sku skye/ o'u han sku skye/ tshogs chen dbu mdzad sogs dka' ram dge tshul slong dang / lung khog gi mi skya skor thang mang po rim gyis 'byor/lam bar du ja zhus mjal ba dang chibs bsu ba mang bas mun rub tsam la bzang skor thang gi sgar thog tu phyag phebs/ nyer lnga'i zhog ka mang 'dus ri khrod bla spyi dang / ho sgar ba/ dpa' rin/ hor skyong sogs nye 'khor gyi grong sde bcu phrag brgal ba so sos sgar thog nas ston mo bsgrigs te mjal kha zhus/ dgon lung gi bla ma dang zhabs drung / sku skye/ chos rje/ dka' ram/ dge tshul slong / mchod gzhis lung khog lnga'i mi skya bcas rta ba brgya phrag mang pos chibs bsu bskyar ma zhus te/ chibs rags kyi mdun/ lam gyi g.yas g.yon du rta pas ser sprengs skya sbrengs gshar/ gling 'dab nas dge 'dun nyis stong brgal bas ser sprengs bsgrigs te/ gdugs/ rgyal mtshan/ 'phan sogs mchod rdzas tshar du dngar zhing / 'bud dkrol sogs rol mo'i bye brag dang / dri zhim po'i spos 'dren gyis mdun bsus/'du khang dang rgyud khang / bla brang gi dbus khang thog tu'ang mchod rdzas rol cha bsgrigs pa sogs rten 'brel gang legs kyis bla brang bkra shis 'od 'bar du phyag phebs/ rje nyid sgar thog nas 'byon par chas skabs/ dgon lung gi lung pa'i phug gi sgrub sde byang chub gling gi phyogs nas bar snang du 'ja' 539

༄/ /gung thangabam pa'izlaname'i gsung 'bum/'od dkar po zhig 'then nas/ nyid kyi phyogs su bsu ba'i tshul du 'ongs/yar chibs bskyod gnang ba dang mnyam du 'ja' 'od kyi sne'ang phyir bsdus te/dgon lung du phyag phebs pa dang sngar gyi gnas su thim song ba thams cad kyis mthong nas ya mtshan pa byung / thog mar mkhyen yangs gling du gsol ston dkar spro'i thog / bla spyi khag so so dang / slob ma sbyin bdag rnams kyes legs dar phul te phyag dbang zhus/ bla brang so so dang phyogs nye ring du ma nas 'ongs pa'i grwa slob sbyin bdag rnams kyis gdan sa chen por phyag phebs pa'i dga' ston rim pa bzhin nyin du mar sbrel nas bstar bas/ dge mtshan gyi yo lang rdzogs ldan gsar pa'i dpal la 'gran par gyur/ dgung lo nga gcig pa me mo lug gi gnam lo gsar tshes kyi dga' ba dang po'i nyin/dponagayog tshang mas lha khang mgon khang rnams su mchod me brgya phrag du ma/mdzod btags sna lnga sogs kyi snyan shal phon che ba dang bcas mchod mjal mdzad/ rnam par rgyal ba'i khang bzang sa la 'phos pa lta bu'i bla brang bkra shis 'od 'bar gye dbus khang chen mor dkar spro gsol ja bzhes thog /zhabs phyi ba rnams dang / rim gyes dgon lung gi bla spyi khag so so dang dge 'dun tshang mas mjal kha gshar ba sogs lo gsar gyi dga' ston dkyus ltar mdzad/ dgon lung gi cho 'phrul smon lam chen mo rje nyid nas btang bar/tshes gnyis nas bcu drug gi bar nyi ma bco lnga'i ring la/ mang ja nga lnga/nyung ja nga gnyis/ bzhes thug bcu gnyis bcas zhus pas/ 'deb ja dang 'o shing mar chur sha 'bras tso'u ri rgyan 'brum sogs dang gtor rtsam dang mchod 'bru'i rin rnams dngul thog tu phab par dngul srang bzhi brgya dang brgyad lhag tsam/ gzhung ston gyi 'gyed la rgya dngul dkar po srang chig stong sum brgya dang / grub ston gyi 'gyed la kha btags nyis stong drug brgya/ spyi 540

༄/ /rjebatsotshos4chosamigazag4gtsosabadakhacodabyungaka'ajog tu har chin wang la nyid nas snyan bskul mdzad de bzang gos 'ba' zhig las bsgrubs pa'i bye phur che ba brgyad/ ka 'phan che ba bcu drug /cod paṇa bsgrigs pa'i mthongs khebs rgya mthong yongs rdzogs 'khor ba bcas kyi rgyu 'gror/ dngul srang stong dang brgyad cu lhag tsam song ba dang / nyid nas smon lam gyi skabs 'grem rgyu'i gdugs legs pa gnyis/ rgyal mtshan gnyis/ dan gnyis/ khrus stegs kyi yol ba tshem grub ma/ khrag mchod pa gnyis kyi phrag khebs spus legs cha 'grigs bcas phul cing / spyi bla brang so so la 'bul ba rgya chen po bstabs/ smon lam gyi skabs spyi nas tshogs dbur gdan drangs/ rgya nag nas bde bar phyag phebs pa'i dga' ston du brtan bzhugs phul te/ khri ba wang paṇ+ḍi ta hu thog thus maṇ+ḍal gyi bshad pa 'brel chags pa zhig zhus thog spyi bla brang so so nas legs 'bul btegs shing /dge 'dun tshang mas mjal kha zhus/ rje nyid gsung chos dang smon lam la phebs te/ 'brel ba thogs pa'i bla dpon sbyin bdag grwa rigs che rim rnams kyi ming tho bkod pa tshogs dbus su bsgrags nas thugs smon rgya chen po mdzad/ sku 'bum/ bya khyung / gser khog / mchod rten thang / gan chen sogs nye 'khor gyi chos sde che chung mang po'i bla ma las sne ci rigs/stong 'khor hu thog thu/ mtsho skyes pe zi/ dge 'dun gung sogs bla dpon 'ga' zhig gi mi sna/ yong khrang gi rgyab tshe chos rje khu dpon/ gzhan yang grong 'brog gi sde khrod nas dad 'dus kyi sbyin bdag drag zhan shin tu mang ba bcas smon lam gye ring la nyin re bzhin bla brang rang du thag nye ring gi 'grul ba zam ma chad bar byung ste/ de dag spyi sger so sos legs 'bul zhus/nyid nas kyang so so la go bab dang bstun te/ gang la gang 'tsham gyi gnang skyes rgya chen po stsal/ dgon sde so sor yang dge 'dun zhal grangs mang nyung 541

༄/ /gung thang bstan ba'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/gis phye ba'i mang 'gyed kyi thebs phon che ba gnang / smad nas chibs skyel du 'ongs pa'i har chin wang gi gu thi tā bla ma bsam grub nyi ma/ khā yum chung /cang ki bstan 'dzin/ khun tu ang ga rag / hūn gar pe zi'i dge bskos chos ldan/ khā phun tshogs bkra shis/ a lag shā wang gi tha'i ji nu su has/dwags po tshang gi ja'i sang / tshe dbang thus lag chi'i dpon po zla ba rnams g.yog 'khor dang bcas phyir ldog rgyur/ sku 'dra dang spos snam byin rten srung mdud sogs bab 'os kyi gnang sbyin dang bka' lung bzang pos mgu bar mdzad cing / ho sho'u so so'i bla dpon sbyin bdag rnams la gnang rgyu'i gsung shog rnams sprad/ sngar gan chen gyi ba tshwa rab 'byams pa tshul khrims rgya mtsho dang / ba ri dge slong 'od zer rgya mtsho gnyis kyis sbyin bdag byas nas/ byams pa'i gos sku chen mo gtad gnyer zhus pa bzhin/ har chin nas rgyu dang bzo phun sum tshogs par bsgrubs nas gdan drangs pa la/rab gnas mdor bsdus mdzad de/ rgyu dang tshag gi 'brel ba thogs pa rnams kyi dge ba rdzogs byang du bsngo ba'i thugs smon mdzad/ yon bdag gnyis kyis legs 'bul gzab rgyas dang / dgon pa'i bla spyi so sos kyang legs 'bul zhus/ yon bdag rab 'byams pa tshul khrims rgya mtsho la chos rje'i cho lo gnang zhing / rgyal ba'i sku bzhengs pa'i phan yon mu mtha' yas pa las brtsams pa'i bsngags brjod kyis spro ba bskyed de rjes su yi rang gis dge tshogs gong du spel/ slob chung ngag dbang bkra shis dang gos sku'i yon bdag rnams kyis dgon par gdan 'dren gyi snyan gsal phul/ gos sku dang lhan du nyid nas kyang gan chen dgon la mang 'gyed 'bul ba bskur/bkra shis 'khyil du 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa rin po cher mtshams zhur po'u kyā nang so ngo g.yog ched mngags gtong / dkon mchog rin chen chos kyi rgya 542

༄/ /chabatsug ba nyis gsangagag pabadakarasadabyung/mtsho che/ / zhes sogs snyan tshig gi lam nas drangs pa'i zhu yig tshigs su bcad pa dang / rgya nas phebs pa'i skyes kyi tshul du rgya ser dang / / rgya nag gi gos chen sogs srus gtsang ba'i dngos 'bul gtos che ba 'bul rgyu bskur/sgrub sde byang chub gling du gdan drangs nas lo gsar gyi gsol ja zhus shing /khri ba sems nyid zhabs drung gtsos pa'i bsam gtan pa rnams la/ rje gong mas mdzad pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi lung dang / sman chog 'dzug thebs su dung tshe khron brgya gnang / khri pa wang bla brang du gdan drangs te sger du zhabs brtan 'bul nod zhus shing / gzhan spyi bla brang so sor yang 'byor ston zhus/ li kyā bla brang du zhabs drung la rab byung gi sdom pa gnang / wang hu thog thu gtsos pa'i dgon lung 'dus spyi nas/ lcang skya rol pa'i rdo rje'i sprul sku 'khrul med myur gsal gyi ched du gsung brtags zhus par brtags zhib gnang ste/ sprul sku 'khrul bral myur du 'byon pa 'dug / 'on kyang sku tshe brtan pa'i ched du tshe gzungs ci mang dang / grub mtha' gtsang ba yong ched du dmigs brtse ma 'gro gang che/ thugs rab rgyas pa'i ched du 'jam dbyangs kyi sku 'dra mang du bzhengs dgos pas/ rim gro gzhan rnams khyed tshos sgrubs/ 'jam dbyangs kyi sku brnyan nged nas bsgrub gsung ste/ lo de nang du pir thogs dbang po du mas 'jam dbyangs kyi rigs mi 'dra ba'i sku thangagaser tshon phun sum tshogs pa mang po bzhengs/ bya khyung gi bla ma dbu mdzad stag lung dge bshes 'jam dbyangs grags pa dang / bla brang phyag mdzod/ tshogs chen dge bskos/ spyi pa'i gnyer pa dpon g.yog bcu lhag tsam 'ongs nas/ chos sde de ga'i khrir bzhugs dgos kyi snyan gsan nan tan zhus par/ sngar pe cing du phebs dus mar tshang nas snyan gsan phul ba la rten 'brel gyi khyad du dgongs nas zhal lon thal song ba bzhin/ rib 543

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/tsam bzhugs rgyu'i zhal bzhes gnang ste/ ra zhi dka' bcu phyag mdzod du bskos nas gnyer pa 'od zer dang bcas thab 'dzin du btang / skabs shig gro tshang mkhan po phebs par/ 'jam dbyangs a ra pa tsa'i rjes gnang dang / gcod khrid smon lam mtha' yas rgya mtsho'i gsung sogs bzhed chos 'ga' zhig gnang / thar pa gling bas lo snga ma rnams su rje nyid kyi zhal bkod ltar/ sum pa mkhan chen gdan drangs nas chos 'brel dang / bla ma sgom pa ngag dbang rab brtan gyi zhal snga nas gdan drangs nas dbyar zhal bzhes dang / bla ma mchod pa'i khrid/ lam rim chen mo'i bshad lung /'du khang du sems bskyed mchod pa rgyas pa/ gzhi gsum cho ga dang chos spyod rab gsal gyi ljags lung sogs gsung chos du ma zhus 'dug par thugs mnyes shing / slob chung rnying ba ma 'tshams par lo dkar dka' bcu ngag dbang bstan dar slob chung du bskos nas sa ga zla ba'i yar tshes la der gtong ba gnang / rje 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa sku 'bum du phebs par mjal phrad kyi don la phebs zhor du zi ling nas am pan dang dngos phrad gnang / sku 'bum spyi so'i thab bsu/ dge 'dun mang gis ser sbrengs sogs kyis mdun bdar te stag tsher sgar bar babs/ rje 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa dang mjal nas nyin gsum bzhugs ring la/ mi nyag sbrul skus zhus pa'i man ngag lhan thabs kyi lung dang / gzhan yang tshe dbang brgya rtsa/ sman chog rgyas pa/ rta mgrin gsang sgrub kyi bsnyen sgrub las gsum gter gzhung le tshan gsum shangs pa'i yig rnying sogs ljags lung thor bu du ma zhig gsan/dbus gtsang dang rgya nag / chen po hor yul gyi gang ci'i gnas tshul gyi gsung gleng rgya cher 'phel/ dgon pa'i dge 'dun hrag bsdus la dga' ldan lha brgya ma'i khrid mkhas grub chig brgyud kyi man ngag dang sbyar nas gzab 544

sa / /che badza gsaza pa d+ma dam bgasadagakabashad gnang / mchod sdong chen mor mchod mjal thog gsol 'debs dang thugs bskyed smon lam rgya chen po mdzad/ tshogs chen dang bshad sgrub gling /rgyud pa/ sman pa rnams la mang ja dang gra ja'i bsnyen bkur zhus/ phyir 'khor te bco lnga'i dus chen nyin rnam rgyal stong mchod la phyag skor mang du mdzad cing / phyag tshwa mang po dpar 'debs mdzad/ zung gru'u zi'i rta dpon dge legs kyi ngag lam nas sbyin bdag har chin wang rat+na sirnyi ri bo rtse lngar mjal du 'ongs te/ de nas sku 'das pa'i gtam gsan pas/ wang 'di'i mes po'i dus nas bla rabs bla thog tu 'brel ba'i sbyin bdag gi gtso bo yin gshis thugs shin tu 'tsher zhing / dgon lung tshogs chen du mang ja bcubazhi sku 'gyed dang bcas btang thog dge 'dun gyi sde rin po cher ched gtad kyi skyabs 'jug dang thugs smon gyi mtshams sbyor zhus shing / nyid nas kyang zhag kha shas kyi ring sku mtshams bsdams nas/ nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i sgo nas sbyang chog gi spyan dmigs mdzad/ de dus zhal nas/ mdang rmi lam du bar snang la bu mo mdzes ma rgyan chas can gnyis kyis wang gi g.yas g.yon nas bskyor te shar nas nub phyogs su 'gro gin 'dug cing / khong rangagis nga'i ngo la bltas nas dga' ba'i rnam pa dang lag pa thal mo sbyar ba'i stangs ka byas te thag ring zhig tu dal gyis song ba rmis/ wang kho rang ci 'dra'i brel ba che na'ang yar ngo mar ngo'i tshes bcu'i mchod pa chag med du mdzad pa zhig yin pas/ nges par rdo rje rnal 'byor mas rjes su bzung ba yin 'dug gsungs/ tshul 'dis/ snying nas re ltos 'cha' ba rnams bslu ba med pa'i skyob pa mchog tu nges par nus so/ / phul byung thabs mkhas 'jug pa brgya phrag gis/ /pha mtha' yas pa'i dad ldan skye bo rnams/ /phan dang bde ba'i dpal la sbyor ba'i tshul/ /phal gyis smra bsam brjod pa'i yul 545

/ /gung bang bstanapa'izlaname'i gsung ཿma/las 'das/ / phang med gtong ba'i dad ldan bsnyen bkur dang / / phongs pa kun sgrol skyabs kyi sbyin pa gnyis/ / phan tshun 'gran pa bzhin du 'phel ba yis/ / pha rol zhi ba'i sgo lam yang por phye/ / zhes kyang go bar bya'o/ / a lag shā wang gis rje nyid la sku tshab cig zhus pa bzhin/ co gong chos rje ngag dbang dge legs gtong ba gnang / lnga pa'i yar tshes la lung dkar ri khrod du phebs te sum pa mkhan chen dang mjal phrad mdzad cing nyin gnyis kyi ring chig drangs shing dga' ston 'phel/ mkhan chen la tshe lha'i sku brnyan/dngul gos sogs kyi 'bul ba dang ri khrod la mang 'gyed btang / de dus ri khrod kyi nags 'dab su khams sang la phebs par/ zhabs phyir btsun chung bsam med cig yod pa de la/ nged tshos slar mkhan chen dang mjal phrad yong ngam mi yong zhes dris pa la/ khos mjal phrad yong zhus pas/ 'dis rdzun bshad 'dug gsung pa phyis su de bzhin byung / 'dul ba dgon du bsu ba ser sprengs dang bcas spyan drangs te/ nyin kha shas bla spyi phan tshun du dga' ston 'phel zhing / dge 'dun gyi sder mang 'gyed dang / spyi 'jog la smon lam skabs su byams skor la gdan 'dren rgyu'i gser zangs kyi byams sku byis pa lo brgyad kyi bong tshod tsam pa/ gos chen gyi bla bre/ me tam cha bcas phul/ di yān chi/ nom chi/ rgyal sras ri khrod rnams nas mtshams zhus pa bla ma las sne ci rigs 'ongs shing / de dag la mang 'gyed kyi thebs bskur/ bco lnga'i nyin har chin wang gi dgongs rdzogs pa khā nye ba ngo g.yog slebs nas bsngo rten dngul srang bzhi bcu'i maṇ+ḍal/ mang nug sogs gos chen yug bzhi/ rgya dngul rdo tshad drug bcas phul/ mtshan mo gza' 'dzin byung bar zhal 'don ched dmigs gnang / tshur lam gser dgon du gdan drangs pa bzhin/ dgon pa spyi dang grwa tshang so so'i bla ma las sne ci 546

༄/ /༄sa tha4cho migyi ga4gtsosagagasaba'akhanarigs kyi bsu ba dang dge 'dun mang po'i ser sbrengs dang bcas zhwa lu ba bla brang du babs/ dge 'dun rnams la de nas mjal kha gnang / jo mjal gnang ste thugs bskyed smon layomadzad/ mā bla brang du gdan drangs nas gsol ston 'bul nod dang / bla spyi gzhan so so nas kyang dem ja dang dngos 'bul zhus/ tshogs chen du mang 'gyed 'bul pa gzab rgyas zhu ba gnang /de nas lam zhor du chu bzang rin po che dang mjal phrad mdzad cing gsung gleng 'phel/ dgon par mang 'gyed gnang / sgrub sde byang chub gling du khri ba sems nyid zhabs drung gtsos pa'i ri khrod pa rnams la spyan ras gzigs snying po don gsum gyi khrid nyin gsum gyi ring gzab bshad stsal cing / sman chog rgyas pa sogs ljags lung 'ga' zhig kyang gnang / dgon lung gi drug pa'i smon lam har chin wang gi dgongs rdzogs sgrub thebs kyis btang bar/ bla brang nas khur blangs bgyis te dkon mchog la mchod pa dang dge 'dun la mang 'gyed kyi bsnyen bkur gzab rgyas bsgrubs/ el chi dang lhan du gnyer ba blo bzang yar 'phel ched mngags gtong / wang gi gdung mchod la/ kha btags nang mdzod/ dngul srang nyer lnga'i maṇ+ḍal/ dngul srang brgya dang nyer bdun las bsgrubs pa'i mchod rdzas kyi skor du ma/ bzang spos phyags pa brgyad/ 'chad pa'i lha khang la dgram rgyu'i sku gong ma'i rten gras bde ba can gye zhing bkod kyi thang ka tshag grub ma/ mi 'khrugs pa'i sku/rdo rje gcod pa dang smon lam rnam lnga gser bris po ti gcig / rnam rgyal mchod rten/ ke ka ni bris ba'i kha btags che legs cha/ dge sgrub kyi zhal 'debs su dngul srang stong phrag gcig bcas dang / sbyin bedag yum sras rnams la sems gso dang bslab ston gyi bka' shog lha rten sogs bskur ba gnang / na'i man gyi ha ta hu'i su me'i bla ma dang yon bdag rnams kyis 547

༄/ /yo ba ngastan pa'ithoname'i gsung 'bum/bka' 'gyur gtad gnyer zhus pa'ang 'di res bskur/ de nas lang gru'u phyogs kyi rgyal yag dgon pa spo rgyu'i gnas gzigs la 'byon rgyur/ lam bar du grong 'brog gi dad ldan du ma'i bsnyen bkur bdag gir bzhes shing khrus dbang dang phyag dbang / mtshan dang gzungs sngags rna lam du sgogs pa/ ma ṇi'i bzlas lung dang khas len bskor ba sogs kyi dga' ston gang 'dod du spel bzhin pa'i ngang nas chibs kyi kha lo mngon par bsgyur/ gan chen ri dgon nas sngar gdan 'dren zhus yod pa bzhin/ 'dan ma sprul sku/bla ma slob chung / bla ma dbu mdzad sogs las sne chos rje dka' ram dang /pa tsha dpon po sogs mchod gzhi'i mgo ba bcas rta ba sum brgya tsam gyis 'phred pa nas chibs bsu zhus shing / rim gyes rta bsu thab bsu khag mang po dang / 'dus sde'i dge 'dun rnams kyis ser sbrengs mchod rol dang bcas bkur ste chen pos mdun bsus te/ 'dan ma bla brang du babs/nyin kha shas bzhugs te 'dan ma sprul sku dpal ldan thub bstan rgyal mtshan/slob chung ngag dbang bkra shis/ bla ma dbu mdzad pa bsod nams sogs chos rje dka' ram dge bshes du mas gtsos ser skya sum stong nye ba la spyan ras gzigs snying po don gsum gyi khrid rgyas par gnang / spyi sger gyis shangasayen gsol ston gzabs shing / 'dan ma bla brang nas maṇ+ḍal/ kha btags/ sku gsung thugs rten/ rta bzang / gos chen/ dngul srang lnga bcu/ dong tshe khron brgya sogs dang / gzhan spyi bla brang dang tsho ba so so nas gos dar dngul sogs 'bul ba spam mtho ba phul/ bsgrub bya nyi shur nye ba la bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa dang / 'dan ma sprul sku dpon g.yog lnga la dpal mgon gyi rjes gnang bka' rgya dang bcas gnang / sprul sku rin po cher thugs dgyes pa'i gsung gleng dang / rnam dkar bslab sbyang sogs la 548

༄/ /rjebam0bzangachos nyima'ig4gagasapasagakhasadabyung/thugs brtson byed dgos kyi zhal bkod zhib lhugs dang / gnang skyes gya nom pa stsal/ tshogs par mang 'gyed gzab rgyas btang / gos sku'i sbyin bdag chos rje tshul khrims rgya mtshos gshag tu gdan drangs nas legs 'bul zhus/ de nas 'bri gu dgon pa'i khri gdan zur gyis gtsos skya ser gyi phebs bsu ring thung brgya phrag du mas/ rab kha dang skyid lung sogs nas chibs bsu dang / rdo dkar thang nas thab bsu zhus shing / dge 'dun mang pos ser sbrengs dang bcas der phyag phebs te nyin kha shas bzhugs/ bla ma khri ba ba za ngag dbang bstan 'dzin/ ko tsha zhabs drung skal bzang mchog grub/sems nyid zhabs drung chos rgya mtsho/ shen 'byung zhabs drung skal bzang dngos grub sogs zhabs drung sku skye dka' ram dge bshes du mas gtsos ser skya nyis stong tsam la'ang spyan ras gzigs snying po don gsum gyi khrid rgyas par stsal/ ri dgon thams cad kyis gzhi len dang / gos dar dngul/ rta nor sogs dngos 'bul spam mtho ba phul/ bla brang so so nas kyang gsol ston dang 'bul ba btegs/ don gnyer can so so'i ngor byang chub lam sgon dang / 'jigs byed bdud las rnam rgyal sogs ljags lung thor bu mang po dang / shen 'byung slob chung gi sku skye la rab byung gi sdom pa gnang ste/mtshanablo bzang legs bshad nyi ma zhes btags/ tshogs par mang 'gyed 'bul ba/ spyi 'jog tu gos chen bzang bsgrubs kyi gnam rgyan legs pa bcas phul/ de nas rim gyis 'brog sde'i mi rnams phyag dbang chos 'brel gyis tshim par mdzad cing / rgyal yag dgon pa'i slob chung sngo kho chos rje gtsos pa'i che gras dang / tsho ba'i rgan gsum sogs thab bsu rta bsu rim pa du ma dang bcas/ bdun pa'i tshe gnyis la dar chen thang du babs nas/dgon pa spo rgyu'i gnas gzigs dang byin rlabs mdzad/ dge 'dun gyi 549

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'izaname'i gsung 'bum/ser sgrengs kyis mdun bsus te dgon par phebs/ hor grub chen dang /zhwa dmar bla ma chos snyan grags/ se chen zhabs drung sogs phyogs tha dad kyi dgon pa nas bla ma las sne ci rigs rim par 'ongs nas gdan 'dren gyi snyan gsan phul bar/ lam zhor du phebs chog pa rnams la 'byon rgyu'i zhal len gnang / gzhi byes kyi ser skya stong phrag brgal ba la spyan ras gzigs kyi rjes gnang stsal/ dgon pa spyi dang / tsho ba drug so so nas 'byor 'khos kyi 'bul nod gang legs zhus/ dgon par mang 'gyed gzab rgyas dang bla brang dang 'du khang ja khang sogs 'bub tshul gyi zhal bkod thabs dang bcas pa gnang / phyir lam bod yul dang or tsho ri khrod pa rnams 'dod chos dang mang 'gyed kyis tshim par mdzad cing / dor 'i dang tā ban dgon nas gdan 'dren pa 'ongs par slar 'byon rgyu'i zhal len gnang ste dgon pa so sor mang 'gyed kyi thebs bskur/ zhwa dmar dgon pa'i khri ba dang zhabs drung sku skye/ chen hu dang tsho ba so so'i mgo ba sogs ser skya'i bsu ba tshan mang po thebs su ser sbrengs rgyas pa dang bcas dgon du 'byor te bla brang gong mar bzhugs/ ser skya'i khrom chen por rnam rgyal lha dgu'i rjes gnang stsal/ri dgon gyis gsol ston dang dngul dung tshe rta nor sogs dngos 'bul rgya chen po phul/ nyin kha shas bzhugs ring la tshigs snga phyi'i sdom pa dang so so'i 'dod chos phyag dbang bka' bsgo lngags bsngo skyabs 'jug sogs gang zhus thams cad yid tshim par stsal/ dgon par mang 'gyed 'bul ba gzabs/stag lung dang 'bri gung nas gdan 'dren pa byung bar slar 'byon rgyu byas nas stag lung sprul sku dang 'bri gung grub chen sprul sku rnam gnyis la dngos skyes gya nom pa dang / dgon pa gnyis la mang 'gyed kyi thebs bskur/ yar klung dang chu klung sogs lam zhor du phebs chog pa rnams la zhal len gnang ste 550

༄/ /rjebatsun bzangachosaminyisa'igagangags pamadakurasadabyungakaphebs zhor du phun tshogs lung bar nyid kyi 'khrungs gnas nor bu thang la sbra shul du gyang brtsigs yod pa der byon te dge mtshan spel ba'i cho ga mdzad cing chung dus kyi rnam thar ngo mtshar can mang po zhig gsungs/ rim gyis 'brog khyim rnams su gdan drangs pa'i don mdzad cing / ur ze'i gong chen du yar klung dgon pa'i bla ma khri ba gtsos pa'i spyi bla brang gi mdzod gnyer las sne dka' ram sogs dang / rgya tig dang mā/ stobs tshang sogs tsho ba so so'i mgos rnams dang bcas ser skya brgya phrag du mas chibs bsu dang thab bsu zhus/ lung bzang gong khor du rgya tig tsho ba'i thab bsu'i thog dad 'dus kyi skye pho mo'i khrom chen por phyag dbang chos 'brel gnang zhing / nyid kyi 'khrungs lha gzhi bdag dge bsnyen gzi brjid 'phags la bsang dang dkar gtor bsngos te dbang bstod mdzad/ de nas tsho ba so so'i ja thab thog dad 'dus kyi pho mo shin tu mang po la phyag dbang chos 'brel gnang zhing dge 'dun mang pos ser sbrengs kyis mdun bsus te yar klung dgon du 'byor/ khri ba lha ram pa ngag dbang bsod nams kyis gtsos ser skya sum stong brgal bar bla ma mchod pa'i khrid lung gnang / spyi sger so so nas gsol ston dang dngos 'bul sbam mtho ba phul/ bsgrub bya drug cur nye ba la rab byung dang dge tshul slong gi sdom pa gnang ste/ kun spyor 'ching brgya gcod pa'i nus ba zin par mdzad/ tshogs par mang 'gyed dang 'bul ba spam mtho ba gnang / de nas chu klung dgon du ri dgon gye rta thab ser sgrengs bcas phebs te ser skya'i khrom la lam gtso'i khrid stsal/ gsol ston 'bul ba gzabs shing phyir dge 'dun rnams la'ang mang 'gyed gnang / tas thung dgon chen gyi bla ma khri ba gdan 'dren du 'ongs te chibs bskyod par lu kyā zhabs drung gis gtso'i rta bsu brgya phrag gis brag 'gag gi mda' nas thab bsu dang / mar zhi ri khrod 551

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'isgoname'i gsung 'bum/pa rnams kyis kyang lam nas gsol ja dang phyag dbang chos 'brel zhus/dge 'dun mang po'i ser sbrengs dang bcas dgon chen du 'byor/ zhabs drung ye shes skal ldan dar rgyas dang khri ba dam chos dar rgyas sogs ser skya'i khrom chen por rten 'brel bstod pa dang bka' chos dkyus ma rnams kyi ljags lung phyag dbang bcas gnang / gsol ston 'bul nod sogs bsnyen bkur phu dud yang dag zhus shing / nyid nas kyang dgon par mang 'gyed sogs 'tshem med du stsal/ lu kyā bla brang du'ang gsol ston 'bul ba zhus/ tas thung gi chu khar thar ba gling gi slob chung lo dkar chos rje las sne dang bcas gdan 'dren du 'byor/ ser lung srog mkhar so so'i dge 'dun rnams kyis sgar tho gnas bsnyen bkur dar phyag dbang chas 'brel zhus/ phar yang mang 'gyed 'bul ba gnang / a gyu ri khrod kyi sku skye dang skyo dkar dgon pa'i las sne 'ga' zhig gden 'dren du 'ongs par ma phebs kyang mang 'gyed thebs bskur ba gnang / dgon gser thar ba gling du thab bsu ser sbrengs dang bcas phyag phebs te dge 'dun rnams la ja thug gi bsnyen bkur thog 'gyed dung tshe khron re gnang / tshogs yongs la lcang skya rdo rje 'chang gi bka' rtsom mi 'khrugs pa'i cho ga'i lung dang 'jal ba mang bo phyag dbang sogs kyis tshim par mdzad/ bkra shis chos gling gi gdan 'dren pa 'ongs te rta thab ser sbrengs bcas der phebs/ tshogs dbur gdan drangs nas byang chub lam sgron dang spyan ras gzigs kyi bla rgyud gsol 'debs shis brjod rnams kyi lung zhus shing / brtan bzhugs kyi rten 'brel bsgrigs te dngos dbul gya nom pa phul/ dge 'dun mang po dang dad 'dus kyi skye pho mo mang po la phyag dbang stsal/ phyi nyin bkra shis chos gling nas thon/ 'brug lung dgon gyi khri pa o'u shi sku skye las sne bcas dang bsam gtan rtse'i bla ma 552

༄/ /rjebamayabacachosaminyima'igasangag mapamadagaracadabyunganalas sne rnams 'byor nas so sos thab bsu zhus/ bsam gtan rtse la mang 'gyed bskul zhing 'brug lung dgon du phebs te dge 'dun la 'jigs byed za ma tog gi lung dang mang 'gyed gnang / khran tsong ri khrod du phebs nas de'i 'du khang nyid nas 'bub thebs dang ljags bkod stsal ba bzhin 'bub kyin yod bar gzigs rtog mdzad de bcu pa'i tshes mgor gsar ba'am/bu med pe zi tshe brtan bkra shis kyi mi sna nang so shag sha bang ngo g.yog 'ongs nas bsgug yod pas mjal kha zhus te pe zi'i zhu shog bzhugs gdan rgyab yol dngul srang lnga bcu bcas dang / gzhan bla dpon sbyin bdag du ma'i zhu yig rten chas rnams phul/ nang so ngo g.yog la bde mchog dkar po'i rjes gnang dang go bab kyi gnang sbyin mdzad cing 'byor lan rnams sprad/gser khri sprul sku dang har chin cho'u thu'i mkhan po chos mdzad mkhan po sogs bod nas 'byor te 'jal kha zhus par gnas tshul gyi gsung gleng 'phel/ bya khyung nas gdan 'dren pa bla ma dbu mdzad gtsos pa'i las sne dka' ram drag zhanamang po 'byor te bcu dgu'i nyin skya dar stag rnga gdugs rgya gling sogs chen po'i las tshan rnams bsgrigs te bya khyung gi gdan 'dren pa dang /dgonalung gi bde rgu mkhan po/ rgyud pa bla zur tshing zhwa chos rje/ tshogs chen dbu mdzad spyi gnyer gra rgan sogs ma bu dgon gyi bla ma las sne chos rje dka' ram dge tshul slong / bla rte nang so dang bde rgu nang so sogs mchod gzhi'i mi skya drag zhan/ yong khrang gi slob chung khyung tsha zhabs drung ngo g.yog bcas gzhi byes kyi chibs skyel ba brgya phrag kha shas dang lhan du dgon lung nas thon/ dgon pa'i khri ba wang paṇ+ḍi ta zhabs drung gis gtsos zhabs drung sku skye chos rje dka' ram shin tu mang pos skyel thung zhus/ tsong chu'i phar 'gram du bya khyung gi rgyud pa dpon slob dang bde yang zhabs drung rnam gnyis gtsos pa'i 553

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/bla ma las sne dka' ram che gras brgya phrag brgal ba dang / bi'i sngon la sgang dug dong 'jug mkhan po dang mdo ba mkhan po rnam gnyis gtsos pa'i dgon ma lag gi grwa ba che gras skor dang ti tsha dpon po ting ka dpon po sogs gcan rong gnyis kyi yon bdag drag zhan bcas ser skya nyis brgya tsam gyi chibs bsu dang / khrom tshang du dgon pa spyis thab bsu zhus/ nyer gnyis kyi nyin bya khyung dgon theg chen yon tan dar rgyas gling gi nye 'dabs su gzhi byes kyi dge 'dun nyis stong nye bas ser sprengs dkyus ring gis gdugs rgyal mtshan ba dan sogs mchod pa'i yo byad tshar du dngar zhing 'bud dkrol sogs kyi rol cha dang dri zhim po'i spos 'dren gyis mdun bsus te bla brang du babs/ thog mar chos rje don grub rin po che'i seng khrir bzhugs nas rten 'brel bsgrigs par mdzad cing / de rjes 'du khang du tshogs dbur phebs te chos khrir bzhugs nas dge 'dun mang la lam rim chen mo'i dbu nas gsung chos thun gcigasnal te mjug tu grwa mang la phyag dbang gnang / rje 'jam dbyangs bzhadapa rin po che nas pang chen pa gsol dpon dge bshes bstan pa dar rgyas ched mngags gtong kha btags nang mdzod/ dngul gye maṇ+ḍal sne 'dogs can/ tshe dpag med kyi sku brnyan/ tshe mdo/ mchod rten/bzhugasagadan rgyab yol/ gos chen yug lnga/ dngul srang lnga bcu/ ja pag bcu/ sdu drug / ar ti/ 'bu ras/ se ras/ lad sogs khri 'bul rnam grangs brgya dang gcig / mdo smad kyi ljongs 'di'i chos sde kun gye phyi mo lta bur gyur pa'i gdan sa chen po nyid kyi chos khrir mnga' gsol ba shin tu legs tshul gyis ched du bsngags pa'i gsung shog dang bcas bskur gnang mdzad pas thog drangs te bya khyung bla spyi so so dang bkra shis 'khyil 'dus spyi'i mi sna/ bde rgu mkhan po dang tshing kyā rgyud zur sogs dgon lung ma lag 554

༄/ /rjebatsug bza0chosaminyima'ig4gsusapasadakhasadabyungakagi chibs skyel pa rnams dang / yong khrang dgon pa'i slob chung dpon g.yog / sku 'bum stag 'tsher sgar ba dang sha sprang an ja su rnams kyi mi sna sogs phyogs tha dad kyi 'grul ba so so nas 'bul ba tshan grangs mang po bstar te khri 'bul gyi bshad pa rgyas pa dang bcas rten 'brel phun sum tshogs pa bsgrigs/ bla brang nas gzhi byes thams cad la ston mo gzab rgyas zhus shing dgon pa'i bla spyi so sor 'bul ba dang dge 'dun la mang 'gyed/ chibs skyel ba dang mi sna rnams la dngos po'i gnang cha sogs 'tshem med du stsal/chibs skyel ba spyi sger nas kyang dgon par mang 'gyed kyi bsnyen bkur zhus/phyogs tha dad nas 'dus pa'i mjal ba ser skya mang por mjal kha gnang /chos rwa nas gzhi byes thams cad la 'cham gyi ltad mo bstar ba gzigs rtog mdzad/ zhabs phyir 'ongs pa bde rgu mkhan po dang gzhung las pa bzang rin rab 'byams pa gnyis kyis dam bca' bzhag ste phan tshun du legs par bshad pa'i dga' ston spel/ dgon lung tshogs chen dbu mdzad sogs dka' ram kha shas zhabs phyir bsdad nas skye lam mang po phyir log / lha khang so so dang nang rten rnams la zhib tu mjal zhing gser gdung chen mor brgya mchod phul te dge 'dun brgya phrag mang po dang lhan cig par yan lag bdun pa maṇ+ḍal dang bcas pa/ yon tan gzhir gyur ma/ bzang spyod/ bstan 'bar ma rnams 'ur chem gyis gsungs nas mkha' khyab bstan 'gro yongs kyi phan bde'i srog zungs su 'gyur ba'i thugs smon rgya chen po mdzad/ dam can gyi btsan khang du gter nas bton pa'i rdo rje snyan shal 'dod gsol can phul te 'azin bcol gnang / rdo rje phag mo'i lha khang du rkang brgyad kyi bstod pa dang mkha' spyod zhal bzang blta ba'i smon lam sogs gsungs te spyan dmigs nan tan mdzad/ bzhugs ring la brel ba che dus ma gtogs nyin 555

༄/ /gung thang bstan ba'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/ltar gung zhog gnyi ga'i chos grwar chag med du phebs nas brtsi bzhag gnang zhing 'dzin grwa so so'i bgro gleng gi rgyug kyang blangs/ 'grig lam skor gyi tshogs gtam yang zhib rgyas snyan 'bul gnang bas thams cad kyis gus pas dang du blangs te tshogs chos grwar hur skyed mdzad pa byung / kyang ring dgon gong ma'i bla ma seng ge dad chen hu mjal du 'ongs par 'dod chos sogs gnang / phyir lam bla chen gyi mdun du mchod sprin rgya mtsho spros te dpon g.yog tshang mas yan lag bdun pa dang gsol 'debs smon lam rgyas par mdzad/ u shing shes rab yon tan chos rje la 'dod chos 'ga' zhig dang /de ga'i mkhan po blo bzang rdo rjes zhu shog gi lam nas bskul ba'i chos rgyal phyi nang gsang gsum gye bsnyen pa dang sbyin sreg bya tshul peḍūl+la'i phreng ba bka' rgya can ljags rtsom mdzad/ ston dgun gyi mtshams nas skus bsnyel tshul bstan te bsnyun gzhi bab lci tsam byung bar/ bkra shis 'khyil du bde rgu chos mdzad ched mngags kyis rje 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa rin po cher lung zhu dang /dgon par mang 'gyed thog zhabs brtan mang po bsgrubs shing / sku 'bum dang bya khyung / mchod rten thang / gan chen/ sems nyid/ 'bri gu/rgyal yag / zhwa dmar/ rab rgyas/ 'bri gung / stag lung / yar klung / chu klung / tas thung / ser lung / srog mkhar/ lo dkar/a kyā/ thar pa gling / mā yang / bsam gtan rtse/ bkra shis chos gling /len hwa thas/ sha rdzong / yan ja su/ chu bzang / 'dul ba/ lung dkar/ ti yān chi/ nom chi/ rgyal sras ri khrod bcas dgon sgrub sde sum cu lhag la dngul srang stong phrag phyed dang gnyis kyis mang 'gyed btang ste bka' 'gyur tshar drug / yum rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum tshar bcu gnyis/gser 'od stong tshar/ gdugs sher sgrol gsum 'bum ther bcu re/ tshe lha 556

sa / /rje btsun tshazang44 mi d+ma shakhamakhas kagasum gyi snying po khri phrag bdun re/ dam can gyi bskang bshags 'bum ther gcig / dgon lung tshogs chen du mang ja brgya lhag dang / rgyud par grwa ja brgya lhag 'gyed bcas zhus thog spyi bskang dang drug cu ba/ rnam rgyal gzungs ring / gdugs sher sgrol ma 'gro gang che/ sgrub sde byang chub gling mang 'dus bde chen chos gling gsum la sman chog rgyas bsdus dang dpal mgon gyi glo bur las btsol rgyun ldan/ gong gsal gyi dgon sgrub sde rnams dang slob ma drag zhan spyi sger nas kyang rang rang gi 'dod mos kyis zhabs brtan rgya chen po bsgrubs pa dang / bla brang du'ang dge 'dun brgya lhag gis bka' 'gyur dag 'don/ dge 'dun bco lnga res mgon po'i zhi ba'i gtor sgrub dang gtor chen lcags mkhar rnams nyin zhag bdun re/ dgon lung khri ba sogs bla ma bzhis sgrub grogs bcu re dang bcas ya ma rā dza'i bdun mtshams mdzad nas las bzhi'i sbyin sreg / dge 'dun bcu res bde mchog dkar bo dang sgrol dkar tshe dpag med gsum gyi tshe sgrub/ bla ma sgom pas tshe bdag mgon po'i tshe sgrub/ zhing sgom pa sogs ri khrod pa khag so so nas tshe sgrub zhag bdun re/ dge 'dun bcus sher snying 'bum phrag gcig glud rdzong bcas dang / bcus rta mgrin gyi bsnyen pa zhag bdun dang de'i sgo nas gtor zlog dang brtan bzhugs 'chi blu/ cho ga pa 'ga' zhig gis nyin lnga'i ring khros nag gi bskang bshags dang 'brel bar mkha' 'gro'i bsun zlog dge 'dun rnams res bskor nas spyi bskang dang rgyal gsol rgyun ldan/ bar mtshams su brgya mchod dang bzang spyod 'chi blu/ tshogs brgya/ gdugs dkar zlog chen dang rgyal rdzongs/ rgyal mdos sogs gto bcos kyi rigs mang po/ 'byung bzhi dang lan chags gtor ma/ sa 'bum chu 'bum srog blu grangs bsags pa dang zi ling gi ngan slong stong lhag la sbyin 557

༄/ /gung thangabastan ba'ithoname'i gsung 'bum/pa dang / skabs skabs su byis pa'i ston mo gnang ba sogs zla ba gnyis kyi ringal nyin bzhin mchod sbyin gyi sgo 'phar yongs por phyes te zhabs brtan par ma chad du bsgrubs/ sngon chad thag nye ring gi bsnyung 'dri ba dang zhabs brtan 'bul mkhan su la'ang mjal kha ma gnang yang / 'khrungs skar gye dga' ston nyin nyid kyang bskun gzhi cung zad dwangs yod pa dang / phyogs tha dad nas 'khrungs skar gyi dga' ston dang bskun 'dri la 'ongs pa'i 'grul ba drag zhan kyang mang bar de dag la mjal kha gnang zhing / dgon lung bla spyi dang bya khyung sogs chos sde 'ga' zhig gi bla ma las sne ci rigs khag so sos maṇ+ḍal sku gsung thugs rten gyis mtshon rten 'byung gi 'bul ba bstar te brtan bzhugs kyi rten 'brel bsgrigs thog/ wang zhabs drung rin po ches zhabs pad brtan pa'i gsol ba nan tan btab par bka' lan bzang po gnang / dgun zla tha chung rag la bskun gzhi lhag med du dwangs par chos skyong rnams la gtang rag gi gsol mchod gzab rgyas btang / snga sor bya khyung du rdo rje phag mo'i lha khang du mjal skabs sku brnyan de nyid shin tu zil che zhing / ldem ldem g.yo ba zhabs phyir yong mkhan thams cad kyis kyang mthong zhing / lhag par rje nyid kyi thugs snang la sku brnyan des khyed rang tshe phyi mar gdan 'dren nam gsung ba zhig byung bas/ thugs la dogs pa cung zad skyes shing / sku bsnyel ba'i skabs der 'ga' zhig gi mi lam du rje 'di nyid mkha' spyod du gdan 'dren pa'i pho nya yin zer ba'i ral gri gnyis bar snang la 'gro ba mis pa dang / rje 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa rin po che'i gsung brtag la mkha' 'gro'i bsun zlog gnad smin zhig gal che tshul phebs pa thams cad phyogs mthun pas/ de phral du bsun zlog gi cho ga 'khyer bde zhig bka' rtsom mdzad de bsgrub tu bcug pas zhabs brtan gzhan las kyang shin tu phan 558

sa / /rje patsun tha bas lab dkurashā cesaka'agyur che ba byung / yang de skabs nyid kyi gzigs snang la mtshon cha du ma thogs pa'i dmag gis bskor te bsdigs pa'i snang ba yang yang byung ba'i tshe khro bo'i bzlas pa dang srung 'khor sogs bsgom pas drung du bcar mi thub kyang cho 'phrul rtsa ba nas zhi ba zhig ma byung ba sems nyid sgom pa blo bzang yon tan gyis lcags mkhar zhig brdabs pa'i dgung mo nas rang zhir song / de skabs phun tshogs bstan pa sogs bsnyun g.yog rnams kyis dka' spyad drag po'isgo nas zhabs phyi hur skyed thugs zin nges zhus pas lhag par brtse bas dgongs te khyed tshos mkha' spyod ma'i dbang ye thob gsung bar/ ma rgyud kyi dbang med pas thob ma byung zhus pas/ 'o na khyed tshos sems nyid sgom pa la bde mchog gi dbang zhus shig / mkha' spyod ma'i dbang ngad kyis bskur chog ces ma zhus par zhal bzhes gnang / de dang dus mnyam du bde chen chos gling nas grwa ba zhig gis mkha' spyod ma'i nang rten thang ga zhig sku mdun dukhyer 'ongs pas/ rdo rje rnal 'byor mas rjes su 'dzin pa'i rten 'brel 'grigs byung zhes lhag par thugs dgyes pa'i rnam pa mdzad/ de nas bla slob kyi mtshams spyor rje nyid kyis mdzad pa bzhin dbus khang chen mor sems nyidasgom pa blo bzang yon tan gyis drung 'khor ba rnams dang dgon lung gi rgyud pa/ chos bzang gi sgrub mchod pa bcas dge 'dun nyis brgya skor la bde mchog khru yi ba'i dbang gnang / de rjes nyid nas drung 'khor pa dang sgrub mchod pa rnams la nā ro mkha' spyod kyi dbang dgyes bzhin du stsal/'dis mtshon tshag thon nas phyag g.yog sgrub mi rnams la phugs su legs pa'i spyan dmigs ched gtad gnang ba zhig yong snang ste/ res 'ga' gsung gi zhoral/ ngas nang dgung gi dus su khyed tshos tshag thon pa'i dge ba rnams byang chub tu bsngo bzhin yod mod kyang khyed tshos ha go ye yod mi shes zhes 559

༄/ /gung thang bstan ba'i me'igasung 'bum/gsungs tshul zhabs sdod rnams kyi ngag las thos/ tshul 'di ni 'khri shing las/ dam pa rnams ni phan pa'i cha/ / bu lon bzhin du sems par byed/ / ces dang / spre'u'i rgyal po'i skyes rabs las/ rigs mthun rnams kyis rab tu gus byas nas/ / gus pas phyag 'tshal bkur ste cher byas pa'i/ / dbang phyug bde ba thob par byas gyur pa'i/ / bu lon de ring bdag gis 'khor bar gyur/ / gsungs pa bzhin/ spyir 'gro ba mtha' dag ris su ma chad par snying rjes bdag gir mdzad na'ang / de'i nang nas kyang rang la 'brel thogs shing bsnyen bskur sogs tshul bzhin du bsgrubs pa rnams la lhag par yang drin du gzo dgos pa dang / de'ang zang zing gi dngos po sbyin pa sogs kyis gnas skabs su phan pa cung zad re 'byung yang / bdag nyid chen po rnams ni de tsam gyis chog shes mi mdzad par gzhan rgyud smin byed bsdu ba bzhi'i rim pas chos kyi lam la sbyar te/ ji skad du/ gang zhig gser gyi ri la gnas bcas pa/ / zhes sogs dang / bka' gdams gong ma rnams kyis kyang / theg pa mchog gi dge ba'i bshes gnyen gye dan rtags bsru ba med pa ni/ su nye ba de nyid bag med pa'i gnas las bzlog cing / yang dag pa'i lam la spyor bas phan pa zhig 'byung bar gsungs pa bzhin/gtan bde'i sgo 'phar phye ba 'di lta bu ni bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rnam thar dang gzhal du med pa'i bka' drin gyi phung por shes par bya'o/ / lo 'dir rta mgrin chos skor gyi yan lag tu lha de'i dam tshig gi snang brnyan bzhengs tshul mthong srol ngo mtshar ltad mo/ 'chi kha ma'i sems can la phan thabs bya tshul nyam thag dbugs 'byin/ 'khor lo'i man ngag gi zin tho / rgyal po sku lnga'ispog gtad bya tshul sogs gsung rtsom thor bu mang du gnang / dgung lo nga gnyis pa sa sprel gyi dus bzhi thog mar tshes pa'i dga' ston gyi nyin su nyid 560

༄/ /rdzobatsotshosazabachosamiyi ga4gtsosamadagarasogayu/g.yon ru'i wang dpal 'byor yar 'phel gyi mi sna khā dkon mchog ngo g.yog dang / or du su ja sag dka' rgyal tshe brtan rdo rje'i mi sna chos rje ngag dbang rgyal mtshan dang / rab 'byams pa ngag dbang dpal ldan ngo g.yog gis dpon po so sos bskur ba'i bdog pa'i dngos 'bul gya nom pa brtan bzhugs lugs su phul te gsol ba btab/ lcang skya thams cad mkhyen pa'i yang srid kyi don skor thag chod par rje nyid dgon lung gi bla ma las sne dang bcas chu bzang du phebs nas sprul skur mjal thog maṇ+ḍal kha btags/ sku gsung thugs rten bzhugs gdan rgyab yol sogs phul te rten 'brel phun sum tshogs pa bsgrigs par mdzad/ dgon lung gi cho 'phrul smon lam nyid nasayor du su ja sag dbang rgyal tshe brtan rdo rje la gtad gnyer mdzad pa bzhin mi sna'i gdong du dngul srang stong phrag gcig bskur ba bla brang nas khur blangs bgyis te dkon mchog gi mchod pa dang dge 'dun gyi bsnyen bkur gzab rgyas ngos smon lam chen mo legs par bsgrubs/ or du su o thog wangagi sras mo bkra shis lha mo/ dpal dar gling gi bla ma dbu mdzad byams pa yar 'phel dang / mi rin 'byung gnas sogs drag zhan gyi 'khor brgya phrag dang bcas mjal du 'ongs par 'dod mos bzhin sras mo nyid dang bla ma dbu mdzad pa sogs khong tsho'i skor dang / ja sag gi chos rje dang rab 'byams pa bcas skal ldan gyi slob ma bco lnga la rje btsun nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i dbang dang / de'i skyed rim rnal 'byor bcu gcig / rdzogs rim rtsa dbu ma/ gnyis bral 'chad dus kyi zhal shes/ gser chos bsam mi khyab thun mong min pa'i rnal 'byor dang / yab yum zung 'brel dang yum rkyang gi 'pho khrid sogs o ṭi ya na'i chos kyi gan mdzod phye ba lta bu'i gsang chen gdams pa'i nying khu mtha' yas pa lhug par stsal te smin cing grol ba'i lam la 561

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'isgroname'i gsung 'bum/bkod/ gzhan yang sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo'i rjes gnang 'od zer drug sprags/ mgon dkar yid bzhin nor bu'i rjes gnang / de'i sgrub skor dang gtor chog gi lung sogs chos bka' thor bu mang tsam stsal/ sras mos maṇ+ḍal kha btags/ sku gsung thugs rten/ bzhugs gdan rgyab yol/gos chen gnyis gser srang bdun dang zho lnga/ dngul srang sum brgya lnga bcu/bye ru'i phreng ba gser gyi bcu shad can sogs chos yon spam mtho ba phul/ mi rin 'byung gnas sogs gzhan mang po la 'dod chos dang / bka' bsgo skyabs 'jug sogs yid mos ltar stsal/ sras mo la lha rten dang byin rten 'gang che'i rigs dang / su nyid wang dang or du su ja sag gi yil chi so sor 'byor lan dang gnang sbyin mdzad/ su nyid rab 'byams pa don grub kyis zhus te dgon lung gi zhabs drung sku skye dka' ram don gnyer can du ma la nam mkha' sgo 'byed kyi dbang dang / a lag sha'i tshe dbang thu sa lag chi'i skor la sgrol ljang gi rjes gnang stsal/ dbyid 'dir rje nyid kyi zhal bkod ltar sems nyid sgom pa blo bzang yon tan thar pa gling du gdan drangs nas slob chung gtsos pa'i tshogs pa yongs kyis mi 'khrugs pa lha dgu/'jigasabyed lha bcu gsum ma/ kun rig rnams kyi dbang dang / gzhan yang so sos 'dod chos sna tshogs zhus/ phyi log tu sum pa mkhan chen sku bsnyel tshul bstan pa gsan nas bsnyung 'dri la 'byon rgyur chas pas/ de nub thugs mis su khang ba nyams dga' ba zhig gi sgo drung du mkhan chen dang mjal te kha btags shig 'bul rtsis kyis btsal bas/ bar der mkhan chen khang ba'i yang thog tu phebs song zhing nyid kyang mnal sad/ phyi nyin thugs rmis byung tshul gsungs te chibs bshol mdzad/ de'i phyi nyin sum pa bla brang gi mi sna 'ongs nas mkhan chen zhing gzhan du gshegs pa'i rgyu mtshan 562

sa / /sdebatsunamakhazang mkhangag khasabadaganasan kha/dang gdan 'dren gyi snyan gsan phul bar 'byon rgyu'i zhal len dang / sprul sku myur 'byon gyi gsol 'debs phral du ljags rtsom gnang / lung dkar ri khrod du phebs nas mkhan chen gyi sku gdung la mchod pa dang gdung 'bul phul te cho ga grogs dang bcas pas rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod dang bdag 'jug mdzad/ sum pa bla brang nas dngos 'bul kyang gya nom pa zhus/ tshur phebs lam du dge 'dun skyabs ja sag sngar nad tshabs chen gyis mnar ba nyid la skyabs btsal nas nad las grol ba'i legs 'bul dang mjal kha zhus/ zhwa dmar bra rti dgon gyi bla ma khri pa dang bra rte zhabs drung /chen hu sogs skya ser mang po mjal du 'ongs par chosi dang zang zing gis tshim par mdzad/ dgon lung khri ba brje mtshams la dge 'dun mang gis nyid la khrir bzhugs dgos kyi gsol ba btab par dgung lo bgres dang bya khyung gi khrir bzhugs bzhin pa bcas gang ci nas chos sde gnyis ga'i 'chad nyan zung 'brel sgrub mi thub tshul nan gyis gsung na'ang u tshugs mthar skyel zhus pas ngo bzlog ma nus par khri 'don lugs mdzad/ bar chos su chos rwar ma chad par phebs nas gsung chos su spyod 'jug gi bshad pa don zab cing go bde ba zhigaganang bar gzhung rang nyid lam gyi rim pa mtha' dag rigs pa'i lam nas drangs te nges pa skyed tshul gyi 'phrul bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i steng du/nyid nas dngos shugs kyi don thams cad rjen par phyungs te gsung tshul ha cang mkhas pa'i stobs kyis blo mchog dman mtha' dag gi yid rang dbang med par 'phrog ste/ byang chub sems dpa'i sa las sems thams cad kyis nyan par gsungs pa bzhin du chos nyan la sems zhugs pas gnyis snang nub pa lta bur gyur/ mos gus dang spro dga' 'gran pa bzhin du 'phel ba'i dbangagis rgan gzhon mtha' dag tshogs chos grwar 'dzin skyor sogs la'ang 563

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'ithoname'i gsung 'bum/skul ma nang nas thebs pas hur skyed mdzad pa byung / snga ma 'ga' zhig gis dgon pa'i gling 'dabs su rgya grong btsugs nas hos hos sdod bcug pa dang /nye 'dabs su sa rmos nas zhing 'deb bcug pa sogs mi 'tsham pa'i srol ngan btsugs 'dug pa rnams kyang dgon par phugs su gnod tshabs che bar dgongs nas tshogs gtam btsan bajid can gnang ste rgya grong bshig nas hos hos ded pa dang / sa mtshams bcad nas sa rtags gnang ba sogs tshar gcod rjes 'dzin gyi tshangs thig drang por btab pas dge la mi 'dun pa re gnyis kyis snying la tsher ma zug pa bzhin du ma bzod par 'phyon ma'i gar stabs sna tshogs byas kyang chos bzhin spyod pa'i dge 'dun mang gis thugs yid tshim pa'i dga' spro dang dad gus rgya cher 'phel/ dpyid chos la byakhyang du phebs nas 'chad nyan mdzad/ sengs bar rnams su 'ga' zhig gis zhus ngor chos nyan pa mang tsam la 'jigs byed zhal phyag yongs rdzogs kyi rjes gnang / rta mgrin chos skor tshang ma dang bla ma lnga bcu pa/ mkhas grub chig brgyudakyi bla ma'i rnal 'byor sogs chos tshan thor bu dgu/ ka bu ga zhabs drung dang rab 'byams pa chos ldan gnyis kyis zhus pa bzhin ku ru kul+le'i chos skor dang char 'bebs kyi rigs du ma/ lcang skya snga phyi'i gsung gi tshe sgrub dang tshe khrid sogs don gnyer can so so'i 'dod mos ltar chos tshan thor bu mang po zhig gi ljags lung gnang / rong po'i chos rje dge 'dun mkhas grub dang 'ol mo chos grags rnam gnyis mjal du byung bar chos mthun gyi gsung gleng 'phel zhing / khong rnam gnyis kyis zhus ngor gzhi byes kyi chos nyan pa mang po la sgrol dkar gyi rjes gnang dang bstod pa'i lung bcas stsal/ brtsi bzhag gnang skabs shig tu gzhung gsar ba'i skyor dpon pa yan dge tshul dngos grub sbyin pa la khyod kyi ming dang rus ci yin dris par/ 'di dang 'di yin 564

ra / /che babastags d+mabashakaragasadagakazhes zhus pas sgol dkar gyi tshe sgrub gnad smin zhig phral du bsgrubs na bzang gsung zhing / yang bskyar brtag pa zhus pas kyang de ltar gnang bas khos bka' bzhin bsgrubs/ mi ring bar kho rang snying khams mi bde ba'i nad kyis 'chi la khad pa byung na'ang srog la skyon med par nad las grol bas lnga ba'i 'phrang las thar ba rje nyid kyi bka' drin du mthong ste mos gus dang yid ches rnyed/ rti tsha dpon po dang rting gang dpon po sogs gcan rong gnyis kyi sbyin bdag drag zhan spyi sger gyes gdan drangs nas bsnyen bkur 'bul nod zhus par dbang bskur bka' bsgo ljags bsngo sogs gang 'dod du stsal cing / mjal ba mang po la phyag dbang gi mjug tu de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan dang gzungs sngags zab mo rna lam du sgrogs pa/ ma ṇi'i bzlas lung sogs gnang ste 'dod gsol dang smon lam gye mtshams sbyar nan tan mdzad/de nas dgon lung du byon te sa ga zla ba'i dus chen dang bstun nas bla brang du rnam rgyal ma'i khri mchod 'bul bar nyid rang gis phyag skor mang du mdzad pa dang dad ldan gzhan la'ang phyag skor mang du byed bcug cing / de dang dus mtshungs su dgon lung tshogs dang / 'bri gu/ mchod rten thang / zhwa dmar/ thar ba gling / chos bzang rnams su mang 'gyed kyis bsnyen bkur zhus te rnam rgyal gzungs ring bye ba bsgrubs/ bsnyen rdzogs bsgrub bya sum cu tsam la dge slong gi sdom pa gnang / de nas skyed tshal du phebs te thugs dam dang dpe gzigs 'phel zhing / thun mtshams su rta mgrin skyer sgang lugs kyi gdams pa ji snyed thob pa rnams kyi brgyud rim nor bu'i do shal/lha de'i skyed rim skabs kyi ting nge 'dzin gsum gyi khog bub tshul/ dus 'khor dpa' cig gi sgrub thabs sogs gsung rtsom mang du spel/ mdung nag lho ba zhabs drung mjal du 'ongs par/ nyid kyis mdzad pa'i rta mgrin 565

༄/ /gung thababastan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/gtor zlog gi skor sogs lngags lung 'ga' zhig gnang / zhwa dmar dgon gyi sku rten chos rje sogs skya ser che rgan rnams 'ongs nas dgon pa'i khrir bzhugs dgos kyi gsol ba btab pa bzhin zhal bzhes gnang ste bzang rin rab 'byams pa ngag dbang dar rgyas slob chung du bskos/ lang gru'i phyogs kyi dgon pa 'ga' zhig la nye 'khor gyi hos hos sdes bsnyad gzir byas pa nyid la skyabs btsal bas de dag la phan thogs pa'i ched dang / bya khyung dgon pa chos rje don rin pa'i gdan sa dge ldan bstan pa'i chu mgo lta bu yin na'ang 7rgyal pos mi mkhyen pas/ de nyid 7gong mar mkhyen du bcug nas zi ben zhu rgyu bcas kyi don la zi ling du phebs te am pan dang mjal phrad thog thabs mkhas kyi sgo nas bsnyad pas las don gnyis ka thugs kyi dgongs pa bzhin du grub/ de nas mar tshang du phebs te bla chen lha khang gi nye 'dabs su gzim gur phubs nas nyin kha shas kyi ring za khar gyi sman chu bzhes/ de dus gzhan don ltar snang gi za zi'i g.yeng ba sogs snyigs ma'i yul dus kyi bla slob du ma'i skyod tshul la thugs gting nas khrel bas de dag la phan par 'dod pa'i snying rje'i gzhan dbang du gyur te/ rang steng du sbyar te skyon mtshang 'don pa'i mgur bzhes pa ni 'di ltar/ skyabs dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal nas/ / dus de ring skyo ba'i glu zhig len/ / glu tshig la ma 'jog rgyud la skor/ / rgyud dred po thul cig bla gzugs po/ / spyir shin tu snyigs ma'i dus mtha' 'dir/ / chos sgrub pa'i skal ldan shin tu dkon/ / sgos mtha' 'khob yul gyi skye bo'i khrod/ / chos rnam dag byed pa nyin skar tsam/ /gzhan 'dren par rlom pa bdag 'dra yang / / gtam 'grigs 'grigs gzhan la 'chad mkhas kyang / / rang shes rgyud gyong po sbram bor lus/ /'dis shin tu skyo zhing ngo yang tsha/ / phyi ngur sprig gos kyis klubs na yang / /566

༄/ / ༄tso yi4cho misnyamag4gas4d+madakarazagayananang shes rgyud sdig ltung kho nas gang / / dpe bshang lces gang ba'i bum pa nyid/ / gos bzang pos dkris dang khyad par ci/ / mgon dge ba'i bshes gnyen du ma las/ / chos zab rgyas legs bshad mang thos kyang / / don rgyud thog khel ba'i nyams len ni/ / zhag thun re tsam yang sgrub pa med/ / gzhung rgya chen du mar sbyangs pa yang / / rgyud 'dul thabs ma song dred thabs song / / me gzhil du re ba'i chu rgyun nyid/ / lar me ru 'bar la ci zhig bya/ / dbang rjes lung zab khrid 'chad pa dang / / rtsom rnam grangs du ma spel rlom kyang / / snod stong pa gcig nas gcig 'byo bzhin/ / gzhan mi phan steng du rang nyid nyams/ / mi gson gshin du mas re ltos kyis/ / rdzas dngos po'i 'bul nod ster ba 'dis/ / khong so sor dge rtsar 'gyur srid kyang / / rang gdeng med bu lon len dang mtshungs/ / phyi tshul 'chos g.yo sgyu'i rdzu bag 'dis/ / kho dad ldan mgo po bskor nus kyang / / las dge sdig 'bras bu mi 'chol bas/ / tshe phyi mar 'o brgyal 'byung gis dogs/ /ming gzhan don zer ba'i bdud las 'dis/ / dus da bar chos kyi go skabs 'phrog / da na tshod lnga bcu kha ral lon/ / bdag lam rgyags med pa'i 'gron po bzhin/ / 'di bsam kyin rgan po lag stong bdag / dus gtan gyi bde sdug gang myong ba/ / skyabs bla ma'i thugs rjes re ba las/ / gzhan blo gdeng ci yang mi bdog pas/ / gnas ngan song gsum gyi g.yang kha na/ /bu snying rul 'o dod 'bod pa 'di/ / pha 'dren mchog rol pa'i rdo rje yis/ / gnas dag pa'i zhing nas dgongs par 'tshal/ / lus 'byung pa 'khrugs pa'i nad kyis gzir/ / sems chags sdang phrag dog gdon gyis dkrugs/ / tshe don med bya bas chud gzan pa'i/ / sbrang nyam thag brtse bas mi gzigs sam/ / las 'du 'dzi g.yeng ba sna tshogs kyis/ / chos sgrub pa'i 567

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/go skabs bral ba 'di/ / khyed byin rlabs mthu yis myur bsal nas/ / da tshe lhag chos kyis 'da' bar shog / slar bgrang yas skye ba thams cad du/ /las sdig pa'i kha skong bsod nams su/ / ming btags pa'i bdud kyi bsru brid dang / / dus nam yang phrad par ma gyur cig / bdag gzhan mnyam brje ba'i byang chub sems/ / lam rim pa gnyis kyi rnal 'byor la/ / srog 'dor la thugs kyang mi g.yel bar/ / shugs drag po'i brtson pa bsten nus shog / ces pa 'di'ang 'khos med kyi btsun pa dharma badz+ra gyis rang gi gnas tshul la skyo ba gting nas skyes te bla chen dgongs pa rab gsal gyi sku gdung rin po che bzhugs pa'i lha khang gi nye 'dab cig tu glur blangs pa'o/ / zhes pa'o/ der nyin gcig zhal nas mdang rmi lam du nag tsho lo tsā ba yin zer ba zhig dang 'grogs nas rgya gar du chas te thang chen po zhig tu 'gro gin 'dug / nged kyi bsam par a tsa ra'i skad mi shes mod kyang lo tsā ba'i drin gyis skyon mi 'dug lo rgas pas slob gnyer mi yong na'ang gnas mjal gnadasprin cig byed snyam pa zhig shar yod pa la lam nas mi zhig gis bal bod kyi mtshams su 'khrugs pa langs 'dug ces bshad nas bshol ba zhig rmos pa ci yin gsungs/ ma 'gyang bar bal bod 'khrugs pa'i mgo brtsams tshul gyi gtam sbir byung bas thugs rmis de nyid 'byung 'gyur mngon sum du gzigs par snang la/ nag tsho ba dang bsdebs nas byon pa sogs ni sngon gnas rjes dran gyi bag chags shig yin nam snyam/ phyir lam mar tshang grong sde gong mas lha khang 'bub rgyu'i gnas gzigs mdzad/ o'u han tha'i ji dkon mchog yar 'phel gyi mi sna tā bla ma dge 'dun ngo g.yog 'ongs nas dgon lung du drug pa'i smon lam btang bar/ tshogs dbur gdan drangs nas sbyin bdag gis bskur ba'i maṇ+ḍal kha btags/ sku gsung thugs rten/568

༄/ /rjebatsotshos4chosaminyamathagangagatsalag khasogakha/bzhugs gdan rgyab yol/ dngul srang brgya tham pa rnams brtan bzhugs lugs su phul/ nyid nas kyang sbyin bdag lhos bcas kyi dge ba rdzogs byang du bsngo ba'i spyan dmigs mdzad/ yel chi rnams la 'dod chos dang 'byor lan gnang sbyin stsal/ dbyar gnas kyi skabs 'chad nyan mdzad cing /bshad sgrub kyi bstan pa'i gzhi ma chos 'dul ba yin la der las brgya rtsa sogs gsungs pa las deng dus thams cad la yongs su grags par lag len du 'deb rgyu'i gtso bo zhig yod pa ni de'i nang nas gzhi gsum gyi phyag len 'di tsam zhig tu snang bas/ thams cad kyis thub bstan rin po che'i btsas su dgongs te ma mtha' 'di tsam re yin kyang ma nub par gtsang sar de ba re ci nas kyang mdzad dgos zhes bstan pa kho na gces par dgongs pa'i bka' nan dang / de bzhin du 'cham dang rol mo bslab rgyu las 'phros te 'cham byung tshul gyi gtam rgyud du ma sogs blo skyed can gyi tshogs gtam rgyas pa gnang / sku tsha blo bzang bstan 'dzin dar rgyas a lag sha'i lhun grub dar rgyas no mon han gyi sprul skur thag bcad pas a lag shā nas thu she gung rdo rje tshe brtan dang / wang gi mi sna khā dpal 'byor/ dgon pa'i grwa tshang bla ma lha ram pa blo bzang rgyal mtshan sogs drag zhan nyi shu skor gdan 'dren du 'ongs te rje nyid gtso mdzad pa'i dgon pa'i bla spyi khag so so'i che rim rnams la bzhugs gral ston mo dang / nyid la 'bul ba/ dgon pa spyi la mang 'gyed zhus/ nyid nas no mon han sbrul sku la 'gro chos su sgrol dkar gyi rjes gnang dang / spyi bla brang so so nas phebs rdzong chibs skyel gang rgyas zhus ston zla ra ba'i yar tshes la mchod rten thang dgon mchod gzhi'i gdan 'dren pa 'ongs nas phebs skabs rang stag gi che ga skal bzang dang / sngo kho lha 'bum sogs khyim tshang mang bor dbang bskur dang / dad ldan gyi skye pho mo'i khrom la phyag 569

༄/ /yo thang bstan pa'isgroname'i gsung 'bum/dbang mtshan dang gzungs sngags/ bsngo smon gyi mtshams sbyor sogs chag med du gnang / mchod rten thang gi slob chung dang bde rgu mkhan po/ sdo kho zhabs drung / rgya tig zhabs drung mchi zhabs drung / zang nga zhabs drung /stobs tshang zhabs drung sogs bla ma las sne dka' ram tsho ba so so'i mgo ba sogs skya ser gyi rta thab rim pa du ma dang / mchod rdzas dang rol cha thogs pa'i dge 'dun stong phrag ste ba'i ser sgrebs bcas dgon par phyag phab ste nyin bdun bzhugs/ dgon pa'i 'du khang rje nyid kyis rgyu mthud dang brtan brjid mdzes gsum gyi bkod pa gnang ba bzhin tshon rtsi dang bcas legs par grub pa yin pas/ cung zad che chung gi khyad par ma gtogs dgon lung gi tshogs chen 'du khang dang bkod pa mtshungs par 'ongs 'dug ces thugs mnyes mnyes mdzad/ dgon pa'i gtso bo 'du khang gi rab gnas dang dgon mchod gzhi'i che phra rnams mjal rgyu'i ched yin gshis/nyid cho ga grogs dang bcas pas rab gnas kyi cho ga bkra shis snyem ltar rten dang brten par bcas pa la sbyan dbye'i cho ga mjug tu zhi ba'i sbyin sreg dang bcasagrub par mdzad/ sbyin sreg gi me bkra la 'tshub ltas cung zad byung bar bskrad cho ga gnang / thab kyi 'das lha spyan 'dren pa'i spos rol gye tshe nyi mas gur phub cing 'ja' sprin las char thar thor babs/ yang de ma thag 'ja' sprin gur dang bcas pa dbyings su yal te ston gnam mthon mthing lta bu'i rang mdangs la nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyis brgyan par gyur pa dang /rab gnas grub rjes thams cad kyi mthun snang du bris 'bur gyi sku brnyan dang 'du khang gi gser tshon rnams snum zhing 'od chags pa'i rnam par mthong ba sogs rten 'brel gyi ltas phun sum tshogs pa byung bar/ rgan pa rnams kyis dam ye bsres pa'i cho ga tshig tsam du ma lus pa'i 'bras rtags yang dag tu 570

sa / /rjebatsun thazangartsamadzam d+madakaras tshur/gor ma chag go zhes dga' ba'i ca co sgrogs par gyur/ 'brog pa 'ga' zhig la dge bsnyen dang / bsgrub bya nyi shu rtsa drug la bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa stsal/chos grwar rigs gra'i gsung bzhad pa'i sprul pa'i sku rin po che bzhugs gnas thu'ubakwan bla brang du mdzad pas sngon gyi sku 'phreng du mar thugs bskyed smon lam bzang pos lu gu rgyud du 'brel ba'i bag chags mngon du gyur te/mjal ma thag nas thugs yid gcig tu 'dres shing / der bzhugs ring nyin re bzhin mjal te thugs bag phebs pa'i rnam pa mdzad/ kun mkhyen mchog gi sprul pa'i sku rin po che nas rgyan 'jug gnyis/ rten 'brel bstod pa rnams kyi phyag dpe/ spos shel gyi phreng ba gcig bcas phyag gis gnang ste/rgyal ba'i bstan pa la thos bsam sgom pa tshad dang ldan pa mdzad nas rgyal ba tsongakha ba'i bstan pa rin po che 'dzin pa la 'gran bral zhig yong ba dgos tshul gyi bslab ston rgyas pa stsal/ sbas don mngon par rtogs pa dang /dngos bstan stong pa nyid kyi rim pa ston pa'i gzhung chen mo gnyis gnang zhing /phyis su gzhung gnyis ka thugs 'dzin yang dpe de'i steng nas mdzad 'dug pa niskra phreng du mar theg pa mchog gi dge ba'i bshes gnyen mdzad cing mdzad par 'gyur ba dang / khyad par du sku tshe 'di nyid la zab pa dang rgya che ba'i lam gyi lus yongs su rdzogs pa'i sgo nas srid zhi gnyis ga'i mthar ltung ba 'gog pa'i theg pa mchog gi yongs 'dzin gyi gtso bo mdzad pa'i rten 'brel rmad du byung bar gor ma chag go / bka' las kyang / de dus nged rang rje 'jam dbyangs bzhad par mjal ba la dga' spro che zhing / stong skor ba la ci byasakhyang mjal phrad byed ma 'dod pas khong dang de res zhal mjal ba tsam yang ma byung / phyis su bsam par/ stong skor bsod nams rgya mtsho de nyid grub pa'i skyes mchog khyad par du gyur pa zhig yin nges pas de dus ma mjal 571

༄/ /yo bang bstan pa'ithoname'i gsung 'bum/ba skal ba zhan pa 'dug snyam du sems so/ / zhes gsungs/ chos bzang ri khrod du bzhugs skabs shig yul lha'i rgyal po seng mtho'i ri rtser 'byon rtsis kyis dpon g.yog mang tsam lam du zhugs pas chu mgo dkar po'i sdings khar slebasapa na phyogs thams cad na bun gyis khyab pa'i gseb tu 'ja' tshon gyi gur khyim blum po dkyil shin tu dwangs pa me long lta bu la gzugs brnyan 'char ba zhig khong dpon g.yog dang lhan du re zhig gi bar du shing rta'i 'khor lo bzhin 'khor nas 'gro ba der tshogs pa'i skya ser thams cad kyis mthong bas ngo mtshar du byed pa byung / dgung lo dgu lon skabs chos bzang ri khrod kyi dbyar gnas la tshogs su phebs rtsis kyis de ga'i zhal 'don rgyal dbang gis gsungs pa'i gnas brtan phyag mchod kyi cho ga thugs 'dzin mdzad pas nyin gsum gyis byang bar bzung ste tshogs pa dang lhan du gsung thub pa byung ba la/thams cad kyis thugs 'dzin bzang ba'i bsngags brjod dar dir du sgogs par byed do/ / 'di skabs rje nyid rang gi thugs bzhed kyis rje bla ma'i gsol 'debs sogs 'ga' zhig dang / rab 'byams pa kun dga' bzang pos bskul nas drangs nas so sos gsol ston dang dngos 'bul zhus/ rgya tig sgar du bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen mang po la glang ri thang pa'i blo sbyong tshig brgyad ma'i zab khrid dang / gzhan rnams la khrus dbang / jigs lung bka' bsgo sogs rang rang gi 'dod mos bzhin stsal/ bla ma dka' ram sogs yon tan can mang bas gsung gleng gi zhar la blo skyed mang du gnang /mchod gzhis kyi nang du gdan 'dren nan che bar sngo kho 'ju lag pa stobs tshang chu brgyud pa dang byang ngos pa rnams su rim pas phebs/ spyi sger so so nas bsnyen bkur phun sum tshogs pa zhus shing phyag dbang chos 'brel sogs gang zhus thams cad yid tshim par stsal/ yar klung dgon pa'i rgyud pa dpon 572

༄/ /ldebatsotshosazangacho misnyamagagangagatsosam khazagaya/slob ba ri don grub bkra shis bsnyungs nas bab lce bar rje nyid phebs yod pa thos nas mjal 'dod che ba la dgon pa spyi nas gdan 'dren pa btang ba 'byor te yar klung dgon par phebs/ ba ri dpon slob la kun rig gi khrus chog dang thugs dam gsal 'debs kyi bslab ston gnang / sog po nang so bkra shis rab brtan sogs grwa ba mi nyung tsam la skyabs 'gro'i khrid stsal/slob chung mā bla ma dang mā tsho bas gdan 'dren zhus pa bzhin rim gyis 'brog khyim mang por dbang bskur chos 'brel sogs gang 'dod kyi re ba skong bar mdzad/ yul lugs kyis 'bul rta phrum dar can khrid pa'i bsu ba mang pos rta rgyug mdun du bdar zhing thab bsu dang bcas mā tsho bar babs/ nyin kha shas kyi ring tsho ba'i khyim tshang rnams su phebs te dbang bskur rjes gnang lung sogasagang 'dod du stsal/ spyi sger so so nas bsnyen bkur yang dag zhus/zhwa dmar dgon gyi bra rti zhabs drung sogs drag zhan du ma gdan 'dren du 'byor par slar 'byon rgyu byas/ slob chung bzang rin chos rje nyid dang lhan du 'ongs pa yin pas dgon par mang 'gyed dang bcas gtong ba gnang /de nas nyin mang por sngo kho lcags rong gi tsho ba so so'i khyim tshang rnams su gdan drangs nas spyi sger gyis bsnyen bkur dang 'dod don zhus pa'i yid tshim par mdzad/ sngar 'ju lag gi sa'i cha brag kha'i sum mdor rje nyid nas bde rgu mkhan po thub bstan dar rgyas dang sngo kho phyag mdzod ngag dbang lhun grub gnyis la pha gi brag ri zhig yod pa de'i ming ci yin zhes bka' 'dri gnang bar khra rab lags zhus/ brag ri de'i gseb nas dud khung nas du ba thon pa ltar na bun dum bu zhig chad de sngo phyu ru ru gyen du song ba de khyed tshos e mthong gsung bar thams cad kyis bltas pas mthong mkhan su yang ma byung /zhal nas ltas bzang ba zhig min pa 'dra gsung / de nas mi ring bar glo 573

༄/ /gung thang bstanapa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/bur du mun rub pa bzhin smug long 'thibs pas nyin mtshan dbye ba mi phyed pa lta bu dang rlung char 'dres ma'i bu yug 'tshub cing 'jigs su rung ba'i 'brug sgra drag po sgrogs pa sogs gnam gshis ngan pa byung bar cung zad thugs khros pa'i rnam pas spyan sdang mig tu gzigs te lngags bzlas shig gnang bas de ma thag sprin thams cad rlung gis gtor nas nam mkha' g.ya' dag par gyur/sgarayi rab kyi ri sul du babs yod pa mgyogs shad kyis 'azin btang nas stag ri'i rtsar spes/ dgung mo sgar gye mthar skor ba mdzad de ched dmigs kyis srung ba gnang / de nub nam phyed la glo bur du char log brgyab nas sgar thog tu ser ba drag po babs shing nye 'khor du thog mang du 'phangs kyang zhabs skor mdzad pa'i sa tshun chad du gcig kyang ma babs pas mi zog gang la'ang skyon ma byung / phyi nyin dbang bskur zhig la mi mang po tshogs par yang char thog drag po sngar dgung ltar 'ongs pa la nyid nas 'dod pa mtshams gnang ste thog srung gi spyan dmigs mdzad pas glags cung zad kyang ma rnyed/de ltar gnod pa chen po ma thub kyang yang yang mtho 'tsham pa'i sbyor ba ma btang ba dang / da res kyang lcags rong stod du kha ba mthug po babs nas bu yug 'tshub ste dbyar chas kyis bgrod dka' ba zhig byung bar brten 'brog sde'i khrod du da dung gdan 'dren zhu mkhan mang yang zhal bzhes ma gnang /de dus zhal rtsed kyi tshul du khra rab la khyi ra kha 'thor dang stag ril bde skyid mthon po zhes ming thogs gsungs pa bzhin deng sang yang de ltar grags 'dug / tsub ltas de dag la brten nas rje nyid cung zad thugs 'tshub cing zhabasaphyi ba rnams kyang dogs pa byas te chu dkar nas phyir 'khor rgyur thag bcad par dpon po phyag rdor gtsos pa'i lcags rong stod kyi khyim tshang drug cur nye ba thams cad kyis sgar thog tu 'dus nas spyi sger gyi zhabs tog 'bul 574

༄/ / rdzobatsug bzangacho minyima'ig4gsumapacadakhasadabyungananod zhus/ sku 'khor rnams kyang kha ba mthug cing grang bad che bas sku bsil nyen che bar 'dug mjal ba 'di dag gzim chung du mjal kha gshar nas bka' chos mi gnang rgyu byas na ye chog zhus par/ khyed tshos ci zer 'brel ba thogasapa rnams la phan thogs rgyu zhig dgos mod sdug bden gyi steng du sdug bden cig bzhag pas phan rgyu ci yod/ phan thogs pa'i thabs sangs rgyas kyi mtshan dang gzungs sngags zab mo rna lam du sgogs rgyu de ka rang yin pas lung 'don dgos gsungs nas sku tshag la ma 'dzem par kha char bu yug 'tshub pa'i thad du da dung phan yon gyi bshad pa rtsal du bton pa'i sgo nas bka' chos dkyus ma'i steng du rnam rgyal gzungs ring bsnan nas bsngo smon gyi mtshams sbyor sogs rgyas par stsal/ 'di res gdan 'dren pa mang bas brel khyad kyis nyin rer khyim tshang mang por phebs shing dbang bskur dang rjes gnang lan mang po dang mjal ba khrom tshogs so sor bka' chos dkyus ma rnams phan yon gyi bshad pa bcas chag med dang / sengs bar rnams su bka' bsgo ljags bsngo gsung brtag srung mdud sogs so so'i yid tshim par gnang dgos pa bcas shin tu 'o brgyal ba byung / zhal nas bla ma 'ga' zhig gis zhog ka 'jigs byed kyi bdag skyed bton nas bum pa zhig bsgrubs na de'i nyin par dbang bskur lan ci tsam bskur na'ang bum chu khyer song nas bdag skyed bum sgrub mi byed par chu bsnan gi bsnan gi khrus chog rkyang ba 'don thub thub gnang gi yod pa'ang snang mod/ nged rang snying chung bas bskur thebs re la bdag skyed bum sgrub re bsgrubs nas dmigs rgyu yod rung med rung 'don rgyu'i rim pa rnams chad lhag med par sgra dag pa zhig 'don dgos pas da lan gye dbang bskur mang po 'dis nga la dka' las gtad byung gsung ba ni grong chog la rtse gcig pa'i yid byed thob pa rnams kyis go dgos pa zhig 575

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'izlaname'i gsung ཿma/ste/ cho ga dpyis phyin pa zhig 'ongs pa la rdzas sngags phyag rgya ting nge 'dzin thams cad ya ma bral ba dgos la/ ma mtha'ang cho ga'i tshig tshang ba zhig ma byungan dkor gyi bu lon lhag par lce bas pha rol po la phan pa lta ci mdzo sprel g.yang la lhung ba bzhin rang nyid kyang shin tu phung bar 'gyur ba shes par gyis shig ces rjes su 'doms pa'i don du snang ngo / / de nub mnal lam la sgar 'dabs su tshag zhwa gyon pa'i hwa shang gi chas can rta pa 'ga' zhig yong bar rje nyid thugs khros pa'i rnam bas grwa pa rnams la de tsho su yin gang nas 'ongs zhesartsad bcad pa na/ de rnams 'ur langs nas rta rgyug btang ste ku dir gyisabros song bar zur nas sa cha de ga'i gzhi bdag yin nam snyam pa zhig gisayus pa'i rnam pas lcags rong stod smad bar gsum la mu ge nad rims gtong mkhan de tsho yin mod gzhan su yang min/ de rnams yul der 'ongs nasam bcu gsum song ba yin zhes zhus/ phyi nyin zhog ka mnal lam byung tshul gsungs te nged rang gis de'i nyin par char thog drag po 'ga' brgyab pa dang / da res kha ba bu yug 'tshub nas nged rang grwa pa bcas dang thag nye ring gi mjal ba rnams dka' las la gtad pa 'di gzhi bdag ma rung ba zhig gi stongs yin nam snyam ste yi dam gyi sngags dmigs kyis bcun pa yin kyang gzhi bdag gi stongs shig min pa 'dra/ rgyal gdon gdug pa can zhig yod pa red gsungs nas yul mi rnams la rta mgrin gsang sgrub kyi rtsa sngags grangs bsags kyi sgo nas gtor zlog sogs gnad dmigs can gyi rim gro 'ga' zhig phab ste tshad ldan sgrub rgyu'i ljags bkod dang / gzhi bdag la'ang rjes nas bzod gsol byed dgos gsungs pa bzhin dgon lung du 'byor ma thag bla ma sgom pa ngag dbang rab brtan la zhus te dkar gtor mang du bsngos nas bzod gsol gnang du bcug pa yin/ phyis su sngo kho lcags rong pa'i rim gro 576

sa / /rjebatsun tha bas lad+ma mkhagacosar/rnams rgya tig zhabs drung dpon g.yog gis rje nyid kyi zhal bkod ji bzhin bsgrubs par phan ngo che ba'i mngon rtags byung 'dug / phyir lam bkra shis dpal lung gi mdar sems nyid dge bsnyen a bo byams sogs yul mi mang po'i thab bsu'i thog 'bri gu dgon pa'i khri ba ba za zhabs drung blo bzang bstan 'dzin 'phrin las ngo g.yog mjal du 'byor/ khong bod du lo mang tsam bzhugs nas gsar du 'ongs pa yin pas gnas tshul zhib 'dri dang khyad par du gtsang ba mkhan pos phyag chen gyi khrid gnang skabs bshad pa mthun mi mthun ci rigs mdzad tshul snyan du son pa las 'phros pa'i dri med mang du mdzad/ zhabs drung khong rang la bod nas mar 'ongs skabs dus gsum rjenapar gzigs pa'i ye shes kyi spyan mnga' ba grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po klong rdol bla ma rin po che nas khyod rang mdo smad du song ste chos sgrub tshul thams cad thu'u bkwan rin po che la zhus te khong gis gang gsung bzhin byas na phugs su legs pa zhig 'byung zhes bka' gnang yod pa'i don bzhin/ rje nyid la blo snying gtad de rjes 'dzin gyi gsol ba nan tan btab par chos bka' gang dgos rnams 'dod pa bzhin gnang chog pa'i zhal bzhes dang phral yun gyi bslab ston zhib par gnang / dge bsnyen rgyal 'bum byams zer ba lo dgu bcu go gcig lon pa zhig gis tshe g.yang phul bar mtshan dang gzungs sngags rna lam du bsgrags/ mchod rten thang du dgon pa'i thad kyi 'julag gi zam pa rnying skyon che bar gsar gsos kyi thebs su dung tshe khron brgya tham pa 'jog pa gnang / stobs tshang rgya thang ba dang zab lung rgya tig gi khyim tshang rnams su spyi sger gyi bsnyen bkur zhus pa'i don mdzad/ rdo dkar ri khrod du rgya tig zhabs drung sogs ser skya'i khrom chen por jo ba'i lugasakyi dzam dkar 'brug zhon lha lnga'i rjes gnang stsal cing spyi sgos kyi chos 577

༄/ /gung thang bstan ba'ithoname'i r+yāng 'bum/bshad las 'phros te/ nor sgrub la rkun ja sogs rtsid spyod la brten pa/kha gsag gzhog slong sogs 'jam spyod la brten pa/ zhing las bun skyed sogs dka' spyad la brten pa rnams las dang po ni ma rabs tha chad kyi lugs yin la/ phyi ma gnyis ni khyim pa skya bo dang khyim pa gser mdog can ci rigs pa'i lugs so gsungs pas thams cad bzhad gad thag ge ba byung /rje 'dis nyams 'tshar gyi gsung re phebs pa de'ang rgyu'i kun slong mkhyen rab dang snying rje zung du 'jug pa'i stobs kyis gnas skabs su blo skyed che la phugs su phan nges pa'i thabs 'ba' zhig tu 'gro ba zhig yod do/ / de nas ri khrod yon mchod thun mong gis gsol ston dang 'bul nod nus pa rtsal sprug zhus/rim gyis byon te dgu pa'i tshes la dgon lung du 'byor/ de dus 'brog sde'i khrod du dkar dro dmar dro'i ston mo ha cang rgya che bar rje nyid nas gdan 'dren pa rnams la srog gcod ma byed ces dang po nas dril bsgrags te gsungs pas yul lugs kyis do gal che skabs lug mang po gsod rgyu de khegs kyangartsa ba nas chod pa zhig ma byung bas/ nyin re'i zhabs tog gi sha khog rnams las rus pa rdog po re blangs nas bsags yod pa la nyid nas sdig pa sbyangs pa'i gzungs sngags mang po gsungs nas ljags sngags btab cing bsngo smon mdzad/ chos bzang ri khrod kyi slob chung la sbyangs yon dang bcas phul nas mi 'khrugs pa'i gzungs grangs bsags kyi sgo nas rus chog dang sats+tsha 'debs su 'jug pa gnang / zhal nas kyang 'brog sog 'dir yul lugs ngan bas srog gcod gtan nas ma byas pa zhig mi yong ba 'dug kyang nga rang la sha 'dren mkhan byung dus lha'i nga rgyal gyis bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs nas bla ma dkon mchog la mchod par phul te dmigs yul de'i don du gsol 'debs smon lam dang / ke ka ni dur ga sogs sdig pa 'dag pa la mchog 578
