/ /chabatsun ba bakhangag masad+madakurasad khakatu bsngags pa'i gzungs sngags phan yon can rnams bton nas sha dang rus pa la sngags btab cing rus pa rdog po re blangs te ri grod pa tshad ldan re la rus chog 'dra byed bcug pa yin/ ya nga bo red kyang de min pa bya thabs mi 'dug pa byung / yon sbyong de tsam mdzad bzhin du da dung thugs 'tsher ba'i rnam pa gnang ba ni rtogs pa mtho yang las 'bras la 'dzem pa'i rnam par thar ba ste/ da lta grong chog gi 'khor lo bskor ba'i bla mchod phal che ba ni rje rol pa'i rdo rje'i zhal nas rang la bsnyen bkur ched du srog bcad pa'i/ / sems can sha khrag dus gsum spungs dkyil du/ / gri phyar mchil mid ches cher rings shing rngams/ / srung tshogs dgra bgegs 'dul la chas 'dra ba'i/ /dge 'dun gzugs brnyan rnams la thugs rjes gzigs/ / gsungs pa bzhin sha'i tsho ljid dang bro ba bzang ngan gyi 'du shes las nyes dmigs yod med kyi rtog dpyod tsam yang 'jug pa dkon par snang bas bdag legs su 'dod pa rnams de dag sems la bcang ste bag zon re bya dgos so/ / lo snga ma rgya yag dgon pa spo rgyu'i gnas gzigs dang 'bub thebs ljags bkod gnang ba bzhin bla brang gi khang skor dang 'du khang dbus 'bub spen pad gyon thog can chos rwa sgo khang rung khang bcas legs par grub cing / rim gyis 'dukhang steng du gser zangs kyi galji ra mi tshad lhag pa/ steng 'og dang phyi nang gi shing rtsi rgya mthongs gyan bcu gcig la thub dbang dang rgyan drug mchog gnyis rje bdag nyid chen po sogs bla rgyud rags rim grub thob brgyad cu gnas brtan bcu drug rnams dang / shod kyi gyan bcu drug la sne na dka' bcus sbyin bdag byas nas rje nyid kyi 'khrungs rabs bskal bzang gi sangs rgyas stong kun rig gi lha tshogs ras bris mthong ba don ldan/ spyan ras gzigs kyi rnam thar bcas steng 'og gi logs ris rnams ras gzhi la gser 579

༄/ /yo thang bstan pa'izlaname'i sku 'bum/tshon shin tu ngos dag par bris shing lha so so'i sku mdog phyag mtshan bzhengs bzhugs sogs kyi rnam dbye dang / spyan ras gzigs kyi rnam thar thor bu rnams kyang mdo rgyud du ma nas btus te gsham du rnam thar gyi yi ge dang lha dang rnam thar so so'i thad du mtshan byang dang ka rtags kyang gsal bar bkod/'dis mtshon pa'i snga sor bris 'bur gyi sku brtan mang du bzhengs pa la thig tshad sku mdog phyag mtshan bzhugs stabs rgyan cha lugs yan chad la phyag dpe mang po btsal nas mdo rgyud kyi dgongs pa dang bstun cing / nyid rang gi bkod pa gang gnang ltar sgrub pa ma gtogs lha bzo rang rang gis gang 'dod byas mi chog cing gzungs 'jug gi skor yang sku dngos kyis gzigs rtog mdzad nas cung zad kyang sla chos dang rtog ge'i ol tshod du ma song ba'i tshad dang ldan pa gnang / dge 'dun gyi thugs dam rten du tshe dpag med kyi sman sku che ba dang thub pa'i li sku khyad 'phags/ nyid rang gi dbu zhwa gos ber bzhugs gdan rgyab yol sogs dang mchod rdzas su gser gos sna tshogs las bsgrubs pa'i ka 'phan ring ba brgyad dang phye phur bzhi/ btsan khang gyan dgu gyo thog can tshon rtsi dang bcas bsgrubs pa'i pho brang nang mar rgyal po sku lnga'i 'bag sku mi tshad long ba thugs ka dang stod smad bar gsum rnams su thun mongadang thun mong ma yin pa'i nang 'jug man ngag bzhin tshad dang ldan pa mdzad/ smon lam gyi skabs bkram rgyu'i byams pa'i gos sku chen po dgon lung gi phyag len ltar gyi 'cham gsar 'dzug mdzad cing / 'cham pa'i grangs dang mnyam pa'i zhal 'bag bzang gos las bsgrubs pa'i 'cham lā dar tshon stod khebs phyag mtshan bod kyi phra lham sogs dgos chas tshang ma/ja tshul gyi thebs rgya mi chung ba bcas 'jog pa gnang zhing gzhan yang sku tshag dang phyag rdzas la ma 'dzem pa'i bkod khyab gnang ste/ rgya'i nags skal nas 580

༄/ /rjebatsug ba4cho minyima'igagangagasumapatshadakhasadabyunganari lung 'ga' zhig gi nags dgon pas bdag gir byas chog par mdzad cing phyin chad su'i thad nas kyang bsgul bskyod mi thub pa'i yig dan bzhag pa sogs brjed par phangs pa'i bka' drin gyis bskyangs pa yin no/ / bod kyi yi ge rnams 'byor bar lung bstan la babs pa'i zhabs brtan las gdugs sher seng gdong ma'i zlog sgyur dang / tshe gzungs sgrol ma sogs grangs gsog pa'i skor dgon lung tshogs chen dang rgyud pa nye 'khor gyi dgon sgrub sde rnams su bsgrubs te/ bla brang nang du wang zhabs drung chog grogs dang bcas bas brtan bzhugs 'chi blu dang sbrags nas zhabs brtan rgyas pa rta mgrin gyi bsnyen ba las bzhi'i sbyin sreg gtor zlog bcas dang mgon po'i gtor chen rnams bsgrubs shing / gling gi dge 'dun pa rnams la yum dang lan chags gtor ma brgya rtsa/ klu gtor sa 'bum chu 'bum rnams gtad nas grangs mang du bsags/ khran tsong ri khrod kyi 'du khang shing rtsi dang bcas nyid nas gsar bskrun gnang ba bzhin zla ba bcu ba'i yar tshes la der gdan drangs te rten brten pa la rab gnas mdzad/ brarti sku skye sogs ri khrod yon mchod kyis rab yon gzabs/ skya ser gyi tshogs pa mang po la phyag dbang gnang tshur phebs te sngar chen po hor gyi yul du phebs skabs dad ldan rnams kyis phul ba'i dngul phud kyis de dag gi don du dmigs nas rnam rgyal mchodarten khru gsum long ba tshigs rgyan pa ṭa rnams gser tshos dang g.yu mu tigabyi ru sogs rin po che'i phra rgyan gyis spras pa zhig gsar du bzhengs nas sku brnyan dang 'phel gdung byin rten 'gang che'i rigs bcas ring bsrel rnam bzhi'i gzungs 'jug nyid kyis phyag bstar nas tshad ldan dang / rje rin po che'i 'dra sku mkhyud gang stong lhag dpar btab gser tshon ngos dag bsgrubs pa rnams wang zhabs drung rin po che chog grogs dang bcas par rab 581

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'isgraname'i gsung 'bum/gnas mdzad du bcug / lo 'dir mar tshang grong sde gong 'gab gnyis ga'i lhakhang so sor sku 'dra mi tshad long ba gsum re bzhengs su bcug pa gnang /skabs 'dir yang lo snga ma'i bsnyun gzhi cung zad 'phar ldang byung bar zhabs brtan rim gro snga ma nas bsgrubs yod cing 'di res kyang rim gro stobs chen mang du bsgrubs/ de skabs mnal lam du dge 'dun mang po zhig gis me tog 'thor bzhin du/ dpal 'byor gyis brgyan yun ring zhabs brtan shog / ces brjod pa zhig byung bsam 'gyang bar bsnyun legs par dwangs/yang de skabs shig tu mnal lam la ri bo rtse lnga yin nam snyam pa zhig gi lha khang che ba zhig gi nang du lcang skya rdo rje 'chang gi sku gdung bzhugs sam snyam pa'i shing gi za ma tog gcig gi drung du chu bzang rin po che dang rje nyid rnam gnyis kyis gtsos pa'i grwa pa mang po 'tshogs nas mchod pa dang gsol 'debs smon lam sogs byed kyin 'dug pa la/ glo bur du za ma tog gi sgo phye ba'i nang na rdo rje 'chang de nyid kyi sku gdung bzhugs 'dug pa des dar tshon gyi thum po zhig tshogs pa'i dkyil du bsgyur byung ba chu bzang rin po che'i phyag tu babs/thumapo bkrol nas rje nyid la gzigs bcug par rus pa'i glegs bu la man ju'i yi ge bris pa kha shas 'dug par rje nyid kyis 'di gsang ba zhig yin 'dra pas/ slar 'gol sa zhig tu man ju'i yi ge shes mkhan zhig la klog bcug pa 'thadagasungs te chu bzang rin po che'i phyag tu phyir gtad pa dang tshogs pa thams cad kyang grol song / de na rje nyid gcig pu sku gdung gi g.yon phyogs su phebs nas dbu gtugs te smon lam 'ga' zhig gsungs pa na/ sku gdung des g.yas phyogs su shog ces pa'i brda' mdzad byung ba bzhin g.yas phyogs su phebs pas za ma tog gi nang nas shad kyis phyir byon phyag nyid kyi dbu la bzhag ste/ khyed rang gi tshe la bar chad che'o gsung byung bar bdag lta 582

༄/ /༄tsotshosazapachos gyi gangag lad+madasabasas/bu shi yang bzod/ rje bla ma khyed mya ngan las 'das nas 'jig rten gyi khams su nyi ma nub pa lta bur gyur pa la de ring dngos su mjal rgyu byung ba ngo mtshar che bas da ni yang bkod pa 'di bsdus nas mya ngan las 'da' tshul mi mdzad pa zhu zhes nan gyis zhus par/ khyod kyi tshe la bar chad yod tshul ston ched du slar sos pa lta bur rdzus pa yin gzhan shi tshar ba tshur gson pa ga la srid gsunganas phebs grab lta bu mdzad kyin 'dug pa la/ 'o na phran bu'i tshe'i bar chad sel thabs ci byas na legs zhus par/ nged kyis bshad ci dgos than mdos glud yan chad kyi rim gro khyod rang gi sems la gang 'thad sgrub pas 'thus mod gsung nas sngar gyi za ma tog gi nang du shad kyis byon ma thag sku gdung gi rnam par gyur song bas thugs skyo ba tshad las 'das pa 'khrungs pa zhig rmis te/ 'di ni bla ma rdo rje 'chang chen po nyid mi lam la dngos su byon nas byin rlabs dang lung bstan mdzad pa yin snang la/ nyid nas mi lam gyi gnas skabs tshun chad du'ang rang srog yal bar bor te bla ma'i sku tshe brtan pa 'ba' zhig gis mos gus rtsol ba med par 'khrungs pa ni legs tshogs mtha' dgagi rten 'brel 'grigs pa'i rtsa ba mkhas pa'i skye bo kun gyis rjes su yi rang ba'i gnas su gyur pa zhig tu snang ngo / / zhal nas kyang rmi ltas 'di dag la dpag na rang lo nga gcig dang nga gnyis kyi thog nad tshab chen po rgyun ring byung ba rim gro stobs chen bsgrubs pas ma shi tsam byung song ba'ang bla ma'i thugs rje kho na yin par 'dug gsung / der ma zad snga ma har chin du bzhugs skabs mnal ltas shig byung tshul yang nyid kyi zhal nas/ nged rang dgon lung gi tshogs dbur khri mthon po zhig la bsdad/ khri thog pa wang zhabs drung rin po ches gtsos pa'i dge 'dun rnams kyis brtan bzhugs shig 'bul rgyu'i 'don pa gsung gin 'dug pa la rim gyis nyag je phra la song 583

/ /gung thang bstan pa'i name'i r+yāng 'bum/ste 'don pa chad/ der wang zhabs drung rin po che thugs khros nas bkra shis rtags brgyad sogs phyag tu 'bul dgos rgyu la lus 'dug gsungs nas thugs 'tshab pa lta bu gnang gi 'dug pa la/ g.yon zur nas 'brog mo na chung bzhin mdzes pa zhig gis glu mang po zhig len pa'i gzhan rnams brjed 'dug / nub bya shar 'phur rang tshang snyegs/ / nam mkha' mtho yang ci byar yod/ / rta zhon rang yul ma song na/ / 'byung bzhi lug spu bzhin du 'thor/ / zer ba sems la zin/ gnyid sad nas rta'i lo rang yul du ma song na lug gi lo 'byung bzhi so sor 'thor nas 'chi ba yin zer rgyu yin pa 'dra bsam/ sbyin bdag wang dang gung sogs blo gros dang ldan pa 'ga' zhig la gleng bas gung gis de khyed la lta rgyu min 'dra/ lug gi lo 'di nam byung res kyis sbyin bdag wang gi khyim du tsub pa zhig yong gi yod pas de 'dra la lta'am zer/ nged rang rta'i lo rang yul du slebs/ lug gi lo sbyin bdag wang dang sras che ba gnyis gshegs/ btsun mo dang sras gzhan rnams ma mthun pas mnga' 'bangs bgo bsha' byas te so sor gyes nas lug bal 'thor ba lta bu byung 'dug cing / nged kyang lug sprel gyi lo gnyis gar na tsha thu mo byung song bas yon mchod gnyis gar gegs chag che ba'i ltas su mngon/ nged rang khri khar bsdad pa rmis pa ni wang zhabs drung rin po che dgon lung gi khri ba spor nas nged rang khrir 'dug pa dang / 'don pa chad pa dang bkra shis rtags brgyad 'bul rgyu lus bas nged rang khrir bsdad nas chos srid gnyis char gyis dgon sde legs par skyong bsam yod kyang dam sris brlams pa kha shas kyi byed spyod la brten bsam pa bzhin ma grub pas de la lta ba yin 'dug ces zhal slob nang ma 'ga' zhig la gsung snang / am ban gyes bya khyung dgon pa'i lo rgyus 7gong mar mkhyen du bcug pa bzhin zi bon gyi 584

sa / /chubatsun bzangatsamadzamanyis d+madamanag sabyung/gsol ras gnang bar am ban dngos kyis bya khyung du zi bon skyel ba dang gzhan gser yig sgrog rgyu yod pas/ nyid dgon lung gi bla ma che kha dang bcas bya khyung du phebs rogs mdzod ces thung zi btang byung ste zla bcu gcig pa'iyar tshes la khri zur wang zhabs drung dang bcas bya khyung du chibs bskyod/bla chen gyi lha khang du mjal zhor la gsar bzhengs gnang ba'i sku 'dra rnams la phyag nas 'thor zhing 'khrungs skar gyi dga' ston co'u kya nas mdzad de bya khyung du slebs/ zi ben dang a ma ban la bsu ba ser sbrengs lugs srol ltar dang / rje 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'ang phebs par ser sbrengs dkyus gcig la bsgrigs/ am bhan dang car go chi sogs dpon po che chung rnams shad kyis tshogs chen 'du khang gi sgo drung du babs te 7gong nas dgon pa'i ming la bstan rgyas gling zhes skad bzhi shan sbyar gye zi ben gsol ras stsal ba de nyid 'du khang gi sgo mo che'i steng thad kyi 'khyams su btegs/ gong nas zhwa ser gye bstanapa'i lugs srol kho na gtso bor byed pa las gzhan grub mtha' mang po gang 'dod byas mi chog pa'i rgyu mtshan can gyi gser yig babs yod pa de nyid rje 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa dang rje 'di ba cha gan no mon han/ wang zhabs drung sogs phyogs 'dus kyi bla ma che chung rnams zhal 'dzom thog tu am ban dngosakyis bsgrags nas rang rang gi mnga' 'og gi dgon sde rnams la dril bsgrags dgos tshul gnang ba bzhin nyid nas bya khyung gi tshogs dbus su bsgrags shing / 7gong nas de ltar bkas bcad gnang ba zhwa ser gyi bstan pa bstan 'dzin dang bcas thugs la btags pa yin pas bka' drin shin tu che tshul dang / tsong kha dang dpa' ri pho rong gan lang shu'u rnams su nyid rang gis bdag mdzad pa'i dgon sde rnams la bka' phebs bzhin gser yig dril bsgrags pa'i gnas tshul rnams am bhan brgyud nas snyan 'bul 585

༄/ /yo thang bstan pa'ithoname'i gsung 'bum/zhus/ sngar shing 'brug lo'i dgun har chin du bzhugs skabs/ nyin gcig zhal nas mdang mi zhig gis khyod kyis nga la ra gsur zhig bsngos na khyod rang rang yul du mgyogs par thon pa'i las rogs nges bgyid pa la zer ba zhig rmis pa dam can gyi 'phrul yin pa 'dra gsung nas de ma thag gsur mchod dpa' bo dgyes skyed ljags rtsom dang gsur rdzas tshad ldan sbyar te gsur gtong 'jug pa gnang zhing / de phyin chad nas sku don gal che ba'i dus su ra gsur ched dmigs btang bas 'azin las bsgrubs pa'i mtshan ma mngon pa mang du byung / de rjes me rta'i lor rgya nag nas yar byon dus mar tshang du zhag bab thog yang zhal nas/ mdang rmi lam du dge ldan bstan rgyas gling gi mkhan po yin zer pa'i thang zhwa spyon pa'i 'brog pa brjid bag can zhig 'ongs nas nged rang sgug sdod byas pa lta bu khyed rgya nag tu phebs nas lo mang po 'gor song zer/ nged kyis lo gsum tsam 'gor ba yin zhes bshad pa'i mu la gnyid sad byung / bod kyi gsang sngags dga' tshal la bstan rgyas gling zerab red/ dge ldan bstan rgyas gling zer ba thos ma myong gang ltar yang mthu ltas dang rgyal gdon gyi 'phrul zhig min na legs pa 'dug gsung cung zad thugs dogs za ba'i rnam pa mdzad/ 'on kyang snga phyi'i mnal lam byung tshul dang rje nyid rgya nag tu 'byon khar bya khyung gi khri'i snyan gsan phul bar zhal bzhes mdzad kyang yar phebs rgyu lo kha shas 'gyang ba dang / yar phebs te bya khyung gi mkhan khrir bzhugs pa'i thog 'dir 7gong ma chen po nas dgon par sgos kyi zi pen dang / dge ldan bstan pa spyi'i dbu 'phang 'degs pa'i gserayig bcas byung ba rnams gung bsgrigs na bya khyung gi srung ma dam can gyis nyid sogs yul du bzhugs skabs gdan 'dren du song nas chibs kha myur du bsgyur ba'i zhabs bskul dang sdongs grogs zhus shing / yar byon 586

༄/ /phebatsugasabazangacho minyima'igagangagag pad+madakhasadabyung/dus phebs bsur 'ongs nas mkhan khrir bzhugs rgyu 'gor ba la thugs 'khang ba'i rnam pa dang / ming zur gyi sgo nas slar bya khyung du bstan rgyas gling zhes pa'i mtshan thogs rgyu dang ri bo dge ldan pa'i bstan pa 'phel rgyas su gtong ba'i 7bka' lung dril sgogs rgyu rnams dkyus gcig la lung bstan par gor ma chag go / am ban dang dpon po rnams la gsol ston 'dzin pa dang rje 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa rin po che'ang bla brang du gdan 'jags par shangs len gsol ston zhus/ gzhan yang bla dpon du ma dang phan tshun du mjal phrad dang lugs zung gi bka' mchid mang du 'phel/ phyir 'byon skabs 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa rin po che gdan drangs te lhan du phebs nas co'u kyar bzhugs/ de nas 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa rin po ches rje 'di ba'i phebs byams la bzhugs nas lcang skya rdo rje 'chang gi sprul pa'i skur mjal phrad la chu bzang du phebs/ rje nyid mar tshang grong sde gong ma'i lha khang gsar ba dang gsar bzhengs gnang ba'i sku 'dra rnams la phyag nas 'thor zhing /dera.o thog gi ca khir chi at+pa sirnyi sogs mjal ba brgya phrag tsam sgug sdod byas yod pas so so nas mjal kha dang bka' bsgo gsung brtag zhus pa'i 'dun pa bskangs/ de nas dgon lung du babs te 7gong ma'i gser yig tshogs su bsgrags/ rje 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa rin po che'ang dgon lung du chibs bsgyur gnang bar khri zur wang zhabs drung gis gtsos phebs bsu ring thung thab bsu ser sbrengs bcas bkur ste chen pos bla brang bkra shis 'od 'bar du gdan drangs/ nyid nas zhus te bla ma sgom pa sogs ri khrod pa 'ga' zhig la rje btsun mi la'i rnam thar dang mgur 'bum lam rim myur lam/sgom chen ngag dbang grags pa'i lam rim rdor 'dzin dkon mchog rgyal mtshan gyi lam rim sogs ljags lung du ma dang / nyid kyi zhal bkod bzhin 587

༄/ /yo thang bstan ba'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/rgyud pas 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum ma'i dbang dang / spyi nas kun rig gi dbang zhus pa rnams bla brang nang du gnang bar nyid kyang gsan par mdzad/zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i tshes gcig la 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa rin po che tshogs dbur gnan drangs nas bla spyi khag so sos zhabs brtan 'bul thog bla brang nas nang mdzod kha btags/ dngul srang bco lnga'i maṇ+ḍal sne 'dogs can/sku gsung thugs rten/ gos chen tshem grub kyi bzhugs gdan rgyab yol/ rdo dril/ rten khebs che legs/ dar dbyangs cha/ gos chen las bsgrubs pa'i sdor bu/ spos shel dang sman shel gyi shal ba gsum/ gos chen legs pa yug gsum/ dngul srang nyis brgya lnga bcu/ lpags ser bcu/ bu la gā ri gsum sogs dngos 'bul rnam grangs mang po dang byams sku gsar bzhengs kyi zhal 'debs su gser srang bcu dang dngul srang brgya bcas phul/rje bla ma de nyid thar ba gling du gdan drangs nas lhan du chibs bskyed de slob chung sogs skya ser gyi rta thab ser sbrengs dang bcas dgon par phyag phebs/nyid kyi dgongs bzhed ltar rje 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa rin po che nas 'du khang dang bka' 'gyur lha khang gsar bzhengs lam rim bla rgyud kyi sku brnyan sogs la rab gnas dang / skya ser gyi khrom la spyan ras gzigs bcu gcig zhal gyi dbang bsgrub bya mang po la dge tshul slong gi sdom pa dpon slob sde dang bcas pa lha mo dang dam can gnyis la gnyer gtad kyi 'phrin bcol gsar rtsom ljags lung dang bcas bka' drin stsal/ yul lugs kyi gsol ston 'bul nod gzab rgyas zhus/ bkra shis chos gling du yab sras rnam gnyis lhan du gdan drangs pa bzhin rje 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa rin po che chibs skyel gyi zhor la phebs te che phra thams cad la mjal kha gnang nas phyir thar ba gling du byon/ nyin kha shas bzhugs te sgom pa bsam gtan rgya mtsho sogs ri 588

༄ / /rje badza gsaza cha mkhag dbyungakakhrod pa dang don gnyer ba du mar rje btsun mi la'i rnam thar dang mgur 'bum/lam rim dmar khrid sogs lngags lung mang tsam gnang / grwa ba 'ga' zhig gis dgon gnas kyi zur du 'gol sa zhig tu sgom khang rgyag rgyu'i sa cha gzigs rtog dgos tshul zhus pa bzhin mchod rten lung ba'i nye 'dabs su gnas bkod mdzad/ or du su ta lang pe zi gzugs gzhi ma bde bar gsung brtag zhu mi rab 'byams pa dang ja lang gnyis 'byor ba la brtag lan phyag sman sogs gnang / dgon lung du phebs te nyer dgu'i nyin mgon po'i gtor chen gye 'cham la gzigs/ dgung lo nga gsum pa sa bya'i lo gsar gyi nyin tshes gtor dang tshogs dbur phebs nas tshogs gtam dang dge bskos bsko bzhag dge 'dun mang la lo gsar gyi mjal kha sogs sgrig lam gye dkyus bzhin gnang / cha har bsam gtan dpon po'i tsha bo dge slong tshe ring gis dpon pos bskur ba'i dngos 'bul gya nom pa brtan bzhugs lugs su phul te gsol ba btab/ smon lam chen mo nyid kyi bkod khyab ltar o'u han wang 'chi med grub pas mi sna khā thub jir gal ched mngags gtong dngul srang stong phrag gcig bskur ba gnang bar bla brang nas khur blangs te dgos chas mtha' dag legs par bsgrigs nas cho 'phrul dus chen gyi ring la lha mchod mi mchod phul du phyin pas bsod nams rlabs po che nye bar bskrun/ tshes brgyad dang bcu bzhi bco lnga'i nyin rnams la gos sku bshams pa dang gtor rgyag gi 'cham sogs la gzigs rtog dang / gsung chos la skyes rabs kyi gzab bshad smon lam la sbyin bdag rnams kyi ming tho bsgrags nas dge ba'i rtsa ba byang chub tu bsngo ba'i spyan dmigs mjal ba mang por ma ṇi'i bzlas lung dang sdom pa 'bog pa sogs phyag len ltar mdzad dur bed dge slong mkhyen rab ho'u chid ku thi blo bzang byams pa o thog mi rin yon tan sogs phyogs nas 'dus pa'i 589

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'isgroname skung 'bum/ 'grul pa drag zhan mang pos nyid la dngos 'byor gyi mchod sprin bstar zhing /dge 'dun rnams la'ang mang 'gyed gya nom pa zhus/ de dag la rta mgrin gsang sgrub dang sgrol dkar bka' bab dgu ldan mi 'khrugs pa seng ldeng nags sgol gyi rjes gnang sogs 'dod chos mang du stsal/ kun bzang ja sag dus las 'das pa'i bsngo rten dang mang 'gyed byung bar srid pa'i 'phrang las sgrol ba'i bsngo smon gyi mtshams sbyor gnang / mā thi dgon pa'i gdan 'dren pa glang zhabs drung las sne 'ga' dang bcas 'byor par zhal len 'dod chos gnang sbyin sogs kyis tshim par mdzad/ bar chos la dgon lung du 'chad nyan shin tu dmar ba mdzad cing / dpyid chos la bya khyung du phebs te der 'chad nyan gyi rgyal mtshan bsgrengs/ sa ga zla ba'i yar tshes la bya khyung dgon du mkhan zur rnams dang rgyud pa bla ma zhabs drung sku skye sogs gzu bor gnas shing blo gsal don du gnyer ba'i snod ldan gyi slob ma mang por paṇa chen chos kyi rgyal po'i gsung gi nying khu byang chub bde lam gyi khrid rje bla ma'i lam rim che chung sogs kyis khogs phub cing / bka' gdams gong ma'i gsung sgros dang dam pa brgyud pa'i man ngag zhal shes kyis zur brgyan pa chos kyi mde'u sne nang du bstan te nyams myong la bskor ba'i gzab bshad smin rgyas su gnang ste so so'i skal ba bzhin mngon mtho lha mi'i rten dang nges legs theg pa gsum gyi byang chub sgrub pa'i lam bzang por bkod/ gdan sa gnyis ga'i skyong khur stabs gcig pa'i dbang gis khrir yun ring bzhugs rgyu dka' 'ang / 'chad nyan sgrig lam 7gong nas bdag rkyen zhu rgyu sogs lugs gnyis char nas gzhan gyis lo mang po'i bar du bsgrub par mi nus pa'i phan pa rgya chen po mdzad de khri'i dgongs pa nan gyis zhus nas khur 'jog par mdzad/ khri ba gsar ba rje 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa rin po che la zhu rgyur thag 590

da / /rje badzastanarā bzang cha gakhagasadag/bcad nas bla brang phyag mdzod ka thog bla ma sogs snyan gsan 'bul mi rnams mngags/ ka bug zhabs drung gis zhus nas nyan mkhan mi nyung tsam la rta mgrin chos skor gyi ljags lung gnang / tshogs dbur brtan bzhugs dang spyi sger gyis legs 'bul btegs te mjal kha dang skyabs 'jug zhus/tshogs par mang 'gyed gya nom pa gnang / gdong 'jug mkhan rin po ches gdanadrangs nas gsol tshigs zhus thog khong rang gi bla brang rnying ba bde ba khang rten gsum mchod rdzas gdan cha snod spyad dang bcas phul/ dgon pa nas chibs bsgyur gnang dus dge 'dun mang gis rgyang grags gcig gi sa char zhabs phyir 'brang nas thal skad dar 'bod sogs slad ma'i rten 'brel legs par bsgrigs/ zhabs drung sku skye las sne dka' ram sogs rta ba mang pos ja thab dang tsha bab zhag bab bar du rim pas chibs skyel dang sga phug zhabs drung dang dge bskos dge rgan ngo g.yog dgon lung bar du zhabs phyi zhus/ dgon lung bas kyang rta thab ser sbrengs kyis mdun bsus te gdan sarababs/ sbyin bdag har chin ching wang maci badz+ra gyi mi sna khā rdor rgyal dang khun tu sin chog thu ngo g.yog 'byor nas brtan bzhugs 'bul thebs dngul srang lnga brgya zhu shog can dang btsun mo ma ṇi dha rā/ lha sras lha rgyal rdo rje dang bsod nams dpal ldan sogs drag zhan mang po'i zhu shog rten chas rnams phul bar wang la rten 'brel gyi legs skyes gzabs shing el chi rnams la gnang sbyin 'byor lan stsal/ don gnyer can 'ga' zhig gis zhus ngor ser skya brgya phrag du ma la khros nag lha lnga'i dbang dang rta mgrin gyi rjes gnang de'i sgrub thabs las byang bdud dpung 'joms pa'i rdo rje dang / de'i dmigs rim rta mchog rol ba'i dgongs rgyan sogs ljags lung 'ga' zhig bcas gnang / sku 'bum mkhan po zin bla ma brje mtshams la dgon pa'i 591

༄/ /yo nga bstan ba'izlaname'i r+yāng༄ma/sman pa dpon slob mi nyag sprul sku dang sku rten chos rje bla brang chen mo'i phyag mdzod dge gnyer tsho ba drug gi rgan pa dang / bla spyi sgar ba so so'i mi sna ngo g.yog bdun cur nye ba 'ongs te zla ba lnga pa'i tshes bzhi'i nyin rje nyid la khri dar phul nas sku 'bum gyi mkhan khrir bzhugs dgos kyi gsol ba btab/nyid nas dgung lo bgres pa dang dgon lung gi khrir bzhugs bzhin pa bcas gang ci nas chos sde chen po gnyis ga'i 'chad nyan zung 'brel du sgrub dka' ba sogs kyi bab rgyun gsungs shing / de mtshungs dgon lung gi gnyer ba chos khrims grwa rgan rnams nas kyang de lugs kyi rgyu mtshan zhib bkrol byas te bshad kyang gdan 'dren pa rnams nas u tshugs mthar skyel gyis zhu ba nan chen yang yang zhus pas ngo bzlog ma nus par mkhan khrir bzhugs rgyu'i zhal bzhes gnang / stag 'tsher dpon chung phyag mdzod du bskos shing gnyer ba blo bzang yar 'phel ngo g.yog thab 'dzin du btang / bod kyi yi ge rnams bsgrigs shing dge 'phel ri khrod pa'i grwa khang zhig gso'i thebs su rgya dngul rdo tshad gcig bskur ba gnang / su nyid g.yon ru'i wang dpal 'byor yar 'phel gyi mi sna khā dkon mchog ngo g.yog 'byor nas wang dang pe li sogs drag zhan mang po'i mtshams zhus dang lung zhus phul bar brtag lan sogs yid tshim par stsal/ tshes bcu'i nyin bya khyung gi khu re zhabs drung la nā ro mkha' spyod kyi dbang gnang / sgrub sde byang chub gling gi ri khrod pa rnams kyis snga ma nas ri khrod 'dzin bdag gnang dgos tshul nan che ba bzhin bco lnga'i nyin der phebs nas khri 'don mdzad/ har chin pe zi'i ho sho'u smon lam bla ma bkra shis dar rgyas kyi phyag mdzod tho yon dge legs rab rgyas ngo g.yog 'ongs nas bla ma'i yang srid dogs gnas kyi 'os tho rje 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa rin po cher phul bar thugs dam brtag pa gnang ste nyid kyi sku tsha kun dga' bstan 592

༄/ /rjebatsug bzangachos nyima'ig4gtsosamadakhasadabyung/'dzin smon lam bla ma'i yang srid du thag bcad pa bzhin bshol zla lnga pa'i tshes drug la phyag mdzod ngo g.yog gis skyed tshal yid dga' chos 'phel nas kun dga' bstan 'dzin la kha btags phul te rten 'brel bsgrigs/ sngar shing sbrulapha la rje 'di ba smon lam bla ma'i dgon par phebs dus mnal lam du smonasam bla mas nged rang phyogs gzhan zhig tu 'gro dgos pas nyid la sang phod tsam la mjal chog / dgon par re zhig yong mi thub pas nyid nas gzigs skor gnang rogs mdzod ces zhus byung ba dang / de rjes grwa rigs rnams kyis bla ma'i yang srid kyi don du gsung brtag zhus par yang mnal lam du smon lam bla ma'i khang bar yang srid kyi dogs gnas yin nam snyam pa'i byis pa re gnyis yod pa la/ skabs shig nub phyogs thag ring nas byis pa zhig rgyug 'ongs nas gdan sar bsdad btang ba zhig byung 'dug pa dang / de'i phyir lo me rta'i mjug tu rje nyid rang yul du 'byor par bla ma sgom pa ngag dbang rab brtan gyes sbrul lo'i mjug tu nub gcig nged kyi rmi lam du sam ṭa zhig gi nang la rgya bod kyi bla ma 'ga' zhig gi mtshan tho bris 'dug pa mthong /phyi nyin zhog ka nor bu 'ongs nas mdang bu chung zhig btsas 'dug pas de la ming zhus zer/ nged kyi sam ṭa'i nang gi mtshan tho'i mjug tu cha med kyi ming mngag li dang kun dga' bstan 'dzin zhes 'dug pas bu chung gi ming la kun dga' bstan 'dzin zhes btags pa yin zhes zhus snang la/ da lan rje —'jamadabyangs bzhad pa rin po che nas kyang 'di nyid smon lam bla ma'i yang srid du thag bcad pa rnams zhib tu brtags tshe don gcig kho nar 'bab pas yid ches kyi gnas su snang / phyag mdzod ngo g.yog la rta mgrin bsnyen yig zhal bzang lta ba'i me long dang sgom rim rta mchog rol pa'i dgongs rgyan sogs chos tshan 'ga' zhig gi lung dang / de'i zla bo gu shri sogs bsgrub bya 593

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'isgoname'i gsung 'bum/kha shas la dge slong gi sdom pa stsal/ phyi log gi nom chi zhabs drung zhing du gshegs par dgon pa spyi nas gdan 'dren pa 'ongs te tshes bcu skor la nom chi dgon du phebs/ zhabs drung gi dgongs pa rdzogs pa'i chos gsungs shing gdung rus la sbyangs chog mdzad/ nom chi bla brang dang dgon pa spyi nas gzhis len 'bul nod yang dag zhus/ dgon par mang 'gyed gnang zhing di na chi dang lung dkar ri khrod nas kyang las sne 'ongs nas mtshams zhus phul bar so sor mang 'gyed bskur ba gnang / grong sde mang por gdan drangs pa bzhin phebs nas phyag dbang lho sgo sogs kyis tshims par mdzad/nyi shu skor la dgon lung du slebs/ rje 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa rin po che zla ba drug pa'i yar tshes la bya khyung gi khri 'don gnang bar sku tsha no mon han ngo g.yog ched mngags gdong dngos 'bul spam mtho ba snyan ngag gi lam nas drangs pa'i zhu shog dang bcas phul/ mdung nag 'jam dbyangs dgon gyi gdan 'dren pa slob chung thog shu'u zhabs drung dpon g.yog 'byor par bka' lan bzang po dang 'dod chos gnang skyes kyis mgu bar mdzad/drug pa'i smon lam la gsung chos smon lam dkyus ltar gnang / smon lam sbyin bdag o'u han dus 'khor skyabs kyis tshogs dbur gdan drangs nas dngos 'bul gya nom pa brtan bzhugs lugs su phul bar dge ba bsngo ba'i spyan dmigs bka' drin bskyangs/ sku 'bum nas gdan 'dren pa rgyud pa dpon slob gser ri sprul sku gtsos pa'i spyi bla brang sgar ba khag chen rnams kyi mi sna drag zhan drug cu skor slebs/ tshes bcu'i nyin 7gong nas gnang ba'i chan zhi'i dngul tham bsngags brjod kyi 'ja' sa gser yig 'phyar dar gser 'brug ma ser po rnams dang / bod nas gnang ba'i skya dar stag rnga gdugs rgya gling sogs chen por 'os pa'i chas rnams chibs rags kyi mdun 594

sa / /rjebatsun bzang gsangagakhu pad+madagarasad khakadu tshar du dngar zhing / wang paṇ+ḍi ta zhabs drung dang gser khri sprul sku rnam gnyis gtsos pa'i dgon lung gi zhabs drung sku skye dka' ram las sne dge tshul slong / gdong 'jug mkhan po rin po ches gtsos pa'i bya khyung dang gser khog sogs ris med kyi dgon ma lag gi bla ma las sne ci rigs/ sku 'bum gyigadan 'dren pa ngo g.yog sogs slob 'khor mang la rags pa brgya phrag du mas bskor te gnam gyis sa bkab pa lta bu'i brjid bag dang bcas gling chen dal 'gros kyi rta bsu thab bsu bcas rim par chibs kyi kha lo bskyod/ thang bar zhag bzhugs tho chi kyā khag gsum gyi grong sde rnams kyis 'grul pa'i gnas tshang dang rtswa chas bud shing gi mthun rkyen legs par bsgrubs/ bcu gcig la phebs lam du rtar hor rdum spyi mang gis gsol ja zhus shing ho'u gru zi la sku 'bumabla brang phyag mdzod mchod gzhis tsho ba drug gi mgo pa che rim lnga bcu skor gyis chibs bsu dang gung tshigs zhus/ zi ling gi nye 'dabs su byams pa glo nyal gyi lha khang la sku 'bum spyi nas zhag bzhugs kyi gra bsgrigs bgyis yod par bzhugs/ am bhan khus tā zhen 'ongs nas mjal phrad dang za ma'i khyad par mang po sbyar ba'i gsol tshigs zhus/ bcu gnyis la sku 'bum nas sman pa dpon slob mi nyag sprul sku gtsos pa'i bla spyi drug dang sgar ba khag che chung rnams kyi mdzod gnyer las sne dka' ram dge tshul slong rta ba gzab 'byor can nyis brgya tsam gyis lam thog nas bsus shing / khong rnams nas spyan 'dren gyi chas su khyer 'ongs pa'i gdugs rgyal mtshan ba dan spos phor rgya gling sogs chibs rag gzhung ma'i mdun du bsgrigs/ ching shus ho la dgon pa spyi'i thab bsu gra bsgrigs thog tu gdan drangs te gsol ja dkar spro zhus/ hwang zi sgang nas mchod rdzas sna tshogs thogs pa'i 'phags pa'i dge 'dunadrar smrig gi rgyal mtshan 'chang ba sum stong du nye bas ser sprengs ring 595

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'ithoname'i gsung ཿma/por bsgrigs te so so nas lus kyi 'khri shing dga' ba dang dad pa'i dri bzhon gyis bskyod pa'i nyams 'gyur du ma dang bcas 'bud dkrol gyi rol mo'i bye brag sna tshogs dang / dri zhim po'i spos 'dren gyis mdun bsus shing grwa khang so so'i thog tu'ang dar 'phyar pa dam me tog bdug spos sogs mchod rdzas du ma bstar ba bcas phun sum tshogs pa'i rten 'brel gang legs kyi sgo nas thog mar yab rje chos kyi rgyal po'i gzim khang 'jam dbyangs sgar bar babs/tshom chen du gsol ja dkar spro dang bla spyi sgar ba khag so sos dem ja zhus shing khri ston la 'dus pa'i 'grul ba drag zhan mang por mjal kha gnang / tshes bcu gsum gza' skar 'phrod sbyor bzang po'i nyin yab gcig brtan pa'i 'khor lo mi'i srid par rol pa'i sgyu 'phrul gyi dra ba thog mar bstan pa'i zhing khams lusbe'i tshal dang rjes su mthun pa bka' gdams glegs bam sogs las 'byung ba bzhin sgrib bral gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi rang mdangs lha'i sku dang yig 'bru mtha' yas pa rang byon du phebs pa'i tsan dan ljon pa'i ming zur las gras te gdan sa chen po sku 'bum zhes grags pa'i ba dan srid na g.yo zhing / mtha' dbus skye 'gro ma lus pa'i bsod nams kyi zhing mchog / rgyal ba'i dbang po na rim gyi gdan sa thub bstan rin po che'i rtsa lag dam par gyur ba'i chos sde chen po nyid kyi tshogs dbur phebs te mi 'jigs gdong lnga'i khri la zhabs sen nye bar bkod/ dge 'dun mang la lam rim chen mo'i dbu nas gsung chos thun gcig dang phyag dbang gnang /'jam dbyangs bzhad pa rin po che nas bang chen mgron gnyer lhun grub rgya mtsho ched mngags gdong / mkhyen brtse'i gdengs ka 'bum du dar ba'i sprin/ / mi zad 'dod dgu'i snying po 'chang ba'i dpyid/ / ces sogs snyan tshig gi lam nas drangs pa'i chab shog dang bcas khri 'bul spam mtho ba bskur 596

༄/ /rjebatsun ba nyis gsangabasgomakhad+madakanas ༄ kaganang mdzad pas thog drangs te sku 'bum spyi so chen mo dang / bshad sgrub gling rgyud pa bla spyi sman pa bla spyi sku rten chos rje sgar ba khag bcu dgu/ bu dgon ri khrod nyi shur nye ba dang zi na nang so mi nyag nang so sogs mchod gzhisakhag can 'ga' zhig / dgon lung spyi so chen mo dang rgyud pa btsan khang gzhan bla brang che chung dang dgon lag bco lnga tsam gyi bla spyi/ chibs skyel pa chos rje dka' ram mang po dang bde rgu nang so da'i ching nor bu sogs dad bas 'ongs pa'i yon bdag mang po dang / bya khyung spyi so chen mo dang gdong 'jug bla brang bla ma dbu mdzad pa ka thog bla ma/ bkra shis 'khyil spyi so/gser khog gi bla spyi dang sde pa chos rje tshogs chen dbu mdzad/ len hwa thas bla spyi/ gser thog dgon pa bla spyi/ sbyin bdag pe zi tshe brtan rdo rje dang pe li 'jigs med ye shes pe li 'phrin las dpal 'byor mi 'gyur pe zi dge 'dun gung chu 'gag ja sag so so'i mi sna rnams mu mthud nas gshar te dngos 'bul rgya che zhing tshan grangs mang ba btegs/ de nas bla brang chen mor phebs te gzhi byes kyi 'grul pa drag gzhan stong phrag mang po la ston mo gzab rgyasadang dgon pa'i bla spyi so sor 'bul ba/ dge 'dun la mang 'gyed kyi bsnyen bkur gzab rgyas dang chibs skyel pa dang mi sna drag zhan so sor go bab kyi gnang cha mdzad/ dang por gnam gshis shin tu dwangs shing ston mo grol mtshams su char zim bu babs pas rten 'brel legs par 'grigs/ wang zhabs drung sogs chibs skyel pa drag zhan spyi sger nas kyang dge 'dun gyi sder 'byor tshod dang bstun pa'i mang ja dang 'gyed rnam bzhag spyi 'jog ci rigs zhus/ 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa rin po che nas bya khyung du dam bca' 'jog parakhrid 'ongs pa'i chos grwa ba rnams 'dir yang mngags te nyid kyi khri ston dang 'brel bar dam bca' 'jog rgyu'i bkod khyab gnang ba bzhin byas pas 597

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'itshoname'i gsung 'bum/chos dang srid kyi dga' ston zung du 'brel bar gyur/ sngon rje nyid dgung lo zhe lnga pa'i skabs nub gcig mnal lam du paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa bzhugs khri mthon po zhig gi steng na bzhugs 'dug pa la khyed mya ngan las 'das zer ba e bden zhus pas/ 'das ma 'das gang ltar yang tha mal pas mi mthong ba zhig byas yod gsung / nyid kyi thugs la tha mal bas mjal mi thub pa'i ye shes kyi sku de mjal rgyu byung ba bdag skal ba bzang snyam du dad pa dang skyo shas 'dres ma zhig 'khrungs/ paṇa chen mchog nas kha btags chos 'don gcig gar+sha pa ni brgya phrag bcas gnang ste khyod kyis sgol dkar gyi sgo nas bla ma la zhabs brtan 'bul ba'i cho ga zhig rtsom zhig / lo 'di nas phar brtsis pa'i lo dgu tsam na rang re mjal lo gsung ba na yig cha de skyabs mgon mchog gi zhabs brtan la dmigs nas rtsom 'dun zhu/ zhal bzhes bzhin lo dgu ba'i thog zhal dkyil cis kyang mjal chog pa'i skyabs 'jug brtse bas gzigs pa mkhyen mkhyen zhes gsol ba 'debs pa'i mnal lam zhig byung ba'ang de nas lo dgu pa'i mtshams su sku 'bum gyi mkhan khrir phebs te sngar paṇa chen bzhugs gnas kyi gzim khang du bzhugs mal 'dra sku sogs la mjal rgyu'i brdar mdon zhing / gtso bor chos sde chen po'i gang nas bdag gir mdzad de bstan pa'i bya ba rlabs po che mdzad rgyu 'di nyid lung bstan par snang ngo / / der ma zad bya khyung gi khrir bzhugs skabs nyin gcig zhabs phyi 'ga' zhig la mdang nged rang gi mi lam du rgya dpon rma bya'i sgro btags pa gnyis 'ongs nas khyed nged tsho'i dgon par rnam 'byon rgyu yin zhes dris byung / nged kyis khyed tsho'i dgon pa gang na yod dris pa la nged rang tsho'i dgon pa'i dkyil du grog mo che ba yod ces 'brel med kyi lan btab byung bas/ nga'i sems la khong tsho'i dgon par bod skad bshad ki med dam 598

sa / / zangams mi)sloba'ig d+ma dmas ga ga kadaponawa 'di gnyis bod skad mi shes pa 'dug snyam pa zhig mis pa ci yin gsungasnang ba'ang bya khyung gi mkhan khri brjes ma thag sku 'bum gyi mkhan khrir bzhugs rgyu'i brda' yin par shes sla la/ mnal ltas 'di dag dang sngar bya khyung gi khrir bzhugs rgyu dam can gyis bskul ba sogs la brtags na dgon so so'i khrir phebs pa'ang grwa rigs sbyin bdag so sos mos zhen gyis gdan drangs pa tsam ma yin par/ thub bstan gling bzhi'i khyon kun gsal bar bya ba'i phyir du bstan srung dam can rgya mtshos 'phrin las rta ljang shing rta'i sgo nas bstan pa'i nyi ma chen po nyid thugs bskyed dus bab kyi phyogs de dang der spyan drangs pa kho na yin par gor ma chag go / bco lnga'i nyin gser sdong lha khang du mchod pa rnam lnga rgya chen po bshams te yan lag bdun pa maṇ+ḍal dang bcas sngon du btang nas sems bskyed cho ga gsol 'debs smon lam sogs gang rgyas dang spyan dmigs shugs drag po gnang / lha khang rnams dang btsan khang chen mor yang lha mar snyan shal bzang spos dang bcas mchod mjal dang chos skyong la 'phrin bcol gnyer gtad mdzad/ o'u han dus 'khor skyobs la nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i siju ra'i byin rlabs stsal/ dbyar gnas kyi skabs gsung chos la lam rim chen mo'i gzab bshad dang 'dzin grwa so sor brtsi bzhag gnang zhing / dgon lung gi rong po dka' bcu dang hor zhi dka' bcu gnyis dam bca' btang bar gzigs zhor du bgro gleng gi rgyugs bzhes/tshogs par chos 'dul ba'i bcas mtshams gzhir bzung ba'i sgrig lam skor gyi tshogs gtam zhib rgyas gnang / thugs rje dang gsung tshul mkhas pa'i dbang gis blo sna rang dbang med par bsgyur te dge 'dun bgres gzhon bar ma thams cad nas gang gsung gus pas dang blangs kyis kun spyod zhi dul la gnas shing 'chad nyan la hur skyed mdzad pa byung / blo gsar ba'i khrod nas 599

mi/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/brtsi bzhag gi rgyug 'bul mkhan yang mang du byung bar thugs mnyes shing gnang sbyin gyis mgu bar mdzad/ sngar zi na mkhan pos sku zhabs 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa rin po cher rje'i gsung 'bum gyi snyan gsan zhus kyang dus la ma sleb pa lta bur lus yod pa da res rje nyid nas bya khyung du gdan 'dren pa btang ste bsu ba ser sbrengs dang bcas bkur ste chen pos gdan drangs/zla ba bdun pa'i tshes gnyis nas nyi ma nyer gsum gyi bar du rje bla ma de nyid kyi sku mdun nas dgon pa'i bla sprul dka' ram dge bshes sogs dge 'dun lnga brgya skor la rje'i gsung 'bum gyi ljags lung yongs rdzogs mnyan du bcug cing / nyid nas kyang sngar ma gsan pa'i skor rnams gsan te kha bskang bar mdzad/ ljags lung grub pa'i mjug tu chos nyan pa rnams kyis dngos 'bul mtshon byed spyan lam du bstar zhing / nyid nas yab rje mchog gi sku che ba'i yon tan las brtsams te bshad pa rgyas bsdus 'tsham zhing 'chad nyan mdzad pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad bla ma'i zhabs pad brtan pa dang rgyal ba gnyis pa'i bstan pa yun ring du gnas pa dang / rje tsong kha pa rgyal ba dbang po'i tog tu sangs rgyas pa'i skabs su thams cad kyis 'khor gyi thog mar skyes nas gsung gi bdud rtsi myong rgyu ste don chen po gsum gyi rgyur dmigs pa'isngags bsngo dang skyabs 'jug zhus par rje bla ma mchog nas de bzhin du 'grub pa'i bka' lan bzang po gnang / bla slob tshang mas bzang spyod dang thog mtha' bar bstan 'bar ma rnams 'ur chems kyis gsungs te rgyal ba'i sras kyi smon lam rlabs po ches rgyas 'debs par mdzad/ nyer lnga'i nyin rje nyid kyis chos rgyal phyi nang gsang gsum gyi rjes gnang gsan/ cha har bka' 'gyur pa dge bshes blo bzang bkra shis la nyid kyi gsar rtsom skor gyi lngags lung mang po zhig gnang zhing / khong la gsang 'dus kyi sngags btu'i 600

sa / /rdzobatsun khaza gakhangabs labadakerashā ༄khakarjes gnang gi rgyun bzhugs par brgyud tho rnams 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa rin po cher spyan 'bebs zhus pas khungs dag par 'dug gsungs pa bzhin chos rgyun la phan par dgongs te bka' 'gyur pa'i drung nas rjes gnang de nyid gsan par mdzad/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor don gnyis lhun 'grub ma'i dmigs rim dngos grub nor bu 'dren pa'i shing rta'ang 'di res ljags rtsom gnang / zla ba brgyad pa'i tshes mgor dgon lung du phebs te ston chos la 'chad nyan mdzad cing wang zhabs drung rin po che o'u han du thon rgyur 'gro chos phebs rdzong zhal ta dang / a lag shar bsdad pa'i sku tshab co god chos rje mjal du 'ongs par 'dod chos 'ga' zhig dang / har chin tho yon ngag dbang blo bzang bod nas rang yul du ldog pa'i lam zhor gyis mjal du 'ongs par na ro mkha' spyod ma'i dbang dang 'jigs byed zhal phyag yongs rdzogs kyi rjes gnang bcas stsal/ zla ba bcu pa'i nang du slar yang sku 'bum du phebs sngar chos sde 'dir rig gnas kyi rgyun spel bar dgongs nas 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa rin po che'i zhabs gras gu thi skal bzang la dge phrug sum cu tsam sprad pa dbyangs can sgra mdo ka lā pa'i ri mo snyan ngag dang sum rtags ci rigs legs par sbyangs par thugs mnyes te dge rgan la legs 'bul mdzad/ gu shri 'di nyid rig gnas ris med la blo mig rgyas pa zhig yin pas chos kyi gsung sgos mang du 'phel zhing / gsung 'phros shig las nged rang gis dpe cha lta dus mgo nas mjug bar du yongs rdzogs 'don mi dgos mtshams mtshams nas blta lugs shig yod/ de ltar bltas na dpe cha de'i spyi'i 'gro lugs dang gnad 'gag gi 'bab sa thams cad sems la shar nas yong / 'di nged rang gis dpe cha lta lugs thun mong ma yin pa zhig yin gsung / gu thi phyir thon nas drung yig la phyag dpe gzigs lugs de bsam 601

༄/ /gung thang bstan ba'izlaname'i khrung 'bum/gyis mi khyab pa'i rnam thar yin pas sa bon la 'god dgos zer zhing dad gus bla na med pa bgyes 'dug pa ni dpyod ldan chos kyi rjes su 'brang ba'i dang pa skye tshul du snang / sman pa dpon slob mi nyag sprul skus dgongs pa zhus par gro tshang mkhan po blo bzang bstan pa'i nyi ma sman pa bla mar bsko bzhag gnang /lnga mchod kyi skabs 'jigs med pe li yum sras dang o thog tha'i ji lha dbang u shing nang so sangs rgyas mdzo mo mkhar chos rje sogs sog 'grul drag zhan spyi sgeral phyag rdor rta mgrin lha mo'i rjes gnang sogs rang rang gi 'dod chos kyis tshim par mdzad/ zla ba bcu gcig pa'i tshes drug la bsgrub bya kha shas la bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa gnang / tshes bdun 'khrungs skar gyi dga' ston nyin or du su hūn gar pe zi'i nu bo tho yon tsan+d+ra thi zhabs drung skal bzang chos kyi 'od zer tā bla ma 'jigs med bde mchog bla ma sbyin bdag thu sa lag chi tshe dbang bsam 'grub kyis ched du mngags pa'i mi sna phas than tā gang nā rnams kyis dngos 'bul gya nom pa bstar te brtan bzhugs kyi rten 'brel bsgrigs/ bde mchog bla mas zhus nas don gnyer ba kha shas la bla ma'i rnal 'byor don gnyis lhun grub ma'i khrid/ nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i dbang dang lngags lung 'ga' zhig gnang / gser thog sgar bar gdan drangs nas nyinakha shas kyi ring sprul sku'i zhabs brtan la mgon po rgyas pa'i gtor sgrub rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg dang bcas gnang / khong rnams nas shangs len dang legs 'bul gang gzab zhus/ bcu gnyis pa'i nang du cha har mur gu chig gi su me'i tī'i chang hu thog thu ngag dbang 'jam dbyangs lhun grub ched gtad kyis bka' chos zhu bar 'ongs pa la khong dpon g.yog dang / sku 'bum rgyud pa bla ma ser ri sprul sku sman pa bla ma gro tshang mkhan po sman pa bla zur mi nyag sprul sku rgyud pa bla zur 'jam dbyangs don grub/ ke kyā zhabs drung pā ju'u 602

༄/ /rjebatsun khazangachosaminyima'ig4gsu padzadakhacodabyung/zhabs drung sogs don gnyer can mi nyung tsam la rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod kyi dbang dang skyed rdzogs kyi khrid 'jigs byed zhal phyag yongs rdzogs kyi rjes gnang dang sngags btu'i rjes gnang de'i skyed rdzogs kyi khrid/ tshe dpag med dkar po dang lo gyon ma gtso 'khor gsum rnam sras gtso rkyang gtsug gtor 'bar ba rnams kyi rjes gnang / dge ldan snyan brgyud kyi tshe khrid bla ma'i rnal 'byor dga' ldan lha brgya ma'i khrid de'i 'pho khrid/rdo rje 'dzin pa dkon mchog rgyal mtshan dang sgom chen ngag gi dbang pos mdzad pa'i lam rim tshig bcad ma'i lung sogs zab pa dang rgya che ba'i chos kyi sgo brgya phye ste re ba'i shing rta man ngag gnor bus yongs su bkang / dgon lung nas khyung tsha zhabs drung dang dge gnyer grwa rgan 'ga' zhig gdan 'dren du 'ongs kyang 'di gnas cho 'phrul smon lam la bzhugs dgos tshul nan che ba bzhinaganang ste dgon lung gi cho 'phrul sgon lam la sbyin bdag zur ba med par bla brang gi las byed rnams la nyid nas sbyin bdag 'ga' zhig la dge bskul mdzad pa'i dngul srang drug brgya tsam yod pa des rgyu yon sbyar te smon lam dkyus ltar legs par sgrub rgyu'i zhal bkod mdzad/ dgun 'dir rdo rje drag mo rgyal gyis gtsos pa'i bstan ma'i gsol mchod cho ga dpag bsam snye ma/ ku ru kul+le'i bsnyen yig don yod 'phrul gye zhags pa/ lha mo'i bsnyen sgrub kyi man ngag snying po bcud 'dus sogs gsung rtsom thor bu 'ga' zhig gnang / dgung lo nga bzhi pa lcags khyi'i gnam lo gsar tshes la tshogs dbur phebs nas dga' ston mdzad cing dge 'dun mang la mjal kha gnang /nyin kha shas kyi ring bla spyi phan tshun du lo gsar gyi dga' ston 'phel zhing /dgon lung dang bya khyung sogs ris med kyi dgon sde che chung nas lo gsar gyi mtshams zhus 'bul mi'ang shin tu mang po byung bar gzhis len ston mo dang go 603

༄/ /gung thang bstanapa'izlaname'i gsungajabum/bab kyi gnang cha mdzad/ smon lam gyi skabs su o thog wang gi btsun mo dkon mchog tshe ring sras mo bkra shis lha mo/ dpal dar gling gi bla ma slob chung dang bla ma dbu mdzad pa car go chi sogs skya ser gyi 'khor brgya lhag dang bcas mjal du 'ongs par spyi khyab tu phyag rdor gtum po khyung lnga dang spyan ras gzigs phyag bzhi pa'i rjes gnang / dpon mo dang bla ma rnams la rgyal po sku lnga'i rigs gtad gnang / dpon mos brtan bzhugs kyi rten 'brel bsgrigs te dngul srang bco lnga'i maṇ+ḍal mdzod btags sku gsung thugs rten bzhugs gdan rgyab yol/ bzang gos bsgrigs pa'i rten khebs che legs tshag gdan che ba bzhi gos chen yug gsum dngul srang bdun brgya bcas phul/gzhan yang ho sho'u tha dad kyi sog 'grul tshan chen po la so sor rjes gnang lung sogs 'dod chos kyis tshim par mdzad/ bcu gcig la stag 'tsher sprul sku'i gtsug phud bzhes te mtshan blo bzang mkhas grub nyi ma zhes gnang /dus chen dang bstun nas bsgrub bya drug cu lhag tsam la bsnyen rdzogs dang sum du za so la nga tshalu blu sdom pa stsal/ bco lnga'i dgung mo lha khang chen mor de tshas pabar༄ rtarwardu khru 4soyobaradzo dab rdo no na rto brgya ma yon tan gzhir gyur ma bzeporgyagabastobar ra mo sos bsu sungs nas phan bde'i 'byung gnas rgyal bstan spyi sgos dar ba'i thugs smon rlabs po che gnang / 'di gar bzhugs ring la thugs brel che dus ma gtogs dgun chos su rtsi bzhag kyang mang po ma chad cing tshogs gtam snyan 'bul dang brtsi bzhag gi rgyug len pa dang / lnga mchod dang cho 'phrul smon lam gnyis la gsung chos smon lam gnang ba dang 'cham dang mchod phreng la gzigs rtog rnams dgos pa'i gtso bor mdzad nas/ chos sde rang gi phyag srol ltar gnang / smon lam grol nas nyi shu skor la dgon lung du phebs/ yo thog dpon mo'ang dgon lung du 604

༄/ /chabatsug bangacho minyima'igasangagag pabadabasadabyungaka'ongs nas tshogs chen du dong tshe khron re'i 'gyed dang rje nyid la tshogs dbur brtan bzhugs bskyar ma phul/ dpon mo dang sras mo gnyis la mgon po snying zhugs kyi rjes gnang dang lha rten spos snam sogs gnang cha gzabs/a lag sha'i grags pa dpal ldan chos rjes zhus te don gnyer can 'ga' zhig la rta mgrin chos skor gyi lung gnang / de dus nyin gcig zhal nas/mdang rmi lam dang nyams snang 'dres mar bu mo zhig nged rang gi rna rtsar 'ongs nas lo'u kyā tun gyi bde mchog rang byon la mchod pa zhig phul na bstan 'gro'i don rlabs po che yong zer byung bas de ci yin gsung / phyi nyin der sems nyid zhabs drung blo bzang mchog grub nyi ma lo'u kyā tun du mjal bar 'gro rgyu'i lam zhor gyis dgon lung du 'byor byung bar stabs yag po 'grigs byung gsung nas shin tu mnyes te bde mchog rang byon la gser chab dang bde mchog rtsa rgyud kyi glegs bam rdo dril dar tshon sna lnga mchod thebs dngul bcas 'bul rgyu bskur/ 'di la dpag na rje bla ma nyid ni smos mi ngasos la/ nyid kyi thugs rjes zhabs drung 'di ba'ang 'khor lo sdom pa yab snyegyer+sharje༄ gu skyong pa'i rten 'brel khyad par can zhig yod par snang / dpyid chos kye skabs 'dan ma grub chen sprul sku dpal ldan thub bstan rgyal mtshan dgon lungagi 'grig gzhug tu phebs par bsu ba ser sbrengs dang bzhugs gral gyi ston mo sogs rten 'brel gye sgo gang legs bsgrigs te bla brang nang du bzhugs su bcug / khong dpon g.yog la lo gyon ma rigs gsum gye rjes gnang dang nyid kyi gsung 'bum dpar 'khod kyi lung bla ma'i rnal 'byor don gnyis lhun grub ma'i khrid bcas gnang / zla ba gsum pa'i tshes la sku 'bum du phebs zhor la mkhar nas ngan slong stong phrag brgal bar sbyin pa gnang zhing /bdog pa thams cad 'bras bcas te/ / skye ba kun la btang sems kyis/605

/ /gung thang bstan pa'i name'i gsung 'bum/zhes pa ltar de'i dge tshogs kyang gzhan don kho nar bsngo bas rgyas 'debs mdzad/ sku 'bum du 'chad nyan dang tshogs gtam 'gro gleng brtsi bzhag gi rgyug sogs skabs su gang bab la zhib tshag gnang / skabs shig zhal nas/nged kyi sems la spyan ras gzigs zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa bzhengs stabs kyis bzhugs pa'i mdun du me tog gi tshal nyams dga' ba zhig la ma te mang podang de'i dzi po lta bu rgya gar pa'i phru gu mang pos me tog sna tshogs lag tu bzung nas rtse gin yod pa'i nyams yang yang shar ba ci yin gsung nas lha bzo zhig la bkod pa gnang ste thugs la shar ba ji lta ba bzhin ri mor bris nas gzim chung gi gyang logs su sbyor bar mdzad/ 'di'i rgyu mtshan ni/ rje nyid nas/ rang re sngon gyi dus shig la/ / yul chen wa ra ṇa se yi/ / grong rdal zhig tu skyes pa'i tshe/ / ma he 'tsho ba'i dzi bo byas/ / nyin bzhin ri la lhan du phyin/ / lam khar spyan ras gzigs dbang gi / sku brnyan bzhugs pa'i lha khang la/ / ri nas btus pa'i me tog gis/ / mchod cing smon lam mang du btab/ / slob dpon rat+na pa dra las/ / bsnyen gnas blangs te lan 'ga' bsrungs/ / tshul de khyed kyis brjed lags kyang / / kho bos lam lam dran par 'dug / ces pa'ang zhabs drung 'jam dbyangs skal bzang bstan 'dzin la gsungs 'dug pas de yin par mngon/ rgyun par yang nyid rang gi bzhugs gnas rnams su spyan ras gzigs kyis rigs drug 'dren tshul dang / khye'u chu 'bebs kyis nya 'dren tshul dang / sgrol mas 'jigs pa las skyob tshul sogs kyi rnam thar ci rigs bshams pa zhig yin pa ni dgongs gzhi khyad par can yod par mngon/ dbyar mā thi dgon pa'i gdan 'dren pa las sne 'ga' zhig 'byor par lo 'dir lcang skya mchog sprul rin po che dgon lung du gdan 'dren zhu rtsis yin/ phebs rgyur song na rten 606

/ /rjebatsun thuzang bas labadakanam ༄kha/'brel gyi mgo yin pas nged rang dgon lung du bsdad de don skor thams cad gra 'grigs nges shig gi do dam byed dgos/ phebs mi thub tshe nged kyang der 'ong chog pas da lan snyan gsan phul nas 'byon mi 'byon gyi bab lta dgos pa 'dug gsung nas chu bzang du phebs/ sprul sku yab kyi khyim du bzhugs yod pas der phebs nas mjal phrad mdzad cing lha thor bzhes nas bkra shis lugs legs su thar pa'i legs dar dang gdan 'dren gyi snyan gsan phul bar sprul sku na phra ba'i stabs do dam pa rnams kyi dbang yin pas/ khong rnams nas lhas thar ma thag 'dir phebs bzhud byas na mi legs pas lo 'dir thag nye ring gang la'ang phebs rgyu min tshul zhus/ de nas nam mkha' ja sag chu bzang dgon du yod par nyid kyang der phebs te khong gi mdun nas lcangs rol pa'i rdo rje'i gsung 'bum nang gi sngar ma gsan pa'i chos chen po tigacig tsam gyi lung gsan/ khri chen rgyu nag pa'i sprul pa'i skus bla brang du gdan drangs nas gsol tshigs zhus shing bka' mchid 'phel/ tshur phebs nas gdan 'dren pa la lo 'dir 'byon rgyu'i zhal bzhes mdzad/ drug pa'i smon lam skabs sku 'bum du gsung chos smon lam gnang zhing gos sku bshams padang byams skor du phebs nas tshogs pa dang lhan du khrus gsol smon lam mdzad/ o thog shes rab sman ram pas zhus ngor don gnyer ba brgya skor la mdo sdud pa sogs chos tshan 'ga' zhig gi ljags lung gnang / smon lam grolanas dgon lung du phebs te mdung nag dang mā thi dgon du 'byon rgyu'i zhal len gnang yod pa bzhin bco brgyad kyi nyin dgon pa nas chibs kha bsgyur/ lam zhor du grong sde'i gdan 'dren pa rnams phyag dbang gis tshim par mdzad/ nyi shu'i nyin 'dul ba dgon gyi bsu ba ser sbrengs dang bcas bla brang du babs tshang mas mjal kha zhus shing nyin gsum gyi ring bla spyi phan 607

༄/ /gung thangabastan pa'i name'i skungababum/tshun du gsol ston drangs nas dga' rtsed 'phel/ sbyin bdag pe zi tshe brtanardo rje'i gdan 'dren pa gnyer ba grags pa ngo g.yog 'byor te nyi shu lnga lade nas thon/ sbyin bdag pe zi dang ta'i ching sku mched blon 'khor dang bcas pa ba ga har ge nas chibs bsu dang i khi har ge nas thab bsu zhus shing / dad 'dus kyi mjal ba stong lhag la phyag dbang chos 'brel gnang /nyer brgyad kyi nyin pe zi'i ur ger dge 'dun gye ser sbrengs dang bcas 'byor/ zla ba bdun pa'i tshes gcig gi nyin no yon i ji dang pe zi sku mched kyis gtsos skya ser stong phrag brgal pa la 'jigs byed kyi khrus dbang dang mtshan dang gzungs sngags rna bas thos pa'i phan yon gyi bshad pa dang bcas dmigs brtse ma rigs gsum mgon po'i snying po byams pas dam bcas pa'i gzungs sogs mtshan dang gzungs sngags khyad par can mang po dang / ma ṇi'i phan yon gyi bshad pa dang bcas yig drug gi bzlas lung dang khas len bskor ba dge ba bla med byang chub tu bsngo ba sogs rgyas par stsal/ho sho'u thun mong nas dbang yon rgya chen po btegs/ tshes gnyis la bsgrub bya nyi shu lhag tsam la dge tshul slong gi sdom pa dang no yon e ji yum sras gtsos pa'i skya ser nyung 'dus la nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i sirdu ra'i byin rlabs 'pho khrid bcasaganang / no yon yi jis dbang yon gyi bdog pa spel/ tshes gsum la pe zi'i dbu gur nas chi ge dang gsol ston drangs nas sogs lugs kyi dga' ba'i rtsed 'jo du ma gzigs mor bstar sbyin bdag pe zis brtan bzhugs kyi rten 'brel bsgrigs thog maṇ+ḍal kha btags sku gsung thugs rten gyis sna drangs te gos dngul rnga rta sogs 'bul ba rnam grangs mang po btegs/bzhugs ring la dad ldan gyi skye pho mo stong phrag mang po 'dus par phyag dbang chos 'brel sogs gang 'dod du stsal/ tshes bzhi la pe zi sku mched 'khor 608

༄/ /sdebatsun ba4cho kyinyis ga bdakurasadabyungakabacasakyis chibs skyel ja thab dang bcas thon a mes blo gsal zer ba'i ri rtsar sgar btab/ 'di nyin lam du char thog chen po brgyab ste kha char bu yug 'tshub pa sog dpon g.yog thams cad 'o brgyal se byung bar thugasacung zad 'tshubapa'i rnam pas yul gyi mi rnams la khyed tsho'i a mes blo gsal zer ba 'di nag phyogs pa yin nam de ring nged tsho la dka' las khag po byung song gsung / phyi nyin zhal nas mdang ngad kyi rmi lam du g.yag zhon cing zhwa dmar po gyon pa'i grwa chas can gyi mi zhig yong bar khyod su yin gang du bsdad yod ces dris pas/ nga rang kun bzang blo gsal yin ri 'di la bsdad yod/sngon bra sgom chos kyi rdo rje mtsho snying la bzhugs dus khong gi mdun nas chos nyan te ri 'di la bsdad nas sgom gyin yod par jag pa kha shas 'ongs nas nga rang bsad pas khong khro'i ngang nas tshe 'phos te mi ma yin du skyes nas ri 'diraganas pa la phyis su grub thob pa zhig gis bdag gi ming zur phud nas 'di1 gsal zer ba zhig yin gyi gsungs par de phyin chad nas thams cad kyis a me blo gsal du 'bod pa yin/ nga rang gi 'gran zla rnams kyis gzhan la mtho brtsams pa dang gnod pa gtong gi yod na'ang nged rang bra sgom chos kyi rdo rje las nyan pa'i chos da dung sems la yod pas gzhan la mtho brtsams pa dang gnod pa gtong gi med zer cing phyag 'tshal ba sogs gus 'dud byed kyin 'dug pa zhig mis byung gsung / mi ma yin rnams la yang las kyis thob pa'i mngon shes phra mo yod pas rje nyid bra sgom gyi sku'i skye ba yin pa shes te gus pa lhur byas par mngon la/ kha char 'bab pa sogs dgos pa med kyang gzhi bdag rnams kyi bsu lugs shig yin par snang / rim gyis u lān mu run du babs te nyin bdun gyi ring gdas dkar wang gami sde rnams kyis rang rang gis tshigs su bsu skyel dang khal ma'i u lā 'o ma me shing rta thun sogs kyi 609

༄/ /yongong bstanapa'ithoname'igasungaḥm/mthun rkyen legs par zhus shing tsha zhag gi sa char skye pho mo'i khrom la phyag dbang chos 'brel dang / mar kham bla ma tshe chin chos rje sogs mi drag 'byor ldan du mas gdan drangs nas bsnyen bkur zhus par so sor lung rjes gnang sogs 'dod chos kyis tshim par mdzad/ a rig gtsod rgan zer pa lo dgu bcu go bdun lon pa zhig gis gdan drangs te 'bul ba phon chen dang tshe g.yang phul nas skyabs 'jug nan tan zhus par 'pho lung dang mtshan dang gzungs sngags khyad par can rnams rna lam du sgog par mdzad/ sems nyid chos rje tshul khrims sogs ser skya du mas rta bsu ja thab dang bcas khu khe e ren du babs te nyin gsum gyi ring phan tshun du gdan drangs nas zhabs tog zhus par dbang skur dang rjes gnang sogs gang 'dod du stsal/mdung nag gi ra ljags dpon slob gtsos pa'i tho'u le ba drag zhan nyi shu skor chibs bsur 'byor/ bco lnga'i nyin mdung nag gis sne tho'u le la 'byor bar chos 'khor gling gi g.yer khu zhabs drung dang ko kyā chos rje sogs grwa ba sum cu skor dang / 'jam dbyangs dgon gyi mchod gzhi'i rgan po bcu lhag bcas rim gyes chibs bsu zhus/ yen der gyi mda' la zhag bab thog mdung nag gi khal ma 'byor bas khu kho e ren gyi skyel mi rnams kyis gdugs dkar dang sher snying gi lung zhus te khal ma dang bcas phyir log / phyi nyin phebs lam dur rgyags dpon po dang mdung nag khag gsum sde drug gi rgan po sogs chibs bsur 'byor nas spyi sger gyi thab bsu rim pa 'ga' dang /'jam dbyangs dgon gye cang yen zhabs drung glang dpon po dbang rgyal pad sdong gi rgan po sogs chibs bsu ba rim pa mang po dang bcas i khe shi rig la sgar btab ste nyin gnyis bzhugs/ nang so em chi 'jam dbyangs dar rgyas sogs lung gsum gyi sbyin bdag che phra thams cad la 'jigs byed kyi sgo 610

༄/ /rjebatsugablobazangacho minya ga4gtsa'id+madabasadabyungakanas byad grol dang dmigs brtse ma dang gzungs sngags zab mo khas len skor ba sogs mdzad sbyin bdag spyi sger nas bsnyen bkur 'bul ba zhus/'jam dbyangs dgon gyi slob chung thog shu'u zhabs drung mchod gzhi'i rgan po dang bcas ser skya sum cu skor gyis chibs bsu zhus/ de nas ra rgyags dpon slob kyis sgar la gdan drangs nas bcag mal mdzad cing / dpon g.yog tshang ma'i rdo rje sems dpa'i rjes gnang ra rgyags sngags pa blo bzang rab brtan sogs la dam can gyi rigs gtad/ pad sdong gi 'jam dbyangs don grub sogs sbyin bdag mang po mjal khar 'dus pa la phyag dbang chos 'brel stsal/ ra rgyags dpon slob kyis gzhis len ston mo gzabs shing dngos 'bul spam mtho ba phul/ de nas ra rgyags dpon po ngag dbang tshul khrims sogs khyim tshang bzhi bcus rta thab dang bcas sa ts+tsha thu la sgar btab nyin gsum gyi ring lho ba sgar sogs phan tshun gyi ru thog tu gdan drangs nas bsnyen bkur zhus pa'i don mdzad cing / ra rgyags dpon pos gtsos khyim tshang bzhi bcu'i skye pho mo thams cad la spyan ras gzigs phyag bzhi pa'i rjes gnang stsal/ lam zhor du glang dpon po dang mā tshayo yi sogs mi drag 'byor ldan du mas gdan drangs nas 'dod don zhus pa'i re ba skong bar mdzad/ 'jam dbyangs dgon gyi su nyid zhabs drung blo bzang bstan 'dzin nyi mas gtsos pa'i dka' ram dge tshul slong / chos 'khor gling gi slob chung ko kyu chos rje mā tsha zhabs drung ko kyā nang so phur tsha dpon po khyang tsha dpon po mā tsha dpon po glang dpon po sogs mchod gzhis drag zhan brgya phrag du ma'i rta bsu ring thung thab bsu dang / mchod rdzas thogs pa'i dge 'dun gyi ser sprengs dang bcas zla ba brgyad pa'i tshes gcig gi nyin chos 'khor gling du babs te nyin lnga bzhugs/ 'du khang gsar bar 611

༄/ /yo bang bstan pa'i sgroname'i ཿnga 'bum/rab gnas dang bla gra tshang mar seng ldang nags sgrol dang sdug bsngal sel ba'i sgrol ma rnam 'joms rta mgrin gsang sgrub rnams kyi rjes gnang dang /gzhan yang zhu mkhan so so'i ngor ljags lung du ma dang bsgrub bya mang por bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa gnang / dgon pa spyi nas gsol ston dang brtan bzhugs kyi rten 'brel bsgrigs thog maṇ+ḍal/ sku gsung thugs rten gyis sna drangs gser dngul dung tshe rta nor mdzo lug sogs dngos 'bul rnam grangs lngabargya dang sum cu so lnga phul/ dge 'dun la mang 'gyed kyi bsnyen bkur dang spyi 'jog tu zog dang dngos po srang nyis brgya'i rtsa long pa gnang /dgon mchod gzhis rnams nas yul phyogs la mtshams mtshams su mu ge nad yams chen po yong gi 'dug pa'i rgyu mtshan zhus pa bzhin thugs dam brtag pa gnang bar mnal lam du mi zhig 'ongs nas nga rang sman pa zhig yin/ 'di ga'i gzhi bdag nad kyis thebs yod par rtsa bltas nas yong ba yin zhus/nyid nas gzhi bdag gi cha lugs gang 'dra zhig red ces dri ba gnang bar/kho rang gos dkar po gyon cing lag tu rin po che'i snod thogs pa zhig red de'i btsun mo klu mo dngul mdog ma zer ba yin zhes zhus pa zhig rmis/ phyi nyin de ga'i gzhi bdag la bsang mchod 'bul tshul lngags rtsom mdzad cing dge 'dun la de'i ljags lung gnang ste sngar yul phyogs su mu ge nad yams mched pa de gzhi bdag gi 'phrul lta bu zhig yin 'dug pas phyin chad klu dang gzhi bdag la phog thug can gye bya ba'i rigs la 'dzem pa gal che tshul gsungs/yus gor gyi gdan 'dren pa rong 'gad zhabs drung pe ran chos rje phun tshogs dpal bzang ngo g.yog 'byor par zhal len gnang / tshes drug la chos 'khor gling gi bla ma las sne'i chibs skyel ja thab bcas thon te phur tsha dpon po'i khyim du bzhugs shing spyi sger gyis zhabs tog 'bul nod zhus par phyag 612

༄/ /sdebatsun kheza bakhangabs lad+madakanas rākha/dbang chos 'brel gyis tshim par mdzad/ rim gyis 'jam dbyangs mgon gyi slob chung dang zhabs drung sku skye grang yen dpon po sogs ser skya brgya phrag du ma'i rta bsu thab bsu dang mchod rdzas thogs pa'i dge 'dun mang pos ser sbrengs kyis mdun bsus te tshes brgyad la dgon thog tu babs/ nyin bcu gnyis bzhugs ring la 'du khang du rab gnas dang bla ma dge 'dun yongs rdzogs la rdo rje 'jigs mdzad lha bcu gsum ma'i dbang chen sta gon dang bcas pa/ 'jigs byed zhal phyag yongs rdzogs rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum jo bo'i lugs kyi dzam lha dkar po rta mgrin gsang sgrub rnams kyi rjes gnang / gzhi gsum cho ga dang rta mgrin chos skor gyi ljags lung sogs dam pa'i chos kyi char phab/ bsgrub bya drug cu lhag la bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa phog ste tshangs spyod yongs su rdzogs pa'i brtul zhugs la bkod/ nyin bzhin phyogs so so nas dad 'dus kyi mjal ba mang por phyag dbang chos 'brel chag med du gnang / dgon pa spyi nas gsol ston rgya che zhus shing zhabs pad bskal brgyar brtan pa'i rten 'brel legs par bsgrigs pa'i thog maṇ+ḍal sku gsung thugs rten gyis mtshon gser dngul dong tshe zam ras rta mdzo nor lug sogs dngos 'bul rnam grangs dgu brgya lnga bcu phul/ 'di res dgon pa'i khri 'jog pa gnang ste tshogs la mang 'gyed kyi bsnyen bkur dang spyi 'jog tu dngul srang nyis brgya'i rtsa long ba'i zog dang gzhis ka gnyis zhing sa 'jag bcu gsum btsugs sdong brgya tham pa bcas gnang / bla ma bka' ram kha shas kyi gshag dang nye 'khor gyi ru sde 'ga' zhig tu gdan drangs par so sor 'dod chos kyis tshim par mdzad/ 'jam dbyangs rang byon la mchod mjal dang thugs smon btab/ yus gur has zi ri khrod sogs lam thog gi dgon sde yon mchod sogs gdan 'dren pa 'byor par zhal len mdzad de nyi shu 613

༄/ /gung bang bstan pa'i sgronami'i gsu 'bum/gcig la 'jam dbyangs dgon nas dge 'dun mang gis dar 'bod chibs skyel ja thab bcas slad ma'i rten 'brel gang legs kyis chibs bsgyur gnang /bshesaganyen dang rngam kha tsho ba so sos bsnyen bkur zhus pa'i 'dod pa skong bar mdzad/ chos lung mda' la yus gur gyi bzang rin zhabs drung lung skya dgon pa'i khri ba khyung tsha zhabs drung pe rin dgon gyi khri ba yig la gar zhabs drung rnams dgon so so'i las sne dang mchod gzhi'i mgo pa jing thu mo ha phu thu mo sogs rgan po rnams dang brgyad po'i jing thu mo has zi'i ha phu thu mo sogs ser skya drag zhan brgya skor gyis chibs bsu zhus shing bzhon rta dang khal ma'ang 'byor pas mdung nag gi yu lā brjes/ mdung nag bkra shis kyi khyim du bcag mal mdzad cing de ga'i khyim tshang bco lnga skor la gdan drangs nas spyi sger gyis bsnyen bkur zhus par mdung nag ngag dbang rab gsal gyi skor la gdugs dkar zhal phyag yongs rdzogs dang phyag rdor gtum po khyung lnga/ pā ri mgon po srung gi skor la dzam lha dkar po/ rgya rag sngags pa'i skor la 'jigs byed kyi rjes gnang rnams dang gzhan rnams kyang rang rang gi 'dod chos kyis tshim par mdzad/ lho pa nang so'i lha khang dang ko kyā zhabs drung gi lha khang gnyis la rim gyis gdan drangs par nang so dpon g.yog la khrus dbang dang ko kyu zhabs drung ngo g.yog la nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i 'pho lung dang sgroladakar bstod pa'i lung gnang / shang chi nas 'jam dbyangs dgon gyi khri ba thog shu'u zhabs drung chos 'khor gling gi g.yer khu zhabs drung slob chung ko kyā chos rje ko kyā nang so sogs dgon pa gnyis kyi nang so dka' ram sogs chibs skyel ba mang pos ja thab zhus nas phyir log / shang shan la has zi'i ong rang chos rje brtson 'grus shes rab sogs dka' ram nang so dge tshul slong dang / ong rad chos grub sogs mchod gzhis sbyin bdag bcas rta pa 614

sa / /rje babargas zang d+ma dmas sa shasalnga bcu skor chibs bsur 'byor nas thab bsu zhus/ has zi ri khrod du bcag mal mdzad cing 'du khang gsar bar rab gnas mdor bsdus dang ong rad chos rje dang ha phu thu mo ngag dbang tshe ring shi jin skal bzang skyabs sogs ser skya bzhi brgya skor la spyan ras gzigs kyi rjes gnang ma ṇi'i bzlas lung phan yon gye bshad pa dang bcas stsal/ so sos nus pa rtsal sprugs kyes gsol ston dang gces nor yod dgu'i mchod sprin bstar zhing nyid nas kyang dge 'dun rnams la mang 'gyed sogs gya nom pa gnang / dgon lung gi bla brang nas grwa pa gnyis mngags pa 'byor te am pan gyis 7gong mas rje nyid kyi gnas tshul bka' 'dri gnang 'dug pas gal srid rgya nag tu 'byon dgos byung tshe thag ring nas tsha drag gis phebs rgyu sku tshag che bas snga sa nas mkhyen du bcug ste ha cang ma 'gyangs par phyir chibs kha bsgyur na bzang gsung 'dug ces zhus/ de nas lung skya dgon du phyag phab ste nyin gnyis bzhugs bla grwa tshang mas chos 'brel dang 'bul ba zhus shing tshogs par mang 'gyed btang /rong 'gad zhabs drung gi gshag tu bla grwa hrag bsdus la phyag rdor gtum chung gi rjes gnang dang 'bul dpon pa la rgyal po sku lnga'i rigs gtad gnang /mjal pa mang po phyag dbang bka' chos kyis tshim par mdzad/ lam zhor du rong 'gad tsho ba spyi sger gyi don mdzad cing khi mar la be ran dgon pa'i bla ma las sne rnams kyis thab bsu zhus thog tsho ba brgyad dang lnga'i dpon po yig la gar dpon po sogs mi drag 'ga' zhig gis chibs bsu zhus/ dge 'dun gyi ser sbrengs dang bcas pe ran dgon du 'byor te bcag mal mdzad/ bla ma dge 'dun mchod gzhis dang bcas ser skya stong lhag la spyan ras gzigs bcu gcig zhal gye rjes gnang dang gra gshag drug tsam la gdan drangs par so sor 'dod chos dang jing thu mo mgon po don grub sogs skye pho mo mang por 615

༄/ /yo thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/sgyung gnas kyi cho ga'i lung rnams stsal/ spyi sger gyis gsol ston dang 'bul ba mi zhel ba bsgrubs/ phebs lam du yig la gar tsho ba spyi sger gyi 'dod don skong bar mdzad cing an gying jing thu mo byams pa bstan 'dzin gyis sbra nang du gdan drangs nas rje nyid snga ma phebs dus nged rang stobs 'byor ha cang zhan kyang ming dang go sa che stabs gdan 'dren mi zhu kha med byung ste spra nang du bzhugs lugs med par phyi log tu phying ba bting nas gdan drangs pas nyid nas sbyin bdag dang spral khyad btang na mi bzang nged rang sbra nang du 'gro gsung nas byon te gsol ja bzhes thog shis brjod dang g.yang 'gugs mdzad cing slar stobs 'byor mnga' thang dga' mo yong gsung ba bzhin deng sang phyugs po'i gral du chud pa 'di'o zhes sngar gyi gnas tshul zhus nas legs 'buladang phyin chad kyi skyabs 'jug nan tan zhus/ yan jin o pa shi ba yod byams pa don grub pa yod bsod nams kyis rim pas gdan drangs nas phyag dbang bsnyen bskur zhus/ so'u wa tsa la sman chu dgon pa'i smon ne+e bla ma spyi gnyer grwa rgan dang bcas yong nas zhag bab kyi gra bsgrigs bgyis par bzhugs te/ phyi nyin dge 'dun gyi ser sbrengs dang bcas dgon du 'byor/zhag gsum bzhugs ring la dad ldan gyi skye pho mo zam ma chad du byung bar phyag dbang bka' chos chag med dang bla ma dge 'dun la spyan ras gzigs bcu gcig zhal dang rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rjes gnang / bzang rin zhabs drung gis zhus ngor bla ma rnams dang bcas don gnyer ba sum cu skor la khros nag mkha' 'gro sde lnga'i dbang rnams stsal/ dgon pa spyi nas gsol ston 'bul ba gzab rgyas dang bzang rin zhabs drung dang yig la gar zhabs drung so sos kyang gdan drangs nas bsnyen bkur zhus/ dgon par mang 'gyed 'bul ba gnang / de nas lam zhor du 'byor ldan gyi khyim tshang du mar rim gyis gdan 616

/ /jebatsugablob nyis gsangabs pabadakuracadabyung/drangs pa la rjes gnang dbang bskur sogs kyis tshim par mdzad/ tshe thar bulag tu brgyad po tsho ba'i jing thu mo mgon po dga' ha phu thu mo rta mgrin skyabs pad sdong gi ha phu thu mo yar 'phel sogs tsho ba so so'i mi drag zhan brgya skor gyis chibs bsu/ gling 'dabs su dge 'dun gyi ser sprengs dang bcas lung ser ri khrod du 'byor/ zhag gsum bzhugs ring la phan tshun du gdan drangs nas bsnyen bkur zhus par jing thu mo mgon po dga'i skor la mgon po bar chad kun sel gyi rjes gnang / pad sdong ha phu thu mo yar 'phel sogs tsho ba spyi mang la phyag rdor gtum po khyung lnga'i rjes gnang sogs rang rang gis gang zhus bzhin re ba skong bar mdzad/ ri khrod du slob chung dka' bcu ngag dbang skal bzang dang dpon po rab 'byams pa ngag dbang tshul khrims sogs ser skya'i khrom la rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rjes gnang stsal/gsol ston dang 'bul ba gya nom pa zhus ri khrod la mang 'gyed stsal/ chu lung la ho yor e khi'i ri khrod kyi slob chung rab 'byams pa skal bzang rnam rgyal jing thu mo kun dga' ha phu thu mo yid bzhin 'khor tha'i ji ngag dbang tshe brtan sogs ser skya mang po chibs bsur 'byor nas ja thab zhus/ tha'i ji ngag dbang tshe brtan gyi khyim du gza' mi tshang mar tshe dpag med kyi rjes gnang stsal te ho yor e khe'i ri khrod du 'byor/ phyi nyin an jing ha phu thu mo yid bzhin 'khor gyis sbra nang du gdan drangs nas pha rgan la dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa dang 'pho lung zhus pa'i re ba bskangs/ an jing ba yan ta'i skor la gdugs dkar gyi lung gnang ste phyir 'khor/ ri khrod du slob chung dang thu mo gnyis sogs yon mchod tshang mar spyan ras gzigs bcu gcig zhal gyi rjes gnang stsal gsol ston 'bul ba bzang zhing phar yang mang 'gyed gnang /rta mgo dgon gyi khri ba rab 'byams pa bstan 'dzin dar rgyas dang chos mdzad 617

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'ithon me'i gsung 'bum/chos rje ngag dbang dar rgyas sogs chos rje dka' ram 'ga' zhig dang tā thu mo ye shes mi 'gyur ha phu thu mo dzam lha skyabs sogs ser skya du ma chibs bsur 'byor te shas rig nas thab bsu zhus/ der mā thi zi'i khyung tsha dpon po ban+de sngo za dpon po 'phrin las rgyab zi dpon po skyi ri dka' bcu shes rab 'jigs med sogs chibs bsu ba mang po 'byor/ tā thu mo ye shes mi 'gyur gyi khyim du rnam rgyal lha dgu'i rjes gnang stsal te dge 'dun gyi ser sbrengs dang bcas rta mgo dgon du 'byor te zhag gsum bzhugs/ spyi mang la rta mgrin gsang sgrub kyi rjes gnang dang chos mdzad chos rje'i ma rgan sogs skye pho mo lnga bcu skor la tshe dbang khri pa rab 'byams pa bstan 'dzin dar rgyas dpon g.yog la khyung khra'i rjes gnang bcas stsal/ spyi sger gyis gsol ston 'bul nod yang dag zhus shing mang 'gyed kyang gnang / de nas chibs bsgyur gnang bar bzang rin zhabs drung smon ne bla ma sogs yus gur gyi dgon so so'i zhabs drung sku skye las sne mo chos rje bka' ram rnams dang / tsho ba khag gi dpon po dang mgo ba sogs chibs skyel pa drag zhan brgya phrag du mas na drin gol gyi mda' nas ja thab zhus te phyir log / thā zi mo'i mda' la shan mo'u zi'i jin kyā zhabs drung sogs grwa pa rnams kyis gsol ja dang mjal kha zhus/ mā thi bod dgon gyi slob chung khyung nag zhabs drung dang chos rje ngag dbang dpal 'byorasti gnyer grwa rgan sogs dka' ram dge tshul slong mang po dang / khyung zhi dang khyung tsha'i tā thu mo sogs tsho ba so so'i rgan po rnams dang rgya dgon gyi slob chung spyi gnyer grwa rgan bcas rta pa brgya phrag brgal ba chibs bsur 'byor te lung zhu phu'i rgya dpon pā tsong gi yā mon du zhag bab gra sgrig bgyis par gdan drangs/ mā shrī pa'i zhon rta dang khal ma'ang 'byor pas yus gur pa'i u lwa phyir slog / de nas nyin bdun gyi ring mchod gzhis nang gi 'byor 618

༄/ /༄tsotshosazangacho migyi gangagatsolagagasabasaranaldan so sos spyan drangs te gang 'byor gye bdog pa'i mchod sprin dang bkur snyi rim gro bla na med pa zhus/ pa nang tsho ba spyi mang la spyan ras gzigs kyi rjes gnang dang bla ma mchod pa'i lung / sngo za tsho ba spyi mang la gdugs dkar gyi rjesaganang dang bla ma mchod pa'i lung / rgyab zi tsho ba spyi mang la rta mgrin gsang sgrub kyi rjes gnang / phan shu'u tsho ba spyi mang la gdugs dkar dang sgyungaganas cho ga'i lung / hang no'u tsho ba spyi mang dang 'bring sho'u tsho ba spyi mang so so la rta mgrin gsang sgrub kyi rjes gnang sogs gdan 'dren pa spyi sger so sor 'dod chos kyi char phab cing mjal ba khrom tshogs so sor mtshan dang gzungs sngags rna lam du bsgrags te ma ṇi'i bzlas lung bsngo smon gye mtshams sbyor rnams gnang smin gyi sgo nas so so'i rgyud la mngon mtho nges legs kyi sa bon thebs nges ba dang gzhan yang bka' bsgo gsung brtag sogs gang zhus thams cad yid tshim par stsal/ yong khrad dgon pa'i gdan 'dren pa slob chung khyung tsha zhabs drung dkon mchog dar rgyas ngo g.yog 'byor par slar 'byon rgyu'i zhal bzhes gnang / gdong lam la bod dgon rgya dgon gyi bla ma dka' ram dge tshul slong du mas rta thab dang gling 'dabs su dge 'dun brgya phrag mang po'i ser sbrengs bcas nyi shu bdun la mā thi bong dgon du phyag babs te zla phyed tsam bzhugs dgon pa spyi nas bla ma mchod pa'i khrid kyi snyan gsan phul bar dgyes bzhin zhal gyis bzhes te dgon pa'i bla ma dge 'dun mchod gzhi'i mi skya drag zhan dang bcas chos nyan ba stong phrag brgal bar bla ma mchod pa'ikhrid zla ba bcu pa'i tshes gcig nas dbu btsugs te nyin bdun gyi ring gsung bshad shin tu rgyas par gnang / de'ang skabs gong 'og kun tu zhal shes kyi man ngag shin tu ngo mtshar ba du mas brgyan cing khyad par du/ zhing mchog dam ba zhes sogs lam gyi lus yongs rdzogs la gshar sbyangs dang 619

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'izlaname'i gsung 'bum/sbrags nas byin rlabs zhu tshul gyi skabs su lam rim ltar skyes bu gsum gyi lam la rim bar slob tshul ngo bo grangs dang go rim mtha' dag la ma rtogs pa dang log par rtog pa'i dri ma bsal te bshad pa don rgya che la blo ngor 'dum bde ba rgyud 'khul nges 'ba' zhig gnang bas blo mig mchog tu yangs pa rnams bstan pa spyi'i 'gang gshog pa'i go ba rnyed cing / rnam dbye cher mi shes pa rnams la'ang so so'i blo tshod dang bstun pa'i phral yun gyi bslab bya bya sla la don che ba du ma zhar byung gi tshul du stsal pa na blo mchog 'bring dman pa mtha' dgagi don du gyur pas thams cad yid tshim zhing dga' spro dang dad gus rgya cher 'phel/ gzhan yang zhu mkhan so so'i ngor sgrol dkar dang dzam dkar rnam 'joms phyag rdor gtum khyung sogs kyi rjes gnang dang rta mgrin chos skor sogs ljags lung du ma dang / rgyud pa grwa tshang la g.yang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud gzhung gi lung dka' ram 'ga' zhig la mgon po snying zhugs kyi rjes gnang bcas stsal/ 'bring shos bla ma bkra shis dpal ldan dang lha ram pa ngag dbang shes rab kyi sku skye gnyis dge bsnyen bsgrubs/ rgya dgon du bla ma dge 'dun tshang mar skyabs 'gro'i khrid gnang / sgrol ma rang byon gyi brag khung du brgya mchod thog smon lam gsol 'debs shugs drag mdzad/ tshes bdun gyi zhog ka zhal nas mdang rmi lam du nged rang gtsang sa skya zhig tu yod pa la dpon po zhig gis dmag 'khor mang po khring 'ongs te nged la khrims kha bstan gshom byas nas rgyal po'i bka' yin khul gyi khrims yig cig bsgrags byung bar/ spyir bla ma ser mo dang khyad par du bla chen de dag ces nag khra 'ga' zhig brjod kyin 'dug pas nged rang gi sems la khos nag khra bsngo lugasal dpag na chos log mkhan zhig yin 'dug phal cher bal bo go r+sha'i rgyalapo yin nam snyam ste tshig 'jam po'i ngos nas bab bstun byi lan btab 620

sa / / chabatsunamakhazangartsamadzamanyima'i bdagarartsamatshurakapas skyon ma byung / nged kyi grogs la khyung nag zhabs drung 'dug pa des ngo 'dzum tsam byas nas 'di tsho gtsang la 'gro rgyu yin pas khyed rang shed mi dgos zer/ gtsang nas gtsang du gang la 'gro byas pas gtsang gi rtse la 'gro sa med dam zer/ khong tshos kyang gtsang du 'gro zhes 'ur zhig langs te rgyug song ba zhig rmis pa bzang ngan ci yin mi shes kyang khyung nag zhabs drung chos skyong gi 'phrul lta bu zhig yin pas bskang gso gtong dgos pa 'dug gsung nas phyi nyin tshes brgyad la dgon lung gi bla brang du'ang dus gtor chen po yin pas de dang bstun nyid sgrub grogs dang bcas pas dpal mgon gyi bskang gso gtong ba gnang / mnal ltas de ni de'i lo rjes mar bal po'i dmag dang po gtsang sa skyar 'ongs kyang de la skyon ma btang bar bkra shis lhun por song ste der brdab gsig che bar byung ba dang / de'i rkyen gyis gong ma chen po nas bla ma ser mo'i rigs spyi dang khyad par sku skye sogs kyi don skor la zhib tshags kyibaka' lung btsan po mang du byung bas 'byung 'gyur de dag mngon sum du gzigs na'ang mis pa'i zol gyis 'doms par gor ma chag la/ pha rol po de dag gis 'og mar nyid la khrims kha bstan gshom byas pa ni gong du smos pa bzhin sa skya'i gdan sa 'di rje rang gi sku 'phreng gong ma du mas bskyangs te bdag gir bzung ba'i yul yin pa de la blta bar mngon no/ / de nas dgon gong 'og bar gsum la rim gyis phebs nas rten mjal dang gnas gzigs mdzad cing tā thu mo mgon po tshe ring sogs tsho ba'i mi mang la sgrol sher seng gdong ma'i lung sogs stsal te phyir dgon du phebs/ dge 'dun spyi nas gsol ston thog brtan bzhugs kyi rten 'brel bsgrigs te maṇ+ḍal sku gsung thugs rten gyis sna drangs dngos 'bul gzab rgyas phul/ bod dgon gyi tshogs chen dang rgyud pa grwa tshang rgya dgon rnams su mang 'gyed gnang /621

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i nayo gsung 'bum/'byor ldan gyi grwa gshag du mar gdan drangs pa la so sor chos bka' gang 'dodadang nyin re bzhin dad ldan gyi skye bo mang por phyag dbang chos 'brel chag med stsal/ tshes bcu gsum la mā thi rgya dgon bod dgon gyi bla ma las sne tsho ba'i mi drag zhan gyi chibs skyel ja thab dang bcas chibs bsgyur gnang /rgya mi phi ching shan gyi khyim du gdan drangs thog nan gus ching gi rgya dpon tsong ye 'ongs nas mjal phrad zhus/ de nas lam zhor du shu'u tu me dang hong tsha ku'u lu rgya che shos/ nib tshu sogs tsho ba so sor mi drag 'byor ldan gyis gdan drangs nas spyi sger gyis bsnyen bkur 'bul nod zhus par lung rjes gnang dbang bskur sogs rang rang gi 'dod chos dang dkyus ma'i bka' chos kyis tshim par mdzad/ tshe ring thang du bcag mal gnang thog bla brang gi gnyer ba dge legs ngo g.yog chibs bsur 'byor te lcang skya sprul sku rin po che dgon lung du chibs bsgyur gnang nas phyir 'khor zin pa'i rgyu mtshan zhus par/ zhal nas nged rang ched gnyer gyis chu bzang du song nas gdan 'dren gyi snyan gsan phul bar do dam pa rnams kyis lo 'dir thag nye ring gang la'ang phebs mi 'gab tshul bshad kin 'dug pas nga'ang 'di phyogs su 'ongs pa yin/ sprul sku phebs rgyu yin tshe nged rang yang rdo rje 'chang chen po de nyid kyi slob ma'i grangs shig dang da lta 'di phyogs kyi bla ma'i bgres mgo lta bu zhig yin stabs/ nged rang yang bsdad de bla slob thams cad mtshams sbyar nas gra gang 'grigs kyis phun sum tshogs pa zhig byed snyam pa yod na'ang nged rang med shul du sprul sku dgon par gdan drangs pa la dgos pa dang rten 'brel 'grigs rgyu lhag po zhig ye yod mi shes gsungs te/ tshul 'di ni sngon thams cad mkhyen pa rol pa'i rdo rje de nyid dgung lo brgyad kyi skabs nas rje ngag dbang chos kyi rgya mtshos do dam gnang ste 'azin las kyi sgo phyes pas sa 622

sa / /rjebatsun thazangama'i mi byuragasamakha'ekhanastengagi bstan pa yongs kyi spyi dpal gcig pur gyur pa'i legs lam gyi srol bzhin/ da lan yang rje nyid nas mchog gi sprul pa'i sku'i mdzad 'azin gyi sgo dang por dbye ba'i dgongs pa khyad par can yod kyang gdul bya bsod nams dman pas cung zad thog tu ma khel bar snang / yung khrang dgon gyi slob chung khyung tsha zhabs drung ngo g.yog slar yang 'byor te dgon pa spyi'i mtshams zhus dang dngos 'bul rnams phul/ tā thu mos gtsos chung shos tsho ba'i mi mang la khrus dbang gnang rim gyis u lān mu rin du babs/ btsan po no mon han gyi sring mo dang sha bi nar rnams kyis gsol ja dang mjal kha zhus/ btsan po no mon han gyi sprul pa'i sku phyugs dzi don grub kyi khyim du 'khrungs pa nyid nas brtag par babs tshul gnang ba dang gzhan lha dang bla ma'i lung bstan kyang phyogs mthun te gsar du thag gcod ba'i skabs yin pa dang don grub kyis kyang gdan 'dren zhus pa bcas de'i khyim du babs nas sprul pa'i sku la sku 'dra dang kha btags 'bul ba gnang ste rten 'brel bsgrigs/ de phyin chad nas chen hu chos rje dang sde ba chos rje sogs kyis sprul sku'i sku don gyi blang dor rnams rje nyid kho na la blo rtse gtad nas zhus par sku'i rkyen sel gyi rim gro sogs skabs su gang babs la mdzes lam du ma song ba'i zhal bkod dang spyan dmigs ji srid zhal bzhugs kyi bar du gnang 'dug / yu lān mu rin nas mā thi ba'i u lā dang skyel mi byings rnams phyir slog / gser dgon gyi mā bla ma sku gzugs ma bde bar khong gi bla brang du gdan drangs te mjal kha dang phral phugs kyi skyabs 'jug nan tan zhus shing zhabs tog 'bul nod bstabs/ de nas dgon lung spyi'i bsu ba thab bsu dang bcas nyi shu bdun gyi nyin gdan sar phyag phebs/ chos 'khor gling gi mā tsha zhabs drung zhabs phyir 'brangs nas slob gnyer la 'ongs par bla brang sdod bcug nas lugs 623
