༄/ /gung bang bstan pa'isgranami'i gsung 'bum/zung gi bka' drin gyis bskyangs/ mdung nag phyogs su yul lugs kyis bla chen gdan drangs na lug gis zhabs tog mang po bsgrigs pa'i srol yod par rje nyid sngar phebs dus yul mi rnams la srog gcod pa'i nyes dmigs kyi gsung bshad mang du gnang bas lug gsod rgyu je nyung du btang yod cing /da res kyang srog mang po gcad mi chog pa'i gsung snga sa nas dril bsgrags pas zhabs tog je nyung du btang yong na'ang rtsa ba nas gcod thabs med pas zhabs tog gi sha khog las rus pa rdog po re blangs par nyid nas kyang sdig pa sbyangs pa'i gzungs sngags dang bsngo smon mdzad cing / ri khrod pa rnams la sprad nas sbyangs chog dang satsā 'debs 'jug par mdzad/ mā thi dgon mchod gzhis dang bcas pas snga ma nas rje nyid la mgo btags yod pa bzhin da res dgon par gtan 'jags su bzhugs chog pa'i sku 'tshab cig gnang dgos tshul zhus pas gser khri sprul sku gtong ba gnang rgyur thag bcad nas gza' skar bzang po'i nyin mā thi dgon nas zhabs phyir 'ongs nas grwa rgan ngo g.yogagis gser khri sprul sku la lha dar phul/ sngar zi lang am ban brgyud nas rgya yag dgon gsar 7gong ma bdag po chen po mkhyen du bcug ste ming zhus pa bzhin dge tshogs gling zhes pa'i zi pen gyi gsol ras gnang ba da res 'byor par am ban gyi mi sna dang bcas rgya yag dgon du skyel 'jug par mdzad/ am ban gyis yi ge'i lam nas 7gong mas bka' 'dri gnang tshul zhib tu zhus te nyid da lan 7gong ma'i mtshams zhur 'byon pa dga' zhes bab 'brel gyi zhu ba nan tan phul bar thugs 'tshab nas nang so phun tshogs bya khyung du 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa rin po che la bshol thabs kyi rim gro skyabs 'jug zhu bar btang / nang sos rje bla ma de nyid la rgyu mtshan zhib rgyas snyan du gsol bas khong snga ma 'ang pe cing du bzhugs myong zhing chos 'jig rten gnyis 624

༄/ /rdzobatsug bzangachos nyima'ig4gsumapabadabazadabyunganaga'i mkhyen rgya'ang gzhan dang mi 'dra gshis da res nges par phebs rgyu byung na bzang ba 'dug / bshol thabs de ga tsam gnang bas ci byed 'di gar bzhugs pa las pe cing du bzhugs na bstan 'gro spyi khyab kyi don rgya chen po yong rgyu yin pas na yi dam chos skyong gis kyang gangs chod pa de la grogs byed pa dang sku rim yang de'i mthun rkyen du 'gro ba las zlog thabs su mi 'gro mod/'on kyang nyid kyi thugs la bzhed pa gtan nas med na yi dam chos skyong gis kyang thugs bzhed dang bstun pa'i las sgrub pa dang sku rim yang bshol thabs su 'gro ba srid gsung ste rim gro rnam grangs mang du phab pa rnams bka' bzhin bsgrubs/ am ban la'ang pho brang du 'byon mi dgos pa'i thabs sgo du ma nas gnang dgos tshul nan cher mdzad/ zla ba bcu gcig pa'i tshes drug la sku 'bum nas tshogs chen dge bskos spyi pa'i gnyer ba tshogs chen dbu mdzad sku rten chos rje bla spyi drug gi mdzod gnyer ci rigs 'ga' zhig bcas 'khrungs skar gyi dga' ston dang gdan 'dren mtshams zhus sum bsgril du 'ongs te/tshesabadun 'khrungs skar la sku 'bum bla spyi rnams dang dgon lung spyi sgrub sde 'ga' zhig gi bla ma las sne cin gar thu sa lag chi'i mi sna bcas so so nas 'bul tshan mang po bstar te brtan bzhugs kyi rten 'brel bsgrigs/ sku 'bum pa rnams kyis gdan 'dren nan che na'ang dgon lung spyi nas gnyer chos khrims grwa rgan rnams kyis sngar lo'i dgun chos dang smon lam la sku 'bum dubazhugs pa yin pas da lo dgon lung du bzhugs pa 'thad tshul nan chen zhus nas de lugs su thag bcad de dgun gyi ring 'dir dgon lung du bzhugs/ brel ba chen po med pas bcad rgya lta bu'i ngos nangs dgung gi thugs dam shin tu 'phel zhing thun mtshams su don gnyer ba mang nyung ci rigs la lung khrid rjes gnang sogs gsung chos thor bu du ma dang mkha' spyod 625

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgron me'i skung 'bum/ma'i gsol 'debs dngos grub myur du 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu rdo rje sems dpa'isgo nas sku gdung mchod cing sbyangs pa'i cho ga rin chen sgron me sogs gsung rtsom 'ga' zhig kyang gnang / dgung lo nga lnga pa lcags phag gi dus kyi thog ma'i rang zhal mngon du gyur pa'i yar tshes dang po la thog mar 'du khang steng du lha mo'i mas gtor dang / de nas tshogs dbus su tshogs gtam dang dge bskos bsko bzhag dge 'dun mang la mjal kha gnang ba sogs lo gsar gyi rim pa rnams bsgrubs/ cho 'phrul smon lam nyid nas sbyin bdag mdzad de nyin bco lnga'i ring dkon mchog gi mchod pa gya nom pa dang dge 'dun gyi sder mang ja drug cu re gsum nyung ja nga gnyis thug pa bzhi bcas zhus thog gzhung ston dang grub ston gyi 'gyed bla spyi khag so sor 'bul tshan bcas gzab rgyas kyi lugs su bsgrubs/ gsung chos smon lam dang gos sku bshams pa dang gtor rgyag gi 'cham la gzigs rtog mjal ba mang po la ma ṇi'i lung dang sdom pa 'bog pa sogs phyag len ltar mdzad/ o thog wang gi btsun mo dkon mchog tshe ring gi el chi nang so phun tshogs ngo g.yog 'byor te lo snga mar nyid nas khe bi su'i gral gdan nyi shu rtsa bzhi gtad gnyer mdzad pa de dang nyid la 'bul ba dgon par mang 'gyed 'bul rgyu bskur ba rnams rtsis sprod zhus/ 'di dang lhan du sog 'grul skor tshan mang po 'ongs pas smon lam skabs su mang 'gyed 'phar ma'ang mang du byung / nang so la seng ldeng nags sgrol gyi rjes gnang dang gzhan spyi sger so sor rjes gnang dang ljags lung sogs rang rang gi 'dod chos kyes tshim par mdzad/ 'di dus btsun mo dkon mchog tshe ring gis rje nyid la da dung lan cig mjal 'dod kyi 'phen pa btang yod tshul skyabs 'jug dang bcas zhus pa'i lan du lo lnga tshun chad la mjal phrad ma byung na ci 'dra yong gsung ba phyis su phag nas brtsis pa'i lo lnga 626

༄/ /rdzobatsug ba4chosaminyi rigagangagasusapamadabasadabyungakapa yos lor btsun mo yum sras kyis rje nyid la gdan 'dren pa btang yang nyid or du su la ma 'byor gong du wang gi btsun mo 'das song bas dbon 'bangs mtha' dag nas sngar gyi lung phebs de dus gsum rjen par gzigs pa'i gsung du yid ches rnyed pa byung 'dug / bco lnga'i nyin gro tshang grags bla brang gi zhabs drung rnam gnyis la rab byung gi sdom pa gnang / zla ba gnyis pa'i tshes la sku 'bum du phebs sgar gsar ba bsgrubs zin 'dug par gza' skar bzang ba'i nyin zhig tu der gdan drangs nas sku 'bum spyi nas maṇ+ḍal kha btags sgol ma nyer gcig gi bdun thang sogs thang ka kha shas phul nas rten 'brel bsgrigs/ bla spyi dang sgar ba khag grwa rkyang spyi sger so so nas legs skyes dang bcas mjal kha zhus sgar nas bzhugs gral bsgrigs te nyin gsum gyi ring khang ston rgyas pa byas/ bkra shis 'khyil du rje 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa rin po cher byams sku chen mo'i grub ston du bla brang phyag mdzod ngo g.yog ched mngags kyi gdong / kun tu bzang po'i ye shes bla med mthu/ / snying rjes sems can bsam pa'i rjes 'gro'i 'phrul/ / cir yang 'char las 'gro kun theg mchog la/ / 'god pa'i bshes gnyen gzugs su nyer bstan pa/ /gangagi zhabs mthil 'khor lo'i mtshan bzang gi / snang ba rtag tu 'thung phyir srid pa las/ / 'das pa'i pad+ma phan bde'i rdul phreng can/ / skye dgu'i gtsug gis mchod 'os de'i drung du/ / zhes sogs zhu yig tshigs su bcad pa legs skyes dang bcas 'bul rgyu bskur/ 'on kyang zhu shog snga ma rnams dang mi 'dra bar 'di'i mjug tu/ dzam bu brik+ṣas mtshan pa'i gling 'di'i phan dang bde ba'i srog / mgon khyod thugs rje'i sman yon nyid las gzhan du sems pa'i gnas med pas/ / mi phyed skyil krung gcig gis rdo rje'i khri la bskal pa rgya mtsho'i bar/ / brten par bzhugs zhes snying nas gsol lo re 627

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'isgroname'i gsung 'bum/'bras don ldan mdzod cig gu/ / zhes skabs don gzhan ci'ang ma gsol par zhabs pad brtan dgos tshul kho na nan tan mdzad pa ni dgongs gzhi can zhig yin par snang / don gnyer ba mang nyung ci rigs la mgon po'i be'u bum gye lung sogs 'dod chos du ma gnang / zla ba gsum pa'i tshes la sgar gsar nas bsgrub bya lnga bcu nga bzhi la dge tshul dang brgyad cu gya bdun la dge slong gi sdom pa gnang ste tshul khrims kyi phung po yongs su rdzogs pa'i dpal la bkod/ dus tshigs brjod pa'i skabs su sgar gsar ba la theg chen chos mdzod ces 'dogs pa gnang / dpyid chos la brtsi bzhag dang tshogs gtam gnang ba bgro gleng dang brtsi bzhag gi rgyug blangs pa sogs sngar rgyun ltar mdzad/ de nas dgon lung du phebs te har chen thu med dzā phu bla ma rdo ram pa ngag dbang shes rab dang nang so rgya mtsho sogs mjal du 'ongs par nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i dbang sogs 'dod chos 'ga' zhig gnang /gdong 'jug mkhan pos dgon lung du chos thog btang nas bla brang du bzhugs par gsung 'bum nang gi chos tshan du ma zhig gi ljags lung gnang /mang 'dus ri khrod 'dus spyi nas ri khrod 'dzin bdag gnang dgos tshul yang yang zhus pa dang 'brug lung dgon pa'i sems nyid sku skye gtsos pa'i tshang mas kyang dgon pa 'dzin bdag gnang dgos tshul nan che ba bcas zla ba bzhi pa'i tshes drug la mang 'dus ri khrod du phebs nas khri 'don gnang / bla zur hu kyā chos rje dang slob chung yu kyā chos rje gnyis gtsos pa'i 'dus spyi dang rdo dkarado sgo gnyis dang gab lung rtsi ri gnyis kyi mchod gzhis rnams nas khri 'bul gzabs/ nyid nas thams cad la ston mo dang dge 'dun la mang 'gyed gnang / phyir 'khor te bcu gcig gi nyin 'brug lung du phebs par ra co lung par khran cong ri khrod kyi thab bsu dang / sne mgor 'brug lung 628

༄/ /rjebatsun ba nyisa'igakhangabasla pad+madaganas rākhakadagon dga' ldan bshad sgrub gling gi sems nyid sku skye gtsos pa'i las sne dka' ram dge tshul slong rta ba mang po'i bsu pa dang bcas bde chen du bzhugs/ bcu gnyis la 'brug lung dgon par dge 'dun mang pos ser sbrengs dang bcas phyag phebs/ nem pa'i chi kyā dpon po sogs phyogs tha dad nas 'grul pa drag zhan mang po byung bar mjal kha gnang / bcu gsum la tshogs dbur phebs te khrir bzhugs sems nyid sku skye gtsos pa'i 'dus spyi dang mchod gzhis rnams nas khri 'bul gya nom pa btegs/ nyid nas kyang tshogs par mang 'gyed dang tshogs gtam zhal bkod gnang / gzhi byes thams cad la dga' ston rgyas pa bstar/ bla brang nas sems nyid sku skye sogs dge 'dun byings la 'jam dbyangs dkar po'i sgrub thabs dang rnam rgyalagazungs ring sogs lngags lung 'ga' zhig gnang / de nas bcu drug la thar ba gling du phebs bkra shis lhun po'i phyag len ltar gyi beg tse'i 'cham gsar du bslab nas btsugs pa la gzigs rtog mdzad/ tshogs par mang 'gyed tsha ra dang spyi pa'i 'dzin thebs su dngul gyi 'jog pa dang bcas gnang spyi khang gsar bar gdan drangs nas gsol ston zhus/ bsgrub bya kha shas la dge tshul slong gi sdom pa dang slob chung gtsos pa'i grwa mang la rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum rta mgrin gsang sgrub spyan ras gzigs bcu gcig zhal rnams kyi rjes gnang / skyabs 'gro'i khrid rta mgrin chos skor phal cher gye lngags lung bcas stsal/ dgon pa'i g.yon zur gyi phrag thog tu dam can gyi lha tho nang gzhug rab gnas sogs tshad dang ldan pa brtsigs shing shar lho'i mtshams su nags 'dab kyi brag la klu bum tshad ldan 'jog par mdzad/phyir 'khor te dgon lung du phebs/ rje nyid nas bla ma sgom pa ngag dbang rab brtan la dgon lung gi chos grwa pa blo ldan rnams la lam rim gyi khrid cig 629

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'izlaname'i gsung 'bum/gnang dgos tshul snyan bskul zhus nyan mkhan rnams la'ang de lugs kyi zhal bkod bcas bla slob kyi mtshams spyor gnang don ltar bla ma sgom pas sa ga zla ba'i dus chen dang bstun nas bla brang bkra shis 'od 'bar du gser khri sprul sku dang dpa' rin rgyud pa bla zur sogs dka' ram dge ba'i bshes gnyen ri khrod pa chos grwa pa sum brgya tsam la lam rim bde lam gyi khrid sems bskyed mchod pa dang bcas/ bla ma mchod pa dang phyag chen gyi khrid blo spyong don bdun ma sogs chos tshan mang po'i lngags lung rnams gnang ste legs par grub zin 'dug pas sgrub pa'i mchod sprin gyis dgyes pa'i rtse mor son/ zla ba lnga bar sku 'bum du phebs/ phab zhi ri khrod pa rnams kyis gdan drangs te zhabs drung gtsos pa'i skya ser gyi khrom chen por spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang chen dang gtor ma brgya rtsa'i khrid bcas gnang / tshur phebs te don gnyer can mang po zhig gis snga ma nas zhus yod pa bzhin sgar ba nas sman pa dpon slob gro tshang mkhan po/ zi na lha ram pa bsod nams bstan 'dzin sogs sku 'bum gyi sprul sku zhabs drung dka' ram dge tshul slong lnga brgya tsam la lam rim bde lam gyi khrid dbu btsugs nas nyin lnga'i ring spyor ba'i chos drug gzab bshad stsal te mtshams mdzad/ nyan mkhan la bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen chos grwa pa mang pas de dag la gzhung chen mo'i 'bab lugs dang sbyar ba'i bshad pa rgya chen po dang blo gsar ba rnams la sa bcad kyi don dril ba'i bshad pa mdor bsdus bcas chos thun re la rgyas bshad bsdus bshad gnyis re dang / res 'ga' dpe don sbyar nas klo la 'char bde ba dang res mtshang brus nas nyes spyod ngos 'dzin sla ba dang res bzhad cha bslangs te gnyid dang skyo ba sel ba sogs thabs mkhas rnam pa sna tshogs kyi sgo nas go ba ster phul che zhing yid 'khul gyi gsung bshad bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig gnang bas thams 630

༄/ /rjebatsunamakhazangartsamadzam ga mapad+madaganacad kha/cad kyis chos byang chub lam gyi rim pa 'di 'chad pa la jo bo yas sras bka' gdams sku mched gsum sogs dngos su byon yang 'di las lhag pa ji ltar ston zhes bcos min gye dad pas bsngags tshig me tog gis mngon par mchod/'di dus nyin rer snga dro chos thun yun ring po re gnang ste gung tshigs kyi gaṇ+ḍi brdung ba dang zhabs phyi pa rnams kyis brda phul nas mtshams mdzad kyin yod pa la nyin cig chos thun grol ma ran gong du gaṇ+ḍi'i sgra ches cher bsgragayopa chos nyan pa mang pos kyang thos shing / zhabs phyi pa rnams kyis kyang gung tshigs kyi gaṇ+ḍi yin dgos rgyu la nyi tshod ha cang snga bas ci yin snyam ste sgo mo che'i phyi rol tu bud nas bla brang rtse dang 'du khang steng sogs phyogs thams cad du bltas pas gang du'ang gaṇ+ḍi rdung gan med cing gaṇ+ḍi'i sgra ni da dung yang grags bzhin par 'dug pas ngo mtshar dang som nyi'i khyogs la 'phyun par gyur/tshul 'di ni rje bdag nyid chen po sogs dam pa gong ma 'ga' zhig gi rnam thar du'ang lha rnams kyis chos kyi gaṇ+ḍi'i sgra bsgrags pa'i lo rgyus bzhin thub pa'i dbang po'i chos kyi rgyal tshab chen po nyid nas nges pa don gyi nyon mongs med pa'i chos sbyin rgya cher stsal pa na/ gser mchog rang bzhin ri rab sogs la gnas pa'i lha dang gdengs can mi 'am ci dang gnod sbyin bstan la dga' ba'i rigs rnams thub pa'i dbang po'i zhal las 'ongs pa'i chos kyi bdud rtsi myang pa'i phyir du 'dus pa'i brdar 'khrul ba med do/ / nyin gcig tshogs bar 'grig lam skor gyi tshogs gtam rgyas pa gnang skabs tshogs chos grwar chag med du phebs dgos tshul las 'phros te tshogs su sher snying gsungs dus dmigs rnam skyong thub pa rnams kyis sngags lugs la mi 'dra ba zhig yod kyang mdo lugs ltar na/ rang gi mdun du thub pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das spyan ras gzigs shā ri'i bu dang bcas gsal btab nas de dag gis 631

༄/ /yo thang bstan pa'izlaname'i gsung 'bum/dri ba dris lan gyi tshul du tshig zur ma nyams par 'don cing / don spyi tsam yidayul du byas nas mjug tu thub pa 'khor bcas rang la bstem nas byin gyis brlabs pa dang / zlog pa'i skabs su'ang 'dre 'ded pa dang gsod pa'i mos pa ma byas par rang bzhin gyis ma grub pa'i ngang du bzlog pa dang stong pa'i mos pa byed tshul dang / 'ga' zhig gis sgol ma 'phrin las myur ba'i lha yin pas phyag 'tshal nyer gcig pa sgra dag mi dag la ma ltos par gang myur bton na bzang zer mkhan yang yod pas de lta na dkon mchog gsum gyi 'phrenags kyang myur bas skyabs 'gro nas bzung chos gang dang gang yin pa thams cad de ltar 'don dgos pas ha cang thal 'gro tshul dang / phyag 'tshal nyer gcig pa 'don dus sgrol ma nyer gcig gam rtsa ba'i sprul gzhi seng ldeng nags sgrol de nyid gzhan thams cad 'dus pa'i bdag nyid du gsal btab ste skyabs 'og tu chud pa'i mos pa dang bcas tshig zur ma nyams par 'don cing mjug tu rang la bstim pas byin gyis brlabs pa dang / sa gsum ma 'don dus rje rin po che gsal btab nas mjug tu rang la bstem zhing byin gyis brlabs pa sogs lha dang bla ma gang dang gang gi bstod pa dang gsol 'debs sogs 'don dus kyang de bzhin bsam dgos tshul dang /de ltar bsam shes na rang gcig pu gshag tu bsdad nas dge sbyong byed lo byas pa las tshogs la phebs nas dge 'dun mang po dang lhan du tshigs bcad gcig gis smon lam btab na de'i phan yon che tshul dang chos grwa pa rnams kyis thal skad bgro gleng skyor sbyangs so so'i skabs kyi bsam tshul dang / rgyud pa'i cho ga phyag len gar thig dbyangs gsum sogs gang gi skabs su'ang bsam pa'i 'khyer so mkhas na sngags dang phyag rgya'i nus pa bsam gyis mi khyab pas sa chod che zhing lam gong ma'i smin byed du 'gro tshul dang / sman pa'i grwa pa 632

༄/ /rjebatsun khazang767) gakhu lad+ma karasad khakarnams kyis rgyud bzhi lag len dang bcas pa la slob gnyer byed tshul dang sman lasbyin pa rnam gsum tshang tshul/ tha na grong chog la 'gro mkhan rnams kyang bsam pas zin na gtor ma cha gsum zhig bsngos pa la'ang sbyin pa gsum tshang bas rgyal ba'i sras kyi lag len chen por 'gro lugs sogs blo mchog dman bgres gzhon bar ma mtha' dag la thad ka thad gar don du 'gyur pa'i bslab bya sgrub sla la don che ba du ma snying gi ze'u 'byur blugs/ de'i rkyen gyis rgan pa rnams rje 'di'i tshogs gtam yang bka' chos yin zhes tshogs gtam gnang res kyis ched du gtad nas ma chag par 'ongs te nyan cing gang gsung gus pas lhur len pa byung / de dus chos grwa pa rnams kyi nang nas gzhung chen mo'i rgyug sprod mkhan mang du byung bas thugs shin tu mnyes shing bab bstun gyi gnang sbyin kyang mdzad/ drug pa'i smon lam gyi skabs su dgon lung du phebs nas gsung chos smon lam gnang zhing chos 'khor bskor ba'i dus chen nyin bsgrub bya lnga bcu rtsa gcig la bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa stsal/ u shing mi rin chos grags sogs mjal ba du mas rta mgrin gsang sgrub kyi rjes gnang sogs 'dod don zhus pa'i re ba bskangs/ gser khri sprul sku mā thi dgon du 'byon rgyur gnang sbyin dang zhal ta mdzad cing dgon lung gi bla spyi so so'i chibs skyel dang bcas mang 'dus ri khrod bar du lhan du phebs/ ri khrod yon mchod 'dod chos kyis tshim par mdzad de tshur dgon lung du byon/alag sha'i bde 'byung tha'i ji ngo g.yog mjal du 'ongs par tshe dbang stsal/de dus dngul gyi bka' gdams mchod rten gser gyi tshigs rgyan rin po che'i phra rgyan gyis spras pa mtho gang long ba zhig gsar du bzhengs par byams pa rin po che'i gdung rus dang dbu lo mtshan sngags sogs gzungs gzhug gi rim pa dang rab gnas rnams nyid rang gis tshad ldan gnang ste 'bral spangs kyi 633

/ /gung tha bstan ba'i name'igasung 'bum/thugs dam rten mdzad/ dbyar gnas kyi skabs su 'chad nyan mdzad cing don gnyer ba rnams la lung khrid sogs chos kyi dga' ston spel/ rgyal gdon 'dul thabs kyi las kyi rim pa spu gri'i 'khrul 'khor sogs ljags rtsom gnang / dbyar gnas grol nas sems nyid ri dgon thams cad kyis gdan drangs pa bzhin chibs bskyod skya bsu gtos che ba dang thab bsu rim pa mang po zhus shing dge 'dun 'dus pa'i tshogs kyis ser sbreng gi mdun bsus te thog mar dgon du spyan drangs/ spyi chos su bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi khrid dang sems nyid zhabs drung rin po che la nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i bskyed rdzogs kyi gzab khrid zhal shes gsang ba'i man ngag du ma dang bcas gces nor gyi tshul du stsal/ bla spyi nas gzhis len bsnyen bkur bstabs shing phar yang mang 'gyed gnang / de nas mchod gzhi'i nang du gdan drangs te zla ba gcig gi ring spyi sger so so nas phangs pa med par bdog pa'i dngos po yod dgu'i 'bul nod dang bkur ste rim gro bla na med pa zhus par phyag dbang khrus dbang 'dod chos sogs gang zhus thams cad kyi re ba skong bar mdzad/ brgyad pa'ibacu drug gi mtshan mo mnal lam du gtsang sa skyar 'jam mgon sa paṇa gyis chos 'khor byed pa yin zer nas dge 'dun mang po zhig la sa skya paṇa chen gyis 'gyed cig gnang gin 'dug par mi bdun tsam la gser gyi ral gri re/ lhag ma rnams la rtsam pa thur re dang gur kum thur re sa paṇa rang gi phyagagis gnang gin 'dug pas dang po kha shas nyid nas sa paṇa gyi phyag tu phul te khong gis dge 'dun re re la gnang zhing / lhag ma rnams nyid rang gis byin par sa paṇa gyis 'di 'dra byas pa ma 'ongs pa na ma brjed pa gyis gsungs pa sogs lung bstan 'ga' gnang pa mis/ phyi nyin de'i gnas tshul gsungs shing de la brten nas sngon gyi sa paṇa gyi phyag g.yog tu skyes pa'ang 634

༄/ /rjebatsug bzangachosakyinyama'igagangag mapad+madasacad ngakabasal bar dran byung zhes gsang rnam du gsungs 'dug kyang snga phyi gung bsgrigs tshe phyag g.yog dkyus ma tsam ma yin par paṇa chen nyid kyi gdung 'tshob pher ba'i bu chen gyi dwangs ma sa skya'i bstan pa'i bdag por gyur pa zhig yin pa'i tshod du snang ngo / / dgu pa'i tshes la phyir 'khor te dgon lung du phebs/ lo snga mar 7gong ma chen po dgung lo brgyad cur phebs pa'i dga' ston gyi mtshams zhur btang ba'i chos rje bstan 'dzin bzang po ngo g.yog 'byor cing de dang lhan du har chin wang gi tho yon 'jam dpal nor bu'ang slob gnyer la 'ongs par mjal kha gnang / sbyin bdag dpon mo ma ṇi dha ras gos bzang las bsgrubs pa'i ka 'phan che chung bcu drug ched gnyer gyis bsgrubs pa'i na bza' dang nyer spyad tshang ma shel gyi snod spyad kyi rigs mang po dang / wang maci badz+ra gyis gos chen legs pa yugs lnga shel gyi tam pi dang lderam me tog 'dzug snod sogs snod spyad sna tshogs gzhan yang har chin ho sho'u so so'i sbyin bdag grwa rigs drag zhan gyis khyad mtshar gyi bca' lag dang gos dar dngul sogs dngos po'i bskur ma mang po yod pa rnams phul/ de nas sku'i rkyen sel du gzim chung mkha' spyod yang rtser bdun mtshams la bzhugs te lha bab dus chen gyi nyin kha skong gi sbyin sreg gnang / de dang dus mtshungs su bla brang du'ang dge 'dun bcu res 'jigs byed kyi bsnyen pa zhi ba'i sbyinasreg rta mgrin gyi bsnyen pa gtor zlog bcas dang / dgon sgrub sde mang por mang 'gyed thog gdugs sher sgrol ma 'bum ther res mtshon zhabs brtan rgya chen po bsgrubs/ zla ba bcu pa'i tshes la sku 'bum du phebs gangs dkar wang thu sa lag chi blon 'khor bcas pho brang du 'gro rgyur lam chos dang bka' bsgo mdzad/ gza' skar phun sum tshogs pa'i nyin rgyud pa grwa tshangagi tshogs dbu mdzad de 'du khang nang gi thub pa gangs chen mtsho dang rje 635

༄/ /gung bang bstan pa'itshonasa'i gsung 'bum/rin po che'i sku brnyan gtsos pa'i rten dang brten par bcas pa la nyin gsum gye ring rab gnas rgyas pa mdzad/ rgyud pa dpon slob gser ri sprul skus sgar bar gdan drangs nas gsol ston 'bul ba zhus/ lnga mchod kyi skabs su o thog wang gi sring mo blo bzang spyid/ thu sa lag chi tshe ring rnam rgyal gza' mi dang tha'i ji na son cir gal mi rin bstan pa bkra shis sogs drag zhan lnga brgya skor thun mong nas gsol ba btab pa bzhin/ gser sdong chen mo'i mdun du mchod pa rnam lnga dpag tu med pa bshams te gzhi byes kyi ser skya stong phrag brgal ba la sems bskyed mchod pa gnang zhing mjug tu sems bskyed pa'i rdzas kyi phud gser sdong chen mor phul nas dpon slob tshang mas bzang spyod dang bstan 'bar ma 'ur chems kyis gsungs te rlabs po che'i thugs smon gyi mtshams spyor nan tan du mdzad/ gzhan yang sog 'grul byings kyi khrod nas sgrol dkar 'od zer drug sbrags dang seng ldeng nags sgrol gyi rjes gnang tshe dbang sogs 'dod chos ci rigs dang bka' bsgo gsung brtag sogs zhu mi mang du byung ba thams cad kyi 'dun pa bskangs/ bkra shis 'khyil bla brang gi mi sna grwa ba zhig 'ongs par 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa rin po che sku bsnyel tshul bstan te ka mdo na bzhugs pa'i gtam gsan ma thag sku 'bumatshos skyong che chung gnyis sku phebs zhus te lung bstan gyi sku rim rnams tshogs chen dang grwa tshang so sor mang ja grwa ja btang thog phral du bsgrubs/ mi sna phyir 'khor bar zhabs pad brtan par bzhugs par gsol ba 'debs pa'i zhu shog 'bul rgyu bskur te bsnyung zhu dang zhabs brtan 'bul mi gtong rgyu'i gzos byas kyang / phyi nyin zhog ka grwa pa de gzhan skya ser 'ga' dang bcas tshur log byung ba na sku mdun pa zhig gis de bzhin yong 'dug ces zhus /ra grwa pa de phyir yong ba ltas bzang po zhig min gsung nas re zhig gi bar du 636

༄/ /chubatsotshothazangachos yi ga4gtsosatshadababasasanagasung yang 'byon ma thub/ de nas blo gros dpon po dang bla brang gi mi sna grwa pabacas mjal kha zhus te ka mdo nas zhing du gshegs pa'i gnas tshul dang gdan 'dren gyi snyan gsan zhus/ nyid nas kyang thugs ngal chen po mdzad cing 'byon rgyu'i zhal len dang mi sna rnams la sku gdung rin po che do dam byed rgyu'i zhal bkod gnang ste phral du phyir btang / sku 'bum tshogs chen dang bshad sgrub gling rgyud pa sman pa rnams la mang ja grwa ja mang du btang ste dgongs rdzogs kyi 'don pa ji ltar gsung rgyu'i ljags bkod gnang / de mtshungs dgon lung du 'phrin btang nas tshogs chen dang rgyud pa la mang ja dang grwa ja mang du btang ste dgongs rdzogs kyi 'don pa gsung rgyu dang gdung mchodal 'gro mi rnams tshag brgyab nas khong dang lhan du 'gro dgos tshul gye zhal bkod gnang / sku 'bum 'dus spyi nas bskul ma mdzad pa dang nyid rangagis kyang thugs dad kyis mtshams sbyar te sprul sku myur 'byon gyi gsol 'debs phral du ljags rtsom mdzad nas tshogs su btsugs/ de nas bcu gcig pa'i tshes gsum la sku 'bum nas thon skya yi'i mda' nas gro tshang mkhan pos zhabs phyi zhus te lhan du phebs/ tshes drug gi nyin ka mdo'i dgon du munasros tsam la 'byor gzim khang sgor phebs pa na thugs skyo shas drag pos nang du 'byon mi phod pa tsam byung zhing / de nas sku gdung gi mdun du brkyang phyag gsum sngon du 'gro bas snyan shal dang bcas mjal kha zhus/spyan chab bsil bzhin sku 'bum nas gsung rtsom gnang ba'i sprul sku myur 'byon gyi gsol 'debs tshar gsum gsungs te gdung shugs drag pos gsol ba btab cing yon tan gzhir gyur ma dal bus gsungs nas byin rlabs zhu bar mdzad/ de rjes gzim chung mdor phyag mdzod chos rjes gtsos grwa pa rnamasakyis mjal kha dang gsol ja zhus te spyir skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang de 637

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'isgraname' gsung 'bum/nyid zhal ma bzhugs pas mgon med skyabs med du gyur cing khyad par sa'i mtha' 'di 'dra zhig tu mdzad pa'i tha ma bstan pa ma legs zhes sdug smras gtam zhus par/ sangs rgyas byang sems kyi mdzad pa gdul bya'i skal ba kho na la ltos tshul rje bla ma de nyid kyis kyang sku tshe gcig la bstan 'gro'i don de las lhag pa mthar phyin lugs med tshul sgo gang nas bsams kyang mya ngan mi 'os pa'i rgyu mtshan dang / zhing brjes pa'i sa'ang dper na sngon yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas yul dbus nas mya ngan las 'da' tshul ma mdzad par mtha' 'khob rtswa can du gshegs pa'i tshul dang mthun par gnas 'di nas mya ngan las 'da' tshul bstan pa la dgos pa che tshul dang / snga ma ka mdo'i dgon pa 'di gsar du 'debs skabs nged kyis sa cha ngan pa 'dir dgonapa btab nas ci byed zhus par 'di sa cha bzang po yin/ nged rang rjes nas 'dir gtan sdod cig byed bsam pa yod gsung byung bas sa cha 'di nas zhi bar gzhol ba'i thugs dgongs de dus nas gtad yod pa yin 'dug / sangs rgyas byang sems rnams kyis dus gsum rjen par gzigs pa'i dgongs pa'i mtha' rang re lta bus dpag mi nus pas/ 'di la sems khral byed rgyu med gsungs te yid gsos kyi bslab bya sgo du ma nas phebs shing brtse bas dbugs phyung / tshes bdun 'khrungs skar gyi nyin tho rangs kyi thun la dmigs bsal gyi thugs dam gnang thun grol nas dpon g.yog tshang ma sku gdung gi mdun du byon te rje nyid nas kha btags nang mdzod dngul srang bco lnga'i maṇ+ḍal sne 'dogs can/ gos chen rgyan bzhi dang kha thi sogs yug drug dngulasrang bzhi brgya ja pag zam ras bcas rnam grangs bzhi brgya bzhi bcu dang / de mtshungs sku 'bum dang dgon lung bla spyi thar pa gling dang chos bzang ri khrod rnams nas gdung 'bul tshan grangs bstar gdung 'bul grub 638

sa / /rje btsun ba nyi'i ri byuraganartsams nanas mchod pa rgya chen po bshams te nyi ma gnyis kyi ring la nyid chog grogs dang bcas pas pur chog rin chen sgron me'i steng nas mchog khrus pur bzlas sogs cho ga tshul bzhin gnang / yig cha 'di nyid gsar du ljags rtsom gnang nas rtsom gdan gcig las med par sku 'bum nas tshur phebs dus 'don cha'i rim pa rnams tshar kha shas 'brir bcug ste/ zhal nas nged rang na ning dgun kha glo bur du 'di 'dra zhig 'bri rgyu sems la shar nas bris pa yin pas chos skyong zhig gis rgyud bskul ba yin pa 'dra da res gcig ma bton na slar nga la 'di 'don dgos pa med ces gsungs/ der ma zad pur chog 'di'inang du bla ma'i sku gdung thag ring po nas gzhan du gdan 'dren byed tshulakhyang zhib tu gsungs 'dug pa spyir de 'dra srid mtha' tsam yin pas do gal mi che'ang 'byung 'gyur 'di nyid mngon sum du gzigs te ched du gsungs pa yin par som nyi med do/ / cho ga grub rjes bkra shis 'khyil nas 'ongs pa'i zhabs phyi pa rnams dang bla grwa tshang mas mjal kha zhus thog yang bskyar sprul sku myur 'byon gsol 'debs kyi lngags rtsom zhus pas de ma thag tu gsungartsom gnang / bkra shis 'khyil nas gdan 'dren gyi snyan gsan nan tan zhus kyang nyid gtsos pa'i sku 'bum dgon lung bya khyung gi bla ma las sne rnamasakyis sku gdung rin po che tsong kha'i phyogs su gdan 'dren rgyu'i rtsod pa dang / rma chu phan tshun gyi dpon g.yog thams cad rang rang gi 'dod pa re bshadanas nyin gcig gi ring 'then khyer byas te thag ma chod/ phyi nyin bla brang gi zhabs phyi pa che rim gyis gang ci'i gnas tshul zhib tu zhus pa ltar nyid nas lngags bkod stsal te gzhan rnams la rten skal re byin te sku gdung bkra shis 'khyil du gdan 'dren rgyur thag bcad cing nyid kyang de dang lhan du 'byon rgyu'i zhal len gnang / bla brang nas rje nyid la 'bul ba lha rdzas nang 639

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i name'i gsung 'bum/mdzod dngul gyi maṇ+ḍal sne 'dogs dang bcas sku gsung thugs rten rdo dril/sposadamar phyags pa bcu sku gzan gasdir sku chos gdol bu dang bcas pa sku 'gag sku sham dbu zhwa sne ring zhabs chag / gser srang gang dngul srang bdun brgya gos chen mang nug dang kha thi sogs yug nyer lnga thod snam dmar po dang ljang gu bubs re snam phrugs mdog sna tshogs yug bco lnga ther dmar bubs lnga/ rtse zhwa gcig zhwa snam nyi shu ko 'bog cha par mdzod bcu chos 'don bcu gzhan kha btags che chung bdun cu zam ras yug bdun cu/ gzim gur cha tshang dngul srang lnga bcu las bsgrubs pa'i gsol ldem thab cha cha tshang dngul srang brgyad cu re ba'i chibs sga tshags ma sga stan srab gsum sdom chibs khebs dang bcas pa/ u lān ho shi'i sga stan srab gsum ban thag thor sdom dang bcas pa chibs chibs 'grul gnyis kyis gtsos rta pho rgod bzhi bcu/'brigayag che chung so lnga rnga mong lnga dre'u gcig lug che chung sum brgya bcas khyon rnam grangs stong tsho gcig dang sum brgya dang bdun cu don gsum phul/der bzhugs ring la mjal mi nyin bzhin brgya phrag mang po 'dus pa thams cad la byams pas dam bcas pa'i gzungs gsung sgrogs dang bcas mjal kha sogs kyi re ba don ldan du mdzad/ sku gdung rin po cher snyan gsan 'bul lugs/ gdan bskyod lugs/ gdan 'dren lugs sogs gang cir bkod pa yang dag pa gnang / tshes dgu la sku gdung rin po che phebs skyel du lhan cig par ka mdo dgon pa nas thon lam zhor gcu 'khor dgon grong sogs ser skya du ma phyag dbang chos 'brel gyis tshim par mdzad bzhin phebs/ hor tshang gser khri zam tsha gser khri rnam gnyis gdung bsur phebs pa nyid la'ang mjal phrad zhus/ bcu gsum la thab bsu'i thog nas nyid snga 'gros su phebs te bla brang chen mo'i sgo drung nas sku gdung rin po cher 640

༄/ /rjebatsunablobazangatshang rngo bas labadagarachod kha/bsu ba mdzad/ bzhugs ring la gtso cher phyag dpe do dam mdzad cing sengs bar du phyogs 'dus kyi 'grul pa drag zhan mang po la mjal kha gnang ba dang bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams dang chos kyi gsung bgros mang du 'phel/ bla brang dang 'dus spyi nas sku gdung mchod rten bzhengs lugs dgongs rdzogs sgrub lugs gdan sa'i 'dzin skyong sogs las don rgya che ba'i rigs nyid la zhe thag pa nas blo rtse gtad de dgongs bstun zhus par thabs mkhas thugs rje'i 'jug pa bsam gyis mi khyab pas/ 'phral yun du phan pa'i bya byed gang dgos phu thag chod pa'i zhal bkod zhib lhugs su stsal te brtse bas bskyangs/ mchog sprul rin po che 'khrul med byur gsal gyi don skor la gsung brtag zhus pa bzhin brtag par babs pa'i rim gro rnams sgrub rgyu'i zhal bkod kyang nan cher gnang / bla brang dang 'dus spyi nas da lam yun ring tsam bzhugs dgos kyi gsol ba nan tan btab cing nyid nas kyang re zhig gi bar du bzhugs rgyu'i thugs 'dun yod na'ang / 7gong ma chen mo nas lo snga ma'i ston ga zi ling am pan la rje 'di pa'i dgung lo dang bsnyung gzhi rnying ba'i bab ci 'dra yin tshul bka' 'dri gnang byung bar an bhan nas 7gong ma'i bka' lan du mtshams zhur phebs rtsis kyi zhu ba phul na legs tshul nan che ba la nyid nas am ban la zhu mkhas dang bshol thabs kyi rim gro rnams bsgrubs nas bshol ba yin kyang / da lo'ang 7gong mas am ban la gnas tshul lo snga ma bzhin bka' 'dri gnang bar am ban gyis kyang pe cing du phebs dgos kyi bka' 'bab shas che bsam nas sku 'bum bla brang gi phyag mdzod la rje nyid mgyogs par gdan 'dren dgos tshul gnang ba bzhin bla brang nas rgyu mtshan 'bul mi rta shad kyis btang ba bcu bdun gyi nyin bkra shis 'khyil du 'byor pas phral du phebs dgos pa byung / dgon pa'i skyes chen 641

༄/ /gung bang bstanapa'izlaname'i gsung ཿma/dam pa rnams la gsung brtag dang / mo phya mkhan 'ga' zhig la'ang mo 'debs su bcug ste pe cing du 'byon dgos pa'i dogs pa sel thabs kyi rim groratshogs chen du mang 'gyed dang grwa tshang so sor gra ja'i thog sku rim gtos che ba bsgrubs/ de skabs zam tsha gser khri tshang nas sku zhabs nyid rgya nag tu phebs dgos kyi nyen tsam 'dug kyang da res rim gro 'dis bzlog pa 'dra/nged kyi rmi lam du rma chu las sum 'gyur gyi che ba'i chu zhig skam song ba'i shul gyi khron pa'i nang du chu la gnas pa'i srog chags mang po shi/ 'ga' zhig 'gul tsam 'ga' zhig gso thub tsam sogs rma rul la 'bu 'tshang ba ltar 'dug cing phyogasagazhan zhig na mtsho chen zhig 'dug pa chu de'i shul du rka 'dren rgyu byas te srol btod tshar kyang rgya dpon mang po zhig 'ongs nas sdong po mang po bsgrigs te rka mgo bcad steng du rma bya'i sgo mang po btsugs pa rmis pas phebs na bstan 'gro la phan che'ang thugs bzhed ltar da res rim gros bzlog par snang / chu skam song ba de lcang skya rin po che dang mtsho de rje nyid la lta rma bya'i sgode cung zad dpyad dka' ba snang zhes zhus 'dug pa phyis de kho na bzhin byung / bar skabs shig byams khang du phebs nas byams chen gsar bzhengs la zhib mjal dang bsngags brjod mdzad/ 'di dus phyag dpe khang gi dpe cha do dam gyi zhor la dpe mang po blangs nas mtshan ril por gzigs rtog gnang / ma 'ongs lung bstan du ma la gzigs nas bstan pa'i 'pho 'gyur gyi gsung 'phros mang po dang ha cang thugs skyo tshul mdzad/ zhal nas da lta stod na rgyal ba yab sras bal po'i sde gzar la brten nas thugs mi bde/smadan rgya nag rgyal po rgyal ba yab sras gnyis kyi gnas tshul la brten nas thugs mi bde/ bar na rgya bod hor gsum gyi mi sde rnams bod dang rgya nag gi dmag lam du song nas sos mi bde bas rgyal khams spyi la bsam blo btang 642

༄/ /rjebatsotshos4cho minyima'igasangagatsosachadasasogs/na'ang snying khong chu las grang / yang dbus na bal bod sde gzar gyi sgo nas grwa sa grwa tshang so so'i bshad sgrub nyams pa'i mgo tshugs/ mdo smad 'dir rje 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i mtshan tsam gyis bstan 'gro mgon dang bcas pa yin pa la da dag pa'i zhing du gshegs pas thams cad ci bya gtol med du gyur/ smad rgya nag na lcang skya rin po che ma bzhugs pas bstan 'gro'i bde skyid ming gi lhag ma tsam du lus pa gang la bltas kyang snying khong chu las grang /rang la bsam blo btang na'ang sna thag rgya nag rgyal po'i lag tu shor res 'ga' glodanas bzhag res 'ga' khrid nas 'gro / lcang skya thams cad mkhyen pa bzhugs dus kyi srol bzang po yod na gang ci las sla'ang de med/ mi bde ba thams cad kyi mgo tshugs pas phyogs gang du phyin yang mi song rgyab kyi lag g.yug kho nar snang / de ltar shes kyang sna thag mi la shor bas skyid sdug dkon mchog la bcol nas las bdag gir bya ba las thabs mi snang / ban chung sna thag rang gi mgo la dkris nas gang nus kyis dam pa'i chos bsgrub pa de rnams skyid pa zhes thugs skyo ba'i gsung yang yang phebs/ phal cher zhig ming dang gos cung zad re byung na'ang rang pho skyes te sangs rgyas kyi sa thob pa lta bu'i mngon rlom bskyed/ chos bzhin byed pa'i gnyom chung lto skya gos byul po rnams khyer kha zhan par bzung nas snying rje go log tu byed pa mang yang rje 'dis ni gzhon nu ma bdun gyi rtogs brjod ltar/ rgyun du de 'dra'i rigs la bsngags brjod dang thugs smon pa mdzad de/ gsung mgur rnams su'ang / dgra po ma thul gyi sdug bsngal/ / nye 'brel ma 'khyongs kyi dogs pa/ / nor rdzas bsog srung gi sems khral/ / gang yang med pa rnams skyid pa/ / mthun 'jug ngo srung ni mi dgos/ / rang dbang rang nyid kyis bzung bas/ / ci byed gu yangs kyis yan pa/ / sna thag mgo dkris rnams skyid 643

༄/ /yo bang bstanapa'ithoname'i gsung 'bum/pa/ / zhes dang / na bun stod g.yogs gyon pa'i g.ya' ri srug po'i sul na/ / lhung lhung dal gyis 'bab pa'i rdza chu sil ma'i 'gram du/ / bag phebs nyams dga' spyod lam bzhi shong g.yam pa'i spyil bur/ / g.yeng med rnam 'byor spyod pa'i spong pa ba rnams skyid pa/ / nags tshal smad g.yogs klubs pa'ispang ri ser po'i mgul na/ / me tog sna tshogs gzhad pa'i ne'u gseng yid du 'ong bar/ / tsha grang reg pa skyob pa'i rang shong 'jag ma'i spyil bur/ / yang dag 'jog la gzhol ba'i bsam gtan pa rnams dga' ba/ /zhesadapen pa las skyes pa'i dga' bdes thugs phrogs shing de lta bu zhig gi thog tu ma khel ba la thugs skyo ba'i rnam pa'ang / rwa bar bskor ba'i ri dwags ji bzhin du/ / gzhan dbang kho nar gyur pa bdag lta ni/ / mi 'dod bzhin du 'du 'dzi'i 'dam du lhung / / chos bzhin sgrub pa'i smon pa zlo bzhin du/ / sna tshogs rkyen gyis go skabs kun phrogs nas/ / 'tsho ba'i 'du byed gnas pa tsam zhig tu/ / gyur 'di bsam gyin skyo bas mchi ma dku/ / zhes dang / mched grogs phal cher ri khrod 'grim pa 'di dga' yang / / ban chung sna thag gzhan la shor ba 'di skyo ba/ / zhes gsungs te rjes 'jug rnams la thos bsam sgom gsum rang dbang du byar yod pa'i dus 'dir skyid ngo shes par byas te 'bad dgos so zhes 'doms par snang ngo / / nged kyang de skabs chokho da tshang dgon du yod pa skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang dag zhing du phebs pa'igatam thos nas mgyogs shad kyis phyir 'ongs te rje nyid la mjal zhing gdung ba'i smre sngags kyi zhu ba phul par phan pa'i bka' lan yid tshim pa gnang / 'di dus thugs brel che zhing thams cad blong blong por song nas bka'atshos mang po gnang rgyu ma byung na'ang tshogs 'dus pas zhus pa ltar khri gdan zur rnams kyis gtsos pa'i che bgres rags bsdus don gnyer ba 644

sa / /sdebatsun khazang4541nyi 'a bdaganacan ngonarnams dang bcas gzim chung gi ra skor du shong tsam la bla ma'i rnal 'byor dga' ldan lha brgya ma'i khrid dang sprul sku myur 'byon gsol 'debs kyi lung gnang / bka' chos kyi dbu tshugs pa dang rdo bcal gyi mkhar brda btang ba dus mnyam du byung bas rten 'brel legs zhes mnyes pa mdzad/ zhal nas sku 'bum du sprul sku myur 'byon gsol 'debs bris dus sde 'dir ngur sprig 'dzin pa'i 'dus pa'i tshogs/ zhes sogs kyi tshigs bcad bris pa dang rnga po che brdung zhing dung 'bud pa sogs rten 'brel legs po byung bas 'dir yang bskyar nas bzhag pa yin gsung / bka' chos kyi zhar la 'jig rten bde skyid bstan pa la rag las tshul bstan pa yun ring du gnas pa'ang mtshan nyid kyi 'chad nyan zhig la rag las pas mkhas grub thams cad mkhyed pas kyang dga' ldan du mtshan nyid rtsal du bton tshul/ kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje gong ma de nyid kyis kyang mtha' 'khob kyi yul du bstan pa'i sgon me sbar ba la med mi rung du dgongs nas mdo sngags kyi 'chad nyan tshugs lugs/ rje de nyid nas kyang phyogs 'di'i bstan pa'i rmang rdo lta bur dgongs nas chos srid kyis bskyangs lugs/ khyed rnams kyis kyang blo mthun gyi ngos nas skyabs mgon thugs rje can de nyid kyi bka' drin bsam nas mdo sngags kyi 'chad nyan gyis mtshon pa'i bstan pa'i srol mtha' dag ma nyams par byed dgos tshul/ 'jam dbyangs chos rje'i zhal chems la 'bras spung pa'i bgro gleng ma nyams pa byas na nga'i gdung mchod yin gsungs pa dang /rong ston gyes nā len+d+rar skyor sbyangs kyi sgra ma nyams na nga'i bsam pa rdzogs gsungasapa sogs kyi gsung sgos du ma dang bcas sems la phan pa'i zhal ta mang du gnang / gtang rag gi yon du bla brang nas bar mdzod dngul maṇa gos chen yug lnga dngul srang brgya sogs dngos 'bul rnam grangs nyis brgya lnga 645

༄/ /gung bang bstan ba'ithoname'i r+yāng 'bum/bcu dang bla spyi khag so so nas kyang 'bul ba gya nom pa phul/ de nas 'dus spyi dang khyad par bla brang gi zhabs phyi ba che rim rnams nas dgon par yang yang chibs kha bsgyur nas gzigs rtog dang sprul sku 'khrul med zhig rnyed rgyu'i mgo 'dren mdzad khyab dang / gang cir phan pa'i bslab ston zhal bkod rnams gnang dgos tshul rgyun mar nan tan mdzad pa bzhin de thams cad dngakhyad par du bla brang gi zhabs phyi pa rnams la nged rang yang yang 'ongs pas bstan don la rgyar phan rgyu yod med gang ltar yang rang gi bla ma'i gdan sa yin gshis skabs skabs su lta rtog la yong rgyu'i 'dun pa byed/ gtso cher khyed rnams blo mthun gyi ngos nas skyabs mgon thugs rje can gyi bka' drin bsam ste dgongs pa rdzogs pa dang mchog sprul 'khrul med myur gsal gyi rim gro sogs la brtson pa gang che dang / phyi nang gi bya bzhag las don spyi dang khyad par rang rang la khur du babs pa'i las don rnams yid chad sgyid lugs su ma song bar dus skabs dang bstun pas gang 'tsham gang nus rang sems rang gis gzengs bstod pa'i sgo nas le shor med par sgrub pa gal che tshul thugs la bzhag nas cis kyang de bzhin mdzod/ nged nas kyang sprul sku 'khrul med nges pa zhig rnyed rgyu'i don skor sogs bla brang dang dgon pa'i las don rnams la gang shes gang nus kyi mgo 'dren phan grogs bgyid pa gzhir bcas phral du byed dgos rnams da lan bkod pa byas pa 'di bzhin dang /gzhan rnams slar rim pas skabs su gang babs la bab ltos kyi bkod pa byas chog ces sogs thun mong dang so so la gang ci'i bslab ston zhal bkod kyi rim pa zhib rgyas gnang ste mya ngan mun pa'i smag tu yid gsos bka' slob kyi snang gsal mngon par btegs nas snying gi gdung ba sel ba'i bka' drin bla na med par gyur/ spyir yang byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod las/ mya ngan 646

sa / /rjebatsun thazang444) char khas tshukhanazug rngus gdungs pa la/ / dbugs 'byin byed pa phan pa'i mchog / ces gsungs pa ltar byang chub sems dpa'i sa las kyang mya ngan gyis gzir ba'i sems can rnams kye mya ngan sel ba ni byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa sems can gyi don bya ba bcu gcig gi nang nas gtso bo zhig tu gsungs la/ rgyal sras zhi ba lhas kyang / mya ngan nyam thag dga' thob shog / yid chad rnams kyang yid sos shog / ces smon lam mdzad pa ltar rje btsun dam pa nyid kyisakhyang bskal pa grangs med pa'i snga rol nas gzhan gyi gdung ba sel ba'i thugasabaskyed lhun gyis grub pa'i don bzhin spyir 'gro ba nyam thag pa kun gyi don mdzad cing / khyad par de skabs nged cag dpon slob kun mgon skyabs dang bral bas ci bya gtol med du gyur pa la rje nyid nas skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang chen po'i zhal sbyin mdzad de sgo mtha' dag nas phas bu skyong ba bzhin brtse skyong mdzad pa'i bka' drin gyi phung po ni nam yang gzhal dka' ba'i gnas su gyur to/ / nyi shu gnyis kyi nyin chibs skyel ja thab dang bcas bkra shis 'khyil nas thon gser chen du tsha bab thog brag dkar rgyud ba grwa tshang gi bla ma las sne rnams kyis thab bsu zhus grwa tshang la dngul srang lnga bcu'i 'jog pa gnang / tsha 'bog bzhes nas chibs thog tu phebs khar byang ngos la gzigs nas brag de rgan gya'i brag dkar red ang gsung / red zhus pas phyag thal mo sbyar nas bde mchog gi sngags yongs rdzogs dang / srid pa gsum 'bar sku ni rjes chags dul bar ldan/ / zhesasogs dang / lha mo tshad ma zhes sogs kyis bsngo smon gnang / de nas zhal tshur la phyogs pa na lho phyogs na sprin dkar po gdugs 'dra ba yu ba lho phyogs dang rtse mo byang phyogs la bstan pa gcig 'dug pa gzigs/ zhal nas sprin 'di bkra shis 'khyil gyi thad na snang ang gsung / snang lags zhus pas/ phyogs thams 647

༄/ /gung thang ba na pa'ithoname'i gsung 'bum/cad nam mkha' g.ya' dag tu song ba la phyogs bkra shis 'khyil gyi thad na sprin 'di ya mtshan gsung / sprin dkar po lding ba'i lho phyogs na/ / gnas bkra shis g.yas su 'khyil ba der/ / mtshan brjod par dga' ba drin po che/ / rje dkon mchog 'jigs med dbang po bzhugs/ / zhes sogs mgur dbyangs mang tsam mdzad 'dug kyang blo la zin mkhan ma byung 'dug / gsung zur de tsam las gsal cha ma mdzad 'dug na'ang de'i bla ma dang yi dam lha'i gzigs snangakhyad par can re byung ba'i tshod du snang ngo / / nyi ma lung dgon pa dang gcu 'khor dgon bis mdo dgon pa so so nas chibs bsu ja thab bsnyen bkur 'bul nod gzabs shing dgon so sor mang 'gyed gnang / phebs lam du grong sde so so'i ja zhus mjal ba sogs zam ma chad pa mu mthud nas yong par phyag dbang mtshan dang gzungs sngags ma ṇi'i bzlas lung bsngo smon bcas chag med gnang / bla brang nas dpa' ris phyogs kyi dgon sde so sor dgongs rdzogs sgrub mi'ang phyag phyir 'drangs nas 'ongs yod pas mar tshang bla chen po'i mdun du brgya mchod rgyas pa phul te rje nyid dbu mdzad nas dpon g.yog tshang mas bla mchod myur 'byon gsol 'debs smon lam dang bcas 'ur chems kyis gsungs shing sprul sku 'khrul med myur gsal gyi spyan dmigs nan tan mdzad pas thams cad kyi mthun snang du gnam gshis bzang ba dang khyad par bla chen gyi zhal ras mdangs gsal zhing 'od 'tsher ba 'dzum 'bol le ba lta bu byung / nyid la gzigs snang khyad par can byung ba yin nam gang ltar yang sprul sku 'khrul ba'i dri ma dang bral ba zhig myur ba nyid du yong ba'i rten 'brel nges par 'grigs byung zhes bla chen gyi zhal ras la yang yang gzigs shing yang yang gsung nas thugs nyams shin tu spro ba'i rnam pa mdzad/zi lang du am ban dang mjal phrad thog 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa rin po che'i 648

༄/ /chubamatshabazapacho minyima'igagangagatsosas khabagasakasku don gyi skor 7gong mar snyan sgron 'bul rgyu'i zhu snang dang bkra shis 'khyil bla brang dang bcas pa'i gang ci'i bya ba thams cad gtad gnyer mdzad/ am bhan nas rje nyid la 7gong mas yang yang bka' 'dri gnang ba 'di dgongs gzhi yod pas da res 7gong ma'i gser zhal la mjal 'dod dang zhabs 'degs sgrub 'dod yod pa'i rnam 'gyur byas nas zhu ba phul na bzang /nged tshos kyang de lugs kyi mthun rkyen sgrub zhus shing de mtshungs car go che dang bi chi chi sogs dpon po thams cad nas kyang de bzhin zhus na legs de 'dra ma zhus na 7gong ma'i thugs la ci dgongs mi shes zer nas dpon po che chung thams cad kha mthun gyis nan tan zhus kyang / nyid nas dpon po thams cada'i lo nyung zhing gzugs po bde na 7gong ma'i gser zhal mjal ba dang zhabs 'degs zhu ba ci la mi 'dod 'on kyang bdag lo rgas shing lus gcong pas da lta 7gong ma'i zhabs 'degs zhu rgyu lta zhog 'gro 'dug phran tshegs re'i lam gyi ngal dub tsam yang shin tu theg dka' ba 'dug / de rigs steng du mi 'ong ba'i thabs mkhas kyi bkod khyab khyed rnams nas cis kyang nan tan thugs la 'dogs dgos zhes rgyu mtshan zhib tu mol bas dgongs bzhed ltar 'grub pa byung / khong rnams nas 7gong ma'i bka' 'dri gnang tshul sogs shin tu gtam snyan yin pa'i rtsis dang / pho brang du phebs na legs tshul zhus pa'ang bsam pa drang ba'i phan gtam du byas pa yin 'dug cing 'jig rten gyi rnyed bkur snyan grags re ba zhig yin na de ltar don la gnas mod/ rje nyid nas byang ba'i byis pa nyung mas mi mgu ba'i dpe ltar chen po'i ming dang go sa rnyed pa dang grags pa sogs la 'khri ba nang nas chod pa'i stobs kyis de lta bu'i rkyen gang gis kyang mi 'phrog pa ni thabs shes zung du 'jug pa rgyal ba'i sras kyi rnam thar bla na med pa yin te/ chos yang dag par sdud pa las/649

༄/ /gung thang ba na pa'i naba'i r+yāng 'bum/stong pa nyid smra ba ni mi gnas pa'i phyir 'jig rten gyi chos rnams kyis mi 'phrog ste/ rnyed pas dga' ba yang med/ ma rnyed pas mi dga' ba yang med/ grags pas yid sos pa yang med/ ma grags pas sro shi ba yang med/smad pas zhum pa yang med/ bstod pas dga' bar sems pa yang med/bde bas chags par 'gyur ba yang med/ sdug bsngal bas yid 'byung bar 'gyur ba yang med de/ gang de ltar 'jig rten gyi chos rnams kyis mi 'phrog pa de ni stong pa nyid shes pa ste/ de ltar mi 'phrog pas stong pa nyid smra ba khong du chud par bya'o/ / zhes dang / byang chub semayodapa'i cho ga gang lags/zhes pa nas/ rnyed pa dang ma rnyed pa dang / grags pa dang ma grags pa dang / bstod pa dang smad pa dang / bde ba dang sdug bsngal gyis mi sgul ba dang / thams cad du tshod shes pa dang zhes sogs gsungs pa lta bu/ chos kyi mig dang ldan pa rnams mchog tu rjes su yi rangs par bya ba'i gnas su gyur pa zhig go / de nas zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i tshes gcig la sku 'bum du phyag phebs hal ha dar han pe li'i dpon mo ngo g.yog mjal te 'dod don zhus pa'i re ba bskangs/ dgon lung nas gdan 'dren pa dge bskos che ba dang grwa rgan bcas 'ongs par pheb4ma thub kyang cho 'phrul smon lam la sger du yonabadag med par bla brang gi las byed rnams la nyid nas sbyin bdag tshol dge bskul mdzad nas dngul srang bdun brgya tsam 'dus pa des rgyu rkyen sbyar te smon lam dkyus ltar legs par sgrub rgyu'i zhal bkod mdzad/ de skabs ke ta ga'i byi dor gyi yang lan yin zer ba zhig gi dpe mched nas byung bar nyid kyi zhal slob dge bshes shig gis de la dgag lan zhig mdzad na zhus kyang ma gsan/ dge bshes khong rang gis de'i dgag lan zhig bsgrigs te dam bca' re re nas sun 'byin pa'i lung rigs mang po dang / tha na'ang lan 650

༄/ /rdzobamazlabazangachosakyinyisa'igangag mapad+madakarasadabyunganade'i ming 'dogs tshul yang me dang mtshon la dpe sbyar ba de rgyal dbang bskal bzang rgya mtsho'i zhal nas/ gang dang nye bar gyur pa kun/ / bsres pa'i me chenagang zhe na/ / cung zad tsam gyi rkyen la yang / / mi bzod khong khro drag po'o/ / zhes dang / gang dang phrad kyang snying gi dkyil/ / 'bug pa'i mtshon rnon de gang zhig / pha rol skyon nas gleng ba yi/ / tshig tsub mi snyan smra ba'o/ / zhes gang gsungs pa ltar/ rang gi kun slong dang yig cha de'i byed las bstan cing mdor na rang gzhan gyi dge rtsa sreg cing gcod pa'i don dang mthun par btags 'dug go zhes ming don thams cad la skyon brtags pa'i dgag pa zhig brtsams te spyan lam du bstar bar/ 'di 'dra bris nas ci byed/ lta ba bkar btags kyi phyag rgya bzhi dang sdug bden gyi khyad chos mi rtag sdug bsngal stong bdag med bzhi nor ba 'di 'dra mtshan nyid pa gsar bu pa rnams kyis kyang shes se ra byes pa'i yi dam rta mgrin gsang sgrub yin zer lugs la bltas na dbus su'ang 'gro ma myong mkhan zhig red/ sgro skur 'ba' zhig gi gtam yug mo'i kha 'dzing lta bu phan tshun thams cad kyi dge rtsa bsregs te bye ma'i rkyal ba kha thur du spub pa ltar ngan song du kha lhan gyes gtong ba'i yi ge 'di 'dra zhig mkhan chen gyis gtan nas gsung mi yong bas 'di ni nges par gang yang ma bslab ci yang mi shes pa'i blun po glang snying can zhig gis bla ma'i zhabs tog tu rlom nas bris pa yin 'dug / 'di 'dra la lan byas kyang chos kyi 'bel gtam gyi tha snyad med gsungs te yi ge de'ang mched du ma bcug / der ma zad dang po'ang rtsa ba mkhan chen rang gis ke ta ka mdzad/ de nas nged la'ang 'dir dogs dpyod byed dgos zhes dbang med du bskul nas byi dor bris pa gcig tu bla ma rang gi gsung bsgrub pa dang bstan pa'i dag ther du'ang e 'gyur snyam pa yin kyang yul dang dus kyi 651

༄/ /gung thang bam pa'izlaname'i gsung 'bum/dbangagis sman dug tu song nas dgos pa mi 'dug pas phyin chad byi dor gyi dpe rgyun yang ma spel zhes bka' rgya mdzad de/ / gnas tshul 'di dag skyon 'ba' zhig tu mthong nas sdig pa gsog pa rnams ni las kyis nongs pas bzlog tu ma mchis la/ rgyab brten bsod nams dang bcas shing blo mig dang ldan pa zhig yin na phyi phyir nyes ltung gi sgo 'gag pa'i nyams len du go dgos pa zhig ste/ mnyam med jo bo chen pos/ smra ba mang po sdig pa'i rgyu/ / don med khong khros dge rtsa 'joms/ / ngag gi nyes pas dgra po 'gugs/ / ngag gi nyes pas bshes dang 'bral/ / zhes gsungs pa bzhin 'jig rten na 'thab rtsod sogs mi bde ba phal cher gyi rtsa ba ngag gi nyes pas byed pas gzhan gyis ngan du zer ba sogs ci 'dra zhig byung yang dang du mi len pa rgyal sras zhi ba lha'i spyod 'jug tu/ de tshe shing bzhin gnas par bya/ / zhes gsungs pa dang / rigs pa'i khu byug gis/ brag cha lta bu'i sgra rnams la/ / bden dang zhen pa mi mnga' bas/ / mtshan mar ma 'dzin lhod de skyur/ / ces gsungs la/ mnyam med jo bo chen por/ tshig ngan thos na ci tsug bya/ / zhes 'brom ston pas zhus pa la/ brag cha bzhin du khyer la thongs/ / zhes gsungs pa dang tshul mtshungs par pha rol pos sgro skur gyis sdangasbras ci 'dra zhig zhus kyang lan sogs mi mdzad par ma zad gzhan gyis byed pa'ang bzlog ste btang snyoms chen po'i ngang du glod nas 'jog pa dang /thog ma'i rtsa ba ke ta ka yin kyang da dung rang nyid kyis lan pa bzhin du mdzad nas byi dor gye dpe rgyun yang bkag pa ni 'brom gyes jo bo la/ rtsod pa spong na ji ltar bya/ / zhes zhus pa'i lan du/ rang la khug la lan no gyis/ /zhes gsungs pa ji lta bar snang bas/ bdag legs su 'dod pa rnams kyis sdeg pa'i sgo mo 'gag pa la nges par thabs 'di 'dra re dgos so/ / lo 652

sa / /rjebatsun bzangamachosanganyima'i d+madaganartsa rākhanamajug tu bal po'i sde gzar la dmigs nas rje nyid kyis rdo rje slob dpon mdzad de chos rgyal gye gtor rgyag gnang / de skabs sman pa dpon slob gro tshang mkhan po'i thugs mis la rje 'di nyid kyi mdun du mi thod gsar ba gsum bsgrigs nas bzhag 'dug pa rmis shing / khong gi phyag mdzod chos rje'i rmi lam du dgon pa'i gling 'dabs su ser dmag mang pos bal bo yin rgyu ba mang po bzung nas bkyig brdung byed kyin yod pa zhig rmis 'dug pas/ bstan pa kho na thugs la bcings te mngon spyod mdzad par dam can chos srung rnams kyis kyang 'phrin las ji bzhin du bsgrub pa yin par snang ngo / / rje nyid bkra shis 'khyil du phebs pa'i shul der zi ling am ban gyis dgon pa rnams la bal po'i 'khrugs pa'i don du rgya nag nas grong thang 'ong gin yod pas dmag rta sgrig dgos zhes sku 'bum dang dgon lung la rta bzhi bcu re/ gser khog chu bzang gnyis la rta brgyad cu re'i khral bzhag ste blangs yod pa la rje nyid bkra shis 'khyil nas tshur lam zi yid brgyud de phebs skabs am ban la khyed kyis grong thang yong rgyu'i dus kyis gtugs te thag ring gi dmag rta ma sleb par snga 'gros su dgon pa tsho'i gra rta blangs 'dug ces tshor/ phral du de 'dra mi gnang kha med yin kyang bla ma ser mos dmag gi rgyab brten du rim gro'i chos 'don pa las rta khral sogs 'jal ba'i srol snga ma nas med/ phyin chad kyang dar mi rung bas slar phyi log gi sog po'i dmag rta thams cad 'dzom dus nged cag dgon pa tsho'i gra rta rnams kha grangs ltar cis kyang gnang dgos gsung bar/ am ban nas da res dgos pa tsho la rta khral 7gong ma'i bkas bzhag pa yin pas phyir slog mi thub da dung yang dmag rta sogs khral ji ltar 'bab rgyu mi shes pa 'dug ces zhus/ 'o na sang gnangs grong thang 'ongs dus nged kyis kyang mtshams zhu byed rtsis yin pas de skabs khong la rgyu mtshan zhib tu zhus 653

༄/ /gung thangabastan ba'ithoname'agasung 'bum/te/ 7gong mar snyan sgron 'bul dgos rung mi byed thabs med yin gsungs nas phyir bzhugs gnas su phebs/ de ma thag am ban kyang nyid kyis bzhugs gnas su 'ongs te nged kyis bsam mno btang bas hu thog thus gang gsungs pa dgongs dag par 'dug / hu thog thu nyid grong thang la mtshams zhu gnang rgyu'i bab 'brel yod na'ang grong thang 'ongs dus phyogs thams cad kyi dpon po che chung mtha' dag 'dus te dmag don kho nar brel bas mjal phrad sos dal ba zhig mi 'ongs/ de bas sku 'bum du phebs nas thugs bde bar bzhugs na nged rang gis grong thang dang gros bgyis nas gang byas kyang lo mjug 'dir dgon pa tsho'i grwa rta rnams kha grangs ltar sprod thabs shig byed ces khas len zhus/ de don bzhin rjes sor dgon pa bzhi'i grwa rta rnams kha grangs tshang bcug ste mkhar nang du gso dka' bas dgon so so'i mi rnams yong rags la nyin kha shas kyi ring sku 'bum gyi ri rtsar 'jog pa gyis zhes thung zi gnyis la spyi so chen mor skyel bcug par/ dgon pa'i las byed dang zhabs phyi ba rnams kyis am ban dang bstun dgos pas re zhig chu dkar du bzhag nas gso dgos sam zhus kyang ma gsan par sku 'bum dang dgon lung gnyis kyi rta brgyad cu tham pa kha grangs ltar blangs te/ gzhan ma rnams nged tshos gso mi thub gsung thung zi la sprad nas phyir btang / 'dis mtshon tesnga phyir am bhan gyis dgon pa rnams la rang gi zhon rta gsor 'jug pa dang gling 'dab kyi nags nang nas bya gsod 'jug pa sogs mi 'tsham pa'i srol ngan btod pa la/ dgon pa gzhan rnams kyis bab khur kyang sku 'bum dang dgon lung du rje nyid khrir bzhugs rang la skabs su gang 'tsham gyi gsung zhi drag ci rigs pas bzlog nas snga ma'i srol ngan pa rnams bsnubs shing phyi ma dod du ma bcug / zhabs phyi ba rnams kyis am bhan nas tshur gtod rgyu'i 654

/ /chubatsun ba nyis gsangag mapad+madakurasadabyung/bya ba re gnyis las med cing nged tshos phar gtod rgyu'i sku don shin tu mang bas ci 'dra yong zhes rgyun du sems 'tsher byed kyang nyid nas de la 'dzem dogs cung zad kyang mi mdzad pa ni dbu ma rin chen phreng bar/ gang phyir bzod pa mi bzod pa/ / shes par dka' ba'i rgyal po ni/ / chos min rigs pa min spyod kyang / / rjes su 'tsho ba'i rgyal po la/ / phal cher bstod pa de yi phyir/ / sman dang mi sman mkhyen par dka'/ / zhes pa nas/ bdag lta gcig pu te por gsol/ / gsungs pa bzhin mthon po'i rigs kyis bya ba legs nyes ci 'dra zhig byas kyang rang gi chab 'bangs dang re ltos can rnams kyis de'i ngo bsrung ba'i phyir gcam bu'i tshig gi phye 'thor kho na bgyis pas bden par rlom ste lcags kyu med pa'i glang po bzhin du lam ma yin par zhugs nas rang gzhan thams cad phung bar byed pa gzigs te brtse bsam bzod cing bstan pa kho na gces par dgongs nas rang don yal bar bor ba'i rnam thar chen po yin te/ zhus lan nor bu'i 'phreng ba las/ ngo dga' med cing gsar 'grogs med/ / rtag tu tshugs ni thub par bya/ zhes dang /nyi ma nyin gcig gi ngo dga' dang phye 'thor gyis tshugs mi thub pas rtag tu ngo tsha dang khrel yod kyis tshugs thub par gyis/ gsha' ma byed pas gang byas kyang mdzes pa zhig 'ong ba yin/ des smras pa'i gtam la'ang tshad mar 'dzin pa zhig 'ong / ngo dga' phye 'thor byed pa de la thams cad kyis dang por 'grogs bde mor rtsi/ kho'i gnas lugs rtogs nas klad slan/ kha bdar kha gsag mkhan de la rgyu mtshan ye med zer nas mjug kun gyis brnyas pa zhig 'ong gsungs pa bzhin/ rgyu 'bras mi bslu ba'i stobs kyis g.yo sgyus gzhan 'brid pa rnams la dang por ngo shes tshad mdza' bshes su 'gro'ang phyi nas thams cad dgrar langs pa zhig 'byung la/ rje nyid nas phan sems 655

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'isgran 'i gsungajabum/kyis drang thal 'ba' zhig mdzad pas dang por mgu mi mgu cung zad yod kyang mthar gus pas btung de sku don sogs la 'gal rkyen du cung zad tsam yang ma gyur la/ tshul 'di dag ni bstan pa 'dzin skyong srung gsum las rnal 'byor dang dbang phyug gi stobs kyis bsrung ba'i che ba bla na med pa zhig tu'ang khums so/ / der ma zad sngar khengs dregs kyis myos pa'i rgya sog gi dpon po mang po'ang rje 'di nyid rgya nag tu phebs phyin nas nyid la dad pa thob ste rim gyes bstanapa bstan 'dzin dang bcas par gus nyams dod song ba de dus kyi mi rnams kyis gleng zhing / nyid rang gi zhal nas kyang nged rang pho brang du dang po 'gro dus sangs rgyas zhal bzhugs dus kyang 'ga' zhig nyan thos kyi 'dul skal du gsungs pa ltar sangs rgyas dngos lta bu'i bla ma gong ma rnams kyi 'dul skal du ma gyur ba'i rgya sog gi dpon po rnams kyis las kyi 'brel bas nga la dad pa thob/ nged nas rgyu mtshan nges bcug ste rim gyis gzhan dang gzhan la dad pa thob pa shin tu mang / nged rang la gzhan las lhag pa'i khyad chos dang byin rlabs yod dogs med/ rtsa ba'i bla ma rnams tshul bzhin bsten khul dang khas blangs pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa rnams bsngo bgrang byed khul dang / khong tshos nga la las kyi 'brel ba yod pa bcas de rnams 'dzom pa'i mthu la brten nas byung ba yin par mngon gsungs/ pā rin e phu bde legs bzang pos nged tsho'i pe cing dang sog yul du sangs rgyas grangs med kyis ma thul ba'i rgya sog gi dpon po mang po chos la zhugs pa 'di bdag gi bla ma thu'u bkwan rin po che'i zla gam gyi byin rlabs yin zhes thal mo sbyar nas yang yang bshad kyin yod cing / ku ru ku l+le'i gtor ma zla gam gyi dbyibs can yin pas yi dam gyi ming sbas nas gtor ma'i dbyibs kyis bshad pa yin 'dug / smon lam bla ma bkra shis dar rgyas kyis thu'u bkwan rin po ches 656

༄/ /rjebatsug bzangacho minyima'ig4gakhumapasagakhasadabyung/smad phyogs kyi dpon po dregs pa can rnams btul ba 'di slob dpon pad+mas 'jigarten pa dregs pa can rnams btul ba dang rnam pa mtshungs pa yin te/mtshan tsam smos pas dad pa skye ba dang bka' las nam yang mi 'da' ba ni srog snying phul nas dam la btags pa lta bu zhig yin zhes bsngags brjod rgyun ldan mdzad kyin yod zer/ wang zhabs drung rin po ches rje nyid zhwa lu'i mkhan por phebs te tshur byon phyin nas bod kyi sangs rgyas la yang dag mi ster ba'i dge bshes mang po slob mar 'dus/ smad kyi dpon chen 'jig rten mes po la bden kha mi ster mkhan rnams kyang sbyin bdag tu gyur pa yin pas/pā rin e phus zla gam gyi byin rlabs yin zer ba dang / har chin smon lam bla mas slob dpon gyis dregs pa can rnams dbang du bsdus pa dang dpe sbyar ba shin tu nas kyang 'grigs 'dug gsungs/ thun mong snang tshod tsam la gnas skabs kyi rkyen de 'dra yin srid kyang gtso bo'i rgyu ni bskal pa mu mtha' yas pa'i snga rol nas gzhan phan byang chub kyi sems la goms pa dbang du gyur cing des zin pa'i bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs rlabs po che'i mthu yongs su rdzogs pa'i stobs yin te/ sbrang rtsi'i dbyangs kyi yal 'dab las/gangagis legs pa'i yid can rnams kyi yid ni kun dga' mnyen ldan rig par byed/ / gang gi mthu yis gdug rnams kyi yang yongs su 'dris pa'i mun pa zhi bar byed/ / gang gi bsod nams grangs med grangs kyi tshig gi tshad kyi yul du mi 'gyur ba/ / 'gro ba thul ba'i mgon po rab rgyas mthu ldan de nyid gcig pu 'byung ba yin/ / zhes dang / yal 'dab so bzhi pa las/bsod nams rab zhi bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin mthu/ / de ni dag pa'i bdag la ci yang yod/ / gang gi mthu yis ma rungs pa rnams kyang / / 'phral la khro ba'i dug ni rab tu gtong / / zhes gsungs pa ltar yin la/ der ma zad 657

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'ithon me'i gsung 'bum/tshad ma'i skyes mchog dam pa klong rdol bla ma rin po ches/ mtho lding byang rtse mkhan po la gsung 'phros shig tu thu'u bkwan sprul sku khong rang pho brang du bzhugs dus thugs ha cang gtum drag nas 7gong ma'i nang blon tsho dang 'khon 'dzing byed pa sogs lugs srol las 'das pa'i bya ba mang po bsgrubs kyang 7rgyal po'i dgongs tshom sogs kyi skyon gang yang ma byung 'dug / de khong rang sngags kyi rtogs pa mthon por glebs pa'i rtags yin pa red gsungs 'dug pa ni/ dper na slob dpon khru yi bas/ kye ma srid pa gsum na 'jigs med des na nga la rgyal po yod ma yin/ / zhes nyam nga med pa seng ge'i brtul zhugs kye spyod pa bstan pa dang cha 'dra ba zhig yin par snang ste/ nyid kyi zhal nas kyang / tshul gnyis gtsug lag rlabs kyi zhags pa yis/ / nor 'dzin 'ching ba'i rgyal khab mtsho chen du/ / blon 'bangs srog chags bye ba 'khrigs pa'i nang / / lugs zung rnam dpyod 'khyug pas rtsen par byas/ / zhes gsungs la/ rang don re dogs kyi 'ching ba 'ga' yang med par bstan pa dang sems can gyi don du gang 'gyur kho na gtso bor mdzad pa'i tshul 'di ni le'u dgu pa'i sgon gsal las/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa gang yin pa de ni spyod pas mtshon te/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa gang yin pa de la ni 'jig rten dang 'gal ba'am/ mi 'gal ba yang rung / rnam pa gang dang gang gis sems can gyi don rdzogs par 'gyur ba'i rnam pa de dang des sngags pa rnams ci nus par rab tu 'jug pa ni byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa'o/ / zhes bdag nyid chen po rnams kyi khyad chos yin paragasungs so/ / tshul de dag la 'di skad ces bya ste/ byin rlabs sprang char kun tu stoms ldan yang / / dbang byed 'phrin las glog gi zhags pa yis/ / mngon rlom khengs dregs rab mtho che dgu'i tshogs/ / sa 'dzin 658

༄/ /rjebatsug ba4chos nyima'ibakhangagasu pad+madakaraladabyungakaphreng ba'i mgul ba gcig car bcings/ / brlang spyod gtum drag btsan dug longs spyod kyi/ / dpal 'byor gzi 'od stong 'bar rma bya'i tshogs/ /gang gi thugs rje byin rlabs sprin gyi sgras/ / mngon dga' dad pa'i 'jo sgeg rol ba bsten/ / rgyal ba'i bsod nams dge mtshan ldan pa de/ / 'gro kun bde ba'i byed por mngon phyogs kyang / / dman pa'i dpal gyis chos lam sgrib pa yi/ / khengs dregs mun pa'i go 'phang mthar byed yin/ / rgyal sras spyod pa thabs shes gom pa'i stabs/ / dregs myos stobs ldan spobs pa dmigs med du/ / rgyas 'debs byed pa rdo rje'i ri kha ste/ / srid zhi'i mtshams las mi 'da' dam tshig mchog / ces ched du brjod par bya'o/ /dgung lo nga drug pa chu byi'i lo gsar tshes kyi dga' ba dang po'i nyin dur ped slob dpon ngag dbang rab brtan dang cha har bsam gtan dpon po'i mi sna rnams brtan bzhugs kyi rten 'brel bsgrigs te dngos 'bul gya nom pa btegs/ tshogs dbur phebs nas dga' ston thog dge 'dun mang por mjal kha gnang ba sogs lo gsar gyi rim pa dkyus ltar mdzad/ dur ped wang gi mi sna ja lang tshe brtan rdo rje o thog tha'i ji rdo rje mi 'gyur gyi mi sna ja lang sogs ho sho'u tha dad kyi mjal ba brgya phrag du ma byung bar tshe dpag med rta mgrin sgrol ma dkar lngang gdugs dkar zhal phyag yongs rdzogs sogs lha du ma'i rjes gnang bka' bsgo gsung brtag sogs kyis re ba don ldan mdzad/tha'i ji rdo rje mi 'gyur gyis sgar ba'i tshom chen du 'ding rgyu'i khe pi su'i gshar gdan ring ba drug 'bul rgyu bskur 'dug par sbyin bdag la byin rten spos snam el chi la gnang sbyin mdzad/ tshes bcu la o thog dge slong 'jigs med phun tshogs kyis zhus ngor gro tshang mkhan po dang pā ju'u zhabs drung sogs don gnyer ba nyung 'dus la nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i dbang gnang / dus chen 659

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgron me'i gsung 'bum/dang bstun nas bsgrub bya brgyad cu gya lnga la dge tshul slong gi sdom pa phog ste thar pa'i rgyal mtshan bsgreng bar mdzad/ bzhugs ring la brtsi bzhag tshogs gtam gsung chos smon lam gnang ba dang rgyug dang 'tsham dang mchod phreng sogs la gzigs rtog zhib mor mdzad/ smon lam grol nas dgon lung du phebs/ bkra shis 'khyil gyi mtshams zhus pa 'ongs par mtshams lan dang lhan du sku gdung mchod rten gyi zhal 'debs la dngul dkar srang brgya phra rgyan rin po che'i rigs du ma/ sgo khyim la 'jog rgyu'i shel sgo che ba bcas bskur ba gnang / 'di dus nub cig gnyer g.yog phun tshogs zer ba glo bur du dbang po shor nas log song ba la thams cad kyis sol me bzhag pa de'i dug phog par bsams nas snang rtags chen po ma byas kyang / sku mdun du rgyu mtshan zhus par de sol dug kho na yin min mi shes gsung sku dngos kyis grwa pa de'i rtsar byon nas rna lam du mtshan dang gzungs sngags sgog pa mdzad pas sras de de'i nub mo dus las 'das song / de'i phyi nub gzhan grwa pa zhig kyang de bzhin log song ba la thams cad kyis snga nub kyi de dang 'dra ba yin nam snyam skrag ste sems 'tshab pa'i rnam pas sku mdun du rgyu mtshan zhus par zhal 'dzum nas 'di sol me'i rkyen gyis khrag rlung mgo 'khor byung ba yin 'gro gsungs pa bzhin zhu mkhan rnams phyir yong rag la grwa pa des dran pa rnyed de skyon gang yang ma byung ngo / / de lta bu 'byung 'gyur legs nyes mngon sum du gzigs pa'i rnam thar ches mang yang mtshon tsam las thams cad 'bri bar ga la nus/ gnyis pa'i tshes la cha har nas dge bshes bka' 'gyur ba dpon g.yog 'byor par phan tshun bka' chos 'ga' zhig gsan res mdzad cing gzhis len gzabs/ 'bri gu'i khri ba ba za bla ma 'ongs par mgon po'i srog rgyud le'u brgyad ma bsnyen sgrub las gsum/ lcang skya rol pa'i rdo rje'i gsung 660

༄/ /rjebatsug ba4chosakyinyis gsangagasumapatshadakarasadabyungakathor bu 'ga' zhig bcas kyi ljags lung gnang / dgon lung khri'i dgongs pa snga ma nas lan kha shas nan gyis zhus par dge 'dun bgres gzhon bar ma tshang mas nan tan gyis bshol ba dang da res kyang de bzhin nan che na'ang /rje nyid nas tshes bdun gyi nyin dgongs zhu'i mang ja btang ste dge 'dun gyi sde rin po cher gang ci'i gnas tshul rnams zhib rgyas zhu ba gnang nas thugs nan chen pos khri khur spor bar mdzad/ tshogs chen khri par bde rgu mkhan po dang rgyud pa'i khri pa rgya tig zhabs drung brje ran par tshab tu rtsig shu'u lha ram pa bsko bzhag gnang / spyi nas tshogs dbur gdan drangs te brtan bzhugs kyi rten 'brel phun sum tshogs pa bsgrigs/ tshogs chen du'ang mang 'gyed rgyas pa stsal/ snga ma wang zhabs drung khrir bzhugs dus bla slob rnam gnyis bka' bkros kyis rab 'byams pa ngag dbang blo bzang la cho lo dang bka' shogaganang ste dgon lung gi chos grwa pa rnams kyi gra ja'i ja tshul 'dzugs ched sbyin bdag rnams la dge bskul 'bul sdud du btang ba la 'dir 'byor cing dngul srang stong lhag byung 'dug par sger du gnyer ba gnyis bsko bzhag mdzad nas grwa ja dang grwa 'gyed kyi ja tshul tshugs/ nyid nas chos grwa pa rnams la grwa ja dang grwa 'gyed du phor ba rtsi can shing thog gis bkang ba re phul nas thog ma'i rten 'brel legs par bsgrigs/ rgya yag dge tshogs gling gi slob chungadang grwa rgan mchod gzhi'i mgo pa 'ga' zhig zhwa dmar dgon pa'i bra rte zhabs drung dang slob chung chen hu rnams rim gyis gdan 'dren du 'byor par so sor zhal len mdzad cing brati zhabs drung la bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa stsal/skabs 'dir zhabs brtan zur ba bka' 'gyur dag 'don rnam rgyal gzungs ring 'bum ther gsum sgrol dkar gyi tshe sgrub dgung grangs sher snying 'bum ther gdugs dkar khri tshar chos skyong spyi'i bskang gso gsol mchod brgya rtsa klu 661

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgoname'i gsung 'bum/gtor 'byung bzhi lan chags gtor ma sa 'bum chu 'bum grangs bsags bcas bsgrubs/ nyi shu skor la thar ba gling du phebs nyer gsum la mi 'khrugs pa'i sgrub mchod kyi tshogs dbu mdzad tshogs pa la mang ja gsum kha btags re dang phor ba rtsi can re'i 'gyed 'jog pa dang bcas gnang /'cham la gzigs rtog mdzad cing 'cham pa rnams la ja 'gyed btang /dge 'dun mang la rta mgrin gsang sgrub klu dbang rgyal bo gdugs dkar sgol dkar dzam dkar 'brug zhon lo gyon ma gtso 'khor gsum gyi rjes gnang /de'i bum sgrub kyi cho ga sogs chos tshan mang tsam gye ljags lung mgon po chos rgyal lha mo bog tse dam can rnams kyi rjes gnang dang / slob chung lo dkar chos rje len hwa rab 'byams pa sogs grwa pa lnga la nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i siskyo ra'ibyin rlabs rnams stsal/ bkra shis chos gling du mang ja dang khe bi su'i gral gdan nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i 'jog pa gnang / zla ba gsum par phyir 'khor nas sku 'bum du phebs te 'chad nyan mdzad/ 'jigs med pi li dpon g.yog mjal du 'ongs par bzhed mos bzhin dam can gye rigs gtad gnang lo snga mar lam rim bde lam gyi khrid spyor ba'i chos drug yan la bshad pa shin tu rgyas par gnang bas thams cad kyi yid phrogs te don gnyer shin tu che ba byung yang de'i bar nas chos mtshams mdzad de mjug gnang rgyur ma song bas 'di lo sngar gyi chos nyan pa rnams kyi steng du hal ha'i erti ni chos rje bla ma dang mdung nag gi rgyud pa zhabs drung sogs phyogs 'dus dang mi nyag sprul sku sogs chos sde rang gi don gnyer pa mang po bsnan pa dang bcas thams cad kyis mgrin gcig tu bde lam gyi khrid shin tu rgyas la cha tshang ba zhig bka' drin skyong dgos zhes nan cher gsol ba btab pa bzhin/ sa ga zla ba'i dus chen dang bstun te gzhi byes thams cad kyi bla ma dge 'dun stong phrag nye bar 662

༄/ /rdzobatsotshos4chosaminyima'igatsagatsolad+madakarabasakhanasgaragasar theg chen chos mdzod nas lam rim bde lam gyi khrid cha tshang smin rgyas gser sdong lha khang nas sems bskyed mchod pa dang bcas phyag len bzhin du rgyas par gnang / de dus lam rim gye bshad pa'i 'gros lo snga ma'i bshad tshul dang phal cher dbyibs 'dra zhing / gzhung bzang stong gi chu bo 'du ba'i phyir/ / dpal ldan legs par bshad pa'i rgya mtsho'ang yin/ /zhesabyang chub lam rim gyi che ba brjod pa las 'phros te bka' pota chen po lnga'i dgongs don mtha' dag lam gyi rim pa'i nyams len du 'khyer tshul dang khyad par du rnam 'grel dang sbyar nas thar ba dang thams cad mkhyen par bgrod pa'i lam gyi lus cha tshang ba mig ldan gyis gzugs la lta ba bzhin du dri ma med pa'i rigs pas rjen cher du phyung nas gtan la 'bebs tshul gyi gsung bshad bsam gyis mi khyab pa gzur gnas rnam dpyod can rnams kyi spyi nor du stsal/ de skabs zhal nas kyang nged rang gis sku 'bum la dngul srang mang po'i 'jog pa byas kyang sang gnangs or du su pa 'ongs na nga las brgya 'gyur stong 'gyur gyi 'jog pa byed rgyu yin pas lhag pa'i phan 'dogs rgyu dang mtshar rgyu gang yang med/ da lan gyi bshad pa 'di nged rang gis sku 'bum la 'jog pa gzabs nas bzhag pa'i khul yin 'di 'dra'i 'jog pa 'jog mkhan yang dkon mtshar yang che bas thams cad kyis chud zos la ma btang bar nya ra mdzad dgos zhes gsungs pa'ang nyams 'char tsam ma yin par man ngag chen po zhig tu snang ste/ drag shul can gyis zhus pa'i mdo las/ sbyin pa la snying por dga' bar rigs par mi bya yi/ bdag gi tshul khrims dang thos pa la snying po can du 'gyur bar bya'o/ / zhes dang / rin po che'i phung po'i mdo las/ shā ri'i bu/ byang chub sems dpa' rab tu byung bar gtogs pa rnams ni chos sbyin par byed pas gnas par 'gyur la/ byang chub sems 663

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung ཿma/dpa' khyim pa rnams ni zang zing thams cad yongs su gtong ba dag la ser sna med pas gnas par 'gyur ro/ / shā ri'i bu de'i phyir chos kyi sbyin pa dag gis bla na med pa yang ngag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas par nus kyi/ de ltar zang zing gi sbyin pa dag gis ni ma yin no/ / zhes gsungs shing / 'di la dgongs te nye bar 'khor gyis zhus pa'i mdor byang sems rab byung gis spyig gu dang snag tsha dang glegs bam dang chos kyi sbyin pa ste bzhi po 'di tsam zhig gtong bar gsungs la/ rnal 'byor spyod pa'i sa las kyang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi bstan pa la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni bslab pa las 'das na ji ltar yang sbyin pa mi gtong ngo / / zhes gsungs te da lta dus kyi tha mar son pas bla slob phal cher zang zing gi dngos po 'ba' zhig gi steng nas bka' drin che chung du brtsi ba ni rtsa ba rul ba'i rtags yin pas bdag legs su 'dod pa rnams phugs kyi khe nyen legs par bsam dgos so/ / khrid kyi mjug tu mi che hril por dge spyor byed 'dod mkhan rnams mdo sngags kyi nyams len ji ltar byed rgyu'i rim pa ngo bo grangs dang go rim tha na thun gcod lugs yan chad dang sgrub pa la rting bskul gyi bslab bya gnad che la go bde ba'i man ngag gi nor bu sil ma snying gi ze'u 'brur blugs/ sems bskyed mchod pa'i skabs su chos nyanapa rnams kyi steng du bka' chos su ma chud pa'i dge 'dun byings rnams kyang phebs te thams cad gdan 'dzom par lam gyi rim pa'i don 'du che ba'i gsung bshad gzab rgyas dang / rdzas phud 'bul ba'i skabs su nam zhig rdo rje ma'i tshab tu tshe rabs kun tu ma gsungs nas dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad rje rin po cher sgrub pa'i mchod par phul zhing bcol ba dang bzang spyod sogs bsngo smon gyi mtshams sbyor gnad smin mdzad/ o'u han tho yon chos rje 664

༄/ /chabatsun bzangachosakyi bsgo pad+madakaracodabyung/bstan 'phel gyis zhus nas bla ma dge bdun mang po la nam mkha' sgo 'byed kyi dbang gcod khrid mdor bsdus bcas dang / gro tshang mkhan po dang pā ju'u zhabs drung drung yig ngag dbang bstan 'phel gsum la rje btsun nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i bskyed rim rnal 'byor bcu gcig gi khrid mdor bsdus tsam gnang /rgyal ba yab sras la bal po gor+shas log sgrub zhus pa'i thugs gso la sku 'bum blaspya nas mi sna ched mngags gdong rje nyid nas 'char can dang 'phar ma'i zhu shog gnyis re dang 'phar ma'i zhu rten du gos chen rgyan bzhi yug re dang rgya dngul rdo tshad gnyis re bcas 'bul rgyu bskur zhing / sde pa gzhung nas dmag rta'i don skor du mngags pa'i el chi la mthun rkyen sgrub dgos tshul gyi bka' shog gnang don ltar rta 'tshab tu rgya dngul rdo tshad gsum gyi mthun rkyen zhus/ bshol zla bzhi par dgon lung du phebs te ke shu'u zhabs drung sogs zhu mkhan so so'i ngor zhabs drung sku skye dka' ram don gnyer can brgya phrag du ma'i khros nag lha lnga'i dbang nam mkha' sgo 'byed kyi dbang gcod stan thog gcig ma'i khrid drag po gsum dril dzam dkar lnga sogs lha du ma'i rjes gnang dang ljags lung mang po bcas gnang / gcod khrid kyi skabs su byang chub kyi sems kyi rtsis zin pa'i 'gyed gsum gyis tshogs bsags rgyab che tshul las 'phros te snga dus kyi gcod pas 'gyed gsum phar gtong gi yod kyang deng sang gi gcod pas tshur len gan 'dug ste/ gcod pa'am grong chog pas khyim tshang zhig tu song na thog mar zho dar sogs dkar spro zhus pa dkar 'gyed dang de rjes ra lug bsad nas dmar spro zhus pa dmar 'gyed mjug tu gos dar zam ras sogs 'bul ba zhu ba sna tshogs 'gyed yin pas 'gyed gsum gyi dod tshang ngo gsungs pa dang / yang grong chog pas kun slong gis zin shes na grib glud bsngo ba yan chad la'ang sbyin pa rnam gsum tshang bas de las don che ba 665

༄/ /gung thang brten pa'isgronama'i gsung babum/med kun slong gis zin ma shes na gnogapa skyel mkhan gyi gdon 'dre dang phan thogs byed mkhan gyi grong chog pa gnyis kyi kun slong la khyad par med de/gdon 'dres mdos gto glud re ba byas nas gnod pa skyel ba dang grong chog pas kyang rnyed pa dang bkur ste re ba byas nas phan 'dogs khul byed pas so/ / khyim tshang zhig tu mi bde ba byung na kho gnyis ga'i dga' zhing spro lugs la'ang khyad par med de don du gnyer bya gcig yin pa'i phyir ro gsungs pas thams cad bzhad gad theg ge ba byung / rje nyid kyis mdzad pa'i khros nag gi cho gar yang / gzhan la gnod pa'i 'dre gdon 'dul skad pas/ / rang nyid 'dre ru song ba ma tshor ba'i/ / rtog 'khyams khros ma nag mo'i zhabs 'dren mkhan/ / 'jig rten pha rol btang la 'dis ci bya/ / gsungs 'dug pa rnams kyang ku re tsam du ma go bar gdams ngag tu khyer nas snying la 'ching dgos pa zhig ste/ rje btsun mi la ras pas/ mi shi ba ro yi sngas mgo la/ / nor len 'dod kyi ngan bon ca co 'don/ / gsungs pa dang /mkhasagrub smra ba'i nyi mas kyang / lto phyir rdzun gyi cho ga byung rgyal gyis/ /phan sems med par grong chog brtson pa ni/ / bdag gzhan bslu ba'i gzhan don gzugs brnyan yin/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar/ dus kyi tha mar son pas yon gnas su grags pa phal mo che zhig ming gzhan don skad du zer yang bsam pa'i 'khyer so phyin ci log tu gyur pas rang gzhan gnyis ka bsrus te mdzo sbrel g.yang du lhung ba bzhin 'gyur ba la dgongs nas bka' gdams gong ma rnams/ mi 'os yon mchod kyi 'jug ngogs thur la bde/ /gsungs te shin tu ya nga ba'i gnas so/ / rje nyid kyis mdzad pa'i gcod kyi yig char yang sems skyed tshul gsungs nas 'di ni chos 'di'i srog lta bu yin pas rtsa ba bor nas yal ga 'tshol bar ma byed cig ces bkod pa rwa stod klong 666

༄/ / rjebatsugablobazangachosakyinyima'igagangagag pad+madakarasadabyung/rdol bla ma rin po ches gzigs nas byams pa rin po che'i byang chub kyi sems kyi man ngag khong gi thugs rgyud la mnga' ba'i rtags bstan 'dug gsungs pa ni 'phags chen dam pa nang phan tshun so so rang gi ye shes kyi spyod yul du gyur pa'i gsang rnam bla na med par snang ngo / / skyed tshal nas gser dgon gyi mā rab 'byams pa blo bzang chos 'dzin dang sog po rab 'byams pa grags pa skal bzang gnyis la spyor ba'i chos drug gi khrid mdor bsdus dang lcam sring gi rjes gnang / bla ma sgom pa ngag dbang rab brtan dang rgyud pa zhabs drung blo bzang bstan nyi ri khrod pa kha shas bcas la rje btsun mi la'i mgur 'bum dang rnam thar dpe chos rin chen spungs ba sogs lam rim blo sbyong skor gyi ljags lung du ma bcas stsal/ mkhar sngon shi re thu'i chos rje ngo g.yog gis dngos 'bul brtan bzhugs lugs su btegs par 'dod chos kyis tshim par mdzad/mang 'dus ri khrod la zla grangs kyi bco lnga'i nyin yon bdag btsal nas brgya mchod re 'bul gyin 'dug pa dus kyi dbang gis sbyin bdag rnyed min ci rigs byung bar rje nyid nas dngul srang lnga bcu'i 'jog pa gnang ste ri khrod ji srid gnas kyi bar du bco lnga'i brgya mchod chag med kyi rgyun btsugs/dbyar gnas kyi skabs su sku 'bum du 'chad nyan mdzad/ su nyid g.yas ru'i wang gi sras tho yon zhabs drung dang tho yon tā bla ma ngo g.yog gis brtan bzhugs kyi rten 'brel bsgrigs te dngos po gya nom pa'i mchod sprin bstar zhabs drung skyel mi rnams la rta mgrin gyi rjes gnang stsal/ de nas don gnyer can du mas gsol ba btab pa bzhin gro tshang mkhan po dang mi nyag sprul sku rgyud pa bla zur 'jam dbyangs don grub pā ju'u zhabs drung ke kyu zhabs drung zi na lha ram pa rgyar tshang sgom pa sogs gzhi sdod dang / hal ha'i orti ni chos rje mdung nag gi mā tsha zhabs drung rgyud pa zhabs drung su nyid wang gi tho 667

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'ithoname'i gsung 'bum/yon zhabs drung hūn gar zhabs drung sogs phyogs 'dus bcas gzhi byes kyi bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen skyes sprul sogs hrag bsdus kyi slob ma lnga brgya tsam la lcang skya rol pa'i rdo rje'i gsung 'bum par du 'khod pa yongs rdzogs dang mnal lam gyi rol mtshor shar ba'i bstan bcos zla ba'i snang brnyan rnams kyi lung gtor ma brgya rtsi'i khrid/ rje rang nyid kyi gsung 'bum dbu btsugs nas chos tshan kha shas kyi lngags lung bcas gnang ste chos mtshams mdzad/hal ha'i erti ni chos rjes zhus nas nyung 'dus shig la sngags lugs phyag chen gyikhrid zab cing gsang ba'i man ngag gis brgyan pa mdor bsdus tsam dang lcang skya rol pa'i rdo rje'i gsung bka' rgya ma du ma'i ljags lung stsal/ su nyid wang gi tho yon zhabs drung dang tā bla ma sogs bsgrub bya 'ga' zhig bsnyen rdzogs bsgrubs/ de dus bka' chos kyi mjug tu sku 'khrugs nas nyi ma kha shas kyi ring sku gzugs ma bde ba chen po byung bar sku 'bum tshogs chen du mang ja grwa tshang so sor grwa ja'i thog zhabs brtan yang mang po bsgrubs/ nyin cig glo bur du thugs 'tshub pa'i rnam pas rje rang nyid kyis 'jigs byed dang chos rgyal gsung nas drug cu pa zhig bsngo ba gnang bas phyi nyin nas bsnyung gzhi lhag med du dwangs/ de skabs zhal nas kha sang nyin mo nyams snang dang rmi lam 'dris mar ri zhig gi srib ngos nas sngags rgan zhig gis dar nag g.yab cing nga'i ming nas smos te dgug gzhug dang dmod bcol byed kyin 'dug pa dmodabacol gyi tshig ma dag pa'i mthar thug pa zhig snang bas nga'i sems la khyod rang ma mtha' dmod bcol gyi tshig sgra dag pa zhig bton nas nga la byad byas na chog pa la snyam pa byung / de mthu byang kyi ltas yin pa 'dra gang ltar yangangs drug cu pa zhig 'phangs pa des 'thus yod lhag pa'i rim 'gro 'dra sgrub mi dgos gsung / rje nyid ni thun mong ba ltar na'ang gnod pas brdzi ba 668
