༄/ /rjebatsug bzangachosakyi ga gsasagatsarumadakhamasarakamed nyid dang / zhes sgom lam gyi byed par gsungs pa lta bu dang thun mong ma yin pa ltar na 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lha la sdigs par byed cing chos skyong bran du 'khol ba zhig la mi bsrun pa'i skye bo rnams kyis glags rnyed pa'i go skabs ga la yod/ 'on kyang sngags nag 'ug pa sbos pa lta bu de dag snga ma'i las ngan gyi lan chags 'khor bas skye bo re gnyis la mthu gtang re byas pa lam du song bas nus ldan du rlom zhing rnyed bkur dang chags sdang gis dbyen spyos pa'i dbang gis rje 'di la'ang mngon spyod kyi las byed khul bgyis pa ni rdo rje'i brag la tsher mas bsnun pa'am wa skyes kyis glang po la stobs 'gran pa'i lo rgyus 'dul ba lung las 'byung ba bzhin rang gi bsod nams dang khengs dregs lhan cig tu brlag pa'i rgyur song ste/ nga las nu'i rtogs pa brjod pa las/ de dag ral pa ngo tsha nas/ / sa gzhi la ni 'byar ba bzhin/ / zhes gsungs pa'i dper gyur to/ / dbyar gnas grol nas zla ba brgyad par 'dul ba dgon du phebs te nyin kha shas bzhugs/ bla brang gi tshom chen du thub pa gtso 'khor gsum rigs gsum mgon po slob dpon pad+ma a ti sha rje tsong kha pa bcas lha dgu'i snang brnyan byis pa lo brgyad kyi bong tshod tsam gsar du bzhengs nas gzungs 'jug sogs tshad ldan bsgrubs pa la rab gnas mdor bsdus mdzad/ sku 'bum bla brang phyag mdzod dang spyi gnyer che ba ngo g.yog zhabs phyir 'ongs par bla spyi phan tshun du gzhi byes kyi mgron la chi ge sogs gsol ston rgyas pa dang dgon pa'i dge 'dun rnams la'ang mang ja sku 'gyed rnam bzhag sogs 'tshem med du bstar/ thu'u bkwan mkha' 'gro sogs khyim tshang 'ga' zhig gis gdan drangs pa'i 'dun pa bskangs te dgon lung du byon/ thar ba gling pa'i dpon slob dge 'dun rnams la chos dang mthun pa'i longs spyod 'phel ba'i thabs su phan che bar 669

sa / /gung thang bstan pa'isgroname'i gsung 'bum/dgongs te mgon dkar gyi gter bum sgrub rgyur 7gong ma chen po'i phyag ras la bzhengs pa'i mgon po gzi ldan gyi tsa ka li gsol lder nas gnang ba'i shing thog gi rigs mdzod nas byung ba'i rin po che'i rigs dang gos sna dar sna sogs mdor na sgrub yig las bshad pa'i gter rdzas gang yod ma tshang ba med par 'du byas te rje rang nyid kyis phyag bstar nas bum par bcug pa sogs phyagalen tshad dang ldan pa mdzad/ bla ma sgom pa ngag dbang rab brtan gyi zhal snga nas la thar ba gling du phebs nas gnas byin gyis brlabs pa'i ched du yun ring bzhugs rgyu dang bum pa sgrub pa sogs kyi snyan bskul gnang ste der gdan drangs/ khong gis kyang bka' bzhin du bum sgrub kyi cho ga gnad smin mdzad nas 'du khang gi phugs kyi rtsig pa la khang bu bgyis par bum gter gzhug tshul sogs dam pa'i phyag bzhes bzhin du gnang / lcang skya rdo rje 'chang sku dngos kyis bsgrub pa gnang ba'i klu dbang rgyal po'i bum pa rje nyid la gnang ba zhig yod pa'ang bskyar sgrub mdzad nas klu ldings su klu tho brtsigs pa'i nang du brtan bzhugs sogs cho ga bzhin tshad dang ldan pa gnang ste gnasader lha klu gzhi bdag la gtor ma rgyas pa btang ba'i mjug tu thams cad la zho ston sogs kyi rten 'brel bsgrigs par yul phyogs 'dir med pa'i ma rmos pa'i lo tog tu grags pa 'bul mkhan byung ba 'byung 'gyur gyi rten 'brel phun sum tshogs pa zhig tu mngon/ bod nas ra stod klong rdol bla mas dgongs gzhi can gyi phyag bris dang lhan du tsan dan dkar po las bsgrubs pa'i spyan ras gzigs bcu gcig zhal gyi 'dra sku khru tshad long ba tsan dan dmar po'i mdun cog dang bcas 'bul rgyu bskur gnang ba 'byor par/zhal nas nged rang chung dus nas bod sog gi nang du ma ṇi'i bzlas lung dang khas len bskor ba sogs rgyun ldan byas nas ma ṇi'ang grangs gsog bcug pa 670

sa / /rjebatshun kha nyis gsangabakhu lad+madaganas rākha/yin/ da re sar stod bla mas sku 'dra 'di khyod la bskur ba dgos pa zhig yod gsung 'dug pas dgongs gzhi khyad par can zhig yod par snang gsungs nas dgyes tshor shin tu che ba mdzad/ zla ba dgu pa'i nang du dgon lung nas dpa' rin rgyud pa bla zur dang har chin tho yon 'jam dpal nor bu sogs du mas gsol ba btab pa bzhin zhub po rnams dang ke shu'u zhabs drung horaskyong sku skye sogs dgon pa'i zhabs drung sku skye dka' ram dge tshul slong brgya phrag kha shas la rje nyid kyi gsung 'bum par 'khod yongs rdzogs kyi ljags lung dang / 'jam dbyangs dkar po 'jam dbyangs a ra pa tsa rta mgrin gsang sgrub lcam sring phyag rdor gos sngon rnam sras ser chen mi 'khrugs pa rnams kyi rjes gnang dang 'od dpag med kyi sgom lung gzhan yang 'dod chos thor bu du ma bcas gnang / zla ba bcu par sku 'bum du phebs lnga mchod kyi skabs su chos rje shes rab rgya mtsho'i gtsos pa'i yor du su ba brgya phrag du mas thun mong nas gsol pa btab pa bzhin gser sdong chen mo'i mdun du mchod pa gya nom pa bshams te zhu mkhan rnams kyis thog drangs snun gar thu sa lag chi tshe dbang bsam 'grub ngo g.yog dang a rig mkhan po sogs gzhi byes kyi skya ser stong phrag brgal bar sngon 'gro chung 'bring gi lam la blo sbyong tshul nas bzung sems bskyed pa'i phan yon dang sems bskyed tshul de'i bslab bya sogs kyi bshad pa blo 'khul ba dang bcas sems bskyed mchod pa gnang ste theg mchog rigs kyi sa bon brtas par mdzad/ rgyud pa dpon slob gser ri sprul skus dgongs pa zhus par mi nyag sprul sku rgyud pa'i khri par bsko bzhag mdzad/ su nyid tho yon zhabs drung gis zhus nas nyan mkhan 'ga' zhig la rta mgrin rjes gnang tshar bcu gsum gnang / or du su cin gar pe zi'i ho sho'u nas thu sa lag chi tshe dbang bsam grub bu tho yon bstan 'phel tho yon 671

sa / /gung thang bstan pa'i name'i gsung 'bum/chos rje ye shes tā bla ma 'jigs med ngo g.yog rnams ched gtad kyis 'khrungs skar gyi dga' ston dang bstun nas yong ba yin pas zla ba bcu gcig pa'i tshes bdun 'khrungs skar gyi nyin sbyin bdag thu sa lag chi ngo g.yog gis maṇ+ḍal sku gsung thugs rten gyis sna drangs te gos dar dngul sogs srang stong phrag long ba'i 'bul ba dang / sku 'bum spyi so chen mo dang bshad sgrub gling rgyud pa bla spyi sku rten chos rje dgon lung bla spyi sogs dgon sgrub sde ris med kyi mi sna/khur lug pe zi'i shog gi bla ma khri pa sogs gzhi byes kyi drag zhan spyi sger so so nas kyang rten 'byung gi 'bul tshan mang po spyan lam du bstar te brtan bzhugs kyi rten 'brel dkyus gcig la bsgrigs/ sku 'bum tshogs chen dbu mdzad dang grwa tshang dbu mdzad sogs skad gra pa du mas gnas brtan phyag mchod zhabs brtan gsol 'debs sogs zhal 'don gye rim pa rnams gsung zhing / zi na lha ram pas rje nyid kyi sku skye ba'i phreng bar bstan 'gro'i don rlabs po che mdzad tshul las brtsams pa'i bshad pa rgyas shing 'brel chags pa dang bcas zhabs pad yun du brtan pa'i gsol ba rtse gcig tu btab par thugs dgyes pa'i bka' lan dang zhal bzhes bzang po gnang / a kyā sprul sku rin po che'ang rten 'brel gyi skyes dang bcas mjal phrad zhus sgar pa nas gzhi byes thams cad la ston mo gzabs/ sbyin bdag thu sa lag chi ngo g.yog la rta mgrin rjes gnang tshar mang po dang sgol dkar 'od zer drug sbrags dang mgon po bar chad kun sel gyi rjes gnang tshe dbang brgya rtsa sogs chos bka' dang rkyen sel gyi rim gro gsung brtag sogs gang 'dod dang lha rten byin rten sogs gnang cha gzabs/ khur lug pe zi'i bla ma khri ba rab 'byams pa 'jam dbyangs grags pas zhus pa bzhin don gnyer ba mang po zhig la thugs rjechen po tshem bu lugs kyi dmar khrid stsal/ rgyar tshang sgom pas zhus ngor 672

ra / /rjesadzamagasaza ཿshadasag dam/khong dang gro tshang mkhan po su nyid tho yon zhabs drung hang gin chos rje blo bzang rdo rje sogs don gnyer can rnams la rje btsun mi la'i mgur 'bum dang rnam thar byang sa rgyud bla ma 'byed gnyis dbe+e chos rin chen spungs pa bo'u bum sngon bo'i 'grel pa rgyal sras thogs med kyi bka' 'bum blo sbyong zhen 'khris kun gcod/ hor rgya'i dge slong 'jam dbyangs rab rgyas kyis zhus ngor rgyal dbang lnga pa'i yi dam sgrub skor dang rdo rje sgra dbyangs sogs ljags lung thor bu mang po dang / dgon lung pa hor zhi dka' bcu dang e sen rab 'byams pa gnyis kyis zhus ngor dbyangs can ma dmar mo'i rjes gnang dang de'i sgrub skor gyi lung / hang kin chos rje blo bzang rdo rjes zhus ngor nam mkha' sgo 'byed kyi dbang dang gcod kyi yig cha 'ga' zhig gi lung sogs gzhibyes kyi dam pa'i chos don gnyer can so sos zhus pa'i chos bka' rnam grangs du ma dkyus gcig la stsal te snod ldan mos pa'i yol go chos kyi bdud rtsis yongs su bkang / hal ha'i erti ni chos rje bla mas theg chen gso sbyong gi sdom pa mnos te thon phyag zhus par gnang skyes dang 'phral yun du dge ba'i bslab ston zhib par gnang / bla ma dbu mdzad pā ju'u zhabs drung gis zhus nas nyan mkhan 'ga' zhig la chos rgyal phyi sgrub kyi rjes gnang stsal/ nub gcig mnal lam du a tsa ra lta bu zhig gis nyid la bal bo'i 'khrugs pa bde 'jags su song ba'i bka' drin gtang rag tu chos rgyal nang sgrub kyi gtor chog rgyas pa zhig ljags rtsom gnang dgos zhes pa skul ma zhus pa bzhin de'i gtor chog rgyas pa las bzhi lhun grub ces bya ba zhig phral du gsung rtsom mdzad/de skabs bstan pa spyi'i don thugs la brnag pa thams cad kyis 'phrin bcol dang las sbyor ci rigs mdzad yod pa gzhir bcas pas de'i nang nas kyang rje nyid dam can las la bskul pa'i dmag gi ru 'dren lta bur gyur pa gtan 673

༄/ /yo ba na ba'i me'i skung ཿma/tshigs 'di nyid kyis shes nus shing 'dis mtshon pa'i rje nyid kyi bka' rtsom rnams ni spyir bstan bcos rtsom pa'i rgyu gsum tshang bar ma zad slob dpon a bh+ya dang nag po spyod pa sogs kyi rnam thar bzhin yi dam chos skyong rnams kyis bskul ma btab ste gnang ba byin rlabs mi zad pa'i gter du gyur pa 'ba' zhig yin par gzu bo'i blos brtags na shes par nus so/ / gzhan yang lo 'dir dpal ldan lha mo'i tshes gtor 'bul tshul gyi lag len khrigs chags su bkod pa 'gag med rdo rje'i sgra dbyangs/ rta mgrin gsang sgrub la brten nas lus sbyin byed tshul mgon po phyag drug pa'i rgyas pa'i gtor sgrub bu tshul dgos 'dod kun 'byung klu dang sa bdag gi gnod 'tshe sel thabs bdud rtsi'i bum bzang sogs lag tu blang bde zhing bla ma'i man ngag gis brgyan pa'i bka' rtsom mang du spel/ dgung lo nga bdun pa chu mo gling gi dus bzhi thog ma'i dga' ston la tshogs su phebs nas dge 'dun mang la mjal kha gnang zhing bla spyi phan tshun du lo gsar gyi dga' ston sngar rgyun ltar 'phel/ dgon lungagi rgyud pa bla ma dge gnyer grwa rgan phyag mdzod sogs dgon sde ris med kyi mtshams zhus pa rnams ston mo dang gnang sbyin gyis mgu bar mdzad/ cha har bsam gtan dpon po'i tsha bo dge slong tshe ring tas kha'i lha khang gi tā bla ma dkon mchog dang ha ya gri wa'i lha khang gi ded bla ma tho yon blo bzang 'od zer dang dur bed chos rje thub bstan cang ki dbang po rdo rje sogs so so nas dngos 'bul gya nom pa bstar te brtan bzhugs kyi rten 'brel bsgrigs/de dag dang dbang phyug ja sag ngo g.yog o thog mi rin pañtsa rak+ṣa mi rin thub pa sogs phyogs 'dus kyi 'grul pa spyi sger la snga phyir rta mgrin gsang sgrub dang sgrol ma dkar ljang tshe dpag med spyan ras gzigs phyag rdor gtum khyung seng gdong ma gtso 'khor gsum gdugs dkar zhal phyag yongs rdzogs mgon po 674

༄/ /rjebatsun bzangartsa'i ma ga mapamadananasadabyungakabar chad kun sel drag po sum dril khyung nag 'jam dpal nag po rnams kyi rjes gnang / dga' ldan lha brgya ma'i khrid rgyal dbang bskal bzang rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i sgyung gnas cho ga'i lung sogs 'dod chos dang tshigs snga phyi'ildom pa bka' bsgo gsung brtag sogs gang la gang 'os kyi re ba 'bras ldan du mdzad/ tshes bcu la dur bod thub bstan chos rje dang cha har ded bla mganyis kyis zhus ngor skal ldan nyung 'dus la nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i si ra'i byin rlabs stsal/ ho'u chid gu shri byams pa phun tshogs kyis bskul ngor rta mgrin gsang sgrub kyi rnal 'byor dang 'brel ba'i tshe sgrub kyi gdams pa 'chi med bdud rtsi'i snying po ljags rtsom gnang / brtsi bzhag dang gsung chos smon lam rgyug dang 'cham la gzigs rtog sogs sngar rgyun bzhin mdzad/smonalam grol nas bsgrub bya bcu gsum la dge tshul dang bdun cu brgal ba lhag pa'i tshul khrims kyi bslab pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i dpal la bkod/gnyis pa'i tshes la zi lang gi zhen dpon pos gdan drangs nas bu chung zhig skyabs btsal bar rkyen sel gyi rim gro bsgrubs te srung ba sogs gnang /mkhar gyi nye 'dabs su rgya gar gyi grub chen zhig gi sgrub khang dang sku brnyan yod tshul snga ma nas rtsar gcod kyin yod pa 'di res rtsar chod de der phebs nas zhib mjal mdzad/ de nas dgon lung du phebs dgon lung chos skyong rdo rje 'od ldan dkar bo'i sku khog gsar ba ba yan sku rten 'bras srungs chos skyong la zhus nas thag bcad cing rje nyid nas kyang bka' bsgo dam bzhag lan kha shas gnang ste 'di res sku rten la btsan khang du spos nas sdong rgyu'i bkod khyab mdzad/ bco lnga'i nyin har chin smon lam bla ma'i zhabs drung dang dgon lung gi ngo lon mkhan po'i sku skyes sogs bsgrub bya sum cu so gnyis la rab byung dge tshul ci rigs dang lnga bcu nga bdun dge slong gi sdom pa gnang 675

—༄/ /gung thang bstan ba'i natha'i gsung 'bum/zhingaspyon lam bla ma'i zhabs drung la blo bzang kun dga' bstan 'dzin zhes sogs 'dogs par mdzad/ bkra shis 'khyil nas sku gdung mchod rten gyi rab gnas la gdan drangs pa bzhin nyer bzhi'i nyin dgon lung nas thon mar tshang bla chen la mchod mjal thugs smon mdzad/ ba'i sngon la rtsar bya khyud gi bla ma las sne 'ga' zhig gis thab bsu dang phyir lam gdan 'dren gyi snyan gsan zhus par zhal len gnang / zla ba gsum pa'i mas gnyis la nged dang khri chen dpal ldan grags pa'i sprul pa'i sku sogs dgon pa'i khri gdan zur zhabs drung sku skyes las sne che chung bla brang gi phyag mdzod chos rje sogs zhabs phyi che rim dang bcas rta pa mang pos gser chen chu kha nas chibs bsu dang ho'u sde'i mdar thab bsu zhus/ gling 'dabs su gdugs rgyal mtshan ba dan sogs mchod rdzas sna tshogs pa thogs pa'i dge 'dun nyis stong brgal bas ser sbrengs dang 'bud dkrol gyi rol cha pa tshan gsum spos 'dren sogs kyis mdun bsus te bla brang thub bstan pho brang du babs/ rab gnas kyi chog gra pa rnams sku mdun du bos te rab gnas kyi bkod khyab zhib mor gnang / rje nyid kyis rdo rje slob dpon mdzad nas cho ga grogs lnga bcu skor dngabacas pas nyin gsum gyi ring rab gnas kyi cho ga dge legs rgya mtsho'i char 'be+ebs ltar zhi rgyas kyi sbyin sreg dang bcas legs par bsgrubs/rab gnas dbu btsugs pa'i nyin dbu ha cang bsnyung yang bgegs gtor bskyal ba dang bde sangs kyis song zhes zhal nas gsung / rab gnas grub pa'i nyin bka' drin gtang rag gi yon du bla brang nas kha btags nang mdzod dngul gyi maṇ+ḍal dar tshon sna lnga'i sne 'dogs can gos chen yug bcu snam sprug bcu spos phyags sum cu dngul rta mig ma bzhi gcan gzan gyi pags pa drug zamayug nyi shu chibs pa gcig kyo'u zi'i chibs drel gcig bkra shis pa'i lha 676

/ / ༄tsotshotha4chosami77ga4gsamusamakhasag nardzas bcas phul te rgyud pa bla ma dbu mdzad dkon mchog lhun grub bas skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang yab sras gnyis sku tshe du mar 'brel ba sogs las brtsams te brtan bzhugs kyi bshad pa phul pa'i bka' lan du/ rje thu'u bkwan pa dge dbang chos kyi rgya mtsho de nyid lung rtogs kyi mnga' bdag yin tshul de nyid la sprul sku'i dogs gnas gsum byung tshul rje rang nyid kyi thugs la rje de nyid kyi sprul sku yin snyam pa ga la yod kyang las smon gyi dbang gis rgyal ba rin po che'igasung brtag babs tshul/ 'on kyang rje bla ma de nyid dang 'brel che ba zhigayin thag chod ces sku na phra ba'i dus thog mar mjal tshul/ dbus su phebs nas dge rgan du bsten tshul sogs nas sku ma 'das bar du thugs dang 'gal ba gtan nas byed ma myong tshul/ de'i gnad kyis sku 'das nas kyang sku gdung rin po cher dang por mjal ba nas gdan 'dren pa'i bar dang da lta rabaganas kyi bar rang gis lag len la 'debs rgyu byung bas skal ba bzang sogs thugs dgyes pa'i bka' lan gnang / sku gdung gi mchod 'bul la dngul las bsgrubs pa'i bkra shis rtags brgyad dang bkra shis rdzas brgyad rgyalasrid sna bdun 'dod yon sna lnga dngul gyi 'khor lo rnams phul te thugs ṭ+wāṃdī ༵ rno'a~X dī dide / zhu rgyuṭ+wāṃ gar+sha ༵ rmi ༷hūṃrji dīrje ṭ+wāṃ ༷ṭ+wāṃ rdoXtram̐ dh+ri/ga dadī pa khri zur bsod nams dbang rgyal nas rje 'di snga ma dbus su bzhugs skabs kyang bla ma byams pa rin po che'i bu chen gyi khrod na byang chub bde lam gyi bka' babs lta bur rtsi ba yin/ slar byang chub bde lam gyi bka' chos gnang mkhan khong 'dra ba zhig mdo dbus gang nas kyang rnyed mi yong bas da res chos chos bdag rang la zhu dgos zhes gros mgo bton pa bzhin nged cag kun gyis rtse gcig tu gsol ba btab par dgyes bzhin zhal gyis bzhes te 'du khang 677

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'ithoname'i gsung 'bum/chen mor khri gdan zur zhabs drung sku skye dka' ram dge ba'i bshes gnyen du mas gtsos dge 'dun bgres gzhon bar ma thams cad gcig kyang ma lus pa lta bu'i chos nyan pa sum stong du nye ba la nyin bdun gyi ring bde lam gyi khrid sngags dang 'brel ba'i chos drug thun mong ma yin pa dang sprags nas gnang bas mchog dman bar gsum thams cad kyis dad pa'i spu long g.yo zhing thal mospyi gtsug tu sbyor ba byung / chos kyi nyi ma srid gsum 'gro ba'i mig /chos kyi dga' ston 'od stong 'gyed pa yis/ / chos 'dod pad+ma'i dga' tshal phye ba na/ / chos bzang lha yi mdun sa bzhin du mdzes/ / legs bshad gter brgya grol ba khyod kyi mgrin/ / sgra don mtshungs pa'i longs spyod 'khor lo ste/ lung rigs gtam gyis dbul ba'i blun rmongs kyi/ / mgrin pa'i rtsa 'khor mu to'i dra phad yin/ / skyes bu gsum gyi lam bzang bgrod pa kun/ /rigs pa'i lam nas drangs shing sngon med kyi/ / nyams 'gyur ro bda'i snyan ngag glur len pa/ / shārnyi de ba'i zhal dang khyod nyid tsam/ / zhes pa'ang rang bzhin brjod pas ched du brjod pa yin no/ / de skabs nyin gcig zhal nas da nangs zhog ka bshad pa byed pa'i zhor la nged rang gnyid song bas bshad pa yagapo yong sa med/ skabs der rmi lam la skyabs mgon de nyid dang nged rang rnam gnyis kyis lhung bzed sog gur gyi che chung tsam zhig gi nang du chu blugs nas dkrugs te kha nas me tog mdog dbyibs che chung ma nges pa sna tshogs 'char ba byung gsung / 'di la thun mong ma yin pa'i che ba bla na med pa zhig dpag tu yod tshod du snang yang gya tshoms su bshad mi nus pa/ thun mong ba ltar na'ang 'gro mgon 'phags pas/ thos pa rgya mtsho'i mchod yon kun nas 'khyil/ / yon tan me tog dad pa spos chu'i mtsho/ / zhes pa lta bu'i dge mtshan gyi ltas ngo mtshar ba zhig yin par sems so/ / de skabs chos 678

sa / /che btsun tshazangama'i mi d+mams/ramakha'esakanyan pa rnams kyis bltas tshod la chos thun der dus rgyun dang mi 'dra bar gsung gi gdangs cung zad 'jam pa zhig byung ba ma gtogs bshad pa'i bab sogs la khyad par cung zad kyang ma byung / mjug tu grwa tshang spyi 'dus kyi brtan bzhugs thog nged nas zhabs brtan gyi bshad pa zhus par dgyes pa'i zhal bzhes bzang po gnang / thos bsam gling gi slob gnyer pa rnams la bgro gleng gtong bcug nas gzigs rtog mdzad cing slob gnyer bya ba'i dgos pa dang phan yon mang du gsung nas slar slob gnyer la hur skyed gnang dgos kyi bslab ston zhib par gnang / dgon pa'i don du gsung brtag zhus par byang phyogs su stobs po che'i gzungs mang du bzhugs dud 'dul mchod rten zhig bzhengs lo re bzhin rta mgrin gyi bye bsnyen gtor zlog dang bcas chag med bsgrubs na dam sri'i gnod pa zhig yod pa zhi 'gro gsungs pa ltar bsgrubs pas don mthun byung bar ma zad mchod rten 'di ma cig gi lung bstan du'ang yod pas/ sngon thod spyon bsam 'grub tu 'khrungs pa'i tshe ma cig rang gis ji ltar gsungs pa thugs la dran par gdon mi za'o/ /snga phyir bla sprul dka' ram che gras mang nyung ci rigs la nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i siskyo ra'i byin rlabs/ bskyed rdzogs kyi khrid 'pho khrid chos skor mang po'i lung mgon po'i bo'u bum gyi nang nas khrid gang bzhugs zhal shes phyag khrid dang bcas pa/ rta mgrin gsang sgrub kyi rjes gnang gzhan yang chos tshan thor bu mngapo'i ljags lung bcas dang hor tshang gser khri rin po ches zhus nas lha mo'i thun mong ma yin pa'i rjes gnang sogs stsal/ bla brang chen mor sprul sku rin po che 'khrul med myur gsal gyi rim gror sgol ma maṇ+ḍal bzhi pa'i cho ga gsungs shing spyan dmigs nan tan mdzad/ nged rang skabs skabs su gzugs phung cung zad mi bde ba zhig yod pa snga sor skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang 679

༄/ /gung thang bstanapa'isgroname'i ཿnga ཿma/de nyid nas 'jigs byed kyi sbyin sreg gcig gnang ba phyin chad re zhig bde yang skabs 'dir cung zad 'phar bzhin pa'i ched du rta mgrin gyi sbyin sreg cig zhus pa brtse bas gzigs te bro nad kyi zug rngu drangs nas byung bas bka' drin bla na med par gyur/ bar skabs shig tu thar ba rtser phebs nas gzigs rtog dang dbe+en pa la dgyes pa'i nyams mgur dang gsung gleng du ma mdzad/ bzhugs ring la gzhi byes kyi mjal ba mang po'i 'du 'dzi che na'ang sangs bar rnams su phyag dpe gzigs pa dang bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams dang chos kyi 'bel gtam rgya cher 'phel/ bla brang gi zhabs phyi pa rnamasal spyi sger gyi bslab ston zhal bkod zhib rgyas gnang ste nyer gsum gyi nyin ja thab chibs skyel dang bcas phyir chibs na bsgyur/ rgan bya'i thang du hor tshang gser khri rin po che brag dkar gyi rgyud pa grwa tshang gi las sne dang bcas phebs nas thab bsu zhus grwa tshang du'ang mang 'gyed bskur/ phan tshun phebs lam du ka mdo dgon grong gcus 'khor dgon grong nyi ma lung dgon yon mchod rnams kyis bsu skyel ja thab gsol ston 'bul nod lam ngan par dka' spyad kyis phebs byams khur ba sogs bkur ste yang dag dang /bi'i mdo dgon grong dang ba yan gong 'gab sogs kyis kyang lam nas ja thab 'bul ba zhus/ nyid nas dgon so sor mang 'gyed dang skye pho mo'i khrom tshogs so sor sangs rgyas kyi mtshan dang byams pas dam bcas pa'i gzungs ma ṇi'i bzlas lung bsngo smon gyi mtshams sbyor bcas chag med du stsal/ kho tshe dpon po sogs 'byor ldan 'ga' zhig gis khyim du gdan drangs par khrus dbang dang 'dod chos sogs kyis tshim par mdzad/ skya yi'i mdar gdong 'jug mkhan pos gzhis gar gdan drangs nas gsol tshigs zhus shing gsung gleng 'phel/ de nas bya khyung gi rta bsu thab bsu dge 'dun mang po'i ser 680

/ /rjebatsug bzangachos nyima'igagangagasamapacadagarazadabyungakasprengs dang bcas wa shul bla brang du babs te nyin gsum bzhugs/ mkhan pos gtsos bla spyi sgar ba so so nas shangs len gsol ston gzab rgyas zhus/sa ga zla ba'i tshes gcig la tshogs dbus su gdan drangs te spyi nas brtan bzhugs kyi rten 'brel bsgrigs bla sprul dka' ram du mas gtsos dge 'dun tshangamar bla ma'i rnal 'byor dga' ldan lha brgya ma'i khrid chos thun yun ring gcig la gzab bshad gnang bar thams cad kyis yid phrogs nas 'don cha'i rim pa'ang gsar rtsom gnang dgos zhus pa bzhin bla ma'i rnal 'byor dngos grub char 'be+ebs zhes bya ba zhig phral du ljags rtsom gnang / sngar rje nyid nas 'bul sdud kyi dka' tham gnang ba sogs mgon 'dren mdzad par brten rgyud pa'i 'du khang gsar du legs par grub 'dug par byams pa chos legs kyis mdzad pa'i shis brjod phun tshogs dge dpal ma gdang snyan pos gsungs te bkra shis kyi me tog char du bsnyil bar mdzad/ zhal nas shis brjod 'di bton na long spyod 'phel pa'i rten 'brel gyi gnad yod par gsungs 'dug ces phebs/ wa shul bla brang gi tshom chen nas chos nyan pa sumabargya skor la nam mkha' sgo 'byed kyi dbang rta mgrin gsang sgrub kyi rjes gnang yon tan gzhir gyur ma dang gtor ma brgya rtsi'i khrid lung gsar rtsom bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang bde gsang gnyis kyi rtsa rgyud sogs ljags lung du ma gnang / wa shul bla brang du theg chen chos kyi pho brang zhes ming 'dogs par mdzad/ tshogs chen dang rgyud pa grwa tshang so sor mang 'gyed 'bul ba gzab rgyas zhus/ lha khang so sor mchod mjal dang gser gdung lha khang du brgya mchod thog mchod rten la snyan shal 'dod gsol can phul te mdun du yun ring tsam bzhugs nas thugs dam spyan dmigs gnang / rdi tsha nang so sogasagacan rong gnyis kyi mchod gzhi'i mjal ba drag zhan shin tu mang po 681

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/byung bar mjal kha dang lngags bsngo skyabs 'jug sogs 'dod mos ltar gnang / de nas tshe rug dpon po dang khyung kya 'phags pa skyabs sogs kyis khyim du gdan drangs pa'i don mdzad de tshes lnga la sku 'bum du 'byor/gser ri sprul sku sogs zhu mkhan so so'i ngor don gnyer can mang tsam la bde mchog dkar po'i rjes gnang dang 'jam dbyangs dkar po'i sgrub thabs skor sogs lngags lung mang po gnang / snga ma nas hwang zi sgang la ri khrod cig 'debs rgyu'i thugs dgongs yod steng dgon pa'i che gras 'ga' zhig nas kyang gnas gzigs gnang dgos kyi mthun 'gyur zhus pa bzhin sa ga zla ba'i bco lnga'i nyin gro tshang mkhan po dang sku 'bum tshogs chen dge bskos spyi gnyer tsho ba drug gi rgan pa sogs slob ma mang po dang bcas hwang zi sgang du phebs nas gnas gzigs mdzad cing gzhi bdag la dkar gtor bsngos/ gro tshang mkhan pos bka' chos shig gnang dgos tshul zhus pa bzhin rten 'brel gyi khyad du dgongs nas gnas der tshogs pa mang po la bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang lam gyi gtso bo rnam gsum gyi khrid lung stsal te lam gyi rtsa ba bshes gnyen bsten tshul dang bsten nas gang la blo sbyong ba ste lam gyi rim pa'i nyams len cha tshang mthar phyin pa'i rten 'brel phun sum tshogs pa bsgrigs/ gnas kyi ming la dga' ldan chos sdings zhes 'dogs pa gnang / bya khyung gi ka phug zhabs drung la lto 'phye'i thig 'debs rgyu dang bla brang gi phyag mdzod gnyer pa la sgom khang phral du rgyag rgyu'i zhal bkod mdzad/ sku 'bum du sngar bka' 'gyur gyi lung rgyun med pas lung rgyun khungs dag cig byung na bstan pa yun du gnas pa'i rten 'brel gyi sgo dang byin rlabs kyi tshan kha che bar gzigs te bkra shis 'khyil nas bka' 'gyur pa dge bshes 'jigs med rab rgyas gdan drangs pa nyid dang lhan du 'ongs yod pas 'di nyin bla brang chen mor gro tshang 682

༄/ /rjebatsugablob4chosakyinyima'ig4gagamapabadakurasadabyunganadapon slob rgyar tshang ri khrod pa dge bshes ngag dbang nyi ma zi na lha ram pa bsod nams bstan 'dzin gon gyu zhabs drung ke kyā zhabs drung sogs sku 'bum pa dang / bya khyung gi ka phug zhabs drung dang dka' ram 'ga' zhig dgon lung sogs phyogs nas 'ongs pa bcas gzhi byes kyi dge 'dun pa lnga brgya tsam la rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur ro cog yongs rdzogs kyi lung mnyan du 'jug pa'i dbu btsugs par bla brang nas thog ma'i rten 'brel du bla mar kha btags nang mdzod dang dngul srang bco lnga'i maṇ+ḍal chos nyan pa rnams la kha btags kyi 'gyed phul/ lung grub kyi bar du bla ma'i gsol ba dang mjug gi 'bul ba phyogs nas chos nyan du 'ongs pa'i grwa rkyang mang po la gnas tshang dang gsol chas gnang ba sogs 'chad nyan de skor gyi mthun rkyen sbyor dngos rjes kyi rim pa thams cad nyid nas bka' drin bskyangs te bstan 'gro spyi la sman pa'i dge legs kyi sa bon grung po 'debs par mdzad/ a kyu hu thog thu rgya nag tu 'byon nye bar gsol ston phebs rdzong dang thugs nang gshin pa'i bslab ston zhu ba gnang / bzhi pa'i smon lam sngar rgyun bzhin bsgrubs te dgon lung du byon/ bla ma sgom pa ngag dbang rab brtan gye zhal snga nas da dung thar pa gling du bzhugs yod par de ga'i dge 'dun tshogs yongs la byang chub lam gyi rim pa bde lam gyi dmar khrid nyin bdun sogs khrid lung du ma dang / phyogs de'i ser skya thams cad kyi phyag skor gyi yul du mchod rten che ba zhig bzhengs rtsis kyis dgon pa'i gling 'dabs su gnas gzigs dang bka' gdams pa'i phyag bzhes bzhin mdo sde bskal bzang sgogs pa dang /bla ma rang nas byang chub kyi sems sbyong ba dang gcod kyi spyan dmigs sogs kyi sgo nas gnas 'dul ba dang mchod rten gyi seng khri'i nang du gzhug rgyu'i gnod sbyin 'khor lo tshogs bdag 'khor lo rnams sgrub rgyu srog shing dang stod smad 683

༄/ /gung thang bstan ba'ithoname'i gsung 'bum/bar gsum gyi gzungs kyi skor sku brnyan gsung rab byin rten sna tshogs gter bum bang mdzod kyi rdzas sogs la rab gnas tshad ldan bcas zhu ba mdzad cing /sbyin bdag hrun gar thu sa lag chi tshe dbang bsam 'grub kyis gser zangs las bsgrubs pa'i gdugs char khebs nyi zla tog bcas dang nang so blo bzang dga' blos kyang zhal 'debs phran bu sbyar zhing / gzhan cha rkyen thams cad rje rang gis sbyor ba gnang ste chos 'khor dang dar dpyangs sgo rgyan bum pa'i steng gi gyo mog rnams kha dog dkar ser ljang gu ci rigs kyi rtsi can dang gzhan rnams so phag brdar ba'i srub rdo zhos sbyar ba'i rung ba dang / nang gzhug tu rnam rgyal gzungs ring 'bum ther gyis mtshon ring bsrel rnam bzhis phyur bur gtams pa'i rnam rgyal mchod rten thog tshad gsum tsam pa dngos dag bsgrub par mdzad/ o thog tā pe li'i gzugs gzhi ma bde bar ched gtad kyis btang ba'i mi sna dem chi mkhas mchog ngo g.yog 'byor par brtag lan dang phyag sman srung ba sogs gzabs/ dbyar gye ring 'dir skyedatshal du bzhugs nas gtso cher lcang skya rin po che'i rnam thar lcags rtsom mdzad/ sngar nas rgyal yag dgon gsar dge tshogs gling dang zhwa dmar bras dgon sogs su 'byon rgyu'i zhal len gnang ba ltar zla ba bdun pa'i tshes bcu gnyis kyi nyin skyed tshal nas thon te rim gyis chibs bskyod/ zab lung gi rgya tig tsho ba'i mi rnams kyis rtsa ring nas chibs bsu dang thab bsu zhus tshogs pa rnams la phyag dbang dang sangs rgyas kyi mtshan byams pas dam bcas pa'i gzungs ma ṇi'i bzlas lung bsngo smon sogs rgyas par gnang /der sngo kho phyag mdzod ngag dbang lhun grub sogs mchod rten thang gi gdan 'dren pa byung / de nas rdo dkar ri khrod du ser sbrengs dang bcas babs rgya tig zhabs drung gtsos pa'i ri khrod pa rnams kyis bsnyen bkur dang ri khrod rje 684

sa / /rjebatsun thazangartsamadzamanyis ga bdakurartsamasabyungakanyid la mgo 'bul zhus ri khrod pa rnams la 'dod chos dang mang 'gyed gnang /stobs tshang tsho bas rgya thang nas thab bsu zhus par phyag dbang chos 'brel sngar nyin ltar mdzad/ zhwa dmar dgon gyi gdan 'dren pa skya ser kha shas dang mchod rten thang gi chibs bsu pa khri zur bsod nams dpal bzang gtsos las sne dka' ram mang po rnams rim gyis 'byor/ 'ju lag gi zam khar dgon pa'i grwa ba mang pos phyag g.yog zhus te zam pa thon gling 'dabs nas ser sprengs dang bcas bco lnga'i nyin mchod rten thang bkra shis dar rgyas gling du 'byor/ tshogs dbur gdan drangs nas zhabs brtan dang dge 'dun mang gis phyag dbang chos 'brel zhus dgon par mang ja dang bla spyir 'bul ba 'du khang steng du gser zangs kyi galjir che legs kyi 'jog pa gnang /mtshan mo gza' 'dzin byung bar dmigs bsal gye thugs dam mdzad rgyun par yang gza' 'dzin nam byung res bzhin dmigs bsal gyi thugs dam la nan tan chen po mdzad pa zhig yod pa ni/ rang byung rdo rje'i nang don las/srogablung dkar dmar spyor ba na/ /zla nyi 'dzin par snang ba dang / /zhes pa ltar phyi nang gi rten 'brel mthun tshul dang / de'i dbang gis dge ba'i 'gyurakhyad 'byung ba dus 'khor sogs bla med kyi rgyud sde du ma'i dgongs pa yin zhing / gsang ba spyi rgyud las kyang / nyi ma zla ba gzas zin dang / /ya mtshan che ltas byung ba dang / / cho 'phrul gyi ni zla ba la/ / bsgrims te dkyil 'khor bri bar bya/ /zhes shin tu 'phel che ba'i dus khyad par ba yin par gsungs so/ /'bri gu dgon pa'i khri ba ba za zhabs drung las sne 'ga' zhig dang bcas te gdan 'dren du 'byor te me thur brgyud nas phebs/'bri gu ri dgon gyis chibs bsu thab bsus bsnyen bkur zhus/ 'bri gu dgon par chu 'jigs chen po byung ba'i skabs yin pas dgon mchod gzhis 685

༄/ /gung thangabastan pa'isgroname'igasung 'bum/nas dgon pa gnas gzhi gsar par spor dgos min gyi thugs brtag zhus par spor dgos tshul gsungs/ dgon par phebs pa'i lam zhor du dgon mchod gzhis nas dgon pa spo rgyu'i gnas ston dgos tshul bzhin sum mdo zer ba'i sa char gnas gzigs dang byin rlabs mdzad cing / gnas 'dir spos nas phyogs bzhir rgyal tho dang 'du khang nang du sa'i snying po'i thang ga bzhengs na legs lam che tshul dang / spor dus bgegs 'tshub cung zad che na'ang rim gro sgrub rgyu'i rim pa 'di dang 'di gyis zhes zhal bkod zhib par gnang zhing ba za zhabs drung la rmi ltas gsang lung 'ga' zhig kyang gsung /rje nyid snga ma 'dir phebs dus shig la phyor rtsang slob chung ngag dbang dar rgyas sogs dgon pa'i rgan pa 'ga' zhig la khyed tsho'i dgon pa gnas 'dir yun ring chags dka' ba 'dra gsungs par/ khong tshos 'o na gnas gang 'dra zhig la spor na bzang zhes gnas ming 'ga' zhig smos pa la gad pa yod sa zhig la spor na bzang mod ces zhal rtsed lta bu gsungs pa da lta'i gnas 'di lung bstan pa yin 'dug ces thams cad kyis gleng / rgya yag dgon mchod gzhi'i chibs bsu dang po skya ser brgyad cu skor 'byor 'bri gu dgon du ser sbrengasakyis mdun bsus te ba za bla brang du babs/ ba za zhabs drung dang gzhan spyi bla brang sgar ba so so nas gsol ston bsnyen bkur zhus shing dge 'dun mang la phyag dbang gnang / rgyag rung stod pa dang rgya yag gi thab bsu bcas rgyag rung du babs phyogs 'dus kyi mjal ba mang po la phyag dbang dmigs brtse ma sogs dang sangs rgyas kyi mtshan ma ṇi'i bzlas lung bsngo smon dang bcas gnang / dgon lung khri zur bde rgu dar rgyas rgya mtsho'i sprul sku dang mkhan po zhabs drung ngo g.yog mjal bar slebs/ shing lung gi la thon nas rgya yag dgon pa'i bla ma hū kyā chos rje dang las sne sogs chibs bsu ba 686

༄/ / chabatsun thazang bas labadakanas rākhanamang tsam dang stag lung sprul sku rin po che 'khrungs yul du phebs yod pa khong dpon g.yog dang gzhan yang yul mi drag gzhan mang po'i chibs bsu rim par 'byor/ dun dkar du zhag bab thog stag lung sprul sku rin po ches dkar spro dang 'bul nod zhus shing gsung gleng 'phel sprul skus zhus ngor khong dpon g.yog dang der tshogs pa'i mjal ba thun mong du rten 'brel bstod pa'i lngags lung gnang / sprul skus dbu ma 'jug pa'i dpe cha zhig phul bar rten 'brel 'grigs byung gsung nas thugs mnyes mdzad/ gser khri sprul sku'i yab gu ru tshe ring gzugs gzhi ma bde bar khrus dbang dang bar do'i 'phrang sgrol gyi lung sogs gnang / zhwa dmar dgon pa'i brarti zhabs drung ngo g.yog gis chibs bsu zhus rim gyis rta pa brgya phrag mang po'i bsu ba thab bsu dge 'dun gye ser sprengs dar 'phyar dung 'bud sogs rten 'brel gang legs kyis nyi shu gcig gi nyin dgon gsar dge tshogs gling du phyag phebs/bla brang gi tshom du dkar spro'i thog hor dgon pa'i slob chung dang las sne nags yangs dgon gyi bla zur 'dan ma zhabs drung slob chung gra rgan sogs phyogs 'grul mang tsam gyis mjal phyag zhus/ a lag shā wang gi mi sna ja lang mi 'gyur ngo g.yog 'byor nas mtshams zhu phul nyin gnyis gsum la char ba che bar brten thugs brel gzhan med pas stag lung sprul sku dang nags yangs dgon 'og ma'i 'dan ma bla ma sogs don gnyer can rnams la nyid kyi bka' 'bum nas ljags lung du ma gnang / dgon pa'i g.yon phyogs kyi ri gdong duganas bdag gi lha tho brtsigs par rab gnas dang gzhi bdag gi gsol mchod kyang gsar bsgrig mdzad/ nyi shu drug skar ma bzang bas 'du khang gsar ba rten dang brten par bcas pa la rab gnas mdzad de phun sum tshogs pa'i dge mtshan gyi snang bas khyab par mdzad/ dgon mchod gzhis 687

༄/ /gung thang bstan ba'ithoname'i gsung 'bum/dang bcas pas rab ston rgyas pa'i thog dngul gyi maṇ+ḍal ba btags sku gsung thugs rten gos dar zam ras rta nor dung tshe sogs 'bul tshan brgya phrag mang po brtan bzhugs lugs su phul/ rje nyid nas dge 'dun tshogs par mang ja sku 'gyed kha btags phor ba dung tshe khron re bla spyi so sor tshan grangs bcas gnang / or tsho tā pan dor zhi dgon rnams kyi bla ma las sne rnams rim pas 'byor cing so so'i dgon du gdan 'dren gyi snyan gsan zhus par lam zhor yin pas zhal len gnang / hor dang nags yangs dgon pa gnyis kyis gdan 'dren nan che na'ang slar 'byon rgyu'i zhal len dang mang ja spyi 'jog sogs gnang / stag lung sprul skus gtsos phyogs nas 'dus pa'i bla ma dka' ram mang po dang bcas dgon yon mchod kyi ser skya stong phrag brgal bar bstan pa'i 'jug sgo skyabs 'gro'i khrid go bde la don zab cing blo 'khul ba'igazab bshad chos thun shin tu ring po zhig gi yun du stsal/ dgon pa gsar btsugs yin gshis slar chos srid 'phel rgyas kyi ched du dgongs nas nyid dngos kyis chos ra'i dbus su khams gsum dbang sdud rig byed lha mo'i dbang gi sbyin sreg gnad smin sgrub par mdzad cing mtshan ltas sogs shin tu legs pa byung gsung / bsgrub bya gnyis la rab byung dang sum cu so drug la dge tshul nyi shu rtsa bzhi la bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa 'bog par mdzad/ zla ba brgyad pa'i tshes gcig gi nyin rten 'brel gyi gnad du dgongs nas rje nyid chos khrir bzhugs te 'dzin grwa so sor brtsi bzhag btang ba'i mjug tu dam bca' tshugs te rje nyid bzhengs nas sems bskyed dang chos 'khor gyi bgro gleng gnang zhing sku tshab hu kyā chos rje la'ang bgro glang gtong du bcug /mngon rtogs rgyan dang 'jug pa gnyis dbon slob tshang mas 'ur 'don byas te mjug tu bstan 'bar ma gsung nas phan bde'i 'byung gnas thub bstan 688

༄/ /rjebatsug bzabachosaminyima'igayogs pad+madakarasadabyungakarin po che 'phel zhing rgyas pa'i rten 'brel phun sum tshogs pa sgrig par mdzad/zhal nas/ rgyan 'jug gnyis bgres gzhon tshang mar zhal mnyam gsung rgyu 'dug pas sems dga' ba byung gsungs/ rje nyid bya khyung sku 'bum dgon lungagasum gyi 'chad nyan skabs bzhes pa'i bla gos rten 'brel gyi khyad kyis dgon pa'i rten gras su 'jog pa gnang / phyi nyin tshogs dbur phebs nas lam rim chen mo'i mgo nas sho lo ka gsum gyi gsung bshad gnang ste mjug slar gnang rgyu'i zhal len dang dge 'dun la sgrig lam skor gyi tshogs gtam rgyas pa gnad phig cing btsan brjid che ba zhig snyan 'bul mdzad/ stag lung sbrul skus gtsos nyan mkhan mang tsam la phyag rdor gtum po khyung lnga'i rjes gnang yang stsal/ gra gshag so sor gdan drangs te 'dod chos ci rigs zhus pa dang 'byor 'khos dang bstun pa'i bsnyen bkur zhu mkhan mang du byung /skabs shig skyo sangs kyi tshul du rgyab ri'i rtse dang gling skor la phebs nas gnas gzigs mdzad cing mdun ri dang nye ba'i shar lho'i spang ljongs la bzhugs nasaganas 'dir lta ba mi gcig pa rnams kyi mgo gnon du mchod rten zhig bzhengs na bzang ba 'dug ces gsungs 'dug kyang stag lung sprul skus thugs smon ltar ci la mi 'grub ces zhus pa tsam las gzhan sus kyang snang rtags ma byas par lus 'dug / bzhugs ring la phyogs tha dad nas mjal mi ser skya drag zhan shin tu mang po byung bar phyag dbang chos 'brel gyis tshim par mdzad/ tshes bzhi'i nyin dge tshogs gling nas rta thab dang bcas thon phebs lam du zhwa dmar dgon pa'i las sne dad chen hu bcas rta pa brgya phrag tsam gyis chibs bsu zhus/ bod yul ri khrod dge 'phel du thab bsu ser sprengs dang bcas phebs gzhi byes kyi ser skya mang po la dzam dkar 'brug zhon lha lnga'i rjes gnang stsal 'du khang nyid nas 'bub thebs sbyar te gsar 689

༄/ /gung thang bstan ba'ithoname'i gsung 'bum/bsgrubs mdzad par bkra shis kyi me tog char du bsnyil/ khong tshos bsnyen bkur gzabs shing phar yang mang 'gyed 'jog pa sogs gnang phyi nyin lam bar du thab bsu dang ja zhu mkhan mang bas sa srib cing na bun 'thib ste char babs pa sogs phebs dka' ba zhig la or tsho dgon pa'i nye 'dabs kyi sgar thog tu mtshan phyed tsam la babs/ zhal nas/ snga mo zhig 'dir bgrod skabs kyang da res ji lta ba bzhin byung bas bom sngon zer ba'i ril gnas pa'i gzhi bdag de ma rung ba zhig yin 'dra zhing klu'i rigs su gtogs pa zhig yin nam snyam gsung / phyi nyin bcag mal mdzad or tsho dgon gyis 'du khang du gdan drangs te skya ser gyi tshogs pa la skyabs khrid mdor bsdus stsal tshur gsol ston 'bul nod dang phar mang 'gyed sogs gnang / rab rgyas dgon gyi gdan 'dren pa rab 'byams pa brtson 'grus ngo g.yog 'byor nas snyan gsan phul/ de nas tā pan dgon pa'i rta thab ser sbrengs dang bcas dgon pa'i nye 'dabs sgar thog tu zhag mal mdzad tshogs dbur gdan drangs te 'bul nod btegs shing tshogs par dga' ldan lha brgya ma'i gzab khrid dang mang 'gyed sogs gnang / dgon pa'i khri pa rgya rdog bla ma mkhas grub bstan 'dzin gtsos pa'i las sne rnams kyis 'du khang rnying skyon che ba gsar bzo'i mgo 'dren gnang dgos kyi gsol ba btab par zhal len dang dkar dzigs phon che tsam stsal/ grwa khang so so nas gdan 'dren thog dbang bskur sogs 'dod chos zhu mkhan mang po'i re ba bskangs/ zhal nas/mdang rmi ltas ngo mtshar ba 'ga' zhig byung ba gnas 'di'i gzhi bdag sprul lcag can gyi 'phrul yin par 'dug gsungs/ de nas dor zhi dgon pa'i bla ma las sne sogs ser skya du ma'i chibs bsu dang ser sbrengs kyis mdun bsus te sgar bar gdan drangs zhabs drung rab byung bsgrubs shing gsol ston 690

༄/ /rdzob〈khus4cho minyimachag4gtso'imadabamig na'abul ba gzabs/ grwa khang kha shas su 'dod chos thor bu 'ga' zhig dang 'du khang du skya ser gyi tshogs pa mang por thugs rje chen po'i rjes gnang phyag dbang bcas stsal/ dgon mchod gzhis nas gsol ston 'bul ba zhus dgon par mang 'gyed spyi 'jog gnang / de nas phebs lam du zhwa dmar dgon pa'i bla ma las sne sogs skya ser mang po'i chibs bsu ja thab dang khyim tshang 'ga' zhig gis khrus dbang zhus/ tshes bcu'i nyin mchod rdzas thogs pa'i dge 'dun mang po'i ser sbrengs dang bcas bras bla brang gong mar phyag babs te nyin kha shas bzhugs/ sngar nyid nas dgon pa'i 'dzin bdag gnang yod pa dgongs pa gtsang zhus gnang yod kyang slar yang dge 'dun mang ma mchod gzhis dang bcas pas mgrin gcig gis dgon pa'i 'dzin bdag dang sku tshab slob chung sogs sngar rgyun bzhin 'jog pa gnang dgos zhes gsol ba btab pa bzhin bras zhabs drung slob chung la bskos/ 'du khang du skya ser gyi tshogs pa stong phrag brgal bar rta mgrin gsang sgrub kyi rjes gnang dang spyan ras gzigs snying po don gsum gyi khrid gnang dgon mchod gzhis nas gsol ston 'bul ba gzab rgyas zhus dge tshul dang bsnyen rdzogs bsgrub bya sum cu skor la sdom pa gnang / 'bri gung nang so dang rab rgyas dgon gyi spyi gnyer ngo g.yog gdan 'dren du 'byor don bzhin zhal bzhes mdzad/ nyin rer skye pho mo'i tshogs pa mang po la phyag dbang dang bka' chos dkyus ma bka' bsgo ljags bsngo sogs 'dod pa tshim par stsal/ grwa gshag dang mchod gzhi'i khyim tshang spyi sger nas gsol ja dang 'bul ba 'degs mkhan mang du byung zhing de dag la'ang 'dod chos gsung brtag sogs rang rang gi re ba'i 'bras bu don smin mdzad/ bco lnga'i nyin de nas thon te 'khrungs gnas kyi khang shul du sgar btab nas dge mtshan spel chog gnang 691

༄/ /yo thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/thog mtsho ba'i rgan bu rnams 'byor nas gdan 'dren gyi snyad gsan phul bar lam zhor min kyang khyed tshos mjal stabs yag po 'grigs 'dug pas yong rgyu'i khas len byed ces gsungs pa ni sngar sku bltams pa'i dge mtshan gyi yul der yul mi rnams gdan 'dren du 'ong ba ltar sku phreng rjes ma'ang der thugs rje gzigs pa 'bab pa'i brdar mngon la gzigs pa lnga las yul la gzigs pa yin par sems so/ / de nas ja zhus mjal ba mang po dang bcas rim gyis phebs nas ge der gu'i thang du sgar phab dus brarti dang rgyal tshang tsho ba gnyis sa don zhig la rtsod pa byung nas sngar rgya dpon mang pos thag ma chod par yod pa phan tshun so sor gsung bkod gnang ste 'dum par mdzad cing chod yig sogs bzhag / dge bsnyen gzi brjid 'phags kyi lha gsol la spyan gzigs lab tser phebs te gsol mchod dbang bstod sogs mdzad cing dge bsnyen gye gsol mchod rgyas pa zhig gsar rtsom gyi dbu btsugs/mchod gzhis rnams kyis bza' bca' btung ba'i rigs kyi tshogs bshams gzhon nu rnams glu len myur 'gro rnams pang 'gran pa sogs dga' ston phun sum tshogs pa ngoms bzhin du rdo lung nas zhag gcig bzhugs/ phyi nyin ja zhus pa mang po'i don mdzad cing sku rten chos rje'i khang bar tshogs pa mang po la thugs rje chen po'i rjes gnang dang sgyung gnas kyi cho ga'i ljags lung gnang /de nas zhwa dmar dang bri gung gi mchod gzhis khyim tshang sum cu lhag la rim gyes phebs nas spyi sger gyi re ba don ldan mdzad cing 'bri gung zhabs drung gnyisanang so bcas ser skya brgya phrag du mas chibs bsu ring thung thab bsu ser sprengs dang bcas bla brang gong du babs nas nyin gsum bzhugs/'du khang du zhabs drung rnam gnyis kyis gtsos bla ma dge 'dun mchod gzhis bcas ser skya'i khrom chen por skyabs 'gro'i khrid chos thun gcig la stsal 692

sa / /rjebatsun bzang gsangabs pabadaganas sbranganadagon mchod gzhis nas gsol ston dang 'bul ba spam mtho ba phul/ bla brang gsham dang dob tshang bla rgan sogs gdan 'dren 'ga' zhig la 'dod chosadang 'bri gung dang stag lung gi mchod gzhis mjal pa mang du 'dus pa rnams phyag dbang chos 'brel gyis tshim par mdzad/ rab rgyas dgon gyi brarti zhabs drung gis gtsos rta pa brgya skor gyis bde chen thang nas phebs bsu dang dkar thar gzhung dang phyugs lung du bla spyi so so'i thab bsu gling 'dabs nas ser sbrengs dang bcas sgar ba la babs/ nyin kha shas bzhugs te grwa khang 'ga' zhig tu 'dod chos ci rigs dang 'du khang du zhabs drung gtsos pa'i ser skya thams cad la rta mgrin gsang sgrub kyi rjes gnang bla ma mchod pa dang rgyal ba bskal bzang rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i sgyung gnas cho ga'i lung bcas stsal/ bsgrub bya gnyis rab byung dang nyi shu rtsa gcig bsnyen par rdzogs par mdzad/ nyin gcig yar klung dgon bar rje drung mkhan pos gdan drangs pa bzhin phebs lam du rje drung dpon g.yog sum cu skor dang dgon pa'i bla ma las sne rnams rim gyis chibs bsu dang thab bsu zhus/ dob tshang bla brang du gsol tshigs thog rgyun ring tsam bzhugs nas bslab ston rgyas pa mdzad/rjedrung dang dgon pa'i grwa rgan rnams nang phan tshun cung zad ma mthun par yod pa la nyid nas bslab bya gsung bkod gnang ste zhe mthun par mdzad slar rab rgyas dgon du phyag phebs yar klung gi dge tshul slong sgrub mkhan drug byung bar sdom pa gnang / zla ba dgu pa'i mas bzhi'i nyin rab rgyas dgon nas mā tsho bar gdan drangs pa'i lam du brarti gnas bdag skyabs kyis gdan drangs nas bsnyen bkur zhus pas khyod rang sngar gnas bdag la skyabs btsal ba yin 'dug pas deng phyin chad dkon mchog la skyabs btsal na bzang gsung nas dkon mchog skyabs zhes ming brjes te phan bde ma lus pa'i 'byung 693

༄/ /gung bang bstanapa'i sgroname' gsung 'bum/gnas dkon mchog rin po ches rjes su 'dzin pa'i rten 'brel gyi sgo 'phar phye/'di ni sngon bka' gdams kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po byang chub bzang po sku na phra mo'i dus zhog pa chen po dang mjal te nga'i ming zhang skyabs 'di dkon mchog skyabs su bsgyur bar zhu byas pas khong shin tu mnyes te khyod bskyab par ma zad spel ba zhig yong bas ming la dkon mchog spel gyis gsungs pa dang cha 'dra zhing sku 'phreng rjes ma'i rigs rus cho 'brang sogs la'ang gzigs pa yin par the tshom med do/ / dob tshang sgar bas kyang gsol ja zhus mā tsho bar nyin gcig bzhugs te spyi sger so sos bsnyen bkur gzabs shing 'dod don zhus pa'i re ba bskangs/ de dus gdan 'dren pa ha cang mang du byung bar rang yul du mgyogs par 'byon rgyu'i rang bskul gyi tshigs 'ga' thol byung du gnang ba ni 'di ltar/ ston mjug shar ba'i me tog spang rgyan khyod/ / dkon mchog mchod gral myur du ma snyegs pas/ / glo bur grang reg ba mos bcom gyur na/ / dbyibs legs bkrag mdangs mtshar ba don med yin/ / tshe mthar slebs pa'i ban rgan se bo khyod/ / 'dun ma chos la myur du ma dril par/ / glo bur 'chi bdag gshin rjes bcom gyur na/ / dal 'byor mi lus thob pa don med yin/ / dus kyis gdugs tshe dud 'gro khrung khrung yang / / yul gzhan snyogs na ban rgan se bo khyod/ / da dung rang yul mi snyegs 'brog sde'i khrod/ / khyi bzhin nyul nas 'dug pa 'thad dam soms/ / zhes pa'o/ / phyi nyin dob tshang tsho ba'i ja thab dang bcas rim gyis bar zhag gnyis kyis mchod rten thang du 'byor/ dgu pa'i smon lam gyi skabs dang bstun tshes brgyad kyi nyin gsung chos la phebs te byang chub lam rim gyi mgo nas gsung chos gnang smon lam yon bdag gis rang 'byor dang bstun pa'i 'bul ba btegs/ de nyid 'ju lag gi chu'i tshur kha sngon stong 694

sa / /rjebatsun thazang gagangags lad+mar nartsa tshur/skor mdo rgyud rgya mtshos dug chu zhig la bdud rtsi'i ming btags pa nas chu de khrag mkhris kyi nad la sman du gyur pa'i chu mig yod pa sman thang zer par zhag bzhugs mdzad par mtshan phyed tsam la gang nas bsgrags ma nges pa'i dung chen dang gling bu bsgrags pa'i sgra mngon sum pa zhig gsan tshul zhabs sdod 'ga' zhig la gsungs 'dug pa'ang dus gsum mkhyen pa'i brda thabs dang rten 'brel gyi che ba zhig tu mngon/ 'brog khyim mang por dbang bskur zhus pa'i re ba bskangs te bcu gnyis kyi nyin skyed tshal yid dga' chos 'phel du phyag phebs/ rje 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa rin po che'i dgongs rdzogs pa stong 'khor dka' bcu bod nas phyir slebs te mjal khar 'ongs pa la dgongs rdzog ji ltar bsgrub pa'i skor las brtsams te bod kyi gnas tshul zhib 'dri gnang bas gsung bshad kyis thugs g.yeng nas mtshan ril por gsung mtshams gtan nas ma mdzad pa la sku mdun pas dka' bcu la brda brgyab ste kho phyir thon/ nyid nas khyed tsho brel don ci yod da dung 'dri rgyu mang po yod pa la gsung par zhal 'don chag dogs nas kho la brda brgyab pa yin da zhal 'don gnang dgos sam zhus pas nga rang gi kha ton bshad zhor gnyid zhor du 'don rgyu'i kha ton yin pas ci 'dra'i brel ba che na'ang chad mi 'gro/ 'du 'dzi'i spros pa bcad nas kha 'don byed rgyu'i bsod nams ni nga la med pa mngon sum gyes mthong bzhin pa 'di yin mod gsungs pa ni/ rje mi las/da res 'ga' 'gro zhing 'gro zhing bsgom/ / gsungs pa lta bu rtogs pa klong du gyurapa'i rnam thar dpag dka' ba zhig go/ de bzhin du phyis sog yul du phebs skabs kyang mo phywa mkhan gcig gis sku don la mo btab nas tshes bcu'i mchod pa'am zhal 'don gal chen zhig chad yod pa 'dra zhus 'dug par/zhal nas khos nged rang sog po'i yul du 'du 'dzis g.yeng ba 'di mthong nas 695

༄/ /gung thangabastan pa'izlaname'i gsung 'bum/'dil tshes bcu phar zhog kha 'don phran tshegs kyang ga 'dra yin bsams te tshod tshod kyis bshad pa yin 'dug kyang rnam rtog za nged rang gi tshes bcu dang kha ton ci la 'chad ces gsungs/ rje 'di ba gzhi byes gang du bzhugs kyang bltas tshod la nyin re bzhin bka' chos dang phyag sman gsung brtag phyag dbang zhu mi sogs chu'i gnyer ma bzhin gcig rjes gcig non bar ma chad pa'i thugs brel gyis dus 'da' zhing sangs par cung zad re byung ba la dpe gzigs zhal 'don gsung rtsom gsum gyi sa bcad yin kyang / gtso bo dpe gzigs la thugs gzhol bas dgun gyi mtshan mo dkar me'i ngos la mtshan ril por dpe gzigs kho na dang dge bshes slob gnyer can rnams kyis mjal na chos kyi 'bel gtam kho na gnang ba zhig yin pas phal ba'i snang ngor zhal 'don gnang ba'i sa khungs med pa lta bu yin kyang / phyis su zhing gzhan du dgongs pa gtad dus nged rang bro 'tshal nas kha ton tshang ma mi spyogs pas 'ga' zhig khyed tsho la re zhig gtang gsungs nas sku'i bcar sdod pa kha shas la mdo klog dang bzlas sgom gtor 'bul gzungs sngags grangs bcad can mang po zhig bkram nas gnang ba phal pas spros pa thams cad bcad nas nyin mtshan kun tu de kho na bton kyang mi thub pa'i tshod kyi zhal 'don de lta bu 'dug ces sku drung na 'khod pa rnams gleng / 'di ni bu ston gyi rnam thar du zhal 'don gnang ba la bltas na sku tshe hril por de kho na mdzad pa lta bu bka' chos gnang ba dang gsung rtsom mdzad pa sogs la bltas na'ang de dang de kho na mdzad pa lta bu rnal 'byor pa'i che ba bsam mi khyab kyi gnas su bshad pa dang 'dra zhing / kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pas kyang nyi ma thang pas dpe gzigs rang la gtso bor mdzad tshul gyi rnam thar gsungs te rtogs pa mtho ba'i bsngags brjod gnang ba bzhin 'phags chen dam pa rnams ched du 696

༄/ /༄tso thangachosami7thag4ga yamadakhamasang/brjod pa'i gnas su gyur pa zhig yin par snang ngo / / dka' bcus bod kyi yige 'ga' zhig phul par rwa stod bla ma rin po che'i zhu shog nang du phran tshe 'phos ma thag tu byang shamabha la lta bu sngags bla med der sa zhig tu skye ba'i smon lam zhu zhu zhes 'dug par dus kyi mtha' 'dir rwa stod dpon slob lta bu re gnyis tsam zhig gis bstan 'gro'i srog 'dzin dgos pa la khong gi gsung gi dbyibs kyang de tsam mi legs pa 'dug gsung nas thugs skyo ba'i rnam pa mdzad/ mang 'dus ri khrod kyi 'du khang nyid nas 'bub thebs dang bkod pa gnang ste gsar bsgrub mdzad pas der phebs nas gzigs rtog mdzad cing grub ston du dge 'dun la ja 'byed kyi gsol ras gnang / zla ba bcu pa'i nang du sku 'bum du phebs lnga mchod kyi skabs stod smad kyi sog 'grul brgya phrag du ma spyi sger so so nas 'dod chos zhus pa'i re ba bskong bar mdzad/snga ma zhig zhabs phyi ba sbyin pa rgya mtshos sku mdun du mjal khar phyin nas phyag 'tshal dus nyid bzhugs 'dug pa la phyag dbang zhu rag la mi snang bar gyur pas kho rang ha thang nas phyir thon de ma thag nyid nas 'bod pa gnang ste rgyu mtshan dris bar nyid mi snang bar gyur nas ma mthong tshul zhus pas bka' bkyon gyis tshar bcad/ da res kyang nyin gcig bcar sdod ba chos 'phel gyes sku mdun du song nas nyid bzhugs 'dug pa ma mthong bar bzhugs gnas gzhan rnams su 'tshol dgos pa byung zhing gzhan zhig gis de'i rgyu mtshan zhus par kho rang 'ongs nas lta nyul zhig byas te phyir thon song ba min nam nga mi 'dug par gang la 'gro rgyu yin ces bkyon/ sman pa dpon slob gro tshang mkhan pos de gsan nas gzhan gyi rnam thar du de 'dra la sgyu lus thob par gsungs yod pas rnam thar sa bon du 'god dgos zhes drung yig la nan gyis gsungs snang / snga phyir de 'dra lan mang po byung 'dug cing dbyar skyed 697

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'ithoname'i gsung 'bum/ tshal du bzhugs dus kyang skabs 'ga' zhig tu phyag g.yog pa rnams la dus thog gcig tu gnas tha dad ba du mar sku re bzhugs pa'i snang ba mi 'dra ba re 'char ba dang der ma zad gsung bshad dang chos bshad la'ang skabs 'gar zhabs phyi ba dang slob ma tshos nyan lugs mi 'dra ba re byung ste rang rang gi mthong thos kyi snang ba bden par bzung nas 'then khyer byed pa'ang mang du byung ste/ sngon gyi rgyal dang rgyal sras chen po rnams kyi rnam thar du byung ba las da lta gtam du'ang cher mi grags pa lta bu'i gnas so/ / zla ba bcu gcig pa'i tshes bdun 'khrungs skar gyi nyin sbyin bdag tson gar pe zi tshe dbang bkra shis thu sa lag chi tshe dbang bsam 'grub gnyis kyi mi sna gnyer ba dge legs ngo g.yog gis dngos 'bul gya nom pa dang sku 'bum bla spyi drug dgon lung bla spyi sogs dgon sgrub sde 'ga' zhig gi mi sna rnams nas kyang tshan grangs bstar te brtan bzhugs kyi rten 'brel bsgrigs/ sku 'bum gyi mkhan khri'i dgongs pa snga ma nas lan gnyis zhus par bla sprul dge 'dun thams cad kyesanan tan chen pos gsol ba btab nas bshol ba yin kyang da res nyid nas dgongs zhu'i mang ja btang ste thugs thag rbad chod kyis dgongs pa gtsang zhus mdzad/ thams cad kyis da dung lo kha shas bzhugs dgos kyi gsolab nan tan btab kyang dgung lo bgres pa dang sku gzugs rgyun du mi bde ba sogs kyi gnas tshul rnams zhib rgyas gsung bas kun kyang bya thabs zad nas dgongs pa phul/ khri ba gsar ba zan dril bsgyur nas gro tshang mkhan po bsko bzhag dang zi na ltaram pa bsod nams bstan 'dzin sman pa bla mar bsko bzhag mdzad/ tshes bcu la sman pa gra tshang gi tshogs dbur gdan drangs nas 'du khang gsar sgrub la nyid nas 'bul sdud kyi bka' shog dang bkod khyab sogs mthun rkyen mdzad pa'i lags 'bul gyi zhabs brtan phul/698

༄/ /rjebatsug bzangachosakyi nyima'ig4gas7pad+madakarasadabyungakargyar tshang sgom pas zhus ngor gro tshang mkhan po dang khong rnam gnyis la lcang skya rol pa'i rdo rje'i gsung bka' rgya'i gras grub chen dril bu lugs kyi 'khor lo sdom pa lus dkyil gyi dmar khrid zhal shes bde chen gsal sgon sogs sngar ma gnang ba'i skor le tshan brgyad tsam gyi ljags lung stsal/ khams nags shod stag phu sprul sku rin po cher lo snga mar lung zhu phul ba'i phyir phebs su khong la yi dam mkha' 'gros lung bstan pa'i tshigs bcad ngo ma bris nas bskur ba gnang bar chos rgyal ma sho ka yi skye ba'i mtha'/ / zhes sogs rje nyid kyi sngon gyi byung ba dang sku tshe 'di'i dgung lo'i tshad dang sku gegs ji ltar yod tshul dang de dag bzlog thabs kyi rim gro dang bcas pa yang dag pa'i zhing gang la smon lam btab na legs tshul zhus pa la thugs bzhed dang bstun nas dag pa'i zhing gang du gsol ba btab kyang khyad par med/ 'on kyang sngon gyi las 'brel che ba lcang lo can gyi zhing khams yin pas yi dam yang phyag na rdo rje gtso bor bsten nas zhing khams der gsol ba btab na legs tshul gsung 'dug par sngar nas hwang zi snang gi sgom khang gsar bar bcad rgya zhig mdzad 'dun yod pa bzhin de gar phebs te zhag bdun mtshams la bzhugs nas phyag rdor gtumakhyung gi bsnyen pa gnang zhor du gnas 'dul dang phyis kyi dge spyor ba rnams la bar chad mi 'jug pa'i spyan dmigs nan tan mdzad pas mnal lam du rgya dpon 'ga' zhig gis dang por tho 'tsham pa dang rjes sor phyag 'tshal nas lha dar bcas mjal kha zhus pa zhig mis pa rgyal po'i lhong tshad dang tshar tshad lta bu zhig yin nam gsung / de nas ri khrod kyi gzim chung du rgya rtsadasgom pa blo bzang rgyal mtshan sdod bcug nas ji srid bzhugs kyi bar cha rkyen du 'bab pa'i 'tshog chas sgar ba nas spyor bar mdzad/ rje nyid sku 'bum gyi mkhan khrir bzhugs ring la bstan pa'i bya ba ji ltar mdzad pa'i sdom 699

༄/ /yo thang bstanapa'ithoname'i gsung 'bum/tshig rag bsdus tsam gnang ba ni 'di ltar/ dharma badz+ra zhes bya'i snyoms las pa/ / mkhas dang grub pa'i grags pa mi ldan yang / / bla ma'i byin rlabs snying la zhugs pa'i mthus/ / rgyal ba'i bstan la bya ba cung zad bgyis/ / blo bzang rgyal ba gnyis pa tsong kha pa'i/ / mdo sngags chos kyi nyi ma 'od po che/ / skal ldan gdul bya'i yid kyi mkha' dbyings su/ / rnam dpyod rta lngang shing rtas nyin bzhin drangs/ / 'dul mdzod dbu phar 'chad nyan nyi zer gyis/ / blo gsal blo yi pad tshal rgyas byas shing / / snyan rgyud gdams pa zab mo'i sbrang rtsi yis/ / snod ldan bung ba'i tshogs rnams tshim par bgyis/khyad par gsung rab kun gyi snying po mchog / skyes bu gsum gyi lam gyi rim pa ni/ / bshad yam tsam min nyams len dmar khrid du/ / bstan bas thar 'dod du ma'i re ba bskangs/ / bod du 'gyur ro cog gi rgyal ba'i bka'/rgyal ba gnyis pa'i gsung rab rin po che/ / rol pa'i rdo rje'i gsung 'bum bcas pa yi/ / klag lung skal ldan rnams kyi rna bar bsgrags/ / bsgrub bya bsnyen bar rdzogs pa dge slong gi / dngos po don gnyer brgya phrag mang po la/ / gsol gzhi'i las kyi sgo nas spong ba bdun/ / 'khor dang bcas pa'i sdom pa legs par phog / mang thos sgrub la gzhol rnams bste gnas su/ /'du 'dzis dben pa'i sa 'dzin nyams dga'i spor/ / sgrub sde dga' ldan chos sdengs gsar btsugs te/ / gnas 'dul byas shing chos kyi mthun rkyen sbyar/ / zhes pa'o/ / stag phu rin po che'i lung bstan la babs pa'i rim gro rnams sku 'bum dang dgon lung sogs dgon sgrub sde du mar bsgrubs shing bla brang du'ang bla ma sgom pas sgol dkar gyi dur ba'i sbyin sreg 'bum ther gnang ba sogs sgrub pa khag 'ga' btsugs nas rim gro stobs chen mang po bsgrubs/'dim bod du slob gnyer la 'gro mkhan mdo smad kyi dgon chen 'ga' zhig 700

༄/ /༄tsotshothazangachosaminyi g.yogatso'id+madakarazabs/dang khyad par du sku 'bum dang dgon lung gnyis nas bod sog gi grwa rgyun mang po zhig lam yig med par bod du thon song bar lha sa'i am bhan gyis 7gong marasnyan sgron dang 7gong nas zi ling am bhan la bka' babs te am bhan nasatsar gcod kyi yi ge byung bar/ de sngon tsam du bal po'i sde gzar la brten nas 7gong nas cur gān gyi lam yig med par bod du song mi chog pa'i drilabasgrags yod pa dang skabs der bla ma ser mo la'ang gegs chag mang po byungaba'i dus yin pas rje nyid nas kyang thog mar cung zad thugs tshab pa'i rnam pa bstan na'ang / rjes nas zhabs phyi pa rnams kyis da res kyi bya ba ci 'dra yong mi shes pas nyid nas thugs dam brtag pa gnang ste rim gro 'dra sgrub dgos sam zhus par/ zhal nas brtag pa 'dra mi dgos thams cad kyi rim gror sgol ma 'bum ther zhig bton na phyir 'di la brten nas phyin chad mjal ba gnyom chung tshor ji 'dra byed rgyu'i srol bzang po zhig btod yod shas che gsung nas thar ba gling du mang 'gyed bskur te bstan 'gro spyi'i rim gror sgrol ma 'bum ther gnad smin bsgrubs/ rje nyid nas am bhan la 'di ga'i dgon pa gnyis la rtsar byas pas slob gnyer don du gnyer mkhan gyi bod sog gi grwa rkyang gnyom chung 'ga' zhig lugs srol mi shes stabs kyis lam yig med par thon song ba bden par 'dug ces pa sogs thabs mkhas kyi zhu ba gnang bar am bhan gyis kyang 7gong mar de lugs kyi snyan sgron phul ba'i phyir phebs la phyin chad bod du 'gro mi bcu yan chad rang rang gi sa cha'i dpon por rgyu mtshanago bcug nas lam yig med par song chog pa'i bka' bzang po zhig babs pa 'dug pas snga ma'i gsung de lung bstan 'khrul med du kun gyis nges pa rnyed/ 'dis mtshon rgya nag dang bod kyi bya bzhag rnams gsung gi zhor du re gnyis gsungs pa thams cad thog tu khel ba mang po yod 'dug kyang ma bris/701

༄/ /gungajang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/lo snga mar rgyal ba yab sras la phul ba'i zhu shog 'char can 'phar ma so so'i lan 'byor zin pa yin kyang da res de dag las zur du gzhung gi gsol dpon chen mo'i yi ge dang lhan du rgyal ba rin po che'i sku mdun nas nang ma'i gnas tshul zhib 'khod kyi bka' shog bstan pa'i gsal byed thu'u bkwan hu thog thu gangagi phyag tu/ deng yang hu thog thu nyid mdo smad bstan 'gro'i mgon du sku'i dkyil 'khor mchog tu dwangs shing gzhan phan 'azin las kyi 'od snang phyogs brgyar grol bzhin pa nas nang ma'i gnas tshul dang / ngos ring por 'tsho ba'i 'dun pa skyed dgos sogs gsung bris dang rten kha btags rgya dngul rta rmig ma bzang gos yug sog lham 'ja' ldan bcas son pa rnams nyams med ji bzhin du 'byor pas yid spro bla med du gyur/ ngos kyang 'du ba snyoms ldan nas rje rgyal ba gnyis pa'i bstan pa rin po che 'di nyid 'dzin skyong spel gsum gyi sri zhu dang 'gro phan gyi lhag bsam che skyed kyi skabs su gnas/bod gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir sa sprel lo nas bzung bstan dgra gor ṣas tshur rgol la brten bstan pa'i gegs chag shin tu che ba'i babs yul de ltar byung song yang 'jam dpal dbyangs 7gong ma bdag po chen bo'i sku'i gzi byin dang dpon dmag grangs kyis mi lang pa'i dpung shugs la brten gor+sha rgyal blon 'bangs dang bcas pa mgo sgur phyag 'tshal gis 7gong ma'i lha 'bangs su tshud grub pas dpon dmag yul nyan rnams kyang pe cing rgyal khab chen por phyir log bskyod grub pa'i skabs bcas bod dbus gtsang bde 'jags skabs su yod/ hu thog thu nyid la 7ngos ring mo nyid nas dang ba chenapo yod kyang da phan mtshams rten sogs zhib cha zhig ma byung 'dug kyang phyin chad nang ma'i gsung 'os rigs nang lugs su yang yang rtsom pa dang /ngos nas kyang nang ma'i zhu 'os rigs byung yang rim bzhin zhu rtsis dang /702

sa / /rje ba 14 mi)khrisa'ig d+ma dgarartsams /slad char yang mdo smad bstan 'gro'i mgon du sku'i dkyil 'khor yun brtan gyi 'phrod bzhes dang 'gro phan gyi mdzad pa thams cad sngar bzhin dgongs skyonganas gsung mchid kyang rim yod zhu/ rten kha btags sku brnyan li ma rin chen ril bu tsha grang rta ri ma dug 'joms dbang ril so so nas rdog bdun re/ 'jam phrugs dmar po legs pa bubs gnyis dang ser po bubs gcig bcas zla tshes bzang po la zhes phebs 'dug par thugs shin tu dgyes shing dad gus kyi rnam pa rgya chen po mdzad/ de phyin chad nas lo rer dkyusas dang nang sbyar gyi gsung shog gnyis re ma chad par phul/ che shos rab 'byams pa 'jam dbyangs dbang rgyal gyis zhus nas don gnyer ba mang po zhig la sgrol dkar bka' babs dgu ldan gyi rjes gnang / bsod nams rdo rje wang yum bcas la so sor 'brang ma dkar mo dang rnam rgyal lha dgu'i rjes gnang stsal/ su nyid g.yas ru'i lā kya zhabs drung dang tho yon chos dar nang so ngag dbang shes rab ngo g.yog gis mjal kha zhus shing dpon g.yog thams cad la bka' chos kyi thog ma tshe dpag med kyi rjes gnang stsal/zhabs drung grwa pa lnga dang bcas dge tshul bsgrubs/ gzhan yang zan khron sngags ram pa su nyid g.yon ru'i rab 'byams pa don yod sogs smad sog dang chos skyong skyabs gung sogs stod sog du ma rang rang gi 'dod chos kyis tshim par mdzad/ zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i tshes drug la tshogs dbus su gdan drangs nas brtan bzhugs kyi rten 'brel bsgrigs te bla spyi khag so so dang bshadasgrub gling rnams nas legs 'bul gya nom pa btegs/ tshogs par mang 'gyed kyang rgyas pa zhus/ dgon lung gi rgyud pa bla ma bla brang phyag mdzod spyi gnyer che ba grwa rgan 'ga' zhig dang sku tsha no mon han ngo g.yog bcas gdan 'dren du slebs no mon han gyis kyang tshogs chen du mang 'gyed zhus/703

༄/ /gung ca bstanapa'izlanalor+yāng 'bum/tshes bcu gcig la sku 'bum nas chib sa bsgyur gnang dus dge 'dun mang gis hwang zi sgang nas chibs skyel zhus thal skad dar 'bod dang bstun chibs ragasakyi zhal phyir slog pa sogs rten 'brel sgo du ma nas bsgregs/ bla spyi drugadang sgar pa khag chen rnams kyi chibs skyel pa byings rnams ja thab bar dang 'ga' zhig zi ling bar du phebs skyel zhus shing / rgyud zur gong ba bla ma bla brang chen mo'i phyag mdzod spyi gnyer che ba rgyud pa dang sman pa bla spyi so so'i gnyer ba ngo g.yog dgon lung bar du zhabs phyir 'brangag mar tshang nas dgon lungakhri ba bde rgu mkhan po gtsos pa'i rta ba mang pos chibs bsu zhus shing gling 'dabs nas mchod rol thogs pa'i dge 'dun mang pos ser sbrengs dkyus ring gis mdun bsus te rten 'brel gang legs kyis tshes bcu gsum la gdan sar babs/ sku 'bum nas chibs skyel du 'ongs pa'i khong rnam pa dpon g.yog la ston mo dang go bab kyi gnang cha mdzad/ su nyid g.yon ru'i wang dpal 'byor yar 'phel gyi mi sna khā u pa shi ngo g.yog 'byor nas wang ma bu dang pe li sogs kyi zhu shog dngos 'bul bcas phul/ wang gi zhu shog nang du lo snga ma rnams su yul phyogs der mu ge than pa chen po byung tshul dang skyabs 'jug zhus yod par mtsho dang chu mig rnams su 'jug rgyu'i sa bcud gso ba'i sman tshad ldan phon che ba dang spyi sger nas rim gro ji ltar sgrub dgos kyi zhal bkod gnang / rong po nas ba'i ba zhabs drung ngag dbang mi pham zla ba rje nyid la bka' chos zhu rgyu'i don du ched gtad kyis phebs par chos kyi gsung sgros mang du 'phel zhing thugs brel che stabs chos bka' mang po slar gnang rgyu'i zhal len mdzad de khong dpon g.yog la nyid kyis mdzad pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi dmigs skor zhal shes khyad par can gyi khrid dang nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i chos tshan 'ga' zhig gi lung bcas stsal/ zhabs drung la jo 704

sa / / bas ngabs muḥbadam pag ba nabo'i chos chung brgya rtsa sogs blo sbyong sna tshogs kyi lung rgyun bzhugs pa sgom chen ngag dbang rab brtan la gsan du 'jug pa mdzad/ cha har mur gu cheg su me'i ta'i ching hu thog thu sku grong ste ched dmigs kyis bsngo rten 'bul mi byung bar ljags bsngo dang yang srid skor gyi brtag lan 'dod pa tshim par stsal/har chin ur the'i dge slong ngag dbang nyi ma dang a lag sha'i tshe dbang thus lag chi'i bum sogs smad srog drag zhan mang po mu mthud byung bar dge slong ngag dbang nyi ma'i skor la nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i dbang dang gzhan spyi sger rnams ljags lung rjes gnang sogs rang rang gi 'dod chos kyis tshim par mdzad/ dgung lo nga brgyad pa shing pho stag gi lo gsar dga' ston dgon lung nas mdzad dgon pa'i cho 'phrul smon lam la yon bdag zur pa med par nyid nas sbyin bdag rnams la ting bskul mdzad de che 'byor chung 'byor gyi zhal 'debs byung ba dngul srang drug brgyar nye bas rgyu yon sbyar te nyin bco lnga'i ring mchod pa dang ja thug gzhung ston grub ston gyi 'gyed khri gdan zur sogs la 'bul ba dang bcas smon lam chen mo legs par bsgrubs/ o thogadaka' bcu blo bzang bkra shis dang mi rin bstan pa bkra shis sogs skya ser brgya lhag gis brtan bzhugs kyi rten 'brel bsgrigs par phyag dbang dang 'dod chos sogs mos pa bzhin du gnang / smon lam grol nas chos bzang ri khrod du phebs te re zhig bcad rgya dam pos zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor la gzhol bar mdzad/ sku 'bum gyi rgyud pa dpon slob mi rtag sprul sku dang gan chen gye 'dan ma sgrul sku mchod rten thang gi slob chung rgyal rdog dgon pa'i bla ma ka mdo'i bla ma rnams rim gyis mjal du 'ongs par lugs gnyis kyi bka' mchid 'phel zhing mdo sngags kyi dri ba mang du zhus pa thams cad lhug par bkrol te dad pa'i sa la bkod/ 'dan ma sprul sku rin po che bod du 705

/ /gung ca bstan pa tshaname'i skung 'bum/'byon rgyur phebs rdzong dang thugs gnyer mdzad lugs kyi bslab ston gnang /bkra shis 'khyil bla brang gi gagol dpon dpal ldan sog yul gyi sbyinabadag rnams kyi mtshams zhur song ba phyir 'byor nas rgyu mtshan 'bul bar 'ongs pa laganas tshul zhib 'dri mdzad/ zhe hor gyi po ta la'i mkhan po rgya tig lha ram pas nang so bstan 'dzin ched mngags gdong nyid la 'bul ba dad dgon lung tshogs chen 'du khang du gser zangs kyi garjir bskur byung bar garjir la gzigs rtog dang gzungs 'jug sogs kyi zhal bkod gnang / thu med gu thi tshe 'phel gyis zhus te spyan ras gzigs tshem bu lugs kyi dmar khrid stsal/ lo snga ma rnams su rgya dmag bshar par brten sa sgo'i dpon pos lung khog gi mchod gzhis la snga dus dang mi 'dra ba'i khral lce mo bzhag pa la khong tshos rje nyid la skyabs btsal zhing nyid nas dpon po che chung rnams la bkod khyab gnang ste khral yang du btang ba yin pas dpyid 'dir lung khog gi grong sde rnams su gdan drangs nas spyi sger gyis mjal kha dang legs 'bul zhus par che phra thams cad la mtshan dang gzungs sngags rna lam du sgrogs pa sogs gsung gi bdud rtsis tshim par mdzad/ rje 'di pa la khral log dang gtam ngan gtug sher sogs kyis gtses pa'i khas nyen 'u thug pa su zhig gis skyabs btsal na'ang de la brten nas rang la mi bde ba byung gis dogs te btang snyoms su 'jog pa mi srid par bkod khyab dang spyan dmigs ci rigs kyis pha rol po de nges par 'jigs pa las thar bar mdzad pa zhig yod 'dug pa ni mi 'jigs pa skyabs kyi sbyin pa la goms pa mthar son pa'i rnam thar du gsal lo/ /zla ba gsum pa'i yar tshes la khran tsong ri khrod pa sogs kyis gdan drangs pa bzhin brarti sku skye dang las sne rnams kyi rta thab dang bcas ri khrod du 706

༄/ /ldebatsun bzang bsrungagag pad+madakurasadabyung/phebs/ brati sku skye gtsos pa'i grwa mang mchod gzhis dang bcas pas rje nyid la ri khrod dang brarti sgar ba'i nang rten rnams 'dzin bdag gnang dgos tshul nan tan zhus pa bzhin bdag gnang rgyu'i zhal bzhes mdzad/ de nas sems nyid sku skye sogs rta thab ser sbrengs dang bcas 'brug lung dgon par phebs te nyin kha shas bzhugs/ tshogs par dga' ldan lha brgya ma'i khrid dang mang 'gyed phyogs 'dus kyi mjal ba mang por mjal kha bcas gnang /thar ba gling gi slob chung dang lcang skya sku skye sogs kyis rta thab dang bkra shis chos gling gi lung pa'i mda' stong sngon bla ma sogs dge 'dun byings kyis mjalakha thar ba gling gi dge 'dun gyis ser sbrengs dang bcas dgon par babs te nyin bcu lhag tsam bzhugs dge 'dun la mang 'gyed 'jog pa gnang / / dgon pa btab pa'i sa cha de snga ma 7gong mar mdzod 'jal ba'i sa cha yin 'dug pas phyin chad mdzod 'jal thebs su sa cha 'ga' zhig a nam spyil gnang nas yig dan bzhag / lo snga ma dgon pa'i grwa pa rnams don med kyi gleng rtsod mi mthun pa byung ba gzhi bdag 'ching sdom gyi 'phrul yin par dgongs nas de'i gsol mchod kyi cho ga 'dod 'jo'i sprin phung dang tshogs 'tshogs skabs sgo dbyangs la snga ma cha bzhag mi 'dug pas rgyud pa gsum gyi bla ma'i gsol 'debs sgo dbyangs ja mchod bkra shis thams cad la sbyar chog pa zhig dang bcas lngags rtsom gnang / zla ba bzhi pa'i tshes la dgon lung du phebasayu rad thu sa lag chi kun dga' gtsos pa'i skya ser brgya lhag thun mong nas gsol ba btab pa bzhin u rang ba dang dgon pa'i don gnyer can bcasaskya ser brgya phrag kha shas la tshe dpag med lha dgu'i dbang chen sta gon dang bcas pa gnang / thu sa lag chi dang de'i bla ma sogs nyung 'dus la mgon po bar chad kun sel dang bla mgon dbyer mid grib sel gsum gyi rjes 707

༄/ /yo thang bstan ba'izlaname'i gsung 'bum/gan snal/ sku 'bum nas su nyid lā kyā zhabs drung nang so bcas dang tho yon chos dar zan khron gu thi rnams bka' chos zhus par 'ongs pa bzhin zhu mkhanarnams dang sku tsha no mon han dgon lung khri sprul li kya zhabs drung ke shu'i zhabs drung mdung nag mā tsha zhabs drung 'brug lung sems nyid sku skye dpa' rin rgyud pa bla zur har chin tho yon 'jam dpal nor bu sogs dgon lung gi dka' ram dge ba'i bshes gnyen dge tshul slong nyis brgya tsam la lcang skya rol pa'i rdo rje'i gsung 'bum yongs rdzogs dang / nyid kyis mdzad pa'i lcang skya rol pa'i rdo rje'i rnam thar rnams kyi ljags lung dang don gnyer ba 'ga' zhig gis zhus ngor nam mkha' sgo 'byed kyi dbang dang stan thog gcig ma'i khrid lung / hal ha dar han pe li'i the yon ngo g.yog gis zhus ngor dur bdag dang gtsug tor 'bar ba 'jam dpal nag po rnam 'joms rnamasakyi rjes gnang dga' ldan lha brgya ma'i khrid rgyas pa dang bcas chos kyi bdud rtsi'i dga' ston rgya cher spel/ lcang skya'i gsung 'bum dang rnam thar gyi lung grub dus dang bstun a kyā hu thog thus bskur ba'i lcang skya rol pa'i rdo rje'i sku thang nyams shin tu dod pa zhig phyag tu 'byor par rten 'brel ma bsgrigs rang 'grigs byung zhes dgyes tshor chen po gnang / slar yang lā kyu zhabs drung dang tho yon chos dar zan khron gu thi nang so ngag dbang shes rab sogs nyung 'dus la rje rang nyid kyi gsung 'bum dpar bkod yongs rdzogs dang lcang skya rol pa'i rdo rje dang nyid rnam gnyis kyi gsung 'bum bka' rgya'i skor gyi lngags lung bka' drin stsal/ thu med do gus su me'i mdzo mo mkhar zhabs drung gi mi sna tā bla ma ngo g.yog 'byor te zhabs drung gis nyid la 'bul bdang dgon lung tshogs chen du mang 'gyed dang spyi 'jog tu ja khra mang po bskur pa rnams phul tā bla ma dpon g.yog la spyan ras gzigs phyag bzhi pa'i 708

༄/ / rdzobatsotshosazangacho migyi gagangagatsosamadakhabag narjes gnang stsal/ su nyid g.yas ru'i zhabs drung kun dga' rnam rgyal gyi mi snag thi thogs med ngo g.yog slebs nas chos rje skal bzang bsam 'grub sku 'das pa'i bsngo rten phul/ chos rje de nyid rje nyid kyi thugs zin gyi slob ma yin pas nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i sbyang chog gi spyan dmigs gnad smin mdzad/chos rje rang nyid kyis btsugs pa'i 'dus tshogs dang / khong la re ltos 'cha' ba'i slob ma dang sbyin bdag rnams snga ma nas skyabs btsal nas gtad gnyer zhus yod ba bzhin da res kyang grwa rigs dang sbyin bdag rnams nas yang bskyar gtad gnyer zhus par zhabs drung kun dga' rnam rgyal gtsos pa'i slob ma dang sbyin bdag rnams la de lugs kyi bslab ston zhal bkod dang byin rten srung ba sogs gzabs nas bskur/ gzhan yang su nyid g.yas ru'i su me thu bla ma ngo g.yog dang las skyabs tha'i ji'i bsngo rten 'bul mi dka'abacu g.yon ru'i tha'i ji bsod nams rab brtan gyi mi sna grwa pa rnams 'byor bar so so'i 'dod pa skong bar mdzad/ gser khog gi chen hu chos rje dpon g.yog mjal du 'ongs par bzhed mos bzhin rta mgrin gsang sgrub kyi rjes gnang stsal/ zla ba lnga pa'i tshes la stag lung sprul sku rin po che bod du chas pa'i lam nas mtshams zhus 'bul mi byung bar mtshams lan 'bul mi btang nas ja thab dang phebs rdzong zhu ba gnang / khran tsong ri khrod pa rnams kyis mgo 'dzul byas pa bzhin skar ma bzang dus shig la ri khrod du byon brti sku skye gtsos pa'i grwa mang dang mchod gzhis rnams kyis bras sgar ba'i nang rten tho dang bcas nyid la rtsis sprod zhus shing ri khrod yang ji srid gnas kyi bar du 'dzin bdag gnang dgos kyi gsol ba btab pa bzhin bdag gir bzhes te phyir byon/ har chin wang gi tho yon sasgo thi tsha bo tho yon dharma ki ti wang gi mi sna khā nye ba har chin gung yul 'khor skyong gi mi sna yem chi don grub rgya mtsho har 709

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'izlaname'i gsung 'bum/chin ja sag ran ke ti'i mi sna mgon po bkra shis ca kher chi po yan thu'i mi sna bi shi re la thu rab 'byams pa har chin smon lam bla ma'i phyag mdzod tho yon dge legs rab rgyas gu thi kun dga' rgyal mtshan dem chi bkra shis phun tshogs/gu bur han thu dang ta lu'i dgon pa gnyis kyi gnyer ba gnyis o'u han khā thu sa lag chi'i tho yon dang thu sa lag chi'i mi sna dge bskos sogs ngo bcu lhag g.yog 'khor bcas glebs nas mjal kha zhus te ho sho'u so so'i bla dpon sbyin bdag grwa rigs rnams kyi zhu shog stong lhag 'degs rten dang bcas phul/sbyin bdag btsun mo maṇi dha ras byams pa'i gos sku che ba rgyu 'gror dngul srang bdun brgya tsam song ba gcig dang ka 'phan cha gsum sogs mchod rdzas 'ga' zhig dbu zhwa gcig dbang chas cha tshang rgya dngul srang sum brgya nya lngags ri mo can bcas dang / sbyin bdag wang mdzi badz+ra sogs ho sho'u so so'i slob ma skya ser drag zhan du mas yul gru mi gcig pa sna tshogs nas thon pa'i nyer spyad khyad mtshar du ma dang gos dar dngul sogs dngos po'i 'bul ba'ang phon chen po byung / byams pa'i gos sku la rab gnas mdzad de byams pas dam bcas pa'i gzungs dang byams smon sogs gsungs nas 'brel ba thogs parnams kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba mtha' dag 'khor gsum yongs su dag pa'i bsngo smon gyi sgo nas bla med byang chub kyi rgyur rgyas 'debs bar mdzad/ gung bstan 'dzin dar rgyas sbyin bdag dad 'dun can zhig yin pa dus las 'das 'dug par dmigs bsal gyi sbyang chog gnad smin gnang ste srid pa'i 'phrangalas bsgral/ tho yon sa rgya thi sogs el chi rnams la sbyor pa'i chos drug dang bla ma'i rnal 'byor don gnyis lhun grub ma'i khrid rta mgrin gsang sgrub kyi rjes gnang ljags lung 'ga' zhig bcas stsal/ de dus ho sho'u so so'i yi ge'i lan rnams bsgrigs pa la bstan pa'i bya ba byed mkhan gyi slob ma 710

sa / / zang bas ngabs labyungamakhag sha nabla chen rnams gzhan phan la bskul ba dang bya ba ma mang bar dge sbyor byed mkhan gyi slob ma ri khrod pa rnams rgyud chos la bskul ba dang / thos bsam byed mkhan gyi slob ma blo gsar pa rnams slob gnyer la bskul ba dang / srid skyongagi dpon blon sbyin bdag nang ma rnams la 'bangs rnams dge ba chu'i khrims kyis skyong bar bskul ba sogs so sor bslab ston zhib rgyas dang chos kyi dogasapa dang lngags rtsom thor bu snyan bskul zhus pa'i dka' ram gu thi yon tan can rnams la de lugs kyi dogs lan dang gsar rtsom/ gang bsam lam du mi 'gro bas yid gdungs pa rnams la dbugs dbyung ba'i bslab ston dang gnad dmigs can gyi rim gro/ nad kyis nyen pa rnams la de lugs kyi phyakospan srung ba dang rkyen sel gyi rim gro/ gdon gyis gtses pa rnams la khyim du mchod rgyu'i rten 'jam dar la gur gum gyis phyag rjes phab nas de'i 'og tu/ bcom ldan rta mchog rol ba'i bka'/ sngags 'chang chos kyi rdo rje'i lung / / rgyal gdon shi gshed dam sri sogs/ / gdug can rnams la bzlo ba ni/ / lung 'di 'chang ba'i sbyin ba'i bdag / mi nor 'khor dang bcas pa rnams/ / rig sngags 'chang ba kho bo yi/ / rdo rje'i srung bar chud zin gye/ / khyed cag gnod cing 'tshe byed na/ / ye shes rdo rje 'bar ba yis/ / mgo bo 'gem par gdon mi za/ de bas bka' las ma 'da' zhig / mahā sa ma ya ha na hūṃ phaṭa ces pa'i bka' shog tham ga can dang /dbul bas nyam thag pa rnams la g.yang mda' la 'dogs rgyu'i phyag mdud rab gnas can dang / rigs rgyud ma yong ba dang ma brtan pas nyam thag pa rnams la de lugs kyi rim gro phab cing 'ga' zhig la bu du yong rgyu'i kha grangs ming dang bcas gsal bar lung bstan pa dang / sri'u skyabs btsal ba rnams la phur mdud srung 'khor ched gtad kyis bsgrubs nas gnang ba 711

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i name'i gsung 'bum/sogs mdor na gang dang gang don du gnyer nas gsol ba btab pa rnams la de dang de'i lan chad lus med par yid tshim par stsal/ 'dis mtshon te rje 'di bas dus nam gyi tshe'ang nyid la re ltos bcas nas lung zhus phul ba rnams la drag zhan dang rgyus yod med la ma ltos par brtse bas gzigs te 'ga' zhig la mnal lam brtag pa dang phal cher la phyag mo zhib tu gnang nas phan thogs nges kyi bka' lan gsal cha can re gnang zhing / zhal nas kyang rang re ltos 'cha' ba rnams kyi zhu rten blangs nas zhus don la snang rtags med par sla chos byas na las 'bras dang mi mthun zhes yang yang gsungs/ yang hor gyi skyam ba dgu pa dang bcu gnyis pa zer ba'i 'jig rten pas grong sde 'ga' zhig tu gnod cing 'tshe ba la ras dar sogs la rdo rje hrī yig gis mtshan pa'i gong 'og tu khro zhal mche gtsigs dkyil du rdo rje'i tha tshig sho lo ka re phyag bris mdzad nas 'jig rten pa de'i gzugs brnyan thang ga lta bu'i steng du thogs gsungs pa bzhin byas pas gnod 'tshe zhi ba dang / su nyid g.yas g.yon phyogs su gshin po 'ga' zhig phan tshun gyi khyim du dngos su 'gro gin yod pa'i mthong snang byung ste khyim tshang rnams su mi shis pa chen po byung ba la'ang nyid nasaphyag rjes dang bka' shog ci rigs gnang bas mi shis pa'i mtshan ma nye bar zhi ba sogs byin rlabs kyi tshan kha 'bur du dod pa'i rnam thar yang ches mang bas re re nas brir ma lang ngo / / tho yon sargya thi sogs el chi sngon la 'thon rgyur sku mdun du ja gral thog tho yon sasgo thi la er ti ni chos rje'i cho lo gnang / sku 'bum mkhan po gro tshang sprul sku mjal khar phebs nas nyin kha shas bzhugs par gsung gleng 'phel/ zla ba bdun pa'i tshes la mang 'dus rikhrod kyi 'du khang tshon rtsi dang bcas grub zin pa dang / slob chung yu kyu chos rjes rang gi dad mos kyis rje nyid kyi 'dra sku sku tshan long ba sman 'dam 712

༄/ / rdzobatsun bzangacho minyis ga4gsumapad+madakurazadabyungakagyis bzhengs nas/ nyid nas gnang ba'i byin rten 'gang che'i rigs kyis mtshonagazungs 'jug tshad ldan gser tshon dang bcas phun sum tshogs par bsgrubs yod pa de dag gi rab gnas la gdan drangs pa bzhin phebs nas rten dang brten par bcas pa la spyan dbye'i chog mdzad de phyir byon/ smon lam bla ma'i phyag mdzod gtsos pa'i grwa pa rnams kyis gza' skar bzang ba'i nyin zhig tu dgon lung tshogs chen la mang 'gyed 'bul ba gya nom pa zhus thog smon lam bla ma'i zhabs drung 'grigs la zhugs/ bla brang du rje nyid kyis gtso mdzad pa'i khri pa bla ma dang rgyud pa bla ma las zur sogs dgon pa'i che rim rnams la bzhugs gral ston mo dang nyid la dngos 'bul sbam mtho ba yab yum la blu yon gzab rgyas bcas rten 'brel gyi sgo dang po bsgrigs/ de nas phyag mdzod dang gu thi gun dga' rgyal mtshan dem chi bkra shis phun tshogs pi shi rel thu rab 'byams pa mgon po bkra shis sogs nyung 'dus la rje btsun nā ro mkha'aspyod ma'i siskyo ra'i byin rlabs skyed rdzogs kyi khrid bcas dang dem chi bkra shis phun tshogs sogs bsgrub bya kha shas la bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa stsal/ja gral thog smon lam bla ma'i phyag mdzod tho yon dge legs rab rgyas la chos rje'i cho lo gnang / rgyal yag slob chung hu kyu chos rje dang mang 'dus slob chung yu kyu chos rje gnyis dgongs pa zhus par rgyal yag slob chung du e sen rab 'byams pa mchog ldan rgya mtsho dang mang 'dus slob chung ngu mā kyā rab 'byams pa ngag dbang bzang po gnyis gtong ba gnang / zla ba brgyad par bla ma sgom pa ngag dbang rab brtan pa'i mdun nas rje nyid sems nyid zhabs drung dang bcas bka' gdams pha chos bu chos bka' gdams gsung bgros thor bu chig lab ring mo khro phu'i snying gtam sum cu phyag rdor nor bus mdzad pa'i phyag rdor gtum chen gyi sgrub thabs be+eg tse'i be'u bum rnams kyi lngags 713
