/ /gung bang bstan ba'i name'i gsung 'bum/lungagasan/ bod nas ra stod bla mas nyid dang bla ma sgom pa rnam gnyis la a ti sha'i sku 'dra re bskur byung ba 'di res pha chos bu chos kyi lung grub dus su 'byor bas rten 'brel ya mtshan ba zhig 'grigs byung zhes rnam pa gnyis kyis thugs dgyes tshor chen po mdzad/ de nas rje nyid nas bla ma sgom pa dang sems nyin zhabs drung rnam gnyis la lcang skya rol ba'i rdo rje'i rnam thar gsar rtsom gyi ljags lung yang gnang / zla ba dgu par mtsho kha'i dbang phyug ja sag 'khor bcas mjal du 'ongs par rta mgrin kyi rjes gnang dang skyabs 'jug gsung brtag sogs bzhed mos ltar gnang 'bul ba'ang gya nom pa btegs/zla ba bcu par bsgrub bya bzhi bcu zhe gnyis la bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa dang gser khri sprul sku la dam can gyi rig gtad dang ljags lung du ma stong 'khor dka' bcu la tshe dbang sogs don gnyer ba rnams la chos bka' du ma gnang /zla ba bcu gcig pa'i tshes gcig la or du su hang kin gu shri chos rje blo bzang rdo rje sogs skya ser sum cu tsam gyis brtan bzhugs kyi rten 'brel bsgrigs te 'dod don zhus pa'i re ba bskangs/ tshes bdun 'khrungs skar gyi dga' stonanyid o thog thu sa lag chi dharma dha tu dang tha'i ji lha dbang rdo rje gza' mi ser skya brgyad cu skor bcas 'byor te dpon po spun gnyis kyis brtan bzhugs kyi rten 'brel bsgrigs nas maṇ+ḍal kha btags sku gsung thugs rten bzhugs gdan rgyab yol gyis ska drangs te gos dngul sogs dngos po'i 'bul ba spam mtho ba phul/ drag zhan tshang mar rta mgrin gsang sgrub kyi rjes gnang dang dpon po gnyis la rta mgrin gsang sgrub kyi sku 'dra rab gnas brgya rtsa ma res mtshon gnang cha gzabs/ gser khri sprul sku phyir 'khor ba dang chabs gcig tu btsun yo ma chis chos phul ba'i byams pa'i gos sku ma thi dgon gyi spyi 'jog tu bskur ba gnang / de nas re zhig gi bar du bcad rgya'i ngos 714

༄/ /rjebatsug ba4chosaminyima'igasangagasu patshadakhamadabyunganathugs dam dang dpe gzigs spel mar gnang / mdung nag gi g.yer khu zhabs drung ngo g.yog slebs par thun mtshams rnams su rta mgrin chos skor gyi ljags lung stsal/ zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i nang du dur bed nang so skal bzang tshul khrims sogs 'byor nas nang sos sngar nad tshabs chen gyis mnar te nyid la skyabs btsal te nad las grol ba'i legs 'bul dang 'dod chos 'ga' zhig zhus/ nang so 'di sngar bod du song nas phyir rang yul 'byor ma thag nad drag pos btab ste rje nyid la gsung brtag zhu mi mngags pa'i lan du khong nas lha rten rnying ba zhig khyer 'ongs tshod 'dug pa de'i phyir bgegs shig 'brang yod 'dug pas de nyid gzhan du spos na legs zhes gsung ba bzhin kho rang gis ngos bzung nas sang nyin gzhan du spo rtsis byas pa'i snga nub lha gur la me shor te rten gsar rnying thams cad chud zos su song bas bka' lung la yid ches lhag par rnyed/ su nyid g.yon ru'i ca khir chi tshe gzungs tsha bo tho yon dang tha'i ji ngo g.yog 'ongs par rta mgrin gsang bsgrub kyi rjes gnang dang khong tsho'i skor khyim tshang bdun gyi phral phugs kyi don rnams nyid la gtad nas skyabs btsal bar de lugs kyi skyabs 'jug dang mchod rgyu'i rten dang srung ba sogs stsal/ gzhan yang su nyid cha har hal ha'i 'grul pa drag zhan du ma mu mthud nas byung bar 'dod chos sogs gang zhus thams cad kyi re ba skong bar mdzad/ hal ha mer gen wang gi ho sho'u'i wang gong ma 'ga' zhig sku tshe ring po ma byung bas da lta'i wang rdo rje skyabs chung dus nas rje nyid la skyabasabatsal bar lo nyer lnga lon rag la skyon med tshul gsungs nas rim gro dang srung ba sogs gnang ba bzhin nyer lnga lon nye bar sems tshab nas brtag zhus bskyar ma phul te skyabs btsal ba la brtag lan dang sku tshe ring po yong rgyu'i zhal bzhes lngags rtsom zhus pa'i tshe bdag mgon po'i gtor chog dang 715

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'ithoname'i gsung 'bum/bcas yid tshim par stsal/ lo 'dir bskul ba po so so'i ngor rta mgon sprags sgrub kyi sgo nas gtor chog bya tshul btsan mdos dang sha brgya bran brgya'i mdos chog 'od ldan dkar po'i gsol mchod kyi cho ga rdo rje rnam 'joms kyi sbyin sreg bslab bya gces pa bco brgyad sogs gsung rtsom thor bu mang du gnang / lo mjug tu u shing mai rin bstan pa sogs mjal ba skya ser brgya dang lnga bcu tsam gleb par rta mgrin gsang sgrub kyi rjes gnang stsal/ dgung lo nga dgu pa shing mo yos kyi lo gsar dga' ba dang po'i nyin hal ha rtsis ram pa chos rje dang cha har bsam gtan dbon po'i tsha bo dge slong tshe ring ngo g.yog gis brtan bzhugs kyi rten 'brel bsgrigs te bsam gtan dpon po dang ho bsnye phun tshogs bcas khyim tshang gsum gyis 'bul ba gya nom pa phul/dgon lung gi cho 'phrul smon lam nyid nas mdung nag gi g.yer khu zhabs drung la rting bskul mdzad pa bzhin khong gis rgyu chas sbyar te bla brang nas khur blangs kyis smon lam chen mo legs par bsgrubs/ o tho ga tha'i ji pa da rang gos dang tha'i ji bsam 'phel tshe ring sogs drag zhan brgya phrag brgal pa la spyi sger so so'i 'dod chos kyis tshim par mdzad/ dur ped nang so skal bzang gi bka' 'gyur la rab gnas mdor bsdus mdzad nang so la dad rten du nyid kyi bzhugasagading dang mgon po'i thang ga byin can bcas gnang / lo gsar gyi tshes gcig nas bsnyung gzhi rnying ba 'phar te hal ha rtsis ram pa chos rjes gsol sman zhus nas cung zad dwangs pa'i skabs yin pas bcu gnyis la dgon lung gi dge 'dun mang gis brtan bzhugs phul te zhabs pad brtan pa'i gsol ba btab/ de nas thu'u bkwan la byon nas bshol zla gnyis pa'i tshes mgo rag la bcad rgya mdzad rtsis ram pa chos rjes kyang gsol sman zhus nas sku mdun du bsdad/ bsnyung gzhi la sman kho nas phan skyed chen po med 716

༄/ /rjebatsotshosazangacho mige g.yogatsolad+madakhasog napar sman pas gtar ga'am me btsa' gang rigs kyi bcos ka dgos pas gtar ga dogs bde'am zhus nas de'i grabs byas pa la mnal lam du lcang skya rin po ches gsang sngags thabs mkhas kye lam la brten nas 'tshang rgya ba la rtsa rlung thig le gsum srog ltar gces dgos pas byed rgyu ma mang na bzang gsung ba zhig rmis/ phyi nyin zhal nas snga ma pe cing du na dus sman pa zhig gis gtar ga phan tshun lab ba'i rgyu mtshan lcang skya rin po cher dgongs bstun zhus par phan shas che'ang khyod la de mi 'gab de bas me thig rang dga' gsungs nas sku dngos kyis me thig gnang ba yin/ de dus kyi gsung dang da res kyi rmilam gnyis don gcig pas gtar kha gtan nas mi rung ba 'dug me thig 'phen rgyu bla mas kyang dgongs pa gnang zhing sngar yang phan myong ba yin pas gal te bcos ka dgos na me thig 'phang chog gsungs pa bzhin byas pas bsnyung gzhi'ang rim gyis gting dag tu song / sku bsnyel skabs bla ma'i bka' drin dran cing thugs rje bskul ba'i gsol 'debs dang dam pa'i chos la sgrub pa byed tshul gyi bslab bya bdud rtsi'i thigs pa rnams nyams myong gi steng nas ljags rtsom mdzad/ 'di skabs bsnyung gzhi ha cang lci mo min yang yun cung zad ring pas dgon lung dang nye 'khor gyi dgon ri khrod rnams su mang ja yang yang btang thog zhabs brtan mang po dang bla brang nang du zhabs brtan zur ba bka' 'gyur dag 'don tshe lha gsum gyi tshe sgrub mgon po'i gtor chen dang gtor sgrub rta mgrin gye bsnyen pa zhi rgyas kyi sbyin sreg dang bcas pa sogs zhabs brtan stobs chen mang po bsgrubs/ mtshams nang du rtsis ram pa chos rje la khros nag lha lnga'i dbang sogs 'dod chos du ma dang sems nyid zhabs drung la lcang skya rol pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa'i nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i bsnyen yigagasang chen bcud kyi thig le dang 'khrul 'khor gyi rnam bshad yig chung 717

༄/ /yo thangabastan pa'isgroname'i gsung 'bum/sogs kyi lngags lung gnang / bshol zla gnyis pa'i yar tshes la dgon lung du phebs thog mar 'dul ba dgon gyi rong po zhabs drung ngo g.yog gis mjal nas brtan bzhugs phul bas rten 'brel 'grigs byung zhes thugs mnyes mdzad/ pā jo'u dgon gyi zhabs drung dbu mdzad spyi gnyer las sne dang bcas 'ongs nas dgon pa'i khrir bzhugs dgos kyi gsol ba nan chen btab pa bzhin zhal len gnang / nem pa'i chi kyā yāmon du gdan drangs pa bzhin tshes brgyad la chibs kha bsgyur lam nas mar tshang bla chen po'i mdun du mchod pa rgya chen po phul te thugs smon nan cher mdzad/ chi kyā dpon po rgan pa dus las 'das par kun rig gi khrus chog gnang gzhi len 'bul ba gzabs/ bya khyung gi gdong mjug mkhan po zhing brje dus rje nyid cis kyang gdan 'dren zhu dgos kyi bkod pa gnang yod pa bzhin dpon chung sogs grwa pa rnams kyis gdan 'dren pa btang ba 'byor te tsha kyā ya mon nas bya khyung du phebs/ mkhan po'i dgongs pa rdzogs ched du 'jigs byed kyi dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod gnang zhing myur 'byon gsol 'debs ljags rtsom mdzad dpon chung sogs nas gzhis len dang 'bul ba gzab rgyas zhus phar yang gdung 'bul phon che ba bstar/ mkhan po zhing gshegs de rje nyid la thugs dad gzhan dang mi 'dra pa'i zhal slob nang ma zhig yin pas rje nyid kyang thugs skyo pa'i rnam pa mdzad cing grwa pa rnams la'ang dbugs dbyung pa'i bslab ston zhal bkod gnang / phyir 'khor te chu bzang du phebs lcang skya mchog gi sprul pa'i sku rin po che rgya nag tu 'byon rgyur mjal phrad dang phebs rdzong gzab rgyas zhus tshur byon te zla ba gsum pa'i tshes la sku tsha no mon han dang bcas thar ba gling du phebs dge 'dun la nyid nas mang 'gyed 'jog pa dang / no mon hanagyis kyang mang 'gyed dang 'du khang gi sran rgyan la gser zangs kyi rnam 718

sa / /rje btsun 'azang ga zla dam partsa cesanabacu dbang ldan cha gcig 'jog pa gnang / pā jo'u dgon pa'i khri 'don mgyogs par gnang dgos kyi gdan 'dren pa nang so grwa rgan bcas dang dgon lung nas dge 'dun mang gis mgyogs par 'byon dgos kyi gdan 'dren du mngags pa'i hu kyā chos rje dang grwa rgan kha shas or du su o thog gi gdan 'dren pa btsun mo dkon mchog tshe ring gi mi sna nang so blo bzang phun tshogs/ sras pe li don grub tshe ring gi mi sna mai rin yon tan dpal dar gling 'dus spyi'i mi sna 'bras ram pa blo bzang yon tan ngo g.yog rnams dang /bkra shis 'khyil gyi gdan 'dren pa gsol dpon dpal ldan rnams rim gyis 'byor par so so'i 'dod mos ltar zhal bzhes gnang ste pā jo'u dgon pa'i khri 'don ston zla ra bar bkra shis 'khyil la phebs zhor du gnang rtsis kyis snga 'gros su phur tsha dka' bcu slob chung du bsko bzhag mdzad cing o thog gi u lwa ston zla tha mar khyer yong rgyu'i dus btab gzhi byes thams cad la 'cham gyi ltad mo bstar ba gzigs/ 'du khang du dge 'dun rnams la rdo rje 'dzin pa dkon mchog rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i lam rim tshigs bcad ma'i lngags lungabla brang du don gnyer ba mang tsam la rgyan 'jug gnyis be'u bum sngon po rtsa 'grel ltung bshags cho ga'i lung / o thog gi mi sna rnams la skyabs 'gro'i khrid lung dang rta mgrin gsang sgrub kyi rjes gnang bsgrub bya lnga la rab byung dang bcul dge tshul gyi sdom pa bcas stsal te gang la gang 'tsham du byin rlabs bdud rtsi'i zil mngar gyis tshim par mdzad/ mā yang dgon dang lo dkar dgonaganyis nas mtshams zhus pa dge gnyer sogs byung ba la so sor mang 'gyed kyi thebs bskur/ tshes brgyad kyi nyin mi 'khrugs pa'i sgrub mchod kyi tshogs dbur phebs bcu gsum gyi nyin 'du khang ra skor du dge 'dun 'phel rgyasadang sbyin bdag 'du ba sogs kyi ched rig byed ma'i dbang gi sbyin sreg 719

༄/ /gung thang bstan ba'izlaname'i gsung 'bum/tshad ldan gnang bar rten 'brel legs pa byung zhes gsungs/ lha mo'i pho brang dang btsan khang du gsol mchod nyin re dang klu sdings nas yul lha la gsol mchod rgyas pa gnang / lo snga mar bzhengs pa'i mchod rten shin tu phun sum tshogs pa byung 'dug pas thugs lhag par mnyes shing der bzhugs ring la nyin re bzhin skor ba mang du mdzad pas dgon pa'i grwa pa dang 'brog pa'i mi rnams kyis phyag skor byed pa'i mig ltos la phan pa chen po byung /harachin smon lam bla ma'i zhabs drung gdan 'dren zhu mi tho yon phyag mdzod dge legs sogs dang mkhar sngon tham ga bla ma chos skyabs di yān chi'i el chi bcas 'byor par el chil 'dod chos dang mtshams lan gnang / pā jo'u nang so dang o thog gi mi sna har chin phyag mdzod tham ga bla ma'i mi sna so so nas dgon par mang 'gyed dang sog 'grul ba rang rang gis rje nyid la'ang 'bul ba bstar/ zla ba bzhi pa'i yar tshes la dgon lung du phebs har chen wang gi btsun mo ma ṇi dha rā dus las 'das pa'i bsdo rten byung bar ched dmigs kyi thugs dam gnad smin mdzad/ btsun mo'i 'dis sngar rmi lam byung tshul gye zhu shog cig rje nyid la phul bar kho rang rgyus med kyi brag ri mtha' dmar po zhig tu tshud nas phan tshun du bug pa 'ga' zhig yod pa la phyin pas sdom gyi ba thag lta bus bkag ste gang du'ang 'gro sa ma rnyed par sems skrag nas dkyil du sdad ljongs shig yod pa der skyil krung byas mig btsums te rje nyid la gsol ba btab pas g.yang skyid dpal skyid bkra shis ma sogs rgyus yod kyi bu bu mo mang posathub chung rnga chung sogs rtsed mo'i rol cha dang bcas yong gi 'dug pa'i skad thos byung bar sems dga' smod phya des nas bltas pas/ sngar gyi bug pa rnams mi 'a dug cing g.yon phyogs su bug pa gcig gi sgo har re phye yod pa la bu bu mo rnams bshar nas song zhing khong rang yang sgo de nas phyir thon te 720

༄/ /jebatsug bzangachos nyima'igagangagatsosabadabasadabyungakakhang skor yid du 'ong pa'i nang la slebs der rgyal po'i btsun mo yung phe nyang nyang bzhugs 'dug pa la mtshams zhus phul bas dgyes pa'i rnam pas gos kyi khug ma zhig gnang / de nas phan tshun du phyin pas khang ba zhig gi sgo nas kho rang gi yab wang bsus nas 'ongs pa dang mjal ba zhig rmis tshul zhus 'dug par kho rang la tshe sgrub sogs rim gro 'ga' zhig phab nas rmi lam yang ngan pa zhig min pa 'dra gsung ba tsam las 'grel pa brgyab nas ma gnang / drung yig ngag dbang bstan 'phel la dpon mo'i rmi lam 'di 'chi kha dang bar do'i gnas skabs dpa' bo dpa' mo'i bsu ba mkha' spyod kyi gnas sogs dang sbyar nas 'grel ba byas nas 'grigs lugs shig 'dug ang gsungs pa bshad tshul gra 'grigs pa tsam ma yin par don dngos gnas pa yin par snang bas/ bshes spring du/ pang na dpal gnas khyim pa rnams kyis kyang / /shes pas nyon mongs chu bo las brgal bgyis/ / zhes sngon chos ldan gyi rgyal bo du mas rgyal srid kyi dpal la gnas bzhin du bden bzhi'i blang dor tshul bzhinabyas pas 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las thar pa byung ba de bzhin du wang yab yum 'di gnyis kyang rje nyid dang mchod yon du 'brel te 'khor lo'i dkanapo dngos su mthong ba'i mos gus kyis sgo gsum bran du phul nas tshul bzhin du bsten pas dgos don bsru ba med par byung ba'i tshod du snong ngo / / spyir yang rje 'di nyid las mkha' spyod ma'i dbang dang gdams pa yongs rdzogs thob nas tshul bzhin nyams su len mkhan rnams smos mi dgos shing / tha na dbang tsam gyi bka' drin mnos te oṃ gsum ma mang nyung ci rigs chag med du 'don mkhan phal ba rnams kyang mkha' spyod du skye pa'i re ba yodade/ dbang zhig gi skabs su zhal nas lcang skya rdo rje 'chang gis 'di'i dbang thob nas oṃ gsum ma rang gis khas blangs pa ma chag par bton na 'chi 721

༄/ /gung bang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/pa'i gnas skabs min rung bar do'i gnas skabs su rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor mas cis kyang rjes su bzung nas dag pa mkha' spyod du 'dren par nges/ma mtha' ngan song du mi skye ba nged rang gis mna' bskyal chog gsungs pas khyed tshos sngags mang nyung ci rigs khas blangs pa de ma chag par thon gal te chad na bskyur ma btang bar chad bsab dang mu mthud nas sngar rgyun ltar 'don dgos/ de ltar bton na lcang skya rdo rje 'chang gis 'gyur med rdo rje'i bka' phebs pa de bzhin 'grub yong gsungs pa dang / phyis su mgron gnyer nang so ma 'tsho skabs zhog kha zhig gzim mal nas bzhengs dus thugs nyams 'ur nas phun tshogs nang so bde ba can du 'dug ma 'dod par mkha' sbyod du 'gro zhes thon song gnyis ka dag zhing yin pas ci khyad ces kyang gsungs pas/ 'dis ni rje nyid mnal lam 'od gsal gyi ngang nas sgyu ma'i lus kyis dag pa'i zhing khams sna tshogs su 'byon gyen yod pa dpog par nus so/ / sgo mang bla ma har chin thon yon la bod kyi lha dang bla mar brtag zhus dang der babs pa'i rim gro rnams bod nas sgrub rgyu'i thebs gser srang bzhi bcu bcas bskur te de mtshungs mdo smad kyi chos sde dgon lung sku 'bum bkra shis 'khyil bya khyung gser khog sgrub sde byang chub gling chos bzang mang 'dus sha rdzong bon ja su gro tshang nom chi 'dul ba lung dkar rgyal sras ri khrod di yān chi mā thi dgon rgyal yag bod yul or tshe dor zhi zhwa dmar/ stag lung yar klung chu klu rab rgyas tas thung tā pan lo dkar mā yangs srog mkhar thar pa gling bkra shis chos gling 'brug lung khran tsong gan chen sems nyid mchod rten thang bcas dgon ri khrod bzhi bcur nye ba la dngul srang stong phrag phyed dang gnyis kyi mang 'gyed thog tshe dpag med kyi gzungs ring bye chen gnyis dang 'bum ther bco brgyad/ gzungs thung bye chen gnyis dang 'bum ther bcu drug 722

༄/ /rjebatsun bzangartsarmadza〉nyis ga d+madakarasadabyungakasgoladakar gye snying po bye chen gnyis dang 'bum ther nyi shu rtsa bzhi rnam rgyal gzungs ring 'bum ther bcu dang gzungs thung 'bum phrag mang po seng gdong ma'i snying po bye chen gcig sgrol ma dkar ljang gi bstod pa 'bum ther re sher snying 'bum ther gdugs dkar mchog grub ma khri tshar sman chog rgyas pa lnga stong drug brgya mchog bden ma khri tsho lhag bcas gnad smin bsgrubs/ ri khrod pa rnams la brgya rtsa dang klu gtor lan chags gtor ma tshe lha gsum gyi tshe sgrub kyi rim pa rnams dang gling gi grwa pa mang po la'ang mdo sde du ma klog pa dang sa 'bum chu 'bum sogs kyi grangs gsog rgyu gtad/ nya pa'i lag nas nya mang po dang bshan pa'i lag nas gsod la thug pa'i bya dang ra lug mang po'i srog blu ba sogs zhabs brtan rgya chen po bsgrubs/ lcang skya mchog sprul rin po che rgya nag tu 'byon zhor la dgon lung du byon par mjal phrad dang gsol ston 'bul ba gzab rgyas zhus/ sku cha smon lam bla ma'i zhabs drung thon nye bar ja gral thog rten 'gang che ba du mas thog drangs pheb rdzong gang legs dang lam chos su sgol dkar gyi rjes gnang stsal/ dbyar gyi ring skyed tshal du bzhugs nas gtso bor thugs dam la gzhol zhing thun gseng du gzhung chen mo du mar dpe gzigs gnang / sku lnga'i bsnyen pa bya tshul rgyal po rol mtsho sogs gsung rtsom 'ga' zhig kyang mdzad/ bla ma sgom pa ngag dbang rab brtan sku ltems par sman bcos dang zhabs brtan phon che ba bsgrubs kyang dngas skyed med par drug pa'i tshes bcu gsum la zhing gzhan du phebs par thugs shin tu skyo ba'i rnam pa mdzad cing dgongs rdzogs rgya cher bsgrubs/su nyid g.yon ru'i brje thu sa lag chi la dge bsnyen nas dge slong bar gyi sdom pa yongs su rdzogs pa stsal/ bdun pa'i tshes la pā ju dang bkra shis 'khyil du gdan drangs pa bzhin phebs skabs ling hwa' thas dgon par bsu ba ser 723

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'isgroname'i gsung 'bum/sbreng dang bcas gdan drangs nas gsol tshigs dang grwa mang gis mjal kha zhus/ de nas pheb lam du mjal pa mang po'i khrom tshogs so so la mjal kha dang dmigs brtse ma rigs gsum mgon po'i snying po spyan ras gzigs kyi gzungs ring ke ka ni sogs gzungs sngags zab mo rnams dang sman bla bde gshegs brgyad sogs de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan mang po rna lam du sgrogayopa sogs chag med mdzad/ pā ju dgon pa'i rta bsu pa tshan mang po dang thab bsu dge 'dun mang gi ser sbreng dang bcas dgon par phyag phebs/ chos kyi khrir mnga' gsol ba'i thog dge 'dun mang la dga' ldan lha brgya ma'i bshad lung dang phyag dbang gnang / dgon mchod gzhis dang yang kyā zi lonajo'u ri khrod gser ri dgon pa sman chu sogs gzhi byes thams cad kyis rang 'byor dang bstun pa'i khri 'bul gang legs zhus/ de dag la bzhugs gral ston mo dang gnang sbyin dgon par mang 'gyed ri khrod rnams la'ang mang 'gyed thebs bskur dad 'dus kyi mjal ba mang po la mjal kha dang bka' chos gnang / lha khang so sor mchod mjal dang nang rten mtha' dag zhal phyesanas gzhi byes kun la mjal kha btang pā ju nang sos gsol ston bsnyen bkur gzabs/ gro tshang dgon pa'i rta bsu dang bcas rdo rje 'chang gi lha khang du phebs te mchod mjal gnang gro tshang dgon pas tshogs dbur gdan drangs te brtan bzhugs kyi rten 'brel bsgrigs shing dge 'dun mang gis chos 'brel mjal kha zhus/ tshogs par mang 'gyed kyang gya nom pa bstar ka ring bla brang du gdan drangs gsol ston 'bul ba dang bzhed chos 'ga' zhig zhus/ ba yan stong tha dgon par gdan drangs pa bzhin bsu pa ser sbreng dngabacas phebs te 'du khang du skya ser spyi 'dus la phyag dbang chos 'brel dngabla ma las zur gnyis dang phan tshun gyi khyim tshang rnams su gdan drangs 724

༄/ /rdzobamachosazangachosaminyima'ig4gtsasadzadabazadabyunganapar so sor 'dod chos kyi tshim par mdzad spyi sger gyis gsol ston 'bul ba gzabs/ de nas rim gyis chibs bskyod par kho bo cag dang khri chen dpal ldan grags pa'i sprul pa'i sku rin po che bla brang phyag mdzod sogs rta pa nyis brgya skor gyis chibs bsu dang ja thab/ dge 'dun nyis stong brgal bas ser spreng dang bcas bkra shis 'khyil du babs/ 'di lo dbyar thog skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang gi sprul sku ngos 'dzin gyi don la hor tshang gser khri rin po che dang dus 'khor slob zur ngag dbang phun tshogs phyag mdzod chen mo sogs bla brang gi zhabs phyi che bgres 'ga' zhig /sku zhabs nyid kyi sku tshab shar ba bka' bcu ngag dbang don grub nged kyi tshab tu bka' bcu nor bu rgyal mtshan ngag dbang wang gi mi sna chos rje bsam 'phel dgon pa spyi nas rab 'byams pa ngag dbang dar rgyas rgan pa bstan pa yar 'phel bcas sprul sku'i dogs gnas yod sa rnams su phebs te so so la sku gong ma'i phyag 'phreng / ḍā dril sogs dngos dang 'dra min gnyis re bcas bstan nas ngos 'dzin du bcug ste blangs rim gyis tho bsgrigs yong bas dkon pa'i khri gdan zur sogs thams cad 'dzom thog nas de lugs kyi rgyu mtshan snyan du gsol zhing / da dung 'di rnams las logs su slar yun gyes btsal dgos na'ang don gye rtsa ba mchogasprul ma 'phyugs ba zhig gal che ba las ngang thung pa'i 'dod dbang kho nar med pas bya byed ring thung ji 'dra zhig dgos na'ang skyabs mgon nyid kyi gzigs pas chod pa zhig dgos zhes gsol ba nan tan du btab/ kun mkhyen gong ma de nyid kyi na bza' dang rten kha shas gdan drangs nas zhag shas kyi bar mchod pa dang gsol 'debs nan tan gye sgo nas thugs brtag gnang bar nub gcig mnal lam du rje nyid zhe hor du bzhugs yod pa lta bu la mi zhig gis de ring rgyal bo'i mdun du bkra shis 'khyil bla brang gi grwa pa che ge mos 725

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'isgroname'i gsung 'bum/mda' 'phang bas dang po ma phog gnyis pa phog / bzhi 'phen dgos kyang gnyis pa phog pas lhag ma gnyis 'phen ma dgos mda' phog mkhan de la rma bya'i sgro gnang song zer ba byung bas phyi nyin dogs gnas bzhi po 'di'i nang du nges par yod 'dug pas slar sgug sdod byed mi dgos par snang gsung ste dogs gnas rnams kyi 'os tho am bhan brgyud nas 7gong ma chen por snyan sgon zhu rgyur thag bcad/ rjes sor dbus nas brtag dril byas pa la'ang dogs gnas bzhi'i nang nas ani gnyis par bab pas snga ma'i gsung la nges pa rnyed cing yab sras gnyis char la yid ches kyi dga' dad lhag par 'phel ba byung / dgon pa'i khri gdan zur zhabs drung sku skye dge 'dun mang dang bcas la gnyan tshem bu pa'i lugs kyi thugs rje chen po'i dmar khrid dang glang ri thang ba'i blo spyong tshig brgyad ma'i khrid tshe khrid 'chi med dga' ston bcas chos kyi bdud rtsi rgya cher stsal/ dbal mang zhabs drung gis zhus ngor lcang skya rol ba'i rdo rje'i gsung bka' rgya ma'i skor mang po zhig gi lung gnang /lcags mkhar gyi 'cham chen bkra shis lhun po'i sngags pa grwa tshang gi phyag bzhes ji lta bar tshugs yod pa la gzigs rtog dang dus 'khor grwa tshang gi tshogs su phebs te sku gsung thugs yongs rdzogs kyi cho ga rta dbyangs sogs rnam rgyal grwa tshang ji lta ba bzhin lag len du bstar bar zhib gzigs mdzad/ kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bla ma de nyid nas spyir bstan pa yongs kyi don mdzad tshul dang khyad par bkra shis 'khyil gyi dgon sde 'dir mdo sngags yongs su rdzogs ba'i bshad sgrub lag len phra mo de'i cha tshun tshad la dag ther 'di 'dra mdzad pa gsung ste thugs shin tu skyo bas spyan chab bsil ba na der 'tshogs thams cad kyis kyang bla ma'i bka' drin gzod ngo shes pa lta bu shin tu phan pa byung / sman pha grwa tshang du nyid kyi gsar rtsom rta mgon sbrags sgrub kyi gtor 726

༄/ /rjebatsug bzangachosakyinyima'ig4gas pamadagasadabyunganazlogagi cho ga ltar gtor zlog bsgrub par gzigs rtog dang grwa tshang so so la 'chad nyan dang cho ga lag len sogs sngar rgyun las g.yo ba med par tshul mthun mdzad dgos tshul gyi bslab ston nan tan mdzad/ nyid nas tshogs chen du mang 'gyed dang thos bsam gling gi phog thebs su dngul srang sum brgya rgyud pa dang dus 'khor sman pa grwa tshang gsum la bde mchog dang dus 'khor gyi bdag 'jug rta mgrin gtor zlog so so'i thebs su dngul srang lnga bcu re'i 'jog pa gnang / sku tsha no mon han yang mang 'gyed dang bcas thos bsam gling gi chos grar bcug phyir lam rgan gyi'i brag dkar la gdan drangs pa bzhin thab bsu ser sbreng dang bcas babs/ nyer lnga'i nyin hor tshang gser khri rin po cher bla med lugs kyi rdo rje sems dpa'i rjes gnang dang rgyud pa'i dge 'dun pa rnams la gsang 'dus dang bde mchog gi rgyud kyi ljags lung dbu btsugs nas chos thun re gnang / hor tshang gser khri rin po ches gtsos pa'i rgyud gra rnams nas gzhis len bsnyen bkur gzabs rgyud pa grwa tshang la mang 'gyed dang bde mchog sgrub mchod kyi thebs su dngul srang sum brgya spyor 'jags mdzad/ bde mchog pho brang du zhib mjal mdzad cing brag ngos na a yig tsam zhig mthong rgyu yod pa kun gyi mthun snang du grub pa der gzigs pa mdzad dus rje rang gi phyag gis dpal 'bar brkyangs nas a yigagi steng du na ro dang thig le 'bri tshul gnang ste a ma red oṃ red ang gsungs shing / slar yang ā ga dang hūṃ yig 'bri tshul gnang ste oṃ 〉 rtu gsum ga snang ang gsungs pa bzhin skabs der phal cher gyis yig 'bru gsum ga mngon sum du mthong rgyu byung ba dang / snga ma byams ba 'bum gling gi gnas mjal du phobs nas brag ngos su lha sku dang yi ge rang byon du babs pa rnams ngos 'dzin mdzad dus kyang gzhan gyis bltas nas ma mthong ba 727

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'ithoname'i gsung 'bum/rnams rje rang gi phyag mdzub kyis lha dang yi ge de dang de'i rnam pa 'bri tshul gnang ste bstan na gzhan dag gi mig lam du'ang de de bzhin du gsal bar snangab zhig yin ces de dus zhabs phyir 'brangs mi rnams kyi ngag rgyun las 'byung ba de dag ni gzhan gyi snang ba bsgyur bar nus pa rgya gar grub chen dang mtshungs pa'i rnam thar 'bur du dod pa'o/ / brag phugs kyi mdo nas rje rang gis mdzad pa'i rje btsun ma'i sgrub thabs dang 'brel bar tshogs 'khor lag mchod rgyud gra kha shas dang bcas pas dpyid glu dang bde mchog smon lam shis brjod rnams gdangs dang bcas te gsungs/ gnas 'di 'khor lo bde mchog gi pho brang dngos yin pa 'dug ces bsngags brjod dang thugs shin tu spro ba'i nyams mdzad tshul la dpag na dag pa'i snang ba khyad par can zhig byung bar mngon/ rgan gya'i mkha' 'gro ma'i lha khang du gdan drangs te gsol ston bsnyen bkur zhus bde mchog lha lnga'i sgrub mchod kyi thebs su dngul srang bco lnga'i 'jog pa gnang / gcu 'khor dgon du gsang 'jigs gnyis tshugs yod 'dug kyang bde mchog ma tshugs 'dug par bde mchog lca i pa'i sgrub mchod bdag 'jug 'dzugs thebs su snga phyir dngul srang nyis brgya dang /dgos chos su bzang gos kyi bla bre gcig rten kheb che ba gsum zangs maṇa che gnyis sil snyan cha gcig dbang rdzas cha tshang tshar lnga bcu rdo dril tshar sum cu dril gdan nyi shu rtsa gnyis bcas 'jog par mdzad de dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i bshad sgrub kyi bstan pa phyogs mthar 'phel ba'i rten 'brel gyi sgo mang du bsgrigs/ ba yan smad tha dgon du rta thab ser spreng dang bcas spyan drangs skya ser kun la phyag dbang chos 'brel dang dgon pa spo rgyu'i gnas gzigs mdzad/ kho tshe dpon po'i khyim du sde pa thun mong gi bsnyen bkur 'bul ba zhus pa'i re ba don ldan dang sngags pa mang po la rta bod nang gi lngags lung kha 728

༄/ /rdzobatsotshosazangachos nyi ga4gtsosamadakhasogayu/shas dang na kyā zhabs drung la rab byung gi sdom pa bcas gnang / zla ba brgyad pa'i yar tshes la dgon lung du babs a lag sha'i wang gi gdan 'dren pa tshe dbang thu sa lag chi nang so chos ldan ngo g.yog gis mjal kha dang snyan gsan zhus/ de nas zi ling du phebs te am bhan dang mjal phrad thog rje 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i sprul sku'i dogs gnas bzhi tsam byung tshul dang gang ci'i don skor thugs khur bzhes dgos tshul gyi gnyer gtad mdzad/de skabs 'bri gu'i bla grwa rnams nags don la kha mchu byung ste dgon pa 'thor nyenal thug nas che bgres rnams gtug sher la 'ongs yod par phan tshun so sor yid la 'bab pa'i bslab bya nan tan stsal te bde 'jags su 'gyur ba'i bka' drin bskyangs/ phyir dgon lung du 'byor pa nas thag nye ring gi ser skya mchog dman du ma sog yul du 'byon rgyu'i pheb rdzong 'bul ba dang rang rang gi 'dod don zhu ba sogs zam ma chad pa lta bu byung / sku 'bum nas lā kyā zhabs drung nang so dang bcas 'ongs te skyabs 'jug zhus nas phyir thon pa la zhalanas zhabs drung 'di pa thog mar mjal dus nged kyi sems la 'di nyid thor ba thar yod dam med snyam pa shig shar nas do dam pa la dris pas chung dus thar yod zer ba las dogs pa mi byed par 'dug nga'i sems la da dung dogs pa snang gsung / de nas a lag shā dang o thog gi el chi u lā dang bcas 'byor te zla ba dgu pa'i tshes gsum la dgon lung nas thon te dgon ma lagagi pheb skyel ring thung ja thab sogs kyi spros pa dang bcas chibs bskyod/mar tshang du bcag mal mdzad cing bla chen gyi mdun du mchod sprin rgya mtsho spros te thugs bskyed smon lam gnang lha khang nas phyir phebs dus sku 'bum nas lā kya nang so 'ongs pa thag ring nas gzigs te kho 'ongs pa ltas bzang po min pas khyod rang song la rgyu mtshan dris shog ces grwa pa zhig btang bas zhabs drung 729

༄/ /gung thang bstan ba'isgroname'i gsung ཿma/thor ba bud nas rkyen lam du song ba'i rgyu mtshan zhus 'dug par thugs skyo ba'i rnam pa mdzad cing nang so la sems gso dang bsngo pa'i spyan dmigs myur 'byon gsol 'debs ljags rtsom sogs bka' drin stsal/ sngar nas zhabs drunga'i thor bas thar med dam zhes thugs 'tsher dang khong tsho la'ang dri rmed nan tan mdzad na'ang kho rang tshor dogs pa tsam yang ma skyes pa ni las kyis non par snang bas tshul 'di lta bu'i sgo nas sangs rgyas byang sems kyi mthu dang sems can gyi las khyad med par bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i gnas yin pa la yid ches skyed dgos so/ / klu skyabs dpon po che bas yā mon du gdan 'dren zhus kyang phebs stabs ma 'grigs pa la dpon po ring gis lam nas chibs bsu ston mo dang byang chub sems dpa' nyi ma'i snying po'i sku brnyan gyis mtshon 'bul pa gya nom pa btegs te 'dod don zhig gtad gnyer zhus/ nyid nasakyang 'bri gu'i nags gyod la brten nas tā pan dgon pa'i 'du khang gi shing cha len pa la bar chad byung ba dpon po kho rang la dbang bar dgongs nas shing cha gtong rgyu gtad gnyer mdzad pas thugs bzhed ltar grub/grong lang du sleb nyin sngon la 'gro mkhan la mkhar gyi phyi rol tu sgar 'deb rgyu'i zhal bkod gnang yod na'ang klu skyabs kyi mi rnams kyis dpon po'i bkod pa bzhin mkhar nang du khong tsho'i ya'i mon la zhag bzhugs kyi gra sgrig bgyis yod pas der babs/ de la brten nas rje nyid thugs 'tshub ste sus kyang bzod par dka' ba'i zil chen po gnang zhing bka' bkyon char ltar bab/ mtshan mo mkhar nas phyi rol tu spos te thang sgar btab phyi nyin zhal nasakhe'i nub mo rmi lam la rgya mkhar zhig gi nang du rgya mo khrag grod pa gang mchan 'og tu sbas nas bzung ba zhig gis grwa pa tsho'i ltag nas 'jab ste gtor grababyed kyin 'dug pa nged kyis mthong nas de ci yin zhes 'bar bas khos 730

༄/ / rjebatsunayab4chosakyinyima'igasangag mapadzadakuragadabyunganabagakhums nas phyir bkyed pa zhig rmis/ kha sang sgar mkhar gyi phyi rol tu 'bab rgyu'i bkod pa byas yod na'ang khong tsho mkhar nang du bab 'dug 'on kyang phyi rol tu bsnur pa yin pas skyon med pa 'dra gsung / 'di res sog yul du tshad rims dang 'brum nag mched pa'i skabs dang thug pa yin kyang nyid kyi bka' bkyon gcig gis tshang ma'i lam gyi nyer 'tshe rang zhir song nas phyir 'byor rag la skyon gang yang ma byung / de bzhin du mchod dpon 'jam dbyangs chos 'phel so na nas thabs gang byas kyang ma phan pa la skabs shig khos byed lugs shig ma 'grigs pas 'gram lcag gcig btang ba na de ma thag nad zug lhod nas rim gyis gting drag tu song / 'di dag ni mtshon tsam ste rje nyid kyis bka' bkyon re nam gnang ba na gegs chag re bzlog pa'am byin rlabs kyi mtshan ma re nges par 'byung bas dgongs gzhi dgos pa'i 'di yin par 'dug snyam du shes rgyu re med mi srid pa ni bcar sdod dpyod pa can kun gyis myong bas grub pa zhig yin par snang / tshul 'di ni sngon kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa mdo smad du bzhugs skabs sgo mang dpon slob tson garazla bzang phun tshogs pa dbus nas ched gtad kyis mjal du phebs te gzim chung du sleb ma thag bstan bshig gsung nas bka' bkyon gyis tshar bcad cing zhabs chag gis brdung ste phyir bton/ phan tshun gyi zhabs 'bring thams cad shin tu ngo gnong ba byung yang dpon slob nyid nas nged rang gi bsam don 'grub pa yin gsung mnyes tshor dpe med mdzad/ rjes sor dus zing gis nyen che ba byung yang khong la nyer 'tshe gang yang ma byung ba de'i thugs rje yin pa ngag rgyun tshad ldan las 'byung ba ltar yin/ sngon gyi dus na'ang dge bshes lha bzo la stod lung pas mjal res bzhin bka' bkyon par khong gi slob ma nyag mo pas slob dpon 'di 'o skol dpon slob la sdang ba 731

༄/ /gung thangangastan ba'izlan me'i gsung 'bum/ zhig 'dug zhus pa na khyod kyis bka' bkyon du go'am kho bo la 'dis 'di lta bu mdzad res kyis te ru gas byin gyis brlabs pa 'dra re 'ongs gsungs pa bzhin te/ bla ma byin rlabs can dang slob ma mos gus can 'dzom na bka' bkyon dang phyag 'bab tsam la'ang byin rlabs tshad med pa 'byung zhing de las bzlog na rgyud sde bzhi'i dbang skur brag thog nas chu 'byo ba ltar byas kyang phan pa dka'o/ / mdor na rje 'dis dgongs gzhi med par gya tshom bu bka' bkyon mi gnang la dgongs gzhi yod tshe drag zhan dang rgyus yod med la ma ltos par tsham tshom med par bkyon na'ang tha mal pa'i 'khon 'dzing lta bu dgos med kyi tshig tsub mi gnang bar phan pa'i gtar sreg ltar sbyor ba tsub kyang phugs su don du 'gyur pa dang 'byung 'gyur lung bstan lta bu thog tu khel ba'i gsung 'ba' zhig gnang ba zhig yin pas/ lhas sbyin dang legs skar lta bu'i mi re gnyis la don du mi 'gyur ba'i mtha' mi khegs kyang blo ldan gzu boraganas pa kun ci 'dra'i bka' bkyon zhig gnang yang sems mi pham pa dang zhe mi sun par ma zad slar dad zhen dang mos gus je cher 'gro ba zhig yin pa ni bka' bkyon don du 'gyur ba'i rtags su mngon no/ / des na bdag legs su 'dod pa rnams ni dge pa'i bshes gnyen gyi mdzad pa la rtogs tshul de lta bu re med mi rung du gal che ste/ brgyad stong pa las chos smra ba dag chos 'dod pa dag la brnyas shing mi sems pa ltar na'ang de la khyod kyis phyir bzlo bar mi bya ste lhag par yang chos don du gnyer ba dang gus shing mi skyo bas de'i phyi bzhin du 'brang bar bya'o/ / zhes gsungs so/ / rim gyisam lag sha'i sa sne zin par wang nas chibs bsur mngags pa'i tha'i ji dharma pā la ngo g.yog 'byor te bsu ston zhus/ de nas ho sho'u'i tsha zhag gi grwa sgrig thog nas phebs te dad ldan gyi mjal ba rnams phyag dbang chos 'brel 732

༄/ / chubatsun khazangachosaspyonyis ga bdagaracadabyung/gyis tshim par mdzad tshe dbang thu sa lag gdan drangs te bsnyen bkur zhus kho la sngar tsha rgyud dkon zhing sri zhugs pa rje nyid la skyabs btsal te tsha bu zhig byung bar gzhan du bzhag ste khyim du blangs par yod pa'ang 'di res zhabs phyir khrid nas khyim du blangs te ming brjes shing tshe dbang yang stsal te dus kyi 'jigs pa las skyabs/ tha'i ji dharma pā las kyang gdan drangs te bsnyen bkur zhus 'dir or du su o thog tā pe li'i mi sna ca khir chi atha sirnyi dem chi grags pa khā shes rab ngo g.yog su lā dang bcas 'byor/ chog thu khu re la gdan drangs te gsol tshigs zhus thog grwa pa rnams la rta mgrin gyi sgrub thabs pad+ma rā ga'i phreng ba'i ljags lung gnang / dwags po hu thog thu'i dgon pa'i glang kya zhabs drung sngags pa grwa tshang gi bla ma dbu mdzad mtshan nyid gra tshang gi gzhung las pa tshogs chen dge bskos sogs rta pa du ma chibs bsur 'byor te bum pa thu nas ja thab dang mjal / wang gi nu bo rje drung mkhan po ngo g.yog dang wang dang gung gi mtshams zhus 'bul mi rnams kyang der 'byor nas mjal kha zhus/ tshes nyer bzhi la o lān tho lo gos nas sbyin bdag chen wang dbang chen dpal 'bar nu bo gung sogs dpon blon gyi 'khor brgya phrag du ma dngabacas pas chibs bsu thab bsu dang yā mon gyi sgo drung nas dgon pa'i dge 'dun rnams kyis ser sbreng mchod rol gyis mdun bsus te wang gi khang chen du gdan drangs nas gsol ja dkar spro zhus/ de nas u ru su'i yā mon du bzhugs gnas gra sgrig bgyis par phebs gzhi byes kyi ser skya kun la mjal kha gnang wang gi rim gro'i thog mar btsan khang du rgyal gsol rgyas pa zhig btang / de nas zla ba bcu pa'i tshes gcig nas nyin bdun gyi ring bcad rgya'i ngos rig byed ma'i bsnyen pa dang sbyin sreg nyin gnyis la sgrub grogs dang bcasapas sgrol ma maṇ+ḍal bzhi pa'i cho ga dang srung ba lnga'i sgrub mchod rnams 733

༄/ /gung bang bstan ba'isgraname'i gsung 'bum/bsgrubs/ wang dang mkhan po sogs chos nyan pa brgyad la rig byed ma'i dbang chen sta gon bcas dang rig byed ma dang 'od zer can ma gnyis kyi rjes gnang wang btsun mo rnams dang bcas par so sor 'brang ma dkar mo'i rjes gnang lha de dag gi sgrub thabs kyi lung dang bcas stsal/ wang gis dngos 'bul du maṇ+ḍal kha btags sku gsung thugs rten dngul rdo tshad bzhi gos chen yug dgu shel snod bzhi ca lag sna tshogs yod pa'i rgam chung gcig rnga mong nyi shu lug lnga brgya bcas phul/ nyid rang gi zhabs brtan du dpal mgon dang jo bo rgyal mtshan pa dam can rdor legs gsum gyi bskang gso nyin gcig btang / bco lnga'i nyin wang dang mkhan po sogs kyis chibs skyel ja thab dang bcas or du sur phebs rgyu'i lam du thon su has thu la o thog tā pe lis chibs bsur mngags pa'i sman pa mkhan po rgyal mtshan chos 'phel bla ma dbu mdzadakhyams pa yar 'phel car gu chi sargyu skyabs ngo g.yog 'byor nas bsu ston zhus shing ho sho'i tsha zhag gi gra sgrig thog nas phebs/ mi rin ching pa thu'i ja thab thog skya ser brgya phrag du ma la mjal kha dang gzungs sngags du ma'i bzlas lung bsngo smon bcas gnang / o'u han nas wang paṇ+ḍi ta zhabs drung gis rje nyid la mtshams zhus dang nyid dgung lo drug cur phebs pa'i dga' ston dang zhabs brtan du dmigs nas dgon lung gi cho 'phrul smon lam gtong rgyur phyug mdzod chos rje ngo g.yog mngags pa lam nas mjal te mtshams zhus dang rgyu mtshan phul/ rma chu'i 'gram du tha'i ji rdo rje mi 'gyur spun gnyis dang dpal dar gling gi su me'i bla ma blo bzang bkra shis tshogs chen dbu mdzad sogs chibs bsur 'byor te rdo rje mi 'gyur gyis gdan 'dren gyi snyanagasan zhus/ nyer gcig gi nyin sbyin bdag tā pe li don grub tshe ring chibs bsur 'byor ar shan gyi sman pa grwa tshang la dge 'dun gyi ser spreng dang 734

༄/ /jebatsun khazang gsangag khasatshadakanasadabyungakabacasagadan drangs te 'du khang du gsol ston zhus pe li dang mkhan po rgyal mtshanatshos 'phel gtsos pa'i gzhi byes kyi ser skya nyis stong lhag la sman chog bsdus pa'i lung phan yon gyi bshad pa bka' chos dkyus ma'i skor mjal kha dang bcas stsal grwa tshang spyi nas dngos 'bul gya nom pa brtan bzhugs lugs su phul/ phyi nyin nas tsha zhag gar babs su mjal ba stong phrag du ma la phyag dbang chos sbyin sogs rgyun gyi phyag bzhes ltar mdzad kung gor bi nas dpal dar gling gi tā bla ma bstan pa thar ba ngo g.yog gis chibs bsu zhus/ nyer lnga'i nyin tha'i ji rdo rje mi 'gyur gyi ho ro la 'byor nas der bzhugs mtshan mo gling me dang bstun thugs dam ched dmigs gnang tha'i ji'i skor la phyag rdor gtum chung gi rjes gnang stsal bsnyen bkur 'bul ba gzabs/ phyi nyin ha rab thal la gung bab thog dpal dar gling gi mtshan nyid mkhan po bstan pa bsam 'phel dang pe li'i sras skal bzang mi 'gyur tshe brtan dpon g.yog chibs bsur 'byor nas mjal kha zhus/ khong tsho phyir thon pa dang zhal nas pe li'i sras 'di snying rje bo zhig yin pa la nga'i sems la tshe thung ba'i nyams shig shar byung gsung nas thugs 'tsher gnang ba phyis de bzhin byung / de nas phebs lam du dpal dar gling gi grwa tshang so so'i dge gnyer gyis gtsos pa'i rta pa brgya skor gyis chibs bsu zhus/ nyi shu bdun la ma ṇi thu nas dpal dar gling gi rta bsu bskyar ma dang thab bsu dgon pa'i nye 'dabs nas mchod rdzas sna tshogs thogs pa'i dge 'dun phyed nyis stong tsam gye ser sbreng rol cha spos 'dren sogs kyis mdun bsus te bla brang du babs/ sbyin bdag pe li sogs mi bzang rnams dang grwa tshang so so'i bla ma rnams kyis bde bar phyag phebs pa'i legs dar phul te mjal kha dang gsol ston zhus 'du khang du dge 'dun mang la phyag dbang dang chos grwa nas dad 'dus kyi mjal ba 735

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'isgroname'i gsung 'bum/stong phrag mang po la mjal kha gnang zhing gzungs sngags zab mo du ma rna bar sgrogs pa dge ba'i dam bca' bskul ba sogs mngon mtho nges legs kyis bon bskrun pa'i thabs kyi rim pa rgyun gyi phyag bzhes ltar mdzad/ de nas nyin mang po'i bar ho sho'i mjal pa khri phrag du ma mu mthud nas bshar bar phyag dbang chos bka' rnam dkar dge ba'i phan yon sogs chos bshad rgyas par gnang / bcu gcig pa'i tshes gcig la dpon po'i yā mon du gsol ston dang thog ma'i rten 'byung gi zhabs brtan phul mas gnyis la dgon pa'i btsanakhang du grwa tshang so so'i bla ma rnams dang bcas dpon g.yog sum cus rgyalagasol rdo rje'i sgra dbyangs ma gzab rgyas btang / tshes bdun 'khrungs skar gyi nyin dgon pa'i tshogs chen 'du khang du mkhan po tā bla ma mtshan nyid mkhan po sman pa bla ma cha gan bla ma su me'i bla ma bla ma dbu mdzad sogs grwa tshang so so'i dge 'dun rnams dang sbyin bdag tā pe li sras skal bzang mi 'gyur tshe brtan thu sa lag chi pa sha la'i dang dharma dha tu ca khir chi arja sirnyi sogs dpon rigs tha'i ji rnams dang pe li'i nu mo bkra shis lha mo ngag dbang ban+de ko nying ha thun ma bu sogs ho ro yas mas kyi dpon dpon mo mang po dang cin gar thu sa lag chi tshe dbang bsam 'grub ngo g.yog mkhar sngon tham ga bla ma'i mi sna dar han gsol dpon sogs gzhi byas kyi mchog dman du ma khra spung nge tshogs te bla ma rnams kyis gtsos cho ga pa sum cus rgyal dbang skal bzang rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i brtan bzhugs kyi cho ga bsgrubs nas rje nyid bkur ste chen pos spyan drangs lha dang bla ma dbyer med la mchod 'bul byin 'bebs sogs cho ga bzhin bsgrubs shing tā bla ma bstan pa thar pas maṇ+ḍal gyi bshad pa snyan cing 'brel chags pa zhig zhus te zhabs pad bskal brgyar brtan pa'i gsol ba btab par thugs dgyes pa'i bka' lan bzang po rna ba'i bdud rtsir stsal/736

༄/ /༄tsotshosazapa 7)nyi chag4gtsosamagasasadabyugadangos 'bul du sbyin bdag pe lis kha btags nang mdzod dngul srang nyi shu'i maṇ+ḍal dar tshon sna lnga'i sne 'dogs can sku gsung thugs rten dngul gyi rgyal srid sna bdun bkra shis rdzas brgyad tshe ril tshe chang gi snod/ bzhugs gdan rgyal yol na bza'i skor gos chen yug lnga dngul srang sum brgya rnga mong nyi shu rta sum cu lug bzhi brgya gtang rag tu dngul srang bco lnga'i maṇ+ḍal sne 'degs can bcas dang / gzhan skya ser drag zhan du mas mu mthud nas rang rang gi 'byor tshod kyi 'bul ba btegs te phyag dbang zhus gzhi byes mgron la dpon po'i gzhung dang dgon pa spyi nas dga' ston gzabs/ de'i steng du chos mdzad grags pa dang rab 'byams pa grags pa gnyis kyis tshogs gleng byas shing gzhan yang stobs can du ma rtsal 'gran pa mgrin bsdebs kyi glu dang rol mo sna tshogs sogs chos srid kyi dga' ston ci yang spel/ de nas nyin kha shas kyi ring sbyin bdag pe li la 'jigs byed kyi sgo nas byad grol dang tshe dbang brgya rtsa hūn gar thu sa lag chi la rig byed ma'i rjes gnang thu sa lag chi dang pe li'i a ke bla ma rnams la rgyal po sku lnga'i srog gtad/ hang kin chos rje tshul khrims kyis zhus ngor drag po sum dril dang khyung khra lha mo shra ma na rnams kyi rjes gnang mtshan nyid mkhan po gnyis sogs gsum la chos rgyal phyi nang gsang gsum gyi rjes gnang u shing pe zi sku mched gnyis sogs la drag po gsum dril gyi rjes gnang bcas stsal u shing pe zis gdan 'dren gyi snyan gsan phul/tābo ma dang mtshan nyid mkhan po gnyis kyis rang rang gi bla brang du gdan drangs nas gsol ston 'bul ba zhus nyi zlog dang bstun nyid kyi zhabs brtan la rta mgrin gtor zlog dang sbrel nas sku glud gzab rgyas bsngos/ mtsho sngon gyigangs dkar wang mtsho skyes pe zi mched gnyis ja sag lha mgon rdo rje tshe thar ja sag rdo rje ja sag phyag rdor ja sag rnams pho brang du 'gro zhor gyi lam 737

༄/ /gung bang bstan pa'i sgron 'igasung 'bum/nas mjal kha zhus/ hang kin gu thi chos rje blo bzang rdo rje sogs grwa pa mang tsam gyis brtan bzhugs kyi rten 'brel bsgrigs shing ljags lung 'ga' zhig zhus/ pe li'i nu mo bkra shis lha mo'i yur ger gdan drangs nas gsol ston zhus shing der zhag bzhugs mdzad phyi nyin bkra shis lha mo dang pe li'i a ke gnyis kyis gtsos pa'i skya ser nyi shu tsam la sman bla mtho brtsegs kyi rjes gnang stsal/ chos yon du gser gyi rgyal srid sna bdun bkra shis rtags brgyad kyis spras pa'i tsan dan dmar po'i maṇ+ḍal sne 'dogs can sku gsung thugs rten bzhugs gdan rgyab yol gos dang dngul rta drel rnga mong sogs dngos 'bul gya nom pa phul/ tshur lam pe li'i sras skal bzang mi 'gyur tshe brtan gyi ur ger gdan drangs nas bsnyen bkur zhus ca khir chi at+pa sirnyi thu sa lag chi dharma dha tu tha'i ji lha dbang rdo rje sogs drag zhan du mar 'jam lugs tshe dbang gnang / chos skyabs mi rin dang ho thong ja lang thub pa cang gi gnyer ba don grub lhun grub khun du tho'u le sogs du mas gdan drangs te gang 'byor gyi bdog pa spel chos skyabs mai rin gyi khyim du mi rin gyis gtsos pa'i skya ser gyi khrom mang por spyan ras gzigs phyag bzhi pa'i rjes gnang sogs stsal/ nyi shu'i nyin phyir dgon par babs/ pe li'i ma yum btsun mo dkon mchog tshe ringagi bsngo rten phul bar btsun mo 'di rje 'di la dad gus gzhan dang mi 'dra zhing da lan gdan 'dren gyi mgo 'dren byed mkhan yang 'di nyid yin kyang nyid phyogs 'dir ma 'byor gong du sku 'das nas mjal ma thub pa la thugs brtse pa'i rnam pa mdzad cing sbyangs chog gnad smin gnang / sbyin bdag pe li la nā ro mkha' spyod dang 'brel ba'i khrus chog dang yum sras thun mong la sdug bsngal sel pa'i sgrol ma dang phyag rdor gtum po khyung lnga'i rjes gnang de dag gi sgrub thabs kyi ljags lung bcas stsal/ ho sho'i rim grong rta 738

༄/ / rdzobatsug bzangachosaminyima'igasangagatsosatshadakhazadabyunganamagrin gsang sgrub kyi gtor zlog dang sprags nas rgyal rdzong btang bas byin rlabs kyi tshan kha shin tu che ba byung / su nyid g.yon ru'i wang gi ma yum btsun ma blo bzang sgrol ma mi sna tā bla ma blo bzang 'byung gnas ngo g.yog 'byor nas brtan bzhugs kyi rten 'brel bsgrigs te wang gis phul ba'i maṇ+ḍalakha btags sku gsung thugs rten bzhugs gdan rgyab yol dngul srang lnga brgya ma yum dang mi sna tā bla ma so sos dngos 'bum spam mtho ba btegs/gnyi ga la rgyal po sku lnga'i srog gtad dang btsun mar dge tshul gyi sdom pa gnang / dur nged wang gi mi sna nang so skal bzang tshul khrims ta lad pe zi'i mi sna chos rje blo bzang bstan 'dzin hang gan pe zi'i mi sna 'jam dbyangs do rāl tha'i ji ngo g.yog rnams 'byor nas mtshams zhus phul bar brtag lan sogs gnang / bla ma dbu mdzad byams pa yar 'phel gyis gshag tu gdan drangs nas gsol ston 'bul ba gzabs shing skyabs 'jug nan tan zhus/yongs 'dzin ye shes rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i rnam thar gyi dpe zhig phyag tu 'byor par thugs brel gyi seng bar nam byung la rgyun du gzigs shing da lta 'du 'dzis sun pa'i skabs 'dir rnam thar 'di la mjal ba de mu ges nyam thag pas bza' btung zhim po la longs spyad pa'i tshod kyi zhe tshim pa byung zhes rjes su yi rang ba'i bsngags brjod mdzad cing / nga rang bod du yod dus ri khrod la 'gro rgyu'i 'dun pa nar mar yod pas de'i mu mthud nas song yod na da tshod dga' mo yong ba la bsod nams dman pas thog tu ma khel zhes thugs skyo ba'i rnam pa dang / nged kyis sgrub pa rnam dag cig byed 'dun yod kyang thog tu ma khel ba 'di cis nyes pa yin gnad dmigs can gyi rim gro ye yod ces ra stod klong rdol bla ma la zhus pa'i lan du khyod rang skye ba 'dis ma zad 'di'iskye ba rjes mar yang da lta'i gnas skabs las mi 'da' bas sgom rnam 739

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'izlaname'i sku 4ma/dag yong dka' de'i skye ba rjes ma la gzod sgom rnam dag gi mgo tshugs yong gsung 'dug / shi nas ngan 'gror mi skye bar da dung bde 'gro'i rten 'thob pa lta bur gsung ba la sems dga' na'ang chos rnam dag yong dka' gsung ba la sems skyo ba zhig snang / nged rang mnas 'chi ba mi dran pa dang ngan song gi sdug bsngal la mi 'jigs pa'i steng du klong rdol bla ma'i lung bstan gyis snying khams je cher btang yod pa 'dra gsung ste bzhad mo mdzad/ yang nged rang gis sgrub pa rnam dag 'dod pa thog tu ma khel ba ma gtogs gzhan gang 'dod 'bad med du 'byung ba zhig yin te snga ma dpe cha dkon pa dang rten 'gang che'i rigs 'di nga la yod na bzang ba la bsam na bod sogs nas bla ma tshos re re bskur kyin 'dug / dka' chen tshang la rnam thar 'gang cam yod pa gzhir bcas pas mjal na bsam yod pa la da res rta tshag rin po ches dpe cha 'di bskur byung / de thams cad byams pa rin po che dang lcang skya rin po che sogs rtsa ba'i bla ma rnams kyis de dang der sprul nas byung ba las nga rang bu bzang nas khong tshos nga la gzab pa ci la yin gsung / de phyin chad nas ri khrod pa zhig yin na dka' chen gyi rnam thar la mjal dgos gsung nas slob ma dge bshes dang ri khrod pa sogs la phyag dpe de ched du gtad nas ston par mdzad/ 'jig rten chos brgyad kyi 'khri ba rtsad nas bcad de gtad pa bzhi dngardo rje gsum gyi sgo nas thos bsam sgom gsum stan thog gcig tu mdzad pas thub bstan yongs kyi srog shing chen por gyur tshul gyi rnam thar 'di lta bus thugs gting nas phrog pa ni dgongs pa'i 'dzin stangs mtshungs shing bstan pa'igand gzigs pa'i khyad chos rnam grol sgrub pa po kun gyis go dgos pa zhig yin gyi/ deng dus bla ma'i go sa 'dzin pa mang po dag gzhan zhig la kha drag dbang che dang rnyed pa gtos che ba byung tshul thos pa na ngo mtshar rmad du rtsi 740

༄/ /rjebatsun khazang la nyis mdakanacodabyunganazhing 'gram chu ldang ba ni rang gis nyin mtshan kun tu de kho na bsgoms pa'i rang mdangs phyir thon pa yin te/ mkhas grub thams cad mkhyen pas/dam pa rnams kyis tshe 'di blos btang nas/ / zab mo'i man ngag rtse gcig nyams blangs pas/ / don gnyis phul phyin mtha' yas rnam thar la / yid g.yos 'dun pa cha tsam mi skye bar/ / da lta'i ston pa 'ga' yi rnyed grags dang / / slob 'khor rgya chen 'du 'god mang po'i gtam/ / thos pa tsam gyis 'gram chu ldang ba 'di/ / gzhi rtsa gting nas nyes pa'i rtags ngan yin/ /zhes gsungs pa bzhin no/ / spyir rje 'dis cha rgyus dang 'brel ba yod med la ma ltos par bstan pa 'dzin cing spel ba'i dam pa khyad par can la thugs dad dang bsngags brjod rang rgyud chos bzhin 'dul ba'i gang zag khyad par ba la thugs gtsigs dang gzengs bstod/ / yon tan yod na'ang mngon pa'i nga rgyal gyes khengs nas rang gzhan gyi rgyud bslad pa dang chos med kyang chos par brdzus nas 'dul 'dzin dang sngags 'chang ci rigs kyi tshul 'chos byed mkhan la dmigs phug nas smad cing bkyon pa sogs gang cir drang por gnang ba las gzhan dang bstun nas ngo dga' zol 'jog tu song ba'i bzang ngan go ldog mi gnang zhing / gzhan gyis tshad mar bzung ba 'ga' zhig nyid kyi dgongs par ma babs pa slar rang mtshang ston pa dang gzhan gyis dman par bzung ba 'ga' zhig nyid kyi dgongs par babs pa rim gyis khyad thon pa'ang mthong chos su mang du byung bas gzhan gyi rgyud tshod mngon par mkhyen pa'i ye shes mnga' ba'i rnam thar bsam gyis mi khyab po/ / nyi shu bdun gyi nyin yon tan mi rin gyis u lā khyer 'ongs pa bzhin der phebs te bcag mal mdzadadad 'dus kyi ser skya'i khrom shin tu mang po la mjal kha dang gzungs sngags sgrogs pa sogs mthong thos dran reg don ldan du 'gyur ba'i mdzad pa 741

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgron me'i gsung 'bum/dkyus bzhin bsgrubs/ mi rin gza' mi rnams kyis gtsos pa'i skya ser mang po la spyan ras gzigs phyag bzhi pa'i rjes gnang stsal/ u shing pe zi'i gdan 'dren pa dge bskos grags pa ja lang po ro khā dngos grub rnams kyis u lā khyer 'ongs te rim gyis phebs/ khā rin chen gyes gsol ja dang u ba shi mi rin gyis gung tshigs zhus u ba shi gza' mi rnams la sgrol ljang gi rjes gnang dang g.yang 'bod gnang / u shing pā thur mi rin gyi khyim du zhag bab gra sgrig thog tu bzhugs mjal ba mang po la chos 'brel gnang / bcu gnyis pa'i tshes gcig la u shing pe zi dang dgon pa'i khri ba sogs ser skya mchog dman du mas rta bsu ser steng dang bcas de ga'i dgon pa theg chen dga' tshal du 'byor te nyin bdun bzhugs/ dgon pa'i dge 'dun pa rnams dngadad 'dus kyi skye pho mo mang po la mjal kha dang gzungs sngags sgogs pa dge ba'i dam bca' bskul ba sogs mdzad pas ma ṇi dung phyur sogs dge ba rlabs po che khas len mkhan mang du byung / 'di skabs su rje nyid kyi spyi bor sman bla ma ched bdun mtho brtsegs su bzhugs 'dug pa la rim gyis gsol ba btab pas gcig gcig la thim nas mthar sman pa'i rgyal po nyid rang la thim song ba'i snang ba byung bas dgos pa khyad par can zhig yod par gzigs te nyams snang de bzhin gyi gsol ba gdab pa'i cho ga'ang ljags rtsom gnang /yu shing ja sag gi gdan 'dren pa chos rje ngag dbang chos 'phel cang gi tshe ring rgya mtsho or du wang gi gdan 'dren pa slob dpon chos bstan pa mai rin yi dam rnams 'ongs nas snyan gsan zhus/ tshogs chen 'du khang dang bsod nams chos rje'i lha khang gsar ba gnyis kyi rten brten par rab gnas mdor bsdus re mdzad/ ser skya spyi mang la phan pa'i chos shig gnang dgos kyi gsol ba btab pa bzhin chos grwa nas bla ma dge 'dun dang pe zi yum 742

༄/ /chabatsunablobazangachosakyi ba masasmadakarasadabyung/bcas sogs ser skya'i khrom chen por snying po don gsum gyi khrid dang mjug tu rgyan 'jug gnyis kyi mgo nas tshigs bcad kha shas re'i ljags lung bcas gnang / pe zi spun gnyis la lha mo dang rig byed ma'i rjes gnang gzhi'i rim gror rig byed ma'i sbyinasreg dang ho sho'u thun mong gi rim gror rta mgrin gtor zlog dang sprags nas rgyal rdzong bcas bsgrub pa gnang / tshogs chen 'du khang du khri pa dang mtshan nyid bla ma sogs cho ga pa rnams kyis tshe dpag med kyi brtan bzhugs kyi cho ga gsungs pa dang sbrags nas pe zis gtsos pa'i ho sho'u thun mong gis dngos 'bul du maṇ+ḍal kha btags sku gsung thugs rten bzhugasagadan rgyab yol dngul srang lnga brgya bcas phul te khri pa chos rje shes rab yon tan gyes zhabs pad brtan pa'i gsol ba btab par dgyes pa'i bka' lan gnang mjug tu bla ma'i rnal 'byor don gnyis lhun grub ma'i khrid mdor bsdus tsam dang nyid kyi zhabs brtan gsol 'debs blo gter 'jam dpal ma'i lngags lung skul tshogs gleng bcas ston chen zhus/ mtshan nyid grwa tshang gi 'du khang dang chos rje shes rab yon tan tho yon blo bzang bskal bzang so so'i gshag tu gdan drangs nas gsol ston dang dngos 'bul btegs der bzhugs ring la thugs brel gyi seng bar nas chos rje shes rab yon tan sogs la nyid kyi gsar rtsom skor gyi ljags lung du ma gnang / cun gar pe zi'i a pe'i lha mo skyid dang thu sa lag chi don grub ngo g.yog 'ongs nas so sos dngos 'bul gya nom pa brtan bzhugs lugs su phul a pe'i la dge tshul gyi sdom pa dang thu sa lag chi la 'dod chos 'ga' zhig stsal/ ja sag dpon po'i tha'i ji 'jigs med skal bzang rdo rje dang zhabs drung tā bla ma has ching thu sa lag chi'i tho yon ngag dbang 'jigs med rnams gdan 'dren du 'byor/ tshes brgyad la dgon nas btegs te pe zi'i ho ro la phebs dpon 743

༄/ /yo thang bstan pa'izlaname'i gsung 'bum/po sku mched gnyis dang chos rje shes rab yon tan rnams la rgyal po sku lnga'i rigs gtad gnang gsol ston 'bul ba gzabs mjal ba mang por phyag dbang chos 'brel gnang / pe zi sogs bla dpon mang po'i skyel thung dang bcas de gnas thon lam zhor du phas than tā mung khe ji ya dang chos rje bkra shis sogs kyis gdan 'dren zhus par phyag dbang chos 'brel gyes tshim par mdzad de u tan chos tam la 'od zer gyi khyim du zhag bzhugs gnang / ja sag dpon po dbang rgyal tshe brtan rdo rje tas ching thu sa lag chi ja khir chi mgon skyabs na du mas chibs bsu dang tshes bcu la yon tan chos rje dang paṇ+ḍi ta'i 'du khang gi tā bla ma gnyis kyis gdan drangs nas bsnyen bkur dang 'dod chos zhus/ ja sag dpon pos thabs su ser sbreng dang bcas tshom gur du gdan drangs te gsol ston zhus shing lha khang du bzhugs gnas gra sgrig bgyis par phebs te mjal pa mang por phyag dbang chos sbyin gnang / zhi bar sku skye ngo g.yog dang hūn gar pe zi tshe dbang bkra shis dpon g.yog rnams der 'byor pe zi dpon g.yog la seng ldeng nags sgrol gyi rjes gnang stsal cing pe zis brtan bzhugs kyi rten 'brel bsgrigs nas maṇ+ḍal kha btags sku gsung thugs rten bzhugs gdan rgyab yol dngul srang nyis brgya rnga mong gcig rta gnyis bcas phul/ ja sag dpon po yab sras thu sa lag chi ja khir chi sogs dpon blon dang zhi bar sku skye ye shes rgyal mtshan sman ram pa mkhan po ngag dbang chos grags zhabs drung tā bla ma ngag dbang dpal ldan sogs skya ser mang po la gtsug tor 'bar ba'i rjes gnang dang lam gtso'i khrid bla dpon che rim pa'i skor la bla ma'i rnal 'byor snyan brgyud thun mong ma yin pa'i dmigs khrid bcas stsal/ ja sag gi rim gror 'jigs byed zhi ba'i sbyin sreg 'go ba'i lha lnga'i gsol mchod lha mo dang lcam sring gi bskang gso dge 744

ga / /sdebatsun thazang bas lad+madagaragaca'ekhakamatshan spel chog dang bcas gsungs/ ja sag gi a ke 'jigs med skal bzang rdo rje dang tas ching thu sa lag chi nyi ma rgyal mtshan so sos gdan drangs nas bsnyen bkur zhus pa'i re 'bras bskangs/ dpon pos gtsos pa'i ho sho'u thun mong nas brtan bzhugs kyi rten 'brel bsgrigs te maṇ+ḍal kha btags sku gsung thugs rten bzhugs gdan rgyab yol dngul srang bzhi brgya dang lnga bcu rnga rta dgu dre'u gnyis bcas phul zhing zhabs pad brtan pa'i gsol ba btab 'dir nyin bdun bzhugs ring la nyin re bzhin mjal ba mang por phyag dbang chos 'brel sngar rgyun ltar mdzad/ wang gi thu sa lag chi dbang ldan ngo g.yog gdan 'dren du 'byor ba bzhin bcu bdun la de nas btegs zhabs drung tā bla ma ngag dbang dpal ldan gyis gdan drangs nas bsnyen bkur zhus/ u lan tho lo gos la nyi ma gu shrīs lha khang bzhengs rgyu'i gnas gzigs dang phyag nas zhus phebs lam du wang gi bla ma lo tsā pa chos rje thu sa lag chi 'jam dpal rdo rje tha'i ji mi rin tshe brtan sogs drag zhan du ma'i chibs bsu ser sbreng dang bcas wang gi ho ro la babs/ ja sag gi a ke sogs chibs skyel ba rnams phyir log bsam 'grub thu sa lag chi'i a ma dang dpon mo a ke tho yon tsan+d+ra thi sogs cung gar pe zi'i shog gi drag zhan du ma mjal khar 'byor cing thu sa lag chi'i a mas dngos 'bul gya nom pa phul/wangagi a pe gnyis dang wang btsun mo blon 'khor bcas skya ser mang po la bde mchog dkar po dang phyag rdor gtum khyung rta mgrin gsang sgrub rnams kyi rjes gnang stsal rim gror rta mgrin gtor zlog dang rgyal rdzong dge mtshan spel chog bcas mdzad/ wang gtsos pa'i blon 'bangs rnams kyis maṇ+ḍal kha btags sku gsung thugs rten/ bzhugs gdan rgyab yol mang nog gcig dngul srang nyis brgya rnga mong gcig rta brgyad bcas brtan bzhugs lugs su 745

༄/ /gung thang bstan ba'isgraname'i gsung 'bum/phula.a pe che chung gnyis kyis rang rang gi ur ger gdan drangs shing bsnyen bkur zhus/ nyer gcig la phyir o thog tu chibs kha bsgyur pa'i lam zhor du bkra shis chos 'khor gling du lo tsā ba bla ma skal bzang grags pas gdan drangs nas gsol ston 'bul ba zhus jo khang la rab gnas rta thog ma gnang / zhi bar sku skyes kyis gdan drangs te 'dod chos 'ga' zhig zhus mang kes la dbu mdzad dar rgyas spun gnyis kyi gur nang du bzhugs zhag gnang / nyi shu gnyis la u'u shing khā bkra shis kyi khyim du gung tshigs dang chos rje chos 'byor khu dbon gnyis kyi gur du zhag bzhugs zhus gung zhag gi sa de rnams su skya ser gyi khrom chen la phyag dbang chos 'brel sngar rgyun ltar gnang / nyi shu gsum la bya khyung ja lang gi khyim du gung babs cha gan ca ta ga'i tha bin gye su me la zhag bab nyi shu bzhi la tha bin su me'i chos rje bsod nams sogs ser skya spyi mang la seng ldeng nags sgrol gyi rjes gnang stsal/ o thog chos grags nang so'i sar gung tshigs dang ja lang ma shi cir gal gyi khyim du zhag bzhugs zhus nyi shu lnga la ma shi cir gal gza' mi rnams la rta mgrin gsang sgrub kyi rjes gnang sogs stsal/ khe shig thu mi rin dang dge slong ngag dbang gnyis kyis lamanas gsol ston zhus te dpal dar gling du babs/ or du su wang gi slob dpon chos bstan pa dang phas than tā pa thag sogs skyel mi rnams u lā dang bcas phyir log / nyi shu bdun nas nyin gsum gyi ring la sbyin bdag gi rim gror lha mo'i bam skong gsungs te mjug tu bsgral chog dang zlog pa mdzad/sngaranas nyams snang du gshis ngan gyis shi ba 'ga' zhig rgyun ldan byung nas sgonalam log 'debs byed kyin 'dug par de la dmigs nas rim gro 'di bsgrubs pa yin pas mtshan mo zhig khyi dang byi la sogs yongs med cing mtha' skor gyi mchod gtor sogs la skyon gang yang med par bam ro gcig pu sus 746

༄/ /rjebatsun bzangacho minyama'igagangagagasapas khasadabyunganakhyer cha med du song zhing / grub nyin ched dmigs kyi shog ling spel tshig can bsregs pa'i me lce las 'ur sgra dang tshag sgra grags shing shog ling gi sne gcig ma tshigs par shor ba la me lce dum bu zhig chad nas bzung ba sogs ltas mtshan khyad par can byung ba bzhin sngar gyi nyams snang de'ang mtshams de nas khegs song gsung 'dug pa ni gdab las gnang du bsnun pa'i grub 'bras su mngon/ dgung lo drug cu pa me pho 'brug gi gnam lo gsar du tshes pa'i dga' ba dang po'i nyin dgon pa'i bla ma dge 'dun sbyin bdag tā pe li yum sras dang thu sa lag chi sogs dpon blon che rim rnams kyis bla brang nas mjal ba dang 'du khang chen mor ston mo zhus/ tshes gnyis la pe li'i yā mon du dga' ston thog glu len dang stobs rtsal 'gran pa sogs kyi gzigs mo bstar phyir phebs te mkhan po cha gān bla ma dang rab 'byams pa byams pa bstan 'dzin gnyis la mgon po bar chad kun sel dang snying zhugs kyi rjes gnang stsal/ tshes gsum la mtshan nyid grwa tshang gi 'du khang du gdan drangs nas gsol ston drangs shing brtan bzhugs phul bar rten 'brel bstod pa dang 'dul ba rgya mtsho'i snying po'i ljags lung gnang / tshes bzhi la hang kin pe zi'icu po tho yon blo bzang bkra shis ngo g.yog 'ongs nas pe zi'i 'bul ba dngulasrang lnga bcu rnga mong gcig rta brgyad bcas phul te dpon po'i sku don dang rang gi 'dod chos zhus pa'i re ba bskangs 'di nyin skar ma bzang pas lam 'bud la phebs te phyir 'byor 'phral bla ma dge 'dun rnams kyis rten 'brel gang legs bsgrigs/ pa ga ho ro'i gdan 'dren pa tha'i ji sko na sidhi ngo g.yog gis u lā khyer 'ongs pa bzhin der phebs te zhag lnga bzhugs nyin re bzhin skya ser stong phrag mang po la mjal kha chos sbyin stsal/ mkhan po cha gan blam dang ca khir chi arja sirnyis gtsos pa'i dpon 'bangs thun mong gi rim 747

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'isgroname'i gsung 'bum/groradage mtshan spel chog dang spyi chos su rdor sems mi 'khrugs pa klu dbang rgyal po bcas kyi rjes gnang stsal/ thun mong nas brtan bzhugs kyi rten 'brel bsgrigs te maṇ+ḍal kha btags sku gsung thugs rten bzhugs gdan rgyab yol gyis sna drangs te dngul dang rnga rta sogs kyi 'bul pa spam mtho ba btegs/casar chi'i dpon mo nad drag pos btab 'dug pa la rim gror bzang spyod 'chi blu sogs bka' drin bskyangs/ cha gan bla ma car gu tshi lha dbang a ke mgon po srung thu sa lag chi dharma dha tu tha'i ji lha dbang rdo rje tha'i ji dzā na sidhi rnams kyis gdan drangs nas bsnyen bkur zhus par so sor chos bka' gang 'dod du stsal/ tshes dgu la phyir dgon par phebs ho sho'i spyi chos su lam khrid cig gnang dgos zhus pa bzhin dgon pa'i bla grwa dang pe li yum sras kyis gtsos pa'i dpon blon dmangs bcas dang zhi bar sku skye ye shes rgyal mtshan ngo g.yog sogs phyogs 'dus dang bcas gzhi byes kyi ser skya sum stong brgal bar tshes bcu nas brtsams te bde lam gyi khrid nyin bcu gcig gi ring stsal par snga dro mjal ba mang por phyag dbang chos 'brel dang phyi dro lam rim chos thun ring po rer gsung bshad don zab la rgya che'ang gdul bya'i rna bar skyel mkhas pa'i dbang gis mchog dman kun gyis go bde bas rgyud 'khul nges pa re gnang / bco lnga'i nyin 'byor ldan rnams kyis mchod pa rnam lnga khrir nye ba bshams te dad 'dus kyi skye pho mo gsar du bsnan pa dang bcas ser skya bdun stong tsam la byang chub kyi sems kyi phan yon de nyid theg pa chen po'i lam gyi srog tu 'gyur tshul 'di dang phyi mar sems bskyed mi nyams pa'i thabs la slob lugs sogs kyi gsung bshad 'byam klas pa dang sems bskyed mchod pa rgyas par stsal te bla na med pa'i byang chub mchog gi rgyu thun mong ma yin pa rin chen sems kyi sa bon grub po 'debs par mdzad/ phyi dro smon lam gyi tshogs dbu 748

༄/ /chabatsug bzangartsa minyama'ig4gagasapabadakhacodabyungakamadzad cing mtshan mo mchod phreng la phebs nas mchod gar la gzigs rtog gnang / nyi shu'i nyin khrid yongs rdzogs grub pa'i mjug tu lam rim gsol 'debs dang smon lam nyid kyis mdzad pa'i bla ma rgyang 'bod rnams kyi ljags lung gnang dpon slob tshang mas bzang spyod dang byams smon sogs gsungs nas thugs smon rgya cher mdzad spyi sger so so nas kyang chos yon gzabs/'di dus bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen chos grwa pa mang bas lung rigs kyi spros pa rgyas pa'i sgo nas dgag gzhag mdzad cing dben sa snyan brgyud kyi man ngag gis brgyan te blo rab 'bring tha gsum gyi nyams su len lugs dang sbyar nas go bde zhing yid 'khrul ba'i gzab bshad lo tsā pa la sog skad du bsgyur bcug ste brda 'byor nges gnang ba yin pas skad rigs mi shes pa'i skye pho mo mang pos kyang rgyu mtshan nges nas rgyud la thar pa'i sa bon thebs nges pa'i dge rtsa bla med bskrun cing dga' ba'i ca co sgrogs pas dus 'da' bar gyur to/ /bka'atshos kyi seng bar la sngags pa grwa tshang du gdan drangs nas gsol ston 'bul ba zhus shing tshogs par 'jam dpal nag po'i rjes gnang dang sgrubs thab kyi lung yu shing pe zi'i tho yon blo bzang bskal bzang la lcam sring gi rjes gnangabacas stsal/ de nas nyin kha shas kyi ring ja sag dpon po sku mched gnyis dang zhi bar sku skye zhabs drung tā bla ma rnams la rig byed ma'i bsnyen yig gi khrid dang lung 'jigs byed rdzogs rim gyi khrid dge bskos blo bzang shes rab sogs la lcang skya rol pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa'i klu gtor gyi cho ga'i lung mtshan nyid mkhan po dang rab 'byams pa blo bzang yon tan gnyis la lha mo shra ma ṇi'i rjes gnang mtshan nyid mkhan po dang bla ma dbu mdzad kyis gtsos pa'i grwa tshang gnyis kyi dge 'dun hrag bsdus la rdor sems dang klu dbang rgyal po'i rjes gnang rta mgrin chos skor tshang ma dang rgyal gsol rdo rje'i sgra dbyangs 749

༄/ /gung thang bstan ba'i name'i gsung 'bum/chos skyong gi 'khu ldog zhi ba'i man ngag nyid kyi gsung 'ga' zhig sogs ljags lung du ma dang / pe li'i a ke skal bzang mi 'gyur tshe brtan sogs slob ma mang tsam la rta mgrin gsang sgrub bog tse dmag zor ma gsum gyi rjes gnang a kegacig pu la ku ru kul+le'i rjes gnang sogs don gnyer can so so la rang rangagi skal ba dang 'tsham pa'i zab rgyas chos kyi dga' ston char bzhin phab/nyi shu drug gi nyin rgyud pa grwa tshang gis gdan drangs nas gsol ston dang zhabs brtan phul/ tā bla ma bstan pa thar ba dang bla ma dbu mdzad gnyis kyis gtsos pa'i dge 'dun tshang mar rnam rgyal lha dgu'i rjes gnang bla ma lnga bcu pa 'dul ba rgya mtsho'i snying po nyid kyis mdzad pa'i rnam rgyal stong mchod kyi cho ga'i lngags lung bcas gnang / nyi shu bdun la tshogs chen 'du khang du spyan drangs nas bla ma dge 'dun rnams tshe dpag gi brtan bzhugs kyi cho ga gsung ba dang sbrags nas sbyin bdag pe li don grub tshe ring gis maṇ+ḍal kha btags sku gsung thugs rten bzhugs gdan rgyab yol dngul srang stong phrag gcig dang brgya tham pa bcas phul/ nyi shu brgyad la pe li'i yā mon du gsol ston zhus shing phying dkar la ras sngon po sprad nas g.yogs pa'i gzim gur spus gtsang gos chen tshos gnyis ma'i yol ba gdan cha cha tshang rang gi spyon pa'i rtse ma chu sram gye ta hu bcas phul nas skyabs 'jug nan tan zhus par bka' lan bzang po dang dpon po yum sras la dzam bha la ser po'i rjes gnang dang bde mchog dkar po'i tshe dbang gnang nyi shu dgu la u shing pe zi po yan thas sku mched gnyis chibs skyel du 'byor par sor 'brang ma dang sgrol dkar gyi rjes gnang stsal pe zis pu la han ta hu dang dngul srang lnga bcu bcas phul/gnyis pa'i tshes gcig la gzhi byes kyi ser skya mang po la mjal kha dang sgrol ma'i 'don thabs 'dod dgu'i mchog sbyin gyi lngags lung gnang / tshogs 750

༄/ / rjebatsotshosazangachos nyisa'igasangagatsosatshadabasadabyunganachen 'du khang du gsol ja dkar spro zhus te dge 'dun mang gis dar 'bod dang chibs rags kyi zhal phyir slog pa sogs rten 'brel gang legs kyis thon sbyin bdag tā pe li dang u shing pe zi dgon pa'i bla ma las sne sogs drag zhan brgya phrag du mas chibs skyel ring thung dang bcas phebs te tsha zhag gar bab tu mjal ba mang po phyag dbang chos 'brel gyis tshim par mdzad/ wang don grub rgya mtsho'i nu mo tho yon blo bzang skyid ngo g.yog dang rka nying ho thon ma bu a ke skal bzang rdo rjes gza' mi rnams kyis lam nas gsol ston pheb rdzong zhus/pe li'i sman pa grwa tshang gi mkhan po rgyal mtshan chos 'phel sogs bla ma las sne'i chibs bsu ser sbreng dang bcas tshes lnga'i nyin sman pa grwa tshang du 'byor te zhag lnga bzhugs/ seng bar rnams su mjal pa mang por phyag dbang chos 'brel dang thas ji yar 'phel dang phas than tā a pa tas mi rin ching pa thu sogs mchod gzhis thun mong nas gsol ba btab pa bzhin gzhi byes kyi ser skya stong lhag la spyan ras gzigs bcu gcig zhal gyi dbang chen sta gon dang bcas pa gnang ste bla na med pa'i byang chub mchog gi rgyu thun mong ma yin pa mtshan bcas mtshan med kyi lam bzang 'grub pa'i nus pa khyad par can rgyud la bskrun/ grwa tshang spyi nas zhus pa bzhin mkhan po gtsos pa'i dge 'dun brgya phrag kha shas la rta mgrin gsang sgrub dang mgon dkar yid bzhin nor bu lcam sring bcas kyi rjes gnang bzang spyod rgyal dbang bskal bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung gi sprung gnas cho ga tsha gsur dang brgya rtsa nyid kyi bka' rtsom gra'i ljags lung du ma bcas stsal/ grwa tshang yon mchod kyis shangs len dang mchod sprin bstar mkhan po rgyal mtshan chos 'phel gyis sger 'bul gzabs/ tshes bcu la rta thab dang bcas rim gyis chibs bskyod 'di dus nyin gcig zhal nas mdang mi lam du phyi rgol pa zhig dang tshogs gleng bgyis nas kha rgyal gyis tshar 751

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i name'i gsung 'bum/gcod pa zhig rmis pas gcig gis kha mchu'i mgo brtsam gyin yod pa'i ltas su mngon kyang rgyal kha nged kyis thob pa 'dra gsung ba phyis de bzhin byung / a lag sha'i wang gi nu bo gung dang rje drung mkhan po tshe dbang thu sa lag chi sogs drag zhan gyi phebs bsu dang bcas bcu drug la pa yan gol gyi lha khang du gdan drangs pa bzhin phebs rje drung mkhan po dang gung dpon po sogs gzhi byes kyi ser skya'i khrom chen por skyabs 'gro dang sman chog bsdus pa'i ljags lung phyag dbang bcas stsal/ sbyin bdag chen wang dbang chen dpal 'bar 'khor bcas kyis chibs bsu ja thab ser sbreng dang bcas ya mon du babs/o thog tā pe'i li'i phas than tā a pa tas dang ja lang pā pe'i sogs drag zhan lnga bcu tsam u lā dang bcas phyir slog / sbyin bdag wang gi yā mon dang rje drung mkhan po'i bla brang o'u ye gung chi ye dpon po rnams kyi khang par rim pas gsol ston zhus/ cha har bka' 'gyur pa bla ma dang su nyid g.yas ru'i tho yon tā bla ma hu thog thu bla ma hal ha er ti ni tho yon chos rje rnams kyis mjal bar so sor 'dod chos dang hal ha'i chos rje dang bka' 'gyur pa bla ma sogs la bla ma'i rnal 'byor gye khrid lung rta mgrin chos skor gye chos tshan du ma 'chi med rdo rje lha mo'i sgrub thabs bcas kyi ljags lung stsal zhing zhabs drung blo bzang bstan rgyal ba'i drung nas dud sol lha me'i rjes gnang gsan/ wang gong ma'i dur khang du brab sngags dang gang ser ma'i shis brjod mdzad wang gi rim gror mgon po'i zhi rgyas dbang gsum gyi sbyin sreg 'go ba'i lha lnga'i gsol mchodartsod dang rmi lam ngan pa sel ba'i sgrol ma'i sgrub mchod ho sho'u'i rim gror klu khang du klu bum gter du sbas shing chu mig la rab gnas dang klu gtor rta mgrin gsang sgrub kyi gtor zlog dang sprags nas sri mnan bcas bsgrubs te nyi shu dgu'i nyin gtor rgyag gnang / gsum pa'i tshes gcig nas thu sa 752

༄/ /rdzobamaglebazangachosakyi nyi ga4gtsokhod+madakhatshadabyung/lag chi tshe dbang dang thu sa lag chi rnam rgyal sogs blon po rnams la seng ldeng nags sgrol gyi rjes gnang rje drung mkhan pos gtsos pa'i grwa pa mang tsam la spyan ras gzigs seng ge sgra dang seng gdong ma gnyis kyi rjes gnang rta mgrin chos skor nang gi brtan bzhugs 'chi blu sogs ljags lung du ma/ wang dang gung rje drung mkhan po sogs ser skya'i khrom chen por rta mgrin dang gdugs dkar gyi rjes gnang rgyal ba dge 'dun rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i rta mgrin gyi sgrub thabs gdugs dkar mchog grub ma nyid kyi zhabs brtan gsol 'debs dge legs 'dod 'jo sogs kyi ljags lung dang rje drung mkhan po sogs la lha mo'i rjes gnang stsal/ rje drung mkhan po'i ma yum sogs bsgrub bya lnga la dge bsnyen ma gzhan bsgrub bya dgu la rab byung bcu gnyis dge tshul nyer gcig la bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa bcas gnang / spyi chos su lam khrid cig gnang dgos zhus pabazhin tshes bcu nas dgon pa'i 'du khang du sbyin bdag wang dang rje drung mkhan pos gtsos pa'i gzhi byes kyi skya ser drag zhan stong lhag la bde lam gyi khrid nyin bdun gyi ring gzab bshad gnang / 'di nyin snga dro'i cha la rlung nag chen po 'tshub nas mun nag 'thib ste khang ba'i nang du ting lo spar dgos pa byung 'dug na'ang phyi dro lam khrid dbu btsugs pa nas bzung ste rlung yang je 'jam du song nas bka' chos grub rags la gnam gshis kyang snga dus dang mi 'dra ba legs pa zhig byung / bco lnga'i snga dro rje drung mkhan po sogs ser skya mang po la theg chen gso spyong gi sdom pa phog cing sman chog bsdus pa sman bla'i gsol 'debs byams pas dam bca' byams smon rnams kyi ljags lung stsal/phyi dro 'du khang dang lha khang so sor mchod pa rgya chen po bshams te wang dang mkhan po sogs sngar gye chos nyan pa'i steng du gung dpon po dang chi ye shi ye de dag gi btsun mo sras mo nyug rum pa rnams dang phyogs 'dus kyi skye pho mo mang 753

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'isgraname'i gsung ཿma/po bcas ser skya nyis stong brgal par sems bskyed mchod pa gnang / rje drung mkhan po e'u ye gung chi ye rnams kyis yang bskyar gdan drangs nas so sos bsnyen bkur zhus/ hal ha mer gon wang rdo rje skyabs sku mched gnyis ma yum ha thun e ji zhabs drung chos rje bstan pa rgya mtsho tā bla ma chos 'dzin mai rin ja lang sogs skya ser mang po ched dmigs kyis mjal du 'ongs par grub rgyalalugs kyi tshe dbang drag po gsum dril gyi rjes gnang dga' ldan lha brgya ma'i 'pho khrid tshe bdag mgon po'i gter chog gi ljags lung wang la dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa bcas stsal/ mir gen wang gis brtan bzhugs kyi rten 'brel bsgrigs te maṇ+ḍal kha btags sku gsung thugs rten bzhugs gdan rgyab yol gos chen legs pa yug bcu dngul srang stong phrag gcig bcas phul/rje drung mkhan po thu sa lag chi rnam rgyal ca khir chi kun dga' sogs la mgon po par chad kun sel lha mo seng ldeng nags sgrol ma 'jam dbyangs dkar po rnams kyi rjes gnang dang sgrub thabs du ma'i ljags lung sogs stsal/ sbyin bdag wang dang mkhan po mer gen wang sogs drag zhan mang po la bde mchog dkar po'i tshe dbang stsal/ sbyin bdag chin wang gis yumon du gdan 'dren zhus nas gsol ston drangs shing brtan bzhugs kyi 'bul bar maṇ+ḍal kha btags gos chen bzang ba yug dgu bu la han gyi phags pa dgu wa nag gi pags pa gcig rgya dngul rdo tshad bcu rnga mong lnga bcu lug lnga brgya bcas dang btsun mo rnams kyis gos bzang gis grub pa'i bzhugs gdan rgyab yol dang gos skyugs khug ma sogs phul/ der bzhugs ring la gzhi byes kyi mjal ba drag zhan mang po zam ma chad du byung bar mjal kha chos sbyin sogs gang 'dod du stsal/ nyi shu gsum la sbyin bdag chin wang dang mer gon wang sogs dponablon du ma'i chibs skyel ja thab dang bcas chibs bsgyur bum pa thu la 754

༄/ /sdebatsug bzabachosakyinyima'ibagangagasumapamadakhasadabyungakadwags po tshang gi dgon pa'i hu thog tu bla ma chos rje dem chi sogs grwa ba mang tsam gyis bsnyen bkur zhus shing lngags lung 'ga' zhig zhus/ rje drung mkhan pos chibs skyel zhor du man ngag lhan thabs kyi ljags lung gsan te cab sar nas phyir log / shi rig do lon la ca khir chi kun dga'i dpon mo ngogayog 'ongs nas mjal kha dang seng ldeng nags sgrol gyi rjes gnang zhus/thu sa lag chi tshe dbang gis gsol ston zhus par sgol ljang gi rjes gnang stsal/bzhi pa'i tshes la tā ke tā nas bla brang gi chos rje bstan 'dzin bzang po ngo g.yog chibs bsur 'byor nas mjal kha zhus par gnas tshul zhib 'dri mdzad/ zan yang khrang rgya sgo'i dpon po tsong yes ya mon du gdan drangs nas mjal 'phrad dang gsol ja zhus/ de nas dgon lung spyi sger gyi phebs bsu ring thung tsong kha dpa' ri pho rod kyi dgon sgrub sde ris med sum cu skor gyi zhabs drung sku skye bla ma las sne mchod gzhis mi skya drag zhan ci rigs klu skyabs dpon po che chung sogs chibs bsu thab bsu bcas rim gyis chibs bskyod nas tshes bcu gcig gi nyin dge 'dun mang gi ser spreng mchod rol dang bcas gdan sar babs/ 'di res mar tshang gi zhag bzhugs thog rgya nag gser khri sprul sku rin po che ngag dbang thub bstan 'phrin las rgya mtsho pas dgra bcom pa lnga brgya tshang ba'i phyag phreng gis mtshon khyad mtshar can gyi bca' lag 'ga' zhig phul/ dgongs bzhed ltar sbyor ba'i chos drug snyan brgyud man ngag gis brgyan pa'i khrid dang rta mgrin gsang sgrub kyi rjes gnang bcas 'bul ba gnang zhag gcig lhan du bzhugs nas bka' mchid kyang 'phel/a lag sha'i chibs skyel pa tha'i ji dharma pā la dang tsang ki gnyis sogs ul mi u lag dang bcas phyir slog par mdzad/ dgon lung sogs dgon sgrub sde rnams su mang 'gyed slob ma sbyin bdag rnams la gnang sbyin stsal/ o'u 755

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'isgroname'i gsung 'bum/hananas wang paṇ+ḍi ta zhabs drung rin po ches skyabs mgon nyid kyi dgung lo drug cu'i dga' ston du brtan bzhugs 'bul rgyu'i bkod khyab gnang ba ltar phyag mdzod chos rjes bco lnga'i dus chen gyi nyin wang bla brang du gdan drangs nas gsol ston dang brtan bzhugs kyi rten 'brel bsgrigs te maṇ+ḍal kha btags tshe lha'i li sku sku thang tshag drub gser zangs kyi mchod rten rgyan phreng gos chen sna tshogs las drub pa'i bkra shis rtags brgyad tshar nyer gcig tshag drub kyi pad+ma brgya rtsa brgyad gos skud sna tshogs kyis dkris pa'i bdug spos nyer gcig dri bzang thum bu du ma cod paṇa gnyis/ dril gdan gos chen yug lnga dngul srang brgya gos kyi khug ma rgam bcas gcan gzan gyi pags rigs dgu tshan gcig nor bu don yod zhags pa bcas phul/ gzhi byes kyi slob ma sbyin bdag rnams kyis 'byor mjal sogs kyi brel ba bsal nas skyed tshal yid dga' chos 'phel du phebs dbyar dang ston gyi ring phal cher der bzhugs nas thugs dam dang dpe gzigs gtso bor mdzad/ sog yul du phebs skabs gsol tshigs la byung ba'i sha rnams nas rus rdog re bsdus te khyer yong bar thugs dam gye skabs su ljags bsngags dang bsngo smon gyi spyan dmigs yang dag gnang ste ri khrod pa rnams la sbyang yon dang bcas sprad/ zhal nas na ning nged rang sog yul du chas dus lug 'di rnams bla ma zhig 'ongs nas mgo la me tog dmar po'i dbang bskur ba zhig rmis yod 'gro gsung nas skyi g.ya' ba'i rnam pa mdzad cing 'on kyang sog yul du dgun dus rang rang gi gro shar dmigs nas lug mang po bsad nas sha bsdus 'jog pa zhig yin pas/'di'i nang na nga la ched gnyer gyis bsad pa'i lug mang po med pas cung dga' sha zos pa'i lan chags ni sbyang chog 'dis 'jal 'gro mod gsung ba ni spyir lang gshegs sogs nas gsungs pa bzhin nyes dmigs che ba dang /756

༄/ /rjebatsug ba4chosaminyima'ig4gtsosabadabamasarakade sbyong ba'i thabs mkhas rgyud sde las gsungs pa bzhin bsgrub tu yod pas rangagis rang gces pa rnams kyis blang dor 'di bzhin byed dgos so zhes rjes 'jug rnams la 'doms par mdzad pa gor ma chag go / lo snga mar bod nas byung ba'i yi ge rnams kyi 'byor lan bsgrigs shing de'i khrod na khams nags shod stag phu ri khrod nas rab 'byams pa blo bzang bsam gtan gyis phulaba'i zhu yig tu/ skabs su bab pa'i gsol ba 'debs pa ni gus phran skyabs 'og pa bdag gis sems can yin na sangs rgyas nges yin pas khyab pa bsams nas stag phu sprul sku rin po cher bdag skye ba phyi ma gang du skye sangs rgyas su'i bstan pa la mthong lam 'thob zhus pa'i lan du/ sku nyid kyi gsang lung du rten 'brel 'grigs na de bzhin gshegs pa zla ba ltar shar ba'i zhabs drung du rab tu byung ste bden pa mthong bar 'gyur zhes lung bstan par gyur pas slar yang bskyar du bde gshegs zla ltar shar ba'i sku'i skye ba da lta gang na bzhugs pa'i lan du sgu rin po che nyid yin par gsal bar lung bstan byung bas/ sku rin po che nyid kyis bdag skye ba nas skye ba thams cad du 'bral med rjes su 'dzin cing bdag gis kyang skyabs mgon khyed nyid mnyes pa gsum gyis mnyes pa kho na bsgrub cing mi mnyes pa skad cig tsam mi bsgrub pa dang khyad par mgon po khyed nyid bskal bzang 'dir de bzhin gshegs pa zla ba ltar shar ba zhes bya ba'i mchog gi sprul pa'i skur mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa'i tshe bdag 'dus pa'i 'khor gyi thog ma nyid du gyur te zag pa med pa'i chos rnams mngon sum du byas te bla na med pa'i byang chub tu lung bstan pa'i lung bstan 'thob pa sogs kyi skyabs 'jug brtse bas gzigs pa mkhyen mkhyen zhes zhus 'dug par/ lan du sprul sku rin po che'i gsang lung la 'gyur ba med pas dgongs gzhi dgos pa yod 'gro'ang nged rang la de 757
