༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/'dra'i re ba rmi lam du'ang med/ 'on kyang dad pa byas na rdo las ring bsrel byung ba'i dpe ltar nyid nas mos gus dang thugs smon mdzad na 'dod don 'grub pa gzhir bcas zhes pa tsam las ma gnang / de las 'phros te bka' slob nang ma 'ga' zhig la gsung 'phros gnang bar dgongs gzhi dang dgos pa ci yin ma shes nged rang bod na yod dus pa ri rdo rje 'chang gi drung nas lam rim chen mo'i bshad lung nyan par bla ma des khyed rang de bzhin gshegs pa sprin kun tu ston par sangs rgyas nas chos kyi 'khor lo skor rgyu yin mod gsung / bla ma de nyid gzhan la lung bstan gnang mkhan min yang nged rang la ma zhus par de ltar gsungs pa yin/ da res stag phu sprul sku'i lung bstan la de bzhin gshegs pa zla ba ltar shar bar 'tshang rgya rgyu gsung 'dug nged rang da dung ngan song la mi ltung rgyu bla ma dkon mchog la gsol ba 'debs kyin yod ces gsungs/ zla ba lnga par zi lang du phebs nas am bhan gsar ba tshe dpag dang mjal phrad thog 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa rin po che'i sprul sku'i dogs gnas rnams 7gong mar snyan sgron 'bul rgyu'i zhu sna mdzad/ am bhan gyis sngar rje nyid har chin thu med du bzhugs skabs nged rang gor ban su bor ga'i char go chi la bsdad yod pas ched gnyer gyis pe zi'i yā mon du song nas nyid la mjal kha zhus par nyid nas gsung 'phros shig la spar zi ling am bhan du yong dus nged tsho'ang thug yong gsungs pa yin/ de dus nged kyi semasal am bhan zhig tu 'phar rgyu yid kyi dku na med na'ang da res lung bstan thog tu babs nas 'ongs pa 'di'o zhes zhus nas dad gus bla na med pa mdzad cing gsung gleng shin tu 'phel/ rim gro zhig gnang dgos tshul zhus pa bzhin sku 'bum gyi grwa pa bcu skor dang bcas nyi ma gnyis la spyi bskang dang sgrol ma sogs rkyen sel gyi rim gro mang du bsgrubs am bhan gyis kyang shin tu 758

༄/ /chubatsunarākhazang bsangag mapabadakanashān khanadaga' ba'i rnam pa dang dngos 'bul gzabs/ 'di dus sum pa bla brang dang hu hu'i sde 'ga' zhig gis nags don brtsad nas gtam gleng chen po byung bar sa sgo'i dpon pos hu hus kyi rgyab byas nas bla brang la mi 'tsham pa'i bsnyadagatser rgyu rdzas ha cang tshod med blangs yod na'ang da dung gyod thag ma bcad par yun bsrings 'dug pa la sum pa chos rjes rje nyid kyi snyan du gsol zhing nyid nas zi ling gi phu'u thas ye la bkod khyab gnang ste sa sgo'i dpon pos rgyu rdzas tshod med blangs pa phyir bla brang du spyod bcug cing kha mchu'ang mi ring bar bde 'jags su song / phyir skyed tshul du byon te rgya nag gser khri rin po che pho brang du phyir 'byon nye bar mtshams zhus dang phebs rdzong 'bul mi mngags/ gser dgon gyi ri khrod pa grags pa rnam rgyal dang ngag dbang bsod nams gnyis kyis rgyud la gang phan gyi chos shig zhus par nyid kyis mdzad pa'i bla ma rgyang 'bod kyi bshad lung 'phral phugs kyi zhal ta bcas dang /mdung nag sgom pas zhus ngor sems nyid zhabs drung em chi chos rje dge 'dun chos bzang ri khrod pa rnams dang bcas don gnyer pa mang tsam la bla ma mchod pa'i khrid dang bde lam gyi nyams khrid gnad 'dril zhing myong ba la bskor bas rgyud 'khul nges pa gtor ma brgya rtsa klu gtor chu gtor dzam bha la dkar nag ser gsum gyi chu sbyin rnams kyi khrid lung / lcang skya rin po ches mdzad pa'i rta mgrin gsang sgrub kyi sgrub thabs dang 'jigs byed kyi sgrub thabs 'jam dpal dgongs rgyan sogs lngags lung 'ga' zhig dang sku 'bum gye rgyar tshang sgom pas zhus ngor stag phu pa'i lam rim sngon 'gro gsal ba'i lung dngabla ma'i rnal 'byor don gnyis lhun grub ma'i khrid mjug tu sngags lugs phyag chen gyi khrid mdor bsdus bcas dang / seng bar rnams su em chi chos rje dge 'dun la ljags lung thor bu mang po bcas chos sbyin mi zad pa'i dga' 759

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'ithoname'i gsung 'bum/ston bkye ste so so'i rgyud la rnam grol gyi sa bon grung po 'deb par mdzad/zla ba drug par dgon lung du phebs te wang bla brang gi sku skye la rab byung gi sdom pa dang / gzhan bsgrub bya bdun la bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa stsal/ grong sde'isngags pa brgya lhag spyi 'dus kyis zhus ngor dgon pa'i zhabs drung sku skye dka' ram sogs skya ser sum brgya tsam la khros nag lha lnga'i dbang dang gcod kyi yig cha 'ga' lngags lung gnang / wang bla brang gi sku skye dang phyag mdzod chos rje bla brang rang gi gsol dpon bsod nams rnams sog yul du thon nye bar lam chos su sgrol dkar gyi rjes gnang dang wang chos rjes bskul ngor gsar rtsom mdzad pa'i 'khrungs rabs gsol 'debs dge legs kun 'byung gi lung gnang / ja gral thog sku skye dang chos rje gnyis la rdzong ba dang zhabs drung rin po che'i mtshams zhus 'byor lan gsol dpon bsod nams la nang pa'i cho lo dang smon lam bla ma'i phyag g.yog tu sdod rgyu'i bkod khyab mdzad/snga ma nas bod du 'byon rgyu'i thugs dgongs shig yod pa'i steng du rta tshag rin po che nas kyang gsung shog gi lam nas snyan bskul zhu ba gnang ba bzhin lo rjes mar bod du 'byon rgyu'i thugs 'dun gyis zhabs phyi pa rnams la de lugs kyi gra sgrig byed dgos tshul gsung bar gra slob rnams nas rje nyid bod du pheb na bstan 'gro'i don rlabs po che zhig dgongs bzhed ltar 'grub pa gzhir bcas kyang sang phod drug cu re gcig gi dgung gegs yin pa dang byang lam sa mtho zhing thag ring ba bcas gang ci nas mi 'gab tshul sogs phod btsugs pa'i zhu nan yang yang byas te bshol btab/ zhabs sdod rnams kyis de ltar byas pa'ang bla ma'i sku la gces spras su byas par 'dug pas rnam pa gcig tu legs mong kyang spyir yongs 'dzin ye shes rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po dag pa'i zhing du dgongs pa gtad pa nas bstan pa yongs rdzogs kyi gnad 'dril 760

ra / /chebabasem mi ཿshadasab dgakaba'ilam rim gyi 'chad nyan sogs dbyibs su gyur te snyigs ma'i tha ma 'di 'drar song ba'i tshe bstan pa yongs 'dzin la nang byan tshud pa'i rje bla ma nyid ltabu zhig gis bstan pa'i 'byung khungs de nas 'chad nyan gyi ru mtshon zhig bsgrengasan mtha' dbus kun tu phan pa rlabs che ba zhig 'ong gyur snang yang thog tu ma khel pa dus bab kyi dbang btsan par mngon te/ mkhas grub smra ba'i nyi mas/ de lta na yang gangs can bstan pa'i gzhi/ /skye mchog du mas gang du btsugs pa'i gnas/ / da lta'ang dam chos ma lus 'byung ba'i khungs/ /dbus gtsang dag pa'i zhing zhes grags mod kyang / zhes pa nas 'phel yang dgos pa chung bar bdag gis mthong / / zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /zla ba bdun par 'dul ba dgon du gdan drangs pa bzhin phebs rong po zhabs drung khyung tsha zhabs drung sum pa bla brang gi dar han yem chi dang dpon po rnams gtsos pa'i phyi log gi dgon pa rnams kyi bla spyi so so nas ja thab chibs bsu tshan mang po dang dge 'dun mang po'i ser spreng dang bcas bla brang du babs/ tshogs dbur spyan drangs te zhabs brtan dang sbrags nas bdog pa'i dngos po sbam mtho ba phul/ tshogs par sgrol ma'i 'don thabs 'a dod dgu'i mchog sbyin gyi lung bshad pa dang bcas gnang / zhabs brtan du tshe sgrub sgrub ched mang ja sum cu tham pa dang kha btags re'i 'gyed stsal/ sbyin bdag pā rin ching wang a tsa las nyid kyi dgung lo drug cu'i dga' ston du ched gtad btang ba'i mi sna dar han dge bskos dpal bzang khā tshe 'phel ngo g.yog dang / a lag shā ching wang gi mi sna nang so blo gros phun tshogs ngo g.yog rnams dgon lung brgyud nas 'dir 'ongs te mjal kha zhus shing pā rin ching wang gis zhabs pad brtan pa'i gsol 'debs kyi zhu shog dang lhan du rten 'byung gi 'bul ba kha btags nang mdzod tshe dpag med kyi 761

༄/ /yo thang bstan ba'i name'i gsung 'bum/gser sku hā shi'i nor bu don yod zhags pa rgyal mdzod nas byung ba'i rin thang can gyi shel gyi snod spyad dgu tshan mdzod gos yug dgu gos bzang las drub pa'i bzhugs gdan rgyab yol spus gtsang bcas dang / wang gi sras gung gnyis dang ho sho'u de ga'i dpon blon sbyin bdag rnams kyi zhu shog legs 'bul can du ma/ a lag shā ching wang gis bca' lag sna tshogs 'jog pa'i dra mig can gyi kun dga' rwa ba khyad mtshar cha gcig bcas 'bul rgyu bskur ba rnams phul/ gzhan yang yi le'i thor god wang gi mi sna nang so sbyin bdag mtsho skyes pe zi sku mched gnyis dbang phyug ja sag su nyid lā kya nang so tho yon chosadar sogs phyogs yas mas kyi 'grul ba drag zhan mang po mu mthud nas 'ongs par so so'i 'dod pa tshim par mdzad cing bla brang nas de dag la dga' ston bstar/ pe zis zhus ngor drag zhan mang po la phyag rdor dang sgrol dkar gye rjes gnang stsal/ zla ba brgyad par lung dkar ri khrod dang nom chi dgon par bsu ba ser spreng dang bcas gdan drangs nom chi zhabs drung la rab byung gi sdom pa dang / gzhan bsgrub bya sum cu lhag la rab byung dge tshul slong gi sdom pa gnang / tshogs dbur gdan drangs nas gsol ston 'bul ba zhus tshogs par rgyal dbang dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i gsung gi rta mgrin gsang sgrub kyi sgrub thabs dang byams pas dam bca'i gzungs kyi ljags lung dang mang 'gyed kyang stsal/ de nas dgon lung du phebs pā rin wang gi mi sna rnams la bka' lan dang gnang sbyin stsal/ a lag shā wang gi el chir sngon nas wang dang mkhan po sogs kyis yul phyogs der char chu sogs shin tu dkon pa la phan pa'i thabs shig gsol ba btab yod pa bzhin sman dang rdzas sogs gtsang spra tshad dang ldan par byas pa'i klu bum mang po bla grwa bcu lhag gis sgrub pagand smin bgyis yod pa rnams spa tshul gyi zhal bkod dang bcas sprod pa 762

sa / /rjebatsun thazangartsa dzam d+maraganartsa tshur/gnang / phyis su a khag shā la phebs dus che phra thams cad kyis klu bum sbas pa nas bzung ste char chu dus su babs nas rtsa dang lo tog sogs shin tu rgyas pasngar dang mi 'dra ba byung zhes bden pa'i tshig gi gtang rag 'bul mkhan yang mang du byung snang / 'dis mtshon rje nyid kyis sngar bod sog gi yul du sabacud nyams nas lo mang po song ba la klu bum sba ba dang chu mig tu sman 'jug pa ci rigs kyiyortsi shing lo tog 'phel ba sogs byin rlabs kyi tshan kha chenapo byung ba'i lo rgyus ches mang ngo / / sku 'bum gyi bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen mang pos dgon par phebs nas yun ring bzhugs te dam pa'i chos kyi bka' dran gnang dgos tshul yang yang snyan sgron zhus pa bzhin zla pa dgu pa'i nang du chibs bsgyur gnang ste bla spyi drug dang sgar ba khag chen rnams kyi rta thab dge 'dun mang po'i ser sbreng dang bcas sgar ba theg chen chos mdzod du babs/ dgon pa'i khri ba gro tshang mkhan rin po che dang rgyud pa dpon slob sman pa dpon slob rnam gsum gyis gtsos thams cad kyis dgun gyi ring dgon 'dir bzhugs dgos zhes nan zhus byas par re zhig bzhugs rgyu'i zhal bzhes gnang / bla spyi phan tshun du gsol ston dang gsung gleng 'phel smon lam gyi skabs su o thog ja lang ma shi skyabs dang hang gan chos rje ngag dbang dpal 'byor sogs la spyan ras gzigs phyag bzhi pa'i rjes gnang dang ljags lung 'ga' zhig lha bab kyi nyin bsgrub bya lnga la dge tshul dang nyer dgu'i bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa/ mi nyag sprul sku rin po che dang rgyar tshang sgom pa sogs don gnyer can mang po la thog ma'i blo spyong gi gzab bshad lung dang rigs pa dang nyams myong kun gyi skya bar nas bton pa'i yid rang dbang med par 'khul ba zhig gnang / nyan mkhan snga ma'i steng du rgyud pa dpon slobawan kya su zhabs drung sogs zhabs drung sku skye dka' ram mang po bsnan 763

༄/ /gu ca ba na ba'i yogasung ཿma/nas nyan mkhan sumabargya tsam la rje nyid kyi gsung 'bum tshang ma'i ljags lung mi nyag sprul sku sogs nyung 'dus la gsung bka' rgya ma'i skor gyi ljags lung rnams gnang / de nas nyin mang po'i bar du sku mtshams la bzhugs nas rdo rje 'jigs byed dang 'brel ba'i snyan brgyud thun mong ma yin pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor gsar rtsom mdzad de de'i steng nas thugs dam gnang bar dgung gegs las grol pa'i mtshan ma ngo mtshar ba byung ste 'ja' klong 'khyil bar/rang lo drug cu'i dus nub cig rmi lam du dgon pa hrul po zhig nas bla brang lta bu'i khang ba phyi nang mang po yod pa zhig 'dug de'i khang ba nang ma zhig na tshar chen rdo rje 'chang bzhugs yod pa'i nyams dang nged rang khang pa'i 'khyams na yod pa la tshar chen gyis gsung mthon pos mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug ces 'bod pa gnang gi 'dug pa la nged kyis 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse bos pa yin 'dug kyang khong 'dir mi 'dug pa snyam/ de nas bya gshong mkhan chen zhes pos byung pas nged kyi sems la bya gshong mkhan po nged rang yin nam snyam nasa'igs zhes lan phul bas da khyed rang yong rgyu'i rtsol ba bgyid ran zhes gsungs/ nged rang dpal spug ri khrod mang mkhar 'dar grang mo che sogs mjaladagos pas re zhig yong mi thub 'dug ces zhus pas lan ma gnang ba zhig rmis gsung ba ni snga phyi'i 'brel sogs ngo mtshar ba'i dpyad gzhi 'gang che ba du ma can zhig yin par mngon no/ / lnga mchod kyi skabs o thog tā pe'i li'i btsun mo lha mo tshe ring sman pa grwa tshang gi mkhan po rgyal mtshan chos 'phel ho sho'u mi rin bkra shis don grub sogs skya ser brgya lhag gis mjal kha zhus shing dgung lo drug cu'i dga' ston du brtan bzhugs kyi rten 'brel bsgrigs te btsun mos maṇ+ḍal kha btags sku gsung thugs rten bzhugs gdan rgyab yol byi ru'i do shal mu tig chun po gos chen dang dngul sogs kyi 'bul ba gya 764

༄/ /rjebaphug bzangachos gyi ga4gsamumadakhabagayunanom pa btegs/ btsun mos zhus ngor nyan mkhan mang po la spyan ras gzigs mkha' 'gro sde lnga dang bcas pa'i dbang dang sgrol ma'i 'don thabs kyi lung stsal btsun mo dang bla ma sogs la ja gral thog lha rten spos snam sogs gzabs hal ha'i ur the'i tho yon gu thi ngag dbang sbyin pa'i skor la drag po sum dril gyi rjes gnang sogs stsal/ bcu gcig pa'i tshes nas sbyin bdag har chin wang maci badz+ra gyis nyid kyi dgung lo drug cu'i 'khrungs skar gyi dga' ston du ched gtad kyis btang ba'i mi sna wang rang gi a khu e rti ni chos rje sago thi khā pa da rang gos khā pa ya ji hu a ke bsod nams dpal ldan gyi mi sna khā i the ge la thu ngo g.yog dang a lag shā wang gi mi sna ja lang mi 'gyur ngo g.yog or du su cun gang pi zi'i mi sna tā bla ma skal bzang 'jigs med ngo g.yog sogs thag nye ring nas 'khrungs skar gyi dga' ston du yong mkhan brgya phrag du ma rim gyis 'dus/ tshes bdun 'khrungs skar gyi dga' ston nyin sku 'bum tshogs chen gyi tshogs dbur gdan drangs bla spyi drug dang sgar ba khag che chung so so nas dngos 'bul tshan grangs mang po bstar te dge 'dun mang pos zhabs brtan gyi bden tshig gsungs tshogs par rten 'brel bstod pa'i dbu nas bshad pa mdor bsdus dang dge 'dun mang la phyag dbang gnang / gser sdong lha khang du mchod me mtshan thub brgya phrag gsum snyan shal dang bcas mchod mjal gnang ste thugs smon rgya cher mdzad/ de nas sgar ba'i tshom chen du har chen gyi mi sna rnams kyis sbyin bdag wang gi 'bul ba lha rdzas mdzod btags dngul gyi maṇ+ḍal sku gsung thugs rten gos chen tshem drub kyi bzhugs gdan rgyab yol mang nog dang nying khru'u sogs kyi na bza' phu thung bub bzhi shel gye rgyan phreng gcig gos kyi khug ma dgu mu tig bcos ma'i sna dam gcig rten kheb che legs gnyis dar dbyangs gnyis yang chi dmar po'i 765

༄/ /gung bang bstan pa'isgraname'i gsung 'bum/bzed zhal gcig ka ped kyi phor ba gcig gos chen yug bzhi pu la gan lnga dngul srang lnga brgya nor bu don yod zhags pa bcas dang / wang gi a khu a ke lha rgyal rdo rje'i 'bul ba sku gsung thugs rten na bza' bub gsum don yod zhags pa wang gi a khu bsod nams dpal ldan gyis mdzod btags dngul maṇa sgrol dkar gyi gos sku gcig glegs bam gcig mchod rten gcig tshem drub kyi bzhugs gdan rgyab yol rten kheb gnyis dar dpyangs cha ldan bza' bub gsum sogs dang / wang gi dgon pa dge tshogs gling spyi dang dgon pa'i zhabs drung ye shes dpal rgyas tā bla ma gu thi bsam 'grub nyi ma sogs grwa rigs rnams dang / mai rin sho'u mar dang khā nye ba sogs blon po rnams dang har chin rat+na ja sag gi ho sho'u'i smon lam bla ma dang de'i dgon pa pur han thu dang tā lu gnyis kyi spyi dang bla grwa 'ga' zhig cha gān ti yan chi hu thog thu thu med pe zi phun tshogs rin chen thas ji tā han tas ja sag gung gi ho sho'i e phu dkon mchog rgya mtsho bā rin pe zi sogs ho sho'u so so'i sbyin bdag dpon blon rnams dang / pe cing gi stong 'khor sprul sku rin po che zung gru zi'i ja sag bla ma mchod rten dkar po'i ja sag zhabs drung bcas gong smos rnams nas 'khrungs skar gyi dga' ston du bskur ba'i 'bul ba gos dar dngul dang shel dngadakar yol gyi snod spyad sogs bca' lag sna tshogs a lag shā dang cun gar gyi mi sna rnams kyis chin wang dbang chen dpal 'bar sku mched dang pe zi tshe dbang bkra shis thu sa lag chi tshe dbang bsam 'grub so so'i 'bul ba dang /bkra shis 'khyil gyi mi sna rnams kyis 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa rin po che'i bla brang gi 'bul ba lha rdzas mdzod btags dngul gyi maṇ+ḍal sku gsung thugs rten gos chen yug gnyis dngul srang brgya sogs dang tshogs chen spyi thos bsam gling spyi rgyud pa spyi dus 'khor spyi sman pa spyi rnams kyi 'bul ba dang / dgon 766

sa / /chubatsugablosazangartsab41nyis d+madakuras rākhakalung gi lcang skya bla brang sum pa bla brang wang bla brang bde rgu bla brang spyi so chen mo ja tshul spyi btsan khang spyi rdo ba bla brang khyung tsha bla brang li kyā bla brang rnams kyi mi sna sogs dgon lung gi dka' ram dge tshul slong phyed nyis brgya tsam dang /su nyid tho yon zhabs drung har chin tho yon dharma kirte ho'u han sku skye yon tan dar rgyas sogs sku 'bum dang dgon lung gi sog po'i grwa rgyun lnga bcu tsam dang bla brang bkra shis 'od 'bar gyi gser khri sprul skus gtsos pa'i grwa mang dang /dpa' ris phyogs kyi dgon sgrub sde bco lnga tsam gyi bla spyi bya khyung bla brang chen mo sharardzong ri khrod sogs chos sde ri khrod du ma'i mi sna dang stag 'tsher zhabs drung sogs dgon mchod gzhis spyi sger nas dad mos kyis 'ongs pa'i yon bdag mang po dang bcas so so nas che 'byor chung 'byor gyi dngos 'bul rnam grangs mang po bstar te mi nyag sprul sku rin po ches dbu mdzad pa'i dge 'dun mang tsam gyis gnas brtan phyag mchod dang zhabs brtan gsol 'debs sogs gsungs shing mi nyag sprul sku rin po ches zhabs pad brtan pa'i gsol ba nan tan btab par dgyes pa'i bka' lan bzang po gnang / zi ling am bhan tshe dpag gis btang ba'i mi sna thung zi ngo g.yog 'ongs nas am bhan gyis bskur ba'i tshe dpag med kyi sku brnyan lam du 'khru dmar po dang ser po yug re gos kyi khug ma che chung bdun bzang spos bag cha gnyis bcad 'bul rgyu bskur ba rnams phul/ gro tshang mkhan rin po che dang rgyud pa dpon slob sman pa dpon slob sogs sku 'bum gyi bla spyi sgar ba zhag che chung gi che gras sogs gzhi byes thams cad la sgar ba nas dga' ston rgya chen po dang el chi rnams la gnang sbyin mdzad/ 'di res sku 'bum tshogs chen du mang ja dgu dang kha btags dang dung tshe'i 'gyed/ bkra shis 'khyil dgon lung bya khyung sogs gongatsās kyi dgon ri khrod rnams la mang 'gyed gya nom pa bskur ba bcas snga 767

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgronama'igasung 'bum/phyir mdo smad kyi dgon sde che chung rnams su tshe gzungs ring po bye chen gcig dang 'bum phrag nyi shu lhag gzungs thung bye chen gcig dang 'bum phrag sum cu rnam rgyal gzungs ring 'bum phrag bcu lhag dang gzungs thung 'bum phrag mngapo sgol dkar gye snying po bye chen gcig dang 'bum phrag kha shas gdugs sher sgrol gsum gang mang bcas bsgrubs shing / bla brang nang du'ang tshe sgrub dang bsnyen sgrub dang gtor sgrub sogs zhabs brtan stobs chen yang yang bsgrubs pa dang ri khrod pa dang grwa ba thugs dam pa mang po la tshe sgrub dang gtor ma brgya rtsa sogs grangs gsog rgyu gtad pa dang bka' 'gyur dag tshar rten byin rlabs can rnams la mchod thebs bskur ba/ zi ling dang nem bis ru gsar sogs kyi ngan slong phyed nyis stong la sbyin pa btang ba mtsho kha'i nya 'dzin gyi lag nas nya mang po dang zi ling dang ru gsar gnyis kyi bshan pa'i lag nas gsod grab byas pa'i lug sum brgya rnams rin gyis blus pa dang sgroladakar sku thang brgya rtsa brgyad sogs thang ga mang po bzhangs pa bcas lo 'dir zhabs brtan dge sgrub bskor gyi rgyu 'gror dngul srang stong phrag gsum lhag song zhing / bod nas kyang sgo mang dpon slob lha btsun mthu stobs nyi mas rgyal ba rin po che rgyal sras rin po che stag phu sprul sku rin po che gnas chung dos rgyal sogs la brtag zhus byas te lo snga mar bskur ba'i gser srang bzhi bcus rgyu yon sbyar nas 'bras spung tshogs chen dang sgo mang grwa tshang dge 'phel ri khrod rgyud stod smad sogs la mang 'gyed thon tshe gzungs ring thung rnam rgyal gzungs ring sogs zhabs brtan mang po bsgrubs shing jo shāka rnam gnyis la snyan dar zhal gser mchod 'bul sogs dang / 'phags pa wa ti la brgya mchod snyan dar phul ba sogs mchod 'bul dang rnam rgyal ma'i stod thang bzhengs pa sats+tsha dang srog blu grangs bsags pa sogs zhabs brtan rgya chen po 768

༄ / /che badza ske0za pa d+ma gakhag gas/bsgrubs 'dug / gzhan yang lo 'di'i nang du chen po hor gyi yul gru nas gsung las skyes pa'i slob ma dang sbyin bdag rnams kyis dngos dang tshab ma zhu yig ci rigs kyi lam nas dgung lo drug cu'i dga' ston du rten 'byung gi 'bul ba dang re gcig gi dgung gegs zhi phyir rang rang gi dad mos kyis zhabs brtan bsgrubs pa'i tho yig mang du byung / zhal nas spob ma sbyin bdag gis dad mos kyis bsgrubs pa'i zhabs brtan 'di kun slong gi khyad kyis stobs che/ nged tsho'i bla brang nas bsgrubs pa'i zhabs brtan 'di chos brgyad dkar nag khra gsum gang gi mtshan gzhir 'jog pa cha mi chod cing phal cher khra bo'i mtshan gzhir 'jog dgos sam gsum pa ni rjes 'jug rnams la dge ba gang sgrub kyang chos brgyad kyi kun slong gis ma bslad pa gal che zhes 'doms par bya ba'i ched du gsungs par mngon/ su nyid tho yon zhabs drung gis zhus ngor nyan mkhan kha shas la nyid kyis mdzad pa'i lcang skya rol pa'i rdo rje'i rnam thar gyi ljags lung gzhan 'ga' zhig gis zhus ngor dzam dkar lha lnga'i rjes gnang dang lcang skya rol pa'i rdo rje'i gsung gi tshe bdag mgon po'i tshe sgrub kyi lngags lung / sku 'bum tshogs chen dge bskos dang dbu mdzad gnyis kyis bskul ngor sgol dkar dang tshe dpag med kyi tshe sgrub byed tshul gyi cho ga shin tu mdor bsdus gsar rtsom ljags lung bcas gnang / bco lnga'i nyinaphyir 'khor te dgon lung du byon su nyid g.yas ru'i dpon mo mi 'gyur sogs mjal du 'ongs par 'dod mos bzhin rta mgrin gsang sgrub kyi rjes gnang stsal/ hal ha'i nom chi no yon hu thog thu'i mi sna mgon gnyer mchod dpon sogs grwa ba kha shas slebs nas no yon hu thog thu dang thu shi thu hān mgon po pe'i li jo nang gung sogs kyi mtshams zhus phul/ grwa pa rnams la rta mgrinagasang sgrub kyi rjes gnang dang nyid kyi gsung gcod kyi skor rta mgrin 769

/ /gung ༄ na pa'ithonama'i ཿnga 'bum/chos skor gyi le tshan 'ga' zhig gi lngags lung bcas stsal/ 'jam dbyangs bzhadapa rin po che'i mchog sprul gyi rgyu mtshan 7gong mar snyan sgron zhus pa'i phyir pheb byung bar zi ling du phebs am bhan dang mjal phrad mdzad cing 7gong ma'i bka' phebs ltar bod du yel chi btang nas lha sa'i jo bo'i mdun gyigaser bum nang du brtag sgril byed rgyur thag bcad ma thi dgon pa 7gong maramakhyen du bcug nas ming gi gsol ras zhu rgyu am bhan brgyud nas snyan sgron phul/ de gar hal ha'i mer gen wang gi mi sna khā dbang phyug ngo g.yog mjal du 'ongs par dga' ldan lha brgya ma'i 'pho khrid phur bu spyog pa'i gsung gi byams pas dam bca'i gzungs kyi 'don thabs bcas kyi lung gnang /zi ling zhon gyes yā mon du gdan drangs nas khrang zhi'i rtsed mo bstar zhing gsol ston zhus thog rgya'i yig tshang nang gi gtam rgyud ngo mtshar can gyi gsung gleng mang du 'phel/ li kyu shang po dpon po'ang ched gnyer gyis 'ongs te mjal zhing dkar spro btegs phyir chos bzang ri khrod du phebs nas phyag na rdo rje 'khor lo chen po'i rnal 'byor gtso bor gyur pa'i bcad rgya yun ring mdzad cing thun seng du de'i sgrub thabs drag po kun 'dul ljags rtsom gnang / lo 'dirardo rje 'jigs byed klu brgyad dang bcas pa'i sbyin sreg gi sgo nas char dbab pa'i gdams pa phan bde kun 'byung lha mo'i drag po'i gtor chen gyi lag len bdud dpung 'joms pa'i rdo rje sogs gsung rtsom mang du spel/dur ped wang gi mi sna dang cha har bsam gtan dpon po'i mi sna rnams 'ongs par 'byor lan sogs stsal/ cha gān no mon hān zhing du gshegs par gdan 'dren zhu mi 'ongs na'ang sa khad ring ba dang grang ngad che ba bcas 'byon rgyu'i rdo ma thogs/dgung lo re gcig pa me sbrul zla ba dang po'i gsar tshes la o thog shog 770

༄/ /chabatsotshothazangachosamiyi gartegatsosag khabashar/gi ca khir chi atho sidhi ngo g.yog gis brtan bzhugs kyi rten 'brel bsgrigs te maṇ+ḍal kha btags sku gsung thugs rten sogs kyis sna drangs te dngos 'bul gya nom pa phul bar phyag rdor gtum chen gyi rjes gnang dang paṇa chen chos rgyan gyigasung gi de'i sgrub thabs kyi lngags lung bcas gnang / dgon lung nas rgyud pa bla mas gtsos pa'i bla spyi so so'i mi sna mang po dang thag nye ring gi chos sde che chung gi mtshams zhus phul mi mang por phyag dbang dga' ston dkyus ltar mdzad/ lo gsar gyi brel ba bsal nas nyin mang po'i ring sku mtshams bsdams te mjug tu kha skong sbyin sreg gnang / de nas dgon lung du phebs or du su me rin mgon po skyabs dang dka' bcu bstan dar sogs kyis 'dodadon zhus pa'i re ba bskangs/ bkra shis 'khyil bla brang gi a khu phyag mdzod ngo g.yog 'ongs nas bod du mi sna gtong rgyu'i skor sogs dgongs bstun zhus par gang ci'i zhal bkod gnang / lo snga mar nyid sog yul du bzhugs skabs dgon lung khri thog pa chu bzang rin po che sku bsnyel nas khri'i dgongs pa zhus par dge 'dun mang gis dgon gnas 'di la chos 'jig rten gnyis ga'i sgo nas 'dzin skyong mdzad mkhan zhig dgos pas da res thu'u bkwan rin po che sog yul nas pheb bstun khri'i snyan gsan 'bul dgos zhes gros mthun gyis thag bcad/ de rjes mtshan mo zhig mi gcig gis rje 'di pa khrir bzhugs mi chog pa'i rgyu mtshan gye sgo skur sna tshogs bris nas sgo la sbyar ba'iganas tshul sog yul nas yar 'byon pa'i lam du phyag mdzod chos rjes zhus pa la/ zhal nas de'i rtsa ba mi shes rgyu med nged rang sngar khrir sdod skabs 'grig lam tshul bzhin du mnan cing dge 'dun mang gis kyang thugs khur bzhes pa'i stabs kyis log spyod mkhan 'ga' zhig la sos mi bde ba byung ba de rigs kyis byas pa yin 'gro/ des nged rang tsho la gnod rgyu med par 771

༄/ /yo thang ba na ba'itshoname'i gsung ཿma/ma zad rkyen ngan grogs yin slar dge 'dun mang nas khrir sdod dgos zhes u tshugs gnang byung na'ang dgongs pa zhu stabs bde zhing / de nas sos bde moradage spyor zhig byed rgyu byung na de ga khe che gsungs te thugs 'khrug pa'i rnam pa sogs gtan nas med par bde 'bol gyes bzhugs/ 'di ni chags sdang gi rtsa ba chod pa'i rnam thar ya mtshan pa 'gro mgron gtsang ba rgya ras kyis/ rtsa ba chod pa'i sgo khang na/ / blo bde sgo nyal byed kyin yod/ /ces pa lta bu ste/ blo sbyong rtsa bar/ yid bde 'ba' zhig rgyun du bsten/ /zhes gsungs pa'ang rkyen 'di lta bu dang phrad tshe gsal dgos pa yin no/ / de donabazhin dgon lung du 'byor ma thag dge 'dun mang gis khri dar phul te gsol ba nan tan btab kyang skus mi lcog tshul sogs gsungs te zhal bzhes gtan nas ma gnang / der dge 'dun mang nas bla ma thugs rje can la zhu ba nan gyis phul na ngo mi bzlog pa zhig yin kyang da lan bstan dgra zhig gis don med pa'i yig log sbyar ba des thugs sun phyung pas lan par 'dug dgongs te 'di la las byed rnams kyis rtsad gcod mi byed pa zhes kha btang zhingasbang ma rnams kyis kyang rtags mi ston pa zhes zhe 'khang dang da res lha shed mi shed gang gi sgo nas yin rung rtsar bcad nas cis kyang cham la dbab dgos zhes 'ur zhog langs/ de skabs su'ang zhal nas spyir na skyon kun zad cing yon tan kun rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la'ang skyon gyi gong bur mthong mkhan yod na nged rang so skye 'ching ba kun ldan la skyon du lta mkhan ci la med khyad par du dgon gnas 'dir snga ma nas dam sri dang rgyal gdon zhig bsdongs nas a bo mi rtsi zer ba tsho'i snying la brlams te dkrug shing byed pa'i srol zhig yod cing / rgyal sras rin po che dang lcang skya rin po che rnam gnyis kyi sku tshe 'ga' zhig dang 'dan ma grub chen chu bzang sku gong ma 772

sa / /rje btsu bas bas lad+ma gtam 'ekhanasogasasngon gyi bla ma mang po zhig la nyams sad pa dang mtho 'tsham pa brnyasasmodabyed pa yig log sbyar ba ci rigs kyis gnod pa bskyal ba khong rnam pa 'ga' zhig gi rnam thar du'ang yod/ chu bzang sku gong ma la log par 'khu ba 'ga'azheg gis yun ring po'i bar du mtho brtsams te mdzad zin lam du ma btang khong gis de'i rgyu mtshan zhib tu gsung nas nged kyi skye ba gong ma la gtad pa bzhin ched dmigs kyis phyag mtshan re gsar du bsgrubs te dgon pa'i srung ma rnam gsum la phul nas drag bskul mdzad pas log par 'khu ba de dgagis mthong chos su las kyi rnam par smin pa myang ba'i gtam brgyud kyang yod/ 'on kyang de la dpe byas nas chos skyong la drag bskul 'dra gtong mi dgos shing rtags ma thon pa la kha'ang btang mi chog chos skyong gis 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas tshur 'ded dgos pas nged cag gi sngon las kyis bskul nas mi dran dgu dran byed bcug pa yin shas kyang che gang ltar yang da res kyi yig log mkhan 'di la rtsad gcod de 'dra ma byed gsung nas btang snyoms su bzhag / tshul 'di'ang gang pos zhus pa las/ sngon gyi las las gyur shes pas/ / rnam smin 'di myong snyam du shes/ / smod dang sdug bsngal dngos po 'di/ / gzhan gyis byas pa ma yin gyi/ / 'di ni nges par las kyi rkyen/ /zhes dang / spyod 'jug las/ 'di ltar phar gnod ma byas na/ / 'ga' yang tshur la gnod mi byed/ / ces sogs lta bu mda' len 'bon 'dzug gi tshul/ byams snying rje'i tshul/ slob dpon slob ma'i tshul/ chos nyid kyi tshul bzhi'i sgo nas bzod pa sgom thabs gsungs pa rnams rjes 'jug la 'doms pa'i thabs mkhas bla na med par snang ngo / / 'on kyang mi mang gi blo la ma 'thad pa'i dbang gis gtam rim par 'khyar te skabs shig am pan gyis gsan khong yang rje nyid la dad 'dun can zhig yin pas 7gong nas mā thi 773

༄/ /gung thangabastan pa'izlaname'i gsung 'bum/dgon du zi pen gyi gsol ras gnang ba skyel zhor du de nyid rtsar byed rtsis kyis zla ba gnyis pa'i yar tshes la dgon lung du 'ongs par zi pen gyi gsol rasal bsu ba ser sbreng lugs srol ltar gyis mdun bsus te bkur sti chen pos gdan drangs/ 7gong ma chen por gsol ras la phyag btsal cing bka' drin gtang rag tu kha btags nang mdzod tshe dpag med kyi li sku byon legs bcas am pan brgyud nas phul/ am pan gyis nged rang tshos mā thi dgon gyi lha khang 7gong ma'i zhabs brtan la dmigs nas bzhengs pa'i rgyu mtshan mkhyen du bcug ste ming gi gsol ras zhus pa'i zhu shog dang lho phyogs kyi dmag thog nas pha rol po'i dmag mang po cham la phab pa'i skad snyan 'bul rgyu'i zhu shog gnyis 7gong ma'i spyan sngar dus mtshungs su 'byor bas 7gong nas thugs shin tu dgyes te rten 'brel la dgongs nas/ rmad byung rgyal ba'i gling zhes ming 'dogs pa gnang zhing nyid snga ma pe cing du bzhugs pa'i gnas tshul dran nas thugs la btags pa'i bka' 'ga' zhig kyang babs 'dugapas hu thog thu'i sku bsod nges par gzhan dang mi 'dra ba zhig 'dug ces gzengs bstod phul/ de skabs zhal nas mā thi dgon pa'i pen 'di 7gong ma'i sku mdun du rten 'brel 'grig par ma zad da res 'di na'ang gleng brjod phran tshegs byung ste mjug ma dang bcas par yod pa'i mtshams su sleb pa nged tsho la'ang rten 'brel 'grigs pa yin 'dra gsung ste bzhad mo mdzad/de ma thag 'o su rgyal na rgyal du chug / gyong dang bub kha rang gis blang / /khe dang rgyal kha gzhan la 'bul/ / zer ba yin pas rgyal kha blangs na 'jig rten lugs la 'dod thog zer yang de las pham kha blangs na chos lugs kyi 'dod thog yin/ dgra gnyen bde sdug gi snang ba rnam rtog gi ri mo tsam yin pas nang gi sems gzo shes mkhan la phyi rol gyi rkyen thams cad bde ba'i yo 774

sa / /che badza bas bas mud+ma dganag g.yokabyad yin sgyu ma'i dgra bos brag ca'i sgro skur bsgrags pas blo chung byis pa la khong skran skyed srid na'ang brda la byang ba'i rgan po la gang yang byed mi thub gsung / de skabs am pan gyis sngar gyi yig log de gang na yod ces rang dbang med par rtsad bcad de zhib tu gzigs pas kho rang tshos zer lugs nyes stabs gzas pa'i khar ma phog par ma gzas pa'i snar phog ste am pan gting nas khros/ mi mang yang shog langs te rtsad gcod drag pos rje nyid la mi mos pa 'ga' zhig ci drag gang drag la gtad/ der rje nyid kyis brtse bsam bzod par las byed rnams la khyed tshos 'di 'dra ma byed nga la mi mos pa tsam gyis nyes can yin pa'i nges pa'ang med cing yin du chug kyang lhang du phud na rgya khrims zhib tshags che bas khong tsho'i zer lugs nyes stabs lus srog la chad pa ci 'dra yong mi shes/ nged rang gis lo re bzhin bshan pa dang nya pa'i lag nas dngul dong tse byin nas ra lug la sogs pa'i srog blu grangs bsags kyin yod pa la dud 'gro'i srog gces par bzung nas mi'i srog yal bar dor ba'i las ci la sgrub/ rgya khrims zhib pas rgya nang nas mi'i srog blu mi thub mod kyang nged rang sog yul na yod dus sbyin bdag dpon po rnams la ngo chen byas nas gsod la thug pa'i mi mang po zhig gi srog bskyabs pa yin da rgas khar mi la bsgral chog byed 'jug don med/ am pan gyis 'dzin dgos zer mod kyang 'u cag gis lha gsol klu gsol gtong khul dang phan tshun du rtsar byed khul byas te yal yol byed rag la am pan phyir log song na bya ba 'di nyid rang shugs kyis zhi bas byed bde mo yong gsung ste cung zad gu yangs su btang bas mi ring bar de bzhin thog tu khel nas bde 'jags su gyur/tshul 'di'ang skyes rabs las/ sdig can rnams ni rang bzhin gyes/ /'dul dang 'gal ba'i lam la brten/ / dam pa rnams ni goms pa'i 775

༄/ /gung bang bstan ba'ithoname'i gsung 'bum/phyir/ / de la'ang phan btags bzhin du bzed/ / ces dang / ched du brjod pa'i tshom las/ 'di na 'khon gyi 'khon can dag / nam yang zhi bar 'gyur ma yin/ / bzod pas 'khon ni zhi 'gyur bas/ / 'di ni chos kyi rangabazhin yin/ / zhes dang / byis pa khros nas tshig tsub smra/ / smras na rgyal bar 'gyur snyam sems/ / gang cheg tshig dag bzod byed pa/ / de ni rtag tu rgyal ba yin/ / zhes ched du bsngags pa dang mthun pa'i rnam par thar pa yin no/ / pha rol po de dag gi kun slong yang dgung lo re gcig gi 'phrang la bsgug ste sku tshe mdzad 'phrin ci rigs la gnod pa zhig e thub kyi re ba yin 'dug na'ang gnod pa med par ma zad grwa slob sbyin bdag mtha' dbus kun tukhyab pa rnams kyis rje nyid snyigs ma'i brlang spyod 'di lta bus thugs sun gyis dogs nas gang nus kyi zhabs brtan tshad med pa bsgrubs shing gdung shugs drag pos brtan bzhugs kyi gsol ba 'debs pa sogs zam ma chad par byung ste pha rol po rnams kyi bsam sbyor thams cad rkyen ngan grogs su gyur pa me la bud shing gi dmag drangs pa'i dpe gsungs pa bzhin sku tshe 'phrin las kyi mthun grogs kho nar gyur to/ / gangs can ri yi rtse mo na/ / 'gying ba'i ri dwags rgyal po la/ / wa skyes brgyal ba'i than skad kyis/ / skrag pa skyed par ga la nus/ / 'bar ba'i 'od kyi gdengs ka can/ / nyin byed lag pas sgrib 'dod pa'i/ / blo chung rang gi re ba'i mig / phyid pas gdungs par ma gyur tam/ dgung sngon dbyings su bsnyags pa byin za'i dpung / / zil gyes gnon phyir bud shing skam po'i tshogs/ / ci tsam bsnan yang phyi phyir mched pa bzhin/ / rkyen ngan grogs su gyur te e maho/ / nyin gcig zhal nas mdang mi lam du dge bskos kyis chos ra nas tshogs gtam gtong gi yod par nged kyis rna ba gtad nas nyan pas jo mo zhig gis khros pa'i rnam pas 776

༄/ /dzibatsugablob4cho minyima'igagangagatsosamadakhazadabyung/'chad nyan nyams 'dug 'grig lam lhod 'dug gso dgos bco dgos zer ba zhig rmis byung ba lha mo'i cho 'phrul zhig yin pa 'dra gsung / rjes sor dge 'dun mang zhal 'dzomathog cig tu'ang nged kyi rmi lam la dpag na dgon pa'i srung ma lha mo thugs shin tu khros yod pa 'dra bas yul phyogs su bkra shis kyi dge mtshan 'byung mi 'byung dgon pa'i chos skyong mnyes mi mnyes la rag las pas thams cad kyis thugs khur bzhes te 'chad nyan 'grig lam sogs sor chud pa gnang dgos la sngar gyi nyes pa sel phyir dpal ldan lha mo la bzod gsol dang bshags pa 'bul dgos gsung / der thams cad kyis 'o na rje nyid nas thugs brtse bas dgongs te dgon mchod gzhis dang bcas pa'i don du lha mo la bzod gsol dang 'phrin bcol gnyer gtad cis kyang bka' drin gnang dgos zhes gsol ba btab pa ltar rje nyid dam tshig gtsang ma'i slob ma 'ga' zhig dang bcas pas lha mo'i pho brang du nyin dang por yig brgya nyer gcig re dang bshags pa tshar re spel ba grangs gsog gis bshags pa gtsor 'don dang / nyin gnyis par 'khrug skong dang bam skong / nyin gsum par gtor 'bul stong phrag tshang bar byas pa'i sgo nas 'phrin bcol gnyer gtad gtso bor gnang bas srung ma dgyes pa'i rtags mtshan gsal bar byung / su nyid g.yon ru'i wang dang bsnye thu sa lag chi so so'i mi sna pur han bla ma'i tsha mo btsun ma rin chen bsam 'grub rnams 'ongs nas wang gi mi snas sngar ho sho'u de gar mu ge chen po byung bar sa bcud gso ba'i sman dang rim gro gnang ba rnams zhal bkod bzhin bsgrubs par brten dge mtshan 'phel ba'i legs 'bul zhus/ rin chen bsam 'grub la dge tshul ma'i sdom pa dang el chi rnams la 'byor lan dang 'dod chos sogs stsal/mdung nag ko kya no mon han sogs yul nas phebs pa'i skyos ma mang po phul 777

༄/ /gung thang bstan ba'ithoname'i gsung 'bum/temajal kha zhus par gsung gleng 'phel/ bkra shis 'khyil gyi rgyud pa bla ma dbal mang zhabs drung 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa rin po che'i sprul sku'i don skor la bod du 'gro rgyu'i thon phyag la 'ongs te sprul sku'i don skor du zhal bkod zhus par sprul sku thag ma bcad gong du bkra shis 'khyil nas ched dmigs kyis lcags mkhar zhig sgrub dgos bar chad phran tshegs tsam yod kyang dbang du mi 'gro / snga sor bkra shis 'khyil nas rmi lam mis tshul zhib tu bshad yod pas de dang 'grigs yong ba 'dra gsung / lam chos su sgrol ma'i rjes gnang dang de'i sgrub thabs 'dod dgu'i mchog sbyin gyi lung pheb rdzong dang gang ci'i gsung bkod zhib tu stsal/ zhwa dmar bra rti dgon pa'i 'du khang la dngul srang sum brgya lhag dang tā pan dgon pa'i 'du khang la dngul srang brgya lnga bcu tsam gyi rgyu mthud dang 'du khang gnyis gar tshad dbyibs kyi bkod pa sogs gnang ste tshon rtsi dang bcas gsar bskrun mdzad/mgron gnyer nang so phun tshogs yun ring tsam na nad sman bcos rim gro rgyun ldan byas kyang phan skyed ma byung bar dus las 'das pa la 'pho 'deb dang sbyang chog mdzad kho'i nor rdzas gang yod kyi steng du phyag rdzas mthud nas dge sgrub gnang / 'dis mtshon te rje 'di pas zhabs phyi drag zhan gsar rnying la ma ltosapar na dus nad g.yog bskos nas do dam byed 'jug cing brtse bas ma dor ba'i nad 'dri dang phyag sman gnang ba sogs thugs khur gang che mdzad pa sngon sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong nad pa mi gtsang ba'i rdzab tu bying ba zhig rang nyid kyis phyag bstar nas bton te rim gro gnang ba'i lo rgyus lta bu dang / de 'dra'i rigs la 'chi dus su'ang dngos dang brgyud pa'i sgo nas mtshan dang gzungs rna lam du sgrog pa shi nas kho rang gi rgyu rdzas gang yod chud zos su gtong mi 'jug pa'i steng du phyag rdzas mthud nas bsngo zhus mchod 778

༄/ /chabatsugablob nyis gsangags pabadakurasad ngaka'abul mang 'gyed sogs dge sgrub gnad smin gnang zhing nyid rang gis kyang bde 'gror skyes rtags ma byung bar du thugs dam chen dmigs gnang ba zhig yin te/ de ltar gnang bas nang so'i skyes rtags byung tshul sngar smos zin cing phyag mdzod ngag dbang tshul khrims har chin wang gi sras bdun par skyes pa dang shi ba gzhan 'ga' zhig dag ma dag gi zhing du rten bzang thob tshul dang drung 'khor ba 'ga' zhig gi skye ba sngon ma ngos 'dzin mdzad pa sogs sku mdun du bcar sdod rnams la rgyus yod pa'ang bcu lhag tsam snang / tha na drung du 'ongs pa'i khyi gu yan chad la mtshan dang gzungs sngags rna bar bsgrags shing shi ba'i ro mer bsregs bcug ste rus chog gnang ba'i lo rgyus 'ga' zhig kyang 'dug pa ni sngon jo bo chen pos 'brog pa'i ru ba song shul du khyi gu 'ga' zhig lus pa phyag tu blangs te brtse ba'i stangs ka mdzad par la las nged bod la mi chen po rnams de 'dra mi byed pa yin zhus pas/ nga mi chen po min sems chen po yin gsung ba'i lo rgyus ltar byang chub kyi sems rin po che'i dbang du gyur pa'i 'bras rtags 'brel tshad don dang ldan pa'i rnam thar ro/ / snga ma har chin pe zi'i ho sho'u la pheb dus chu chen zhig gi 'gram du mjal ba mang po 'dus par grwa pa zhig chus khyer song ba la de dus spyan dmigs gnang yod pa gzhir bcas shing lan rjes ma phebs dus kyang chus khyer sa der bab nas thugs dam ched dmigs gnang ba dang / nyid la mi mos pa'i grwa pa zhig mig na nas sman bcos kyis ma thub par phyag sman zhus pasaspan ster mkhan la mi mos pa la phan 'dogs byed par smon kyang stabs 'grig dka' bas da res stabs 'grigs dus 'dir phan thogs nges byed dgos gsung nas rgya sman bzang po gzab nas gnang / rgyun par yang ched gtad kyis mjal pa yin min la ma ltos par mi mang tshogs par/ gang zhig 779

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'isgroname'i gsung 'bum/bdagagi gzugs mthong ming thos dang / / dran reg 'brel thob skye 'gro'i tshogs rnams kun/ / nyer 'tshe dang bral chos srid legs tshogs 'phel/ /rnam 'dren go 'phang myur du thob par shog / ces pa'i smon tshig mngon chung gi tshul du gsung zhing spyan dmigs nan tan mdzad pa sogs nang gi snying rje'i rang mdangs phyi rol tu shar pa'i rnam thar mtha' yas pa ni brjod kyis mi lang ngo / / a lag shā wang gi mi sna tha'i ji dharmā pā la ngo g.yog 'byor par brtag zhus la nyid nas lo snga mar rigs rgyud kyi don du rim gro skyabs 'jug gnang ba bzhin btsun mo mngal chags yod pas pho mo gang yin gyi bka' gsal gnang dgos tshul zhus 'dug par thugs cung zad 'tshub nas pho mo gang yin btsas dus go mod/ 'di 'dra'i rigs la dri ba dris lan byas na bar chad che bas gsang dam dgos pa yin snga ma 'ga' zhig la bu byung na gsang dam dgos tshul bshad pa la khong tshos btsas ston byed khul gyis lam du ma song ba min nam/ nga la mngal na gnas pa'i pho mo'i dbye ba 'byed pa'i mngon shes med kyang da lan gyi 'di la mo yin zhes lan skur dgos gsungs nas bka' lan de bzhin gnang / rjes nas btsun mo btsas dus bu skyes pa yin kyang nyin kha shas kyi mtshams nas rtags 'gyur te mor log pa'i gnas tshul zhur 'ongs par rten 'brel 'phyugs song bas da bu rgyud yong dka' ba 'dra gsung nas thugs 'tsher gnang ba phyis de bzhin byung / nyin gcig zhal nas mdang rmi lam du nged rang rgyus med kyi ri mthon po zhig gi rtse la phyin pas ri de'i pha ki'i khul chen po mtha' mi mngon pa zhig tu grub thob pho mo rgyan chas can grangs kyis mi lang ba nam mkha' gang ba zhig phar 'phur tshur 'phur byed kyin 'dug pa la ltad mo bltas bsdad par grogs shig gis bskul nas phyir 'khor ba zhig rmis gsungs/ rjes sor zhig gsung 'phros kyi lhongs la nged rang drug cu re 780

༄/ / chubatsotshothazangachosakyi 1logasangagasamud+madakaragadabyungakagacig gi steng du rkyen ngan byung ba des tshe gegs bzlog song ba yin de min tshe gegasa'is grol yod med mi shes zhes gsung 'dug pa la dpag na lo 'dir dag pa mkha' spyod du 'byon pa'i dgongs pa gtad pa gdul bya'i bsod nams kyi mthu dang zhabs brtan gyi gsol 'debs nan tan zhus pa'i mthus re zhig bshol ba yin par mngon/ / de nas sngar rje nyid dgon pa'i che phra thams cad la 'grig lam bco dgos pa dang 'chad nyan gso dgos pa'i dran bskul mdzad pa bzhin dge 'dun mang yang 'grig lam dang 'chad nyan slar gso rgyu la spro ba skom pas chu 'dod pa lta bu skyes shing de'i rtsa ba 'chad nyan sogs gso thub pa'i bla ma zhig sko rgyu la rag las par 'dug ces dgongs mthun gyi thog am pan dang yang gros bsdur bar/ stod smad nas mang du glengayang mthar las dang rten 'brel gyi dbang zhig gis nged sko rgyu la thams cad bzhed pa mthun par byung / de nas rje nyid kyi sku tshab cig dang am pan gyi thung zi dgon pa spyi nas rgyud pa bla mas gtsos pa'i las sne rags bsdus bcas gtong bar mdzad pa rnams bkra shis 'khyil du 'byor gsung shog dang bcas rgyu mtshan rnams gleng byung bar da lta dus dbang gis dgon pa'i 'dzin skyong du grags pa rnams kyang srid dang ma 'brel ba'i chos rnam dag cig 'ong dka' la/ 'khor ba'i bya ba zhig dang 'brel phyin chad brjod gleng dang gtam gye gzhi ma phar je rgyas su song ba bzhin 'thab rtsod sogs kyi rkyen las ma 'das pa zhig yin pa ni mngon pa mdzod las/ de dag nyid dus gtam gzhi dang / / nges par 'byung bcas gzhi dang bcas/ / gang dag zag bcas nyer len pa'i/ / phung po de dag 'thab bcas kyang / / zhes dang / sa'i dngos gzhir mdo lung drangs pa las/ sems can brjod bya'i 'du shes can/ / brjod bya la ni gnas pa rnams/ / zhes sogs ltar yin 781

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'izlaname'i gsung 'bum/par ma zad mtshams 'di snga ma'i brjod gleng gi 'phro de ma thag tu song bas byed spro ba zhig mi 'dug la/ der ma zad skabs der bkra shis 'khyil gyi khri'i khur yang 'dzin bzhin pa yin pas phan tshun gnyi ga 'chad nyan gyi grwa sa yin stabs lhan du skyong rgyu shin tu dka' bas blos mi 'chun pa lta bu byung / 'on kyang am pan dbang che na'ang thabs kyis bshol lugs yod la bla ma'i gsung nan che ba zlog tshul dang mngon lkog byed lugs med pas dang du len dgos pa byung / de nas lnga pa'i tshes la dgon lung du song ste khrir 'khod skabs kyang gang ci'i zhal bkod brtse gzigs dang ston mo'i tshe bzhugs gral gyi mgon du phebs yul lugs kyi bshad pa tshig bkra legs pa'i bden tshig sogs kyang rje nyid nas gnang ste rten 'brel phun sum tshogs pa'i sgo 'phar dang por phyes pas bka' drin gzhal du med par gyur/ rje nyid bden pa'i tshig la dbang 'byor pa'i byin rlabs kyis de phyin bla ma dge 'dun rnams thugs mthun zhing 'chad nyan 'phel ba dang yul khams su'ang lo chu sogs shin tu legs pas dge mtshan phul du phyin pa byung / nged kyi skyel mar 'ongs pa dus 'khor dpon slob kha kya dar rgyas dang ba za zhabs drung sogs don gnyer ba nyung shas la lcang skya rol pa'i rdo rje'i khrid yig thog nas mgon po snying zhugs kyi khrid dang lngags lung bka' drin stsal/ bdag la lho brag snyan brgyud kyi dbang rjes gnang rnams dang lung rgyun sogs 'di phyogs su dkon par 'dug pas khyod kyis 'di rnams la byed dgos gsungs te bka' 'bum gyi dpe dang skyid shod pa'i zur 'debs kyi dpe de'i dgos chas kyi rigs dang bcas gnang ba bzhin ba za zhabs drung dang chos bzang gi slob chung dgon lung grwa pa rgan pa 'ga' zhig bcas la bka' 'bum gyi lung dang skyid shod pa'i zur 'debs ga yod ltar gyi snyan brgyud kyi skor rnams cha tshang bar bka' bzhin du byas/782

sa / /chabatsun thazang4541 d+madaganas ༄kha/sgo mang bla ma lha btsun mthu stobs nyi ma'i gdan 'dren pa nang so rab bzang ngo g.yog 'byor par wang gi zhu shog nang du sgo mang bla mar rang yul du 'byon rgyu'i bkod khyab gnang dgos tshul zhus 'dug pas sngar nyid nas sgo mang bla ma la mkhan khri brjes pa dang rang yul du 'byon dgos kyi bkod khyab gnang ba'i lan du 'gro 'dug gang byed las la blta dgos pa 'dug ces pa las gsal kha ma byung ba la da res gsung shog tu ja 'thung rgyu'i las bsags yod na'ang rang gis rtsol ba ma byas par las la blta dgos zhes bsdad pas ja kha nang du mi yong ba bzhin du 'gro 'dug kyang rang gi 'bad rtsol la mi ltos par rang bzhin lhun gyis 'grub pa yong dka' bas da lan rang yul du 'byon pa'i rtsol ba gyis shig ces bskur ba gnang / har chin dge slong chos grags nyi mas bskul ngor spyan ras gzigs kyi bla ma'i rnal 'byor gru 'dzin nye lam gsar rtsom mdzad de bskul ba po dang nang so rab bzang rnams la de'i lung dang lam chos 'ga' zhig bcas gnang mtshams shig skyed tshal du phebs nas bzhugs skabs bdag kyang der shog gsungs nas zhag shas der sdod ring lha'i dga' tshal la co 'dri ba lta bu'i khang bzang bkod pa sna tshogs pa'i ltad mo mig gi bdud rtsir gyur ba dang phral nyams dga' la phugs don zab pa'i chos kyi gsung gleng du mas yid kyi skyo ba bsangs shing spro dga' nyams su myong / chos bzang ri khrod pa rnams la mgon po zhal sgrub dus kyi rjes gnang zhig gis gsung ba'ang bka' bzhin bsgrubs skabs der gsung 'phros kyi zhor la thol byung du gsungs pa 'ga' zhig ma 'ongs lung bstan du 'dug pa rjes sor rim gyis nges 'drongs byung / mkhar sngon tham ga bla ma sku gshegs pa'i sngo rten 'bul mi dge bskos dang gnyer ba ngo g.yog 'ongs par ljags bsngo dang yang srid skor gyi brtag pa myur 'byon gsol 'debs dang bla ma'i rnal 'byor 783

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'isgroname'i gsung 'bum/ljags rtsom zhus pa bzhin gnang har chin tho yon dharma kirti sogs la dge tshul gye sdom pa stsal/ khran tsong ri khrod dang 'brug lung dgon par gdan drangs pa bzhin phebs te 'dod chos dang mang 'gyed gzabs slar skyed tshal du byon nas zhwa dmar bra rte zhabs drung sogs la snying po don gsum gyi khrid 'jam dpal mtshan brjod sman chog bsdus pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor gru 'dzin nye lam rnams kyi ljags lung dang / 'jigs med pe li'i nu bo thu sa lag chi lha mgon tshe brtan sogs la rta bod kyi ljags lung tho yon gsung rab sogs bsgrub bya kha shas la bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa gnang / dbyar ston gyi ring skyed tshal du thugs dam dang dpe gzigs shin tu 'phel zhing seng bar du rje btsun ku ru ku l+le'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga khams gsum dbang du sdud pa'i lcags kyu rgyal po sde lnga'i gsol mchod 'phrin las char rgyun bskul ba'i 'brug sgra sogs gsar rtsom gnang / byams chen mkhan po ngag dbang nor bu bod nas glebs te 'byor mjal du 'ongs par gsung gleng 'phel/ zla ba dgu pa'i tshes la thar pa gling du phebs de ga'i dge 'dun dang 'brug lung gi sems nyid sku skye bkra shis chos gling gi dung sngon bla ma sogs gzhi byes kyi ser skya sum brgya tsam la bde lam gyi khrid nyin bcu'i ring la sngags lugs dang 'brel ba'i zhal shes kyis brgyan te gnang / gzhan yang rje nyid kyis mdzad pa'i bla ma rgyang 'bod bzang spyod byams smon mdo sdud pa khri rgya nag pas mdzad pa'i gcod khridachen mo rnams kyi ljags lung stsal/ thar pa gling bkra shis chos gling lo dkar ri khrod sogs kyi bsgrub bya drug cu tsam la bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa gnang / zla ba bcu pa'i tshes la hal ha'i nang so blo bzang mkhas mchog dang sman ram pa dkon mchog rgya mtsho sogs la rta mgrin gyi rjes gnang dang de'i chos skor gyi lung hang kin mi rin bkra shis dang o thog mai rin do nos sogs 784

༄/ /rtsebatsugablobazangachosaminyama'ig4ga mapad+madasasadabyungakal sgrol ma'i rjes gnang / o thog dpon mo tshe ring lha mo la mi 'khrugs pa'i gos sku bzo rgyu'i thebs sprad nas gtad gnyer mdzad pa bzhin phun sum tshogs pa zhig bsgrubs nas mi rin yon tan dang lha bzo ngag dbang skal bzang sogs kyis khyer 'ongs par rje'i lnga mchod kyi dus chen la rab gnas mdzad cing 'brel thogs rnams kyi dge rtsa byang chub tu bsngo ba'i spyan dmigs gnang / lha bris pa la pe lig thu nang so'i cho lo dang bzo btsem pa rnams byin rten dang yon gyis mgu bar byas/ u shing bsod nams chos rje dang o thog shes rab rgya mtsho sogs or du su pa mang po'ang 'dod chos kyis tshim par mdzad nyin gcig gzim gur du 'ga' zhig dang gsung gleng mdzad kyin yod pa'i skabs shig tu thugs 'ur ba'i tshul gyis 'grul ba wa zhwa gyon pa 'ga' zhig sleb byung gsung bas mdun na yod pa tsho ha thengs te gcig bltar phyin pa na wang bla brang gi gnyer ba dpon g.yog gsum wa zhwa re spyon te sgo'i phyi log der gleb 'dug pas kun ngo mtshar du gyur/ der zhal nas nga'i mig lam du dngos su mthong ba 'dra zhig byung bas rtog dpyod ma btang bar thams cad kyis mthong yod mod bsams te kha nas thal song ba red gzhan de 'dra bshad pa la dgos pa med ma bshad rung 'grul ba yong yod mod gsung nas cung zad zhalatsha ba'i rnam pa mdzad/ thar pa gling 'dir sngar nas mang ja nyis brgya bcu lhag gi steng du gdugs sher tshe dpag med kyi gzungs ring 'gro gang che sogs zhabs brtan rgya chen po bsgrubs shing 'di res 'dus spyi nas 'khrungs skar dang bstun nas brtan bzhugs rgyas pa 'bul rgyu'i snyan gsan phul te dge 'dun tshang mas tshe dpag gi brtan bzhugs kyi cho ga blor bzung nas phyag len rta dbyangs sogs bslab yod pa bzhin bcu gcig pa'i tshes bdun 'khrungs skar gyi nyin rje nyid spos 'dren mchod rol dang bcas spyan drangs te 785

༄/ /gung thang bstan ba'ithon me'i gsung 'bum/slob chung gis gtsos pa'i dge 'dun brgya lhag gis tshe dpag med kyi sgo nas brtan bzhugs 'bul tshul gyi cho ga rgyas pa 'bud dkrol gyi rol mo dang dbyangs rta sogs cha thams cad nas gra 'grig pas phun sum tshogs pa dang /de'i steng du dngos 'bul gyi rim pa'ang dgon pa spyi nas kha btags nang mdzod dngul srang sum cu las bsgrubs pa'i maṇ+ḍal sku gsung thugs rten bzhugasagadan rgyab yol gyis sna drangs te gos dar 'phrug zam ras zhwa snam/dong tshe sogs dngos po'i 'bul ba rnam grangs phyed dang sum brgya/ de mtshungs dgon lung gi bla brang phyag mdzod tshogs chen dge bskos dang spyi gnyer grwa rgan sogs bla spyi so so'i mi sna dpon g.yog brgya skor bkra shis chos gling gi dung sngon bla ma sogs dge 'dun drug cu skor gyis gtsos dgon sgrub sde bco lnga tsam gyi bla ma las sne/ a kya sgar ba bra rte nang so mar tshang dpon tshang thu'u bkwan mkha' 'gro sogs lung khog gi yon bdag tsho ba'i mi rnams dang bcas phyogs tha dad nas 'khrungs skar gyi dga' ston la ched dmigs kyis 'dus pa'i drag zhan mang pos che 'byor chung 'byor gyi 'bul tshan gang yod rnams dkyus gcig tu bstar/ slob chung lo dkar chos rjes skyabs mgon nyid kyi sku che ba'i yon tan las brtsams te lo rgyus can gyi zhu 'bul dang zhabs pad brtan pa'i gsol ba rtse gcig tu btab par dgyes pa'i bka' lan dang zhal bzhes bzang po gnang / gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal dang mjug chogagrub rjes chos ra nas mi 'khrugs pa'i gos sku la khrus gsol mdzad cing 'cham gyi ltar mo bstar ba gzigs za brang nas gzhi byes kyi 'gyal pa zag 'an mngapor ston mo dang gnang sbyin gya nom pa dang tshogs par mang 'gyed gong gsal gyi dgon ri khrod rnams la'ang mang 'gyed bskur ba gnang / gzhi byes kyi ser skya mang po la tshem bu dmar khrid sogs gnang lo dkar chos rjes 786

da / /rjebache dmi ga ཿshadam pagasadagakadagongs pa zhus par phur tsha chos rje slob chung du bsko bzhag mdzad/ sbyin bdag pe zi tshe brtan rdo rjes gcung tas ching dbang phyug gdan 'dren du btang ba bzhin zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i tshes la chibs bskyod de mar tshang du zhag bab thog bla chen po'i lha khang du thugs smon dang mchod 'bul mdzad/ der bkra shis 'khyil bla brang gi mi sna gsol dpon dge bshes bstan pa dar rgyas ngo g.yog 'byor nas 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa rin po che'i sprul sku lha sa'i jo bo'i sku mdun gyi gser bum nang du brtag dril byas nas 'os tho gnyis par thag bcad pa'i rgyu mtshan dang gdan 'dren gyi snyan gsan zhus/ zhal nas nged rang chung dus nas bla chen po la dad pa gzhan dang mi 'dra bas sri zhu bkur ste'ang mang po byas da lta'i dus kyi na bza' nang ma 'di nged rang lo bcu gsum gyi skabs rang gis lag pas bzos nas phul ba yin/ rgyun du yas mas su 'gro zhor la mchod mjal re ma chad 'dod don gal chen rnams gsol ba btab nas 'grub myong ba'ang mang / rje 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa rin po che zhing du phebs phyin nas mchod mjal byed dus sprul sku 'khrul ba med pa zhig myur du 'byon rgyu'i gsol 'debs re byed kyin yod da res bla brang nas sprul sku thag chod pa'i rgyu mtshan nges 'jug bar ched dmigs btang ba'i mi sna bla chen po'i mdun du 'byor pa 'di'ang rten 'brel ma bsgrigs rang 'grig byung /sprul sku'ang snga ma nged kyi brtag par babs pa dang da lan gyi brtag dril la babs pa 'di gnyis kyang mtshungs 'dug gsung nas dgyes tshor chen po mdzar/ 'angul ba ragon rtsa rong po 'bas jang gtsos pa'i rta bas thab bas ser sbreng dang bcas bla brang du babs te zhag lnga bzhugs/ mar du su ja sag dbang rgyal tshe brtan rdo rje'i mi sna chos rje ngag dbang chos 'phel dang mi rin dge 'dun ngo g.yog dgon lung brgyud nas 'dir 'ongs te brtan bzhugs 787

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgronama'i gsung ཿma/kyi rten 'brel bsgrigs thog dpon pos bskur pa'i maṇ+ḍal kha btags sku gsung thugs rten dngul srang sum brgya rnams phul nas zhabs pad brtan pa'i gsol ba btab/ rong po zhabs drung gtsos pa'i 'dul dgon 'dus spyi nas maṇ+ḍal kha btags phul te rje nyid kyi thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i rnam thar nyid rang gis lngags rtsom gnang dgos kyi snyan bskul zhus/a lag shā rje drung mkhan po ngo g.yog kyang thar pa gling brgyud nas der phebs mkhan po dpon g.yog dang ring po zhabs drung or du su chos rje dang mi rin sogs don gnyer can du ma la bla ma mchod pa'i khrid dang phyag rdor gtum chung gi rjes gnang mkhan po gcig pu la ge ṭa pā la'i thun mong ma yin pa'i rjes gnang stsal/ di nas rim gyis phebs te gser thog no mon han gyi sprul sku ye shes bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho slob chung rab 'byams pa grags pa bstan 'dzin tas ching no yon ca khir chi yi dam sogs mchog dman du ma'i rta thab ring thung ser spreng dang bcas tshes bcu gnyis la pe zi tshe brtan rdo rje'i ur ger 'byor thog mar ser thog no mon han gyi bzhugs gur du gsol ston zhus/sbyin bdag pi zi mgo log gi lam srung la pheb shul yin pas no yon i ji sras sras mo dpon mo rnams dang bcas mjal kha zhus/ de nas rje nyid sgrub grogs dang bcas bdun mtshams la bzhugs te sbyin bdag dpon pos gtsos pa'i sde pa thun mong gi rim gror 'jigs byed kyi sgo nas snyan brgyud thun mong ma yin pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi sgrub pa dang las gshin kyi gtor chog drug cu pa dang sbrags nas mdzad/ mtshams grol te gser thog no mon han dang no yon e ji sogs kyis gtsos pa'i skya ser brgya skor la rta mgrin gsang sgrub dang rnam 'joms kyi rjes gnang bla mchod 'jam dpal mtshan brjod smon lamanam lnga rten 'brel bstod pa bstod sprin rgya mtsho sogs lngags lung du ma/788

sa / /rje btsun tha bas babadaganacoms kano mon han sogs grwa pa kha shas la 'jigs byed mgon chos lha mo rnam sras rnams kyi mngon rtogs gtor chog gi lung / yang skya ser stong phrag brgal bar mi 'khrugs pa'i dbang chen dang de'i sgo nas khrus chog 'od dpag med kyi 'pho khrid sogs rim gyis stsal sbyin bdag rnams kyis brtan bzhugs kyi rten 'brel bsgrigs te lha rdzas mdzod btags dngul mkha sku gsung thugs rten bzhugs gdan rgyab yol na bza' nyer spyad gos chen snam bu dngul/ rta nor lug sogs dngos 'bul spam mtho ba btegs mi 'khrugs pa'i dbang chogakhyang de dus ljags rtsom mdzod/ pe zi'i sras rnams kyi ur ge dang no mon han gyi ma yum nor bu mtsho'i ur ge so sor gdan drangs pa bzhin phebs te sras gsum la rta mgrin gsang sgrub dang dpon mor tshe dpag gi rjes gnang stsal/ gnyan po zhabs drung dpon g.yog la mkha' spyod ma'i sgrub thabs tsharachen gyis mdzad pa dang nyid kyi ljags rtsom gnyi ga'i lung za byed mkha' 'gro'i sbyin sreg gi khrid lung yang don gnyer can 'ga' zhig la rdor sems kyi rjes gnang rta mgrin gyi sgrub thabs 'jam dpal mtshan brjod kyi lung sogs chos bka' du ma gnang / lo mjug tu nyid sgrub grogs dang bcas pas rta mgrin gsang sgrub kyi gtor zlog dang dad 'dus kyi skye pho mo mang po la'ang phyag dbang sogs 'dod mos ltar gnang ste re ba yongs su tshim par mdzad/ /dgung lo re gnyis pa sa pho rta'i lo gsar gyi nyin bsang chog bkra shis dbyangs snyan dang 'go ba'i lha lnga'i gsol mchod btang no mon han dang no yon e ji sogs drag zhan du mas mjal kha dang nyin gnyis kyi ring no yon e ji sogs kyisagasol ston gang legs bstar zhing no mon han la sgol dkar gyi sku thang phyag nas brgya rtsa ma gnang nas phral phugs kyi bslab ston zhib rgyas mdzad/tshes gsum la drag zhan du ma'i pheb skyel ring thung dang bcas te 'dul ba 789

༄/ /gung thang bstanapa'isgroname'i gsung 'bum/dgonabargyud nas byon phyi log nang log gi grong sde'i mi rnams la phyag dbang dang 'ga' zhig gis khrus dbang zhus pa rnams kyi re ba bskangs/ rim gyis dgon lung pa'i pheb bsu ring thung thab bsu ser sbreng bcas tshes bcu la dgon par babs or du su'i shog gi zhi bar sku skye gshegs pa'i bsngo rten 'bul mi u'u shing mai rin bstan pa ngo g.yog o thog mai rin chos skyabs su nyid badhe thu sa lag chi'i gnyer pa cha har bsam gtan dpon po'i tsha bo dbang chen dur zad nang so skal bzang mkhar sngon shi re thu bla brang gi dge bskos ngo g.yog sogs rim gyis 'byor nas nyid la 'bul ba dang tshogs par mang 'gyed zhus/ dpon po bsam gtan dang jon tā tshul khrims gnyis kyi bsngo rten dang khyim tshang gsum gyi skyabs rten bcas gser sku legs pa bzhi dang dngul srang drug brgya skor gyi 'bul ba btegs de dag spyi sger la lung rjes gnang sogs chos bka' du ma 'dod mos ltar gnang / dbang chen dang khong tsho'i skor gyi khyim tshang gsum la dad rten du rta mgrin dang sgrol dkar gyi sku thang rab gnas brgya rtsa ma re re dang spos snam sogs stsal/ brel ba bsal nas thu'u bkwan du bcad rgya'i ngos thugs dam 'phel zhing thun mtshams su ba za zhabs drung la mi la'i mgur 'bum gyi lung sogs gnang / zhabs phyi pa chi kyu rgan zer ba na nas phung po skrad ba la khos mi tshes 'chi dus chu bsag gi nad byung na rig pa dngas pa zhig yong zer gyin 'dug pas nga rang nad 'dis 'chi rgyu yin zhes sman bsten kha ma nyan pa la/ zhal nas mi 'ga' zhig 'chi ba la brod pa de lus rten 'di las lhag pa'i rten bzang zhig thob par re ba red rang gis tshe 'di tsam la dge sbyor phran bu byas pa la nga rgyal byas nas dga' yal yal byas mi chog cing gzhan gyis mi tshe gcig tsam la sdig pa byas pa la mtha' gcig tu smad nas brnyas thabs kyang byas mi chog ste/ las 'di 790

༄/ /chubatsugasab4cho minyima'ig4gtsosagagatasadabyungaka'akhor ba thog ma med pa nas tshur 'dod dgos pas rten bzang ngan gang 'thob rgyu 'jig rten pha rol tu ma song gong du shes dka'/ phyi ma'i lus rten bzhin mdzes rnam par bkra ba 'thob bar rings pa las da lta'i lus rten rgas 'khog 'di la brten nas ma ṇi grangs gsog pa rang dga' zhes dgongs gzhi can gyi gsung phebs shing nad des mi 'chi bar don gyis lung bstan nas phyag sman thun 'ga' gnang bas 'phral du sos te lo gcig tsam dge sbyor legs po byed rgyu byung / zla ba gnyis pa'i yar tshes la 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i sprul sku rin po che gdan sar spyan drangs te mi 'jigs seng ge'i khri la zhabs sen bkod pa'i thog ma'i dga' ston du nang so blo bzang yar 'phel ngo g.yog ched mngags gdong tshig don phun sum tshogs pa'i shis brjod kyi shog dril lha rdzas nang mdzod dngul srang bco lnga'i maṇ+ḍal dar tshon sna lnga'i sne 'degs can tshe rdzas kyis bkang ba'i rin chen bum pa dpag bsam shing gi kha rgyan can gyi rtse mor tshe dpag med kyi sku brnyan bzhugs pa sku gsung thugs rten rdo rje'i re kha can gyi bzhugs gdan rgyab yol tshem drub ma nor bu don yod zhags pa bcas 'bul rgyu skur ba gnang / a lag shā tshe dbang thu sa lag chi gza' mi rnams mjal du 'ongs par sgol dkar gyi rjes gnang sogs stsal/ zhwa dmar dgon gyi gdan 'dren pa bra rti zhabs drung ngo g.yog mā thi dgon gye gdan 'dren pa rgyud pa bla ma khyung nag zhabs drung sogs rim gyis 'byor par bka' lan bzang po gnang / mdung nag ko kyu no mon han gnas skor du 'byon zhor la 'ongs par khros nag lha lnga'i dbang mkha' spyod ma'i siskyo ra'i byin rlabs sogs gsang chos 'ga' zhig gnang gong ma'i mdzod nas thon pa'i ku ku sha'i ho phun rin thang can zhig phul/ bkra shis 'khyil bla brang nas rgyal mkhan po grags pa rgyal mtshan dang spyi so'i gnyer ba ngo g.yog rnams gdan 791

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/'dren du 'byor te gsum pa'i tshes la chibs kyi kha lo bsgyur bis sngon la rtsar byakhyung dgon pa'i las sna grwa pa mang po zhig 'ongs nas ja thab zhus/ pa yan stod smad ka mdo gcu 'khor gyi grong sde du ma'i ja zhu dang mjal pa mu mthud nas 'ongs par mjal kha dang dmigs brtse ma rigs gsum mgon po'i snying po byams pas dam bca'i gzungs sogs gzungs sngags zab mo rnams dang bde gshegs brgyad dang rin chen gtsug tor can sogs kyi mtshan rna lam du sgrog par mdzad/ rta bsu ring ba tshan gnyis gser chen chu khar dus 'khor spyi dang rgan gya'i ched hu so so'i thab bsu a khu phyag mdzod sprul sku rin po che'i yab bla brang gi zhabs phyi che gras kyi rta bsu/ stag ri'i thang la tshogs chen khri thog pa sgo mang mkhan zur blo bzang chos dar nged dang khri dpal ldan grags pa'i sprul pa'i sku sde khri sprul sku rgyud pa dus 'khor sman pa gsum gyi dpon slob gdan zur zhabs drung sku skye las sne che chung sogs kyi rta bsu pa sum brgya skor mchod rol sna tshogs thogs pa'i dge 'dun nyis stong lhag gi ser sbreng dang bcas pas mdun bsus te tshes drug la bla brang chen mor phyag phab nas sprul sku rin po che dang mjal phrad mdzad/ sku phreng du mar thugs yid gcig tu 'dres pa'i rten 'brel gyis mjal tsam nyid nas yab srasaganyi ga thugs shin tu bag pheb cing dgyes tshor tshad med pa mdzad pas der 'khod kyi zhabs bgres rgan pa rnams kyang mos gus dang skyo shas kyis yid g.yo ba byung / che bgres rnams kyis mchog sbrul rin po che rab byung sgrub rgyu dang chos bka' gsan rgyu'i snyan gsan dang yun ring tsam bzhugs dgos kyi gsol ba btab/ rje nyid nas mchog sbrul rin po cher brtan bzhugs kyi rten 'brel bsgrigs te lha rdzas nang mdzod dngul gyi maṇ+ḍal sku gsung thugs rten bzhugs gdan rgyab yol na bza' cha tshang dbang chas cha tshang rten kheb 792

sa / /rje btsun tha bas mud+mar tagan6khakagacig cod paṇa cha phor shub dngul mgo can gyi rdor dril bkra shis rtags brgyad tshem grubs tsher bdun gar yol gyi thod pa tho lo gor gyi skyed bu kha kheb dang bcas gos chen rgyan bzhi dang rdo rje gsang lam ma sogs yug che chung bco lnga kha che'i ras gser gyi me tog can yug o ru su'i phyar khra legs pa gcig khe bi su'i bzhugs gdan 'brug ma spu byug legs pa yug bzhi dngul srang brgya dngalnga bcu spos dang zhwa snam zam dar sogs rnam grangs sum brgya lhag phul zhing maṇ+ḍal gyi zhu 'bul dge bshes 'jigs med rab rgyas kyis mdor bsdus tsam zhus/ 'di dang lhan du bkra shis dge 'phel gyi ri khrod pa rnams kyis sprul sku rin po che'i zhabs brtan du tshe sgrub byas pa'i bum chu khyer 'ongs pa phul bas rten 'brel ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba 'grigs tshogs chen du mang 'gyed bstar/ tshes bcu la mchog sprul rin po che'i gtsug phud bzhes te rab byung gi sdom pa stsal nas tshangs par spyod pa'i dpal la bkod cing mtshan blo bzang thub bstan 'jigs med nyi ma zhes gsol/ mchog sprul rin po cher sgol dkar bka' bab dgu ldan dang seng ldeng nags sgol 'jigs byed zhal phyag yongs rdzogs mgon po bar chad kun sel dang snying zhugs rnams kyi rjes gnang / skyabs 'gro gdugs dkar bstod pa sgol sher sogs kyi lngags lung gnang zhing / tshogs chen 'du khang du khri thog pa sgo mang mkhan zur khri chen dpal ldan grags pa'i sprul pa'i sku sde khri sbrul sku rgyal mkhan po sgo mang bla ma ngag dbang dge legs kyi sprul sku grwa tshang so so'i bla ma sogs nged cag dpon slob dge 'dun mang dang bcas par lam rim chen mo'i bshad lung gi dbu btsugs te mchod brjod kyi steng nas ngo mtshar ba'i bshad pa rnam grangs mang zhing gzhung gi khogs la go ba bog chod du ster ba'i blo skyed can gyi gsung bshad ya mtshan pa gnang / dgon pa'i bla sprul kha shas dang rong bo'i 793

༄/ /gu bang ba nar+sāthoname'i gsung 'bum/yi ngogs mkhan chen sprul sku don yod rgya mtsho yi ngogs chos rje dge 'dun mkhasagrub sogs phyogs 'dus 'ga' zhig bcas don gnyer can brgya lhag la blo sbyong tshig brgyad ma'i khrid 'jam dpal nag po'i sgom lung nyid kyis mdzad pa'i mgon po'i bskang bshags mdor bsdus sogs lngags lung 'ga' zhig / hor tshang gser khri tshang dang 'gyang ro sprul sku sogs kyis gtsos pa'i grwa pa bco lnga la nyid kyis mdzad pa'i mgon dkar dang dzam dkar gyi sgrub skor sogs kyi lung gling sprul sku sogs la lcang skya rol pa'i rdo rje'i gsung bla mgon dbyer med kyi gsol 'debs sogs kyi lung gnang / tshom chen gsar ba'i nang du yab sras rnam pa gnyis kyis dbu mdzad dgon pa'i bla ma las sne thams cad gzhi byes kyi 'grul ba brgya lhag tsam dang bcas pas bzhugs gral gyi dga' ston rgya chen po'i thog a mchog rab 'byams pa mtha' yas rgya mtsho dang mdzo dge rab 'byams pa blo bzang gnyis nas tshogs gleng byas te chos dang srid kyi dus ston spel/ rje nyid la legs 'bul lha rdzas nang mdzod dngul gyi maṇ+ḍal dar tshon sna lnga'i sne 'dogs can sku gsung thugs rten dngul rta mig ma drug gos chen rgyu mdog sna tshogs yug che chung nyi shu snam phrug nyi shu spos chags brgyad cu gya gcig zhwa snam nyi shu leng dkar bo yug bcu gzig lpags gnyis stag lpags gnyis dom lpags gcig zam yug sum cu chibs chen gnyis kyis gtsos rta nyi shu rtsa lnga bkra shis pa'i lha rdzas bcas khyon rnam grangs lnga brgya dang bcu bdun phul/ bla brang gi phyag g.yog pa thun mong gis bskul ngor mchog sprul rin po che'i zhabs brtan gsol 'debs ljags rtsom lung dang bcas gnang / nged dang hor tshang gser khri tshang tshogs chen khri thog pa so so'i nang du'ang gdan drangs te gsol ston dang legs 'bul zhus byams pa'i gos sku gsar ba bkram pa la dge 'dun mang dang lhan du khrus gsol smon lam gsung /794

༄/ /chubatsun bzabachosakyinyis ga bdakerasadabyunganarje btsun mi las mgon po rdo rje rjes su bzung tshul gyi bkod pa shā 'cham du grags pa'i ltad mo bstar bar gzigs rtog dang byams khang dang gser gdung 'du khang sogs la mchod mjal thugs smon mdzad/ dus 'khor grwa tshang gi tshogs dbur yun ring tsam bzhugs nas phyag len dbyangs rta sogs la zhib gzigs dang thugs dgyes pa'i rnam pa mdzad rten 'brel gyi khyad du sku gzan rnying ba rten skal la bzhag / sku tsha no mon han sku bsnyungs te lo kha shasakyi ring sman bcos rim gro rgyun ldan bgyis kyang phan skyed cher med par rim lod du song ste sku gshegs par rgyu mtshan zhu mi thu'u bkwan nang so ngo g.yog 'byor par thugs 'tsher chen po mdzad cing sems nyid zhabs drung blo bzang mchog grub nyi ma la sku gdung zhugs 'bul zhu rgyu dang dgongs rdzogs ji ltar ba rgyu'i zhal bkod gnang ste yel chi phyir btang / mchog sprul rin po ches gtsos dgon pa'i bla sprul rnams la ljags bsngo dang tshogs chen dang grwa tshang so sor mang ja grwa ja'i thog bsngo smon yang dag zhus/ bzhugs ring la dad ldan mang por phyag dbang chos 'brel sogs gang 'dod du stsal zhing sengs bar du bla ma dge bshes rnams mdun du 'dzom par mdo sngags rig gnas lo rgyus sogs las brtsams pa'i chos kyi gsung 'phros dang dpe sna tshogs par gzigs rtog sogs kyis dus 'da' bar mdzad/ las tshan pa rnams la dgon pa spyi dang bla brang nang gi don skor rnams btang snyoms su ma bzhag par 'bad dgos kyi bslab ston gnang / khyad par mchog sprul rin poche'i zhabs brtan sku rim le shor med par sgrub rgyu'i dran bskul dang dge rgan lha ram pa la sger du sprul sku'i rgyun gyi mdzad spyod dang gsan spyong gi zhabs bskul zhu lugs sogs kyi bslab bya mthil phyin pa stsal te mdor na sprul pa'isku rin po che'i sku tshe mdzad 'phrin sogs gong du 'phel ba'i thabs dang 795

༄/ /gungangong ba napa'i me'i gsung 'bum/rten 'brel gyi sgo cha mtha' dag nas phye ste phun sum tshogs pa'i dge mtshan gyi lamapol yangs por mdzad do/ / yab rje ma dros bdag po'i gsang gsum gyi/ / bcud ldan 'dren pa mchog gi sprin sngon las/ / 'phrin las gru char 'jo bas ma dros klung / / 'gengs pa'i bka' drin zo chun 'khor lo bzhin/ / rgyal ba'i sras po 'jam dpal gzhon nu yang / / rgyal kun yab tu gyur pa'i ngo mtshar bzhin/ / rab bkram skye ba'i zlos gar bsgyur na yang / /thugs bskyed re kha'i mtshams las 'da' ba med/ / mtha' yas zhing du du ma'i sgyu 'phrul gyi/ / bkod pa rab 'byam 'byam klas bsgyur na yang / /mgon po khyod thugs thugs rje'i dbang gyur phyir/ / skyo ba mi mnga' mnga' bdag chen po'i tshul/ / sdung byed zung gis snang byas pa'i/ / kun gsal mchog tu gsal ba bzhin/ / mgon po zung gis mgon bcas pa'i/ / dor 'dzin dge mtshan nor bus gtams/ / zla ba'i ma ma zla ba'i zer gyis 'phel/ / rgyal ba'i myu gu rgyal ba'i sras su grags/ / de bzhin lu gu rgyud du yab sras kyi/ / 'phreng bar 'brel ba'i thugs bskyed e ma rmad/ / de ltar mchog sprul rin po che'i bzhed don dang mchog dman mtha' dag gi 'dod pa'i re ba skong bar mdzad nas nyi shu'i nyin bla brang nas thon dus mchog sprul rin po che la gser gyi grangs 'dzin can gyi phyag phreng rnying ba zhig phul te 'bral mi phod par thugs 'phrang ba'i rnam pa mdzad cing dge 'dun mang gis gling 'dabs su chibs skyel dar 'bod dang thal skad gtong ba sogs rten 'brel mang po bsgrigs khri gdan zur las sna che chung sogs kyis ja thab bar du chibs skyel zhus/ nyi ma lung la zhag bzhugs mdzad de ri khrod la mang 'gyed nyer gcig la gcu 'khor dgon du bzhugs dgon par mang 'gyed dang mngonatogs rgyan nyid kyi zhabs brtan gsol 'debs sogs kyi lung gnang /796

༄/ /chabatsun bzangartsamadzamanyisa'i mdagarasadabyungananyer gnyis la bas mdo'i dgon bkra shis chos gling du gdan drangs pa bzhin rta thab ser sbreng dang bcas g.yer chung bla brang du babs dad 'dus kyi pho mo drug brgya tsam la mjal kha gnang ste mtshan dang gzungs sngags zab mo rna bar bsgrags nas thar pa'i sa bon bskrun pa sogs rgyun gyi phyag bzhes ltar mdzad/nyer gsum la 'du khang du dgon pa'i khri pa dpal ldan rgya mtsho stag ge sprul sku dge 'dun bstan pa rab rgyas sogs kyis gtsos gzhi byes kyi ser skya stong phrag brgal bar dga' ldan lha brgya ma'i khrid lam gtso dang mngon rtogs rgyan gyi lung bcas stsal gsol ston dang 'bul ba gzab rgyas zhus shing phar yang mang 'gyed gnang / de nas rim par phebs te kho tshe dpon po'i khyim du bcag mal mdzad cing sngags pa 'ga' zhig la rta mgrin chos skor gyi le tshan kha shas kyi lung dang 'dod don zhus pa'i re ba bskangs shing so so nas 'bul nod gzabs khu re zhabs drung gis gdan drangs nas gsol ston 'bul nod dang rten gsum la rab gnas zhus/ nyer dgu'i nyin dgon lung du phyag phebs rgyal ba yab sras sogs bod kyi mchog dman rnams kyi yig lan sngar rgyun ltar bsgrigs/ snga ma zhig rta tshag rje drung rin po che'i gsung shog tu mkha' ral shig rgyus kyis 'tshem pa'i ngal ba byed kyin yod gsung ba la/ nyid nas shig rgyus kyis mi yong bas dgu tshigs kyis tshem mdzod ces zhu ba gnang ba las 'phros te lo snga mar rta tshag rin po ches bzhad cha slong ba'i gsung 'ga' zhig bskur gnang 'dug pa'i lan du nged rang gis bzhad cha slong ba'i tshig re gnyis zhu 'dod snga mo nas yod kyang / deng sang bla chen phal cher thugs kyi ri dwags rnam rtog gi rgya la 'thum pa'i tshul mdzad pa'i dbang gis snga ma 'ga' zhig la nged nas ku re byas pa thugs ga'i hūṃ mthing nag la phog ste 'od zer nag po 'phros byung ba dang 'dab chags ne tso gzeb tu chud pa'ang ha cang smra 797

༄/ /gung thangangayo pa'isgraname'i gsung 'bum/ba mang ba'i nyes pa yin par mthong zhing / kha gang zag gi bdag med 'di la dge mtshan ci'ang med par shes nas gzhung bzang re gnyis ma gtogs pa'i so phal che ba'ang 'thor ba bcas deng sang smra ba bskyung ba nyid nyams len gyi gtso bo bgyed lags na'ang / skyes mchog nyid nas gzhan gyes ku re sogs zhus pa la mi mnyes pa med pa nam mkha' lta bu'i thugs dgongs can yin skad thos par ma zad da res kyi zin yig tu ring nas zum pa'i kha'i ba ku la dbang med du 'byed pa'i gsung gi 'gram chang yang 'thor ba gnang 'dug par brten spyi brtol bskyed de cal col 'ga' zhig zhus pa 'di lta ste zhes pas mtshamasasbyar nas kyal ga'i gsung 'ga' zhig dang / nam mkha' ral ba'i rgyurkyen dang de nyin bcos rgyag rgyu'i skor la dam pa gzhan dang gzhan 'ga' zhig nye sras gzhan bdun re re dang sbyar nas de dag gi gnam gyi ka ba nyan pa'i re ba mi 'dug tshul dpe re re dang sbyar nas gsungs pa yi ges 'jigs te ma bris/ rta tshag rin po che nam mkha'i snying po ngang sbyar nas mkha' ral la bcos rgyag pa nam mkha'i snying po nyid kyi khur yin pa rang gi mtshan gyis kyang gsal bas nged mi'u thung yin pas nam mkha' la lag pas rnyob pa mi 'dug ces mi gsung ba mkhyen mkhyen zhu zhes bskur gnang mdzad pa 'byung 'gyur lung bstan lta bu zhig tu song snang / mo'u ming gan gyi rab 'byams pa chos rgya mtshos zhus ngor don gnyer ba nyung 'dus la nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i sirdu ra'i byin rlabs stsal/ sa rgyan sbyor tshul theg chen lam bzang gsal ba'i nyi ma zhes tshig tshogs ha cang mi che'ang gzhung spyi'i khogs 'bub tshul gyi gnad gsal bar ston pa la 'gran zla med pa'i legs bshad gser gyi lde mig lta bu de nyid lngags rtsom mdzad/ nged kyis sngar nas gsol ba btab pa bzhin nged dang sems nyid zhabs drung o'u shi zhabs drung che chung gnyis li kyā zhabs 798

ga / /jebatsun tha gsangathab labadaganacomatshurakadrung o'u han sku skye bkra shis 'khyil gyi dge bshes gnyis har chen tho yon sogs dgon lung gi chos rje dka' ram don gnyer ba lnga bcu tsam la sgrub thabs rin 'byung las jo bo'i lugs kyi sgrol dkar nas nyi ma spas pa'i lugs kyi yongs rdzogs byed pa'i sgrol ma'i bar lha brgya dang dgu bcu go bdun gyi rjes gnangasnal/ rjes gnang grangs mang yang tshar gang mgyogs brtsis pa'i sla chos mi mdzad par mgo mjug thams cad cha mnyam du mngon rtogs rnams spyan dmigs dang bcas dal bus gsungs shing bzlas pa grangs can re gnang / mchod gtor sogs kyang rgyud sde gong 'og gi lugs srol ma 'dres pa rjes gnang gi grangs dang mnyam pa'i mchod ba cha tshang ba rjes gnang snga phyi'i bar du gsol ba dang khams gsang sogs gnang na'ang de ma thag khrus dang nye reg mdzad pa sogs phyag len phra zhing zhib pa dang rjes gnang phal cher la lha rang rang gi lo rgyus phan yon gzhung gzhan dang lugs srol gzhan la der ming 'dogs tshul mi 'dra ba'i brda chad tshun chod dang / ching su cug thu'i lhan thabs sogs la kha bskang dgos pa 'ga' zhig ma tshang zhing 'ga' zhig lhag por 'dug pas 'byin 'jug 'di ltar byed dgos zhes zhib tu gsungs pa sogasablo skyed can gyi gsung bshad mang du gnang ste mdor na bshad pa dang phyag len gang thad nas blo ldan gzu bor gnas rnams rang dbang med par yid ches kyi dang ba 'dren pa'i khyad chos bla na med pa zhig snang ngo / / thog mar rjes gnang 'di'i snyan gsan phul ba'i tshe nged kyis rin 'byung gi rjes gnang byas pa 'di mthar phyin po zhig yong dka' bar 'dug snga sor pe cing du tshador no mon han la 'di'i rjes gnang byed skabs kyang mjug grub rgyur ma song / da lan yang tshang bar e thub mi shes kyang gang thub cig byed dgos gsung byung ba skabs der gsung tshul tsam yin mod snyam byung 'di'i rjes 799

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i ga4 'bum/gnang 'phro ma rnams rjes sor 'ongs nas zhu rtsis byas pa rkyen dbang gis thog tu ma khel bas sngar gyi gsung de nyid de dus nas 'byung 'gyur mngon sum du gzigs te gsungs pa yin par gzod shes pa byung / de nas rje nyid kyis gsar du bka' rtsom mdzad pa'i lcang skya rol pa'i rdo rje'i rnam thar dge ldan bstan pa'i mdzes rgyan glegs bam gnyis kyi dpar rong po nas g.yer gshong mkhan rin po che dang bis pa sprul sku rnam gnyis kyis thugs khur mdzad nas legs par grub ste bskur byung par drug pa'i tshes drug la mdzod pa rab 'byams pa phun tshogs bstan pa ngo g.yog chu bzang dgon du ched mngags gdong lcang skya sprul sku rin po cher rnam thar gyi dpar phud po ti gnyis phul par thugs dgyes tshor chen pos mdzod pa rab 'byams pa la phyag mdzod chos rje'i cho lo bka' drin gnang zi ling du dus chen dang bstun sprang po brgya phrag mang po la sbyin pa gtong 'jug par mdzad/ yongs 'dzin rin po che'i slob ma hor lding sgom pa blo bzang rgyal mtshan mjal du 'ongs par sems nyid zhabs drung sogs sku skye dka' ram 'ga' zhig la yongs 'dzin rin po che'i gsung gi bla mchod khrid yig chen mo sogs kyi lung mnyan du bcug par mdzad/zla ba bdun pa'i nang du bya khyung gi khu re zhabs drung gis zhus ngor de dang sems nyid zhabs drung sogs grwa pa brgya lhag la bla mchod kyi khrid dang thu sa lag chi lha mgon tshe brtan gyis zhus ngor mgon dkar gye rjes gnang dang nyid kyis mdzad pa'i de'i gtor chog dang nor sgrub rig byed ma'i sgrub thabs ut+pa lī phreng ba dpang gi sbyin sreg khams gsum dbang du sdud pa'i lcags kyu bcas kyi lung / gzhan yang bla med lugs kyi rdor sems rjes gnang lam gtso dga' ldan lha brgya ma/ thun drug rnal 'byor bla ma'i rnal 'byor don gnyis lhun 'grub rnams kyi khrid 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa rin po che'i sprul sku'i 800

da / /che badza gas byung khag dgonazhabs brtan gsol 'debs sogs chos tshan thor bu mang po bcas so so'i mos pa bzhin zab cing rgya che ba'i chos kyi bdud rtsi'i dga' ston rgya cher stsal/nyin gcig nged kyi sdod gnas su glo bur phebs te lha rdzas nang mdzod gos chen ser po yug dngul dkar gyi 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa che legs bcas gnang nas sa rgyan sbyor tshul 'di sa lam gyi 'geng gshog pa la shin tu gal che ba zhig 'dug pas rgyas pa zhig 'bri 'dun yod kyang long skabs ma byung bas mdor bsdus tsam zhig bris pa yin/ da khyed kyis phan tshun gcig gis gcig la kha skongatshul dang lam gyi lus gcig tu dril lugs sogs phan tshun sbyor tshul gyi gnad rnams gsal bar ston cing sa sde spyi'i khogs 'chun pa'i bshad pa shin tu rgyas pa zhig bri dgos zhes bka' gnang byung bar bdag lta bu la de 'dra'i spobs pa ga la yod kyang bla ma'i byin rlabs la brten nas de 'dra'i skal ba yod srid dam snyam pa dang / gtso bor 'dren mchog yab sras rnams kyis rjes su bzung ste theg pa mchog gi gzhung lugs rgya mtsho lta bu de dag la thos bsamasgom gsum gyis 'jug pa'i rten 'brel gye sgo mi 'gag pa'i phyir du bri rgyu'i khas len zhus/ sngon chad g.yeng ba ci rigs kyis bri ba rngo ma thogs kyang da dung bka' bzhin sgrub pa'i mchod pa zhig e thub snyam pa'i yid smon gyi ngang du mchis/ mchod rten thang gi bla zur sngo kho zhabs drung rgya tig zhabs drung rnam gnyis gtsos pa'i dgon pa'i las sde dang mchod gzhis rgan gsum bcas skya ser sum cu tsam 'ongs nas bkra shis dar rgyas gling gi chos khrir bzhugs rgyu'i gsol ba nan tan btab par zhal bzhes mi gnang kha med byung stesnga 'gros su dgon lung gi dge bshes hor zhi bka' bcu slob chung du sko bzhag mdzad cing phyag mdzod gnyer ba dang bcas thab 'dzin du btang /zla ba brgyad pa'i tshes la har chin nas bla brang gi gzhi gnyer nang so dge 801
