sa / /gu ba nab thoname'i gsung 'bum/legs ngo g.yog dang bod nas rje 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i dpon po mkhan po dkon mchog sergo ngo g.yog rnams 'byor nas mjal kha zhus par rgya bod kyi gnas tshul las brtsams pa'i gsung gleng 'phel/ tshes brgyad la kho bo cag nas rkyen sel du dmigs te gsol ba btab pa bzhin nged cag brgya lhag tsam la sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo bka' bab dgu ldan gyi rjes gnang bka' drinadu stsal/ snga sor nged la mtshan nyid kyi dge bshes sgra snyan ngag sogs la'angasbyang ba yod pa gnyis tsam zhig khrid yod na 'di nas don gnyer can rnams la phan thogs par 'dug gsungs pa bzhin mdzod dge blo bzang dang rdoba'i dge 'dun gnyis khrid 'ongs te dgon lung du blo gsar ba rnams la mtshan nyid kyi dpe khrid dang don gnyer can 'ga' zhig la sgra'i ri mo dang sum rtags sogs bslab nas bka' bzhin bsgrubs par thugs shin tu mnyes pas bsngags brjod bla na med pa mdzad cing gnang sbyin stsal/ tshes dgu nas bzung ste nyi ma gsum gyi ring sems nyid zhabs drung sogs mang po la sa rgyan sbyor tshul theg chen lam bzang gsal ba'i nyi ma mi 'khrugs pa'i dbang chog gaṅgā'i chu rgyun rdor sems rjes gnang bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun 'jigs byed kyi bla ma'i rnal 'byor gdugs dkar zlog chen rgyas pa sogs nyid kyi gsar rtsom mang po dang / 'jam dbyangs bde ba'i rdo rjes mdzad pa'i srad rgyud lugs kyibla ma'i rnal 'byor thun mong ma yin pa'i brgyad 'debs khrid yig 'pho ba dang bcas pa kun mkhyen 'jigs med dbang pos mdzad pa'i dga' ldan lha brgya ma'i smon lam sogs don gnyer can mang po'i 'dod mos ltar chos tshan thor bu mang bo zhig gi lngags lung stsal/ bcu gnyis la zhabs drung sku skye sogs grwa pa brgya lhag la nam mkha' sgo 'byed kyi dbang stan thog gcig ma'i khrid/ nyid kyis mdzad pa'i gcod kyi gdams pa thar pa'i sgo 'byed zab 802

༄/ /༄sasum4cho migyisagangagatso4gagatasadabyungakadonayang snying gcod lugs kyi glud chog dri med mchog sbyin khros nag lha lnga'i bdag mdun gtor zlog gi cho ga bcas kyi lung stsal/ chos bzang ri khrod kyi 'du khang rje nyid nas rgyu chas sbyar te lo snga ma zhig nas shing rtsi logs ris dang bcas legs par grub zin par rab gnas byed dgos zhes nged la gsung gnang ba bka' bzhin bsgrubs/ hal ha'i che chen han gyi sder gtogs mahā thi pe li'i shog gi lha ram pa blo bzang bzod pa sin no yon gyi sder gtogs tho yon blo bzang bkra shis ngo g.yog bka' chos don du gnyer nas ched gtad kyis 'ongs pa bzhin zhu mkhan rnams kyis gtsos rdo ba zhabs drung li kyā zhabs drung sogs drag zhan byed sum brgya tsam la zla ba dgu pa'i tshes lnga nas nyin bcu'i ring snying zhugs ma gtogs pa'i mgon po bka' chen gyi rjes gnang yongs rdzogs dang seng gdong ma gtso 'khor gsum drag po gsum dril rta mgrin gsang sgrub rnams kyi rjes gnang / lha bcu gsum ma'i sgrub thabs za ma tog sa rgyan sbyor tshul sogs dang kun mkhyen 'jigs med dbang po'i gsung gi tshe bdag mgon po la brten pa'i tshe chog 'chi med 'dod 'jo'i bum bzang sogs chos tshan kha shas dang jo bo'i chos chung brgya rtsa'i dbu btsugs nas byang chub kyi sems rin po che sbyong tshul dgra las rgyal ba gsang bas mdzad pa zhes pa'i bar le tshan sum cu lhag tsam gyi lung sogs chos bka' thor bu du ma dang / bco lnga nas nyin bdun gyi ring lam rim bde lam gyi khrid nyin rer chos thun gnyis re byas te gsal byed kyi dpe dang sgrub byed kyi lung rigs mtha' yas pa dang sbyar ba'i bshad pa 'byam klas shing myong steng du bskor bas rgyud 'khul nges pa gnang ste lam gyi lus yongs su rdzogs pa'i bag chags khyad par can shes rgyud la bskrun par mdzad/ lha bab dus chen dang bstun nas mkhyen yangs gling du mchod pa rnam lnga dpag tu med pa bshams te dge 'dun 803

༄/ /yo ba na ba'ithoname'i༄nga ཿma/lnga brgya tsam gyis sems bskyed mchod pa gnang ste dpon slob tshang mas bzang spyod ltung bshags sher snying bstan 'bar ma rnams 'ur chems kyis gsung /lha ram pa dang tho yon gnyis kyis brtan bzhugs kyi rten 'brel bsgrigs te bdog pa'i dngos po gya nom pa bstar zhing lha ram pas zhu 'bul 'brel chags pa mdor bsdus shig zhus par thugs dgyes pa'i bka' lan gnang / 'di dus zhal nas khyed tshos nged rang gis chos khri'i steng nas bshad pa 'di rnams mabarjed pa gyis brjed nas nga la dris kyang ngas mi shes nged kyis lam rim rgyun ldan nyams len byed kyin med cing 'dris cha'ang chen po med 'on kyang lam rim bshad dus thog mar bla ma byams pa rin po che la yan lag bdun pa dang maṇ+ḍal phul nas gsol ba btab ste chos bshad la 'jug na nyin ji tsam gyi ring bshad dgos kyang bshad rgyus mi phongs pa zhig yin/ 'di ni bla ma'i byin rlabs dang chos nyan pa'i bsod nams kyi mthu tshogs pa las byung ba yin pas rjes sor nga la dogs pa dris kyang nged rang gis shes dgos pa'i nges pa med gsung ba ni rnam pa khengs bskyung ba lta bu la blo gros can zhig gis legs par brtags na bsam gyes mi khyab pa'i rnam thar dang rjes 'jug rnams kyis godagos pa'i man ngag chen po zhig tu snang ngo / / nyer gsum la bde lam dam 'khrid lam rim gsol 'debs dang smon lam paṇa chen chos rgyan gsung gi gcod kyi gdams pa thar 'dod ded dpon gyi khrid lung / 'pho khrid dpa' bo g.yul 'jug ma'i khrid lung sogs dang tshe khrid kyi brgyud 'bebs 'chi med mchog sbyin gye lung bcas stsal te mang mas chos mtshams mdzad/nyer bzhi la lha ram pa dang tho yon sogs nyung 'dus la snying zhugs kyi rjes gnang rgyal po sku lnga dang dam can gnyis kyi rigs gtad nyid kyis mdzad pa'i sku lnga'i bsnyen yig rgyal bo rol mtsho'i lung bcas gnang / sbyin bdag pe zi 804

༄/ /stebatsugasab4cho migyi gagangagatsosacadakhasadabyung/mtsho skyes rdo rje sku mched gnyis mjal du 'ongs par gang zhus dgongs bzhed ltar bsgrubs/ zla ba bcu pa'i tshes la hal ha thu she gung gi no yon tu thog thu'i phyag mdzod don 'grub bzang po ji nong gung gi a khu tho yon tshe dpag rdo rje sogs ser skya mang tsam sleb khong tshos kyang ched dmigs kyis bka' chos zhu bar 'ongs pa bzhin lha ram bas zhus pas bka' chos kyi 'phro dang 'di tshos zhus pa rnams phyogs gcig byas nas zhu mkhan rnams kyis gtsos ma rgyud kyi dbang thob pa bzhi bcu skor la nā ro mkha' spyod kyi siskyo ra'i byin rlabs de'i bskyed rdzogs kyi khrid nyin lnga'i ring smin rgyas dang mjug tu slob ma snod ldan kha shas la bsam mi khyab thun mong ma yin pa'i sdud rim gyi khrid lkog chos su stsal/gzhan yang nam mkha' sgo 'byed kyi dbang rta mgrin gsang sgrub dang khyung nag gi rjes gnang thog ma'i blo sbyong sogs chos tshan thor bu 'ga' zhig gi lung dang rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas kyi khrid sogs don gnyer can mtha' dag gi 'dod pa bzhin chos kyi bdud rtsi'i 'char phab ste bde mchog dkar po'i tshe dbangagis bka' chos kyi mjug bsdu bar mdzad/ 'di'i tshes bcu gnyis la brtag gzhi can gye mnal lam zhig byung tshul 'ja' klong 'khyil bar gsal/skabs shig phyag mdzod chos rje phun tshogs bstan pa'i nad gzhi rnying ba rgyun ldan 'phar nas blo sems ma bde ba la khyod kyi nad 'di lo lnga rag la skyon med dam snyam de phan chad sems chung dgos shas che gsungs pa ni rta nas brtsis pa'i lo lnga ba khyi lor rje nyid dag zhing du gshegs pa yin pas khong rang bzhugs ring la sku dngos kyis phyag sman dang byin rlabs gnang rgyu yin pas dogs pa mi dgos shing / de phyin chad nas blo rtse gtad pher sa med gshis sems chung yang dag byed dgos zhes pa'i brda yin par gdon mi za'o/ / de dusablo gros dar rgyas kyi rmi lam du chos rje rang gis skyabs 'jug zhus par 805

༄/ /gung bang bstan pa'i sgroname'i skung 'bum/nyid nas nged kyis rnam 'joms byab khrus shig byas na skyon med gsung ba zhig mis/ phyi nyin zhog ka mi lam de zhus chog gam mi chog bsam yod par zhus chog pa'i rteng bskul lta bu chos rje'i nad 'di la gang byas na dga' zhes yang yang gsung ba la khos mi lam byung tshul de zhus pas dgongs par babs te nyid dngos kyis rnam 'joms kyi byab khrus shig gnang ba nas bzung ste nad gzhi 'phar ldang gi shugs chad song / 'dis mtshon nas sku don gal che dus 'ga' zhig tu zhabs phyi pa dang slob ma sogs kyi rmi lam la cha bzhag pa'i tshul gnang ste 'phyug med byung ba mang zhing chos kyi dogs pa dang 'jig rten gyi bya bzhagagang zhu rgyu sku mdun du song nas zhu ma phod pa'am brjed song ba rnams la de dang de'i rigs kyi gleng mo bslang ste zhu rgyu'i go skabs phye ba sogs pha rol gyi bsam pa mngon par mkhyen cing gdul bya'i don la bsnyel ba mi mnga' ba'i dan rtags shin tu mang ngo / / 'on kyang rje 'di ni rang gi yon tan sba bya zhing / / gzhan gye yon tan bsgrag par bya/ / zhes pa ltar bka' gdams gong ma'i rnam thar lhur bzhes te rang la mngon shes yod pa'i gtam sogs gtan nas mi mdzad la/ gal srid de 'dra dgos pa byung tshe rang gzhan gye rmi lam la bsdur ba'i tshul dang gsung 'phros dang zhal rtsed bka' bkyon ci rigasakyis zhor du gnang ba zhig yin pa ni gong 'og tu bris pa rnams kyis dpog nus pa de bzhin yin pas zhabs 'brang ba sogs la de 'dra'i skabs rmi lamagasal cha 'byung ba'ang gzhan gyi snang ba bsgyur ba la mnga' brnyes pa'i byin rlabs kyi mthu yin pa gor ma chag go / lnga mchod kyi skabs su hang gin gu thi chos rje blo bzang rdo rje sogs skya ser sum cu tsam glebs par tshe dpag med dang ku ru kul+li thun mong ma yin pa'i rjes gnang de'i sgrub thabs ut+pa la'i phreng ba'i lung bcas gnang drung 'khor gu thi ngag dbang bstan 'phel gyis 806

sa / /rje btsun tsha bas mushā dmanam sa nagasol ba btab pa bzhin rje'i dus mchod kyi nyin lam rim smon lam skal bzang 'jug ngogs gsar rtsom mdzad de zhu ba po sogs la lung yang bka' drin stsal/ mtshan mo zhig sems nyid zhabs drung dang gu thi ngag dbang bstan 'phel gnyis la rgyal dbang rnam thar gsang ba rgya can las 'byung ba'i dpal ldan dmag zor rgyal mo la las bzhi'i lha mos bskor ba'i rjes gnang thun mong ma yin pa stsal/ zla ba bcu gcig pa'i tshes la o thog pe li'i mi sna phas than tā a pa tas sogs skya ser brgya lhag 'ongs nas pe li gsar ba bsod nams rab rgyas dge 'dun gyi zhu shog dang legs 'bul rnams phul bka' bcu bstan dar ngo g.yog la khrus dbang dang sgrol ljang gi rjes gnang stsal 'grul ba so so nas dngos 'bul dang dgon par yang mang 'gyed bstar/tshes bdun 'khrungs skar gyi dga' ston chos bzang ri khrod nas mdzad par tshogs dbur spyan drangs te slob chung gtsos pa'i dge 'dun rnams kyis gnas brtan phyag mchod gsung ba dang sprags nas dgon lung khri pa bla brang gi phyag mdzod dge gnyer grwa rgan zhabs drung sku skye sogs dang mchod rten thang 'dul ba dgon sogs gzhi byes kyi dka' ram dge tshul slong brgya phrag kha shas dang bcas thams cad kyis rten 'byung gi 'bul ba tshan grangs mang po bstar te brtan bzhugs kyi rten 'brel bsgrigs ri khrod la mang 'gyed dang 'grul ba so sor gnang sbyin mdzad/ de nas dgon lung du phebs hal ha mgon po pe li'i tho yon tā bla ma blo bzang shes rab dang su nyid g.yas ru'i gu thi ngag dbang chos 'phel rnams 'ongs par de dag gis gtsos nyung 'dus la skyabs khrid smin rgyas lam khrid mdor bsdus nam mkha' sgo 'byed kyi dbang rta mgrin gsangasgrub kyi rjes gnang nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i dbang 'pho khrid dang bcas stsal/ zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i yar tshes la bkra shis 'khyil bla brang gi mtshams 807

/ /gung thangabastan pa'ithon 'i gsung 'bum/zhus 'bul mi 'ongs par srul sku rin po che'i lngags rtsom tshigs bcad cig khyer 'ongs pa la ṭīk+ka mdzad nas bskur ba gnang / su nyid g.yon ru'i wang gi mi sna tā bla ma blo bzang 'byung gnas ngo g.yog dang yo rad dom ta gung gi shog dge slong rgyal mtshan grags pa ngo g.yog rnams rim par 'byor nas tā bla mas wang gtsos pa'i drag zhan gyi zhu shog rten chas rnams phul de dag so sor tshe dpag med kyi tshe dbang dang seng ldeng nags sgrol gyi rjes gnang sogs stsal/sbyin bdag wang dpal 'byor yar 'phel gyis zhus pa ltar sde brgyad kyi bka' shog dang tā bla ma sogs kyis bskul ngor bslab mchog gling gi bca' yig ljags rtsom mdzad de gnang / ho'u chid g.yon ru'i wang gi tho yon ye shes bstan 'phel ngo g.yog la rta mgrin gsang sgrub dang lcam sring gi rjes gnang dga' ldan lha brgya ma'i khrid don gnyis lhun 'grub ma'i dmigs rim gyi lung sgol ljang gi rjes gnang sogs dang / dur ped chos rje blo bzang rnam rgyal sogs la mgon po'i be'u bum yongs rdzogs kyi lung rnam sras mdung dmar can gyi rjes gnang mgon po snying zhugs kyi rjes gnang bcas so so'i 'dod mos ltar rim pas stsal/ dgung lo re gsum pa sa mo lug gi lo gsar dga' ston dgon lung nas mdzad dgon lung gi cho 'phrul smon lam la sbyin bdag zur ba med par rje nyid nas dad ldan sbyin bdag rnams la rting bskul mdzad de 'ongs pa'i dngul srang drug brgya skor gyis rgyu sbyar bla brang nas khur blangs byas te tshes gnyis kyi gral 'dzin nas bcu drug gi yag pa'i brar mang ja drug cu re drug nyung ja nga gnyis thug pa gnyis bskang gso khang gi ja thug dkon mchog gi mchod pa chos skyong gi tshogs 'khor 'bul ba thob bzhin pa rnams la 'bul ba dang tshogs par gzhung ston dang grub ston gyi 'byed spyi 'jog tu nyid nas phyar dar chen po brgyad phyag mdzod chos rje phun tshogs bstan pas keng 808

༄/ /chubatsun khazang bakhangabakhu pabadaganasad khanaru'i 'cham lā bzhi bcas smon lam chen mo legs par grub/ bcu bzhi dang bco lnga'i nyin lcags mkhar gyi 'cham gzigs pa dang gsung chos smon lam gnang ba mjal pa rnams la sdom pa 'bog pa sogs mdzad o rad dom ta gung gi shog zhabs drung blo bzang skal bzang ngo g.yog la 'jigs byed zhal phyag yongs rdzogs kyi rjes gnang stsal/ 'dul ba dgon gyi rong po zhabs drung dpon g.yog gis rten 'byung gi 'bul tshan bstar te brtan bzhugs kyi rten 'brel bsgrigs o thog car gu chi sasgo skyabs tho yon blo bzang bstan 'dzin tha'i ji mo'u khus sogs 'dod chos kyis tshim par mdzad/ gser khog gi ched hu chos rje blo bzang bstan 'dzin gzhung las pa rab 'byams pa blo bzang chos 'dzin sogs la phyag rdor gtum po khyung lnga'i rjes gnang stsal/ zi lang am pan nas 7gnam skyong gong ma gnam du gshegs pa'i rgyu mtshan gyi yi ge byungabar nyi shu gsum nas dgon lung tshogs chen du zhag nyer gcig gi ring dgongs rdzogs kyi chos gsung rgyu'i dbu btsugs pa la rje nyid kyang tshogs dbur phebs nas bla mchod smon lam sogs gsungs shing lngags bsngo rgyas pa gnang / de nas zi lang du phebs te am pan dang mjal phrad mdzad cing rje rang nyid dgung lo bgres shing sku gzugs gcong can yin pa dang 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa sprul sku rin po che ha cing sku na gzhon pa bcas yab sra sa rnam gnyis sku dngos kyis pho brang du pheb dka' tshul rnam pa gnyis gas gnam skyong gong ma'i dgongs rdzogs kyi chos gsung gin yod tshul 7kyā ching gong mar thugs gso zhu rgyu'i skor rnams rta zam brgyud nas zhu ba phul/ tshur phebs te 7gong ma'i dgongs rdzogs kyi 'don pa grub nas chos bzang ri khrod du phebs sems nyid zhabs drung sogs bcu lhag la nyid kyi bka' rtsom gra'i rdo rje sems dpa'i rjes gnang bya tshul dpal mgon gyi gtor 'bul lha mo'i gtor chen 809

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/thun mong ma yin pa ma mo 'khrug skong lam rim smon lam sogs gsar rtsom mang po dang sum pa mkhan chen gyis mdzad pa'i lcags mkhar gyi cho ga rnams kyi ljags lung sku 'bum gyi mi nyag sprul sku rin po che dpon g.yog dang la mo bde chen gyi mog kyu zhabs drung ngo g.yog mjal du 'ongs par skyo ba bsangs pa'i gsung gleng dang 'dod chos ci rigs kyis mgu bar mdzad/ mi nyag sprul skus sku 'bum du 'byon rgyu'i snyan bskul zhus o rad tho yon sogs la rta mgrin gsang sgrub kyi rjes gnang stsal bcad rgya zhig gnang ste mjug tu kha skong gi sbyin sreg mdzad/ nag zla'i nya la dgon lung nas bsgrub bya kha shas dge tshul dang lnga bcu lhag la dge slong gi sdom pa stsal te bslab pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i gzhi la bkod/ lcang skya mchog sprul rin po che 7gong ma'i mtshams zhur 'byon rgyu'i mjal phrad la chu bzang du phebs nas pheb rdzong zhus mā rab 'byams pa blo bzang chos 'dzin gyis btsan po no mon han sprul pa'i sku rgya nag tu 'byon rgyu'i skor zhus par khyod rang yang 'gro rgyu yin mod gsung ba la mi 'gro tshul zhus pas 'gro dgos shas che zhes blang dor gyi bslab ston gnang ba bzhin rjes sor khongayang 'gro dgos shar bas sngar gyi gsung la yid ches rnyed/ de dus mā rab 'byams pas lcang skya gong ma'i rnam thar rje nyid kyis mdzad pa de brjod bya rjod byed gang thad nas yid 'phrog pa'i bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig byung 'dug pas rje nyid kyi rnam thar yang nyid rang gis mdzad na legs pa 'dug ces gsolab btab par nged rang gi rnam thar 'di yin zhes gsung rtsom sa rgyan sbyor tshul gyi dpe cha gnang ba dgongs gzhi zab par mngon/ hal ha'i mer gnasang gi mi sna dge bskos ngag dbang dpal bzang khā seng ge a lag shā chinawang gi mi sna tha'i ji bzang po sogs 'byor nas sbyin bdag so so'i zhu shog rten chas phul par brtag lan sogs 'tshem med du gnang / sa ga'i 810

༄/ /rjebatsugasab4chosaminyima'ig4bakhu pacadabasadabyunganadus chen la skyed tshal du bcad rgya mdzad de thugs dam shin tu dmar ba dang lo ltar gyi phyag tsha mang po dpar rgyu'ang sngar rgyun ltar mdzad/ zla ba lnga pa'i tshes la har chin ye phu tsachu pā la'i tho yon dpal ldan nor bu ngo g.yog 'byor par bla ma 'jam dbyangs pas mdzad pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi khrid yig brgyud 'debs 'pho ba dang bcas paṇa chen gsung gi gtor ma brgya rtsa rgyal dbang gi klu gtor cho gnyid kyi gsar rtsom skor gyi lung thor bu mang po gnang /mchod rten thang nas khri 'don la nan che bar tshes drug gi nyin spyi bla brang so so'i chibs skyel dang bcas dpon g.yog brgyad cu skor dgon lung nas thon/mang 'dus bla ma tshang kyu chos rje ngo g.yog mchod rten thang gi khri zur zang nga zhabs drung sogs rta bsu mang po dang bcas rdo dkar thang la sgar btab/tshes bdun gyi nyin rdo sgo bzhugs khri la mchod rten thang spyi'i ja thab zhus shing khes chen bud nas skya reng mda' la sgar btab mchod rten thang gi bla zur sngo kho zhabs drung gtsos pa'i skya ser mang po chibs bsur 'byor dad 'dus kyi mjalab mang po la mjal kha dang gzungs sngags zab mo rna lam du bsgrags/tshes brgyad la rnga chen mdar sngo kho gdugs dkar gtsos pa'i dud tshang mang po'i ja thab thog mjal ba brgya phrag mang por mjal kha dang bka' chos dkyus ma'i skor rnams rgyun gyi phyag bzhes ltar mdzad/ pheb lam du mchod rten thang gi slob chung hor zhi chos rje bde rgu zhabs drung tshogs chen dge bskos sogs skya ser brgya phrag gis chibs bsu dang khams mda' nas sgar btab/tshes dgu la dgon pa'i khri zur rgya tig zhabs drung gtsos pa'i rta bsu mang po dang gling 'dabs su dge 'dun mang gi ser sbreng gis mdun bsus te bla brang du babs bla zur rnam pa spyi pa btsan khang so so nas dem ja dang bcas mjal kha zhus dad 'dus kyi skya ser mang por phyag dbang sogs stsal/ gan chen 811

sa / /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/'bri gu chu klung thar pa gling zhwa dmar dgon sogs chos sde che chung rnams nas 'ongs pa'i bla ma las sne ci rigs kyis mjal kha zhus/ bcu gcig gi zhog ka tshogs dbur phebs te khri 'don mdzad dge 'dun mang gis zhabs brtan gyi bden tshig gsung ba dang lhan du dgon pa rang gi bla spyi so so dgon lung spyi so sogs phyogs tha dad kyi 'grul ba drag zhan so so nas maṇ+ḍal kha btags sku gsung thug rten gyis sna drangs te khri 'bul spam mtho ba phul/ bla brang dang spyi ba so so nas gzhi byes thams cad la bzhugs gral ston mo gzab rgyas dang bla brang nas tshogs par mang 'gyed phyogs 'dus kyi mgron la gnang sbyin gzabs/ rje nyid gar pheb tu gsol ston sogs la dmigs nas srog gcodabyed pa la bkag cha ha cang che bas 'di res kyang dkar gsum gyi ston mo gnang ste phyin chad kyang de bzhin gnas dgos par bcad/ dbyar chos tshugs pa'i gral 'dzin gyi tshogs grol nas dgon lung gi sran ching dka' bcu don grub rnam rgyal dang o'u han dka' bcu yon tan dpal bzang gnyis dam bca' 'jog rgyu'i dbu btsugs par gzigs rtog mdzad/ 'dus spyi nasagasol ba btab pa bzhin dgon pa'i slob chung dang bla ma zur ba rnams kyis gtsos dge 'dun tshang ma dang 'bri gu dgon gyi khri ba ko'u rtsa zhabs drung skal bzang mchog grub ba za zhabs drung blo bzang bstan 'dzin 'phrin las spos khang zhabs drung ngag dbang chos rgya mtsho sogs phyogs 'dus mang po dang bka' rab 'byams dge pa'i bshes gnyen rnam dpyod kyi rtsal dang ldan zhing chosadon du gnyer ba mang pos thog drangs ser skya nyis stong tsam la/ tshes bcu gnyis nas nyi shu gsum gyi bar lam rim bde lam gyi khrid sems skyed mchod pa dang bcas pa lung rigs dgag gzhag brkyangs shing nyams len gyi gnad rnams myong steng nas dmar khrid du stsal te mjug tu dpon slob tshang 812

sa / /rje badza (tsha lta'i ri shā ṭakhartsa cesanamasadage ba rdzogs byang du bsngo ba'i smon lam gyi mtshams sbyor rgyas pa mdzad/spyi sger nas bdog pa'i dngos po spam mtho ba bstar te rgya tig zhabs drung gis bstan 'gro'i dpung gnyen dam par zhabs pad brtan dgos tshul gyi zhu 'bul gang legs byas par dgyes pa'i bka' lan gnang zhing / khyed rnams nas dngos po'i 'bul ba gzab mi dgos mchod pa la sgrub pa'i mchod palas lhag med pas da res gsan pa'i chos 'di ris su ma bor bar rang rang gi 'khos tshod kyis thugs nyams su bzhes pa byung na des 'thus gsungs te sems bskyed kyi rdzas tsam ma gtogs pa'i 'bul ba gzhan rnams phyir slog mdzad/ bka' chos kyi bar mtshams su bla ma dge bshes de dag nas dka' gnadakyi dogs gcod mang du zhus pa rnams go sla la 'dum bde ba'i bka' lan gyis 'grol bar mdzad cing tshogs bshad du ma gnang ba'i snyan brgyud kyi zhal shes mang po'ang phag nor gyi tshul du stsal te yongs su mgu bar mdzad/gzhan yang zhu mkhan so so'i ngor gzhi byes kyi bla ma dge 'dun la 'jigs byed bskyed rim gyi khrid sgrol dkar dang spyan ras gzigs phyag bzhi pa'i rjes gnang bla mchod dang 'jigs byed dpa' gcig sogs lngags lung thor bu mang du gnang / bka' chos kyi sengs bar du dam bca' yang nyin bdun bzhag par gzigs rtog dang dgyes pa'i bslab ston mdzad/ de sngon tsam la dgon 'dir mtshan phyed cig tu dung dkar nyis sgrags kyi gsal po zhig yun ring tsam grag pa dpon slob bsod nams 'od zer dang tshogs chen dbu mdzad tshul khrims sogs mang pos thos nas ci yin snyam yod pa 'di res bka' chos kyi tshogs dung bus pa'i sgra sngar gyi dung sgra ji lta ba bzhin 'dug ces gleng / 'di ni dkar phyogs kyi lha rnams mngon par dga' ba'i mtshan ltas shig sngon du bstan pa yin nam snyam/ bka' chos tshugs dus rje nyid kyi 813

/ /gung bang bstan pa'i name'i gsung 'bum/mnal lam bud med rgyan gos can zhig 'ongs pa la khyod rang gang gi yin dris pa la mo shul pha gi na yod zer pha gi'i ming ci yin gsung par dgon shul lags zhes zhus/ de'i mu mthud nas btsun pa 'brog zhwa dang chos gos spyon pa lhung bzed mkhar gsil thogs pa 'khor 'ga' dang bcas ra skor du 'ongs pa nyid kyis gzigs shing gri ba zhig gis bla ma mjal du 'ongs zer ba la re zhig khogs gsungs pas/ yang 'ongs nas bla ma shi 'dug zer 'o na ro 'don thabs kyis gsung bar yang 'ongs nas kho shi ba ma red ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par bzhag pa da sad 'dug ces zhus de rjes de dag gling gseb tu song nas phan tshun lta nyul byed kyin yod pa zhig mis/ phyi nyin nas zang nga dpon slob sogs chos nyan pa mang po zhig la cham pa phog ste tshad rims mched pa'i nyams byung bar mi ltas de rgyal bsen gye 'phrul du dgongs nas gnad dmigs can gyi rim gro dang phyag sman gnang zhing mjug tu nyid kyang zhal 'cham bzhes na'ang 'chad nyan la bar chad med par bka' chos legs par grub cing rims nad de rbad de chad song / rgan rabs rnams kyis rje nyid zhala'acham bzhes pa nas bzung ste sngar gyi nad pa rnams sangs drag tu song zhingaphyi ma'i mched rgyun kyang chad song ba yin pas bla ma a wa dru ti dang mi la ras pas gzhan sdug rang steng du blangs pa dang rnam pa mtshungs pa byung song zhes gleng zhing dad gus rgya cher 'phel/ bsgrub bya bzhi bcur nye ba la dge tshul dang ko'u rtsa zhabs drung skal bzang mchog grub sogs sum cu lhag la dge slong gi sdom pa gnang / sgar ba khag so so dang 'byor ldan gyi grwa pa bcu lhag gis gdan drangs nas bsnyen bkur zhus par rang rang gi 'dod chos kyis tshim par mdzad/ gling chog la pheb dus srang bar mi mang gi lam dang mi gtsang pa'i khrod du lha la phul pa'i me tog sogs mchod rdzas rnying ba bskyur ba 814

༄/ /chubatsug bzangatsha migyi gsangagatsosagagatasadabyungakagazigs te dbang rjes gnang thob bya dang dam tshig spang byar byed mkhan rnams la chos bshad pas ci byed ces bka' bkyon gnang nas phyin chad mchod ro dang gtor ro gtsang sar skyel rgyu'i bkod pa mdzad/ bla ma rnam pa dang chos khrims pa sogs che gras rnams nas dgon pa'i 'grig lam bar skabs shig nas cung zad lhod 'dug pas rje nyid nas da res dam pa'i chos kyi bdud rtsi stsal par brten thams cad kyi yid 'gyur pa'i dad pa skyes pa'i skabs 'dir da dung tshogs gtam zhal bkod cig gnang na 'grig lam nges par sor chud yong ba gzhir bcas pas cis kyang bka' drin gnang dgos zhes zhus pa bzhin 'grig lam skor gyi tshogs gtam gnad phig pa zhig snyan 'bul gnang bas/ dge 'dun che phra tshang mas dang du blangs te 'grig lam rang khur gyi ngos nas bgres pa rnams kyis thugs dam nyams len dang gzhon pa rnams kyis bslab sbyang 'dzin skyor la brtson pa hur skyed byas pa sogs sgrub pa'i mchod pas dus 'da' ba byung / nyid kyi zhal bkod bzhin grwa ba 'ga' zhigal skar rtsis dang dpar rko rgyu slob tu bcug par phyis su dgon pa 'dir gdong mjug zhag gsum rnam dbye 'bri ba'i srol dang dpar rko ba'i srol kyang dar rgyas su gyur 'dug / de ltar nyin re bzhin dam pa'i chos kyi char rgyun mi 'chad du phab nas so so'i rgyud la thar pa'i sa bon thebs nges pa'i dge rtsa bla na med pa skrun par mdzad pa la tshogs pa thams cad kyis yul phyogs 'dir sngar 'di 'dra'i tshogs pa mang pos bka' chos zab mo 'di lta bu thob pa'i skal ba bzang bo byung ma myong bas 'di ni nges par skyabs mgon rin po che nyid kyi thugs bskyed smin lam gyi mthu 'ba' zhig go zhes gleng zhing ngo mtshar ba'i dga' ba dang rjes su yi rang ba'i dad gus 'gran bzhin 'phel/ der ma zad yul phyogs kyi lha klu rnams kyang dga' pa'i mtshan mar rje nyid chibs 815

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/bsgyur ba nas bzung char chu dus su babs shing rtsi bcud 'phel ba dang yul na sngar med pa'i me tog 'ga' zhig kyang gsar du skye ba sogs snod bcud kyi dge mtshan rgya cher 'phel/ nyin gcig skyo sangs la phebs nas sngon bra sgom chos kyido rjes 'ju btul skabs dam la btags par grags pa'i klu bdud mgo dguba'i gnas rba klong 'khyil ba'i chu mig gi thad du yun ring tsam bzhugs/phyi nyin klu rgan de ha cang nag phyogs pa zhig min pa 'dra ma dang mi lam du 'di ga'i zam pa la 'gro rtsis kyis khal rta ba shar bar nged kyi sems la zam pa la gong shing gcig las med pas bgrong dka' bsam par klu mtsho'i gos na phyugs nyams che ba'i 'brog khyim gtsang ma'i nang nas 'brog phrug gos sngon po gyon pa zhig yud kyis thon 'ongs te ngas rogs byed zer nas yun tsam zhig la phar 'gram du bton pa zhig mis/ 'di mchod na ri dgon la phan nges pa zhig 'dug gsungs shing rgya tig zhabs drung gis zhus ngor mchod chog kyang brtsams te bla brang nas rgyun ldan mchod rgyu'i zhal ta mdzad/ dgon pa'i g.yas kyi thad de chus gtub pas dgra'i skyon du che bar bco lugs kyi bkod pa sogasaskya ser spyi sger la phral phugs su phan pa'i blang dor gyi lung bstan zhal bkod zhib par gnang ste nyer drug la dgon pa nas thon dus dge 'dun mang gis gling 'dabs nas skyel zhus dang chibs skyel ba mang bos kha mdo thang gi zhag bab bar du skyel ma zhus/ rim gyis skyed tshal du phyag phebs te brel ba bsal nas thugs dam dang dpe gzigs gnang / 'ja' 'khyil du/ rang lo drug cu re gsum pa sa lug lo zla ba drug pa'i tshes drug gi tho rangs rmi lam gsal ba zhig la khang ba zhig gi khyams na rdo rje 'chang lcang skya rin po che bzhugs pa dang mjal ba la nged nas da nga rang lo rgas pas 'chi ba la nye bar 'dug / nyid nas snga mo'i zhal bzhes bzhin 'chi dus rjes su 'dzin dgos 816

༄/ /rjebatsug bzangachosakyinyima'igagangagatsosamadakarasadabyung/zhus pas rdo rje 'chang bzhengs nas phyag bdag gi spyi bor bzhag rna bar thal skad cig gtong ba gnang / phyag mdzub kyis spyi gtsug tu ne ma ne ma mdzad cing zhal nas mkha' spyod kyi zhing gi yon tan dang dpa' bo mkha' 'gro mang bo'i mtshan brjod pa'i mthar gzungs skyid ces lan kha yar 'bod pa gnang /ngedanas bla ma dam pa nyid bde mchog zhal gcig phyag gnyis yum bcas kyi rnam par bsgoms nas dad pa rtse gcig byed pa zhig rmis zhes gsungs pa sad mi mnyam par rtogs pa klong du gyur pa'i rnam thar dpag dka' ba zhig tu snang / bdun pa'i tshes la hal ha'i stong 'khor hu thog thu'i mi sna gsol dpon dkon mchog bzang bo thu she thu han dang no ma chi chos rje gnyis kyi mi sna kun dga' ye shes tshe dpag skyabs gung gi mi sna tā bla ma blo bzang brtson 'grus ngo g.yog rnams 'byor nas bla dpon so so'i zhu shog rten chas phul/nom chi chos rjes mdo sngags kyi dogs zhus mang po dang rje btsun dam pa rang byung ye shes rdo rjes mdzad pa'i ma ṇi sgrub thabs kyi 'grel pa dang rang byung ye shes rdo rje la gsol ba 'debs rgyu'i tshigs bcad rnams ljags rtsom snyan bskul zhus pa bzhin dogs lan dang sgrub thabs kyi don 'grel khyad du 'phags pa gzhan rnams la'ang gang 'os kyi bka' lan dang 'dod chos sogs mos pa bzhin stsal/ brgyad pa'i tshes gnyis la dgon lung du gzim chung gsar ba zhig phug pa grub zin par de'i nang du gsol ton drangs pa dang bstun ye shes nyi mas bskul ngor mdzad pa'i phag dkar shes rab gsal byed kyi sgrub thabs shes rab chu gter 'phel pa'i zla ba zhes bya ba'i lngags lung gnang / skyed tshal nas rgyang tshar sgom pa sogs la tshem bu lugs kyi dmar khrid rje phur bu spyog gi gsung bde mchog bsnyen yig rgyas pa'i lung gro tshang mkhan po rin po che la rgyal gsol rdo rje'i sgra dbyangs kyi lung gnang zhing gsung 817

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/gleng 'phel rgyar tshang sgom pas sku 'bum du 'byon rgyu'i snyan bskul zhus/'brug lung dang khran tsong ri dgon gyis gdan drangs pa bzhin bsu thab dang bcas khran tsong ri khrod du phebs ri khrod la mang 'gyed gnang / tsho ba brgyad kyi 'brog pas khran tsong thang du sgar btab nas der gdan drangs brarti sku skye sogs dge 'dun dang skye pho mo lnga brgya lhag la spyan ras gzigs phyag bzhi pa'i rjes gnang ma ṇi'i bzlas lung dang bcas stsal/ 'bul tshan bstar te brati zhabs drung gis brtan bzhugs phul par mnyes pa'i bka' lan dang sbyin bdag de rnams la mi dge bcu spong gang thub dang khyad par du rkun jag gi las dang chang 'thung pa rnams la 'dzem gang thub byed dgos kyi bslab ston gnang / de nas 'brug lung dgon du bsu ba ser spreng dang bcas bla brang gsar bar babs sems nyid sku skye mchod rten thang gi slob chung du bsko bzhag dang tshogs par mang 'gyed zhus/ sgo mang mkhan zur lha btsun mthu stobs nyi ma bod nas 'byon nye ba'i phrin byung bas phyir 'khor te dgon lung du phebs khong dpon g.yog kyang 'byor nas mjal kha zhus par gzhis len ston mo gzabs shing thugs bag phebs pa'i gsung gleng 'phel/ sgo mang dpon slob de nyid chung dus nas yab wang gis rje nyid la gtad gnyer zhus pa bzhin nyid kyis rjes su bzung ste dgon lung du lo mang por lhan du bzhugs nas thugs gnyer mdzad cing / de rjes bod la pheb dus kyang nyid nas rwa stod dpon slob rin po cher gtad gnyer mdzad nas khong gis rjes su bzung ste 'dul khrims rnam par dag pa'i sgo nas thugs gnyer dang sgrub pa nyams len mthar phyin cing lha ram pa dang sgo mang mkhan po rim gyis byung nas 'khor lo gsum gyi bya bas bstan pa la bya ba mdzad pa'i thugs zin nges kyi slob ma yin gshis thugs gtsigs chen po gnang zhing / khong gis kyang rje nyid dang ma mjal 818

sa / /rjebatsun bzangartsa kyinyis ga bdaganacan nganabar lo mang po song stabs da res lhan du dgun bzhugs mdzad nas bka' chos mang po gsan bzhed kyis tsha bu wang la de lugs kyi phrin bskur nas bzhugs rgyur thag bcad/ khong bzhugs ring la dpon g.yog tshang ma'i bzhugs mal nar ma'i gsol chas dgun gyi na bza' sogs bla brang nas le thogs med par mthun rkyen gnang ste mthong gzos bla na med pa mdzad/dgu pa'i tshes la nged kyis dgon lung gi khri'i dgongs pa zhu rgyu'i don du rgyud pa slob zur dbal mang zhabs drung mngags par 'byor te mjal kha zhus/o'u han dge slong ye shes nyi mas zhus ngor sgo mang dpon slob rin po che dpal mang zhabs drung li kyā zhabs drung sogs la phag dkar shes rab gsal byed kyi rjes gnang / nyid kyi bka' rtsom de'i sgrub thabs kyi lung / sgo mang dpon slob dang dpal mang zhabs drung rnam gnyis kyis zhus ngor nyung 'dus la lcang skya rol pa'i rdo rje'i gsung bka' rgya'i gra'i tshe bdag mgon po'i tshe sgrub sogs chos tshan mang po nyid kyi gsung bka' rgya'i skor 'ga' zhig gi ljags lung dpal mang zhabs drung gcig pu la phyag na rdo rje drag po gsum 'dul gyi khrid bcas gnang / dbal mang zhabs drung ngo g.yog gis nged nas 'bul tshan bskur ba rnams btegs te thon phyag zhus/ sgo mang dpon slob kyis kyang bod nas phebs pa'i skyos ma sku gsung thugs rten gyis sna drangs te zhwa ser 'phrug ther bzang spos/ phyar khra gsol phor kha che'i dri bzang sogs dngos po gya nom pa phul/ gros dbang pa rnams nas sgo mang bla ma bod nas byon pa dang dgon lung gi khri'i spor mtshams dus 'grigs shing khong sngar dgon lung rang gi grwa rgyun yang yin stabs da res yun ring bzhugs mi thub rung rten 'brel gyis rang yul du 'byon rag tshun la bzhugs rgyu'i snyan gsan 'bul zhes gros mthun gyes rje nyid la dgongs bstun zhus par de bzhin 'thad tshul 819

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/gnang ste dge 'dun mang gis sgo mang bla ma la khri dar phul bar zhal bzhes gnang / sgo mang dpon slob nas zhus pa'i bka' chos skor rnams rim gyis gnang bar khong dang dgon pa'i zhabs drung dang chos rje dka' ram nyung 'dus la har chin lhun 'grub bzang pos zhus pa'i nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i dbang gis sna drangs te de'i sa skya'i be'u bum yongs rdzogs/ rgyal sras thogs med kyi bka' 'bum thog ma'i blo sbyong blo spyong zhen 'khris kun gcod rnamasakyi ljags lung de'i steng du ba za zhabs drung dang spos khang zhabs drung sogs bsnan pa'i lnga bcu skor la jo bo'i lugs kyi sgrol ma nyer gcig gi rjes gnang paṇa chen gsung gi sgrol ma'i las tshogs kyi lung / snar thang brgya rtsa'i rjes gnang cha tshang de'i lha tshogs kyi mngon rtogs rgya gzhung dang bod gzhung mchim nam mkha' grags kyis phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa'i lung phyag rdor gtum po khyung lnga'i rjes gnang tshem bu dmar khrid rnams gnang ste nyer dgu'i nyin mang mas chos mtshams mdzad/ rje nyid nas bkra shis 'khyil gyi bi leg thu lha bzo la gzim chung phugs su bzhugs rgyu'i rta mgrin gsang sgrub dang nā ro mkha' spyod ma gnyis kyi shing sku khru tshad long ba re gtad gnyer mdzad pa bzhin ba so 'phrul ma'i rgyan chas can gyi sku brnyan byon legs tshon rtsi dang bcas legs par bsgrubs nas khyer 'ongs par ring bsrel rnam bzhi'i gzungs gzhug rnams nyid dngos kyis gzigs rtog ngos tshad ldan grub yod pas/ba za bla ma la bsnyen pa khyed rang dga' rab btang yod 'gro da lo bla brang gi dbus khang chen mo'i steng shod bzo skyor byas yod pas de dang sku 'dra 'di rnams khyed rang gis rab gnas gyis shig gsung nas bcu pa'i tshes gcig la bza bla ma chog grogs dang bcas pas steng shod rten brten par rab gnas mdor bsdus byas/ tshes gnyis nas sgo mang dpon slob sogs la lcang skya 820

༄/ /rjebatsunablobangachos nyima'ig4gsumapadzadagarasadabyungakarol pa'i rdo rje'i gsung bka' rgya'i skor rje nyid kyi gsung bka' rgya'i skor mkha' spyod ma'i chos skor rnams dang stag phu rdo rje 'chang gis mdzad pa'i mgon po phyag drug pa'i gtor chen de'i zhi rgyas dang drag po'i sbyin sreg rjerat+na'i mtshan can gyis mdzad pa'i ge ṭa pā la'i gtor chog rnams kyi ljags lung stsal/ dbang phyug ja sag gi a ma ngo g.yog 'byor te brtan bzhugs kyi rten 'brel bsgrigs te 'dod don zhus pa'i re ba bskangs/ mdung nag ko'u kyā no mon han sog yul du 'byon zhor la 'ongs par khong dang sgo mang dpon slob sems nyid zhabs drung sogs la mgon po dur khrod bdag po'i rjes gnang dang khong rnam gnyis la nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i gsang khrid bcas stsal/ ko'u kyā no mon han gyis chos yon la gser gyi 'khor lo tsan dan gyi mdun cog me long shel gyi tam 'bis dri bzang gi snod hor gos gser ma glod khra legs pa dngul srang lnga bcur re ba'i bod sga srab med cha tshang rta bcu tham pa bcas phul khong la'ang gzhis len ston mo pheb rdzong bstar/ bcu gnyis la sgo mang dpon slob dgon lung gi khri 'don gnang bar dbus khang chen mo'i nang du yab sras rnam gnyis gtso mdzad nas gzhi byes kyi 'os rim pa rnams la tshogs gleng dang bcas bzhugs gral ston mo bsgrigs 'di'i zla ba gcig gi ring la dam pa'i chos kyi bdud rtsi chad med du stsal cing sgo mang bla ma dang 'bri gu'ibla ma gnyis kokyā no mon han sogs dpon slob rnams kyis res 'ga' mdo sngags kyi dka' gnad du ma la dogs slong dang rtsod pa/ res 'ga' bla ma gong ma rnams kyi rnam thar gsung gleng gnang ba sogs thugs nyams spro ba'i ngang nas nyin mtshan kun tu dam pa'i chos kyi dga' ston gyis dus 'da' bar mdzad do/ / byams pa 'bum gling gi yung bla mas 'du khang gsar ba'i rab gnas la gdan drangs pa bzhin bco lnga la dgon lung nas thon te mar tshang bla 821

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/chen po'i lha khang du mchod 'bul dang thugs skyed sgon lam sngar rgyun ltar mdzad/ ling hwa' thas dgon du li kyā zhabs drung gtsos pa'i dge 'dun mang gi seng spreng dang bcas gdan drangs nas gsol ston mjal kha zhus khron khu li kyu dbon pos yu mon du gdan drangs te gzhis len ston mo gzabs/chi li zi'i bla ma dge 'dun rnams kyis chibs bsu ser spreng dang bcas lha khang du gdan drangs par phyag dbang chos 'brel gnang zhing dge 'dun la mang 'gyed kyi thebs sprad 'bum khang thang dge ldan bshad sgrub gling gi dge 'dun rnams kyis thang sgar btab ste ser sbreng dang bcas gdan drangs te bsnyen bkuragazabs/ tshogs par dga' ldan lha brgya ma'i bshad lung lam gtso rigs gsum mgon po byams pas dam bca'i gzungs sogs kyi lung phyag dbang bcas stsal/ de nas mā yang lha khang gi bla ma dung kha zhabs drung gtsos pa'i dge 'dun rnams kyis chib bsu ser sbreng dang bcas gdan drangs nas dung kha bla brang du babs phyag dbang chos 'brel gyis tshim par mdzad/byams pa 'bum gling gi yung bla mas gtsos pa'i grwa pa che gras kyis 'di nas chib bsu zhus phas le wan du 'bum gling gi zhag bab thog tu bzhugs sgrol ma phugagi yang zhabs drung ngo g.yog dang a 'gang zi'i bla ma hu kyu rab 'byams pa ngo g.yog 'byor nas gdan 'dren gyi gnyan gsan zhus/ nyer gnyis la ser sbreng dang bcas yung bla brang du babs mjal ba mang por phyag dbang chos 'breladang 'du khang gsar ba rten brten par rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sgo nas rab gnas kyi cho ga bsdus pa dge legs rgya mtsho'i char 'bebs kyis zur brgyan nas rgyas bsdus 'tsham pa zhig gnang / dge 'dun mang la dga' ldan lha brgya ma rigs gsum mgon po'i snying po byams pas dam bca'i gzungs bcu gcig zhal gyi gzungs ring sogs kyi lung gnang / yung bla ma 822

༄/ / chubatsug bzangachosakyi nyima'ig4gsumapad+madakazadabyung/gtsos pa'i 'dus spyi nas maṇ+ḍal kha btags sku gsung thugs rten gyis sna drangs te dngos 'bul spam mtho ba btegs/ u kyā rab 'byams pas zhu 'bul byas par rje nyid nas lha khang rten gsum bzhengs nas rab gnas dang mchod pa dang bsnyen bkur byas pa'i phan yon las brtsams te yon mchod rnams kyi yid la dga' ba ster ba'i bka' lan bzang po gnang / byams chen lha khang du mchod mjal thog skyabs sems dang yan lag bdun pa maṇ+ḍal phul nas byams smon gsol 'debs sogs gsungs/ byams chen 'di da lta ngag rgyun la lar kong tses bzhengs pa yin zer zhing de'i rgyu mtshan gyis kong tse'i ming la'ang bzo kong tse dang kong tse 'phrul gye rgyal po zhes zer/ 'ga' zhig de bon po zhig yin pa gzhir bzhag nas sku 'di dang po ston pa gshen rabs kye sku yin pa la phyis su byams pa'i skur bsgyur ba yin zer ba sogs ngag sgos sna tshogs 'dug kyang de ni rgya nag gi khung phu'u tsi'am khung tsi zer ba de bod skad la zur chag nas kong tse zhes pa yin zhing de nyid phugs sangs rgyas la mos kyang gnas skabs gdul bya'i dbang gis she'u zhes pa lugs kyi bstan bcos tsam mdzad pa las chos dang bon gang gi'ang srol bzung ba med la bzo bo yin pa'i lo rgyus kyang med pas ngag rgyun de dag ni mun sprul yin par rje nyid kyi grub mthar gsungs pa bzhin no/ / de ltar na byams chen 'di bzhengs mkhan ni sngon gyi chos 'byung du mar rgya bza' kung jo bod du phebs pa'i'im khar blon po mgar la sgug sdod mdzad de brag la byams chen brkos zer ba dang / 'ga' zhig tu rdzu 'phrul gyis sha ba bzung ste zhing rmod pa dang brag la byams chen khru brgyad cu pa bzhengs pa sogs bshad 'dug kyang gzhan nade 'dra ston rgyu mi snang la/ 'di ni de dus kyi pho brang zhing phu nas yar phebs pa'i lam du'ang 'grig 'dug pas de nyid yin nam snyam zhing 'di dang 823

sa / /gung thang bstan pa'i sgron me'i gsung 'bum/khad nye bar sgrol ma rang byon phebs pa'ang de skabs kung jo rang nyid der bzhugs pa'i byin rlabs kyi mtshan ma zhig yin nam snyam mo/ / yang bla mas gtsos pa'i dge 'dun gyi ser sbreng dang bcas sgol ma phugs su phebs thog mar sgrol ma lha khang du mchod mjal dang gsol 'debs smon lam gsung /'du khang du gdan drangs nas gso ston 'bul ba zhus pa'i re ba bskangs yāng bla mas bla brang du gdan drangs te bsnyen bkur gzabs phyir 'bum gling du byon/ lo kyu tun gyi gdan 'dren pa 'byor kyang lam bgrod dka' bas pheb / dī sda ༵ dī ༵ di ༵dī pa/ dī dīdī dīrji ༷ dh+rirdo dh+ri sbyodī ༷ dīdī ༵ ༵ /ra tsha rdo /naspya /a 'gang zir pheb lam du lu kyā zi'i dge 'dun rnams kyis lha khang du gdan drangs nas gsol ston phyag dbang zhus a 'gang zi'i dge 'dun rnams kyis ser sbreng dang bcas lu kyu rab 'byams pa dkon mchog rgya mtsho'i gshag tu babs a 'gang nang ma'i 'du khang la rab gnas mdor bsdus mdzad dngos 'bul spam mtho ba btegs skya ser mang por phyag dbang chos 'brel gnang /a 'gang phyi ma'i dge 'dun gyis gdan drangs nas gsol ston 'bul ba gzabs shing dga' ldan lha brgya ma'i bshad lung sogs stsal dgon par ming zhus par byams sprin gling zhes 'dogs par mdzad/ sgang kha ri khrod kyi mtshams zhus 'bul mi 'byor par mang 'gyed thebs bskur a 'gang dgon phyi nang la mang 'gyed bstar phyir 'bum gleng du phebs/ bcu gcig pa'i tshes gcig la de ga'i tshogs su mang ja btang thog dge 'dun re la bsod btags re dang dong tshe nyis brgya re'i 'gyed gnang yung bla ma che chung gnyis la 'jam dbyangs kyi li sku dang gos chen sogs gnang sbyin gzabs/ tshes gnyis la bsgrub bya bcu gcig bsnyen rdzogs mdzad lon cu bkra shis chos gling 824

༄/ /rjebatsug ba4chos nyima'igagangagatsaphrobadabasadabyungakagi gdan 'dren pa 'ongs pa bzhin tshes gsum la 'bum gling nas chibs bsgyur gnang bla ma las snas tha la phing gi ja thab bar du chibs skyel zhus/pā ju'u dgon gyi zhabs drung che chung gnyis kyis gtsos pa'i grwa pa kha shas chibs bsur 'byor nas gu'u sha ye'i yā mon du gdan drangs te ja thab zhus/ tshes drug la lon cu'u dgon du rta thab ser sbreng dang bcas bla brang du babs mjal ba mang por phyag dbang chos 'brel stsal/ tshes bdun 'khrungs skar gyi nyin bcag mal mdzad de nyid sgrub grogs dang bcas pas bsang chog bkra shis dbyangs snyan dang 'go ba'i lha lnga'i gsol mchod btang tshogs dbur gdan drangs te bla ma dge 'dun gyis brtan bzhugs kyi rten 'brel bsgrigs te dngos 'bul spam mtho ba btegs bla brang nas kyang dga' ston rgyas pa bstar/phyi dro bla grwa tshang mar 'jigs byed bcu gsum ma'i sgrub thabs mgon chos lha mo gsum gyi gtor chog sogs ljags lung du ma gnang zhing / dgon par mang 'gyed stsal/ de nas pheb zhor du hā khrod khu'u dang shā khrod khu'u'i lha khang sogs kyi skya ser phyag dbang chos 'brel gyis tshim par mdzad bzhin bcu gsum gye nyin gdan sar babs/ 'di res lam nas lha khang zhig gi 'bul ba'i khrod du 'jam dbyangs kyi gser sku sngon gyi li ma zhig byung bar phyag mtshan ral gri med pa la zhal nas 'di rgyu dang bzo rnying ba zhig yin pas 'di nyid kyi ral gri ngo ma yod na bzang ba la gsung / phyi nyin sa cha gzhan gye mjal pa'i nang nas rgan mo zhig gis phyag rten phran bu zhig ched gtad kyis phyag tu phul ba gzigs pas sngar gyi 'jam dbyangs kyi phyag mtshan ral gri ngo ma byung 'dug pa la thams cad ya mtshan pa byung mkhar rnga legs pa zhig byung ba rgyud pa'i spyi 'jog tu gnang / sbyin bdag a lag shā chin wang gi gdan 'dren pa ca khir chi kun dga' ngo g.yog 'byor nas snyan gsan phul bar snga phyir gdan 'dren 825

༄/ /gung thang bstan ba'ithoname'i gsu jabum/zhus reb mang bas 'di res 'byon rgyu'i zhal len mdzad/ sngar 'bum gling du phebs dus sgo mang bla ma la 'bri gu'i bla ma rnam gnyis dang dgon lung gi zhabs drung sku skye sogs chos rgyun la phan thogs nges pa'i grwa pa rnams la mkhas grub rje'i gsung 'bum gyi lung gnang dgos kyi skul ma mdzad cing slob ma rnams la'ang de lugs kyi zhal bkod gnang nas mtshams sbyor mdzad pa bzhin khong gis don gnyer can sum cu skor la mkhas grub rje'i gsung 'bum gyi lung rgyun gang yod thams cad dang blo sbyong snyan brgyud chen mo legs bshad kun 'dus sogs kyi lung gnang nas legs par grub pa la dgyes tshor chen po mdzad/ sgo mang bla mas rje nyid la bde mchog dkar po'i brtan bzhugs kyi cho ga bzhin zhabs brtan rgyas pa 'bul rgyu'i snyan gsan phul te bcu gnyis pa'i tshes gnyis la mkhyen yangs gling du mchod pa dang tshogs 'khor rgya chen po bshams te sgo mang dpon slob nyid chog grogs dang bcas pas bde mchog dkar po'i brtan bzhugs kyi cho ga gsung ste tshogs zhing spyan 'dren gyi skabs su rje nyid mchod rol spos 'dren dang bcas bkur ste chen pos spyan drangs nas mi 'jigs seni'i khrir bzhugs su gsol ba la phyi nang gsang ba de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa 'bul ba bstod cing gsol ba 'debs pa rnams grub rjes/maṇ+ḍal skabs su lha rdzas nang mdzod dngul mkha che legs sku gsung thugs rten bzhugs gdan rgyab yol na bza' nyer spyad gos chen yug gsum gser srang lnga dngul srang brgya phyi mdzod bcu chos 'don bcu brgyad bag bcu dung dkar gcig bcas bstar te sgo mang bla ma nyid kyis skyabs mgon rin po che nyid skye phreng du mar bstan 'gro'i don rlabs po che mdzad tshul las brtsams pa'i bshad pa dang sbrags zhabs pad yun ring du brtan pa'i gsol ba btab par dgyes pa'i bka' lan gnang / mjug tu dpon slob tshang mas tshogs 826

༄/ /rjebatshug bzangachosaminyima'igagangagasu pachadakarasadabyungaka'akhor mdzad nas dpyid glu dang thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i lam gyi rtogs pa rgyud la skye ba'i gsol 'debs dang smon lam shis brjod gsungs te bkra shis kyi me tog char du bsnyil bar mdzad do/ / zhal nas mdang rmi lam du rgya mi 'ga' zhig gis nga la gnod pa brtsam par 'ongs pa la sgo mang bla ma gtso ba'i grwa ba 'ga' zhig gis rgya mi rnams bzung nas chad pa brgyab pa zhig rmisabyung ba de ring gi brtan bzhugs kyis tshe'i bar chad sel ba'i ltas yin namagasungs te bla slob dam tshig gtsang ma'i rten 'brel gyi sgo khyad par can zhig byung bar mngon/ yang mnal lam du 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa rin po che phebs nas khyod kyis myur du mtshams shig bsdams na legs pa 'dra gsung nasaganas shig bstan byung ba sku 'bum gyi phyogs yin pas 'gro e thub snyam par 'o na chos bzang yin kyang chog gsung ba zhig rmis byung gsungs nas chos bzang ri khrod du phebs te re zhig gi bar bcad rgya mdzad de thugs dam shin tu 'phel/ lo mjug tu su nyid g.yas ru'i wang gi mi sna nang so tshe grub ngo g.yogadang zan khron gu thi ngo g.yog dur bed wang gi mi sna khā badz+ra ke rti ngo g.yog cha har slob dpon tshe ring dang ye rte ni em chi ngo g.yog u'u shing pe zi'i shog chos rje nyi ma rgyal mtshan dang yum mi rin skya ser lnga bcu skor rnams rim par sleb nas mjal kha zhus shing rang rang gi phyogs kyi bla dpon sbyin bdag sogs kyi zhu shog rten chas rnams phul bar 'byor lan 'dod chos sogs stsal/ dgung lo re bzhi ba lcags sprel lo'i gsar tshes kyi nyin cha har slob dpon tshe ring dang e ti ni yem chi su nyid tho yon dge 'phel nor bu dpon po blo bzang rgyal mtshan rnams kyis brtan bzhugs kyi rten 'brel bsgrigs nas maṇ+ḍal kha btags sku gsung thugs rten bzhugs gdan rgyab yol gyes sna drangs te bdog pa phun sum tshogs pa'i tshan grangs ring bo bstar gzhi 827

༄/ /gung bangangastan pa'isgroname'i gsung 'bum/byes thams cad nas lo gsar gyi mjal kha zhugs/ 'grul pa de rnams kyis gtsos pa'i don gnyer can mang po la tshe dpag med kyi tshe dbang dang rta mgrin gsang sgrub dang mgon dkar yid bzhin nor bu'i rjes gnang stsal/ cha har slob dpon tshe ring ho brnye phun tshogs ye shes rgyal mtshan khyim tshang bzhi la dgon lung gi tshogs chen 'du khang gsar gsos kyi yon bdag gtad par thugs dgongs ltar sgrub rgyu'i khas len phul/ khyim tshang bzhi ga'i rim gror dge mtshan spel ba'i cho ga dang 'brel bar g.yang 'bod mdzad de g.yang mda' g.yang rdzas dang bcas yon bdag la sprad/ slob dpon tshe ring la yer rte ni nang so'i cho lo dang khyim tshang so so la 'du khang gtad gnyer gyi gsung shog sku brnyan snam phrug sogs kyi gnang skyes dang bcas bskur ba gnang tho yon dge 'phel nor bu'i tsha bo rab byung bsgrubs/ tshes brgyad sgo mngabla ma'i 'khrungs skar la nyid nas tshe mtha' yas pa'i sku thang glegs bam mchodarten tshe bum rgyan can bkra shis lha rdzas bcas gnang nas sku tshe brtan pa'i rten 'brel bsgrigs bcu bzhi bco lnga gnyis la 'cham gzigs dang gsung chos smon lam gnang / hal ha'i ja sag thu han gyi sder gtogs dkon mchog tā gung gi shog zhabs drung ngag dbang blo bzang bkra shis gcen gcung gnyis slob 'khor bcas 'byor nas thog ma'i mjal rten du lha rdzas mdzod btags dngul gye maṇ+ḍal tshe sku li ma tshe mdo gser bris dngul gyi mchod rten gos chen yug gnyis bcas phul te nyin zhag mang po'i lam nas rje nyid kyi gsung gi bdud rtsi myong rgyu'i don kho na bsam nas 'ongs tshul dang bka' chos mang po'i snyan gsan phul par dgyes bzhin zhal bzhes gnang / smon lam grol nas zhu ba po dpon g.yog sgo mang bla ma/ gser khri sprul sku/ 'dan ma sprul sku sogs sku skye dka' ram bcas dge 'dun brgya phrag skor la bde lam gyi 828

༄/ /rtsebatsug baḥchos nyim ga4gsamumagatazagayunakhrid sems bskyed mchod pa dang bcas nyin bcu gcig gi ring gzab bshad smin rgyas stsal par 'dan ma sprul sku dang ba za zhabs drung gnyis kyis zin bris kyang mdzad/ mjug tu hal ha'i zhabs drung dpon g.yog gis maṇ+ḍal kha btags gos chen yug bcu dngul srang sum brgya bcud kyis bkang pa'i dngul bum gnyis bcas brtan bzhugs lugs su phul/ gnyis pa'i tshes gcig la zhabs drung sku mched gnyis la rje nyid mkhan po sgo mang bla mas las slob ba za zhabs drung gis gsang ston byas te lnga tshogs kyi sgo nas bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa stsal/ sgo mang bla ma rang yul du thon nye bar khong la 'jigs byed dpa' cig gi dbang khong dang hal ha'i zhabs drung ba za zhabs drung sogs la mgon po bar chad kun sel dang mgon dkar gyi rjes gnang tshe khrid bdud rtsi'i zil mngar gyi khrid lung bcas gnang zhing / ja gral thog sgrol ma nyer gcig gi bdun thang na bza' cha tshang khe bi su'i bzhugs gdan rgyab yol chibs drel legs pa sogs pheb rdzong gya nom pa dang rang yul du phebs nas rje bla ma'i rang lugs dri ma med pa mdo sngags zung du 'jug pa'i bshad sgrub kyis bstan 'gro'i don rgya cher mdzad dgos tshul dang khyad par du lam thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i nyams bzhes gtso bor gnang dgos tshul gyi bslab bya nan cher mdzad/ tshes brgyad la khong dpon g.yog gis bka' bsgo zhus parakhong la shel gyi sku 'dra zhig gnang ste thugs 'phrang ba'i rnam pa dang spyi sger gye pheb skyel ja thab sogs gang rgyas kyi bkod khyab mdzad/ a lag shā chin wang gi mi sna tha'i ji dharma pā la ngo g.yog gis wang nas ched gnyer bsgrubs nas bskur ba'i pheb byams gsar ba phul te sbyin bdag wang dmag 'khor dang bcas lho phyogs kyi dmag thog tu pheb dgos byung ba la skyabs 'jug sogs zhus par wang gi sku la 'chang rgyu'i rten mi g.yo ba'i sku brnyan byin 829

༄/ /yo thang bstan pa'isgroname'i gsung 'bum/rlabs can dang gdugs dkar gye srung 'khor blon 'khor rnams la phur mdud re rim gro 'ga' zhig bcas gnang nas rim gro rnams legs par bsgrubs na dmag thog tu phebs kyang 'thab mi dgos par phyir yong ba 'dra gsung bar de bzhin byung / lo ltar gyi zhabs brtan dang 'brel bar 'dan ma sprul sku ba za zhabs drung sogs kyis gtsos pa'i skya ser mang po spyi sger so so nas maṇ+ḍal kha btags phul te zhabs pad yun brtan gyi gsol pa nan tan btab par thugs mnyes pa'i zhal bzhes gnang ste zhabs brtan zer ba dam tshig gtsang ma'i slob ma dad gus rnam par dag pas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di 'dra la zer ba yin rten 'brel gyi gnad kyang shin tu che gsung / 'dan ma sprul sku ba za zhabs drung bras zhabs drung gsum gyis rang rang gi dgon par gdan 'dren gyi snyan gsan phul bar rten 'brel gyi khyad du 'byon rgyu'i zhal len gnang / ba za bla mas jo bo'i dngul sku gsar bzhengs la kha byang smon tshig dang gzungs 'jug tu 'bul rgyu'i rten sna 'gang chen phra rgyan 'ga' zhig nyid kyi phyag 'phreng gi grangs 'dzin mu tig rdog po che ba gcig g.yu rdog bcas gnang / gang dkar wang gi thu sa lag chi dpon g.yog mjal khar 'ongs pa la rta mgrin gsang sgrub dang sor 'brang ma dkar mo'i rjes gnang stsal/hal ha'i erte ni paṇ+ḍi ta chos rje dang nom chi no yon hu thog thu dpon g.yog skya ser brgyad cu skor 'byor nas rje btsun dam pa rin po che'i gsung shog gnang rten phon che ba bcas dang mdzi thi no mon han yongs 'dzin tha ma khri pa nom chi bla ma e rti ni jo bo'i nom chi chos rje khu re'i am pan thu she thu han tā gung sogs mchog dman du ma'i zhu shog rten bcas phul/ bla ma rnam gnyis kyang ched dmigs kyis bka' chos gsan par byon pas thog ma'i mjal rten dang bcas mdo sngags kyi bka' chos mang po'i snyan gsan phul par zhal bzhes 830

sa / /rjebatsun thazang sa blo dgadag b.rakaganang / snga phyir 'ongs pa'i bla ma rnams kyi bzhed chos rnams phyogs gcig byas nas tshes bco lnga nas dbu btsugs te hal ha'i e rte ni paṇ+ḍi ta chos rje ye shes bstan 'dzin 'phrin lasanom chi no yon hu thog thu ye shes don gnyis lhun 'grub zhabs drung ngag dbang blo bzang bkra shis spun gnyis 'dan ma sprul sku gser dgon rgyud pa dpon slob smon ne 'jam dbyangs rgya mtsho grwa tshang 'og gi bla ma ser tshud lha ram pa 'azin las dpal bzang rgyal rdog bla zur blo bzang 'jam dbyangs rgya mtsho tshar tsha lha ram pa bsam gtan rgya mtsho dkar rtsa zhabs drung sogs gzhi byes kyi dka' ram dge tshul slong sum brgya lhag tsam la dge ldan phyag chen khrid gnang bar bla mchod dang rdor sems sgom bzlas phyag chen dngos gzhi khrid rnams nyin bcu gcig gi ring smin rgyas stsal/ bka' chos la bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen sku yon can mang po 'dus pas mdo lugs dang sngags lugs kyi phyag rgya chen po'i bzhed srol mi 'dra ba sna tshogs yod tshul bka' brgyud gong ma rnams 'khrid tshul gyi sgo mi 'dra ba so sor byas tshul/kun gyi nang nas paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pas mdzad pa ltar gyi dga' ldan phyag rgya chen po'i 'khrid tshul 'dir snga ma de dag gi zab gnad ma lus par tshang zhing de las lhag pa'i khyad chos yod tshul sogs shin tu 'gang che ba'i zab gnad mang po snyan brgyud kyi man ngag du mas brgyan cing rgyab brten lung dang rigs pa'i dgag gzhag gi spros pa rgya chen po brkyangs te gsung bshad 'byam klas par gnang / skabs shig 'tshub lhong lta bus glo bur du sku bsnyel nas snyungagazhi bab lci tsam byung yang hal ha'i ye rti ni chos rjes nged nas zhabs brtan la lus sbyin gtong ba bgyid ces zhus nas khong rang gis lus sbyin gtong ba gnang zhing gsol sman gyi 'phrod brten dang gnad dmigs can gyi zhabs brtan 'ga' zhig bsgrubs pas phral du dwangs song / yang slob ma 831

༄/ /gung thang bstan ba'i me'i gsung 'bum/'ga' zhig gi 'dod mos bzhin nyung 'dus shig la sngags lugs phyag chen gyi gzabakhrid kyang skog chos su stsal/ de dus bla ma dge bshes rnams kyis rje nyid kyi gsung bshad la bshar sbyang mdzad pas dka' gnas 'ga' zhig tu nyan lugs mi 'dra ba byung nas 'then khyer byas par erti ni chos rjes bla ma'i gsung gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa yin pas nged cag rang rang gis thos pa yid la bzung ba las gcig gcig la bstun nas phan tshun rgyas 'geb mi chog pa 'dra byas 'dug pa ni/ gsung gcig nyid du gsung mod kyang / / du ma nyid du so sor go / zhes pa'i don bzhin rnam dpyod can gyi gsung du snang /zla ba gsum pa'i tshes nas yang nyin bdun gyi ring la sngar gyi chos nyan pa che gras skor mang nyung ci rigs la nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i siskyi ra'i byin rlabs de'i bskyed rdzogs kyi khrid gnyis bral 'chad dus kyi zhal shes gser chos 'pho khrid bcas dang / nam mkha' sgo 'byed kyi dbang gcod stan thog gcig ma'i khrid lung dga' ldan lha brgya ma'i khrid bla ma'i rnal 'byor don gnyis lhun 'grub ma'i khrid zhal shes dang bcas 'jam dbyangs dkar po gtum po khyung lnga lo gyon ma gtso 'khor gsum ma rnams kyi rjes gnang / lcang skya gong mas mdzad pa'i 'jigs byed sgrub thabs rol pa'i rdo rje'i gsung bka' rgya'i gras shin tu gsang ba'i mgur dbyangs nyid kyis mdzad pa'i gcod kyi skor khros nagagi skor 'jam dbyangs zhi khro sbrag sgrub sogs kyi lung dang tshe khrid bdud rtsi'i zil mngar gyi khrid lung bcas chos sbyin mi zad pa'i gter gyi sgo brgya phyes/'jam dbyangs dkar po'i rjes gnang gi skabs zhal nas nged rang gis gzhung chen po'i dka' gnad phra mo mi go ba'i tshe 'di nyid kyi sngags brgya rtsa re btonanas gsol ba btab na don thams cad yid la lam gyis shar ba zhig yin khyed tshos kyang 'di la gsol ba btab na dngos grub myur zhing byin rlabs 832

sa / /rjebadza shas changagakhag g.yakyi tshan kha che gsung 'dug pa ni slob dpon tsardo go mi dang jo bo chen po sogs la lhag pa'i lhas 'phral 'phral du the tshom bsal ba'i lo rgyus dang cha mthun pa zhig ste deng dus kyi chen po rnams la 'di 'dra'i rigs 'byung ba lhag par dka'o/ / erte ni chos rje dang no yon hu thog thu zhabs drung ngag dbang blo bzang bkra shis sogs snga phyir 'ongs pa'i bla ma rnams kyis so so nas maṇ+ḍal kha btags sku gsung thugs rten gos dar 'go snam dngul gyi bca' lag sogs dngos po'i 'bul ba tshan grangs mang po bstar/ sngags pa 'ga' zhig gis zhus ngor khros nag lha lnga'i dbang no yon hu thog thus zhus ngor lcam sring dang durakhrod bdag po'i rjes gnang lha mo dbyangs can ma lha mo tha ma ṇa'i rjes gnang rnams stsal/ 'di dus kyang sngar gyi sgrang gzhi'i 'phro cung zad 'phar ldangaphyas nas gsol sman bzhes kyang phan skyed chen po ma byung bar no yon hu thog thus nged nas zhabs brtan la grib glud cig bsngo zhes zhus nas khong rang gis grib glud cig bsngos pas 'phral du bde song / zhal nas snga ba na dus erti ni chos rjes lus sbyin btang nas drag song da res no yon hu thog thus grib glud bsngos pa tsam gyis bde ru song bas grong chog la sog po'i bla ma rnams mkhas po 'dug ces zhal rtsed gsung zhing mnyes par mdzad/ hal ha'i bla ma rnams thon phyag zhus par ja gral thog yerti ni chos rje la rje btsun dam pa rin po che'i mtshams zhus gzhan mchog dman rnams kyi 'byor lan sprad cing khong rang la rta mgrin dang mkha' spyod ma'i sku thang rje btsun mi la'i 'dra sku byi ru'i phyag 'phreng / no yon hu thog thu la dang rten du rje gong ma'i bzhugs gdan sku gsung thugs rten zhabs drung sku mched gnyis la'ang nyid kyi paṇa zhwa rnying ba lha mo'i sku thang snam ther sogs dngos skyes gzabs shing bstan 'gro'i don sgrub tshul gyi bslab ston zhib tu gnang / su nyid g.yon 833

/ /gung ba bstan ba'i mi gsung bum/ru'i wang gi mi sna rab 'byams pa dkon mchog brtson 'grus ngo g.yog 'byor par brtag lan dang 'dod chos stsal/ lon cu'u dgon spyi'i mtshams zhus pa 'ongs nas dgon pa'i rten skal du na bza' bub cig zhus par sku gzan rnying ba kha byang can bskur ba gnang / thang ring dgon pa'i nga snga zhabs drung mjal du 'ongs par 'dod mos bskangs/ sku 'bum nas gdan 'dren gyi snyanagasan yang yang zhus yod pa bzhin bzhi pa'i tshes la der phebs/ o rad dge slong dbang rgyal dang or du su dge slong tshul khrims 'byung gnas sogs kyis zhus ngor 'jigs byed zhal phyag yongs rdzogs phyag rdor gtum khyung 'jam dbyangs dkar po rnams kyi rjes gnang 'jam dpal mtshan brjod kyi lung rnams stag 'tsher zhabs drung che shos zhabs drung rgyar tshang sgom pa sogs brgya phrag tsam la gnang / bco lnga'i dus chen nyin tshogs chen dang grwa tshang so sor mang ja grwa ja'i bsnyen bkur dang ngan slong nyis brgya lhag tsam la dung tse brgya re'i sbyin pa dang phyag dbang chos 'brel gnang / gser sdong chen mo'i lha khang du brgya mchod bshams te yan lag bdun pa maṇ+ḍal dang bcas sngon du btang nas sems skyed mchod pa dang gsol 'debs smon lam nan tan mdzad/ dgon pa'i nang rten chos rgyal gyi gsang thang gi zhal kheb cung zad phye ste phrin bcol gnyer gtad mdzad/ lha khang so so dang 'du khang steng rgyud pa sman pa rnams la rim gyis mchod mjal dang btsan khang du chos skyong la phrin bcol gnyer gtad mdzad/ phyi dro mi nyag sprul sku dang rgyar tshang sgom pa gnyis kyis gsol ba btab pa bzhin sku 'bum mkhan po ser ris sprul sku gro tshang mkhan po mi nyag sprul sku sman pa dpon slob mdo ba sprul sku gser thog sprul sku stag 'tsher zhabs drung kos zhabs drung che shos zhabs drung bum par zhabs drung gro tshang zhabs drung gnyis rgyar tshang sgom pa blo bzang rgyal 834

༄/ / rjebatsug bzangachosakyi gyi gagangagatsosabadabasogayakamatshan lha ram pa bsam gtan sogs kyis gtsos pa'i dge 'dun lnga brgya lhag la lam rim 'jam dpal zhal lung gi khrid dbu btsugs te rim gyis chos thun bcu gcig gis thub par mdzad cing / mjug tu nyid kyis mdzad pa'i lam rimasgon lam gyi lung gnang nas dpon slob tshang mas dge ba rdzogs byang du bsngo ba'i smon lam mdzad do/ / bka' chos kyi skabs phyi log gi mi rnams kyis dgon pa'i steng gi thad du 'ja' tshon sna tshogs phan tshun mdung tshugs su yang yang shar ba mthong ba ni rten 'brel rmad du byung ba'i ltas shig tu mngon/ bla brab rtse gro tshang sgar ba sogs su gdan drangs nas gsol ston bsnyen bkur zhus/ 'jam dbyangs sgar bar gsol tshigs zhus thog hal ha'i chos rje bsod nams dbang rgyal sogs la mkha' spyod ma'i sgrub thabs sgrol ma bzang spyod sogs kyi lung gnang bar maṇ+ḍal kha btags gos dar dngul gyi 'bul ba gya nom pa phul/ mi nyag sgar bar gsol tshigs zhus thog khong gi yab la phyag dbang chos 'brel gnang skabs shig ri khrod dga' ldan chos sdengs su phebs nas de'i ri mgor yun ring tsam bzhugs te mi nyag sprul sku che shos zhabs drung sogs la rgya sog gi lo rgyus ngo mtshar can 'ga' zhig gsung / sgom khang nas khong dpon g.yog la nyid kyi 'khrungs rabs gsol 'debs dang bla ma'i rnal 'byoragru 'dzin nye lam gyi lngags lung stsal/ phyir lam bshol zla bzhi pa'i tshesagacig la mar tshang du bcag mal mdzad cing bla chen gyi mdun du mchod 'bul smon lam nan tan mdzad/ o'u han rab 'byams pa bkra shis dge legs dang ma rga dka' bcu bsam gtan sogs kyis zhus ngor dge 'dun brgya lhag la dpon slob byams pa rin po che'i gsung 'bum yongs rdzogs kyi lung gnang / 'di dus rje rang nyid 'ja' lus brnyas nas zhabs phyi pa rnamasakyis gzugs sku rags pa la sri zhu byed kyin yod pa'i thugs mis byung 835

༄/ /gung bang bstanaba'i sgronami'i gsung 'bum/tshul chos nyan pa rnams la gsungs te shi bar mis na lo gsum 'tsho zer ba yin pas bzang zhes lo gsum phan chad du mi bzhugs pa don gyis gnang zin kyangadogs dpyod byed mkhan ma byung 'dug / dbyar gyi ring skyed tshal du bzhugs nas thugs dam dang dpe gzigs ljags rtsom spel mar gnang su nyid g.yon ru'i dka' bcu 'jam dpal grags pa ngo g.yog sleb par ljags lung du ma gnang / chu bzang dgon pa'i khri zur lha ram pa 'byung gnas dpon g.yog dang gro tshang mkhan po dpon g.yog byon nas nyin kha shas bzhugs te chos kyi gsung gleng 'phel/ lha ram pa la rta mgrin chos skor nas le tshan kha shas kyi lung dang gro tshang mkhan po zhabs drung rnam gnyis dang bcas par 'jam dbyangs dmar ser gyi rjes gnang phyag chen gyi khrid chos tshan 'ga' zhig gi lung bcas gnang / sum pa bla brang gi zhabs drung dang phyag mdzod sogs nas mkhan chen gyi sprul sku'i dogs gnas kyi 'os tho phul ba la mnal lam bsgug ste dogs gnas rnams tshogs pa'i nang du da lta'i sprul sku 'di ban chas byas 'dug par 'di nyid yin ngo che tshul gnang / bkra shis 'khyil bla brang gi a khu phyag mdzod dus las 'das pa'i rgyu mtshan zhu mi 'ongs nas bsngo smon zhus shing phyag mdzod gsar ba sko bzhag gi skor dgongs bstun zhus par am ban la zhu sna mdzad de sprul sku rin po che'i thugs bzhed ltar dge rgan mkhan po dkon mchog seni bsko bzhag gnang / rje nyid kyi sku'i nye rigs 'ga' zhig dang gzhan slob bu mang po thor ba mthar pa la lha 'brum dkar po 'deb rgyur bla brang gsol dpon dge bshes bstan pa dar rgyas la skad bskur ba bzhin khong yang 'ongs nas sku tsha rdo ba zhabs drung sogs che phra du mar lha 'brum btab par nyes skyon gcig kyang med par legs par thar bas thugs shin tu mnyes/ o thog pe li'i gnyer ba shes rab bstan 'dzin 836

༄/ /༄tsotshotha4cho misnyamag4gtsaphromagakhazadagagangogayog 'byor nas dpon mo dus 'das kyi ched du bsngo smon zhus/ mar tshang lha khang gi logs ris rnying skyon che bar nyid kyis thugs dad kyis kun nas bslangs te rong po lha bzo ye shes ngo g.yog btang nas gsar gsos legs paragrub zin par thugs mnyes shing lha bzo rnams yon gyis mgu bar byas/bdun pa'i tshes la dgon lung du byon nas cun gar thu sa lag chi'i tho yon bstan 'phel nyi ma gsol dpon dge bshes bstan pa dar rgyas sogs la khros nag lha lnga'i dbang lha me dang lcam sring gi rjes gnang sku lnga dang dam can gyi rigs gtad phag dkar shes rab gsal byed kyi rjes gnang de'i dmigs rim gyi khrid sogs stsal/ kun gru'u mā thi dgon rmad byung rgyal ba'i gling du sngar nas gdan 'dren nan che ba bzhin bcu bdun la chebs bskyod btsan po bla brang gi phyag mdzod ser tshud zhabs drung dang dkar rtsa zhabs drung gnyis kyis gtsos pa'i lha sde skya ser rnams kyis nyin kha shas bzhugs dgos tshul zhus pa bzhin nyin gsum bzhugs te gdan 'dren zhu mkhan so so'i 'dod mes bzhinakhrus dbang 'pho lung gsung brtag sogs yid tshim par stsal/ mtsho mang du jas tshang lha 'bum gyis gdan drangs pa'i don mdzad cing jid ya ling du mdzi ja sag gi ja thab thog de phyogs kyi mjal ba mang por phyag dbang chos 'brel gnang mo ne'u ho la gser khri sprul sku dang spyi gnyer sogs mang po 'byor nas bla brang gi ja thab zhus/ gangs dkar wang gi shog mkhan po bla ma gtsos pa'i yul mi rnams kyi ja thab thog ye shes dar rgyas wang dpon g.yog mjal du phebs par phyag dbang dang gsung gleng mdzad/ phen tu khu'i mdar nā thi dgon pa'i grwa pa che gras rnams dang tā thu mo gtsos pa'i ra 'khyung tsho ba bcu bzhi'i dpon po rgan sum rnams chibs bsur 'byor nas ja thab zhus shing khyung nag bla ma gtsos pa'i grwa pa che phra mang po'i chibs bsu bod dgon rgya 837

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'ithoname'i gsung spyom/dgon gnyis kyi dge 'dun mang po'i ser spreng dang bcas nyi shu brgyad la bod dgon bla brang du babs/ a lag shā wang gi mi sna tha'i ji dha rma pā la ngo g.yog 'byor nas zla ba bcu pa'i nang du ho'u sho de gar chibs bsgyur gnang dgos kyi gsol ba nan cher btab pa bzhin de lugs kyi khal rta khyer 'ong rgyur thag bcad/ dgon pa'i tshogs chen 'du khang rje nyid nas sbyin bdag thu sa lag chi tshe dbang bsam grub la gtad gnyer mdzad nas khong gis 'bub zebs sbyar/ shing bzo rtsig dpon lha bzo rnams dgon lung nas btang ste 'du khang gsar ba tshon rtsi dang bcas legs par grub zin pas da res de la rab gnas dang lam khrid sogs gnang dgos kyi gsol ba btab pa bzhin brgyad pa'i tshes nas gser khri sprul sku dang khyung nag bla mas gtsos pa'i dgon gnyis kyi dge 'dun dang mchod gzhis skye pho mo bcas ser skya nyis stong tsam la bde lam gyi khrid dbu btsugs nas nyin bcu gsum gyi ring smin rgyas dang nyin gnyis la bcu gcig zhal gyi dbang sta gon bcas gnang ste dpon slob tshang mas dge ba rdzogs byang du bsngo ba'i mtshams sbyor mdzad/ lam rim gyi khrid lung rigs kyi spros pa ha cang rgya mi che rung dbang po no rtul gyi rim pas lung dang rigs pa dpe dang gtan tshigs ci rigs kyi sgo nas gdul bya'i rna bar skyel mkhas pa'i dbang gis mchog dman 'bring gsum thams cad kyi yid tshim zhing rang rang gis ci nus su dge ba sna re tshun chad la brtson pas phan skyed shin tu che ba byung / tshes bdun gyi nyin tshogs dbur gdan drangs nas brtan bzhugs kyi rten 'brel bsgrigs te maṇ+ḍal kha btags sku gsung thugs rten gyis gtsos pa'i bdog pa'i dngos po spam mtho zhing tshan grangs mang ba bstar/ 'di'i mtshan mo thugs mis la rje nyid bla ma byams pa rin po che dang dngos su zhal mjal nas phan tshun chos kyi gsung bgros mang du 'phel ba'i 838

sa / /che badza gas 09)khagasadago/mjug tu nyid nas nged rang snga mo nas kyang sgrub pa rnam dag cig byed 'dun yod kyang 'du 'dzi sna tshogs kyis bar bcad nas da bar du bsgrub ma thub pas del rim gro gang bgyis na bzang zhes zhus par byams pa rin po ches gtor ma brgya rtsa rgyun du thongs gsung ba zhig mis 'dug cing / zhal nas snga ma nged la 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa rin po ches khyod rang 'jam dpal mtshan brjodadang gtor ma brgya rtsa ma chag par gnang na bzang zhes gsungs pa da resakyi 'di gnyi ga rgyu mtshan gcig yin pa 'dra gsungs nas phan shu'u dge slong ngag dbang bstan 'phel zer ba la lo gcig gi ring gtor ma brgya rtsa chag med du gtong rgyu'i ljags bkod dang thebs dang yon rnams sprod par mdzad de 'di ni mnal lam du ming btags pa tsam ma gtogs bla ma rnams dang nam yang 'du 'bral med par bzhugs pa'i rnam thar 'gang che ba zhig tu mngon/tshesabargyad la rje nyid chog grogs dang bcas 'du khang rten brten par rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sgo nas rab gnas gnang ba la chos skyong bsgo ba'i skabs su de ga'i sgos kyi chos skyong lha mo la gtor 'bul mchod bstod 'phrin bcol gnang b.raspyan 'dren ming brgya ma'i skabs su tre'us skad 'tsher ba dang / 'azin bcol dpon slob sde bcas ma lan gsum gsungs pa'i skabs su bu mo mang po zhig gdangs snyan pos glu len pa dang mtshams mtshams su pho rog gi skad sgrog pa'i nyams snang byung 'dug pa ni dpal ldan lha mo mngon sum du byon te rdo rje'igayar dam bzhes pa'i brdar gor ma chag go bsgrub bya nyi shu rtsa dgu la bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa stsal/ rje nyid nas bod dgon gyi tshogs chen la mang ja btang thog dong tshe lnga brgya re dang bsod btags re skya chen lnga re'i sku 'gyed rgyud pa grwa tshang dang rgya dgon gnyis la'ang mang 'gyed gzabs byams khang gsar bzhengs kyi thebs su dong tshe khron bzhi brgya bcas gnang /839

༄/ /yo bang ba ba me'igasung 'bumadagon 'og ma brgyud nas dgon par mar phebs te zhag bzhugs mdzad phyi nyinagaser khri sprul skus gsar du bzhengs pa'i lha khang la shis brjod mdzad/de dus gnas bstod dang 'brel bar sgrub pa la bskul ba'i bslab bya zhig gnang ba ni 'di ltar/ 'di phyi'i legs tshogs 'byung ba'i gnas/ / drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma dang / / bslu med skyabs gnas mchog gsum la/ / snying nas dad pas phyag bgyis te/ / mdo smad bod yul byang gi mtha'/ / ra khyung zhes bya'i sa phyogs 'di'i/ / snod bcud yon tan brjod pa'i gtam/ / glu ru len no dpyod ldan nyon/ / gna' dus byang chub sems dpa' che/ / rgyal bu blo gros 'phel zhes pas/ / klu bdud gdug pa btul ba'i —gnas/ /bsil thang bya ba yul 'di ste/ / bla ma a wa rtu ti ga / rnam gsum bzhugs pa'i sa cha yang / / dgon pa gong 'og bar gsum gyi/ / gnas 'di yin zhes kun la grags/ / brag la brkos pa'i mchod rten dang / / lha khang ngo mtshar can du mas/ / ri lung gang ba la dpags na/ / khyad 'phags gnas su nges pa skye/ / lhag par brag la bzos pa yi/ / sgrub khang dben zhing nyams dga' mang/ /gna' dus sgom sgrub la gzhol ba'i/ / skal ldan mang du byung bar nges/ / yul 'di'i 'brog pa'i mi rnams ni/ / dad pa che zhing g.yo sgyu chung / / mtha' gnyis ma lhung 'byor pa ldan/ / 'thab rtsod med par phan tshun mthun/ / e ma yul phyogs bzang po 'dir/ / rgyal ba byams pa'i mdo rgyan las/ / sgrub pa'i gnas kyi mtshan nyid lnga/ / gsungs pa rnams ni legs par tshang / / kho bo chos kyi rdo rje ni/ / gnas bzang 'di 'drar rtse gcig tu/ / sgrub la gzhol bar yid smon kyang / / bsod nams chung bas thog ma khel/ / dal 'byor don ldan byed 'dod pa'i/ / skal ldan yod na gnas 'di 'drar/ / 'du 'dzi g.yeng ba gtan spangs te/ / tshe dang sgrub pa 840

sa / /che bache gas bshagakhag gagadasnyoms par 'tshal/ / dal 'byor rnyed dka' don che zhing / / nam 'chi nges med shi ba'i tshe/ / chos min gzhan gyis mi phan tshul/ / bsam nas rang rgyud bskul ba gces/ / dben pa'i khong nas 'di snang gi / phun tshogs sgrub pa 'ga' zhig gis/ / mi tshe 'da' bar byed pa rnams/ / lung stong gnas pa'i 'brog pa 'dra/ / de phyir rang gi sgo gsum la/ / rang gis bya ra legs bgyis nas/ / chos brgyad bya ba kun spangs te/ / dam chos rnam dge sgrub la 'bungs/ / byang chub lam gyi rim pa dang / / gsang sngags bskyed rdzogs nyams len gyis/ / mi tshe skyel ba'i skal ldan la/ / byang sems rnams kyang smonaganas byed/ / de 'dra'i rgya chen ma thub kyang / / rang gzhan 'khor ba las thar phyir/ / dad pas ma ṇi la 'bad kyang / / dal 'byor thob pa don dang ldan/ / khas blangs sdom khrims bsrung bya la/ / gnod 'aspyod med pa'i gdengs ldan na/ / dge gzhan sgrub par ma nus kyang / / thar pa'i lam sna zin dang 'dra/ / rang la snying brtse ldan pa dag / mnog chung tshe 'di'i bya bzhag gis/ / mi tshe don med ma gtong bar/ / gtan bde'i btsan sa zin la 'bungs/ / lcags sprel khrums zla'i bcu drug nyin/ / dgon pa bar ma'i bste gnas su/ / mang thos rgan pos glu 'di blangs/ / yul phyogs rtag tu bkra shis shog / ces pa'o/ / de nas dgon gong mar gzigs rtog dang mchod mjal gnang ste dgon par phebs bzhugs ring la de dag spyo sger so so'i 'dod mos lhar lhag lha 'ga' zhig gi rjes gnang chos tshan thor bu mang po'i lung bka' bsgo gsung brtag sogs kyis tshim par mdzad/ nyer gnyis la dgon nas thon skabs dge 'dun mang pos chibs skyel dar 'bod ja thab bcas spros pa rgya chen pos mjal ba mang po chos kyi bdud rtsis tshim par mdzad bzhin phebs/ gser dgon gyi chin hu chos rjes cha gan u su la zhag bab gra 841

༄/ /yo thangabastan ba'ithoname'i gsung 'bum/sgrigaphyas yod par zhabs phyi byings rnams bsdad cing nyid chin hu chos rje'i nang du bzhugs shing gsol ston 'bul nod bstabs chos rje'i lha gur nang du rten gsum la rab gnas rta thog ma mdzad/ dgu pa'i tshes la gdan sar babs/ bod kyi yi ge rnams 'byor par lung bstan 'ga' zhig tu rim gro mang po bab yod pa bzhin nye 'khor gyi dgon sgrub sde rnams su mang 'gyed thebs bskur nas tshe lha gsum gyi gzungs ring thung 'bum grangs bsags pa dang gdugs sher sgrol gsum gang mang / bla brang du'ang tshe sgrub bsnyen sgrub sogs zhabs brtan mang du bsgrubs shing ri khrod pa rnams dang gling gi thugs dam pa rnams la tshe sgrub mdo klog pa brgya rtsa klu gtor lan chags gtor ma sa 'bum chu 'bum grangs gsog rgyu gtod pa gnang / lo 'dir snga phyir gsod la thug pa'i ra lug brgya phrag tsam dang bya dang nya'i srog kyang mang po blus yod cing da res kyang sku 'bum sgar ba'i nang so la rje'i lnga mchod dang bstun nas lug brgya phrag tsam gye srog blu'i thebs sprad rgya sbrang mang po la'ang sbyin pa gtong ba gnang / sngar zhwa lu ri mthil gyi bla ma las byed nas gtsug lag khang dang mchod rten nyams gsos kyi mthun rkyen snyan bskul zhus pa bzhin sku 'bum chen mo nyams gsos kyi thebs su rgya dngul srang brgya tham pa bskur ba'i lan du bka' gnang ltar sku 'bum chen mo nyams gso byed rgyu'i gnas tshul dang slar yang gtsug lag khang nyams gsos kyi mthun rkyen snyan bskul gyi zhu shog bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa'i thugs dam rten brgyad stong rgya dpe bcas 'byor par/zhal nas spyir yang dge 'dun gyi kun dga' ra ba dang mchod rten sogs gsar ba bzhengs pa dang rnying pa gso ba'i phan yon mdo rgyud las mang du gsungs pa dang khyad par bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa'i gsung gi legs bshad dang rnam thar gyi yi ge sogs mthong bas dad pa bcos min yod par ma 842

༄/ /chubatsug ba4cho minyis gagangagakhu pabadakaragadabyungakazad/ nged rang bod du sdod skabs gdan sa de'i mkhan po'i ming yang bdag gir byas pa yin pas da dung 'byor tshod kyi mthun rkyen sgrub dgos zhes thugs la btags pa'i gsung mang du byon/ 'dis mtshon pa'i mchog dman su zhig gis gtsug lag khang gsar bzhengs nyams gso dang tshogs zangs gral gdan mchod rdzas kyi skor gang dang gang gtad gnyer zhus kyang ngo ma zlog par thugs dgyes pas zhal bzhes gnang ste dngos kyis rgyu sbyar ba'am dad ldanagazhan la rteng skul gyis cis kyang mthun rkyen bka' drin gnang ba zhig yin no/ / lha bab dus chen gyi nyin cun gar tho yon bstan 'phel nyi ma sogs bsgrub bya re gnyis la bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa stsal te bslab pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i gzhi la bkod cing or du su a mor sa na chos rje ngo g.yog rnams kyang gsol ba btab pa bzhin chos kyi bdud rtsis tshim par mdzad do/ / smras pa/ nor bu'i ba gam 'od kyi snang bas phyogs kyi 'khor lo 'dri byed rnam par rgyal ba'i khang bzang na/ / sbyin skyes dpung tshogs dga' ba mthar byed 'chi med gzhon nu'i tshogs kyis gus bsten lha yi dbang / / be+e ḍūr sa gzhi gtsang ma'i ngos la 'dod dgur 'char bas nye dbang tshogs kyi re skong zhing / /bdud rtsi'i gru char gzeg ma 'bum gyis mtha' yas 'jig rten gdung sel kun dga'i mchod yon 'gyed/ / de bzhin chos dang srid kyi 'byor pa'i dpal/ / dus 'dir sa yi steng na mi dman pa/ / mdo smad nor 'dzin yangs pa'i thig le ni/ / gang gis yongs bzung dge mtshan 'od snang 'bar/ / de yis gdung ba bslang ba'i yid srub dpung / / phyi phyir mya ngan khung bur bcug pa na/ / dkar phyogs lha dang blo ldan gzhon nu'i tshogs/ /lhang lhang dga' ba'i dbyangs snyan srid rtser sgogs/ / tha dad yul dang yul ljongs dge 'dun sde/ / kun gyis gsol btab ji bzhin 'dod gu ru/ /843

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i name'i gsung 'bum/gshegs bzhud bzhugs pa'i go skabs 'gog med du/ / 'char bas skal bzang yongs kyi re ba skong / / mkhyen brtse zung du 'jug pa'i sprin klong nas/ / mdo sngags chos tshul bdud rtsi'i gru char gyis/ / srid dang zhi ba'i gdung ba kun 'phrog cing / / don gnyis 'bras bu'i dga' ston smin par mdzad/ / ces rigs dang dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum rmad du byung ba'i mdzad bzang 'dab brgya'i dga' tshal gyi cha tsam gtam du byas pa rtogs brjod pad+ma dkar po las/bstan pa'i rmang gzhir dgongs te ljongs 'di'i gnas so sor mdo sngags kyi 'chad spel gtso bor gnang ba'i tshul gyi 'dab ma ste bcu gnyis pa'o/ /844

༄/ /༄tsotshosazangacho minyi garagatsosamakhabs ka༄7/ / 'dab ma bcu gsum pa/ byang phyogs kyi ljongs su gdul bya rnams smin cing grol ba'i phyir chibs bskyod mdzad pa'i tshul/zlab bcu pa'i tshes la a lag shā wang gi gdan 'dren pa thu sa lag chi rnam rgyal gyes gtsos pa'i drag zhan sum cu skor gyis 'u la khyer yong ba bzhin tshes drug la dgon lung nas bla spyi so so'i ja thab chibs skyel dang bcas thon/mar tshang bla chen gyi lha khang du mchod sprin rgya mtsho spros te nying chog grogs dang bcas pas ldeb ris gsar bzhengs la rab gnas mdor bsdus dang thugs smon nan tan mdzad/ stong shag gi ri dgon gyi rta thab bcas phebs mo'u tha la'i lha khang du ser lung dgon gyi grwa bas gdan drangs gsol ston 'bul nod zhus par phyag dbang chos 'brel sogs kyis tshim par mdzad/ 'dir hal ha'iyerti ni cang jun wang gis ched dmigs btang ba'i mi sna de min bshad sgrub jas tshang dge 'phel ngo g.yog 'byor nas zhu shog dngos 'bul dang bcas phul/ pho rod kyi dgon che chung gi bsu skyel ja thab dang bcas zung shan du babs stag lung sprul sku rin po che dpon g.yog dang 'bri gung thub chen sprul sku chos rje dang bcas dpon g.yog mang po 'ongs nas thabs su pheb rdzong zhus/ rtag lung sprul sku rin po ches lcang skya rol pa'i rdo rje'i gsung lta mgur gyikhrid zhus par khrid rgyun med na'ang bshad lung tsam 'don pa la 'gal ba med pa 'dra gsung nas khong dpon g.yog la lta mgur gyi dka' gnad rnams dmigs phug nas bkral te bshad pa mdor bsdus tsam dang gzhan yang ser 845

༄/ /gung bang bstan pa'isgroname'i gsung 'bum/skya mang po la dga' ldan lha brgya ma'i khrid lung gnang / thos pa tsam gyis 'khor ba mtha' can du byed pa'i mtshan dang gzungs sngags zab mo rna bar sgrogs pa sogs rgyun gyi phyag bzhes ltar mdzad/ 'khrungs lha dge bsnyen gzi brjid 'phags la gsol mchod btang sor du su u rang hal ha cha har u cu mu chin sogs kyi mjal ba mang po rim par 'byor nas 'dod don zhus shing / ong nyid pe li'i shog sbyin bdag ha sa pā thur gyi dpon mo mkha' 'gro mtshos sgrol dkar gyi sku thang tshags drub byon legs shig 'bul rgyu bskur ba sogs bla dpon so so'i zhu shog dang dngos skyes rnams spyan lam du bstar/lcang skya mchog sprul rin po che 7gong ma'i mtshams zhus grub nas phyir chibs kha bsgyur bar shi wa za nas mjal phrad dang gsung gleng mdzad u cu mu chin smon lam bla ma'i zhabs drung dang ku lu khu khu'i zhabs drung sogs smad sog drag zhan mang pos mjal kha zhus/ kun gu'u mda' la gung bab thog o thog sbyin bdag thu sa lag chi dharma dha ju ca khir chi lha dbang rdo rje spun gnyis dpon g.yog mang po dang bcas pas phyag dbang bka' bsgo zhus/ sog po'i sa sne zin nas nub gcig mnal lam du rje nyid byams pa rin po che dang mjal nas yun ring tsam bzhugs ngos chos kyi bgro ba mang du mdzad cing khyad par rje nyid kyi thugs dgongs la da res byams pa rin po che dang mjal dus 'dir lam gyi rim pa'i 'brel sgrig la dogs slong mang po byas te phu thag chod pa zhig byed dgos dgongs nas skyes bu gsum gyi lam gyi rim pa'i 'brel sgrig la phan tshun dri ba dris lan mang du mdzad de thugs tshim pa lta bu byung ba'i mtshams der/byams pa rin po ches khyed rang gis snga ma nas byang chub lam gyi rim pa'i sgo nas gdul bya mang po bskyangs pa la nged rang sems dga' ba yin da dung yang skyongabar mdzod 'u cag mi ring bar thug pas nged rang 'gro gsung nas pheb 846
