༄/ /༄tsotshotha4chos snya gtsagatsosagagasabasgoranasong ba zhig rmis byung zhes phyi nyin zhog ka zhabs phyi na yod pa'i dka' ram gu thi sogs 'ga' zhig la nyams mtshar pa'i tshul du dri ba dris lan gnang tshul mgo 'bus tsam re gsungs pas/ khong tshos kyang mnal lam du byung ba ji lta ba bzhin phyag bris shig gnang dgos kyi gsol ba btab par lam rim zhig gzhan mang pos bskul zhing rang gis kyang rtsom 'dun yod pas slar bris chog /rmi lam du byung tshul smos na gzhan dag gis lcang skya rol pa'i rdo rje'i rnam 'grel la lad mo byas 'dug ces kha gtong ba las don du gnyer mkhan dkon gsung nas zhal bzhes ma gnang / sgrib bral chos kyi nyi ma'i 'od stong gis/ / ljongs 'dir mdo sngags lam bzang pad+mo'i tshal/ / phye ba'i tshul la ched du bsngags pa ni/ / bstan dang 'gro la dgongs par mngon na yang / /byang nas byang du gdul bya'i tha ma la/ / jilta ji ltar 'tsham pa'i chos bstan te/ / myur ba myur bar zhing gzhan 'byon pa'i brda/ / bstan tshe bstan dang 'gro la ma dgongs sam/ / snyan nas snyan du brgyud las ches zab pa /thugs nas thugs su 'phos pa'i man ngag de/ / yi ger ma bkod gdong lnga'i 'o ma yi/ / snod gyur rin chen yol gos phongs sam snyam/ / de 'dra'i rigs gzhan yang mang du yod tshod 'dug kyang yi ger 'god pa ma gnang ba'i tshod du snang ste sog po'i bla ma zhig gi gsung rtsom khrod na mi lam du byung ba'i dbang skur tshul zhig yod pa gzigs nas nga la'ang mi lam dang nyams snang gi chos mang po yod kyang yi ger yang ma btab gzhan la'ang ma spel ba yin gsung / ong nyod pe li'i mchod gnas bla ma'i yang srid nyid nas thag bcad nas dgon lung du yod pa gdan 'dren zhu mi gnyer ba blo gros ngo g.yog 'byor nas pe li'i zhu shog rten bcas phul zhing nyid nas bla brang gi phyag gnyer rnams la yang srid gdan 'dren skor gyi zhal bkod bskur/ bye 'dabs su 847

༄/ /gung thang bstan ba'isgraname'i gsung 'bum/rje drung mkhan po dpon g.yog dang wang gi mtshams zhus pa mi rin dkon mchog ngo g.yog 'byor nas mjal kha zhus/ 'di'i mtshan mo thugs mis la rje nyid sman ram pa'i mtshan btags gnang rgyu yin zhes bshad pa mdzad dgos par thugs dgongs la thog mar sman gyi brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams la mchod brjod byed dgos pas/ 'phags yul gyi mgon po klu sgrub dang slob dpon dpa' bo bod kyi g.yu thog gsar rnying rnams la mchod brjod byed dgongs nas de dag la tshigs bcad re gsar rtsom gnang ste mchod brjod mdzad pa zhig rmis tshul gsungs shing tshigs bcad de dag kyang yi ger 'god pa ma gnang / thung ge la tha'i ji dha rma pā la dang tha'i ji lha dbang dpon mo yul skyid rnams kyis rang rang gi khyim du gdan drangs nas 'dod don zhus/yumaskyid kyis ched dmigs sgrub pa'i gzim gur cha tshang khe pi su'i gdan cha dngabacas phul nas skyabs 'jug zhus/ or du su ja sag shog gi jang gi er khe cir gal dang gu thi dpal 'byor sogs mjal ba sum cu skor gyis sgar thog nas brtan bzhugs kyi rten 'brel bsgrigs te dngos 'bul btegs par dga' ldan lha brgya ma'i lung sogs stsal/ se ri khes la bla brang rang gi lha sde rgyal yag mkhan po dang dam chos sku rten sogs kyis gdan drangs te bsnyen bkur zhus/ de nas rim gyis sbyin bdag chin wang sku mched rnams kyis chibs bsu thab bsu ser sbreng dang bcas nyi shu lnga la yā mon du babs 'di nyin rje'i dus mchod yin pas dmigs bsal gyi thugs dam mdzad/ ho sho'u rang dang o rad hal ha or du su'i mjal ba rnams zam ma chad du byung bar phyag dbang chos 'brel sogs gang 'dod du stsal/ hrun gar thu sa lag chi'i tho yon sogs lam 'grul 'ga' zhig zhabs phyir 'brang nas 'ongs pa 'di nas thon phyag zhus/ sde dge zam thang zhabs drung grong chog gi ang nyan 848

sa / /rjebatsun khazang gsangagakhu pamadakuracod ngakal 'ong don bzhin wang zhabs drung rin po cher gtad gnyer gyi phyag bris dang bcas 'jigs med gu thi dang lhan du o'u han du gtong ba gnang / snga ma pheb dus i li'i thor god kyi grwa rgyun gnyis bod nas 'ong nas gro kha dang khal rta chad skad rigs dang lam mi shes par ngal dub chen po byung ba'ang nyid nas zhabasabyer khrid 'ongs te 'di nas gro kha dang khal rta'i mthun rkyen gnang ba sogs rje 'di ni dus nam gyi tshe'ang 'gron po grogs dang cha rkyen gyis phongs pasalam mgo ma thon pa dang rgya sgo ma thar par ngal zhing dub pa mang po la skabs su gang bab kyi mthun rkyen rgyun ldan gnang ba zhig yin te/ zhal nas yun ring gi nad pa dang thag ring gi mgron po la phan 'dogs dgos pa zhig yin zhes yang yang gsungs la/ 'di ni mdo las/ lam gol 'khyam pa rnams la lam ston 'gyur/ zhes dang / rgyal sras zhi ba lhas/ mya ngam lam gol 'khyams pa rnams/ / mgron po dag dang phrad gyur nas/ / chom rkun stag sogs 'jigs med par/ / mi ngal bde blag 'dod par shog /ces smon lam mdzad pa'i don bzhin snying rje'i gzhan dbang du gyur pa'i spyod pa rmad du byung ba zhig go / hal ha'i e rte ni cang jun wang gi mi sna rnams kyis thon phyag zhus par brtag lan sogs stsal/ nyi ldog dang bstun nas wang gtsos pa'i sde ba thun mong gi rim gror rje nyid sgrub grogs dang bcas pas rta mgrin gsang sgrub kyi gtor sgrub nyin bdun bsgrubs te zlog dmigs nan tan mdzad/ o thog pe lis 'khrungs skar gyi dga' ston la brtan bzhugs dang gdan 'dren gyi snyan gsan 'bul mi sman pa mkhan po rab 'byams pa blo bzang yon tan dge bskos ngag dbang sbyin pa phas than tā yon tan mi rin khi shig sogs 'byor nas snyan gsan zhus par zhal bzhes mdzad/ sog yul du song ba'i gsol dpon blo gros dar rgyas las don grub nas phyir 'byor 849

༄/ /gung thang bstanapa'ithon 'i gsungangabum/'di'i sngon nas blo gros dar rgyas yong ba la lam bgegs chen po 'dug gsung nas gsol mchod gtong du 'jug par mdzad/ de skabs kho cha har du gleb pas kha ba pus mo nub tsam bab nas zla bo wang bla brang gi grwa ba rnams phyir log dgos byung yang kho rang skyon med du 'byor pa ni nyid kyi thugs rje kho na yin par nges pa rnyed/ tshes bdun 'khrungs skar gyi nyin thog mar sbyin bdag wang la dge mtshan spel ba'i cho ga gnang wang gis 'khrungs skar gyi dga' ston du mdzod btags gos chen yug dgu shel dang par yol gyi snod spyad dgu tshan gcig gha ri'i 'khor lo khyad mtshar can shi pā lo han gye phreng ba tsan dan gyi don yod zhags pa bcas phul/ dpon mo sras mo rnams kyis kyang ca lag khyad mtshar can mang po dang rje drung mkhan po dgon pa'i grwa pa che gras blon po che chung sogs so so nas che 'byor chung 'byor gyi skyes dang bcas mjal kha zhus/de rjes o thog pe li'i mi sna rnams kyis brtan bzhugs kyi rten 'brel bsgrigs te dpon pos bskur ba'i maṇ+ḍal kha btags sku gsung thugs rten dngul srang brgya bcas phul gzhi byes thams cad la 'khrungs skar gyi ston mo gzab rgyas gnang / de nas nyin bdun gyi ring khong tsho'i rim gror lha mo'i bskang bshags dang sbrags nas bam skong 'khrug skong 'phrin bcol gnyer gtad gnadasprin sgrub par mdzad/ de dus nyin re'i srod thun gyi mjug tu glud rdzong re bsngo ba gnang bar nyin dang po'i glud rdzong bsngo dus gzim gur gyi phyi rol byang shar mtshams nas glud de nga la byin cig zer ba'i skad cig thol gyis byung ba gsan nas 'don mtshams gnang ste thams cad la dri ba gnang bas sus kyang ma tshor 'dug / mchod g.yog sogs la phyi rol tu ltos gsung nas bltas pas nye 'khor du su gcig kyang mi 'dug par de phyin chad nas nyin re'i glud rdzong phyogs der skyel ba gnang / yang nyin bdun gyi ring rta mgrin 850

༄/ /chubatso thazangacho minyima'igasangagasu pasamakhazagasakagasang sgrub kyi sgo nas sri mnan tshad ldan bsgrubs te mjug tu gtor rgyag mdzad sku rim de dag gi mtshams su hal ha'i lha chen ja sag shog gi mjal ba 'ga' zhig la rta mgrin gyi rjes gnang de'i chos skor le tshan kha shas kyi lung /rje drung mkhan po dang gu thi blo bzang rdo rje gnyis la nyid kyi gsung bka' rgya'i gras rig byed ma'i bsnyen yig mgon po dang chos rgyal gyi skor yongs rdzogs sogs kyi lung u rang dge slong blo bzang zla bas sngar nas nan tan zhus pa bzhin don yod zhags pa'i cho ga gsar rtsom lung dang bcas gnang / su nyid g.yon ru'i wang dang thu sa lag chi blo bzang don 'grub gnyi ga'i mi sna su nyid g.yas ru'i grwa rigs ta las dpon po sogs skya ser mang po dang ku lu o lan gyi dge bshes bla ma tā bla ma sogs dang dur bed wang gi mi sna sogs rim pas 'ongs nas bla dpon so so'i zhu shog dngos 'bul rnams phul/ badhe thu salag chi dus las 'das pa'i bsngo rten byung bar sbyang chog gi spyan dmigs mdzad de dag la rta mgrin gsang sgrub kyi rjes gnang skyabs 'gro'i khrid dga' ldan lha brgya ma'i khrid sogs so so'i 'dod chos dang brtag lan yid tshim par stsal/ hal ha'i gu'i gu thi sogs nyung 'dus la rgyal po sku lnga'i rigs gtad o rad rab 'byams pa mkhas grub rgya mtshos zhus ngor rje drung mkhan po sogs la bla mchod kyi khrid dang gcod thar 'dod ded dpon gyi lung bcas gnang /zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i tshes gcig la cha har khu be thu o lān gyi sbyin bdag phun tshogs dang ye shes rgyal mtshan ngo g.yog gleb nas sngar dgon lung gi tshogs chen 'du khang gsar gsos kyi gtad gnyer mdzad pa bzhin theb dngul khyer 'ongab phul/ tshes gnyis la gzhi byes kyi nyan mkhan lnga bcu skor la 'jam lugs tshe dpag med lha lnga'i sgo nas tshe dbang rgyas pa stsal/ phun tshogs dang ye shes rgyal mtshan gnyis kyis brtan bzhugs kyis rten 'brel bsgrigs te 851

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'isgroname'i gsung 'bum/maṇ+ḍal kha btags sku gsung thugs rten gyi thog drangs dngos 'byor gyi bdog pa spel de dag dgon lung du 'gro rgyur dgon pa'i che gras rnams la lo rjes mar tshogs chen 'du khang cis kyang zhig gso byed rgyu'i zhal bkod kyi gsung shog bskur ba gnang de nas nyin bdun gyi ring bcad rgya'i ngos thugs dam dmar bar mdzad/ bcad rgya grol nas su nyid gu shri chos 'phel dang 'jigs med gnyis kyis zhus ngor slob ma lnga la nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i bskyed rdzogs kyi khrid gser chos 'pho khrid dang bla med kyi yi dam gang la'ang sbyar chog pa'i gtum mo'i khrid bcas smin rgyas dang / o thog sman ram pa snyan grags kyis zhus te rje drung mkhan po sogs grwa pa lnga bcu skor la tshem bu lugs kyi dmar khrid rol pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa'i dkon mchog spyi mchod chos skyong gi 'khu ldog zhi ba'i man ngag gi ljags lung bcas stsal/ wang gi khrims ra'i btson gyi nang nas gsod la thug pa'i mi nag can gsum ngo chen mdzad de 'jigs pa skyabs kyi sbyin pa stsal cing mtshan dang gzungs sngags rna bar bsgrags te chos kyi sbyin pa dang phyin chad bya ba ngan pa la 'dzem dgos pa'i zhal bkod gnang / wang gi pho brang dang mkhan po'i bla brang so sor gsol ston dang rnam rgyal thu sa lag chi sogs blon po khag 'gas kyang rang rang gi khyim du gsol ston 'bul ba zhus thu sa lag chi bza' mi rnams la sgrol lngang gi rjes gnang dang gzhan so sor lngags lung dang bka' bsgo sogs 'dod mos bzhin stsal/ o thog pe li'i gdan 'dren pa thu sa lag chi pa shā lus mi rin labes dpal dar gling gi tshogs chen dge bskos rnams 'ul mi 'u lag dang bcas 'byor te bco lnga'i nyin wang dang mkhan pos gtsos drag zhan ba rgya phrag brgal pa'i rta thab dang bcas yu mon nas chibs bskyod/ gung mgo la ma bu gnyis kyis byung gur phub par gdan drangs te gsol ston 'bul nod zhus 852

༄/ /rjebatsun bzabartsa kyi bas lasadakaras ༄ra/paraphyag dbang gnang pur ga su thas la sman pa grwa tshang gi mkhan po gtsos pa'i chibs bsu pa mang po 'byor nas dgon par gdan 'dren gyi snyan gsan phul/ rma chu'i 'gram du zhag bzhugs thog dad 'dus kyi skya ser stong phrag brgal ba la phyag dbang gnang ste dal 'byor don che rnyed dka' tshul dkar nag gi las 'bras mi bslu bas blang dor byed dgos tshul dkon mchog gsum las skyabs gnas re sa gzhan med pas blo rtse gtad dgos tshul gyi gzab bshadagal cing de lo tsā ba la sog skad du basbyar bcug nas brda 'phrod nges mdzad/ gsung gdangs mthon pos thams cad kyis thos par rin chen gtsug tor can sogs kyi mtshan dang gzungs sngags zab mo sogs sgogs pa dkyusaltar la khyad par du ma ṇi'i bzlas lung gi skabs 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs bod sog gi lha skal yin pa'i rgyu mtshan/ de'i gzungs kyi phan yon mdo sde du ma dang bla ma gong ma rnams kyis gsungs tshul rtsal du bton pa'i bshas pa rgya cher gnang ste bla slob tshang mas yig drug brgya skor kha shas 'ur 'don dang yig drug sogs dge ba'i rtsa ba gzhan dang gzhan khas len du bcug nas mjug tu khyed rang rnams kyis dus gsum du bsags pa'i dge ba'irtsa ba spyi dang khyad par du de ring gi dus su ljags lung nyan cing ma ṇi bton pa dang slar 'don rgyu khas blangs pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs la sgrub pa'i mchod par phul nas tshe rabs thams cad du spyan ras gzigs kyis rjes su 'dzin pa'i ched du bsngo rgyu dang khyed tshos kyang mos pa de bzhin du byed dgos tshul gyi brda sprad de/ 'phags paspyan ras gzigs dbang thugs rje'i gter/ / zhes sogs 'don gsol dang paṇa chen chos rgyan gyis mdzad pa'i smon tshig dang ji srid thub mchog ma sogs bsngo smon gyi mtshams sbyor rgyas par mdzad/ sbyir mtshan dang gzungs 853

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/sngagasarna bar sgogs pa 'di snga mo nas phyag bzhes ltar chags yin kyang pheb res 'dir mjug tu bsngo smon rtsal 'don gnang ba ni dgongs gzhi khyad par can zhig yin par mngon/ hal ha'i ti yan chi blo bzang dpal ldan gyis zhus te nyan mkhan nyung 'dus la bla ma'i rnal 'byor don gnyis lhun 'grub ma'idamigs khrid sogs gnang / sbyin bdag pe li bsod nams rab rgyas dge 'dun thu sa lag chi dharma dha tu sogs dpon blon du ma chibs bsur 'byor nas mjal kha zhus dpon blon rnams kyis zhabs phyi zhus te rma chu dar lam la bud/ sman chu'i dgon pa kun dga' gling la ser spreng dang bcas babs 'dukhang nang du gdan drangs nas sbyin bdag pe li gtsos pa'i dpon blon sogs kyis dkar spro zhus shing brtan bzhugs kyi rten 'brel bsgrigs gzhi byes kyi khrom chen por phyag dbang chos 'brel dkyus ltar stsal/ gun gor pi la su me'i bla ma blo bzang bkra shis dang chos rje shes rab rgya mtsho ngo g.yog gis chibs bsu dang hal jas la dpal dar gling gi mkhan po tā bla ma mtshan nyid mkhanapo nā legro'i chos rje sogs rta pa brgya phrag gis chibs bsu zhus/ rka nyong ha thun e ji'i ho ro la gsol ston 'bul ba gzabs ha thun e jis gtsos pa'i drag zhan mang po phyag dbang chos 'brel gyis tshim par mdzad/nyi shu lnga la ma ṇi thu nas dgon pa spyi'i ja thab zhus dpal dar gling gi nye 'dabs su dge 'dun nyis stong nye ba'i ser sbreng dkyus ring gis mdun bsus te sngags pa grwa tshang du babs thog mar 'du khang du grwa tshang so so'i bla ma rnams dang pe li dpon blon che gras rnams kyis legs dar dang bcas phyag dbang dang gsol ston zhus/ de nas dge 'dun mang la phyag dbang dang dad 'dus kyi khrom chen por mjal kha dang bka' chos dkyus ma rnams gnang /ji nod wang gi mi sna dka' bcu 'od zer dang mi rin pa yan ta les dpon 854

sa / / zangartsamadzamanyis gsangagakhu patshadagadacan ngonagayog sleb nas gdan 'dren gyi snyan gsan zhus/ hrun gar a pas tho yon blon bzang sgrol ma ngo g.yog 'ongs par klu dbang rgyal po'i rjes gnang stsal tho yon gyis maṇ+ḍal kha btags sku gsung thugs rten dbang chas tshang ma tsha ru'i thul pa gos dang dngul rnga rta sogs kyi dngos 'bul brtan bzhugs lugs su phul/ dgon lung nas mang nyod pe li'i bla ma ser khri chos rje'i sku skye gdan drangs nas 'ongs pa la phyag dbang gnang zhing sku skye ha cang na phra ba dang dus tshodakyang dgun gyi sgang la thug nas cung zad 'o brgyal 'dug par nyi ma kha shas ngal bsos nas sdod dgos tshul gsungs te 'dug tu bcug lo mjug tu nyin gsum gyi ring ho sho'u thun mong gi rin gror rje nyid chog grogs dang bcas pas rta mgrin gsang sgrub kyi bdag mdun rgyas pa dang 'brel nas bzlog pa gtsor 'don gyi cho ga ngos dag bsgrubs/ nyer dgu la sku rim grub pa'i mjug tu ha thun e ji rnam gnyis dang pe li dpon po dpon blon che gras rnams kyis legs 'bul gya nom pa zhus de dag la yul lugs dang bstun pa'i sngags chus bkru ba dang khrus glud bsngo ba sogs rgyas par mdzad/ sngags pa grwa tshang du khro bcu'i gtor zlog phyag len rnam par dag pa zhig tshugs yod cing grwa tshang gi bla ma nā legro chos rje 'ang mgon po gur gyi gzhi'i bsnyen pa song mkhan zhig yin pas grwa tshang yongs rdzogs la rje nyid kyi zhabs brtan du khro bcu'i gtor zlog nyi ma gsum gyi ring sgrub tu bcug / hang gin yo lan ho sho'u'i brtson 'grus chos rje zer ba grib skyon gyis na bar grwa ba zhig 'ongs nas gsung brtag zhus pa la lha rten mchod rten lta bu zhig la thog 'jigs byung ba yemad gsung bar med ces zhus/ de 'dra'i rten la skyon byung ba bco skyor byas pa e yod gsung bar med ces zhus 'o na rkyen ci yin nged kyis mi shes pas gzhan la dris shig gsungs pas/ kho bag khum nas dbyar kha mtshan mo 855

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/zhig char chen bab nas mchod rten zhig la skyon byung ba bco skyor byas pa yin nam zhus par yin shas che gang ltar yang 'di dang 'di gyis zhes gnad dmigs can gyi rim gro 'ga' gnang ba bka' bzhin bsgrub pas kho'i srog gi mu mthud thub pa byung / khos dang por ji bzhin ma zhus pa'i dbang gis rjes su'ang rjen par zhu ma sgobs pa ma gtogs mchod rten der thog gi skyon byung nges yin par rgyus yod gzhan 'ga' zhig gleng / der ma zad lan cig mi tshang zhig gi lha gur du me mched nas rten gsum gzhan la skyon ma byung bar rgyal po sku lnga'i thang gi zhig yod pa mes tshig pa'i rgyu mtshan lo tsā ba la bshad lo tsā bas sku mdun du brel ba che dus shig la zhu rtsis kyis mi de'i ming bzung nas lha gur du rgyal po sku lnga'i thang ga zhig yod pa zhes pa'i mtshams su mes tshig songazer rgyu red rim gro 'di dang 'di gyis shig ces shod gsung nas zhu ma dgos par bka' lan gnang ste/ skabs skabs su 'di lta bu thugs nyams 'uranas mngon par shes pa'i gsung thol byung du pheb pa ches mang bar snang ngo / / dgung lo re lnga pa lcags mo bya'i lo gsar tshes la grwa tshang so so'i bla ma las sne che gras dang sbyin bdag pe li dpon blon che gras ha thun e ji rnam gnyis sogs btsun mo sras mo'i skor rnamasa'ongs nas lo gsar gye mjal kha zhus shing dga' ston rgya cher spel/ sbyin bdag thu sa lag chi dharma dha tu dang ca khir chi lha dbang rdo rje spun gnyis kyis lo gsar gyi thog ma'i mjal rten du rgyal ba tshe mtha' yas pa'i 'bum sku'i gser thang stong phrag gcig phul nas bstan 'gro'i dpal du zhabs pad srid mtha'i bar brtan par bzhugs par gsolab nan tan du btab par thugs shin tu dgyes te bla ma dkon mchog gsum gyi byin rlabs dang sbyin bdag rnams kyi dad mos rten 'brel bslu ba med pa'i mthu gcig tu tshogs pa la brten nas nged rang yang tshe ring por gyur 856

sa / /rjebatsun khazangartsamadzamanyis d+madaganacodabyung/pa dang sbyin bdag rnams kyang tshe bsod rgyas shing legs tshogs gong 'phel du yong pa gzhir bcas nged nas kyang de bzhin 'grub pa'i ched du dkon mchog la gsol 'debs bgyid ces gsungs/ tshes gnyis la yod nyod sku skye ngo g.yog mkhan po tā bla ma sogs la rta mgrin gsang sgrub kyi rjes gnang stsal/tshes gsum nas ha thun e ji dang pe li dpon po thu sa lag chi rnams kyis rang rang gi ho ro la gdan drangs pa bzhin phebs/ e ji sogs drag zhan sum cu skor la tshe rta zung 'brel gyi rjes gnang stsal par lha rdzas mdzod btags dngul maṇa che legs dbang chas cha tshang sogs dngos 'bul gya nom pa btegs lha gur du rten gsum la rab gnas rta thog ma mdzad/ de nas pe li'i ho ro la phebs te mjal ba mang por phyag dbang sogs stsal der bcag mal mdzad cing rta mgrin gsang sgrub dang 'brel bar dge mtshan spel ba'i cho ga dang 'go ba'i lha lnga'i gsol mchod gtong ba gnang / sbyin bdag pe lis brtan bzhugs kyi rten 'brel bsgrigs te mdzod btags dngul mkha che legs sku gsung thugs rten bzhugs gdan rgyab yol gos chen yug 'ga' dngul srang sum brgya tshom gur chen po gos chen tshos nyi ma'i yol ba gdan cha sogs cha tshang bcas phul te zhabs pad brtan dgos kyi gsol pa btab/ or du su ja sag dbang rgyal tshe brtan rdo rje'i gdan 'dren pa chos rje ngag dbang chos 'phel dang rab 'byams pa ngag dbang brtson 'grus ngo g.yog 'ongs nas snyanagasan phul/ tshes lnga la thu sa lag chi'i ho rol phebs skye pho mo'i khrom chen por phyag dbang chos 'brel gnang / hang gin tā pe zi'i gdan 'dren pa chos rje ngo g.yog 'byor nas snyan gsan phul thu sa lag chi dharmā dha tu dang ja khir chi lha dbang rdo rje spun gnyis kyi rim gror rje nyid chog grogs brgyad dang bcasapas lcang skya rol ba'i rdo rjes mdzad pa'i sgrol ma'i 'don thabs kyi sgo 857

/ /gung thang ba na pa'ithoname'i gsung 'bum/nas sgrol ma'i snying po brgya re dang dmigs bsal gyi 'dod gsol tshar re spel macos te nyin bdun gyi ring snying po 'bum ther dang phyag 'tshal nyer gcig 'gro gang che ngos dag sgrub par mdzad/ 'di dus sbyin bdag dpon blon rnamasadang khyad par du thu sa lag chi spun gnyis la gzhan gyis bsnyad gtser byas pa'i skabs yin pas sgrol ma la dmigs bsal gyi 'dod gsol gsar du bsgrigs te ched dmigs kyi thugs dam spyan dmigs gnang bar nyid rang gi mnal lam du gzhan zhig gis sgrol ma'i sku brnyan re bab pa'i kha btags bag cha zhig phul ba sbyin bdag spun gnyis kyi dad rten du gnang ba dang / yang 'brug dang sbrul gnyis 'thab nas mjug tu sbrul pham pa'i thugs rmis gnyis mu mthud byung ba dang / chog grogs shig gi rmi lam du bsnyad gtser byed mkhan de rnams ho ro 'di gar 'ongs nas rje nyid la lha dar bcas mjal kha zhus shing dga' zhing gus pa'i rnam pa byas pa sogs rmis pa la/ rje nyid nas sgrol ma'i sku brnyan dad rten du byin pa lhag pa'i lha'i skyabs 'og tu chud pa dang sbrul phrag dog gi mtshon don yin pas lhag pa'i lha'i byin rlabs kyis pha rol po'i gdug sems zhi ba dang / de dag gis nga la dga' zhing gus pas mjal ba de nged kyis 'di tsho'i bar gzu byas na don dag 'grub rgyu'i ltas yin namagang ltar yang rmi lam 'di dag sku rim gnad dmigs su song ba'i ltas bzang po zhig yin pa 'dra gsung ba mi ring bar de bzhin thog tu khel/ ca khir chi lha dbang rdo rje'i khyim du gsar bzhengs sgol ma'i gser sku sogs rten gsum la rab gnas mdor bsdus mdzad/ thu sa lag chi dharma dha tu'i khyim du 'go ba'i lha lnga'i gsol mchod dang dge mtshan spel ba'i cho ga gsung / thu sa lag chi spun gnyis kyis kha btags dngul man che legs sku gsung thugs rten gos chen gyi bzhugs gdan rgyab yol gzim gur yol ba gdan cha bcas cha 858

༄/ /rjebatsug bzangacho spyonyima'igasangagasu0patshadakhasadabyunganatshang gser dngul gos dar sogs dngos 'bul gya nom pa brtag bzhugs lugs su phul/ a ke dzña na sirnyi spun gnyis kyis gdan drangs nas gsol ston 'bul ba zhus/ skya ser gyi khrom chen po'i phyag dbang chos 'brel yang gnang / tshes bcu gnyis la phyir dgon par pheb lam du sbyin bdag pe li'i ma yar gyi dur thog tu gdan drangs par gzungs sngags dang gang ser ma sogs gsung nas phyag nas 'thor/ hang gin pe zi'i mi sna chos rje tshul khrims dang mi rin phun tshogs bkra shis sogs nam 'byon rgyu'i yang nyan du 'byor par bka' lan gnang / ta lad pe zi'i mi sna chos rje ngo g.yog sleb nas zhu shog gos chen gnyis dngul srang lnga bcu bcas phul bar brtag lan gnang / dpal dar gling gi tshogs chen dang grwa tshang so sor mang 'gyed bco lnga'i mchod pa la zhal 'deb bcas gnang / bco lnga'i zhog ka pe li'i zhabs brtan la tsan dan jo bo'i lha khang du rje nyid kyis grwa tshang so so'i bla ma dge bshes sum cu skor la theg chen gso spyong gnang zhing rnam rgyal stong mchod mdzad stong mchod grol nas smon lam gyi tshogs dbur phebs te ljags bsngo rgyas par gnang / de'i mu mthud nas skye pho mo khri phrag gsum lhag la phyag dbang gnang zhor du gzugs sngags zab mo rnams rna lam du sgogs par mdzad/ 'di nyin tshogs pa ha cang che bas gung ma yol tsam nas phyag dbang gnang ba yin kyang tshar dus mun rub 'dug / de dag gi nang nas kyang bka' bsgo skyabs 'jug rten la rab gnas g.yang rdzas sman dang bdug pa rten mdud sogs la byin rlabs sogs 'dod don zhu mkhan mang du byung bar yang sku tshag la ma gzigs par so so'i re ba tshim par mdzad/ mtshan mo lha khang ra skor du phebs te dge 'dun mang dang lhan du khrus gsol dang mchod gar dang mchod phreng la gzigs rtog mdzad cing mjug tu me'i rtsed mo sna 859

༄/ /gung ba ngastan pa'isgonami'igasung 'bum/tshogs bstar bas/ tshogs pa thams cad kyis yul phyogs 'dir sngar paṇa chen rin po che pheb dus ma gtogs 'di 'dra'i tshogs pa mang po 'dus ma myong zhing khyad par du 'di lta bu'i rdzogs ldan gyi dga' ba la longs spyod rgyu de ring min pa byung ma myong zhes gleng / spyi nas gsol ba btab pa bzhin tshogs chen 'du khang du mkhan po tā bla mas gtsos pa'i grwa tshang so so'i bla ma dge 'dun tshang ma dang sbyin bdag pe li dpon blon che gras rnams dang hang gan chos rje blo bzang rdo rje u shing chos rje ngag dbang rin chen sogs gzhi byes kyi ser skya sum stong nye ba la lam gtso'i khrid nyin bdun gyi ring rgyas par stsal/ mjug tu dpon slob tshang mas bzang spyod dang bstan 'bar ma gsung nas dge ba rdzogs byang du bsngo bar mdzad/ 'di dus khrid kyi sngon du rgyal ba tsong kha ba'i thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i rnam thar dang lta sgom spyod gsum gyi khyad chos rnams rtsal du bton nas gsar rtsom grub mtha'i nang du bkod pa ltar zhib cing rgyas pa dang khrid dngos gzhi'i rim pa'ang lung rigs du mas brgyan te nyams len gyi rim par dril nas go ba ster phul che zhing yid 'khul ba'i gzab bshad gnang bas thams cad kyis rje bla ma'i bka' srol 'di nyid la rgyu mtshan mthong ste 'gyur ba med pa'i dad gus dang spro ba 'gran bzhin 'phel/chos bar gyi mtshan mo zhig mnal lam du rje nyid bla chen 'ga' zhig dang bcas lhan du bzhugs pa la 7gong mas gnang ba'i 'gyed yin nam snyam pa'i rje'i sku bab pa'i gos btags kyi 'gyed byung bar gzhan gyi phyag tu byung ba rnams dkar mnyam yin pa la/ nyid kyi phyag tu ser thig can lta bu zhig byung bar dri ma can zhig yin nam dgongs nas gzigs pas gzhi dkar po la rje'i sku ser pos btags pa'i kha btags dri ma med pa zhig yin 'dug par thugs la dga'ab chen po 'khrungs pa zhig byung 'dug pa ni spyir rnam par dkar ba'i 860

ga / /rje btsun tsha bas mucha gtag g.yona'aphrinalas gdul bya'i rgyud la 'jug pa tsam du ma zad yab rje rgyal ba gnyis pa'i bstan pa'i snying po mthar thug pa gsal bar byas shing byed 'gyur gyi mtshan ma khyad par du 'phags pa zhig yin par mngon/ der ma zad bka' chos grol nyin dka' bcu blo bzang bkra shis 'ongs nas rje rin po che'i gser sku dang dpe cha po ti 'ga' zhig byang chub mchod rten bcas phul te ming bkra sogs gang thad nas rten 'brel rang 'grig tu byung / dka' bcus lam gtso'ikhrid ma non pa la blo 'aspyod che bar sbyor pa'i chos drug gi khrid mdor bsdus dang skyabs 'jug sogs yid tshim par stsal/ ho sho'u thun mong gi don du gsung brtag zhus par gnad dmigs can gyi rim gro mang po zhig phab pa'i nang nas rta mgrin gtor zlog dang rgyal mdos ho sho'u spyi 'dus kyis yig drug dung phyur tshang pa'i ma ṇi sgrub rgyu 'di gsum rje nyid nas gnang dgos kyi gsol ba nan tan btab par/ phyag g.yog rnams kyis rje nyid nas sku rim gzhan sgrub chog na'ang rgyal mdos 'phen pa gnang stabs mi 'grigs zhes shag brgyab nas 'then khyer byas pa la/ zhal nas bsam pas ma zin na chos bshad dang cho ga rim gro gang dang gang byas kyang sa chod chen po med la/bsam pas zin na rgyal mdos la'ang sbyin pa rnam gsum tshang tshul yod de/mi ma yin gye mgron rnams dngos dang yid kyis sprul pa'i dkor chas tshim par byed pa zang zing gi sbyin pa dang chos bshad kyis rgyud smin par byed pa chos kyi sbyin pa dang de la brten nas sbyin bdag rnams nyer 'tshe las grol pa skyabs kyi sbyin pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ / des na sbyin bdag rnams kyi bsam pa rdzogs ched du ma zad sde pa mang po la phan thogs pa'i rim gro gnad dmigs can yin pas da res rgyal mdos shig 'phen pa la 'gal ba rang med pa 'dra gsung nas rgyal mdos kyang gnang rgyur thag bcad/ de nas nyin bdun gye ring rje nyid 861

༄/ /gung ngabastan pa'i name'i r+sāng 'tsho/rdo rje slob dpon mdzad de dpon g.yog bcu skod gyis rta mgrin gsang sgrub kyi gtor zlog nyid kyis mdzad pa'i rdo rje'i 'phrul spyog ltar tshugs pa dang mnyam du rgyal mdos kyang sbyin bdag stobs 'byor can rnams kyi 'byor pa la dpag pa'i gzab rgyas bshams te gnyis ka sbrags mar bsgrub nas nyer dgu'i nyin rgyal mdos phyir skyel dusarje nyid nas brab cing bskrad pa dang yi dam chos skyong gi zor rim gyis 'phen pa gnang par phyag g.yog pa rnams sku drung du bcar mi thub pa'i tshod kyis zil chen po byung zhing / mthun pa'i rlung 'tshub kyis me lce'ang rgyal mdos skyel phyogs su dum bur chad cing 'khyil pa sogs zor bkra shin tu legs pa byung / rgyal mdos skyel ba'i snga nub mnal lam du rgya dpon 'khor g.yog mang po can zhig sku mdun du 'ongs pa sngar rgyus med na'ang nyid nasakhya dga' mang po ster yod pa lta bu dga' zhing gus pa'i rnam pas nged cag 'gro rgyur chas nas nyid la thon phyag zhu bar 'ongs pa yin zer ba la/nyidanas dpon nyid de ring gang la sleb ces dris par nged dpon g.yog de ring yu'u ling mkhar du gleb rgyu yin zer ba zhig rmis/ phyi nyin yul mi rnams la yu'i ling mkhar zer ba yod med rtsar bcad pas rgyal mdos skyel phyogs nyi ma kha shas kyi lam du yod pa zhig yin zer bar da res kyi rim gro 'di nges par gnad dmigs su song yod pa 'dra gsungs nas thugs shin tu dgyes/bar skabs kyi mtshan mo zhig tu pe li dpon po dang thu sa lag chi dharma dha tu ca khir chi lha dbang rdo rje gsum sku mdun du sdod bcug nas lus sbyin gtong ba gnang / zla ba gnyis pa'i tshes gcig la sbyin bdag pe lis rje nyid kyi zhabs brtan la dmigs na rnam rgyal lha dgu rigs bdag 'od dpag med chos skyong chos rgyal bcas lha bcu gcig gi gos sku khru nyi shu rtsa lnga zhig bzhengs rgyu'i gra sgrig byas te ras dkar po la skya ris yongs rdzogs 'then cing chos skyong gi sku 862

༄/ /༄tsotshosangacho migyi gartegatsosas khabags/brnyan bzos tshar yod pa rnams bshams par gzigs rtog mdzad cing gang thad nas sprus gtsang 'ong yod par bsngags brjod chen po gnang nas dgyes tshor mdzad/ sman pa mkhan po sogs la 'jam dbyangs dkar po'i rjes gnang stsal/ nā legro chos rje bla ma dbu mdzad bying 'dren sogs bod du 'gro mkhan mang po zhig la bka' bsgo srung mdud sogs yid tshim par stsal/ nā legro chos rje la sa skya khri pa dbang sdud snying po dang zhwa lu dgon 'dus spyi la 'bul rgyu'i yi ge rten chas dang bcas sprod pa gnang / mkhan po cha gan bla mdang lha dbang car gu chi so so nas kyang 'bul nod dang 'dod don zhus pa'i re ba bskangs/ mkhan po tā bla ma mtshan nyid mkhan po sman pa mkhan po nā legro chos rje rnams dang sa dge'i chos kyi gsung bgros rgyun ldan 'phel/skabs shig sngags gra'i ra skor du khams seng gnang zhor la mkhan po tā bla ma dang sman pa mkhan po gnyis la 'dul ba'i skor gyi dogs slong 'ga' zhig dris nas khas len shor tshab che bar sman pa mkhan po rab 'byamayopa blo bzang yon tanasdod bcug ste nyid dngos kyis bgro gleng btang nas blo ldan rnams la blo skyed kyi skyes dang skyo sangs pa'i dga' ba phun sum tshogs pa chabs cig tu stsol bar mdzad do/ / hang gin tā pe zi'i gdan 'dren pa zhabs drung bla ma ca khir chi dpal rdo rje sogs 'ul mi'u lā dang bcas 'byor te tshes gnyis la bla dponadrag zhan du ma'i rta thab dang bcas dpal dar gling nas thon mi rin dkon mchog gi khyim du tho yon chos rje don grub sogs 'byor nas gdan 'drenagyi snyan gsan phul/ tsha gan chir ga'i ru sde rnams kyis lam nas ja thab zhus shing yul phyogs der lo kha shas kyi ring la na tsha shi chad sogs mi shes pa'i mtshan ma mang po byung bar che chung thams cad kyis skyabs btsal bas skye pho mo lnga brgya skor la phyag dbang dang chos 'brel gnang ba'i mjug tu rta mgrin gyi 863

༄/ /gung bang bstan pa'i sgroname'i r+yāng 'bum/bka' bsgo rgyas pa dang phyag rdor lospri pa la'i sngags kyis bcun zhing zil chen pos bgegs bskrad mdzad de gzhi la gtor rgyu'i phyag nas kyang bka' drin stsal/ de nas tho yon chos rje'i lha khang du ser sbreng dang bcas babs mjal ba sum stong tsam la phyag dbang bka' chos stsal/ tshes gsum gyi zhog ka 'du khang du tho yon chos rje ye shes don 'grub gtsos pa'i grwa mang gis gsol ston 'bul ba zhus shing de dag la dga' ldan lha brgya ma'i bshad lung lha rten du shis brjod mdzad/ phebs lam du pe zi'i sras ho shu'u chi bkra shis rgya mtsho thu sa lag chi 'jam dbyangs bkra shis sogs rta pa du ma dang pa yan thol gos la sbyin bdag tā pe zi bkra shis dar rgyas blon 'khor lha khang gi tā bla ma sogs drag zhan brgya phrag du mas chibs bsu dang thab su zhus/ rim gyis dge 'dun gyi ser sbreng dang bcas pe zi'i yā mon du babs gsol ja dkar spro'i thoga.a bas e ji dad dpon po yum sras rnams kyis phyag dbang zhus/ de nas skya ser gyi khrom chen por phyag dbang gi mjug tu gsung bshad dang bcas dmigs brtse ma mtshan dang gzungs sngags du ma khyad par du ma ṇi'i phan yon rtsal 'don sogs kyi sgo nas rang rang la dge ba'i dam bca' khas len bskul te bsngo pa'i mtshams sbyor kyang nan tan du mdzad/ o thog gi chibs skyel pa thu sa lag chi dharma dha tu ngo g.yog phyir log nyin kha shas kyi ring phyogs 'dus kyi mjalab zam ma chad par phyag dbang chos 'brel chag med dang seng bar du chos rje blo bzang rdo rje dang chos rje tshul khrims gnyis la nyid kyi gsung bka' rgya ma'i lung gnang / thu sa lag chi 'jam dbyangs bkra shis kyis khyim du gdan drangs nas gsol ston 'bul ba zhus par seng ldeng nags sgrol gyi rjes gnang stsal/ du gu'i su me'i mdzo mo mkhar zhabs drung zhing brjes pa'i bsngo rten phul bar bsngo smon dang sprul sku'i don la brtag lan gnang / sbyin 864

༄/ /jebatsun khazangartsamadzamanyisa'i d+madakaracod kha/bdag tā pe zis ser skya thun mong la lam rim gyi khrid dang sems bskyed mchod pa bcu gcig zhal gyi dbang chen dang rjes gnang sogs kyi snyan gsan phul bar zhal bzhes gnang ste tshes brgyad nas bkra shis bsam gtan gling gi 'du khang du sbyin bdag tā pe zi bkra shis dar rgyas yum sras dpon blon che gras skor dang / bsam gtan gling gi tā bla ma tho yon mkhan po blo bzang bkra shis sogs dge 'dun tshang ma dang bkra shis chos gling gi mkhan po 'jam dpal rgya mtsho kun skyabs gling gi zhabs drung chos rje shes rab 'phel pa'i gling gi zhabs drung tā bla ma/ shing na gar su me'i sku skye dzā rag gi mkhan po blo bzang nyi ma dpal dar gling gi grwa ba 'ga' zhig sogs gzhi byes kyi skya ser drag zhan stong phrag gnyis tsam la bde lam gyi khrid dbu btsugs te rim gyes nyin bcu gsum gyi ring snga dro bla grwa lnga bcu skor la bklags lung dang phyi dro lam rimachos thun re spel mar gnang nas nyi shu'i nyin nyid kyis mdzad pa'i rol pa'i rdo rje'i rnam thar sogs gsar rtsom skor phal che ba'i lung lam rim gyi khrid bcasagrub/ nyer gcig gi nyin lha khang 'du khang so sor mchod pa rnam lnga dpag tu med pa bshams te sngar gyi chos nyan pa'i steng du gsar du mang po bsnan yod pa bcas skya ser sum stong brgal bar sems bskyed mchod pa rgyas parasnal/ bka' chos kyi dbu btsugs pa'i rjes su hal ha'i mgon po pe li'i tsha bo tho yon blo bzang bkra shis dur bed wang gi mi sna thu sa lag chi yar 'phelardo rje hal ha'i nom chi no yon hu thog thu dpon g.yog rnams rim par slebs par de dag la khrid cha tshang thob pa'i ched du mgo nas sa bcad ma stong pa'ibashad pa mdor bsdus re dang chos nyan du bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen mang po 'dus pas lung rigs kyi spros pa'am cung zad rgyas shing dben sa snyan brgyudakyi man ngag mang pos brgyan te dbang po rab 'bring tha gsum so so'i 865

༄/ /gung bang ba ba'ithoname'ir+yāng babum/nyams len dang sbyar nas gzab bshad gnang / mtshams mtshams su mtha' 'khob kyi yul du bslab pa gces spras dang nyams len bslab sbyang la brtson mkhan rnams la gzengs bstod dang / de'i ldog phyogs pa rnams la phan pa'i gtar sreg lta bu'i gnad phig cing mtshang 'bru ba'i bshad pa rtsal 'don dang chos ngo mi shes pa'i skye pho mo mang po la phyag skor dang dkon mchog mchod pa dge 'dun bsnyen bkur ba sgyung gnas dang bsnyen gnas bsrung ba'i phan yon/ chos rje blo bzang zhi bas zhus pa'i snying po don gsum gyi khrid kyang mi mang la phan pa'i ched du skyes bu chen po'i chos skor gyi mgor tshogs su gnang ste spyan ras gzigs bod sog gi lha skal yin pa'i rgyu mtshan gzungs ring dang yig drug gi phan yon sogs 'bur dod kyi bshad pa dang de las 'phros te lhag pa'i lha gzhan gyi mtshan dang gzungs sngags rnams yid la dran pa dang rna bas thos pa'i phan yon gyi bshad pa rgya cher gnang nas/ nged rang gis khyed cag thag nye ring gi mjal pa 'ongs tshad la mjal kha ster pa'i rjes su de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan dang gzungs sngags zab mo mang po ci nas kyang rna lam du bsgrags pa'ang phan yon 'di la bsam pa yin/ nged kyi lag pa khyed tsho'i mgo la bzhag pa sdug bden gyi phung po ril ril gyi steng du sdug bden gyi phung po leb leb cig bzhag pa yin pas de la phan yon yod rgyu gang yang med phan thogs pa chos yin pas nga'ang rjes sor 'ongs nas khyed cag la yang yang chos bshad rgyu dka' da res lan cig 'ongs nas chos bshad pa'i dus 'dir nged ringagis kyang khyed cag blo rab 'bring tha gsum so so'i rgyud tshod dang 'tsham pa'i chos ga 'dra zhig bshad na go bde zhing phan thogs che ba 'byung ngam snyam nas mi lo lon gyis bsam blo yang yang btang nas gnad dmigs can gyi bshad pa mang po byas pa 'di chud zos su ma btang bar rang rang gis 'khos 866

/ /rjebatsotshosazapa tsamagyi g.yogatsa'ibadababasgosakatshod nus tshod kyis lag len la thebs pa mdzod ces sogs phral phugs su phan pa'i bslab ston rgyas par gnang / / lam khrid dang sems bskyed mchod pa'i skabs sagasung bshad rnams sog skad du bsgyur bcug ste thams cad la brda 'phrodange4gnang bas skad rigs mi shes pa'i skye pho mo yan chad kyi rgyud la thar pa'i sa bon thebs nges pa'i dge rtsa bla na med pa bsgrun par mdzad do/ / der ma zad 'di skabs hal ha ye rte ni chos rjes zhu yig phul ba'i lan gyi chab shog tu'ang / bod yul dzing bur bag yangs 'khod pa las/ /gzhan gyi nan tan lcags kyus nya bzhin du/ / drangs te sa mtha'i bye thang skya bo na/ / 'dod yon lan tshwa'i chu la dga' bas rtsen/ / de tshe yul phyogs kun nas kho bo la/ / bong ba gser du mthong ba'i dag snang gis/ / mjal phyag kho na'i ched du dka' spyad kyis/ / lhags pa'i mchog dman skye bo bgrang las 'das/ / mgo bor lag pa bzhag la phyag dbang zhes/ / grags kyang sdug bden gcig steng gcig brtsegs par/ / byin rlabs re ba chags ldan lus phra ma/ / ma ning dag las 'dod bde re dang mtshungs/ / de phyir dad pas 'dus pa de dag gi / rna ba'i yol go sangs rgyas byang sems kyi/ /mtshan dang gzugs sngags zab mo'i bdud rtsi yis/ / 'gengs par byed pa'i cho ga nyin bzhin bsgrubs/ / zhes dang / nor rdzas ri bo'i gtos tsam 'byor pa yis/ / tshe mthar gtugs pa bdag la ci zhig phan/ / chos sbyin rgya cher spel 'di rang gi yang / / phyi ma'i lam rgyags rung snyam dga' ba 'phel/ / zhes gsungs te gzhan phan kho nar gzhol ba'i rnam thar bla na ma mchis par mngon la/ chab shog 'di nyid kyi ming la'ang khu byug mon yul snyogs pa'i lam glu zhes gsungs shing 'di nas sems nyid sbrul skur springs pa'i chab shog la rgyun phyogs gzhol ba'i nyal 'gro'i rang sgra zhes btags te 867

༄/ /gung thangabastan pa'i name'igasung ཿma/'di gnyis chab shog gi rjes ma lta bur snang bas ming 'dogs tshul de'ang 'phral gyi snang tshod la rang dgon du phyir myur bar 'byor rgyu'i rnam pa yin kyang dgongasagazhi ni dag pa'i zhing du dgongs pa gtad pa'i gsung yin pa bab kyis shes par snang ngo / / 'phrin las rlabs kyi 'khri shing rol ba'i gar/ /nam mkha'i mtha' la bsnyegs pa'i gaṅgā ma/ / rang gnas sgrib bral dbyings kyi rgya mtsho ru/ / gzhol ba'i rang sgra skyo ba'i gdangs su 'tsher/ / phyi ltar mdo smad skyid pa'i sman ljongs dang / / nang ltar mi pham chos rje'i mdun sa che/ / gsang ba mkha' spyod dpa' bo'i grong khyer du/ / 'byon par rings pa'i lam glu dal gyis blangs/ / phun tshogs dbyar gyi lang tsho yol ba na/ /dman pa'i khu byug zhi ba'i rong bsnyegs kyang / / dpa' bo lha bya kong mo lta bu rnams/ / dgun dus lhag par rdza la mi gnas sam/ / mthong ba don ldan zhal bzang bdud rtsi'i 'od/ / gang la gzigs pa'i cha tsam lhung bas kyang / / thar pa'i sa bon bskrun pa'i dga' ston ni/ / yul mtha'i 'gro la lhag ma'i mgron du bkye/ / nam mjug 'chad kha'i sprang bu nyam chung rnams/ / dgung kha'i nyi 'od lhongs shig gsal dus 'dir/ / dge ba'i gshog stabs cung zad sgyur cig dang / / da ni ji ltar 'gyur ba cha ma mchis/ /chos nyan pa snga ma bzhin la spyan ras gzigs bcu gcig zhal gye dbang chen sta gon bcas dang 'jam dbyangs dmar ser gye rjes gnang rgyal dbang bdun pas mdzad pa'i sprung gnas cho ga nyid kyi gsung bla ma'i rnal 'byor gru 'dzin nye lam lam rim smon lam sogs kyi ljags lung stsal/mjug tu tā be+e zi bkra shis dar rgyas kyis gtsos pa'i ho sho'u thun mong nas brtan bzhugs kyi rten 'brel bsgrigs te lha rdzas mdzod btags dngul maṇa che legs dar tshon sna lnga'i sne 'dogs can sku gsung thugs rten dngul gyi bkra 868

da / / /sko 'a /sa dam/ pabab ga/shis rtags brgyad dang rgyal srid sna bdun spyi blug bzeng zhal gos chen gyi bzhugs gdan rgyab yol gos chen yug brgyad o ru su'i gos khra bo yug gnyis phang zi yug gnyis dngul srang stong phrag gnyis rnga mong lnga rta nyi shu bcas dngos 'bul rgya chen po bstar te be+e zi'i sras ho sho'u chi bkra shis rgya mtshos zhu 'bul byas nas zhabs pad brtan pa'i gsol ba nan tan du btab par dgyes pa'i bka' lan bzang po gnang / bkra shis chos gling gi mkhan po sogs kyis zhus pa'i bklags lung gi skor dang sbyin bdag dpon po yab sras dang hal ha'i no yon hu thog thu so sos zhus pa'i rjes gnang gi skor rnams phyogs gcig tu byas te bla grwa che gras lnga bcu skor la byams chos sde lnga dbu ma rigs tshogs drug mdo sdud pa dbu ma 'jug pa smon lam bdun cu pa sogs chos tshan thor bu du ma'i ljags lung / de dag gi steng du be+e zi yab sras sogs dpon blon che gras mang po bsnan pa la chags lugs gtsug tor 'bar ba phyag rdor gtum pokhyung lnga rta mgrin gsang sgrub seng ldeng nags sgol rnam rgyal lha dgu 'jam dbyangs dkar po dzam bha la dkar po'i rjes gnang rnams rim gyis gnang ste nyer bdun gyi nyin chos mtshams mdzad/ bka' chos kyi seng bar gang yod du bla ma dge bshes rnams la mdo sngags rig gnas sngon gyi byung ba sogs ci rig pa las brtsams pa'i bka' mchid mang du stsal cing rang rang gi blo dang 'tsham par blo skyed sna tshogs pa stsal te dga' spro'i dpal la bkod/ nyin bzhin dad 'dus kyi mjal ba mang nyung ci rigs la phyag dbang chos 'brel sogs dkyus bzhin stsal/ dgon lung bla spyi nas mtshams zhur mngags pa'i chi kyu rab 'byams pa dang ba ye rab 'byams pa ngo g.yog 'byor par 'du khang gsar gso'i skor gyi zhal bkod dang gnang sbyin khal rta sogs kyi mthun rkyen gang drag gnang / dur ped wang gi zhu shog nang du gdan 'dren nan che zhing 869

༄/ /gung ba mi na ba'izla ma' ཿnga 'bum/el chi thu sa lag chi dang nang so gnyis kyis kyang u tshugs byas par ho sho'u de gar song na de dang 'dab chags pa'i ho sho'u mang po'ang nged kyi sbyin bdag yin pas de dag gis gdan 'dren dgos pa shar tshe ma song na sbyin bdag gi bsam pa mi rdzogs shing song na lo re gnyis 'gor gzhi che bas de rag la gang gi gdan 'dren pa yong rgyu cha mi chod/ gang ltar yang brtag pa byas nas bab lalta dgos pa 'dug gsung nas thugs dam brtag pa gnang ste phyi nyin zhal nas el chi nang so dang nged rang gnyis kyis ho sho'u de gar 'gro rgyu'i skor la lha mo'i sho 'phang bar bcu gnyis pa babs el chi dang nged rang gnyis kyis mo nges par tsub pa 'dug ces gleng ba zhig mis pas da res song mi chog pa 'dug gsungs shing sbyin bdag wang gi yig lan du slar phag lor 'byon rgyu'i zhal len dang dad rten du sku gzan rnying pa bcas bskur ba gnang / el chi gnyis la rta mgrin gsang sgrub kyi rjes gnang sogs 'dod don gang zhus kyi re ba bskangs/ ji nong wang gi mi sna mai rin pa yan ta les nam 'byon rgyu'i ang nyan du 'ongs par bka' lan stsal/ 'di dus nub gcig mnal lam du rgyus med kyi bla ma zhig grwa ba 'ga' dang bcas 'ongs nas bla ma des grod pa rlung gis sbos pa zhig nyid kyi mdun du phang par nyid kyis rdog bas bsnun te bkad pa zhig rmis tshul slob ma 'ga' zhig la gsungs pas de dag gis rje nyid nasayul phyogs 'dir dam pa'i chos kyi dga' ston rgya chen po stsal bar skal ldan gyi slob ma sa'i dreg pa bzhin mtha' yas pa 'dus par 'di ga'i bla chen phrag dog can zhig gis nyin mtshan med par lcam sring la drag bskul gtong khul byed kyin yod 'dug cing / der ma zad skyabs mgon nyid nas chos bzhin spyod pa rnams la gzengs bstod dang chos min spyod pa rnams la smad pa mang po gnang ba'i rkyen gyis mchu dmar na 'di snang chos brgyad nyams len gyi 870

༄/ /chubatsunazlasazang gsangabs pacadakarasadabyungakagatso bor byed mkhan gyi bla gsob cig yod pa des thos nas sems la phog 'dug zer ba dang / kho'ang snga ma nas ma dga' tshad la dam can rbad nas dgra la mi sha lon pa la mkhayopa zhig yin 'dug pas bsam sbyor ngan pa de 'dra'i rigs yod tshe de rigayobazlog thabs su dmigs gsal gyi thugs dam re gnang dgos sam zhes zhus pa la/ zhal nas lcam sring dang dam can chos skyong ba'i srung ma yin pas phrag dog gis kun nas bslang pa'i bon chog mkhan gyi grogs byas te snying rjes kun nas bslang ba'i chos bshad mkhan la gnod pa skyel ba dpe la mi srid/ spyir lcam sring dang dam can la mchog dman su zhig gisagator ma phul nas 'azin bcol byas na las phran tshegs re sgrub pa yod mod kyang las de lcam sring dang dam can gyis bsgrub pa'i nges pa med de dag gi zhal blta ba tsam yang mi thub pa'i 'khor gtogs kyi gtor ma re mkhan mi ma yin 'dre yan chad mang po yod pas de tsho'i nang nas gcig gis gtor ma bdag byas nas las phran tshegs re sgrub pa'i mtha' mi khegs/ de 'dra'i rigs ni dgra 'dul gnyen skyong la rno shugs che khul byas kyang phugs su de las phung tshab che ba med pas bla ma rnam gnyis kyis lcam sring dang dam can bran du bkol ba'i bzang ngan sang gnang 'jig rten pha rol la pheb dus gzhi nas lta rgyu yin zhes rus pa can gyi gsung byon cing thugs snang ci yang med par bzhugs/ yang nub gcig mnal lam du rtsi shing me tog rgyas shing mtsho dang ne'u gsing yod pa 'di 'dra'i skyid pa'ang snyam pa'i sa cha zhig tu pheb kyin yod par grogs shig la 'di sa cha gang yin zhes dris pas grogs kyis bde ba can yin mod ces zhus/ thugs dgongs labade ba can gyi sa gzhi lag mthil ltar khod snyoms pa zhes yod pa la 'di ni sa gzhi 'bar 'bur zhig yin pas ga 'dra yin zhes dgongs shing yang de ma thag tu dag zhing yang snang ba dag ma 871

/ /gung ca bstan pa'ithoname'i gsung 'bum/dag gi dbang gis sna tshogs 'char ba zhig yin pas nged rang snang ba ma dag pa'i dbang gis 'bar 'bur du mthong ba ma gtogs 'di ni bde ba can yin rgyu red ces dgongs nas grogs la 'od dpag med kyi bzhugs gnas gang tshod na yod ces dris par/ khos 'di'i gcig na yod mod kyang da dung cung zad sleb ran med ces zhus pa'i mu la mnal sad byung pa'i gnas tshul yang gsung 'dug pa ni mi ring bar dag pa'i zhing khams de dag tu 'byon pa'i brda ston pa yin par gor ma chag go de ga'i dgon pa bkra shis bsam gtan gling kun skyabs gling gnyis la mang 'gyed stsal cing bkra shis dpal dar gling du'ang mang ja'i thebs bskur nas zhabs brtan 'ga' zhig bsgrubs/ nyer brgyad la ca bar chi dpal rdo rjes gdan drangs par lam zhor du thu sa lag chi byang chub rdo rje'i khyim du gsol ston 'bul ba zhus par gza' mi rnams la skyabs 'gro ltung bshags dga' ldan lha brgya ma nyid kyi zhabs brtan gsol 'debs sgrol ma dkar lngang gi bstod pa sher snying bzang spyod sogs kyi ljags lung stsal/ ci khir chi'i ho ro la nyin gsum bzhugs rim gror rta mgrin gtor zlog dang dge mtshan spel ba'i cho ga rten gsum la khrus gsol dang rab gnas mdor bsdus gza' mi rnams kyis gtsos pa'i drag zhan mang por sgrol dkar gye rjes gnang stsal/ ca khir chis maṇ+ḍal kha btags sku gsung thugs rten sogs dngos 'bul spam mtho ba phul/ o rad g.yas ru'i mer gen bla ma'i sku skye gu thi tā bla ma'i sku skye sogs dang bkra shis chos gling gi mkhan po 'jam dpal rgya mtsho kun skyabs gling gi zhabs drung thub bstan gsal byed sogs la rta mgrin gsang sgrub kyi rjes gnang bla ma'i rnam 'byor rigs gsum spyi sgrub kyi khrid mdo sdud pa'i lung blo sbyong mtshon cha 'khor lo zhen 'khris kun gcod blo sbyong tshig brgyad ma 'jam dpal mtshan brjod sogs kyi lngags lung 872

༄/ /chubatsolosazangacho mirnamagangagatsolatshadabazags/rnams gnang / gsum ba'i tshes gnyis la phyir 'khor lam du ca khir chi'i ho ro spo rgyu'i gnas gzigs mdzad/ zhal nas gnas 'di khyed rang gi 'dod padang bstun pa yin gyi khyod kyi khyim gyi shar lho'i mtshams su 'di las cung bzang ba'i gnas shig yod tshod 'dug pas slar rnyed tshe gang 'thad kyis gsungs/ de bzhin du thu sa lag chi dharma dha tu spun gnyis kyi ho ro sgo rgyu'i gnas 'ga' zhig gis khyer 'ongs nas gzigs 'bul zhus par bzang ngan gyi bye brag phyes nas lung bstan gnang ba sogs rje 'di pas bod sog gi yul du khang khyim sogs kyi gnas gzigs mdzad pa la bkra shis kyi dge mtshan mthong thos su byung ba mang zhing / gnas kyang dngos su gzigs dgos pa'i nges pa med de smad phyogs kyi gnas 'ga' zhig gi ming dang sa rdo sogs bskur byung ba la brtags nas bzang ngan gyi lung bstan pa la thog tu 'khel ba gcig kyang su la'ang smra rgyu med do/ / skabs 'ga' zhig tu gnas kyi ming smos pa tsam gyis dbyibs 'di dang 'di 'dra zhig ye red ces thol byung du bka' 'dri gnangab zhig yin cing hal ha'i erte ni chos rjes lha khang rnying pa zhig zhig gsosakhyed rgyu'i don la lung zhus bskur byung bar zhu shog 'bul mkhan la lha khang de'i mdun rgyab dang g.yas g.yon sogs kyi sa cha'i dbyibs ci 'dra yin pa de bzhin gsal bar gsungs nas sa cha tsub pa zhig yin pas re zhig rang sor bzhag na bzang zhes bka' lan gnang bar khos ya mtshan pa byung /lan cig bkra shis 'khyil du phebs pa'i lam khar lha zhis sde pa rnams kyis gter zhig 'jog rgyu'i gnas shig spyan 'beb zhus par khyed rang tshos phan tshun 'dir btsal na nang du mi gcig shod pa'i tshod kyi brag phugs kha shar du bstan pa zhig yod 'gro bas der bzhag na legs gsung / khong tshos btsal bas kyang nye 'khor de nas gsung ba ji lta ba bzhin zhig rnyed de gter bzhag 873

༄/ /gung thang bstan ba'ithoname'i gsung 'bum/pa yul khams du shin tu 'phrod lam che ba byung 'dug / rje gong ma ngag dbang chos rgyan pas kyang de ltar gsungs pa'i gtam rgyud 'ga' zhig kyang yod 'dug pas sku tshe snga phyi'i mdzad tshul dang gsung gi bab tshun chad dbye ba ma mchis pa 'di lta bu ni yid ches pa'i mtshan ma gzhan dang ma 'dres pa zhig go / mi rin phun tshogs bkra shis kyis gdan drangs te gsol ston bsnyen bkur zhus shing gza' mi rnams la skyabs 'gro sgrol ma 'jam dpal mtshan brjod sogs kyi lung gnang / de nas pe zi'i ho ro la babs bkra shis bsam gtan gling gi 'du khang lha khang la rab gnas rta thog ma dang pe zi la 'jam lugs tshe dpag med rigs lnga'i sgo nas tshe dbang brgya rtsa sras la sna tshogs yum gye rjes gnang de'i sgrub thabs sogs kyi lung gnang / sbyin bdag dpon pos dpon g.yog tshang ma la gsol ston rgyas pa dang sger 'bul gya nom pa zhus/ji nong wang gi gdan 'dren pa slob dpon bstan pa mi rin pa yan ta les phas than tā pa tag ngo g.yog gis 'u lā khyer 'ongs pa bzhin tshes lnga la tā pe zi yabasras sogs drag zhan du ma'i rta thab dang bcas thon te tsha zhag gar bab tu dad 'dus kyi mjal ba mang por phyag dbang chos 'brel sngar rgyun ltar gnang / su pur ga'i su me'i chos rje grags pa rgya mtsho sogs kyis cha gān su pur ga la gdan drangs nas brten bkur zhus mchod rten la rab gnas mdor bsdus gnang zhing bum pa'i nang du phyag na rdo rje'i sku brnyan byin rlabs can sogs nang rten 'ga' zhig yod pa phyir gdan drangs nas tshogs pa thams cad la byin rlabs dang skya ser mang por phyag dbang chos 'brel gnang /u rgyan gol gyi zhag bab thog sbyin bdag ji nong wang tshe brtan pā pas bkra shis chos 'khor gling gi hu thog thu bla ma tā bla ma sogs skya ser brgya phrag gis chibasabasu zhus/ thas ji lha dbang rdo rje spun gnyis kyis lha khang du gdan 874

sa / /rjebatsun thaza bas mid+maragatartsa casanadrangs nas jo khang la rab gnas zhus thas ji gnyis kyis gsol ston bsnyen bkur gzabs/ tshes bdun la/ bkra shis chos 'khor gling gi bla ma dge 'dun gyi ser sbrengs mchod rol dang bcas wang gi ho rol babs gsol ston dkar spro zhus thog a pes gnyis dang wang sogs mi drag rnams kyis 'jal kha zhus dad 'dus kyi skya ser nyis stong nye ba la mjal kha dang bka' chos dkyus marnams rgyas par gnang hang gan gyi chibs skyel ba chos rje tshul khrims bkra shis dang mi rin phun tshogs bkra shis ngo g.yog phyir log / o'u han nas wang paṇ+ḍi ta zhabs drung gi grwa ba rag gdong sman pa dang wang 'chi med grub pa'i mi sna phas than tā thub cir gal ngo g.yog gleb nas zhabs drung rin po che'i zhu shog lam rim chen mo sum mchan can dpar du bkod pa'i dpar phud tshar gsum bcas dang wang sogs de ga'i bla dpon drag zhan gyi zhu shog dngos 'bul rnams phul/ wang zhabs drung rin po che snga ma nas rje nyid la zhal mjal bar yong rgyu'i thugs 'dun che tshul yang yang zhus pa'i lan du de phyogs kyi bla dpon sbyin bdag rnams nyid la dad 'dun che zhing rang yul du bzhugs pa las mtha' 'khob tu bstan 'gro'i don mdzad pas chod che bas 'di gar 'byon pa la thugs brel gnang don mi 'dug ces bshol 'deb kho na mdzad kyin yod kyang 'di res khong gi zhu shog gi lan du nyid rang nged la thugs 'dun yod pa zol med cig yin na lo 'dir cis kyang 'byon thabs gnang dgos/ mi nan nam byon kyang khyad par mi 'dug ces mgyogs par 'byon pa'isnyan bskul shugs can dang sku tsha smon lam bla ma'i zhabs drung la'ang de lugasakyi ting skul mdzad yor du su ho sho'u so so'i dpon chen rnams la'ang zhabs drung rnam gnyis 'byon pa shar tshe 'u la'i mthun rkyen bsgrub rgyu'i zhal bkod gnang / sgo mang mkhan zur lha btsun mthu stobs nyi ma'i zhu shog tu/875

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/7gong ma'i mtshams zhur sku dngos kyis 'byon rgyu'i snyan bskul zhus pa'i lan du rgas shing khog pa bdag ni rā dza 'di'i mdun du shwa thob shor gyi sems khral byed pa las rā dza gcig shos kyi drung du sha thob shor gye khe nyen bsam pa nyid skabs su bab bar snang bas rab rgal gcig la brje bcang gnyis kyi ngal ba mi dgos pa 'dra snyam du sems zhes dgongs gzhi can gyi gsung dang bslab bya zhus pa'i lan du/ bla ma don yod mkhas grub pas/ chos dang 'jig rten gang la'ang byed rgyu nyung ba mdzod/ 'di nga'i bslab bya'i snyeng po yin no/zhes gsungs pa de bskyar nas sku tshe dang sgrub pa snyoms par mdzad dgos tshul don gyis 'phang ba'i bslab ston gcig chod bcas gnang / lcang skya sprul sku rin po che bod du 'byon nye ba la pheb rdzong zhu bar gsol dpon blo gros dar rgyas mdo smad du ched mngags gdong sbrul sku rin po cher zhu shog dngul rta mig mgasum chibs chen legs pa bcas 'bul rgyu bskur u rad ca khir chi rin chen zla ba ngo g.yog mjal du 'ongs pa'i re ba bskangs/ dar had kyi mkhan po skal bzang dang el deb jas tshang sogs 'byor nas e cen pog to'i or dul gdan 'dren gyi snyan gsan phul par zhal len mdzad/ or du su ja sag gi a ke skal bzang 'jigs med rdo rje zhabs drung tā bla ma ngo g.yog nam 'byon rgyu'i yang nyan du 'ong bar bka' lan gnang / wang gi ho sho'u thun mongagi rim gror nyid chog grogs dang bcas pas rta mgrin gtor zlog nyin bdunabasgrubs de dang dus mtshungs su dge 'dun sum cu la rta mgrin gyi bye bsnyen gtong 'jug pa gnang / de nas wang gis bla mchod kyi khrid zhus yod pa bzhin bkra shis chos 'khor gling gi 'du khang du sbyin bdag wang blon 'khor dang ho thog thu bla mas gtsos pa'i dge 'dun tshang ma ja sag gi mkhan po bla ma dang zhabs drung tā bla ma ja rag gi mkhan po sogs gzhi byes kyi skya ser nyis 876

sa / / chabatsun thazangalnga'i yinyis d+mar nachen kha/stong nye ba la bla mchod bde stong dbyer med ma'i khrid chos thun dgu la smin rgyas gnang / 'di dus kyang bla ma dge bshes sku yon can mang po tshogs pa yin pas de dag la thugs brtse bas gzigs te dben sa snyan brgyud kyi gdams pa thams cad dpe mkhyud med par thang mar brdal zhing khyad par bde stong dbyer med kyi ye shes kyi ngo bo ngos 'dzin tshul rtsal du bton nas gzab bshad gnang / de skabs zab pa las kyang zab pa dang gsang ba las kyang gsang bar gyur pa'i man ngag gi snying po du ma rjen par stsal pa la chos bdag mkha' 'gro rnams 'khren pa'i tshul gyis sku khams cung zad mi dwangs pa dang mnal lam du dpon dpon mo rgyan chas can mang po 'ongs nas ma dga' ba'i rnam pas 'khon 'dzin byed pa lta bu byung zhing sog skad du bsgyur mkhan lo tsā ba la'ang rmi ltas ngan pa byung ba bcas 'tshub cha yod pa'i rnam pa shar/'on kyang rje nyid ni chos nyan pa rnams la rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas byed du bcug cing chos thun re re'i mgor yang bla slob tshang mas rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgom bzlas dang 'brel bar yig brgya nyer gcig re bzla ba mdzad pas 'tshub cha zhi ba byung / wang gis zhus pa'i bcu gcig zhal gyi rjes gnang ri bo rtse lnga'i ri khrod pa 'jam dbyangs blo 'phel gyis zhus pa'i tshem bu dmar khrid rnams mi mang la phan pa'i ched du sngar gyi chos nyan pa tshang mar chos thun gsum la gnang zhing / spyan ras gzigs kyis thugs skyed tshul las brtsamasate snyigs dus kyi sems can rnams kyi lhag ba'i lha skal yin pa'i rgyu mtshanadang skung gnas dang gzungs ring thung gi phan yon sogs go sla ba'i bshad pa rgyas par stsal pas chos kyi rnam dbye cher mi shes pa'i skye pho mo rnams la'ang phan thogs shin tu che ba byung / sbyin bdag wang tshe brtan bā pas gtsos pa'i ho sho'u thun mong nas dngos 'bul ltardzas mdzod btags dngul 877

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'isgraname'i gsung 'bum/maṇa che legs sku gsung thugs rten bzhugs gdan rgyab yol gos chen yug bzhi 'phrug lwa gcig dngul srang lnga brgya ja leb brgya rta che chung brgya tham pa bcas dngos 'byor gyi mchod sprin bstar te bla ma dge 'dun gyis zhabs brtan bden tshig gsung nas gsol ba rtse gcig tu btab par dgyes pa'i bka' lan gnang / chos 'khor gling gi tshogs par mang 'gyed stsal chos bar3mas su hūn gar thu sa lag chi tshe dbang bsam 'grub ngo g.yog dang thu sa lag chi don grub nu bo tho yon chos rje dang bcas rim par 'byor nas so so nas maṇ+ḍal kha btags sku gsung thugs rten dngul dang rnga rta sogs dngos 'bul gya nom pa brtan bzhugs lugs su phul/ bsam 'grub thu sa lag chi thu sa lag chi don grub mi rin pa yan ta le so so'i skor la drag po gsum dril tshe dpag med kyi rjes gnang rnams stsal/ gung gi su me'i chos rje tshul khrims ri bo rtse lngar gnas mjal du 'gro rgyur de ga'i 'jam dbyangs gtsos pa'i rten 'gang chen 'ga' zhig la mchod 'bul gyi thebs dngul dang spos zhing khyab snyan shal rnams bkur ba mdzad/ dur bed wang gi btsun mo nor bu rā ga srasapo bcas tha'i ji tshe ring rnam rgyal nang so skal bzang tshul khrims sogs drag zhan sum cu skor dang su nyid g.yas ru'i wang gi tho yon bka' 'gyur pa ho thog thu tsha po tho yon hu thog thu bla ma bcas ngo g.yog nyi shu skor rnams rim gyis 'byor nas mjal kha zhus shing dur bed tā wang dang su nyid tā wang so so'i zhu shog dngos skyes dang bcas phul/ dur bed wang gi btsun mo ngo g.yogadang ja rag gi mkhan po sogs la rta mgrin seng gdong ma gtso 'khor gsum sgrol dkar rnams kyi rjes gnang dang btsun mos bskul ngor sbyar ba'i sgrub thabs dregs pa kun 'dul gyi lung bcas stsal/ btsun mos brtan bzhugs kyi rten 'brel bsgrigs te maṇ+ḍal kha btags sku gsung thugs rten 878

༄/ /chubatsugablobazangalnga 41 gsumapamadaporasad khakadangulasrang nyis brgya lnga bcu gos chen yug lnga bcas yul/ sgrol ma dang rta mgrin gyi sku brnyan rab gnas brgya rtsa ma spos snam sogs gnang cha gzabs sbyin bdag wang dang a bes che chung rnams kyis rang rang gi gur du gdan drangs nas gsol ston sger 'bul zhus/ so so'i rten gsum la rab gnas rta thog ma dang wang la ku ru kul+le'i rjes gnang stsal hal ha'i tho yon bzang po ngo g.yog la dga' ldan lha brgya ma'i bshad lung gnang zhing dngos 'bul gzabs/ 'dir bzhugs ring la nyin re'i nang dgung gi mjal ba khrom tshogs la phyag dbang chos 'brel chag med du gnang bar ma zad mtha' 'khob 'dir nged rang yang yang 'ongs nas chos bshad rgyu dka' bas da res kyi yong thebs 'di la 'brel ba thogs pa rnams kyi 'dod pa tshim pa zhig byed dgos gsungs nas chos lung sogs gang zhus lhug par stsal pas rang rang gis gang 'dod kyis gsol 'debs smon lam blo sbyong sogs dpe sna tshogs khyer 'ongs pa la skyo ngal gyi rnam pa med par ma zad kun la phan pa'i phyir mjal mang 'dzom thog tu stsol bar mdzad/ de nas e cen pog to'i dar had kyi gdan 'dren pa chos rje nyi ma dang thas bu pi la gun ngo g.yog gis yu lā khyer 'ongs pa bzhinaganam gang la wang gi ho ro nas thon wang gi sras dang chos 'khor gling gi hu thog thu bla ma sogs drag zhan sum cu skor gyi chibs skyel dang dar had kyi skal bzang mkhan po dang el deb ja'i tshang sogs che gras rnams kyi chib bsu bcas dbang ldan thu sa lag chi'i khyim du gung bab thu sa lag chi nad drag pos thebs yod par mtshan dang gzungs sngags sogs rna lam du bsgrags nas bsngosgon rnam dag mdzad/ ye cen pog to'i ho ro la dar had kyi grwa mang gis spos rol sogs kyis mdun bsus te bzhugs sgar du babs khrom tshogs mang por mjal kha bka' chos gnang / ja sag dbang rgyal tshe brtan rdo rje 879

༄/ /gung tha bstan pa'isgroname'i gsung 'bum/dpon g.yog cung gar tā pe zi tshe dbang bkra shis ngo g.yog rnams 'byor nas mjal kha zhus/ zla ba bzhi pa'i tshes gcig la ji nong wang skal bzang mkhan po el deb ja'i tshang sogs dar had kyi che gras rnams nas e cen pog to la khrus gsol dang skya ser thun mong la lam gtso'i khrid kyi snyan gsan phul ba bzhin e cen pog to'i or du la byon nas yul khrus mdzad cing / dar had kyis gsar du bzos pa'i dngul gyi mchod rdzas kyi skor 'bul du bcug nas ched dmigs kyi 'azin bcol rje nyid nas mchod thebs gnang ste de ga'i lugs srol ltar gyi mchod pa 'bul du bcug par mdzad/ sbyin bdag hūn gar tā pe zi dpon g.yog la gdugs dkar zhal phyag yongs rdzogs kyi rjes gnang stsal/ tā pe zis brtan bzhugs kyi rten 'brel bsgrigs te maṇ+ḍal kha btags sku gsung thugs rten bzhugs gdan rgyab yol gos chen yug gsum dngul srang brgya rnga mong rta brgyad bcas phul/ tshes gnyis la gzim gur gyi sgo drung du ras gur gyi tshoms chen po phug yod par sbyin bdag ji nong wang ja'i tshang khu kho sogs cho lo can dang skal bzang mkhan po sogs chos rje gu thi du mas gtsos pa'i dar had kyi skya ser stong phrag nye ba dang / su nyid g.yas ru'ibaka' 'gyur pa tho yon hu thog thu sogs dang ja rag gi mkhan po hal ha'i tho yon o rad rab 'byams pa dpal dar gling gi rgan pa rnams dang bcas slob ma stong phrag brgal bar lam gtso'i khrid nyams len gyi rim par dril nas chos thun ring po gcig la gnang / 'di skabs khrid rdzogs nye ba dang char zim bu babs shing mjug gi maṇ+ḍal gye skabs su bka' chos gnang ba'i tshoms gur dang e cin pog to'i or du gnyis kyi bar du 'ja' tshon sna lnga'i gur khyim shar ba'i sne gnyis or du dang tshoms gur gnyis kyi rgya mthongs la mdung tshugs su tshugs pa byung bar thams cad ngo mtshar ba'i dga' dad 880

༄/ /chabatsunablob nyis gakhangags pabadakanacad ngona'aphel zhing / rje nyid nas e cin pog to 'di nyid gnyan po yin na'ang chos la dga' ba zhig yin 'dug rmi lam la dpag na'ang 'dir 'ongs pa la dga' ba'irnam pa 'dug cing de ring yang dga' ba'i ltas bstan pa yin snang gang ltar yang rten 'brel legs par 'grigs byung gsungs nas dgyes tshor che ba mdzad/ dar had thun mong gi 'bul bar maṇ+ḍal kha btags sku gsung thugs rten bzhugs gdan rgyab yol gos chen yug gsum dngul srang brgya rta che chung sum cu bcas phul/ tshes gsum la ja'i tshang dang khu kho gnyis kyis rang rang gi khyim du gsol ston 'bul ba zhus/ ja sag gi gdan 'dren pa chos rje ngag dpang chos 'phel mi rin thor go ngo g.yog gis yu lā khyer 'ongs te/ tshes bzhi la ji nong wang 'khor bcas kyi rta thab dang bcas thon jang gi po yan ta la'i khyim du gung bab thog ja sag gi a ke rnams gtsos pa'i drag zhan mang po chibs bsur 'byor thas ji mai rin co rig thus gdan drangs nas gsol ston 'bul ba zhus/ mi rin gzugs gzhi ma bde bar sgol ljang gi rjes gnang dang mtshan dang gzungs sngags rna lam du sgrog par mdzad/ de nas ser spreng dang bcas ja sag gi lha khang 'dod dgu 'byung gnas gling gi bkra shis khang gsar du babs ja sag gtso ba'i mi drag rnams kyis phyag dbang dkar spro zhus skya ser gyi khrom chen por phyag dbang chos 'brel gnang / wang gi ho sho'i slob dpon bstan pa dang phas than tā pa tag dar had kyi ja'i tshang sogs chibs skyel pa rnams phyir log u shing pe zi'i gdan 'dren pa thu sa lag chi chos kyi grags pa dgon pa'i khri pa sogs 'byor nas snyan gsan phul bar zhal len gnang / ja sag dpon po dang su nyid tho yon sogs so sos zhus pa'i bka' chos rnams tshes lnga nas dbu tshugs te 'du khang du ja sag dbang rgyal tshe brtan rdo rje dpon blon sogs dang mkhan po ngag dbang chos 881

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i name'i gsung 'bum/grags sogs grwa slob mang po su nyid bka' 'gyur pa tho yon zhabs drung hang gin ja rag gi mkhan po u shing pe zi'i zhabs drung tā bla ma dar had kyi skal bzang mkhan po hal ha'i tho yon sogs bka' chos la 'dus pa'i gzhi byes kyi seraskya nyis stong nye ba la bla ma'i rnal 'byor don gnyis lhun grub ma'i khrid chos thun gcig dang / bde lam dmar khrid dang blo sbyong don bdun ma'i khrid sbrags nas chos thun bco lnga la grub cing / bco lnga'i dus chen nyin bka' chos su ma chud pa'i dad ldan mang po dang bcas sum stong nye ba la snga dro bcu gcig zhal gyi rjes gnang / de'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor gru 'dzin nye lam gyi bshad lung phyi dro mchod pa rnam lnga bshams te sems bskyed mchod pa gnang /bka' chos tshugs pa'i rjes su o thog gi thu sa lag chi dharma dha tu dpal dar gling gi tshogs chen dge bskos ngag dbang sbyin pa sogs phyogs nas 'ongs pa mang po la'ang khrid cha tshang ba'i phyir nyin snga ma rnams su song zin pa'i skor yang mdor bsdus te chos thun gye mgor stsal/ mtha' gcod pa'i lung rigs kyi dgag gzhag cung zad re rang shugs kyis 'phros 'gro'ang gtso bor chos kyi mde'u nang du bskor te lang shor gyi shes rgyud gyong po 'di nyid 'dul thabs 'ba' zhig dang sbyar nas gsungs pas blo mchog dman mtha' dag yid 'khul zhing dad pas mchi ma 'khrugs pa byung / bcu drug nas bzung ste nyin re bzhin snga dro tshoms su gsang chos zab mo rnams slob bshad kyi tshul dang phyi dro 'du khang du tshogs bshad spel mar gnang ste/ ja sag dpon po yab sras bzhi thu sa lag chi gnyis mkhan po bla ma zhabs drung tā bla ma sogs slob ma nyung 'dus la nā ro mkha' spyod kyi dbang dang de'i bskyed rim rnal 'byor bcu gcig rdzogs rim rtsa dbu ma mkha' spyod grub pa'i gser chos bcas dang /chos nyan pa mang po la nam mkha' sgo 'byed kyi dbang stan thog cig ma'i khrid 882

༄/ /rjebatsotsho'iḥcho migyi gartegatso4tshadakhabasar/khrirgya nag pa'i gcod khrid sogs gcod kyi yig cha 'ga' zhig gi ljags lung rigasagasum spyi sgrub kyi bla ma'i rnal 'byor nyid kyes mdzad pa'i bde lam gyi spyor ba'i chos drug gi ljags lung sogs rgyu 'bras kyi theg pa'i chos tshul zad mi shes pa'i gter mdzod phye nas skal ldan yongs kyi re 'bras smin par mdzad/chos bar du cha gan su mes u rad zhabs drung sogs bsgrub bya 'ga' zhig la bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa dang us jing thu sa lag chi yi the gel ca bar chi sogs la dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa gnang / thu ra'i car gu chi'i mtshams zhus 'bul mi byung bar mtshams lan dang nyi shu'i nyin wang gi ho sho'u'i nyi ma gu this lha khang gsar bar gdan drangs te rten brten par rab gnas mdor bsdus gnang gu this lha khang rten bcas rje nyid la phul/ nyer gcig la su nyid tho yon zhabs drung dpon po yab sras sogs la sgol dkar dang dzasta la dkar po'i rjesaganang stsal/ su nyid zhabs drung gis dngos 'bul gzabs shing thon phyag zhus par gnang cha mdzad/ nyer gnyis la sbyin bdag ja sag gi dbu gur du dge mtshan spel ba'i cho ga gnang / dpon pos jo zhwa dang sku gzan sogs na bza' 'ga' zhig dang rta dang dngul sogs kyi 'bul ba zhus/dpon pos nyid kyi jo zhwa rnying ba dad rten du zhus par 'di nged rang rgya nag tu rjes ma 'gro dus lcang skya rol pa'i rdo rjes gnang ba yin de phyin chad nas nged rangagi lam rim gyi 'azin las lhag par rgyas pa yin pas byin mi chog gsung nas rten 'tshab cig gnang / 'di'ang lha cig dī paṃ kā ra'i gdung 'tshob tu mnga' gsol ba'i brda dang rten 'brel gyi sgo khyad par can yab sras gnyi ga'i thugs la gsal ba zhig yin snang / a ke skal bzang 'jigs med rdo rje thu sa lag chi nyi ma rgyal mtshan zhabs drung tā bla ma yus jing thu sa lag chi yi the ge la ca khir chi sogs kyis nang so sor gdan drangs te 'dod don zhus pa'i re 883

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i name'i gsung 'bum/ba bskangs/ nyer gsum la dpon po yab sras gtsos pa'i sngar gyi chos nyan pabyings la seng ldeng nags sgrol dang tshe dpag med kyi rjes gnang stsal ba'i mjug tu bla ma dge 'dun dang bcas pas zhabs brtan gsung ba dang sprags te ho sho'u thun mong gi 'bul ba maṇ+ḍal kha btags sku gsung thugs rten bzhugs gdan rgyab yol gos chen yug lnga rnga rta bzhi bcu zhe gcig dngul srang phyed dang lnga brgya bcas phul te gsol ba btab par bka' lan bzang po gnang / nyin re'i nang dgung gi mjal mang la phyag dbang bka' chos dkyusam rnams gnang thog tshogs thebs re re la grwa pa rnams kyis lung thar thor mang po zhus pa'ang 'dod mos bzhin gnang ba la 'ga' zhig gis khrom chos su gnang mi chog pas gdams ngag gi dpe 'ga' zhig khyer 'ongs pa'ang logs su bsags te gzim chung nas don gnyer can nyung 'dus la gnang nas re ba smin par byas/ u shing pe zi'i gdan 'dren pa grwa tshang bla ma dang tshogs chen dge bskos ca khir chi phun tshogs bkra shis sogs kyis u la khyer 'ongs te/ nyer lnga la phebs zhor du paṇ+ḍi ta'i 'du khang la ser sbreng dang bcas babs mkhan po bla ma ngag dbang chos grags kyi gsar bzhengs rgyud pa'i 'du khang la rab gnas mdor bsdus gnang zhing rab yon zhus mjal ba mang por phyag dbang chos bka' gnang zhing / pe zi'i zhabs drung tā bla ma'i uge la gsol ston dang shis brjod zhus dpon pos zangs ri'i steng gi lab tse la gdan drangs par phyag nas dpang bstod mdzad ja sag dpon po dang mkhan po bla ma sogs chibs skyel pa byings rnams phyir log / dar rgyas chos rje'i yur ge la gung bab thog u shing pe zi po yan thas blon 'khor dang bcas chibasabasur 'byor ba gno 'ur du pe zi'i zhag bab gra sgrig thog tu bzhugs/nyer drug la dgon pa'i khri pa gtsos pa'i grwa pa mang pos chibs bsu dang dge 884

sa / /rjebatsun khazang btangabs lad+madagadasad kha/'dunagyi seng sbreng dang bcas pe zi'i ho rol babs dad 'dus kyi mjal pa stong phrag brgal par phyag dbang chos bka' gnang dpon po'i dbu gur du dpon g.yog tshang ma la gsol ston dang dngos 'bul gya nom pa zhus/ nyer bdunal pe zi'i dgon pa theg chen bshad sgrub gling du ser sbreng gis mdun bsus te bzhugs sgar du babs skya ser gyi khrom chen por phyag dbang chos sbyin dang / dgon pa'i mkhan po lha ram pa blo bzang rdo rje bro 'tshal nas bab lce bas khong gis ur ger phebs nas phyag dbang bka' bsgo phyag sman gnang ja sag gi chibs skyel ba chos rje ngag dbang chos 'phel dang ja lang bka' 'bum ngo g.yog phyir log / o rad thu sa lag chi kun dga' rin chen mchod gnas sku skye dang bcas drag zhan du ma mjal du 'ongs pa la rta mgrin gsang sgrub kyi rjes gnang sogs dang sku skye sogs bsgrub bya bcu la rab byung gi sdom pa dang thu sa lag chi sogs 'ga' zhig la bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa gnang /zlab lnga pa'i tshes gcig dang gnyis la mkhan po bla ma'i rim gror rta mgrin gsangasnub kyi sgo nas 'chi blu dang drug cu pa tshad ldan bsngo ba mdzad/ tshes gsum nas tshogs chen 'du khang du spyi sger gyis zhus pa'i bka' chos rnams gnang bar sbyin bdag pe zi sogs dpon blon che gras skor dang tshogs chen khri pa chos rje shes rab yon tan mtshan nyid bla ma dka' bcu ngag dbang chos 'phel sogs dge 'dun tshang ma dang ja rag gi mkhan po hal ha'i tho yon dpal dar gling gi rgan pa rnams dang bcas gzhi byes skya ser nyis stong tsam la skyabs 'gro'i khrid chos thun bcu gcig la smin rgyas stsal cing mjug tu blo spyong tshig brgyad ma'i khrid mdor bsdus shig gnang / bka' chos su bla ma dge bshesasang bas skyabs 'gro'i khrid kyang lung rigs kyi spros pa rgya chen po'i sgo nas skyabs gsum 'jog lugs grub mtha' bzhi so so'i 'dod tshul de re re la 885

༄/ /gung thang bstanapa'izlaname'i gsung 'bum/nang gses kyi dbye bas 'dod tshul mi 'dra ba mang po skyabs 'gro la'ang skyes bu gsum so so dang / skyes bu chen po la phar phyin dang sngags kyi theg pa rgyud sde gong ma bla med la skyed rim pa dang rdzogs rim pa'i skyabs 'gro byed tshul rnams so sor ma 'dres par spu ris phye ste bstan pa yongs rdzogs kyi gnad skyabs 'gro'i khongs nas thon pa'i gzab bshad stsal te skal ldan yid kyi bum bzang legs bshad bdud rtsi'i zil mngar gyis 'gengs par mdzad/ de'i mu mthud nas nam mkha' sgo 'byed kyi dbang stan thog gcig ma'i khrid lha mo 'od zer can rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum 'jam dpal nag po rnam 'joms tshe dpag med dkar po sor 'brang dkar mo lo gyon ma gtso 'khor gsum seng ldang nags sgol rnam rgyal lha dgu sogs lhag lha mang po'i rjes gnang /gnas brtan rtogs brjod kyi bshad pa kun gzigs lnga pa'i gsung gi de'i phyag mchod rdo rje 'dzin pa dkon mchog rgyal mtshan gye lam rim tshigs bcad ma lam sgon lam gtso sogs chos tshan mang po'i ljags lung gnang nas bcu bzhi'i nyin chos mtshams mdzad/ nyin re bzhin gyi nang dgung gi mjal ba mang por mjal kha chos sbyin chag med gnang thog tshogs thebs re rer ming med kyi lung thor bu mang po zhu mkhan rnams la'ang sku tshag la ma 'dzem par gang mos bzhin stsal/ zhal nas ming med kyi lung thor bu mang po 'di thog mar wang gi ho sho'u nas srol btod de nas yu'u shing dang ja sag gnyis la dar ba yin o thog la snga ma med kyang dpal dar gling gi chos nyan pa rnams kyis bslab yod pas sang nang o thog la'ang 'jug rgyu yin mod gsung nas bzhad mo mdzad/ 'di dus tsha ba che zhing mjal ba mang bas mjal pa'i nang nas lung zhu dang bklag lung zhu mkhan mang ba la zhabs phyi pa rnams kyis tshig pa zos nas 'ga' zhig gi lung zhu rgyu bkag pas rje nyid kyis gzigs te/886

/ /sdebatsunablobazang za nyis cadakanas rākhakakhyed tsho mjal ba mang po dang bka' chos mang po la sun 'dug ste de tsam sun midagos ngal bso ba'i dus shig ci la med ces dgongs gzhi can gye bka' bkyon gnang nas su dang sus gang dang gang zhus pa thams cad la de dang de'i lan rnams 'dod pa tshim par stsal zhing / seng bar rnams su chos kyi 'bel gtamaganang zhor du blo skyed kyi skyes kyang mang du gnang nas che phra thams cad dga' spro phun sum tshogs pa'i dpal la bkod/ dgon pa'i mkhan po bla ma zhing du gshegs par thugs dam gsal 'debs kyi rim pa dang dgongs rdzogs kyi cho ga sogs gsungs/ sbyin bdag o thog pe li dpal dar gling gi mtshan nyid mkhan po thu sa lag chi gnyis ca khir chi mi rin dang bcas 'ongs nas dgon par dbyar gnas grol bar du bzhugs nas ma ṇi ril sgrub dang skya ser thams cad la da dung chos bka' gnang dgos kyi gsol ba btab par dgyes pa'i bka' lan mdzad dgon par mang 'gyed kyang bstar/ bco lnga'i nyinabla ma dge 'dun gyis zhabs brtan gsung ba dang sbrags te ho sho'u thun mong nas maṇ+ḍal kha btags sku gsung thugs rten gos yug gnyis phang zi bdun dngul srang lnga brgya bcas btegs nas khri ba chos rje shes rab yod tan gyis yon bshad phul/ de nas chibs skyel ring thung dang bcas dgon nas thon sbyin bdag pe zis hu thong gi cha gan no'ur la gdan drangs nas der gung bab mdzad mtsho la phyag nas 'thor zhing klu gtor gtong ba gnang pe zi 'khor bcas mjal kha zhus nas phyir log / bar zhag gcig gis o thog mi rin yu pa shi'i khyim du babs te zhag bzhugs mdzad/ mi rin bza' mi rnams kyis gtsos pa'i skya ser lnga bcu skor la seng gdong ma gtso 'khor gsum gyi rjes gnang ma du dge mtshan spel ba'i cho ga gsung gzhi len 'bul ba gzabs/de nas phas than tā yon tan gyikhyim du gdan drangs nas der bzhugs skye pho 887

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'isgroname'i gsung ཿma/mo'i khrom chen po mjal kha chos 'brel gyis tshim par mdzad cing / phas than tā gza' mi rnams kyis gtsos ser skya drug cu skor la rta mgrin gsang sgrub kyi rjes gnang dang khyim du dge mtshan spel ba'i cho ga gnang bsnyen bkur 'bul bgazabs/ bco brgyad la mkhan po tā bla ma sbyin bdag pe li dpon blon sogs kyi rta thab dang bcas dpal dar gling du babs/ che phra thams cad kyis da dung yun ring tsam bzhugs dgos tshul nan che zhing rje nyid kyang de bzhin gnang bzhed che na'ang lo 'dir 7gong ma'i mtshams zhur mi sna cis kyang gtong rgyu dang / de'ang zi ling am pan dang gros mthun gyis gtong dgos pa bcas thabs med par mgyogs par 'byon dgos byung bas drug pa'i tshes mgor rang yul du thon rgyur thag bcad nas spyo sger gyis zhus pa'i bka' chos rnams dbu btsugs te/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor don gnyis lhun grub ma'i khrid tshem bu dmar khrid 'jigs byed bcu gsum ma'i skyed rdzogs kyi khrid dang bshad lung mdo sdud pa blo spyong don bdun ma sogs chos tshan thor bu mngapo'i ljags lung seng ldeng nags sgrol rnam rgyal lha dgu sogs lhag lha du ma'i rjes gnang / hang gan tā pe zi'i sras ho sho'u chi bkra shis rgya mtsho slebs nas des zhus pa'i 'jam dpal nag po mgon po bar chad kun sel lha mo rnams kyi rjes gnang bcas gnang nas mjug tu tshe khrid bdud rtsi'i zil mngar gyi khrid stsal te mang ma'i chos mtshams mdzad/ nyid mgyogs par 'byon rgyu thos nas ho sho'u'i mjal ba mang po 'dus par phyag dbang chos bka' sogs gang 'dod du stsal nying sha'i car gu chi dang hang gan tā pe zi sogs dgos don zhig tu 'ongs pa mjal phrad zhus shing gsung gleng 'phel/lo snga mar ho sho'u 'dir rtsod gleng zhig yod pa 'khrug gzhi chen por 'gro grab la rje nyid nas ching gnang bzhed kyis khag gnyi ga la rgyu mtshan zhib mol gnang 888

༄/ / zangartsal41nyis gsangagakhu pachadakurasadabyung/bar phal cher gyis bka' gnang ltar byed 'dun che na'ang re gnyis kyis shag brgyab nas rgya spyod du 'gro rgyu bshol ma thub par bskyur btang ba yin kyang /mtshams shig tu zhal nas nged rang gis sbyin bdag rnams la khyad nye ring ma btang bar sems bzang pos ching byed bsam pa la a ma 'drer mthong ba'i rnam rtog can 'ga' zhig gis sne gtor bar brten lus ngag gi rtsol ba re zhig btang snyoms byas pa yin mod/ 'on kyang ho sho'i che phra thams cad snga ma nas nged la dad 'dun che ba'i sbyin bdag yin pas yid kyis kha mchu zhi ba'i ched du dkon mchog la ched dmigs kyi gsol 'debs re byed kyin yod pas/mdang rmi lam du shag rgyag mkhan de tsho 'ongs nas nged la mjal kha zhus par ngedakyis khyed tsho ci la 'ongs zhes bzhin cung zad gnag pas de dag dpa' zhum ste nying sha'i car gu chi'i yi ge bskyal nas 'ongs pa yin zer nas sog yig cig bstan byung / nged kyis sog yig 'don mi shes rung don dag sems la shar te lnga pa'i mjug tu nam mkha' las byung ba'i sprin nam mkha' la yal 'gro zer ba zhig 'dug ces bsam byung ba zhig rmis/ dkon mchog gi byin rlabs bsrub med pas da dung lta rgyu zhig snang gsung ba da res zog tu khel nas zla ba lnga ba'i mjug 'dir gyod don thag gcod par rgya sog dpon po rnams 'dzom pa la/ rje nyid nas shan 'gyed mkhan dang sher rgyag mkhan phan tshun du bkod khyab gnang bar brten gyod rang zhir song nas gang ci'i bya ba thams cad kyi dgongs bzhed ltar bkra shis lugs legs su gyur to/ /zhal nas deng sang gi mi rnams kyis skyabs 'gro go log tu song nas zhal lce gcod mkhan la bya dga' ster nas mgon skyabs bcol ba ma gtogs dkon mchog mchod nas mgon skyabs bcol mkhan dkon pa des ma byung ba 'dugadakon mchog la blo rtse gtad thub na dkon mchog gis skyob mi thub pa'i bya ba 889

༄/ /gung bang bstanapa'izlaname'i gsung 'bum/zhig med gal te dkon mchog gis bskyabs ma thub na kho rang las kyis nongs pa yin pas zhal lce gcod mkhan gyis kyang skyob mi thub/ khong tshos lham mthil zad nas rgya sog gi khrims sa nyul kyang lhag pa'i bya ba ma grub pa la nged rangagis mal dron por sdod bzhin du dge kha thob byung ba 'di skyabs 'gro'i khyad par las byung ba yin pas dkon mchog gi 'phrin las nam mkha' gar khyab tu khyab pa khong tshos ma shes pas nongs pa 'dug ces nyams mtshar gyi tshul du gsungs/ deng dus kyi gdul byas gdams ngag ngo ma shes pa'i skyon ma gtogs sngon bka' gdams gong ma rnams kyi gsung sgros bu slob so sos gdams pa'i mthil du bzung nas bsgrigs pa ltar byed rgyu byung na rje nyid kyis tha na nyams mtshar dang bka' bkyon gyi tshul du gsungs pa thams cad kyang nyams 'char bde la blo 'khul pa'i gsung rus pa can snying chu 'byin pa'i gser thur lta bu 'ba' zhig yin cing / da res kyi gsung 'di rnams kyang rjes 'jug rnams la skyabs 'gro ma nor ba dang skyabs yul la blo rtse gtod pa gal che tshul/ 'doms pa'i man ngag phul du phyin pa zhig yin par 'dug go / dpal dar gling gi bla spyi so so nas gsol ston pheb rdzong gzabs u shing pe zi dpon g.yog dang ji nong wang dang ja sog dpon po'i mi sna sogs chibs skyel dang pheb rdzong zhu mkhan mang du byung / drug pa'i tshes gcig la ho sho'u chi bkra shis rgya mtshos zhus pa'i ku ru ku l+le'i thun mong ma yin pa'i rjes gnang dpon chen la mkho ba'i chos shig yin gsung nas sbyin bdag pe li dang zhu pa po rnam gnyis la lkog chos su gnang / u'u shing pe zi yum bcas la dge bsnyen pha ma'i sdom pa dang don gnyer can mang tsam la seng ldeng nags sgrol gyi rjes gnang stsal te/ ho sho'u 'di ga'i bka' chos kyi mjug sgrol ma'i rjes gnang gis bsdus pa yin pas rten 'brel bzang gsung pa ni/ spyir/ de 890
