༄/ /rje zangachosakyinyis gagangabasgo pacadakurasadabyunganabazhin 'khor ba ji srid 'di'i/ / las ni rgyun mi 'chad par 'dod/ / ces pa ltar 'khor ba ma stongs bar du 'azin las rgyun mi 'chad pa gzhir bcas kyang sgrol ma 'azin las kyi lha yinapas thun mong snang tshod la'ang sku 'phreng rjes ma rnams su'ang 'azin las kyi 'jug pa gong 'phel du 'gro ba dang / lhag par yang bka' gdams glegs bam las/ khyod kyi rjes 'jug kho mos skyongs/ / zhes pa ltar rje 'di nyid nas phyogs 'dir lam rim gyi 'chad nyan rgya cher mdzad pa bzhin slan chad kyang lha chos bdun ldan gyi srol bzang po spel bar 'gyur pa'i mtshan ltas su dgongs par mngon/ de dus ho sho'u mang por phebs te bsnyen bkur bdag gir bzhes pa la khengs bskyung pa'i tshul dang / mdo sngags kyi chos bka' mang po gnang ba la spro ba 'phel ba'i tshul gyis gsung mgur gnyis gnang ba ni 'di ltar/ dam pa'i rigs brgyar shar ba'i lha thams cad/ / gsang chen rigs gcig 'dus pa rdo rje 'chang / / ngur sprig 'dzin pa'i rnam rol bdag gi mgon/ / drin can bla ma 'bral med snying dbus bzhugs/ / chos don gnyer ba'i skye bo dad ldan la/ / chos gtam 'grigs 'grigs smra la mkhas na yang / / chos dang rang sems rgyab 'gal song ba yi/ / chos kyi rdo rjes rang gi skyon mtshang glengs/ /gzhan gyis bskyod tshe rang tshugs mi thub par/ / ri klung gcong rong thang sogs nges med yul/ / ngal bas nyul 'di snying po'i lced bral ba'i/ / shing bal rlung gis phyogs kun mkhyer dang mtshungs/ / nyams dga'i gnas su bag phebs gnas pa la/ / gzhan gyi nan tan stobs kyis nyer drangs nas/ / bye thang skya bor ngal 'di dzing bu'i nya/ / lcags kyus drangs te thang la 'gre dang mtshungs/ / yul phyogs kun nas las kyis bkugs pa yi/ / skye bo stong phrag mang po nyin re bzhin/ / bdag drung lhan du tshogs 'di ston rlung 891

/ /yo ba napa'i me'igasungajabum/gis/ / shing lo sna tshogs gcig tu spungs dang mtshungs/ / sdug bsngal bden pa gcig steng gcig bzhag pa'i/ / phyag dbang zhes grags gzhan la phan med cing / / rang nyid ngal ba'i las 'di byis pa dag / rdo ba brtsegs pa'i rtsed mo byed dang mtshungs/ / snod dang ldan min ma brtags rnyed bkur ched/ / skye bo'i khrom dbus zab khrid man ngag rnams/ / gang shes lhug par 'chad 'di ras chung rnams/ / lto phyir mi la'i mgur dbyangs 'then dang mtshungs/ /slob ma rnams la chog shes dam chos gsungs/ / bla ma rang ni khab skud tshun chad bsag / chos dang phyag len 'gal 'di dur khrod kyi/ / rtogs ldan mi ro rgyab sprod khur dang mtshungs/ / nang du 'bul ba zhabs tog la dmigs nas/ / byu ru mig btsum smin ma zeng zeng gi / cho gas gson gshin bslu 'di g.yo can gyi/ /chu skyar byi la'i rnam thar nyid dang mtshungs/ / gar glebs gnas su gsol tshigs 'dren skad kyis/ / nor lug bsad pa'i sug bzhi mgo dang bcas/ / mdun du spungs 'di kla klo mu stegs dag / phyugs kyi mchod sbyin byed pa'i tshul dang mtshungs/ / pha mar ma gyur sems can med zer bzhin/ / rang gi ched du bsad pa'i sha za bar/ /cir yang mi sems dga' 'di rngon pa dag / ma ṇi 'dren bzhin ri dwags gsod dang mtshungs/ / tshe mthar gtugs pa'i rgan po bdag 'dra la/ / dad ldan rnams kyis bkur ste dngos 'bul tshogs/ / rgya cher stabs 'di gsod nye'i nag can la/ / gos klubs rgyan btags gzengs bstod byed dang mtshungs/ / 'on kyang 'brel ba thogs tshad la dmigs nas/ /mchog gsum thugs rje bskul te 'phral yun du/ / dge ba'i smon lam btab 'di gser 'gyur rtsis/ / lcags khams sa le spram du bsgyur dang mtshungs/ / zhes dang / bla ma ru grags pa'i 'ur rgyang can mang yang /892

da / / rngo pa/ste kyi ཿshadams gsadag yongs rdzogs kyi thub bstan bdag po ru bzhugs pa/ / drin can gyi bla ma wa li ta badz+ra/ /wa gen+d+ra mi dri rnam gnyisasu gda'o/ / zhabs pad la gtugs paya re 'tshengs snyam mo/ / chos lugs dang grubamatha' sna tshogs zhig snang ba/ /rang babs su bzhag na thams cad rang legs kyang / 1lung rigs kyis dpyad na 'khrul bral du nges pa/ / zhwa ser gyi ring lugs dri med 'di yin 'dug / mjal rgyu zhig byung ba bsod nams che snyam mo/ / zab zab tu grags pa'i gdams pa ches mang ba/ /skyon yon gyi 'grib 'phel phyogs re la rung yang / /spangs rtogs kun rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sgrub thabs/ /lam rim du grags pa 'di nyid rang yin 'dug /nyan rgyu tsam byung ba'ang skal pa bzang snyam mo/ / gsang sngags kye man ngag kha bo can mang pa/ /byin rlabs dang dngos grub yod mnyam rang yin rung / / brtson 'grus kyis chog na tshe gcig gi sangs rgyas/ /nges pa ru ster ba bskyed rdzogs gnyis yin 'dug /thun re tsam bsgom kyang don chen 'grub snyam mo/ /'khor 'das kyi srung ma ji snyed cig bzhugs pa/ / mthu stobs dang 'phrin las mi ldan pa medakyang / / bla brgyud kyis bsten pas chos rigs la 'go ba/ / dam tshig gi mgon po zhal bzhi pa yin pas/ / dal dus su mchod na brel dus su slebs snyam mo/ / chags sdang gi gtam dang kha gsag sogs smra la/ / deng seng gi mi rnams gang mkhas su snang yang / / don ldan gyi chos gtam tshigs bcad du sdebs nas/ /thogs med du smra la kho po rang mkhas pas/ /shugs 'byung du thon 'di a re mtshar snyam mo/ / zhes pa'o/ / tshes gnyis la bkra shis dpal dar gling nas chibs bskyod gnang bar dge 'dun mang gis gling 'dab nas chibs skyel dang / sbyin bdag hang gin tā pe zi thu sa lag chi ca khir chi sogs dang yu'u shing pe zi dpon g.yog cun gar thu sa lag chi tshe 893

༄/ /gung bang bstan pa'ithoname'i ཿngababum/dbang bsam 'grub ngo g.yog wang dang ja sag gi mi sna rnams dang bcas rta ba brgya phrag gis sa tshigs gcig gi bar du chibs skyel zhus/ ha thun e ji lha mo tshe ring gis ho ro la gdapadrangs nas gsol ston pheb rdzong zhus/ sbyin bdag pe lis ho ro la gdan drangs nas gsol ston dkar spro zhus thog brtan bzhugs kyi rten 'brel bsgrigs te ho sho'u thun mong gi 'bul ba maṇ+ḍal kha btags sku gsung thugs rten bzhugs gdan rgyab yol dngul srang stong phrag gcig bcas phul nas zhabs pad brtan pa'i gsol ba btab par dgyes pa'i bka' lan gnang / sbyin bdag pe li la dri bral srid du ring pa'i lha rdzas shig gnang nas nang sbyar gyi bslab ston zhib rgyas stsal/ rje nyid kyi jo zhwa dgon pa'i chos khri'i steng du lus song ba zhabs phyi pa zhig song nas khyer 'ongs pa la/ zhal nas nged rang gis khong tsho'i ma ṇi ril sgrub dang chos bka' 'ga' zhig rjes la bzhag pa bsgrigs nas 'grigs pa'i rten 'brel dang da resajo zhwa chos khrir lus song ba 'di ma bsgrigs rang 'grigs kyi rten 'brel yin pasobasgrigs nas 'grigs na'ang rten 'byung gi nus pa shugs chen ma bsgrigs rang 'grigs kyi rten 'brel 'di nus pa yin tu che gsungs pa'ang gong du sgol ma'i rjes gnang gnang tshul gyi lo rgyus bsnyad pa dang don 'dra bar mngon/ sbyin bdag pe li 'khor bcas kyis chibs skyel dang bcas phebs te pag ho ro la gdan drangs pa bzhin babs thu sa lag chis rmadha tu dang ca khir chi thun gnyis kyis gsol ston pheb rdzong bstar/ drag zhan mang po la glang ri thang pa'i blo sbyong tshig brgyad ma'i lung sogs chos tshan 'ga' zhig gnang / de nas tsha zhag gar bab tu skya ser stong phrag mang po phyag dbang chos 'bral gyis tshim par mdzad bzhin phebs/ a ke skal bzang rdo rje mi rin chos skyabs nang so legs bshad so sos lam nas gsol ston 'bul nod 894

ga / /rjebatsun thazang/67) d+mad nam cagazhus/ tshes drug la sman chu dgon kun dga' gling du bla ma las sne rnams kyis rta thab ser sbreng dang bcas bzhugs sgar du babs phyogs 'dus kyi mjal pa khrir nye ba 'dus nas sgug sdod byas yod par phyag dbang gnang / zhal nas de ring chos 'khor bskor ba'i dus chen yin pa dang mjal pa mang tshogs kyi mjug yin pas khri mthon po bshams te chos bshad dang lung rgyas par 'don dgos zhes chos khri lan gnyis bshams pa la dma' song 'dug gsungs nas gra pa'i nyal 'bog rnams brtsegs te mthon po zhig bshams pa la bzhugs/gsung mthon pos dal 'byor don che rnyedadaka' ngan 'gro'i sdug bsngal skyabs 'gro dang las 'bras skor gyi gsung bshad mdor bsdus re dang /byams pas dam bcas pa'i gzungs sogs gzungs sngags zab mo rnams dang sangs rgyas kyi mtshan dmigs bsal can rnams rna bas thos pa'i phan yon lhag par spyan ras gzigs byin rlabs 'jug pa myur tshul sogs skabs su gang bab pa'i gzungs sngags so so'i phan yon gyi bshad pa dang dga' ldan lha brgya ma dang 'brel bar dmigs brtse ma rigs gsum mgon po'i snying po bcu gcig zhal gyi gzungs ring byams pas dam bcas pa'i gzungs ke ka ni du rga te tshe gzungs yig brgya rnam rgyal gzung4ring sman bla bde bshegs brgyad rin chen gtsug tor can 'od dpag med kyi mtshan rnams rna lam du bsgrags te/ ma ṇi'i bzlas lung gi skabs su bla slob tshang mas yig drug phreng skor gsum re dang ma ṇi sogs khas len du bcug ste 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang sogs 'dod gsol dang bsru med bla ma dang ji srid thub mchog ma sogs bsngo smon gyi mtshams sbyor rgyas par mdzad/ tshes bdun la sman pa grwa tshang gi 'du khang du gdan drangs nas gsol ston 'bul ba zhus sman pa mkhan po gtsos pa'i gzhi byes kyi ser skya mang por sman bla mched bdun gyi rjes gnang 895

༄/ /gung ba bstan pa'izlanama'i gsung 4ma/stsal/ grwa tshang la mang 'gyed bstar bla brang du mkhan po rab 'byams pa blo bzang yon tan gyis gsol tshig dang sger 'bul gya nom pa zhus/ sman chu'i mgor phebs nas chu mig la rab gnas dang klu gtor bsngos snga nub mnal lam du dgon pa'i g.yas g.yon gyi ri sul nasagos dkar byul po gyon pa'i rgya sprang lta bu 'ga' zhig 'gro 'od byed kyin 'dug pa zhig mis pa bzhin de'i lam gcod dang dgos pa 'ga' zhig la'ang dgongs nas bdud 'dul mchod rten gnyis bzhengs rgyu'i zhal bkod dang gnas gzigs mdzad/ sman pa mkhan po dang dem chi mkhas mchog gnyis la rma chu'i kha nas nya srog mang po blu thebs dong tshe khron nyis brgya sprad nas nya rnams la sangs rgyas kyi mtshan dang gzungs sngags zab mo rnams rna lam du sgrog rgyu'i zhal bkod gnang / tha'i ji tshe dpag skyabs mi rin dpal 'byor sogs kyis kyang 'dod don zhus pa'i re ba bskangs/ thams cad kyi mjug tu dka' bcu blo bzang bkra shis kyis tshe khrid cig zhus par rten 'brel bzang gsungs nas zhu ba po sogs la tshe khrid bdud rtsi zil mngar gyi khrid gnang / tshes brgyad la de nas thon grwa tshang gi las sna rnams kyis rma chu'i 'gram nas ja thab zhus mi rin ching pa thus gdan drangs te ser spreng dang bcas phebs te der bzhugs 'du khang du mi rin spun gnyis kyis gtsos pa'i skya ser mang po la skyabs 'gro'i khrid bka' chos dkyus ma phyag dbang dang bcas gnang / rten la rab gnas mdor bsdus dang khyim du dge mtshan spel ba'i cho ga gnang / mi rin gyis maṇ+ḍal kha btags sku gsung thugs rten sogs dbul ba gzabs thu sa lag chi dharma dha tu dpon g.yog gis bka' bsgo zhus nas phyir log / de nas mi rin ngo g.yog gis chibs skyel ja thab dang bcas thon nas rim gyis bcu gcig gi nyin i khi hu tog la zhag bab thog rje drung mkhan po dpon g.yog chibs bsur 'byor/896

ga / /rje badza bsazabang byu gakhas gsaka.o thog gi u la'i rnga rta mang po'i rna lam du mtshan dang gzungs sngags rnams sgogs par mdzad 'dis mtshon pa'i dus nam gyi tshe'ang phan tshun du phebs dus rnga rta dang khal ma sogs kyi rna lam du mtshan dang gzungs sngags rgyun ldan bsgrags shing nyid kyi chibs pa kha rgas dus ched dmigs kyis mtshan dang gzungs rna lam du bsgrags nas 'chi rag tshun chad sos bder 'jog pa yin/yo thog gi skyel mi sman pa mkhan po rab 'byams pa blo bzang yon tan car gu chi sangs rgyas skyabs mi rin dpal 'byor sogs drag zhan bzhi bcu skor la phyag dbang rten sna phyag mdud sogs go bab kyi gnang sbyin mdzad/ bcu gnyis la pa yan gol gyi mdar sbyin bdag chin wang 'khor bcas kyis chibs bsu dang ja thang zhus/ de nas pa yan gol gyi dgon par mchod rdzas thogs pa'i ser sbreng dang bcas 'byor sbyin bdag wang gis rje nyid la ched gnyer gyis bsgrubs pa'i bla brang gsar bar babs/ bcu gsum la 'du khang nang du rje drung mkhan po gtsos pa'i dge 'dun pa rnams la snying po don gsum gyi khrid stsal/ 'di phyogs su nyid kyis mdzad pa'i rtsis gzhung mkhas pa'i snying nor gyi steng nas sa ris 'bri rgyu dar shas che bas grwa pa 'ga' zhig gis rtsis gzhung de'i rgyug phul par thugs mnyes te gnang sbyin kyang mdzad dgon par mang 'gyed gnang / bcu bzhi la de nas thon te lam zhor du wang gi dpon mo'i dur thog tu gdan drangs par brab sngags dang gang ser ma sogs gsungs nas phyag nas 'thor wang gis skyed tshal du bzhugs gnas gra sgrig bgyis par babs/ hal ha tho yon gyis er ti ni paṇ+ḍi ta chos rje nom chi chos rje mgon po pe li sogs drag zhan mang po'i zhu shog dngos 'bul rnams phul/ sbyin bdag wang gis yun ring tsam bzhugs dgos tshul nan chen na'angagong smos ltar sku don gal chen yod stabs 'phral du 'byon rgyur thag 897

༄/ /yo ba bstanapa'ithoname'i gsung ཿma/bcad wang gi rim gro'i 'phro rnams bsgrubs/ rje drang mkhan po'i bzhed mos ltar khong dang hal ha tho yon sogs la ku ru kul+le bla med lugs kyi rdor sems khyung nag sogs kyi rjes gnang dang gsar rtsom skor gyi ljags lung 'ga' zhiganyu chos su wang dang mkhan pos gtsos pa'i drag zhan lnga brgya tsam la rnam rgyal lha dgu'i rjes gnang bcas stsal/ wang gis gsol ston drangs thog dngos 'bul lha rdzas mdzod btags gos chen sna tshogs yug dgu wa nag gsum pu la gan nyer bzhi ri mo'i bahwar dgu skug 'phrul ma'i yang chi'i bahwar che ba khyad mtshar gnyis dngul srang stong phrag gcig rnga mong nyer bdun lugs sum brgya bcas phul/ rje drung mkhan po yo'u ye shi ye ar sa lang tha'i ji rnams rang rang gi nang nas gsol ston 'bul ba zhus hal ha'i tho yon blo bzang bkra shis chos yon du maṇ+ḍal kha btags sku gsung thugs rten gos dar dngul sogs dngos 'bul gya nom pa phul/ sku thang rab gnas brgya rtsa ma dang dpe cha 'byor lan rnams stsal/ pa yan gol gyi dgon pa nas tshur 'byon dus rje nyid kyi zhabs chags bzhugs khri'i 'og tu lus pa sbyin bdag wang dang mkhan pos rten 'brel gyi khyad du dgongs nas zhabs chags de nyid dadarten du gnang dgos tshul nan cher zhus par sku gsung thugs kyi gras la mchil lham bzhag na mi bzang gsung nas rten gsum gyi gral du mi 'jog pa'i bka' rgya dang bcas gnang / zhal nas da lam o thog gi dgon pa nas thon dus chos khri'i steng du jo zhwa lus pa dang pa yan gol gyi dgon pa nas yong dus bzhugs khri'i 'og tu mchil lham lus pa 'di gnyis mtshar ba zhig 'dug gsung / mjal pa mang por phyag dbang chos 'brel gyis tshim par mdzad rje drung mkhan rin po ches kyang der bzhugs ring 'bral med du phyag g.yog zhus par dogs pa gang zhus sogs la blo skyed nam 'dod du stsal te thugs kyi bzhed 898

sa / /che ba nga sangabs mucha ṭakhag sha napa tshim par mdzad/ sngar lo rma chu'i 'gram du sleb pa nas bzung da bar du mjal pa khrom tshogs byung ba la thugayo'agol dus gsung bshad dang bka' chos dkyus bzhin dang ci 'dra'i brelab che na'ang phan yon dang dmigs pa brda sprod kyi gsung bshad mdor bsduyore dang bcalobyam4pasadam bcas pa'i gzungs yig drug gi bzlas lung phreng skor re khas len bskor ba 'dodasgon dang bcas ma chag par gnang ba ni pheb res kyi tha ma 'dir de dag so so'i rgyud la mngon mtho nges legs kyi sa bon thobs pa zhig ma byas pa'i thabs mi 'dug snyam du thugs brtse bas ma bzod pa'i rang mdangs phyir shar ba yin no/ / rje nyid snga ma lan kha shas phebs dus dge ba khas len du bcug pa la brten nas ma ṇi dang gzungs sngags grangs bsags pa dang sgyung gnas mang po bsrung ba sogs lus ngag gi dge ba gang byas kyi tho yig 'bul mi'ang mang du byung bar dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams byang chub tu bsngo ba'i spyan dmigs kyang nan tan mdzad de/ mdor na sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mya ngan las 'das tshul ston khar grong khyer chen po rnams dang mthar rtswa can gyi grongadu gshegs shing rje btsun mi la'ang sku 'da' khar sku'i bkod pa du mas gnya' nam sogs kyi sbyin bdag so so'i rtsar byon pa bzhin/ rje nyid la dad gus rtse gcig tu 'cha' ba'i byang phyogs chen po hor gyi yul gru'i gdul bya'i tha ma rnams gang la gang 'tsham gyi thabs mkhas thugs rje mdzad pa brgya phrag gi sgo nas mngon mtho dang nges legs kyi lam la bkod de phan bde'i dga' ston zad mi shes pa'i dpal la spror bar mdzad do/ / / / smras pa/ byang dzhai~X ༷ rdoṭ+wāṃ dī ṭ+wāṃdī dze+e spridhi /dhis zhe/ rdo/ ༷ rdo ༵/na /pob /༷ ṭ+wāṃ / tram̐ dī ༵ ṭ+wāṃ dī mdzad pas/ / thar pa chen po'i sgo lam yangs po ru phyes so/ / mdo smad 899

༄/ /gung ba napa mi'i༄ngababum/yul ljongs 'dir yang yun ring du bzhugs nas/ / mdo sngags chos kyi 'khor lo chad med du bskor na/ / mdo dbus bstan pa'i 'byung gnas cha mnyam zhig 'ongs yang / /mdo khamasaskye bo'i bsod nams ji 'dra zhig yin ang / /re 'dod stsol ba'i nor bu rang lag na yod dus/ / re gnyis tsam lasasgor ngo shes mkhan yang dkon te/ / re skong nor bu dga' ldan mkha' spyod du khyer dus/ / re thag chad pas 'gyod kyang 'phyis pa las med do/ /sa steng kun na dkon pa'i legs bshad kyi sgron me/ / sa lam bgrod tshul mtha' dag ji bzhin du gsal mdzad/ /sa gsum 'gro ba'i ded dpon khyod nyid dang 'dra ba/ / sa 'dir slan chad mig gis mthong rgyu zhig e yong / /dusagasum sgrib med gzigs pa'i ye shes kyi spyan ldan/ / dus las yol ba med pa'i thugs rje yi mnga' bdag / dus mtha'i 'gro la lhag pa'i byin rlabs kyi gter khyod/ /dus kun 'bral med gtsug gi cod paṇa du bzhugs shig / ces rigs dang dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum rmad du byung ba'i mdzad bzang 'dab brgya'i dga' tshal gyi cha tsam gtam du byas pa rtogs brjod pad+ma dkar po las/slarayang byang phyogs kyi ljongs su gdul bya'i tha ma rnams smin cing grol ba'i phyir chibs bskyod pa'i tshul gyi 'dab ma ste bcu gsum pa'o/ /900

da / /che badza gas bshadasag das༄/ / 'dab ma bcu bzhi pa/ gzugs sku'i bkod pa bsdus pa'i tshul gdung mchod kyi rim pa rnam thar gyi don bsdu ba dang bcas/de nas nyer drug gi nyin wang dang mkhan po sogs bla dpon du ma'i pheb skyel ring thung ja thab dang bcas yā mon nas thon te rim gyes dad ldan rnams la byin rlabs dang gsung gi bdud rtsi spel zhing / dgon sgrub sderis med kyi chibasabasu thab bsu mu mthud pa'i sprosapa dang bcas zla ba bdun pa'i bcu gsum la mar tshang du babs/ bla chen po'i lha khang du mchod pa rgya cher bshams te yan lag bdun pa maṇ+ḍal gsol 'debs bcas sngon du btang nas thugs smon nan tan mdzad cing bzang spyod smon lam gyi mtshams spyor rgyas par mdzad/ rje 'di pa dus nam gyi tshe'ang rten la mchod mjal gnang skabs brel ba med dus zhal 'don gyi rim pa rgyas pa dang ci 'dra'i brel ba che na'ang bde lam ltar gyi yan lag bdun pa maṇ+ḍal gsol 'debs mdor bsdus dang / ji ltar sngon gyi bde gshegs kyis/ / sogs kyis thugs skyed dang spro ba skyed pa/ bsngo smon gyi tshigs bcad 'ga' bcas cis kyang gnang ba ni phyag len star chags yin/ bcu bzhi'i nyin dgon lung du bla spyi so so'i rta bsu bskyar ma thab bsu ser spreng dang bcas babs nyen kha shas kyi ring gzhi byes kyi mjal mi mang po'i 'du long gis dus 'das shing 'bul sbyin dang mang 'gyed sogs gtong ba'i sgo 'phar yangs por phyes nas thams cad mgu bar mdzad/ dgon pa'i tshogs chen 'du khang zhig gsos legs par grub 'dug 901

༄/ /yo thang ba na pa'ithoname'i shā 'bum/par gzigs rtog dang dgongs bzhed ltar phun sum tshogs pa byung ba la thugs dgyes tshor chen po mdzad/ a lag shā wang gi chibs skyel pa ca khir chi kunadaga' mi rin dkon mchog sogs drag zhan du ma u lā dang bcas phyir ldog rgyur byin rten gnang sbyin gzabs/ nub cig mnal lam du dgon lungagi phu'i phyogs nam mkha'i mtha' pha tshad cig nas grub thob lta bu 'brug zhon zhig bar snang du 'ja' lam brgyud nas 'ongs te bla brang gi sgo mo che'i thad kyi mdun ri'i rtser sleb pa dang 'brug skad gzhi 'dar ba'i tshod cig bsgrags pas gzim yang sad 'dug pa ni sku tshe rjes ma 'khrungs pa'i phyogs dang gdan sar pheb rgyu'i lo mdzad pa 'phrin las sogs kyi rtags mtshan zhig yin nam snyam/ zla ba brgyad pa'i nang du hal ha'i che chen han gyi sde ba jo nang pe zi tshe brtan dbang rgyal rdo rjes ched dmigs btang pa'i mi sna chos rje ye shes grags pa khā tshe 'phel ngo g.yog sleb nas pe zi'i zhu shog dang dngos 'bul rnams phul dpon po sgyung gzhi drag pos btab yod par phyag sman srung babartag lan stsal/ yel chi chos rje sogs la rta mgrin gyi rjes gnang dang rtogs bdun rtogs gsum gyi lung gnang sbyin bcas mdzad thu med burnya thi lha ram pa sogs la blo sbyong don bdun ma'i khrid stsal/ dgu pa'i tshes la a ro hor chin pe li dbang rgyal tshe brtan rdo rje'i mi sna 'ongs nas pe lis lung zhus dang mer gen mkhan po 'phrin las rab rgyas kyi bsngo rten yang srid skor gyi brtag zhus kyi lan sogs stsal/ de nas zi ling du phobs te am pan dang mjal phrad thog7gong ma'i mtshams zhus mi sna gtong rgyu'i gros mdzad/ ston dgun gyi mtshams 'dir chos sde chen po dgon lung sku 'bum bya khyung bkra shis 'khyil dgon lung ri khrod mang 'dus ri khrod chos bzang ri khrod mchod rten thang gan chen 'bri gu sems nyid mā thi zi rgya yag dgon bod yul ri khrod or 902

༄/ /rjebatsun khazangartsamadzamanyis d+madakarasad khakatsho tā pan dor zhi zhwa dmar 'bri gung stag lung rab rgyas yar lung chu klung tas thung ser lung lo dkar mā yang thar ba gling 'brug lung khran tsong len hwa' thas pā jo'u byams pa 'bum gling ang 'gang zi gcu 'khor gan gya'i brag dkar sha rdzong an ja su gro tshang dgon pa nom chi 'dul ba dgon rnams la dngul srang stong phrag phyed dang gnyis kyi mang 'gyed gnang ste/ tshe gzungs dung phyur gcig dang bye chen bdun rnam rgyal gzungs ring 'bum ther gcig dang khri tsho gnyis yig brgya 'bum ther gsum dmigs brtse ma bye chen gcig dang sa ya gnyis rigs gsum mgon po'i snying po bye chen gsum re ya ma rādza hrī khyimagon po'i snying po rnams bye chen re myur mdzad ma khri tsho bzhi brgya rtsa stong lan chagasagator ma 'bum ther bcu sher phyin ma rnam 'joms khro bo spe brtsegs khyung khra khyung nag rnams kyi snying po gnas brtan phyag mchod sman chog skyabs 'gro ltung bshags bzang spyod 'jam dpal mtshan brjod gdugs sher seng gdong ma'i zlog sgyur so so nas 'bum grangs gsog pa sogs zhabs brtan rgya chen po bsgrubs/ 'di dus skyabs 'jug sa bon rje nyid kyis gnang pa ni/ngedal re ltos byed pa'i gson gshin thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyong zhing dal 'byor gyi rten bzang brgyud mar thob ste rnam 'dren rgyal pa'i go 'phang myur du 'thob pa dang / nged rang gi tshe yun ring du gnas te dal 'byor don ldan yong ba'i ched du dmigs nas mang 'gyed spyi 'bul 'di bzhin phul bas rim gro 'di dang 'di nyid dang khyad par dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams bzang spyod sgon lam gyis rgyas 'debs pa dang 'dod don 'grub pa'i thugs dgongs nan tan mdzad dgos zhu 'tshal/ zhes gnang 'dug / zla ba bcu pa'i tshes la 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa sprul sku rin po che'i mi sna gnyer ba grags pa ngo g.yog 'byor nas mtshams zhus phul par mtshams lan du dka' bcu ngag dbang 903

/ /gung tha bstan pa'izlanami'i gsung 'bum/skal bzang ched mngags gdong sogs yul nas phebs pa'i sku skyos 'ga' zhig phul/ 7gong ma'i mtshams zhur pi lig thu gu thi ngag dbang bstan 'phel ngo g.yog rdzong brda mdzad par 7gong mar 'bul rgyu'i 'dzin pa dang bla dpon 'ga' zhig gi mtshams rtags rnams sprad cing tsan dan jo po dang mchod rten dkar po la dus chen dang bstun nas mchod 'bul ngos dag gnang rgyu sogs gang ci'i zhal bkod gnang / ngag dbang wang gi dpon mo ngo g.yog 'ongs par 'dod chos sogs stsal/ rong po bes pa sprul sku ched dmigs kyis bka' chos gsan par 'ongs don bzhin khong dpon g.yog sogs la bde lam gyi khrid zhal shes man ngag gis brgyan pa dang / sprul sku rang la dge ldan phyag chen sngags lugs thun mong ma yin pa'i zab khrid lngags lung 'ga' zhig bcas nyi ma bdun gyi ring la gzab bshad stsal cing mjug tu gang zhus thams cad phyag len la 'debs rgyu'i zhal bkod gnang zin pa dang dus mtshungs su dgon lung gi tshogs dung 'bud pa dang me tog gi char 'dab ma lnga drug re yod pa sa gzhi kheb par bab pa sogs rten 'brel rang shugs kyis 'grigs pa la thugs spro bas nyams 'ur ba lta bus nam mkha' la hu re gzigs te bzhad mo dang phyag thal mo sbyor ba'i rnam 'gyur zil che ba gnang tshul la dpag na dag pa'i gzigs snang ngo mtshar can yod tshod 'dug ces nyams can rnams gleng / rab rgyas dgon gyi zhabs drung che chung dpon g.yogabacu skor 'ongs nas bla ma ngag dbang chos 'phel rgya mtsho'i sprul sku la rab byung gi snyan gsan zhus pa bzhin 'dun pa bskang zhing mtshan blo bzang bshad sgrub nyi ma zhes stsal/ rta mgrin gsang sgrub kyi rjes gnang sogs dang tshe dpag gi li sku bzhugs gdan sna tshogs rdo rje can sogs gnang nas sku tshe tshe dpag med dang mnyam zhing zhabs pad rdo rje ltar brtan par 'gyur pa yin 904

sa / /che btsu 60 bas mud+maragasas casanazhes bden tshig gsung / bas pa sprul sku rab rgyas zhabs drung che chung gnyis rgyud pa bla ma li kyā zhabs drung sogs nyung 'dus la phyag chen gyi khrid chos thun gcigal gnang / bis pa sprul sku la rje'i li sku dang lam rim chen mo sum mchan can sogs gnang cha stsal/ zla ba 'di'i mar ngo'i nub cig nyams dang mnal lam 'dres pa'i snang bar lam rim chen mo'i mchod brjod kyi 'brel gyi rim pa zhig thugs la shar ba zur du yi ger 'khod 'dug / lnga mchod kyi skabs hal ha'i tho yon blo bzang rin chen nang so blo bzang bkra shis o thog gi car gu chi blo bzang bkra shis sogs skya ser mang po slebs nas ti yan chi grags pa rgya mtshos cung gar tho yon blo bzang sgrol mas bskul pa'i bla brang theg chen chos mdzod kyi bka' 'gyur gyi na bza' cen khru'u'i thum brgya dang drug phul par 'byor lan dang 'dod chos sogs kyis tshim par mdzad/sems nyid zhabs drung gis gsar rtsom 'ga' zhig gi lung zhus pa'i mjug tu nyams snang la 'ongs pa'i lam rim chen mo'i mchod bajod kyi 'brel bsgrigs kyi lung gnang nas 'di'ang chos kyi dbu lta bu zhig yin pas rten 'brel bzang gsungs pa ni sku tshe 'dir lam rim gyi 'azin las rgyas par mdzad pa'i mjug tu slar yang lam rim chen mo'i mchod brjod kyi 'brel zhig thugs la shar ba sku tshe'i 'phrang bar lam rim gyi sgo nas bstan 'gro'i don rlabs po che yongs pa'i rten 'brel rmad du byung ba la dgongs par mngon/ zhabs drung gis gnyan khrod la 'gro rgyu'i skyabs 'jug zhus par bsam bzhin 'grub pa'i zhal bzhes dang nyid kyi sgom thag dang rje btsun mi la dang mkha' spyod ma'i sku brnyan bzhugs gdan rdo rje can nyis 'brel zhig gcig gis nged rang tshe ring ba mtshon gcig gis khyod rang tshe ring ba mtshon zhes dgyes pa'i bka' stsal phebs/ nyer lnga'i nyin dmigs bsal gyi thugs dam dang phyag tshwa mang po 905

༄/ /yo bang bstan pa'i nalo gsung 'bum/dpar 'debs pa dang 'debs 'jug pa gnang zhing ngan slong bzhi bcu skor chos dang zang zing gi sbyin pas tshim par mdzad/ bcu gcig pa'i tshes bdun 'khrung skar gyi dga' ston nyin 'dul ba dgon pa'i rong po zhabs drung gis rgya nag nas 'ongs pa'i skyos ma mang po dang hob tu'i tā bla ma blo bzang nyi mas gos chen gnyis pu la han gnyis dngul srang brgya cung gar thu sa lag chi'i mi snas ched gnyer gyis bsgrubs pa'i gser zangs kyi bkra shis rtags brgyad dang rdzas brgyad rgyal sred sna bdun 'dod yon sna lnga sogs dngos 'bul rgya chenapo dang / dgon pa'i bla spyi khag so so dang nye 'khor gyi dgon sgrub sde mang po'i bla ma las sne spyi sger nas 'bul tshan bstar te brtan bzhugs kyi rten 'brel dkyus gcig la bsgrigs nas rong po zhabs drung rin po ches bshad pa phul bar dgyes pa'i bka' lan gnang / lha bzo pi lig thu nang so ngag dbang skal bzang la rgyal dbang skal bzang rgya mtshos sku rgyur rab gnas mdzad pa'i tsardon dmar po la thub pa grong khyer ma'i sku khru tshad long ba bzhugs khri rgyab yol dang bcas bsgrub tu bcug pa byon legs khyad du 'phags pa zhig grub zin nas brtan bzhugs kyi mjug tu phul par thugs shin tu dgyes gzhi byes kyi drag zhan rnams la ston mo dang gnang sbyin sngar rgyun ltar mdzad/tshes bcu nas sku mtshams la bzhugs te dgun gyi ring 'dir bcad rgya'i ngos grub mtha'i bstan bcos legs bshad shel gyi me long sngar le'u 'ga' ljags rtsom gnang yod pa la zhus dag dang gzhung byings che ba lus yod pa rnams gsar du brtsams nas mjug yongs rdzogs grub pa gnang / bka' rtsom 'di nyid thog mar gsol ba 'debs pa po nged rang yin la de'i rgyu mtshan ni 'jam dbyangs gong ma chen po kho na'i bka' drin la brten nas da lta grub mtha' thams cad kyi nang na dge ldan pa'i phyogs 'di phyi rgya dus tshod la dpag 906

da / /che badzaḥgs bshadasag dmapa'i sde dgon dpal 'byor sogs gang thad nas phun sum mtshogs pa'i lugasayin kyang nang nyams su rang bstan gyi de nyid shes te bshad sgrub kyis 'dzinanus pa shin tu dkon te/ phal mo che dge lugs yin zhes pa'i ming tsam dang zhwa ser po yin pa tsam gyis chog snyam pa las de khyad du 'phags tshul 'di yin snyam pa dang khyad du 'phags pa'i rgyu mtshan zhig yong dgos rgyu'i rtog dpyod tsam yang med par cal rgyug kho na yin/ la la zhig 'di rje bla ma'i rang lugs bstan pa'i snying po 'khrul ba thams cad dang bral ba gser sbyang btsom lta bu yin mod ces che brjod nyis brtsegs sum brtsegs su byed kyang sgrub byed bsgrub bya dang mtshungs pa de ka ma yin par dpyod ldan dga' ba skyed cinganges pa 'dren nus pa'i sgrub byed rnam dag sna gcig kyang spro rgyu med la/gzhan phyogs 'gog tshul yang dpyad pa gsum gyis skyon 'di 'jug zer rgyu med par sdang smras kyi tshigs tsub kho na byas nas de bstan pa la dag ther byas pa yin par zlom mo/ / 'ga' zhig ni grub mtha' ris med la dag snang spyong ba'ikhul byed kyang spyong tshul ma shes pas log pa 'ba' zhig tu gyur te spyir mdodang rgyud theg pa gong 'og dam pa gong ma so so'i gsung rnams la sgras zin mi mthun pa ci rigs 'byung ba ni nad kyi dbang gis sman sna tshogs dgos pa bzhin gdul bya'i khams dang bsam pa'i dbang yin pas gcig gi thog tu thams cad sgra sor bzhag byed mi dgos shing / dus skabs so sor sbyar na de thams cad kyang nyams su len dgos pa kho na yin gyi 'dor rgyu gcig kyang med par go na 'gal ba med par ma zad gcig gcig gi grogs su shar nas phyi phyir yid ches pas dag snang 'byung rgyu yin pa la de ma go bar sgras zin thams cad kyang sgra ji bzhin par bzung ste/ bden par yod ces pa'ang bden bden par med ces pa'ang bden dpyad sgom gtso che zhes pa'ang bden ༅7

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'izlaname'igasung 'bum/dpyad sgom mi rung zhes pa'ang bden zhes 'gal ba ltag sprod 'ba' zhig tu bzung ba de bstan pa thams cad 'gal med du rtogs pa dang / grub mtha' gcig gi'ang 'gro phyogs ma shes pa de grub mtha' rab 'byams shes par rlom pa'i mun sprul ci yang byung la de jo bzang gi rnam thar yin rgyu'i rdzu byed cing rigs mthun blun po rnams kyang de la rtsis su byed do/ / gzhan kha cig /spyir chos nyid lta bu bden par yod med gnyi ga yin mi zer yang theg pa rang sa na bden pa yin pas dge lugs pa lta bu la chos nyid bden par med pa de bden jo nang nga lta bu la bden par yod pa de bden zer ba ni gzhan gyi zer zlos kho na las rang la don gyi spyi gang yang ma shar pa'i blun gtam yin te/chos nyid rang ldog gi grub lugs gcig dang grub mtha' gnyis gas 'dod pa ltar grub lugs gnyis te gsum ga so sor byas pas rang ldog la gtad so med pa dang lugs gnyi ga'i de'ang gzhi'i sdod tshul la ma song bar grub mthas bzhag pa tsam du 'gro bas des ni dag snang sbyong ba'i khul byas kyang don gyis thams cad la skur ba btab pa yin no/ / de dag gis dag snang sbyong khul byed pa'i rtsa ba'ang phal mo che grub mtha' so so'i rnam gzhag ci yang ma shar bas dgag sgrub byed pa'i lce rtsa thung ngur gyur nas de'i rdzun 'geb la dag snang sbyangs pa yin rgyu'i zob byas pa yin la/ 'ga' zhig ni dgag pa byas na chos spong gi nyes pa 'byung dogs nas de la 'dzem pa'i lugs yin 'dug kyang de ni gnad ma go ba'i skyon yin gyi lugs ltar snang la dgag pa byas na nyes pa mi 'byung bar ma zad de la dag snang byas na chos spong gi nyes pa 'byung ba'i tshul/bzhi brgya pa las/ chos 'di de bzhin gshegs rnams kyis/ / rtsod pa mdzad phyir gsungs ma yin/ / 'on kyang me yis bud shing ltar/ / 'di yis phas kyi rgol ba sreg / ces dang / dbu ma 'jug par/ bstan bcos 908

ra / /chebabadza gas cha dasas dgakalas dpyad rtsod la chags pa'i phyir/ / ma mdzad rnam grol phyir ni de nyid bstan/ / gal te de nyid rnam par dpyad pa na/ / gzhan gzhung 'jig par 'gyur la nyes pa med/ / ces gsungs shing / mdo las kyang / dge slong dag gam mkhas rnams kyis/ / bsregs bcad brdar ba'i gser bzhin du/ / legs par brtags nas nga yi bka'/ / blangs par bya yi gus phyir min/ / zhes rgyal ba'i bka' la'ang gus zhen tsam gyis mi 'jug par sgras zin dang dgongs don la rigs pas dpyad nayo'ador len byed dgos par gsungs so/ / rgyal ba'i dgongs pa dang mi mthun zhing dri ma med pa'i rigs lam dang 'gal ba'i lugs ltar snang la dad pa byas pa de dad pa go log yin pas khe las nyen che ste/ rnam par 'thag pa thams cad bsdus pa'i mdo las chos ma yin pa chos su bzung na'ang chos spong du 'gro bar gsungs la/ dbu ma rin chen 'phreng bar yang / dad pa can ni gzung nyes pas/ / gcig shos sdang phyir khros pa yis/ / dad pa can yang bsreg bshad na/ / sdang bas phyir phyogs smos ci dgos/ / zhes dad pa byed tshul ma shes na'ang phung la sdang zhugasakyis kyang phung ba 'dra bar gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ / der ma zad chos yang dag dang ltar snang thams cad la cha mnyam du dad pa sbyangs pas chog na ston pa yang dag dang ltar snang thams cad la dad pa sbyangs na'ang phan yon 'byung dgos rgyur snang mod kyang 'jig rten pa'i lha sogs la skyabs su song na skyabs 'gro btang ste legs tshogs kyi rtsa ba 'chad par mdo bstan bcos kun las gsungs pas dad pa yin khul byas tshad 'tsheng ba zhig min no/ / des na rjebla ma'i lugs bzang 'di la shes nas dad pa thob par byed pa la lugs gzhan la nor 'khrul gyi skyon yod pa rnams rje bla mas bsal tshul dang de dag la legs pa'i cha gang yod lugs 'dir yang tshang tshul shes tshe dper na 909

/ /gung thangabastanaba'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/'phags yul gyi grub mtha' 'og ma so so'i lugs legs par shes nas skas kyi gdang bu bzhin 'og ma 'og ma las gong ma gong ma khyad zhugs tshul gyi rim pas thal 'gyur pa'i khyad chos thun mong ma yin pa rnams go ba bzhin du rje'i bstan pa 'di'ang grub mtha' kun gyi nang nas rgyal mtshan gyi tog ltar khyad du 'phags tshul shes pa gcig 'ongs par 'dug kyang bod kyi grub mtha' phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa'i gzhung de 'dra zhig sngon chad mi snang bas/ snga sor skyabs mgon thams cad gzigs pa chen po rje btsun 'jigs med dbang po'i zhabs la gsol ba btab ste zhal gyis bzhes kyang mgo tshugs tsam las gdul bya'i skal ba'i dbang gis mjug rdzogs par rtsom rgyur ma song de nasagrub mtha' rgya mtsho'i pha rol tu son pa la rje bla ma 'di nyid lta bu zhig sa steng 'dir med par mthong nas nyid la zhus pas dgyes bzhin zhal gyis bzhes shing grub mtha'i dgag gzhag sogs 'byam klas pa'i gzhung shin tu rgyas pa zhig gnang bzhed thog mar yod na'ang chos srid 'phrin las kyi rlabs phreng gcig rjes gcig non gyis bar mtshams med pa lta bus long skabs phrogs te re zhig rtsom rgyur ma song / da ni dag pa mkha' spyod la 'byon pa'i dgongs gtad bzlog tu med pa dang nye bar gtugs song bas bstan pa'i btsas dang phyi rabs kyi gdul bya rnams la nyid kyi zhal skyin lta bur legs bshad kyi dga' ston 'di nyid gnang rgyu cha ma tshang dogs pas shin tu tsha drag mdzad de rnam zla dgun gyi grang sgang dang nyi ma thung dus yin kyang grub mtha' la mkho ba'i phyag dpe mang po gzigs rgyu dang / sam ṭar phyag bris gnang rgyu'i skor phal cher mtshan mo mar ma'i ngos la gnang nas drung yig blo bzang dar ma dang ngag dbang phun tshogs ye shes dpal ldan gsum la bkram ste 'brir bcug pa sogs sku tshags la ma 'dzem pa'i hur skyed chen po mdzad/910

sa / /rje btsunas zang ༄ blo dganas cesanadus dang skal bas snga ma'i thugs bzhed ji lta ba'i rgyas pa zhig gnang ma thub kyang grub mtha' so so'i 'dod tshul thun mong ma yin pa gzhi che ba'i rigs gsal bar thon pa 'dus che la go bde zhing 'gal zlos ma 'brel sogs kyi skyon gyis cha tsam yang ma reg pa sngon med pa'i legs bshad kyi gter chen por gyur pa ni mtha' dbus kyi mkhas pa blo gros che zhing gzu bor gnas ba su zhig gis bltas kyang bsnyon du med pa 'di yin no/ / dug 'don mkhas pa'i sman sbyor ji bzhin grub mtha' so so'i lhad bsal te/ /dngos gzhi thar 'dod skye bo'i 'jug ngogs rgyal ba'i dgongs pa nyag gcig tu/ / 'dril ba'i dag snang nor bu'i 'od kyis chos spong nyes pa'i mun pa sel/ / gsung rab ma lus gdams par shar ba'i mgon khyod rnam thar e ma rmad/ / la la rang gzhan grub mtha'i bzhed gzhung phyogs tsam ma shes par/ / mthong tshad kun la skyabs su mchi zhes zlos pa lhur len te/ / de skad bslab pa'i ne tsor grub mtha'i sdang zhugs med na yang / /rmongs tsam nyid las chos la dag snang sbyang ba ga la yin/ / gzhi lam 'bras bu'i rnam bzhag ma chags par/ / dmar ser cod pan tsam gyi grub mtha' dang / / sde dgon chags sdang kho nas rgyal pa'i bstan/ /'dzin par 'dod pa kye ma shin tu 'khrul/ / sngon med legs gsung mig sman thur ma yis/ / blo min phye ste rab 'byams grub pa'i mtha'i/ / de nyid mthong na 'jam dpal snying po yi/ / bstan la shes nas dad pa thob par 'gyur/ / zhes pa'ang bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /lo mjug tu cha har slob dpon blo bzang dbang 'phel dang dur bed blo bzang bkra shis sogs 'byor nas drag zhan so so'i zhu shog dngos skyes rnams phul/ de dag la 'jigs byed sngags btu seng gdong ma gtso 'khor gsum 'jam dbyangs dkar po dang nag po sgrol dkar rnams kyi rjes gnang 911

༄/ /yo ngabastanapa'isgroname'i khrung ཿma/sogasasnal/ su nyid g.yas ru'i zhabs drung kun dga' rnam rgyal dang gu thi blo bzang bkra shis dpon g.yog or du su hang gin tā pe zis nyid la mtshams zhusadang dgon par ma ṇi sgrub rgyur btang ba'i mi sna dge bskos rgyal mtshan dang ja lang bsod nams dpal ldan ngo g.yog rnams 'byor nas mjal kha zhus/ /dgung lo re drug pa chu khyi'i lo'i gsar tshes kyi dga' ston sngar rgyun ltar mdzad/ 'ja' 'khyil du rang lo drug cu re drug pa'i zla ba dang po'i tshes gnyis kyi tho rangs rmi lam gsal ba zhig la khang pa zhig gi nang na lcang skya rdo rje 'chang khri chung zhig la bzang po'i bzhugs stangs kyis bzhugs 'dug pa la ngedakyis sgom sgrub sogs byed pa la 'du 'dzi sna tshogs kyis par bcad nas thog tu mi khel ba zhig 'dug pas de la thabs ci byas na phan zhus par khyed rang gi snying ljang gur bsgoms na phan zhes dang / gzhan yang gsung 'phros 'ga' zhig gnang pa'i mjug tu/ 'khor 'das sna tshogs kyi me tog bkra ba/ /rang sems mes po yi 'phrul du gda' zhing / / sems nyid rgan po de'i gzhi rtsa bcad tshe/ / 'di yin 'di min gyi ngos bzung bral zhing / /rig rig tur tur gyi gsal nyams che la/ / dga' dga' bde bde yi nyams myong ngo mtshar/ / rtogs ldan rgan po yis ngo 'phrod 'gyur gyi/ /rtog ge mgo mkhregs tshos yus kyang ci cha/ / ha ha/ zhes gsungs pa'i mod la gnyid sad/ ces gsungs 'dug pa ni sngags kyi rtogs pa khyad par can dang zab mo'i lta ba zung du 'brel ba'i lam rtags ya mtshan pa zhig yin nam snyam yang 'phags chen dam pa rnams kyi gsang ba ni nang phan tshun so so rang gi ye shes kyispyod yul du gyur pa las tshur mthong byis pa'i blo gros kyis kha tshon gcod par mi nus so/ /tshes gcig nas zhabs drung kun dga' rnam rgyal gyis zhus ngor khong dpon g.yog sogs la rgyal dbang gsung gi gnas brtan phyag 912

༄/ /rjebs thazangachosakye lta ga4gtsalad+madakarasog namachod sogs kyi ljags lung bla ma'i rnal 'byor don gnyis lhun grub ma'i khrid bcugacig zhal dang sgrol dkar bde mchog dkar po lha mo rnams kyis rjes gnang / gzhan yang hang gin dge bskos dang ja lang o rad ca khir chi rdo rje bkra shis ka le tā tshe ring o thog g.yang skyabs car gu chi so so'i 'dod mos ltar sgrol ljang rta mgrin gdugs dkar zhal phyag yongs rdzogs skyabs khrid rnams stsal/ yang zhabs drung dpon g.yog sogs bcu skor la nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i dbang dur khrod bdag po dang spyan ras gzigs kyi rjes gnang gtor ma brgya rtsa'i khrid zhabs drung la mgon po snying zhugs kyi rjes gnang lcang skya rol pa'i rdo rje dang nyid kyi gsung bka' rgya'i skor gye ljags lung bcas rim par gnang / 'grul pa spyi sger nas dgon par mang 'gyed gya nom pa zhus hang gin pe zi'i ma ṇi yang bla brang nas khur blangs byas te smon lam dang sprags nas bsgrubs/ rje nyid khri zhal 'dzin gnang pa'i thog yin min la ma ltosapar dge 'dun gyi skyong khur thugs la brnag pas sngar rang gi phyag rdzas steng nas dgon lung gi cho 'phrul smon lam lan gsum dang gzhan la rteng bskul mdzad nas lan bcu gnyis bcas bsdoms pas bco lnga gnang 'dug la rje nyid la mjal bar 'ongs pa'i zhor gyis dge 'dun la mang 'gyed byung ba ni bgrang gis mi lang ngo / / dgon 'dir ma zad phyogs kyi dgon sgrub sde sogs la phebs te cung zad re bzhugs pa'i dus na'ang der phyogs ris med kyibla ma dge bshes dpon mi drag 'byor ldan gyi sbyin bdag du ma pad+ma'i tshal la bung ba bzhin du ngang gis 'dus te yul la g.yang chags sa la byin bab snod bcud thams cad bag dro bas chos 'chad nyan gyis 'ur chem me bsnyen bkur longs spyod kyis snum chil le che chung thams cad yid dga' spro lhang lhang ba'i ngang nas 'gro ba/ phyogs gzhan gyi mi zhig 'ongs nas bltas na'ang 913

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i me'i khrung 'bum/dgon 'di chos srid dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa'i bste gnas su 'dug snyam nas yid smon 'chor ba zhig yod pa ni bskal ba rgya mtshor goms pa'i tshogs gnyis kyi bdag po'i 'bras bu'i cha shas tsam yin te/ sgom lam gyi byed pa ston pa'i rgyan las/ byang chub dang ni rten mchod nyid/ / ces gang du bzhugs pa'i gnas de skye dgu'i mchod pa'i rten du 'gro bar gsungs la/phrugs kyi tshom las kyang / dgon pa'am yang na grong dag gam/ / gshong ngam thang bu dag kyang rung / / gang na 'phags pa bzhugs pa yi/ / sa de yid du 'ong ba yin/ / zhes pa ltar der thang gcig bzhugs pa tsam gyis bde skyid 'byung na dgon de'i chos kyi gdan khri bzung ba'i tshe 'dod dgu char du bsnyil ba smos mi dgos te/ sa skya'i legs bshad las/ dam pa dpon du bskos gyur na/ / don 'grub pa dang bde skyid 'thob/ / nor bu rgyal mtshan rtser mchod na/ / yul phyogs dge zhes mkhas rnams sgrogs/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ / bdag nyid chen po 'di lta bu'i sku bsod dang 'phrin las kyis rang shugs la 'ongs pa de lta bu gzhan phal cher rang la lo gcig gnyis tsam gyi khur bab pa'i dus rang gi nus pa rtsal sprug byas shing gzhan la thabs sna tshogs kyis bskul nas 'bad kyang 'ong ba'i re ba med de/ 'dul ba lung las/ 'di na rang gi bsod nams mthu ldan la/ / ji ltar dgos pa ngang gis 'grub 'gyur te/ / de lta bu ni skye bo dman pa la/ / 'bad pa brgya dag gis kyang 'byung mi 'gyur/ / zhes gsungs pa bzhin no/ dgon pa'i lha khang so so dang btsan khang gnas khang rje gong ma'i sku gdung lha khang rnams su phebs nas mchod 'bul dang bcas rten gyi drung du thugs bskyed smon lam dang srung ma rnams la 'azin bcol nan tan mdzad cing / ba 'ong 'jig rten mgon po'i mdun du'ang mchod pa phul te thugs bskyed smon lam rgya chen 914

༄/ /༄tsotshosangachosamigyi ga4ga༅4sagatasadagagapo gnang / dgon lung gi btsan khang chen mo rnying skyon che bar nyid nas mgo 'dren gnang ste sog yul nas 'bul sdud dga' rab byung yod pa bzhin dgon pa'i las byed rnams la lo 'dir cis kyang gsar gso byed rgyu'i zhal bkod zhib tu gnang / smon lam gyi skabs mchod mjal du 'ongs pa'i skye pho mo mang por mjal kha gu yangs gnang ste gzungs sngags zab mo rna lam du gsung sgrog mdzad/ bco lnga'i nyin dgon lung chos skyong chen mo chos ra nas bla brang du phebs te rje nyid la lha dar dri med phul nas bstan 'gro'i dpal du zhabs pad brtan par bzhugs pa'i gsol ba nan tan dang / sngar btsan khang du byon nas 'azin bcol gnang dus bstan 'gro spyi sger gyi don gal chen 'ga' zhig zhal nas dngos su ma gsung bar thugs la dmigs te gnyer gtad mdzad pa'i skor re re nas smos te de de bzhin du sgrub rgyu'i khas len phul bar dgyes pa'i bsngags brjod mdzad/ smon lam grol nas rdo ba zhabs drung li kyā rgyud pa bla ma rgyud zur dpa' rin chos rje o'u han sku skye sogs bzhi bcu skor la byams chos sde lnga spyod 'jug nyid kyis gsar rtsom gnang ba'i grub mtha' legs bshad shel gyi me long rnams kyi ljags lung gnang / de dus spyod 'jug gi lung gnang skabs mi rtag pa ston pa'i tshig 'ga' zhig las 'phros te thugs skyo ba'i gsung mang du phebs shing / grub mtha'i lung grub pa'i mjug tu nged rang gis da res kyi lung 'dis lung 'don rgyu'imatshams byas pa yin phyin rang lung 'dra mang po 'don mi thub ces kyang gsungs 'dug / mchod rten thang gi sngo kho zhabs drung sogs sbyin bdag 'ga' zhig gis byams pa'i gos sku zhig gtad gnyer zhus pa nyid nas wang zhabs drung la zhal bkod gnang ste/ khong gis mgo 'dren mdzad nas gos skubazo khyad par du 'phags pa srid du 'dom dgu lhag tsam bzhengs zin pa 915

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/sbyin bdag rnams kyis nyid la rab gnas zhus par 'bri gu'i ba za bla ma 'don grogs dang bcas pa la gos sku de nyid dang gsar bzhengs tsan dan gyi thub pa grong khyer ma sogs rten gsar rnying mang po la rab gnas byed du bcug cing /nyid nas kyang byams pa'i gos sku la rab gnas mdor bsdus mdzad de shis par brjod pa'i me tog gi char phab byams pas dam bcas pa'i gzungs dang smon lam sogs gsungs te 'brel tshad mtha' dag rgyal ba byams pa mgon pos rjes su 'dzin pa'i spyan dmigs nan cher mdzad/ ba za bla ma la sgrub mchod pa rnams kyis thog drangs skya ser brgya phrag kha shas la phyag rdor 'khor chen gyi dbang dang don gnyer can nyung 'dus la lho brag bka' 'bum gyi lung bcas gnang 'jug par mdzad/ rje nyid re zhig bcad rgya'i ngos thugs dam bskyangs/ zla ba gnyis pa'i tshes brgyad la byams pa 'bum gling gi yung zhabs drung sogs bsgrub bya bzhi la bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa gnang / mā thi dgonanas gser khri sprul sku grwa rgan 'ga' zhig bcas slebs nas lo snga mar 'du khang nang du khe pi su'i gral gdan gsar ba bcu drug 'jog pa gnang ba'i legs 'bul zhus hal ha'i sen no yon rin chen rdo rje'i mi sna dang no yon hu thog thu'i mi sna rnams 'ongs par 'byor lan dang 'dod chos sogs stsal/snga lo nas wang zhabs drung rin po che dang smon lam bla ma rnam gnyis 'byon pa la bar chad che tshul mkhyen cing gzigs te wang bla brang gi grwa pa rnams la sku rim sgrub rgyu'i zhal bkod yang yang phebs/ de don bzhin khong rnam gnyis lhan du lam la zhugs nas yar phebs kyang smon lam bla mar lha thor bud de phyir ldog dgos byung / wang zhabs drung rin po che'ang khal mar nad yams mched cing kha ba mthug po bab pa bcas gang ci nas lam bgrod dka' ba byung bar zhabs phyi pa rnams kyis phyir ldog pa'i 'azen khyer byas na'ang khong rang 916

༄/ /ldebatsun khazang gsang2khu pamadagarasadabyung/gis lo snga mar rje 'di bas khyed kyis nges par nged la 'dun pa yod na lo 'dir pheb dgos de las 'gyed na nam phebs kyang khyad med ces dogs pa can gye gsung nan phebs yod pa de thugs la bcings te sku tshag la ma 'dzem par byon pa or du su'i sa sne zin pa nas bzung nyid kyi bkod khyab bzhin ho sho'u so so nas u la'i mthun rkyen legs par bsgrub par brten bde bar phyag phebs te nyid la mjal phrad zhus shing gang ci'i gsung gleng rgya cher 'phel/sku tsha smon lam bla ma'i zhabs drung dang po har chin du gdan dren byed dus grwa parnams la ha cang ma 'gyangs par lo re gnyis kyi mtshams su 'dir 'ongs nas rim gyis bod du song chog pa'i zhal bkod gnang yod kyang rjes nas khong tshos sa thag ring stabs ji bzhin thog tu khel dka' tshul gyi rgyu mtshan zhus pa langed kyis dus btab pa der yong ma thub phyin slar nam 'ongs na'ang khyad med gsung nas stabs 'grig dus dang bstun chog pa'i bka' lan gnang ba ni dus de las 'dzur na nam 'ongs kyang mjal rgyur mi 'gro ba mkhyen nas gsungs par mngon/ de nas wang bla brang du gdan drangs nas zhabs drung chog grogs dang bcas pas bde mchog dkar po'i brtan bzhugs kyi cho ga dang sprags nas lha rdzas nang mdzod gos chen tshags drub kyi sku gsung thugs rten bzhugs gdan rgyab yol na bza' 'ga' zhig mchod rdzas 'ga' zhig shel dang dkar yol sogs kyi snod spyad du ma gha ri'i 'khor lo gcig gos chen gsum dngul srang brgya tsan dan gyi don yod zhags pa bcas dang / sku skye blo gros chos ldan phyag mdzod chos rje bkra shis rab brtan lha btsun ye shes bsam 'grub sku skye ye shes lhun grub tā bla ma phyogs las rnam rgyal sogs zhabs phyi ba dang skyel mi so so nas kyang 'bul ba gya nom pa bstar te zhabs drung rin po ches dngul srang nyi shu'i maṇ+ḍal phyag tu thogs nas zhabs pad brtan pa'i 917

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'isgroname'i gsung 'bum/gsol ba btab par dgyes pa'i bka' lan gnang / nyid nas kyang gser khri sprul sku btang ste khong la dngul ma mdzod btags sku gsung thugs rten bzhugs gdan rgyab yol na bza' sham chas kyi skor sne ring dang bcas cha tshang spos snam sogs dngos 'bul gtos che ba dang bcas zhabs brtan 'bul 'jug pa gnang / sku 'bum mkhan po gsar ba mi nyag sprul sku dpon g.yog mjal khar 'ongs pa la rje rin po che'i li sku mdzod btags dang bcas gnang nas thugs la btags pa'i bslab ston mdzad/ sbyin bdag a lag shā wang gzugs gzhi ma bde bar brtag zhus 'bul mi jas tshang ngo g.yog mngags don bzhin brtag lan dang phyag sman sogs bka' drin bskyangs/ 'ja' klong 'khyil bar zla ba gnyis pa'i nyi shu gcig gi mtshan mo rtsang gi sa cha yin nam snyam pa zhig na rgyab ngos su snar thang yin snyam pa'i dgon pa che ba gtsug lag khang dmar po rim pa mang zhing spen pad dang gasdir sogs phun sum tshogs pa zhig mdun ngos na khang skor mang po dang gtsug lag khang shin tu mang po 'dug pas khang ba che ba zhig gi nang na sa skya khri chen dbang sdud snying po yin rgyu'i sngags chas dwangs zhu can gzi brjid che ba zhig bzhugs 'dug pas nged la dgyes nyams che ba mdzad pa la nged kyis snga mo bdag chen rdo rje 'chang ngag dbangakun dga' blo gros kyis rjes su bzung ba'i lo rgyus sogs mang po zhus shingayid skyo bas mchi ma bton pa la khri chen yin rgyu pa nges khyod ma ngu bar bdag chen rdo rje 'chang gis mchod rten la mjal kha zhus ngas khyod la sa skya'i lta ba 'chad ces lam 'bras kyi lta ba 'khor 'das dbyer med yin nam snyam pa mang po zhig gsung byung ba mis gsungs pa ni 'di dus yin/ gsum pa'i tshes la hal ha mir gen wang gi mi sna slob dpon ye shes dang dbu mdzad tshul khrims 'byor bar sbyin bdag wang la tshe dpag med kyi sku thang rab gnas brgya 918

sa / /chubatsunablobazang gsang2khu pabadaganasang kha/rtsa ma dang nyid kyi gsungs 'bum tshar gcig brtag lan bcas bskur cing yel chi rnams la rta mgrin dang khro rgyal gtsug tor 'bar ba gnyis kyi rjes gnang mkha' spyod ma'i sgrub thabs bde chen nye lam dang gtum mo'i nyams len mdor bsdus kyi lung bcas gnang / sum pa mkhan chen gyi sprul sku gdan sar 'khod rgyur gdan 'dren nan che ba bzhin sprul sku pheb nyin wang paṇ+ḍi ta zhabs drung dang gser khri sprul sku rnam gnyis zhabs phyir khrid nas sum pabla brang du phebs te sprul sku'i 'phrin las kyi sgo 'byed pa'i thog ma'i rten 'brel bsgrigs/ sngar nas sku cung zad ldem tshul bstan pa 'di skabs nas rim gyis bab lci ru song bar sa chu brjes nas thu'u bkwan gzhis gar phebs wang zhabs drung rin po che sku'i gam du bcar bzhugs mdzad/ sa ga zla ba'i yar tshes la mchod rten thang gi zang nga zhabs drung phyag gnyer grwa rgan grwa ba mang po zhig dang bcas slebs nas brtan bzhugs 'bul zhing zhabs pad brtan pa'i gsol ba btab par dgyes pa'i bka' lan dang / dgon pa'i spyi 'jog tu ras gzhi mtshal ma la gser gyis bris pa'i tshe dpag med kyi 'bum sku'i stong thang stsal cing mi ring bar dgon pa'i khri'i dgongs pa'ang zhus nas khri 'gyed dang spyi 'jog tu rje yab sras kyi li ma gsum 'jog pa mdzad/ rje 'dibs kho bo chung dus skyes yul nas dgon lung du chas skabs mchod rten thang bkra shis dar rgyas gling 'dir gdan drangs nas 'azin las kyi sgo 'byed pa'i thog ma'i rten 'brel sgo du ma nas bsgrigs shing dge ldan pa'i chos grwa zhig 'jal ba'i dang po'ang yin gsung nas dgon yon mchod la thugs gtsigs shin tu che zhing skya ser tshang mas kyang kha zhe med pa'i dad pas phral phugs kyi bya ba rnams nyid kho na la re ltos byed cing / nyid nas kyang skabs su gang bab pa'i chos srid kyi brtse skyong bka' drin tshad med pa gnang 'dug / snga sor 919

༄/ /gung thang bstan ba'isgoname'i gsung 'bum/gong ma'i mtshams zhur mngags pa'i pi lig thu gu thi ngag dbang bstan 'phel ngo g.yog 'byor nas 7gong ma'i gnang sbyin gyi gos chen rnams dang mchog dman du ma'i zhu shog dngos skyes bcas phul par 7gong ma'i mtshams zhu'i skor gyi sku don dgongs bzhed ltar grub pa la thugs shin tu mnyes pa'i rnam pa mdzad/ el chis pho brang du 'gro dus blo rtse gtad pher ba'i bla dpon che rigs la gtad gnyer gyi gsung shog gnang dgos tshul zhus par gtad gnyer bgyid pa gzhir bcas kyang thog tu khel ba'i nges pa med blo rtse bla ma dkon mchog kho na la gtod ces gsungs pa bzhin pho brang du 'byor ma thag gtad yul 'ga' zhig bzhugs med cing yod pa rnams la bkod khyab zhu long yang ma byung bar sku don phral du grub song ba dang / de'ang el chi song rjes dgun zla tha ma'i tshes gsum gyi nyin rgya nag pa'i rim gror gsol mchod ran bas sang nas nyin gsum gyi ring spyi sger gyi chos skyong la gsol mchod gzab rgyas thongs gsungs nas de bzhin bsgrubs pa dang / el chis zla ba de'i tshes bzhi'i nyin cur gan du rgyu mtshan zhus nas lnga'i nyin 'dzin pa bstan te drug gi zhog ka mtshams zhus grub pa dang / rje nyid nas sku rim sgrub tu bcug pa'i nyin gsum po dus 'grigs pa byung 'dug pas sgrib bral ye shes kyi spyan mnga' ba'i sgrub byed 'di las lhag pa mi dgos pa lta bu yin no/ /dpyid kyi ring zhabs brtan dkyus ma rnams sngar rgyun ltar bsgrubs te de'i mu mthud nas bsnyung gzhi dwangs thabs su lha bla ma mo pa rtsis pa mchog dman ris meda'i lung bstan zhus nas gtong ba'i sgo 'phar phyes te sku 'bum bkra shis 'khyil gser khog chu bzang dgon rnams su sgrol ma gdugs sher seng gdong ma'i zlog sgyur 'gro gang che mdung nag 'jam dbyangs dgon du tshe chog gang 'grub mchod rten thang du rnam rgyal gzungs ring 'bum dang tshe gzungs 920

༄/ /༄tso tha4cho migyi gartegatsosas khabacas/'bum ther thar pa gling du gdugs dkar khri tshar chos bzang du sher snying khri tshar dgon lung tshogs chen du bka' 'gyur tshar gnyis yum rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum tshar kha shas gdugs sher sri zlog grangs gsog pa sogs zhabs brtan rgyun ldan/ rgyud pa la spyi bskang grangs gsog pa'i sgo nas drug cu pa 'bum ther lha mo'i pho brang du bskang bshags gang mang dang bam skong 'khrugs skong / bla brang nang du wang hu thog thu 'dan ma grub chen sprul sku bam zhabs drung sems nyid zhabs drung dpa' rin rgyud zur sogs slob dpon so sos dbu mdzad nas cho ga pa mang nyung ci rigs kyis phyag rdor 'khor chen gyi gzungs ring 'bum ther sbyin sreg bcas khyung nag dang mgon po'i bsnyen pa sbyin sreg bcas khro bcu dang gtsug gtor 'bar ba'i sgo nas byad zlog gdugs dkar zlog chen seng gdong ma dang rta mgrin gyi gtor zlog sogs sgrub pa khag mang po dang / seng bar rnams su rnam rgyal stong mchod dang maṇ+ḍal bzhi pa bzang spyod 'chi blu brgya bzhi 'bar ma sogs gto bcos kyi rigs srung ma'i gsol mchod rgyun ldan/ brgya rtsa klu gtor 'byung bzhi lan chags gtor ma rnams grangs gsog bcug pa nang phyogs bzhir 'byung ba lnga'i satsu 'bum ther re mchod rten dang 'bum khang rnying ba rnams la dkar rtsi gsol ba sogs zhi drag gi rim gro mang po nyin mtshan bar ma chad du bsgrubs/de dus gsung mgur gnang ba ni/ skyabs sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun rnams/ / don gcig 'dus bla mar gsol ba 'debs/ / rkyen bar chad lam du bsgyur ba dang / / blo chos su 'gro bar byin gyes rlobs/ / sprang chos med kho bo tshe 'di la/ / dgra nad gdon du mas gtses na yang / / mgon mchog gsum skyabs 'og chud pa las/ / dus da bar tshe srog 'gag ma gyur/ / lo chu khyi rang lo re drug 'dir/ / lo spar me'i mi mthun mang 'dzom 921

/ /gung nga na ba'ithonayo gsung 'bum/zhing / / dgra'i bsam ngan sbyor tsub brtsams sogs kyis/ / bdag sngon bsags las ngan bskul pa las/ / spyir rkyen ngan du ma ru 'dzings shing / /sgos sgyu lus phung po nad kyis zin/ / blo gzu bo can rnams sems khral byed/ / dgra phrag dog can rnams khong 'dzum shor/ / sha tsha ba'i slob 'khor g.yog rnams kyis/ / mo rtsis pa lha babs zer tshad la/ / lan mang du dris nas de dag gis/ / thabs rim gro gang smras thams cad bsgrubs/ / nyams can gye sman pa mkhas pa 'ga'/ / go bstun gyis sman sten zas spyod gzab/ / mo phywa dang rtsa chu brtag mkhan rnams/ / kha mthun par skyon med khags theg zer/ / bdag rang gi blo gding 'di 'cha' ste/ / re dogs dang tsab tsub mi byed par/ / ci byung yang dkon mchog mkhyen snyam du/ / yid bde 'bol ngang nas gtong len bsgom/ / bdag nad 'dis shi yang 'gyod pa med/ / lo deng gi rgan po'i rtse mor son/ / tshe phyi ma'i lam rgyags mi nyung bsags/ / lha bla ma'i thugs rjes 'dzin par nges/ / dus da res nad las grol kyang legs/ / chos nyams len rgya chen ma nus kyang / / lha bla mar dad pas gsol 'debs dang / / sems bzang pos gzhan phan gang 'grub bgyid/ / yang skabs 'gar bsam tshe na mkhan dang / / nad rtog pas phar btags tsam ma gtogs/ / don gshis la grub pa mi 'dug pas/ / nga na bar sems pa 'khrul lam snyam/ / don des na kho bo na ba 'di/ / dgra bdag 'dzin 'gong po'i 'phrul du go / kho phaṭa sgra drag pos mthar bskrad nas/ / gshis 'chi med ngang du skyid nyal byed/ / mkha' khyab kye 'jig rten khams kun na/ / nad drag pos mkhar ba ji snyed kun/ / bdag na pa 'di yis go chod nas/ / kun nad las sgol ba'i smon pa bgyid/ / gdon gnod byed byad phur mkhan la sogs/ / bsam sbyor ngan rtsom pa thams cad 922

༄/ /sdebs7tha4cho minyi gangagatsolamadabasag nakyang / /las ngan pa'i 'bras bu mi myong bar/ / dus rtag tu bde la spyod par smon/ / bdag na ba'i g.yog byed rim gro sgrub/ / sman ster sogs phan pa sgrub pa kun/ / tshe ring zhing nad med bde skyid rgyas/ / mchog gtan bde myuradu thongapar shog / ces pa 'di 'ang 〉dharma badz+ra gyis rang lo re drug skabs nad kyis yun ring mnar dus gsems kyi 'char sgo glur blangs pa'o/ / zhes pa'o/ / de ltar sa chu brjes nas sman bcos rim gro stobs chen bgyis kyang sgung gzhi la phan skyed chen po med par zla ba lnga pa'i bcu bdun gyi nyin dgon lung du phebs/ de nas zhabs gras rnams la thugs dgyes pa'i rnam pas da snga khyed tshos gzhan gyi lung bstan la babs pa'i rim gro rnams tha na mdos gto glud yan chad chad lus med par bsgrubs pa yin mod da nged kyi sems la shar tshod kyi rim gro 'ga' zhig sgrub dgos gsungs nyid rang gi dgongs pas bcad de zhal bkod gnang ba bzhin slar yang sku 'bum tshogs chen du sman chog rgyas pa khri tshar mang 'dus ri khrod dang dgon lung ri khrod gnyis la sman chog bsdus pa dang 'brel bar sman bla'i mtshan dang gzungs 'bum phrag re dang / gsar rtsom a ru ra'i stong mchod kyi cho ga ltar stong mchod mchod rten thang du rnam rgyal gzungs ring 'bum dang lan chags gtor ma 'bum thar ba gling du ke ka ni dang dur ga te 'bum phrag bcu re 'brugayang dgon dang khran tsong ri khrod gnyis la klu dbang rgyal po'i snying po 'bum phrag bcu re chos bzang ri khrod du gnas brtan phyag mchod rgyas pa snyong dang bsdus pa gang 'grub dgon lung tshogs chen du ltung bshags 'bum dang dmigs brtse ma bye ba rgyud pa la yig brgya 'bum phrag bcu lung dkar dang rgyal sras ri khrod gnyis la yig brgya 'bum phrag gsum bla brang nang du cho ga pa nyi shusadage ldan ril sgrub dang dge 'dun pa brgya dang nyi shus sgyung gnas stong 923

༄/ /gung thang bstan ba'isgronarme'i gsung 'bum/srung rgyu rnams rim gyis btsugs/ rje gong ma dang lcang skya gong ma sum pa mkhan chen rnams kyi gdung rten dang mar tshang bla chen zhi bar 'od dpag med sogs rten byin can rnams la dkon mchog spyi mchod dang 'brel bar bzang spyod grangs gsog pa dang / slob dpon gyi sku dang gsol 'debs dpar du bkod nas grangs mang dpar zhing gsol 'debs 'bum 'don pa dang rtsa gsum gyi lha la tshogs brgya gang 'grub gsar rtsom grog sbyin gtong tshul gyi cho ga ltar dge slong 'ga' zhig gis dbyar gyi rag grog ma la zan sbyin gtong ba dgon pa'i gling gi grwa rkyang rnams la gnang sbyin zi ling dang nem bis sogs kyi btson ma dang ngan slong mang po la sbyin gtong skabs skabs su btsun chung rnams la byis pa'i ston mo gnang rgyu rnams kyang zhal bkod ji lta ba bzhin bsgrubs/ sngar nas wang hu thog thu dang dar han em chi dge legs bsam 'grub zhabs gras bod pa sman pa rnams gros bsdur gyis gsol sman zhus bzhin pa'i thog sbyin bdag pe zi tshe brtan rdo rjes rtse thang pa sman pa mkhas pa zhig zhabs phyir khrid nas 'ongs shing gser khog gi sog po sman pa nyams rgyas can zhig kyang bos te thams cad kyis phyag rtsa chab rtags sogs mjal nas gros bsdur gyis gsol sman zhus/ sngon chad 'grul pa'i rigs la mjal kha med rung rgyu mtshan zhus chog pa yin kyang / rtse thang sman pas lnga pa'i mar ngo 'dir shin tu tsub pas 'grul gtam dang snyun 'dri lta zhog las byed rnams kyisakyang dgongs bstun 'dra ma zhus na bzang zhes phyi'i skad cha zhu rgyu thams cad bcad btang bas chos sde rang gi bla ma dge 'dun gyis zhabs brtan 'bul rgyu dang bkra shis 'khyil nas zhabs brtan 'bul mi sleb pa'i rgyu mtshan rnamasakyang zhu ma thub par sgug sdod byas/ nyer lnga'i nyin zhal nas rtse thang sman pas nga la bar 'dir gegs chag che ba go 'dug nged kyi sems la'ang de 924

༄/ /chabatsunamakhazangalnga 41nyis bdakaram rākhakaring nga la gegs chag chen po zhig yong ngam snyam pa'i dogs pa snang gsung nas nyams ngan pa'i tshul bstan pa la wang baṇ+ḍi tas phyag thal mo sbyar nas rje nyid nas sku tshe'i 'du byed tshe mtha' yas pa'i ngo bor byin gyis brlabs te zhabs pad yun ring du brtan par bzhugs pa'i thugs 'dun gnang dgos/ gal te gzhan don du dgongs pa gtad dgos na gzhan ngor lus gnad bcos pa'i thugs dam la bzhugs pa dang thugs dam gsal 'debs kyi rim pa ji ltar zhu ba'i zhal bkod dang / sprul sku myur du 'byon pa'i zhal shes dang gang du 'byon pa'i zhal bkod gsal po gnang dgos zhes gsol ba btab par dang po cung zad thugs 'tshub pa'i rnam pas sngon sngags pa zhig gis 'chi dus su nye du rnams kyis sngags rgan mkha' spyod du 'byon pa yin pas skyon mi 'dug nged tshos ci drag ces mya ngan byas par nga la'ang dbang yod na mkha' spyod du 'gro ba las 'dir 'dug rgyu 'dam mod kyang rang dbang mi 'dug ces bshad zer de bzhin du nga'ang 'dug rgyu 'dam nas sman bcos rim gro la 'bad bzhin pa 'di yin mod kyang so skye 'ching ba kun ldan la 'chi bdag gshin rje dbang che bas 'dod thog tu 'jog mi 'jog sus shes/ sngon bka' gdams pa'i bla ma zhig gis nga 'chi dus glang 'chi yin zhes gsungs zer de bzhin nga 'chi dus rkang brkyang lag brkyang yin sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang phyag brkyang zhabs brkyang mdzad nas mya ngan las 'da' tshul bstan payin/ mi tshe hril por 'jig rten chos brgyad byas pas ma chog par 'chi khar 'jig rten chos brgyad byas pas ci la phan ston pas rjes 'jug la gnang ba'i thugs dam gsal 'debs 'du shes bcu gcig pa dang 'da' ka ye shes kyis mdo yin pas de dag gi don rnams yid la dran 'jug pa dang sangs rgyas kyi mtshan dang gzungs sngags zab mo rna lam du sgogs pa las lhag pa'i thugs 925

sa / /gung bang bstan pa'ithoname'i gsung 'bum/dam gsal 'debs 'dra mi dgos nga la bsam bzhin du skye ba len pa'i nus pa med las dbang gis skye ba zhig len mod kyang gar skyes ngas mi shes zhes gsungs te zhal cung zad gnag nas bzhugs pas sku drung du sdod mkhan rnams mig mchi mas bkang zhing dran pa stor nas bsdad pa la/ slar yang thugs brtse ba'i rnam pas zhala'adzum pa mdzad de 'o sku skye yong ngo yong ngo yong par ma zad 'dir yong ngo nged tshos dag zhing 'dod mod kyang dag zhing gis nged tsho mi 'dod ngan song gis nged tsho 'dod mod kyang nged tshos ngan song mi 'dod bar nas skye ba zhig len dgos na rang gis gra sgrig bgyis bzhag pa 'dir ma 'ongs par gzhan gyi dpal 'byor la 'tham pas ci byed ces zhal rtsed lta bu gnang bas/ khong rnams kyang cung zad dran pa rnyed nas bka' drin che legs zhus par nga la blo rtse gzhan med kyang lha bla ma 'ga' zhig gi lung bstan dang rang gi rmi ltas sogs la dpag na nged rang lung pa 'dir da dung lan 'ga' yong rgyu yin pa 'dra zhes sprul sku 'khrul med 'byon pa'i zhal bzhes don gyis 'phang ba'i 'gyur med rdo rje'i gsung gis dbugs dbyung mdzad/lasabyed rnams la khyed tsho'i don dag gal chen 'ga' zhig rtse thang sman pa'i lung bstan gyis bar bcad yod pa min nam ngas bsam na bkra shis 'khyil pa'ang 'ongs nas sgug bsdad yod pa 'dra zhes sus ma zhus kyang mngon mkhyen gyis gzigs nas gsungs pas yin min gyi lan zhu rngo ma thogs/ nyid nas rtse thang sman pa la thag ring gi 'grul pa la mjal kha med pa'i steng du rgyu mtshan kyang zhu ma bcug na khong tsho'i sems pham pas ji ltar byed ces dris pas khos de ring phyi dro nga la brtag gzhi byung bar da skyon med zer ba zhig bab pas sang nyin snyung gzhi'i bab bltas nas 'phar ldang ma byung na gnang nyin nas snyung 'dri sogs zhus chog pa 'dra zhus/ sman pa'i brtag pa dang rje rang nyid kyi snga 926

sa / /che ba ngams minyi ba'i d+ma gakhag sdomakaphyi'igasung gi dbyibs la dpag na rje nyid nam yin kyang tshes bcu zhig dang bstun nas mkha' spyod du 'byon par thugs dgongs gtad yod pas lnga pa'i mar ngo'i tshes bcu'i nyin mkha' spyod du 'byon par chas pa yin kyang brtan bzhugs 'bul mi rnams kyi re ba skong ba sogs dgos pa 'ga' zhig gi dbang gis thugs dgongs bshol bar gdon mi za'o/ /nyer bdun gyi nyin gza' skar gyi sbyor ba'ang phun sum tshogs pas chos sde rang gi khri pa rgya tig zhabs drung sogs bla sprul bcus gtsos pa'i dge 'dun tshang ma dang / 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa sprul sku rin po che'i mi sna sman pa dpon slob dpal mang chung ba dang gsol dpon dbyig gnyen nged kyi dpon po lhun grub bkra shis 'khyil tshogs chen spyi gnyer sogs gzhi byes kyi zhabs brtan 'bul mi rnams kyis gzimachung gi phyi rol nas spyi sger so sos maṇ+ḍal kha btags sku gsung thugs rten gyis gtsos pa'i dngos 'bul gya nom pa btegs nas maṇ+ḍal gyi 'don pa dang zhabs brtan gsol 'debs 'ur chems kyis gsungs shing / wang hu thog thus dgon pa'i bla ma dge 'dun gyi zhu 'bul dang 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa rin po che'i zhu shog grwa tshang so so'i khri gdan zur sogs nang chen spyi sger gyi zhu shog maṇ+ḍal dang bcas sku mdun du khyer nas phyag tu phul/ zhu 'bul gyi yi ge rnams sems nyid zhabs drung la 'don bcug par bkra shis 'khyil spyi'i zhu 'bul gyi/ 'chi med dpal ster lhag pa'i lha tshogs mthus/ /rje btsun bla ma bskal brgyar zhabs brtan shog /ces shis pa brjod pa'i tshig mtshams 'dir dgon pa'i tshogs dung btang bas bcar sdod pa rnams kyis sems la dga' ba skyes shing rje nyid kyang thugs dgyes nyams mdzad/ 'dis mtshon pa'isnga phyir mo rtsis lung bstan phyi nang gi rten 'brel rnams gang legs las rtags mtshan ngan pa zhig su la'ang ma byung ba ni rje nyid kyis brtan g.yo'i ngo 927

༄/ /gung bangabastan pa'i name'i gsung 'bum/bo mtha' dag lhan skyes bde ba'i 'khor lor bsdoms te dga' ba chen po 'ba' zhig gi nang du bzhugs pa de'i rang mdangs dang byin rlabs kyi mthu zhig yin par mngon/ 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa rin po ches nyin rer snga dro sgrol dkar tshe sgrub thun re dang chos skyong rnams la 'azin bcol mdzad bzhin pa dang de ga'i grwa tshang so so nas zhabs brtan rgyun ldan bsgrub bzhin pa dang /dgon lung ma bu dgon gyi grwa rigs sbyin bdag spyi sger nas dad mos kyis mang ja btang ste zhabs brtan bsgrub bzhin pa'i rgyu mtshan rnams snyan du gsol bas thugs mnyes pa'i rnam pa mdzad zhabs brtan 'bul mkhan rnams kyi ngo 'dzin tsam du bka' lan bzang po gnang zhing / 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa rin po cher na bza'i nang gi rtse ma 'ga' zhig gis mtshon 'bul ba gya nom pa bskur te skyabs 'jug dang thugs smon zhus de ga'i gser gdung rnam gnyis la mchod pa 'bul thengs snyan shal 'dod gsol can dang bcas gsol dpon dbyig gnyen la sprad nas drug pa'i tshes bcu'i nyin mchod pa 'bul rgyu cis kyang 'grigs pa byed dgos pa'i zhal bkod mdzad/ rje gong ma de nyid zhing brjes dus bkra shis 'khyil du kun mkhyen gong ma 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa rin po che'i sku gdung la mchod pa 'bul mi mngags te de gar mchod pa phul nyin 'di nas zhing brjes tshul rnam thar du gsungs yod pa bzhin da res kyang mchod thebs dang snyan shal bskur ba 'jam dbyangs bzhad ba sprul pa'i sku rin po ches dbu mdzad de nged dpon slob rnams nas bka' phebs kyi nyin der sku gdung rnam gnyis kyi mdun du phul ba dang / rje nyid dag pa'i zhing du dgongs pa gtad pa dus mtshungs byung 'dug pas stabs 'grigs tsam ma yin par sku tshe snga phyi gnyi gas ched dmigs kyis de ltar gnang ba ni skyabs mgonayab sras gnyis sku tshe'i 'phreng bar thugs skyed smon lam lu gu rgyud du 928

da / /che btsu gas jugadasagasad na'abrel ba'i mthu brtas pa'i 'bras rtags dang / snga phyi nam 'dod du sku tshe 'pho thub pa skye 'chi la rang dbang thob pa'i rang bzhin gyi rtags 'khrul pa med pa gzhan dang ma 'dres pa'i khyad chos bla na med pa zhig go / bod kyi yi ge bsgrigs dus kyang brjod bya'i nyams snga dus dang mi 'dra zhing rgyal ba yab sras gnyis la skye ba'i 'phreng bar rjes su 'dzin pa'i skyabs 'jug nan tan zhu zhing rgyal sras rin po che la ched dmigs kyis skyabs 'jug zhu yig dang / zhwa lu ri spug gi 'du khang gso thebs dngul srang sum brgya skur rgyu rnams sprod yul blo gtad pher ba zhig ma rnyed par thugs khral mdzad kyin yod thog hor chin gnam sngon zhabs drung dang har chin tho yon dharma kirti sogs bod du 'gro mkhan 'ga' zhig mjal du 'ongs par gnam sngon zhabs drung la dngul de dang har chin tho yon la rgyal sras rin po cher 'bul rgyu'i zhu shig sprad de dag la mjal kha med kyang zhal gdams dang gnang skyes kyis mgu bar mdzad/rje nyid sku bsnyel tshul bstan pa nas bzung ste mjal kha bkag pas sku mdun du brelab gzhan med cing nyid kyang sku'i nyams ngan pa las skun zug cher med stabs thugs bag pheb pa'i ngang nas snga rtsom gye skor zhu dag dang / rtsom mjug skong dgos pa rnams rtsom pa gnang bzhin yod pas drug pa'i yar tshes bden bzhi'i chos 'khor bskor ba'i dus chen gyi nyin nā ro mkha' spyod kyi sgrub thabs gsang chen bcud kyi thigs pa je rgyas su btang ba'i mjug rdzogs par grub pa ni cha tshang ba'i gsung rtsom gyi tha mar snang / snga ma mkha' spyod ma'i spyi don ljags rtsom mdzad skabs gsang chen bcud kyi thigs pa 'di'ang bsdus pa zhig mdzad nas mjug ma rdzogs par yod pa la sems nyid zhabs drung gis de nyid je rgyas la btang nas mjug rdzogs par mdzad pa'i skul ma zhus pas zhalanas 'di nged kyi lam yig yin pas phral du thang mar brdal nas mjug 929

/ /gu ba bstan pa'i me'i gsung bum/rdzogs pa dang gzhan du spel ba mi 'grigs gsungs pas khong yang gsung de la dogs pa skyes te de nas bzung rteng skul gyi tshig zur tsam yang zhu ma spobs 'dug / de nyin gsung 'phros kyi zhor du sems nyid zhabs drung dang gu thi ngag dbang bstan 'phel gnyis la rje rang gi nyams snang du shar ba'i lam rim mchod bajod kyi 'brel sgrig gi gsung bshad dang / sems nyid zhabs drung gis zhus ngor khong dang gser khri sprul sku rnam gnyis la mkha' spyod ma'i sgrub thabs gsang chen bcud kyi thigs pa de nyid kyi lung gnang ba ni bka' chos kyi tha ma'o/ / rje nyid sku tshe 'dir mdo sngags kyi gsung chos dang lngags rtsom mang du spel ba'i mjug slar yang chos 'khor bskor ba'i dus chen dang stabs 'grigs pa ni phyis 'byung legs pa'i rten 'brel khyad par can du mngon/'du shes bcu gcig pa'i mdo dang 'da' ka ye shes kyi mdo gnyis kyi sdoms tshig phyag bris mdzad nas wang hu thog thu la gnang bas khong gis de'i steng nas dogs gcod 'ga' zhig zhus par/ dogs lan zhib tu stsal/ 'jig rten gyi mi rnams gnas gcig tu tshogs na chags sdang rmongs gsum gyi dbang gis dgra gnyen bar mar ris su bcad nas phan tshun mthun mi mthun yong ba chos nyid yin pas sngar nas nged kyis mjal kha bkag pa'i skya ser 'dra yod na nged kyi ngos nas khyed cag la phral phugs su dge ba'i smon 'dun shugs drag bskyed pa'is khon 'dzin gyi sems cung zad tsam yang med khyed tsho'i ngos nas kyang 'khon 'dzin dor nas bsam pa bzang po skyed cig ces pa'i phyag bris shig dge bskos la gnang nas tshogs su sgrog bcug pas de 'dra'i rigs 'ga' yodapa rnams dga' dad dang skyo shas kyis blo sna 'gyur nas mjal du 'ongs par dngos su mjal kha gnang stabs ma 'grigs kyang gsung tshig bzang pos tshim par byas/ tshes brgyad kyi nyin gsar rtsom grub mtha'i zhu dag gi 'phro 930

༄/ /sdebatsun ba nyisa'igasangabs pabadakurasadabyugardzogs par grub ste wang hu thog thus phul ba'i byams pa'i gos sku chen mo gzim chung ra skor du sgo khang steng nas leb bkram lta bur bshams te gzigs rtog dang byams pas dam bcas pa'i gzungs gsung nas thugs smon mdzad skabs ga nas 'ong cha med pa'i rlung 'tshub 'jam pos gos sku'i rgyab nas phul te byams pa'i sku yar bzhengs stabs lan 'ga' byung bas zhal 'dzum zhing dgyes tshor chen po mdzad hu thog thu nyid la ched gnyer gyis bsgrubs pa'i pheb byams gsar ba lha rdzas bcas gnang / sngar nas bzo bo las tshan khag 'ga' yong ba la tshes brgyad dgu'i bar du 'grub dgos zhes zhal bkod mdzad yod pa bzhin lha bzos chos bzang 'du khang gi rgya mthongs g.yas g.yon gyi tshe lha gsum dang gdon gsum gyi gnyen po'i lha gtso 'khor gyi logs ris thang ga bzhi grub pa spyan 'bebs zhus par wang hu thog thu la rab gnas gnang bcug / shing bzos bzhugs khri lan gan can 'do li mdun cog sogs las shing chis rgyag mkhan gyis de dag la chis brgyab nas las 'phro cung zad lus yod pa rnams phral du bsgrub rgyu'i zhal bkod mdzad/ zhal nas nang 'di na ngan bas nyi ma 'phul byed du dpe cha lta rtog tsam las gzhan spros pa mi 'dug phyi rol na rim gro ba mang po rim gros brel bzo ba mang po las gas brel grwa ba rnams 'gro 'dug langs gsum gyis brel nas bla brang na ci 'dra'i spros pa yod ang gsung ba gzugs sku'i spros pa sdud rgyu'i brda zhig ston bzhed yin 'dra'ang dgongs phyogs ma lon pas dar han yem chis rten 'brel bzang ba 'dug lags zhus par zhal 'dzum mdzad/ wang hu thog thus nged kyi rmi lam la sku mdun du bud med rgyan 'phyor ma 'ga' zhig gzim mal gyi mtha' bskor nas bskung g.yog gi tshul du bsdad yod pa zhig rmis pas mkha' 'gro'i bsun zlog cig sgrub dgos sam zhus pa dang sngo kho zur rgan gyis rta 931

༄/ /gung bang bstan pa'i natha'iskung 'bum/mgrin gtor zlog dang 'brel bar mi glud cig brdzangs na bzang ngam zhus pa dang / gzhan yang zhabs phyi rnams kye sems 'tshab nas mo phywa mkhan dang chos skyong khog zhugs sogs la yang yang dris te phral du sgrub dgos pa'i rim gro rnams kyang grwa slob rnams kyi sems 'dzin ched du yongs rdzogs bsgrub bcug ste tshes dgu'i nyin dge 'dun tshang ma gtor rgyag la phebs nas sku glud du chi kya ban+de dkor chas gtos chen dang bcas bsdangs/ sngar nas zhing pa sgom chen la tshes dgu'i nyin shog gsung ba bzhin khong phebs te nyid kyi zhal bkod ltar me long la gzugs brnyan shar ba la khrus dang sku dngos la bya ba srung mang du zhus/ skyed tshal gyi pad+ma gad e 'dug ces yang yang 'dri ba gnang ba bzhinapad+ma gsar du gad pa rnams khyer 'ongs nas phul bas na nang bis ba zhabs drung gis me long bra 'beb la me tog pad+ma bzhad pa'i pad+ma'i sdong bu'i steng du tshe dpag med kyi sku bzhugs yod pa zhig shar zer ba de rang yin gsung ba ni 'di nas pad+ma gsar du kha phye ba'i dus tshod dang / tshe dpag med dang pad+ma gar dbang chos kyi rdo rje sogs ni rnam grangs su 'byung bas dus de'i tshe mgon po nyid dag pa'i zhing du byon nas pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs par 'gyur ba'i brda yin nam snyam/ skabs shig smon lam grol yod pas da mchod rdung byas pa 'di chos skor yin nam ci yin zhes snyan gtad nas gsan tshul mdzad par bcar sdod rnams kyis rna ba gtad nas nyan yar ma tshor bar nged tshos mi tshor ba 'dug lags zhus/ spyan yar gzigs te thugs g.yeng ba'i3ma pas cung zad bzhugs nas kha sang khes nyin nas nged kyis mthong tshad thos tshad 'khrul ba 'ba' zhig tu song 'dug pas dran tshad kyang goms 'chol du song med na bzang ste ngas bkod pa byas pa sogs la chal le chol le 'dra med dam gsung bar med lags zhus/ gsung 'di la dpag na rje 932

sa / /rje btsun bzang444) d+maraganas 'ekhakabadag nyid chen pos/ yid 'ong mchod sprin snyan pa'i rol mo'i sgra/ / ngo mtshar ltas bzang mang pos bsu bar shog / ces gsungs pa dang / de don bzhin rje btsun bla ma nyid kyis kyang mkha' spyod ma'i gsol 'debs dngos grub 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu las/ rang semasakhyod thugs dbyings dang bsre ba yi/ / lam mchog 'pho ba 'byongs par byin gyes rlobs/ / de tshe dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams kyis/ / rdo rje'i glu dang yid 'ong mchod pa'i sprin/ / ngo mtshar ltas bzang mang pos mdun bsus te/ / mkha' spyod dag pa'i zhing du 'khrid du gsol/ / zhes dang / gsol 'debs nor bu'i shing rtar/ glu gar rol mo 'ja' 'od gur khyim sogs/ / ngo mtshar ltad mos bsus te 'khrid par mdzod/ / ces sngar nas yang yang gsungs pa bzhin dpa' po mkha' 'gro nam mkha' gang ba rnams kyis bsu ba'i bkod pa ngo mtshar pa'i gzigs snang khyad par can mang du byung bar gdon mi za ba'ang drung na 'khod pa rnams kyis de'i rgyu mtshan dngos su zhu bar ma sbobs so/ /de nyin rje rang nyid kyi gnas tshul gsung zhor du rje 'jug rnams la zhal gdams gnang rtsis kyis tshig lhug dang tshigs bcad kyi rtsom pa 'ga' zhig mgo brtsams nas gnang ba la 'ga' zhig gis gsung rtsom 'di'i nyams la dpag na mi legs pa 'dug ces mya ngan byas pa'i rkyen gyes rtsom 'phro bsgyur te/na med 'chi med go 'phang thob/ / ces pa'i mtshams su 'jog pa gnang /lha bzo skal bzang gis tsan dan gyi brag ri zhig bzhengs kyin yod pa e tshar zhes yang yang bka' 'dri gnang bas khos tsha drag gis bsgrubs te tshes bcu'i zhog ka sku mdun du phul bar brag ri'i steng du chu shel gyi sangs rgyas chu 'dra ma dang yu she'i drang srong tshe ring dwangs shel gyi bka' gdams mchod rten sogs bzhugs su gsol nas dgyes pa'i nyams mdzad/ lha bzo la kha btags 933

༄/ /gu bangabastan pa'ithoname'ir+yāngababum/gnang ste las ka phran tshegs rnam4grub zin pas da las ka che ba zhig mgo rtsom dgos kyang cung zad ngal gso ba kyis gsung ba ni zhing du phebs rtes dgongs rdzogs su mi 'khrugs pa'i shing sku che ba seng khri rgyab yol dang bcas pa bzhengs rgyu lha bzo des bzhengs dgos byung bas de la dgongs par mngon/sku tsha rdo ba zhabs drung dang zhabs gras rnying ba'i skor rnams bos te mjal kha gnang zhing thugs brtse ba'i stangs ka mdzad/ dgon lung khri ba rgya tig zhabs drung la 'byon skul zhu mi mngags te de nyid phyir ma 'byor gong du'ang khong yong stabs mi 'grigs shas che zhes mi zhig la kha btags dang gsung tshig bzang po bskur ba gnang nas 'byon mi dgos tshul gsungs pa ni snga ma'i mi de la khong rang 'khrugs lta bu zhig gis ma bde bas 'phral du yong mi thub tshul gyi lan phul 'dug pa mngon mkhyen gyis gzigs par snang / de nyin snga dros cha ladapal mgon gyi dam tshig bskang gso khrus gsol pa'i cho ga nag 'gros su 'god rtsis kyis mgo brtsams te mtshams mdzad pa ni ljags rtsom thams cad kyi tha ma'o/ / de nas kyang logs su sbyar ba'i rgya'i ri mo rnams la phan tshun gzigs pa'i rnam pa mdzad de 'di tsho las dkon mchog gi rten bkram bzhag na sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa'i dgos pa yod pas mchod bshams kyis zhes bsham tshul zhal bkod gnang ba ltar sku'i g.yas su 'bral spang gi thugs dam rten rnams sngar nas yod cing g.yon du byams pa'i zhing bkod dang lañtsa'i mi 'khrugs pa'i gzungs mdun ngos su lam rim bla brgyud sum thang rje'i sku nga 'dra ma bla ma byams pa rin po che lcang skya rol pa'i rdo rje rje dkon mchog 'jigs med dbang po rnams kyi 'dra sku rnams zhal sprod mchod pa bkod bas mdzes pa dang bcas bshams/ skye bdun sogs ril bu 'gang che ba'i rigs bgrud nas mtshams mtshams su cung zad re gsol gyin yod pa bzhin 934

sa / /che btsunas0zang cha mkhas g.yanabazhes/ sngar go dar sogs skyur rigs la 'dzem nas mi bzhes kyang skabs 'dir gsol zho kham gsum dang dar ba hub gsum tsam bzhes/ bar skabs 'dir rab byung na 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa sprul sku rin po che gdan 'dren zhu dgos pa yin kyang sku na phra ba'i stabs kyis mi 'grigs pas de'i zhal tshab lta bur kho bo cag 'bod rgyu'i ljags bkod dang / yang nged rang da res zho dar 'thung nas khog pa'i nang du bde cham me song ba 'di ltar na nad log la bcos log yin pas nad 'di 'dra 'gro ba 'dra gsung nas zhal 'dzum mdzad cing / de ma thag tu re dogs 'di bdud kyi g.yab mo yin pas ngan da sems rtse gcig pas shi na gson na bla ma dkon mchog mkhyen snyam nas 'dug rgyu yin gsung ba ni gsung glang gi tha ma ste rang cag rnams la 'chi dus de ltar bsam dgos pa yin zhes 'doms par mdzad pa gor ma chag go /yig drug rgyun ldan gsung ngos bris 'bur gye sku brnyan rnams la spyan ras kyis btsa' zhing phyag thal mo spyor ba dang zhal 'dzum pa yang yang mdzad/ de'ang rje 'di bas mkha' spyod ma'i 'pho khrid nam gnang dus su 'di'i brgyud pa'i bla mgong ma rnams kyis 'pho ba ma mdzad na'ang mkha' spyod du 'byon des yin kyang 'ga' zhig gis der 'byon pa la thugs brel ba lta bu 'pho ba'i lam nas mkha'aspyod du byon pa ni rjes 'jug rnams la 'pho pa'i che ba ston pa sogs dgos pa khyad par can la dgongs pa yin pas 'pho ba 'di legs par sbyangs nadag zhing du skye ba la byin rlabs kyi tshan kha shin tu che zhing myur ba yin zhes yang yang gsungs pa zhig yod la/ de ltar du rje nyid kyang dgongs pa de dag la dgongs nas 'pho ba'i lam nas mkha' spyod du 'byon pa'i thugs 'phen sngar nas btang yod pa'i don bzhin hor zla drug pa'i yar ngo'i tshes bcu'i phyi dro'i cha la gzim mal gyi tha mar seng ge'i nyal stabs kyis bzhugs te ting nge 935
