༄/ /yo bang bstan pa'isgronami'i gsung 'bum/'dzin la 'byams pa'i rnam pa mdzad pas wang hu thog thu sems nyid zhabs drung zhing ba sgom chen dbon g.yog sku mdun du phebs par phyag mdzub gsum bstan nas brda gnang ba bzhin khong rnam pas bde gshegs brgyad kyi mtshan nas mgo brtsams te thugs dam gsal 'debs zhal bkod ji lta ba bzhin rim gyes zhus/ de skabs hika dma' ba 'ga' brgyab pas sku lus yar cung zad re bsnur zhing mthar nyika shugs drag po zhig btab pa na sku lus dbu sngas phyogs su yer gyis spar ba byung zhing / de dang dus mtshungs su zhal dbugs kyi rgyu ba mi mngon par gyur te skye bo rtag 'dzin can rnams chos la bskul ba'i phyir zhing 'dir gzugs sku'i bkod pa re zhig bsdus nas dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs nam mkha' gang ba rnams kyis bsu pa'i bkod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang bcas dag pa mkha' spyod kyi gnas su gshegs par gyur to/ / mkha' dbyings dkyil 'khor kun tu khyab pa 'ja' tshon 'od lnga'i lam yangs las/ / mkha' 'gro ma tshogs rdo rje'i glu yis mchod pa'i gar gyi gzigs mor bcas/ / mkha' spyod zhing der yud kyis gshegs tshe gdung ba drag pos phyi bzhin du/ / mkha' la ring du bltas kyang mya ngan mchi ma'i ra ris tsam du zad/ / brtse ldan rgyal yum mkha' spyod dbang mos kyang / /mgon po dag ba'i zhing du nyer bsus nas/ / gang la re ltos 'cha' ba'i bus pa kun/ / mya ngam thang du bsgyur ba phod lags sam/ / chos kyi nyi ma sa ༷sdordo ༵ṭ+wāṃ dh+ri disnaX bde/༵ / rji dī dīdī nub rdoX phaṭ+wāṃ ༈ dhi/ ༷ rji dh+rin/ bya/ dīrdo skadasgogs/ / rgyu skar 'phreng ba nam mkha'i khyon gang yang / / nyi ma gcig pu nub pas mtshan mor 'gyur/ / 'gro ba'i sgron me gcig pu mnal bas kyang / / bgrang yas gdul bya'i 'dren byed gcig car zum/ / 'dod rgyal 936

da / /thebabadzaḥgs bdam pazlasadaganasgra las drangs pa'i bstod dbyangs kyis/ / nyi mar btags pa'i sgon ma grangs mang yang / / rang khyim tsam las thub bstan nor 'dzin gyi/ / khor yug gsal bar nus pa 'ga' ma mchis/ / kye ma phan bde kun gyi sgo gcig bu/ /thub bstan snang byed nyi ma nub pa na/ / phung khrol mtha' dag skyed pa'i gdon chen po/ / rgud pa'i rmongs mun stug pos thibs kyis mnan/ /'gro ba nyon mongs gdon gyis brlams pa yis/ / nyes spyod rims nad me ltar mched pa na/ / sman gyi sbyor ba lhag par mi stsol par/ / 'tsho byed dam pa gzhan du byol rigs sam/ / snyigs ma bod pa'i dmag tshogs 'khrugs pa yis/ / nyam thag 'gron po dbang med 'joms pa na/ / phyi phyir snying stobs brtsan po'i go bgo ba/ / ded dpon dpa' po'i ngang tshul ma lags sam/ /lha chos bdun ldan bstan pa'i bad tshal skam/ / gsang chen snying po nor bu'i 'byung khungs nub/ / gzhan phan gru char 'jo ba'i sprin phung 'thor/ /snyigs ma'i rang mtshang shā 'od bzhin du rdol/ / mkhas grub nor bu'i ka ba brgya phrag gis/ / thub bstan khang bzang mtha' dbus thams cad nas/ /'gyel ba med par btegs pa'i dus bzang de/ / mthong bzhin mod la dran pa'i yul du gyur/ / deng dus gong ma'i lung dang srid 'byor gyis/ /dge ldan bstan ba cung zad 'phang mtho yang / / nges pa'i don du rang gzhan grub mtha' kun/ / rgyud chags pi wang ji bzhin dbyibs su zad/ /'chad rtsod rtsom pas bstan pa'i srog shing 'dzin/ / mkhyen brtse nus pas gdul bya rjes su 'dzin/ / skyabs kyi khyad par kun tshang khyod lta bu/ / slad nas rmi lam du yang mjal bar dka'/ / cher snyigs kun tu rmongs pa'i smag rum na/ / mkhyen brtse'i glog dmar 'od kyi zhags pa can/ / mgon po zhi ba'i dbyings su mnal ba yis/ /phyi phyir mun pa'i bla 937

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'isgraname'i gsung 'bum/gos brtsegs pa bzhin/ / rgyal ba'i nyi ma 'das pa'i phyi rjes su/ / dang sems mig gi pad+mo mngon phyogs te/ / lhang lhang gdung pa'i yid kyis gsol 'debs na/ / rjes chags 'od dmar zhags pa ring du rkyongs/ / nyin der gnam shin tu dwangs par yod kyang skabs 'dir blo bur du sprin bsdus nas char zim bu zhig babs te slar yang nam mkha'i rang mdangs shin tu gsal ba rgya mthing bzang po lta bur gyur pa la 'ja' sprin kha dog sna tshogs pa zhag shar ba ni tha mal pa rnams kyi dbang po'i spyod yul du 'gyur bar ma nus pa las lha dang lha mo rnams kyis mchod pa'i sprin phreng bstar ba yin pa gor ma chag go /de nas dge 'dun pa bgres gzhon mtha' dag gzim chung rwa skor du phebs nas brgya mchod khrus gsol dang bcas bla mchod smon lam lnga ga gdung dbyangs snyan pos gsung nas thugs rje bskul/ zhing pa sgom chen la thun mong ma yin pa'i thugs dam gsal 'dabs shig zhal bkod gnang yod pa bzhin khong gcig pus sku mdun du nam gyi sum cha dang po rdzogs rag la bzhugs nas thugs dam gsal 'debs zhus/ de dus khong gis bar snang dugadangs snyan pa'i rol mo'i sgra 'ur di ri ri grags pa gsan tshul wang hu thog thu la zhus 'dug kyang rjes nas gu shis khong la 'dri gtugs zhus pas nga la bar der 'khrul ba zhig byung ba wang zhabs drung gis dag snang du go 'dug gsung na'ang khong yang gang zag khyad par can zhig yin 'dug pas don dngos gnas kyi gzigs snang yin par mngon te/ bde mchog rtsa rgyud las/rnal 'byor pa rnams 'pho ba'i tshe/ / khrag 'thung dpal sogs rnal 'byor ma/ / lag na me tog sna tshogs dang / / rgyal mtshan ba dan sna tshogs dang / / rol mo'i sgra ni sna tshogs dang / / sna tshogs glu yi mchod pa yis/ /'chi ba zhes bya'i rnam rtog te/ / mkha' spyod gnas su 'khrid par byed/ /938

༄/ /chubatsotshosangacho migyi gagangagatsosatshadababagayu/ces dang / rje mar pa lo tsās/ dus lan cig 'chi ba'i tshul ston te/ /rnam smin gyi lus rgya grol ba'i tshe/ / 'da' ka 'chi brod kyi gdeng yod de/ /rgyal mtshan rol mo'i sgra dang bcas/ / bde chen mkha' spyod kyi gnas su 'gro/ / zhes pa ltar yin la/ rje nyid kyis sngar ko kyā zhabs drung la stsal ba'i chab shog las kyang / rdo rje btsun mo'i thugs rjes ring nas bskyangs/ / dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnams dang snying thag nye/ / gsang lam bgrod pa'i cha rgyus mchis pa'i phyir/ / mkha' spyod rig 'dzin tshogs gral thob tu re/ / zhes zhal gyis 'ches pa bzhin no/ / der ma zad gser khog gi phun tshogs lung ba'i ri khrod pa phyor rtsad bla ma ngag dbang chos 'phel gyis nged kyi mthong snang la shar phyogs su zla 'od la brten pa'i 'ja' 'od nyin mo las gsal ba zhig shar byung bas thu'u bkwan rin po che dag zhing du phebs song ba min nam zhes 'ga' zhig la gsungs pa rjes su de nyin yin par go nas khong rnam ya mtshan du gyur/ dgon pa'i gling gi grwa ba dang grong 'brog gi skye bo dgon bar 'ongs pa 'ga' zhig gi snang ngor yang nyi 'od kyis mi non pa'i 'ja' 'od phra mo mthong ba dang gang du yin ma nges pa'i sgra snyan thos pa dang snga dus dang mi 'dra ba'i dri zhim po bro ba sogs snga phyir ltas khyad par ba ci rigs byung / rje nyid skun tshul yun ring bzhes pa'i skabs der yang sku 'khor rnams sems mya ngan du 'gyur gyis dogs nas mas bu chung gi sems gso ba bzhinadag pa'i zhing du dgongs pa gtad pa'i rnam pa sbas te bla brang gi bya byed las gsum gyi zhal bkod mdzad lugs da dung yun ring bzhugs rgyu'i thugs 'dun yod pa'i rnam pa lta bu gnang yang lkog tu sems nyid zhabs drung la zhal shes 'ga' zhig brjed thor 'god 'jug pa'i zol gyis nyid kyi yang srid rtsar gcod lugs dang sku gdung la sri zhu byed tshul dang dgongs rdzogs ji 939

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'izlaname'i gsung 'bum/ltar sgrub pa'i zhal bkod kyi yi ge gnyis brir bcug ste phyag rtags brgyab nas zhabs drung nyid la bcol/ sku tsha smon lam bla ma dang har chin wang sogs sbyinabadag gnang mi 'ga' zhig la gnang rgyu'i gsung shog gi sa bon wang hu thog thu la bcol yod pas khong rnam gnyis kyis gser khri sprul sku dang chos rje rnamaganyis sogs grwa ba rgan rim rnams 'tshogs thog tu yi ge de rnams sprad/skyabs mgon mchog nas dus phyis yul phyogs 'dir skyes bu dam pa khyad par ba rnams zhing du phebs na gtsug lag khang gi gañdzi ra mi mngon par byed pa dngadage 'dun rnams tshogs su zha mo med par phebs pa sogs mya ngan byed srol dar 'dug na'ang nga la dge 'dun rnams thugs mthun khrims gtsang ngos 'chad nyan la thugs g.yel med par brtson par mdzad na des chog gong gisrol ltar mya ngan byed mi dgos zhes pa'i zhal bkod gnang yod pa bzhin dge bskos la bshad nas tshogs su zhus/ de'i mtshan mo nas dbu btsugs te sku gdung rin po che'i mdun du wang hu thog thu 'dan ma grub chen sprul sku sems nyid zhabs drung ba za zhabs drung khur tsha zhabs drung rnams kyis gtsos dam tshig gtsang ma'i slob ma bcu skor gyis nyin bzhin mchod sbrin rgya mtsho spros te rje nyid kyis mdzad pa'i gdung chog rin chen sgron me'i steng nas bdag mdun bum chog pur bzlas mchog khrus dbang bzhi len pa sogs gnad smin dang rjes su 'dzin pa'i gsol 'debs smon lam shugs drag mdzad/ bde gsang 'jigs gsum dang nā ro mkha' spyod kun rig rnams kyi chog gra'i rgyun rim gyis btsugs/ thugs dam grol nyin dar han em chis zhabs phyi zhus nas wang hu thog thus sku gdung la khrus dang byug pa gnas yig gdags pa sogs chas su gzhug pa'i rim pa rnams phyag bzhes bzhin ngos dag mdzad de mchod rol dang bcas tshoms chen du gdan drangs par dge 'dun mang gis 940

da / /che babastags chagadasartsa dganamadun bsus te gdung mjal zhus shing zhugs 'bul gyi bar nyin bzhin tshoms chen mdor 'tshogs nas khrus gsol dang bla mchod smon lam rnams gsungs/ bla brang nas mchod pa sngar las rgya cher spel ba'i steng du chos sde rang gi bla spyi khag so so dang gling stod smad kyi grwa gshag tshan so so lung khog lnga'i skya ser skor tshan so sos res mos kyis gdung 'bul dang mchod 'bul gzab cing / phyogs tha dad kyi dgon sgrub sde ris med kyi gdung 'bul dang mchod pa 'bul mi rnams rim gyis mu mthud byung ba bcas dgongs rdzogs sgrub pa'i ring der dri bzang gis bsgos pa'i yon chab me tog gsar ba spos rengs mar me lha bshos te rnam lnga'i brgya mchod chu'i ri mo bzhin gcig rjes gcig mthud nas tshoms chen gyi phyi nang kun nyin mtshan khor mo yug tu mchod rdzas kyis go mtshams med par gtams pas rab 'bar sgron me'i 'od kyis nyin mtshan 'khrul ba lta bu dang / dri zhim spos kyi dri mas phyi nang kun tu khyab pa dang /snyan 'jeb rol mo'i sgra dbyangs dang thugs rje bskul ba'i gdung dbyangs 'dres pas lung ba 'gengs pa lta bu dang / rgyu dngos gtsang ma'i zhal zas che chung bgrang las 'das pa tshar du dngar pa sogs yid du 'ong ba'i mchod pa'i bye brag ma tshang ba med pa 'phags pa kun tu bzang po'i sgyu 'phrul lta bu chad pa med par bstar te dad ldan kun gyis bsod nams kyi phung po gtugs pa med pa nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam par spel/ zhugs 'bul gyi nyin bla ma dge 'dun mang nas gdung dbyangs kyis gsol ba 'debs bzhin par mchod rol rgya chen po dang bcas sku gdung rin po che mkha' spyod rtse'i nye 'dab tu bur khang brtsegs pa der gdan drangs te wa paṇ+ḍi ta hu thog thus slob dpon mdzad nas sngar gyi gdung chog pa rnams dang bcas dpon slob bco lngas rdo rje sems dpa'i sgo nas me mchod phul/ bur khang brag rtsar gtad pas rlung gi 'gro 941

/ /gung bang bstan pa'ithoname'i gsung 'bum/lugs kyis du ba thon ma thag dgon pa'i lung pa'i mdar na bun bzhin du 'khyil zhing dri ngad bzang pos phyogs kun khyab par byas te rim gyis du ba yongs su rdzogs pa yar bsdus te 'ja' 'od dang bcas rgyab ri'i steng brgyud nas lung pa'i phu'i phyogs su thon song ba la mi mang gis sprul sku phyogs der 'byon pa 'dra zhes gleng ba phyis de bzhin byung / de skabs nam mkha'i mthongs shin tu dwangs pa la 'ja' tshon sgor mo dang zla gam lta bu shad brkyang ba sogs gdugs rgyal mtshan ba dan bsgreng ba'i rnam pa lta bu dang / mtha' 'khor cha mnyam par sprin dkar po zho gsar ba lta bus bskor cing de'ang dbyibs bkra shis rtags brgyad dang rgyal srid sna bdun sogs kyi rnam pa lta bu so so'i mthong tshul yang mi 'dra ba ci rigs shig byung bas ser skya thams cad bla ma dran pa'i gdung shugs kyis non pa'i ngang nas kyang mthong snang sna tshogs kyis ngo mtshar ba'i ca co sgrogs pa dang phyag dang mchod pa sogs kyes 'ur langs pas 'di snang gi bya byed thams cad yid kyis brjed pa lta bu byung /zhal chem du sku rus la rus chog gnad smin zhu dgos tshul gnang yod pa bzhin cho ga pa rnams kyis rgyud kyi dgongs pa ltar yang dang yang du tshad ldan bsgrubs te gdung rus rnams sgrom bur bcug / slar yang dge bdun mang gis ser spreng dang bcas bla brang du gdan drangs nas sngar gyi gnas su bzhugs su gsol/ dgung zhag bzhi bcu zhe dgu grub kyi bar dkon mchog gi mchod pa dang dge 'dun gyi bsnyen bkur gya nom pa'i sgo nas sku gdung rin po che'i mdun du cho ga pa bco lnga skor gyis rdo rje sems dpa'i sgo nas sku gdung mchod tshul dang 'brel bar sprul sku myur 'byon dang bka' drin dran pa'i gsol 'debasasgon lam rnam brgyad sogs chag med dang / chos bzang ri khrod kyi sgrub mchod pa rnams gtan chags bsdad nas nā ro mkha' spyod kyi sgrub mchod 942

ra / /che bache gsazang shāka khas dananabadag 'jug dang dgon pa'i bla sprul dang dge 'dun rnams nyin bzhin res mos kyis gdan drangs te bde gsang 'jigs gsum res mos dang kun rig chag med/ tshogs chen du bla mchod dang myur 'byon gsol 'debs smon lam rnams dang rgyud pa la bde gsang 'jigs gsum gyi bdag 'jug /dgonalung ri khrod dang mang 'dus ri khrod gnyis la sman chog chos bzang ri khrodal gnas brtan phyag mchod thar ba gling du mi 'khrugs pa'i sgrub mchod bdag 'jug rnams gsungs/ sngar gyi zhabs brtan gyi sgyung gnas kyi mjug mthud nas dgongs rdzogs la dmigs pa'i sgyung gnas sum brgya drug cu re bdun bsrungs/ gling gi grwa pa rnams dad mos kyis sku gdung gi nye 'dab bskal bzang 'jam sdud bzang gsum rdo rje gcod pa rgyan 'jug rgyud gzhung sogs mdo rgyud klog pa dang / rnam rgyal gzungs ring sgo drug pa'i gzungs byams pas dam bcas pa'i gzungs sogs gzungs sngags khyad par can dang gsol 'debs smon lam 'don pa brkyang phyag 'bul ba sogs rang rang gi mos pa dang bstun pa'i dge sbyor rgyun ldan dang / sku 'bum mkhan po dang bya khyung mkhan po rnam gnyis kyis gtsos phyogs nas gdung mjal du byon pa'i bla sprul dka' ram dge tshul slong mang bos kyang rang rang gi ngos nas dgongs pa rdzogs thabs bla na med pa mdzad pa'i steng du bla brang nas bsnyen bkur zhus te 'jigs byed kun rig sogs dkyil 'khor chen po dang bla mchod dang gsol 'debasasgon lam ci rigs gdung dbyangs snyan pos gsungs nas thugs rje bskul ba sha stag byung / rje nyid kyi zhal bkod ltar nged 'bod par dgon lung rgyud pa bla ma dpon g.yog rnams 'byor ba bzhin mgyogs par song ste zhag bdun gyi ring sku gdung yid bzhin nor bu'i mdun nas bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo tha mi dad du byas te dbang bzhi len pa dang / rang gi blo 943

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'ithoname'i gsung 'bum/nus dang bstun pa'i phyi nang gsang ba de kho na nyid kyi mchod pas mchod cing bstan pa dang 'gro ba'i dpal du mchog sprul rin po che myur du 'byon pa'i gsol 'debs shug drag po dang tshe rabs kun tu bla ma mchog gis rjes su 'dzin pa'i smon lam nan tan du btang / 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa rin po che nas nged dang lhan du mgron gnyer dka' bcu shes rab rgya mtsho ched du mngags ste sku gdung rin po cher mchod thebs gya nom pa dang / kha btags bar mdzod dngul srang sum brgya gos chen lnga 'phrug lnga sogs kyi gdung 'bul bskur ba rnams bstar ba'i rjes su rang gis kyang 'byor tshod kyi mchod thebs dang mdzod btags dngul srang brgya gos chen gnyis 'phrug gsum bcas phul/dbus su dgongs rdzogs sgrub tshul sogs don rtsa che ba'i rigs rje nyid nas zhal bkod chu thag chod pa gnang ste byed bde bar 'dug na'ang phran tshegs kyi dogs gcod dgos pa rnams 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa rin po che'i sku tshab dang bla brang rang gi zhabs phyi che gras rnams dngos 'dzom gyis mol bsdur bgyes/ har chin smon lam bla ma'i sprul skus mchod pa dang gos chen dras drub kyi sku gsung thugs rten dngul srang sum brgya sogs kyi gdung 'bul btegs/ thag nye ring gi phyogs so so nas bla chen dpon chen sogs bka' slob tu gyur pa rnams kyis rang rang gis tshogs gsog pa'i ched du mchod pa dang gdung 'bul zhu mi btang ba rnams rim par 'byor te mchod sprin bstar/rje bla ma mchog gi zag med thugs kyi dgongs pa rdzogs ched du 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa rin po che la lha rdzas nang mdzod dngul gyi maṇ+ḍal sku gsung thugs rten bzang gos dras drub kyi bzhugs gdan rgyab yol bu la gan gyi na bza' gos kyi zhabs chag rgyal mdzod kyi gsol phor dbang chas cha tshang rten kheb che legs mang nog sogs gos chen legs pa yug drug 'go snam yug gnyis dngul srang 944

༄/ / rdzobatsugablobazangachos nyama'igasangagagagapabadasacadabyungakabazhi brgya chibs drel gnyis phrug ther sogs kyis mtshon spus gtsang ba'i 'bul ba rnam grangs lnga brgya lhag dang / nged la'ang lha rdzas bar mdzod dngul gyi maṇ+ḍal bzhugs gdan rgyab yol dbang chas tshang ma wa rtsag gos kyi zhabs chag rgyal mdzod kyi gsol phor rten kheb cod pan sogs mchod rdzas du ma dngul gyi gsol dem gos chen yug dgu dngul srang nyis brgya lnga bcu chibs rta chibs drel 'go snam phrug ther sogs kyis mtshon rnam grangs bzhi brgyar nye ba/ wang paṇ+ḍita hu thog thu la lha rdzas nang mdzod dngul gyi maṇ+ḍal sku gsung thugs rten bzhugs gdan rgyab yol dbang chas cha tshang dbu zhwa dang na bza'i skor tshang ma gos phrug gi zhabs chag rdzab yi'i gsol phor dngul gyi gsol dem khi pi su'i mthil gdan che ba gzim gur gsar ba thab cha'i skor dang bcas/gos chen yug brgyad dngul srang nyis brgya lnga bcu chibs rta sga 'khor can sogs rta drel bzhi shing shin dran phrug ther zam ras pags rigs mchod rdzas snod spyad du ma bcas rnam grangs lnga brgyar nye ba/ dgon lung khri pa 'dan ma grub chen sems nyid zhabs drung ba za bla ma khu rtsa zhabs drung rgyud pa khri gdan zur sogs res mos kyis cho ga'i gral dbu mdzad pa'i bla sprul mang po go bab dang bstun nas dngos gtsang ba'i 'bul tshan brgya nas nyi shu'i bar ci rigs dang / sku 'bum mkhan po bya khyung mkhan po hor tshang gser khri g.yer gshong sprul sku stag lung sprul sku gro tshang mkhan po sogs chos sde ris med kyi bla sprul khri gdan zur rnams dang / rgya nag gser khri rin po che a kya sprul sku har chin sgo mang mkhan zur sogs sog yul gyi bla chen 'ga' zhig bcas la go bab kyi 'bul tshan drug cu nas bcu bzhi'i bar/ dgon lung rang gi tshogs chen du dgongs zhag grub kyi bar mang ja chag med zhus thog rgyal sras rin po che dang lcabaskya rin po che sogs 'bul ba thob bzhin pa rnams la dngul gyi 'bul ba 945

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'isgoname'i gsung 'bum/dang / dge 'dun nyis stong brgal bar snga phyi bsdoms pas dong tse khron re dang kha btags re'i sku 'gyed bul bas mtshon/ sku 'bum bya khyung bkra shis 'khyil gser khog chu bzang gan chen mchod rten thang gro tshang stag lung tas thung dgon chen sogs phyi log nang log gi dgon sde drug cu skor la mang 'gyed/rtenabyin can rnams la mchod pa dang ngan slong mang po la sbyin pa bcas lo 'dir rje de nyid sku ltem tshul bstan pa nas zhal bzhugs kyi par zhabs brtan bsgrubs pa dang / zhing brjes nas dgung zhag grub kyi bar dgongs rdzogs su song ba rnams bsdoms par dngul maṇa che legs brgya lhag sku gsung thugs rten bub so bzhi bzhugs gdan rgyab yol bub dgu ḍa dril bub so drug dbang chas bub dgu rten kheb dril gdan cod paṇa sum brgya lhag gis mtshon mchod rdzasakyi rigs ches mang po/ dngul rkyang srang lnga stong dgu brgya lnga bcu skor dong tshe khron bzhi stong brgyad brgya skor gos chen brgya zhe drug / gos chung brgya lhag 'go snam phrug ther brgya so lnga zam ras stong lhag mdzod btags nyis brgya skor dang gzhan kha btags che chung chig khri lnga stong skor/ ja bag bdun brgya so gnyis mar rgya ma nyis stong bdun brgya rta drel brgyad cu skor na bza' dang gyon ba'i rigs bub lnga bcu skor/ bags rigs dang bca' lag snod spyad kyi rigs ches du ma sogs gong gsal dngul rkyang ma gtogs pa'i dung tse sogs dngos po gang song bsdoms pa rags rtsis kyis srang chig khri lhag tsam song 'dug cing / bod du gser khri sprul sku lo tsā ba gu thi ngag dbang bstan 'phel gsol dpon blo gros dar rgyas ngo g.yog bcu gsum song nas/ lha sa smon lam du nyin gang gi ja thug dgu dang dngul zho lnga re'i sku 'gyed zhus thog gongs yas phyin tshogs dbur spyan drangs te/ rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen par lha rdzas nang mdzod dngul srang sum brgya'i maṇ+ḍal/ tshe dpag med kyi li 946

༄/ /༄tsotshotha4chosamigyi ga4gtsalag khams /sku lam rim po ti gser zangs kyi mchod rten bzang gos dras drub kyi tshe dpag med dang la ñtsa'i a yu rnam rgyal mchod rten rnams cha 'grigs/ bzang gos dras drub kyi bzhugs gdan rgyab yol dngul gyi bum pa dang bkra shis rtags brgyad rgyal srid sna bdun tshag drub kyi bkra shis rtags brgyad bum par bsdus pa tshar bdun dri bzang dang ma nu dang ba so 'phrul ma'i rgyan phreng srus legs gsum/ 'be+e tha rkos ma dang ha she rkos ma'i gsol phor gnyis gu gu sha dang sa byir 'phrul ma dang ba so 'phrul ma'i gsol phor cha re gu gu sha'i gsol gar che legs ka bed rang grub kyi yu ring zhi ba phor gsol lder rnams ri mo 'bur dod cha 'grigs yang chi dang ba so rkos ma'i gsol lder spus ldan cha re dngas shel 'brug ma'i gsol phor dang me tog tam 'bis cha re dngul skud las grub pa'i bzed zhal rin po che'i phra can btegs na kha rgyan gyi pad 'dab kha phye zhang bzhag na kha zum pa'i khyad mtshar can cha tshang rgyu mtshungs kyi yol go cha 'grigs drug / gser zangs 'phrul ma dang byang chub shing las grub pa'i yolago dngul gyi nang sha can re gser zangs dang 'un gru'i dri bzang gi snod cha re ba so 'phrul ma dang sa byir 'phrul ma'i dri bzang gi snod cha re 'un gru'i sgam chung g.yu'i phra rgyan can cha/ shel gyi me long ku ku sha'i yu ba can ku ku sha'i khrus gzhong che legs mar me'i 'od khang lcags dkar gyi shubs can cha gos chen tshag drub kyis g.yogs pa'i gser zangs kyi ho phun che legs yang chi'i stegs dang bcas/ mu tig bcos ma dang mchod ma nu sogs kyi shangs dka'i kho khor bdun phyag gshan 'un gru'i shubs can dang me lcags ba so rkos ma'i shubs can spus legs re/ chu tshod 'khor lo dus tshod re rdzogs mtshams su a tsa ra zhig phyir thon nas ting ting grag pa'i dril bu rdung ba'i nyams mtshar can sogs mdzod nas thon pa'i khyad du 'phags pa'i rin thang 947

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i name'i gsung 'bum/can gyi bca' lag sna tshogs dang bzang gos dmar po'i zhabs chags gser skud dngul skud kyi 'ja' ris can/ bzang gos dras drub kyi dbang chas tshag drub kyi rigs lnga dang bcas bzang gos kyis bsgrigs pa'i tor bu spus legs rten kheb che legs gnyis dril gdan bcu cod paṇa nyi shu/ dri bzang gi phye phur chob can chung ba nyi shu tshag drub kyi zhwa stegs dpe shub dngul srang nyis stong lnga brgya mang nog dang rgyan bzhi sogs bzang gos yug so dgu /shing shing gran gyi mthil gdan che ba gser skud dang gos skud kyi ri mo can shing shing gran dang tho snam gyon 'dang gsum/ wa nag dang bu la gan sogs pags rigs nyi shu zam so dang ras chen bzhi bcu na bza' nyer spyad kyi dod rta drel nyi shu nor bu don yod zhags pa srid du ring ba'i lha rdzas bcas/rgyal tshab rta tshag rin po cher lha rdzas bar mdzod dngul srang nyi shu'i maṇ+ḍal tshe dpag med kyi li sku glegs bam tshem drub kyi shub can bka' gdams mchod rten/ bzang gos dras drub kyi bzhugs gdan rgyab yol dngul gyi bum pa kha rgyan can tshag drub kyi bkra shis rtags brgyad bum par bsdus pa tshar gsum/dri bzang gi phreng ba spus legs che chung gnyis gar yol sngon po'i yu ring pe tha rkos ma dang ka bed rang byung gi gsol phor spus gtsang gnyis dwangs shel 'brug ma dang gar yol shing ris ma'i gsol phor gnyis/ yang chi'i gsol phor gnyis yang chi'i gsol lder gser ris can ba so 'phrul ma'i ka bed dbyibs can gyi yol go dang dri bzang gi snod khyad mtshar can cha re 'un gru'i dribazang gi snod srus legs che chung bdun/ ku ku sha'i bzed zhal cha khyung skyug gi snang dam nyis sbrel chu shel dang gar yol gyi sna dam gnyis/ rgya khug gser skud dngul skud kyi chob can snyug sgog dngul shal can nang du phyag shan dngul gyi thur ma dang bcas me long tshag drub kyi shubs can dbang chas tshag 948

sa / /che badza bas nyi pa'i d+ma gakhag sha kadrub kyi rigs lnga dang bcas/ rten khebs che legs dril gdan cod pan bco lnga dri bzang gi phye phur chob can chung ba nyi shu gos chen dmar po'i zhabs chags dngul srang lnga brgya/ bzang gos yug bcu bdun tho snam gyon 'dang gnyisawa smug dang bu la gan sogs pags rigs bcu zam so dang ras chen sum cu na bza' nyer spyad kyi dod wa nag dang bu la gan bdun don yod zhags pa bkra shis pa'i lha rdzas bcas/ bkra shis lhun po'i tshogs chen du mang ja dang dngul zho gang skar lnga re'i 'gyed zhus thog paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa tshogs dbus su spyan drangs te 'bul ba lha rdzas nang mdzod/dngulasrang nyer lnga'i maṇ+ḍal tshe dpag med kyi li sku glegs bam tshem drub kyi shubs can gser zangs kyi mchod rten bzang gos dras drub kyi tshe dpag med dang lañtsa'i a yu rnam rgyal mchod rten rnams cha 'grigs/ gos chen dras drub kyi bzhugs gdan rgyab yol dngul gyi bum pa kha rgyan can dri bzang gi rgyan phreng spus legs che chung gnyis byi ru dmar po'i rgyan phreng spus gtsang / be tha 'phrul ma dang hā she 'phrul ma'i gsol phor gnyis ku ku sha dang gar yol shing ris ma'i gsol phor gnyis gar yol g.yung drung ma'i gsol phor cha ka bed rang grub kyi gsol phor dang gsol lder pad 'dab can yang chi'i gsol lder gser ris ma ku ku sha'i gsol lder che legs ba so 'phrul ma'i gsol lder dang yol go khyad mtshar can gnyis/ sa byir 'phrul ma dang dngul skud las grub pa'i bzed zhal srus ldan cha re 'un grub dri bzang gi snod phra rgyan can dgu ku ku sha'i spos phor dri bzang gi snod me thur thal gnon dang bcas cha tshang shel gyi me long yu ba'i nang du nyer mkho'i bca' lag yod pa'i khyad mtshar can/mar me'i 'od khang lcags dkar gyi shubs can o ru su'i phyag shan spus legs me lcags ba so 'phrul ma'i shubs can mu tig bcos ma dang spos shel sogs kyi 949

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'isgroname'i gsung 'bum/sna ngam bzhi bzang gos kyi dbang chas tshem drub kyi rigs lnga dang bcas/tor bu srus legs rten khebs che legs dril gdan cod paṇa nyi shu dri bzang gi phye phur chob can bco lnga tshag drub kyi zhwa stegs/ dngul srang brgyad brgya bzang gos yug nyer gcig 'go snam dang tho snam gyon 'dang re mthil gdan ser po me tog gi ri mo can wa spug dang pu la gan sogs pags rigs bcu zam so dang ras chen yug so lnga na bza' nyer spyad kyi dod du wa nag legs pa dang gos 'phrug legs pa yug chen gcig don yod zhags pa sring du ring ba'i lha rdzas bcas/ sku zhabs shod la phyi mdzod dngul maṇa sku gsung thugs rten rten kheb che legs dril gdan cod paṇa bdun byi ru'i phreng ba spus legs dngul srang brgya bzang gos yug bdun gos dmar po'i zhabs chags bu la gan gsum zam so dang ras chen yug bco lnga bcas/ sa skya bdag chen la lha rdzas nang mdzod dngul srang nyi shu'i maṇ+ḍal gser tshos mtshe dpag med kyi li sku glegs bam tshag drub gyi glegs shing can gser zangs kyi mchod rten bzang gos dras drub kyi bzhugs gdan rgyab yol/ dngul gyi thod pa stegs can ku ku sha'i khrus gzhong srus legs dngas shel gyi gsol phor cha gar yol shing ris ma'i gsol phor cha ka bred rang grub kyi gsol phor che ba cha gar yol gyi gsol lder pad 'dab can/ rgya g.yu 'phrul ma dang sa byir 'phrul ma'i dri bzang gi snod spus ldan cha re gzi las grub pa'i dri bzang gi snod spus legs nyer mkho'i bca' lag yod pa'i gser zangs kyi khe zi khyad mtshar can phyag shan ku ku sha'i shubs can dang spyan shel ba so 'phrul ma'i shubs can spus legs re sna dam spusagatsang gnyis shel gyi me long shubs ldan mar me'i 'od khang shub can dri bzangagi phreng ba gos skud kyi thor can dwangs shel sngon po'i yol go byi ru'i rgyan ldan nyams mtshar ba bzang gos kyi dbang chas dras drub kyi rigs lnga dang 950

/ /chabatsunablobangachos nyama'ig4thab pasagatazadabyungakabacas/ rten khebs che legs gnyis dril gdan cod paṇa nyi shu dri bzang gi phye phur chung ba bcu rgya dngul srang nyis brgya bzang gos yugs bco lnga bi ji twan gyi mthil gdan tshag drub kyi ri mo can tho snam gyon 'dang stag lpags dang bul ha ri bub re don yod zhags pa lha rdzas bcas/ 'on chos ldings kyi tshogasapar nyin gang gi ja thug bcu dang dngul zho gang re'i 'gyed zhus thog rgyal sras rin po che tshogs dbur spyan drangs nas 'bul ba lha rdzas bar mdzod dngulasrang bco lnga'i maṇ+ḍal gser gyi bkra shis rtags brgyad dang rgyal srid sna bdun gyis spras pa tshe dpag med kyi li sku glegs bam tshem drub kyi glegs shing can mchod rten/ bzang gos dras drub kyi bzhugs gdan rgyal yol dwangs shel dang hā she'i gsol phor gnyis dri bzang gi breng ba gos skud kyi thor can 'un du rna dang hā she'i rkos ma'i sna dam gnyis me long yu ba can shubs bcas bzang gos kyi dbang chas dras drub kyi rigs lnga dang bcas/ rten khebs che legs dril gdan cod paṇa bco lnga tshem drub kyi gdong dar nyer gcig dang grwa rtags gsum bzang gos ser po'i zhabs chags spus gtsang rgya dngul srang brgya dang lnga bcu bzang gos yug bcu tho snam spyon 'dang bu la ha ri bub gnyis zam so dang ras chen yug bco lnga mdzod btags bcas/ lcang skya mchog sprul rin po cher lha rdzas bar mdzod dngul srang bcu'i maṇ+ḍal tshe dpag med kyi li sku gos chen dras drub kyi bzhugs gdan rgyab yol rten kheb dril gdan cod paṇa spus legs dgu gos chen yug bdun tho snam gyon 'dang rgya dngul srang brgya tham pa bcas/ khams nags shod stag phu rin po che'i dgon par mchod pa dang mang 'gyed kyi thog sprul sku nyid la lha rdzas bar mdzod bzang gos legs ba yug chen lnga rten kheb dril gdan cod pan spus gtsang dgu byi ru dmar po'i phyag phreng spus legs dri bzang gi phyag phreng dang phye phur 951

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/chung ba bzhi sa byir 'phrul ma'i sna dam legs pa chu tshod 'khor lo ting ting gragasapa spus ldan rgya dngul srang brgya lnga bcu bcas/ phur bu lcog tu mang 'gyedalan mang thog byams pa sprul sku rin po cher lha rdzas bar mdzod dngul srang bdun gyi maṇ+ḍal thub pa'i li sku khe bi su'i bzhugs gdan rgyab yol/ dri bzang gi phyag phreng spus legs dwangs shel dang hā she gar yol shing ris ma rnams kyi gsol phor gsum/ yang chi'i gsol lder hā she rkos ma sogs kyi sna dmagasum dbang chas tshag drub kyi rigs lnga dang bcas rten kheb che legs dril gdan cod pan dgu gos chen yug lnga chu tshod 'khor lo ting ting grags pa che legs rgya dngul srang brgya sogs 'bul ba yang yang dang / gzhan yang rwa sgreng no mon han de mo sprul pa'i sku sems dpa' sprul sku mnga' ris sprul sku dga' ldan khri ba shar rtse byang rtse rgyud stod smad kyi mkhan po sogs grwa tshang phan tshun gyi bla ma rnams dang sgom chen thugs dam pa rnams la mchod bsngo'i 'bul tshan gyis khyab par byas pa dang / 'bras spungs tshogs chen du mang ja dang dngul zho gang skar lnga re/ bkra shis sgo mang du grwa ja gsum dang dngul zho bzhi skar lnga re/ khang tshan mi tshan la tshoms ja dang dngul zhor/ se ra dang dga' ldan tshogs chen du mang ja dang dngul skar phyed brgyad re'i sku 'gyed kyis mtshon rgyud stong smad rnam rgyal grwa tshang lcags po ri chos 'khor gling tshe chog gling bstan rgyas gling mi ru bzhi sde sgra dbyangs gling dge 'phel nas ri rgya bar lha sa'i nye 'khor gyi sgrub sde bcu dgu/ gung thang chos khri/ gsang sngags bde chen/ bkra shis 'byung / yer ba/ lo dgon ma lag lnga/ la mo/'brigung mthil dang yang ri sgar/ spangs dgon/ rin chen gling / kha rgya dgon pa/ rdzing phyi'i byams pa dang zangs ri khang dmar sogs rgyal sras rin po ches zhal bdag gnang ba'i dgon sgrub sde brgyad/ gdan sa mthil/952

༄/ /chubatsunamakhazang4541nyis d+madakarasadabyung/mnga' ris grwa tshang / nya mgo dgon/ rtse thang gi dgon pa gsum/ khra 'brug rab 'byams lha khang sogs gnas gsum rten gsum dang / ri bo bde chen man chad yar klung khul gyi dgon sgrub sde bcu bdun/ bsam yas/rdo rje brag byams pa gling / smin grol gling / gong dmar chos sde/bshad sgrub gling / rong byams chen/ dben sa dgon/ ba so chos sde/jo mo nang / khro phu/ bya rgod gshong / sa skya dgon chen/ srad rgyud/snar thang / zhwa lu ri mthil/ mtshan sgogs gling / theg mchog gling /'bring rtse chos sde/ rgyang rtse khul gyi dpal 'khor chos sde dang / gnas rnying chos sde/ brtse chin chos sde/ rgyang ru ser lding / nyan thos skyid phug sogs dgon sgrub sde nyi shur lung / mtshur phu/ bsam lding ba sogs yar 'brog spang gi sgrub sde drug / lcags zam dgon dang chos yang ba sogs chu bo ri'i nye 'khor gye dgon sgrub sde bcu bzhi/ dgye re yang dgon dang yang dben/ chu shur thar ba gling dang byang chub gling / ljang dgun chos/gsang phu'i dbyar chos/ ra stod dpyid chos/ rin chen gling / sgrol ma lha khang dang smog sbog sde gsum sogs snye thang khul gyi sgrub sde dgu/ skyor mo lung / stod lung chu bzang / nā len+d+ra/ shar 'bum pa/ glang thang /stag lung / ra sgreng sogs gong gsal grub mtha' ris med kyi dgon sgrub sde brgya dang bdun bcu lhag gi tshogs par mang 'gyed dang / lha rten gdung rten khungs ma rnams la brgya mchod/ gzhan thams cad la mchod me snyan shal gyis khyab par byas pa dang / jo shāka rnam gnyis la stong mchod re dang zhal gser lo ke shār dang rje'i gser gdung rgyal dbang dang pa chen gyi sku na rim gyi gdung rten rnams la mchod pa gzhan las gzabs shing / 'u shang mdo dang shug gseb sha ba dgon gsum gyi jo bo sku mched gsum 'u yug shing 953

༄/ /gung thang ba na pa'izlaname'i gsung 'bum/gi sog po dang gza' bu'i gnas kyi slob dpon rang byon/ gangs dkar sha med mar rgyag pa'i gnam lcags rdo rje/ mkha' 'gro'i dar thag sogs nang rten mang du bzhugs pa'i lha khang bdun tshe ma bu ri'i bde mchog gnyan mgon phugs yol ru'i mgon po brag ram dar lung gnyan gyi pho brang kha'u brag rdzong bye 'gyur sogs dbus gtsang khul gyi gnas rten byin rlabs can rnams dang /skyid grong 'phags pa wa ti bal po'i 'phags pa shing kun/ mchod rten bya rung kha shor/ gangs te se'i rje btsun mi la dang rgyal ba rgod tshang ba'i sgrub phug / kha che'i jo bo sku mched gsum/ mnga' ris mtho lding gi rnam snang lha khang dang rgyud sde bzhi'i gser khang / kha che'i jo bo rang byon dang ldang 'phags pa/ khams phyogs kyi lha mdun rnam snang / brag yab byams chen/li thang thub chen sogs la'ang 'grul zhor du mchod thebs bskur ba dang /ngan slong sum stong nye ba la dngul skar phyed gsum re'i sbyin pa btang ba sogs bod du mchod sbyin bgyis pa'i dngul dang dngos po che long rnams bsdoms par dngul rkyang srang nyi khri sum stong nyis brgya skor/ bzang gos yug nyis brgya nga gsum bzang gos kyis bsgrigs pa'i dbang chas bubs bcu drug rten kheb nyi shu dril gdan cod pan bzhi brgya skor byi ru dkar dmar mu men 'un du rna rgya g.yu spos shel mchod rnams rdog che zhing brgya grangs tshang ba'i rgyan phreng tshar gnyis re gser dngul gyi ga'u bzhi dang bcas/ gzhan byi ru sogs rin po che'i rigs kyi phreng ba rgyan ldan lnga bcu skor spos shel rdog nyis brgya byi rurdog drug brgya gser skud dngul skud chun po lnga brgya gos skud rgya ma bcu 'go snam dang tho snam bcu drug zam so sum brgya ras chen lnga brgya lnga bcu skor/wa nag drug bu la gan drug cu ko gser dang bu la ha ri sum cu mdzod btags sum brgya lnga bcu chos 'don dang rnam dpang ma sogs gos btags nyis stong 954

༄/ / rtsebatsugablobazangacho kyinyima'ig4gsu pamadaporasadabyunganabargyad brgya lhag / bsod btags dang skya chen sum khri dang bdun brgya lhag rgun 'brum dkar po sgam bcu gnyis bye ma ka ra sgam gnyis bkwa men rgam drug rgya ser dang rgya nag gi yul gru nas thon pa'i rin po che'i rigs kyi rin thang che ba'i bca' lag khyad mtshar dang gser dngul las bsgrubs pa'i mchod cha go lag sga chas sogs gong gsal ltar gyi dngos po'i rigs ches mang ba rmugs 'dzin gyi bang mdzod phye ba lta bu'i gtan pa med pa'i mchod sbyin gyi dge tshogs bsam las 'das pa bskrun/ zi lang am ban nas rje de nyid zhi bar gshegs pa'i rgyu mtshan 7gong ma chen po'i snyan du gsol bar/ 7gong nas drung 'khor ba rma bya'i sgro can gyi dpon po shā tā zhen dang / mong gol cur gan gyi bā tā zhen/ po sho ho dpon po gnyis bcas/ dpon po che chung bzhi mchod 'bul du gtong ba gnang ba zi ling gi car gu chi dang thung zi sogs kyi chibasaskyel dang dgon pa'i bla ma dge 'dun rnams kyis bsu ba ser sbrengs dang bcas chu phag lo'i zla ba dang po'i tshes nyer gnyis la dgon lung du 'byor te sku gdung rin po che'i mdun du/ 7gong nas bka' drin stsal pa'i lha rdzas nang mdzod dngul srang lnga bcu'i maṇ+ḍal kha btags chos 'don lnga bcu dngul srang lnga bcu/ sgos sbom bzang po chags pa gcig bcas phul nas nyin gsum gyi ring mchod pa rgya chen po dang 'brel bar bla mchod smon lam dang sprul sku myur 'byon gyi gsol 'debs sogs 'don 'jug pa gnang / grwa slob rnamasakyes zi ling am pan brgyud nas 7gong ma chen por tshe lha'i 'dra sku kha btags nang mdzod bcas phul te gsol ras la phyag 'tshal ba'i rgyu mtshan snyan 'bul zhus/ zhal chem du lha gdung mchod rten gser dngul gyis bzhengs mi chog pa'i bka' rgya gnang yod pa bzhin gser zangs kyi mchod rten zhig rgya nag nas sgrub rtsis kyis bla brang nas phra rgyan du 'god rgyu'i rin po 955

/ /gung bstan pa'isgraname'igasung 4ma/che'i rigs phon chen thig tshad dang bcas har chin dge legs phyag mdzod la sprad nas gtad gnyer byas pa yin kyang / sbyin bdag dam pa har chin wang mdzi badz+ra nas rin po che de rnams kyis phra rgyan byas pa'i gser zangs kyi lha bab mchod rten thog tshad cig bzhengs nas dngul srang nyis brgya'i gdung 'bul dang bcas mi sna ched mngags gdong bskur ba gnang ba bzhin sku rus byings rnams dwangs shel gyi za ma tog dang bcas mchod rten de'i bum pa'i nang du bzhugs su gsol te mtha' skor du 'bral spang gi thugs dam rten bla ma byams pa'i dngul gdung mchod rten mkhyed gang ba dang / dus rgyun mgul du bsnam pa'i lcang skya rol ba'i rdo rje'i gser sku tshon gang la ga'u dang bcas pa sogs byin rlabs can gyi rten sna mang pos thog drangs ring bsrel rnam bzhi'i gzungs 'jug gis gtams par byas/ chu phag zla ba drug pa'i tshes gcig gi nyin mkha' spyod rtse'i lha khang du bkur sti chen pos gdan drangs nas rje de nyid kyi dgongs pa rdzogs ched du gsar du bzhengs pa'i mi 'khrugs pa'i shing sku mi tshad tsam pa rgyu mtshungs kyi seng khri rgyab yol gser tshon gzungs gzhug bcas grub zin pa de nyid dbus dang / g.yas su rje gong ma'i sku gdung mchod rten dang g.yon du sku gdung mchod rten 'di nyid bzhugs su gsol/ chos 'khor bskor ba'i dus chen dang bstun nas mchod sprin rgya mtsho spros te wang hu thog thu chog grogs dang bcas dpon slob bco lngas rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sgo nas rab gnas rgyas pa mdzad/ bla brang nas slob dpon la dngul dkar srang brgyas mtshon 'bul tshan brgya lnga bcu lhag dang grwa pa rnams la go bab kyi rab yon gzabs/ wang nas gdung 'bul du dmigs pa'i dngul srang nyis brgyas kyang sku gdung gi mdun du mchod pa gang rgyas dang dgon pa'i tshogs chen la rab ston gyi mang 'gyed zhus/ mtsho sngon sbyin 956

sa / /sdebatsunamakhazangartsamadza nyis d+madagaras rākhanabadag pe zi tshe brtan rdo rjes gser mgar mkhas pa ngo g.yog gsum gtong ba gnang ba bzhin 'di nas gser zangs kyi lha bab mchod rten thog tshad cig dang rgya nag nas gser zangs kyi dbyen skum mchod rten chung ba zhig bcas bla brang gi ngos nas mchod rten che chung gnyis dang / har chin sgo mang mkhan zur a ke bur+ṇa pā la a ke bsod nams dpal ldan so sos gser zangs kyi mchod rten che ba re dang har chin wang gi drung 'khor thun mong nas gser zangs kyi mchod rten gcig bcas zur du bzhengs pa'i mchod rten drug la'ang sku rus kyi cha shis res mtshon gzungs 'jug dang spyan dbye'i cho ga sogs bsgrubs te sgo mang mkhan zur gyis bzhengs pa'i mchod rten ri bo rtse lngarardo sgo'i bde mchog gi lha khang du bzhugs su gsol/ bla brang rang gis bzhengs pa'i mchod rten che ba de chos bzang ri khrod pa'i rten skal du gdan drangs shing / gzhan rnams mā thi dgon pa rgya yag dgon pa thar pa gling sku 'bum sgar gsar theg chen chos mdzod rnams kyi rten skal du re re gdan 'dren zhus/ rje de nyid kyi mdzad pa las kyi 'khor lo'i 'phro dgon lung tshogs chen 'du khang gi logs ris dang shing rtsi yin pas nang gi logs ris rnams rje rang nyid kyi bkod khyab ltar wang hu thog thus sbyin bdag mdzad nas phun sum tshogs par bsgrubs shing phyi nang gi shing rtsi dang phyi khyams kyi logs ris rnams bla brang nas rgyu yon sbyar te chu phag lo der legs par bsgrubs nas grub ston la tshogs chen du ja thug gsum dang kha btags re'i sku 'gyed zhus thog dngos kyi sbyin bdag khyim tshang bzhis 'bub thabs sbyar ba dang gzhan nas zhal 'deb 'dus pa bcas 'du khang 'bub thebs kyi dngul ci tsam byung tshul las mgo brtsams pa nas mjug grub kyi bar lo gsum gye bar sa las tshon las shing las gsum gyi nyo bca' rim pas nyos pa dang gla rin rim pas ster 957

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i na me'i gsung 'bum/ba gro chas rim pas bsgrigs pa'i song khungs so sor dngul ci tsam re song ba'i rgyu mtshan zhib 'khod kyi tho yig rgyas pa zhig tshogs dbus su bsgrags te/ bla brang rang nas dngul srang brgyad brgya dang srang drug zho drug skar lnga mthud pa'i gnas tshu la rnams dge 'dun la snyan 'bul gyi thog spyir bstan 'gro'i phan bde'i legs tshogs 'phel zhing khyad par 'brel thogs pa rnams la 'phral yun du dge ba'i skyabs 'jug zhus nas las mjug mthar phyin par byas te thugasakyi dgongs pa yongs su bskangs te mdor na rjes kyi bya ba thams cad kyang skyabs mgon nyid kyi thugs skyed byin rlabs dang phyi nang gi las byed mtha' dag 'dun pa gcig tu dril ba'i bsam sbyor rnam par dag pa gnyis zung du 'jug pa la brten nas shin tu rlabs che zhing ngos dag pa phyi nang gi 'gal rkyen gang yang med par byed bde zhing kun gyi smon pa'i gnas su lhun gyis grub pa 'ba' zhig sgo nas mthar phyin par gyur to/ / 'od stong sprin gyi phang bar mnal bas kyang / / yangs pa'i 'jig rten snang byed mthu gang zhig / mngon par gsal ba'i zla ba skar tshogs kyi/ / phreng bar bcas pas nam yang bskrun nus min/ / de bzhin mgon po zhi bar zhugs pas kyang / /'gro ba'i bsod nams mchog gi lam yangs po/ / gsal bar phye ba'i 'azin las 'od kyi cha/ / bstan 'dzin phal gyis mtshon nus ga la zhig / thog ma bar dang tha mar dge ba yi/ / mdzad pas 'brel tshad rtag pa dam pa'i skur/ / bsgyur mdzad ma dros chu gter khyod drung du/ / bdog pa'i 'bras bu spel rnams skal ba bzang / / snying pos dben ba'i chu shing ljon pa ru/ /tshad ma'i lung gis grub pa'i srid 'byor yang / / byang chub mchog gi snying por sgrub pa yi/ / thabs mkhas sgyu 'phrul spyod pa e ma rmad/ / rgyal ba'i bsod nams gser gyi ri bo'i ngos/ / bya ba'i gar bsgyur 'dab chags tshogs 958

sa / /che badzabashasaza ཿshadakaracha dganarnams༅nga / /sgo gsum nyes pa'i dri ma dang bral ba/ / mi zad legs byas gser bzang 'od du 'tsher/ /zhes bya ba'ang bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /de'ang rgyal ba'i bstan pa yongs su rdzogs pa la bka'i 'khor los 'dod dgur mnga' bsgyur ba'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rigs dang dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i bdag po 'di lta bu ni sku gsung thugs kyi mdzad pa gang la bltas na'ang dpyod pa po rang nyid blo gros kyi nor dang ldan zhing blo gzu bor gnas pa zhig yin na rnam thar gyi yi ge sogs la ma ltos par yang phul du byung ba'i dad pa skye bar nges te/ dang por bshes gnyen mtshan nyid dang ldan pa bcu phrag du ma las mdo dang sngags kyi chos tshul rgya mtsho lta bu la thos pa ngoms pa med pa gzhon nu nor bzang gi rnam thar lhur bzhengs nas gsungs rab dgongs 'brel dang bcas pa'i don la ma rtogs log rtog the tshom gsum gyi dri ma drungs phyung ste mang du thos pa rgya mtsho'i pha rol tu son nas 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyis rgyal ba'i bstan pa la byi dor ji ltar mdzad pa'i tshul gyi bshad pa'i rgyun dang / ji ltar thos pa'i don rnams thugs rgyud la sbyar te thun mong ba lam gyi gtso bo rnam gsum dang thun mong ma yin pa gsang chen rim gnyis kyi rnal 'byor sogs la gcig tu gzhol bar mdzad pa'i mthus sku 'phreng gong ma du mar goms pa'i skyes thob dang gnas skabs kyi sbyangs stobs zung du 'jug pa'i brten nas thun mong gi snang tshod la'ang rtogs pa klong du gyur te grub pa'i go 'phang mthon por gshegs pas yi dam lha'i zhal gzigs shing chos skyong bran du 'khol ba sogs kyi grub 'bras smra bsam gye ra ba las 'gongs pa du ma dang / bstan pa'i gzhi ma dge 'dun gyi sde du ma gsar du btsugs nas mdo sngags bshad sgrub kyi srol btod cing sngar yod pa'i dge 'dun gyi sde che chung bgrang las 'das pa la'ang chos 'chad nyan sgrig lam nyams gsos 959

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/sogs sgo mtha' dag nas skyong bar mdzad pa dang sku gsung thugs kyi rten grangasadang tshad kyis dbog par mi nus pa gsar bsgrun sogs bya ba las kyi 'khor lo'i phyag rjes te/ mdor na 'khor lo gsum gyi mdzad pa'i cha re re la bltas na'ang sku tshe gcig gi mdzad pa la 'di lta bu 'ongs pa dka' bar 'dug snyam pa sha stag gi sgo nas bstan pa dang 'gro ba'i phan bde'i dga' tshal mchog tu yangs pa'i rtsig ngos la sras bcas rgyal ba kun gyi gzigs mor che ba'i grags snyan tshon brgya'i ri mo bskal ba'i mthar yang nyams pa med pa 'ba' zhig tu bkod de gnas pa 'di nyid rnam thar gyi dngos gzhi yin mod/ 'on kyang yul dang dus kyis bskal ba'i dbang gis de dag ji lta ba bzhin du rtsar gcod par mi nus la dam pa'i rnam thar gyi rjes su blo mig gyen du phyogs 'dod pa rnams la thar pa'i lam gyi 'jug ngogs gsal bar bya ba'i phyir rnam par thar pa phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs nas yi ger 'khod pa 'di'ang don shin tu chen po dang ldan pa yin te/ skyes rabs las/ grags pa'i mtshan mar gyur pa bzang po 'di rnams kyis/ / bde bar gshegs 'gyur lam rnams gang yin bstan par 'gyur/ / yid la dad pa med pa rnams kyang dad par 'gyur/ / chos dang ldan pa'i gtam gyis rab tu dga' bar 'gyur/ / zhes gsungs pa bzhin no/ / de ltar ma yin par dang por gzhung lugs la thos bsam tshul bzhin du byas pa'i 'bras bu 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi sgo nas rgyal ba'i bstan pa la bya ba 'di ltar byas bya ba'am/ de'i don la rang gis nyams len 'di lta bu bgyes bya ba sogs mdor na theg pa che chung gi sde snod rnams su bla ma'i mtshan nyid ji snyed cig gsungs pa las sna gcig gi sgo nas kyang rjes su dran par bya rgyu med par kha drag dbang che 'khor g.yog mnga' thang dgra 'dul gnyen skyong sogs mdor na brjod bya'i ngo bo 'jig rten gyi sde dpon 960

sa / /rjebatshunasatha bas sacha gsas tshuranazhig gi gnas lugs bajod tshul las ma 'das kyang / skabs skabs su snga phyi'i 'brel dang rgyu mtshan ci yang med bzhin du btsan thabs kyis sangs rgyas las kyang lhag par sangs rgyas pa lta bu'i stong 'ud re bsgrags te sbrul gyis bya sgod mid pa lta bu phra nyag spom gsum cham mtshungs pa'i rnam thar gyi yig 'jog byas pa ni snag shog gron du byed cing mkhas pa rnam dpyod can rnams khrel ba'i bzhad gad kyi rgyur zad do/ / der ma zad da lta snyigs ma'i tha mar song ba'i dbang gis phal mo che zhig yul phyogs sde dgon gyi zhen pa'am/ zang zing gi 'dod pa phugs su bcug ste skye bo phal ba ci 'dra zhig la'ang dpal ldan bla ma dam pa zhes zer ba la the mi tshom bar snang mod/ rtog yul na yod pa'i rtags kyis 'dod rgyal gyi sgra rnams gang la'ang brjod du rung bar grags pa'i rjes dpag gis grub pa las rgyu mtshan can gyi tha snyad rnams ni 'dogs pa'i rgyu mtshan dang mthun pa dgos pas/ bla ma zhes pa'i sgra don 'jug pa'ang rang nyid yon tan gye lced dang ldan pa'ang yang na gu ṇa a kā ra zhes slob ma la yon tan rnams de'i drin las 'byung bas yon tan gyi 'byung gnas su gyur ba zhig dgos te/ 'khri shing las/ nor bu bzhin du yon tan nyid kyis bla ma 'thob/ ces dang / skyes rabs las kyang / yon tan gyi tshogs kyis bla mar gyur pa zhes gsungs so/ / khyad par du dpal ldan bla ma zhes pa'i sgra don tshang ba ni/ don dam bsnyen pa las/ gang zhig yon tan rin phung dpal ldan bla ma de/ / gang zhig srid pa'i skyon 'joms dpal ldan bla ma de/ / gang zhig snyan pa'i ngag smra dpal ldan bla ma de/ / gang zhig lam bzang ston pa dpal ldan bla ma de/ / gang zhig dmyal ba'i mi 'joms dpal ldanabla ma de/ / gang zhig srid pa'i phar sgol dpal ldan bla ma de/ / gang zhig 'gro ba'i gnyen gcig dpal ldan bla ma de/ / gang zhig 'gro ba'i mig 961

༄/ /gung tha bstan pa'izlaname'i gsung 'bum/gcig dpal ldan bla ma de/ / gang zhig sems can mnyam sems dpal ldan bla ma de/ / zhes sogs ltar dang bor rang nyid thos bsam sgom pa'i sgo nas yon tan rin po che'i phung por gyur cing / de nas sems can kun la mnyam par brtse ba la bu gcig pa lta bu'i sgo nas snyan pa'i gsung gis gang la gang 'tsham du yang dag pa'i lam bzang bstan te dmyal ba'i me dpung 'bar ba sogs ngan song gi gnas las drangs nas mngon mtho'i rten dang srid pa phra rags kyi rgya mtsho'i pha rol tu bsgral nas nges legs byang chub gsum la dgod pa sogs rgyal ba'i mdzad pa mtha' dag sgrub pas 'gro ba kun gyi dpung gnyen dang mig gcig pur gyur pa rje bla ma 'di nyid lta bu ni nges pa don gyi dpal ldan bla ma yin pas/ dpal ldan bla ma de ni ci phyir bsten mi bya/ / dpal ldan bla ma de ni ci phyir tshim mi bya/ / dpal ldan bla ma de ni ci phyir mchod mi bya/ / dpal ldan bla ma de la ci phyir phyag mi bya/ zhes yon tan rjes su dran nas tshul bzhin du bsngags pa sogs sgo gsum gyis phyag dang mchod pa lhur byed dgos par gsungs so/ / de las bzlog ste rang la tshul bzhin sgrub pa'i yon tan yang med/ slob ma rjes su 'dzin pa'i brtse ba'ang med/ nor longasaspyod tsam la chags nas de kho na don du gnyer rjes 'jug rnams chos ston pa'i mkhas pa gzhan gyi drang du 'gror mi ster bar phrag dog gis smod cing / rang nyid la chos kyi lam bstan nas skyong rgyu med par dge 'dun gyis dkor sogs log 'tsho'i sbyin pa tsam gyis sdud pa ni phan las gnod pa che ba'i sru brid kho na yin pas 'dor ba'i 'os su gyur pa'ang de nyid las/ 'dod pa phal bar zhen pa dpal ldan bla ma min/ / legs 'ong nor la chags pa dpal ldan bla ma min/ / skyes bu mkhas la smod byed dpal ldan bla ma min/ /sems can snying brtse rnam spangs dpal ldan bla ma min/ / dge 'dun dkor 962

༄/ /rjebatsotshos4cho minyima'ig4ga musadabasogasakalas rab ster dpal ldan bla ma min/ / nor med slob ma 'dor ba dpal ldan bla ma min/ / bu bzang bslu bar 'dod pa dpal ldan bla ma min/ / rdzas kyi mthu yis rab dga' dpal ldan bla ma min/ / zhes sogs rgya cher gsungs so/ / des na nges pa don gyi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa 'di lta bu'i rnam par thar pa la tshul bzhin du rjes su yi rang bar bya ba ni dal ba'i rten la snying bo blangaba'i thabs phul du che bar mthong ste so bon ji ltar 'khor pa bzhin sgro skur spangs nas rgyas par brjod zin pa bzhin yin pas de dag slar yang thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i lam gyi lus lta bur don tshan so sor bsgrigs te zhib tu bshad na nges pa ster tshul gyi gnad mang po yod kyang yi ge'i tshogs ches lce bar 'gyur bas mdor bsdus te phyogs tsam mtshon par byed pa la/rang don phun sum tshogs pa lung rtogs kyi yon tan brnyes pa'i tshul/gzhan don phun sum tshogs pa 'phrin las kyis gdul bya bskyang ba'i tshul gnyis/ dang po la'ang gnyis te/ lung gi yon tan phun sum tshogs pas 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum la mnga' brnyes tshul/ rtogs pa'i yon tan phun sum tshogs pas grub pa'i go 'phang mngon du mdzad tshul lo/ / dang po ni/nges pa'i don du blo gter 'jam dpal rnon po'i gsang gsum sgyu 'phrul gye bkod pa gnas gcig tu skad cig ma gcig la bstan pa'ang / ji skad du/skra tsam khyon la dus gsumatshad snyed kyi/ / sangs rgyas rgya mtsho zhing rnams rgya mtshodang / / bskal pa rgya mtshor spyod cing rab tu 'jug / ces gsungs pa ltar smra bsam gyi yul las 'das shing / thun mong ba'i snang ngo dang mthun par bstan pa'i dbang du bgyis na'ang 'khrungs rabs kyi rim pa tshad mar gyur pa'i lha dang bla ma gzhan gyis lung bstan pa dang / grub pa'i 'khor los sgyur ba chen po rje ngag dbang chos kyi rgya mtshos sngon gnas rjes su dran tshul 963

༄/ /gung thang bstanaba'isgroname'i gsung 'bum/las dag gi slob ma 'ga' zhig la gsungs pa rnams dang / re gnyis tsam rje blas nyid nas kyang zhal gyis bzhes pa sogs gung bsgrigs na sngon thub pa'i dbang po'i mdun sar stong nyid smra ba'i khyu mchog byang chub sems dpa' nges don dbyangs sgog tu skye ba bzhes pa nas bzung 'phags bod kun tu mkhas grub du ma'i skye ba bzhes tshul gsol 'debs nor bu'i 'phreng ba ltar gye steng du de dag so so'i sgos kyi rnam thar rnams su gcig nas gcig tu brgyud pa sogs su dam pa mang po phan tshun thugs rgyud gcig tshul gsungs pa rnams shan sbyar pa'i tshe gsol 'debs me tog 'phreng mdzes las 'byung ba bzhin skyes rabs kyi 'phreng ba ches mang la/ mdor na rim dang gcig car gyi nges pa kho na la'ang ma ltos par gdul bya'i skal ba kho na'i rjes su 'gro ba'i dbang gis rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po ches gar khyab tu mkhas pa paṇ+ḍi ta dang rnal 'byor gyi dbangaphyug / chos ldan gyi rgyal po la sogs pa sgyu 'phrul gyi bkod pa gang 'tsham du bstan te thub bstan mi nub pa'i rgyal mtshan bsgreng bar mdzad pa gdon mi za'o/ / da lta 'ga' zhig mkhas grub gnyis 'dzom gyi skyes rabs gser gye ri bo lta bu rim par bgrangs kyang rang la de dang rjes su mthun pa'i rnam pa cha tsam yang med par gdul bya'i skal ba'i dbang dang / dus kyi dbang dang / tshul bstan gsum la phug skyel dgos pa lta bu ma yin par rje bla ma 'di nyid kyi mdzad pa'i ngang tshul mthong nas 'khrungs rabs snga ma rnams kyi rnam thar la bltas pa na 'di dang 'di ni nges par skal ba mnyam pa'i rgyu 'bras su snang snyam pa sha stag 'byung bas/ sku na shin tu phra mo'i skabs nas kyang sku 'phreng snga ma de dag tu gsung rab rgya mtsho lta bu la sbyangs pa'i nus pa thugs la god pa med par mnga' ba'i dbang gis chos gang gzigs pa na'ang thogs pa med par thugs la lam gyis 'char ba dang gzhan gyis nyams sad lta 964

༄/ /sdebatshun bzangatsamadzamanyis ga d+madakarasad nga/bur dri ba zhus na'ang gsung rnon po re res sgog gi gzer bkrol ba bzhin btang ste yun ring por sbyangs pa'i yus can gyi rgan po rnams kyi snyems pa phrogasas te gzhung lugs la gsar du sbyong rgyu med pa lta bu yin na'ang / don mthunapa'i sgo nas gdul bya rjes su 'dzin pa la bshes gnyen bsten te thos bsam mdzad tshul sogs rgyal ba'i bstan pa la rim gyis slob tshul skas kyi gdang bu lta bu zhig dgos par gzigs te/ rgyal dbang bdun pa rje btsun blo bzang bskal bzang rgya mtsho/ paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa dpal ldan ye shes/ rje ngag dbang byams pa/ lcang skya rol ba'i rdo rje/ bdag chen kunadaga' blo gros/ gnub ston bzhad pa'i rdo rje/ kun mkhyen 'jigs med dbang po/ mkhan chen ye shes dpal 'byor sogs theg pa mchog gi dge ba'i bshes gnyen mtshan nyid dang ldan pa du ma rigs kyi cod pan du bsten nas chos kyi bdud rtsi nod par mdzad/ de'i tshul yang mu to'i phye bzhin lung dang rjes gnang thar thor sogs sna kha gang mang gis thos lo'i rnam grangs bsags pa tsam ma yin par rgyal ba'i gsung rab thams cad kyi dgongs pa'i don shing rta chen po gnyis dang jo bo yab sras/ rje bdag nyid chen po rnams kyis gsal bar mdzad pa'i man ngag bzhin skyes bu gsum gyi lamagyi rim par bsgrigs te bka' bod chen po thams cad de'i yan lag tu byas nas gtan la 'bebs tshul dang / de nas sngags kyi dbang rnam par dag pa sngon du 'gro ba'i sgo nas rgyud sde bzhi'i rgyud dang rgyud 'grel chen po rnams kyi bshad pa/ de dag lam gyi rim par bsgrigs pa'i rim gnyis kyi man ngag thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa dam pa gong ma rnams kyi thugs nas thugs dang snyan nas snyan du brgyud pa'i gces mdzod lta bu shin tu zab cing gsang ba thams cad bum pa gang byo'i tshul du gsan te rgyal ba'i bstan pa 965

༄/ /gung thang bstan ba'ithoname'i gsung 'bum/yongs su rdzogs pa'i gnad ma tshang ba med par thugs su chud pa/ dper na ri shin tu mthon po'i rtse mor phyin nas bltas pa na shod kyi ri klung thams cad dusagacig la mig 'og tu chud pa lta bur gyur/ da lta mtshan nyid kyi gzhung la sbyong ba phal mo che tshig re re'i zer lugs legs nyes tsam gyi rjes bsnyegs te ri dwags thang la ded pa bzhin song bas bstan pa spyi la nges pa rnyed pa lta zhog / thad ka thad ga'i rtsa ba'i gzhung gi steng du'ang mi 'khri zhing shes rgyud dang sbyor rgyu'i phyogs na'ang med pas gzhung lugs la ji tsam sbyangs pa bzhin rgyud je gyong du song nas chos dang sems gnyis 'dzol te 'gro ba ni thos pa byed tshul ma shes pa'i dbang gis yin pas/ rje 'dis dang po bsdus tshad kyi gzhung la sbyangs pa'i skabs nas bzung mdo phyogs mtha' dag sngags kyi grogs su 'char ba dang / sngags kyi phyogs rnams mdo'i grogs su 'char ba zhig yod pas ci tsam du thos pa rgya che bar btsal ba bzhin gzhung lugs mtha' dag gdams par shar ba'ang shugs kyis 'byung ba ni gzhan gang dang yang ma 'dres pa'i khyad chos yab rje rgyal ba gnyis pa'i rnam thar gyi rjes su 'gro ba zhig go / sngon sgo mang chos grar 'dzin gra gzhung gsar nas phebs te cher ma 'gyang ba'i skabs shig rje phur bu lcog pa'i bka' chos la byon nas yun ring 'gor song bar blo chung khron pa'i rus sbal gye rnam thar 'dzin pa 'ga' zhig skabs 'dir de 'dra gnang ba mi 'thad par 'dug snyam nas blor ma bab pa'i gtam smras/ rjes sor tshul phebs nas rtsod pa gnang dus kho rang tshos srod pharabaskyal tho rangs tshur bsus te ngal ba cher byas pa las brgya 'gyur gyis lhag pa'i lung dang rigs pa ngo mtshar ba'i phreng ba thogs med du spel ba na sngar cal col smras pa la 'gyod pa skyes shing ngo mtshar dang mos gus 'gran pa bzhin du 'phel/ rje nyid nas kyang nga'i lung rigs 'di tsho phur bu lcog gi 966

༄/ / ༄tsug bzapachosaminyama'igasangagatsosamagasasadabyunganabrag gseb nas rnyed pa yin zhes nyams mtshar gyi zhal pho lta bu'ang mdzad 'dug / skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang 'jigs med dbang po'i zhal nas kyang thu'u bkwan tshang gi mkhyen rab de me 'bar ba lta bu zhig yin phar dpyad pa byas kyin mched nas 'gro bas khong gi kha ya sus kyang mi chod gsungs pa dang /u cu mu chin gyi gu thi skal bzang zer ba sngon gyi bag chags kyi dbang gis skyes thobakyi shes rab dang mang du thos pa zhig la deng sang gi dus su ya med lta bu sngon paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa rgya nag tu pheb skabs bka' bgros mdzad pas thugs ha cang ya mtshan ba ltar gyur pa des kyang nga tshos chos la phyi nas phar bltas ba dang thu'u bkwan rin po ches rdo rje rnal 'byor mas chos kyi gter kha phyeste nang nas rdol pa gnyis po 'dra sa med ces zer ba dngos su thos te mkhas pa rnam dpyod can gyi tshig tu snang ste/ la la til mar bzhin du btsir las byung / / la la rgyal po'i bu bzhin lhun gyis grub/ gsungs pa'i dpe ltar phal pa'i skye bo gnas skabs sdug rus tsam gyes yon tan bre gsog phul gsog byed dgos pa dang mi 'dra bar bdag nyid chen po de lta bu ni nang gi nyer len sku 'phreng snga ma mang por sbyangs pa'i yon tan gyi tshogs cung zad kyang kha ma bri bar gnas pa dang / lhan cig byed rkyen lhag pa'i lhas rjes su bzung ba'i stobs kyis zab cing rgya che ba'i gzhung gi dka' gnad ji 'dra zhig la'ang mkhyen pa thogs med du 'jug tshul gong du smos pa bzhin rje ngag dbang byams pas gnang ba'i 'jam dbyangs kyi gser thang zhig yod pa la gsol ba re btab na 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum ci 'dra zhig mdzad dgos kyang thogs pa med par 'ong tshul dang / shin tu dka' ba'i gnad 'ga' zhig thugs la 'char dka' ba byung ba'i tshe 'jam dbyangs dkar po'i sngags brgya rtsa re bzlas te gsol ba btab na lam gyis shar 'ong tshul rje nyid kyis gsungs pa ni 967

༄/ /yo cabastan pa'isgoname'i gsung 'bum/slob dpon tsan+d+ra go mi dang mnyam med jo bo chen po sogs kyi rnam thar lo rgyus bzhin yin la/ dpe glog mdzad pa na'ang thar chags su gzigs mi dgos par mtshams mtshams nas gzigs tsam re mdzad pas gzhung gi lus cha tshang bar thugs la nges pa 'byung zhing zhal nas kyang 'di ngas dpe cha lta tshul thun mong ma yin pa yin gsungs te chos rgyun gyi ting nge 'dzin brnyes pa'i mtshan ma yin la/ tha na mnal lam du'ang bla ma dang yi dam gyi lhas gdams pa dang rjes su bstan pa rgya cher stsal pa'i tshul gong du smos pa bzhin yin pas de ltar rgyu tshogs ma tshang ba med par bsgrubs na de dang rjes su mthun par 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i rnam dpyod 'gran pa'i zla dang bral bar 'gyur ba las 'os med do/ / gnyis pa rtogs pa'i yon tan phun sum tshogs pas grub pa'i go 'phang mngon du mdzad tshul ni grub pa thob ces pa da lta phal mo che gdon bgegs 'dul ba'i nus pa phran tshegs re yod pa dang spyod pa lhug par spyod pa tsam zhig la go ba ni chos kyi gnad ma shes pa yin pas grub pa zhes pa chos grub pa la go dgos so/ / chos grub pa'i don ji ltar yin snyam na lung gi bstan pa'i don tshul bzhin nyams su len pa la rtogs pa'i bstan pa dang sgrub pa'i bstan par 'jog dgos pas mos spyod kyi gnas skabs na chos tshul bzhin du sgrub pa yod kyang de kun rdzob pa'i chos dkon mchog tsam du 'gro ba las chos don dam pa zhig rang rgyud la ma grub pas rten gyi gang zag kyang don dam pa'i dge 'dun dkon mchog gi grangs su mi 'gro nam zhig bden pa mngon sum du mthong ba na rang rgyud la don dam pa'i chos grub pa yin pas/ mdo sde rnams su chos mthong ba chos thob pa chos rig pa the tshom las brgal ba som nyi las brgal ba zhes gsungs shing / rgyal ba byams pa mgon pos mdo sde rgyan las kyang / sa rnams thams cad ma grub dang / / grub pa dag tu shes par 968

sa / /rje btsun/tha bka ngabs lashā dganartsa ces/bya/ / zhes pa'i don 'jam mgon sa paṇa gyis/ grub thob chung du mthong lam yin/ / grub pa 'bring po sa brgyad pa/ / grub thob chen po sangs rgyas sa/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ / bdag nyid chen po 'dis na grub pa'i go 'phang mngon du bya ba'i tshul ji skad du bstod pa brgya lnga bcu par/ nyes pa nyams smad rtsa nas bton/ / yon tan spel nas rnam par sbyangs/ / gzhung lugs bzang po des na khyod/ / grub mchog lhag par brnyes pa lags/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar rgyal ba'i gsung rab nas ji ltar 'byung ba bzhin du thog mkho nar dge ba'i bshes gnyen sten tshul rmad du byung bas legs tshogs kyi rmang gzhi tshugs par byas des ji ltar gdams pa bzhin du bslab pa rin po che rnam pa gsum gyis bsdus pa'i lam thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa mtha' dag la nyams len phyogs char ma lhung ba mdzad de mdo rgyud so so nas ji ltar gsungs pa'i sa lam gyi rtogs pa dan rtags 'khrul ba med pa dang bcas pa mngon du mdzad pas grub pa'i dbang phyug chen por gyur pa ni gzu bor gnas shing chos kyi mig dang ldan pa rnams kyis ci tsam yun du dpyad pa bzhin phyir mi ldog pa'i nges pa je brtan kho nar 'gyur ro/ / 'di dag gi tshul yang gong du thor bu thor bur mang du song zin pa rnams bstan bshad 'byor ba'i phyir 'ga' tsam smos na rje ngag dbang byams pa'i drung nas byang chub lam rim gyi khridagasan pas bla ma dang chos la mos gus kyi rkang tshugs te de nas bzung sangs rgyas dngos kyi 'du shes ma gtogs tha mal gyi 'du shes skye ma myong gsungs pa dang / sku tshe hril por rje de nyid la mos gus rtse gcig tu sbyangs tebla ma'i snang ba dang ma bral ba'i dbang gis mnal lam tshun chad du byon nas lam rim gyi dka' gnad mang por dri ba zhus pa rnams legs par phye ste som nyi'i 'ching ba grol bar mdzad/ lcang skya thams cad mkhyen pa'ang 969

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'isgroname'i gsung 'bum/dpal he ru ka dngos su gzigs pa'i rgyu mthun gyis rdo rje 'chang nas dbang khrid man ngag sogs stsol tshul yang slob ma dkyus ma gzhan dang mi 'dra bar rgya gar grub chen snga phyis gcig gis gcig rjes su 'dzin tshul ltar phun sum tshogs pa bzhi dngos gnas su tshang ba'i sgo nas stsal cing rigs kyi bdag por 'du 'bral med par bzhugs pas lcang skya rdo rje 'chang nas nyams mgur dang ljags lung 'ga' zhig gegs sel bog 'byin gyi gdams pa mang po stsal cing /sku 'da' kha'i tshe'ang rje 'di la mnal lam du phebs nas de'i rgyu mtshan gsungs pa dang 'das rjes su'ang gsol ba nan btab kyi tshe nyams dang rmi lam ci rigs pa'i tshul gyis zhal dngos su bstan nas zab rgyas kyi gdams pa dang 'byung 'gyur gyi lung bstan sogs stsal tshul gzigs pa lnga ldan gyi lo rgyus ji lta ba bzhin byung la/ kun mkhyen 'jigs med dbang pos kyang 'tshub chag che ba'i skabs mang por rje 'di'i mnal lam du byon nas 'jigs pa'i 'phrang las bsgral tshul sogs mdor na dad pa can gyi sgo khang na/ / bla ma sgo nyal byed kyin yod/ / gsungs pa bzhin bla ma rnams kyis thugs rjes skad cig kyang mi gtong bar rjes su bzung ba'i mtshan ma mthun grub tu byung ba ni bla ma rnams kyi ngos nas slob ma so so la thugs rje nye ring du gyur pa min yang nyid kyi ngos nas bshes gnyen sten tshul gyi thog ma'i rten 'brel gzhan las chesakhyad par du gyur pa'i mtshan ma yin no/ / de ltar lam gyi rtsa ba bshes gnyen sten tshul rmad du byung ba'i rten 'brel gyi sgo de dang rjes su mthun par thun mong ba skyes bu gsum gyi lam gyi rim pa dang / thun mong ma yin pa rdo rje theg pa'i lam rim pa gnyis kyi rtogs pa mngon du mdzad tshul rnams ni phyogs tsam zhig rnam par thar pa gong du smos pa rnams kyis mtshon par nus la/gtso bor gyur pa ni slob dpon seng ge bzang pos/ byang chub sems dpa' 970

da / / zabang :ga khabab lakarnams kyi tha snyad ni sems can gdul ba'i dgos pa'i dbang ma gtogs par rtogs pa dang rjes su mthun pa kho na yin no/ zhes gsungs pa ltar bka' rtsom gyi gzhung che chung nyams mgur dang bslab bya nyung ngu re tshun chad la'ang mkhas pa rnams dpyod can bstan pa'i gnad shes pa zhig gis bltas na tshig gi na yam tsam ma yin par nyams dang rtogs pa'i klong nang nas rdol ba'i mtshan ma kho na yin par shes nus so/ de'ang sku 'phreng re re tsam ma yin par sku tshe du mar mdo sngags kyi lam la sgrub pa lhur mdzad pa'i bag chags sku na shin tu phra mo'i dus nas lhan skyes su yod pa mthun snang du grub pa'i tshul yang / dgung lo gsum bzhi tsam gyi dus ngas lam rim bshad rgyu yin gsungs te las dkar nag gi dbang gis bde 'gro dang ngan 'gror 'gro tshul de las skyob pa'i skyabs dkon mchog gsum kho na la brten dgos tshul sogs brda'i sgo nas mtshon ba'i gdams pa ngo mtshar ba gnang zhing / mtshan mo gzim mal du'ang / sang dang 'jig rten phyi ma gnyis/ / sngon du gang 'ongs gtol med pas/ / zhes gsungs pa bzhin sang nam langs kyi bar du'ang mi sdod nges pa lta bu'i mi rtag pa'i 'du shes shugs drag po 'khrungs nas grogs la zhal chem bzhag tshul dang / 'khor ba mtha' dag me 'bar ba'i rlubs lta bur mthong ba'i nges 'byung gi shugs kyis thog mar rab byung mdzad pa'i tshe thar pa'i rgyal mtshan brtan par gyur cig ces sogs kyis shis pa bajod pa na nges par 'byung ba'i tshul khrims rnam par dag pa 'di lta bu thob rgyu byung ba e ma skal ba bzang snyam du rang dbang med par mchi ma 'khrugs pa byung zhing rtse mor na bun 'khrigs pa'i rdza ri mthon po dang nags tshal yid du 'ong ba sogs gzigs re bzhin 'di snang chos brgyad kyi g.yeng ba btsan chod byas te gnas 'di 'dra zhig tu tshe dang sgrub pa snyoms rgyu byung na snyam pa'i 971

༄/ /gung tha bstan pa'i me'i gsung 'bum/thugasakyi 'dun pa nar mar 'khrungs/ sku na phra mo'i skabs khyi zhig mu ges 'chi la thug pa gzigs nas tsham tshom med par sku sha sbyin par bsams kyang gri ma rnyed cing mi gzhan gyis mthong ste stabs ma 'grigs/ spyir 'gro ba kun la brtse ba chen pos dgongs par 'dra na'ang 'di 'dra ba'i nyam thag dang nad pa thu mo shin tu dbul zhing phongs pa rgyal po'i chad pas mnar ba sogs mgon dbaskyabs med pa rnams gzigs pa na sha'u la me phog bzhin thugs kyis mi bzod par thabs ci rigs kyi sgo nas de las skyob pa'i thabs shig mdzad ma zin gyi bar la thugs khral rgyun du gnang ste yal bar mi 'dor ba dang / de lta bu'i snying rje chen pos dran pa yang dang yang gso ba'i dmigs rkyen du 'phags mchog thugs rje chen pos 'gro ba rnams 'jigs pa chen po brgyad las bskyabs tshul sogs kyi rnam par thar pa'i ri mo rgyun du gzigs sar bkram nas byams snying rje'i dmigs rnam bskyangs tshul sogs kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems kyi nyams len dang / lta ba'i dpyad pa mdzad pa na thugs ngor kun rdzob kyi spros pa thams cad 'gags pa'i tshul paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen par zhus pas dbu ma thal 'gyur pa'i lta ba rnam par dag pa yin tshul gyi bsngags brjod mdzad pa sogs don dam byang chub kyi sems kyi sgo nas srid pa'i rtsa ba hrul por mdzad pa'i tshul gyi rnam par thar pa'ang thor bu ba mang tsam gong du song ba bzhin no/ / thun mong ma yin pa sngags kyi rtogs pa khyad par can mngon du 'gyur ba'i rgyu'i gtso bo ni/ gang gi drin gyis bden chen nyid/ / skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang / / bla ma rin chen lta bu zhes grub pa'idabang phyug du mas mgrin gcig tu gsungs pa bzhin bla ma dang yi dam dbyer mi phyed pa phyi nang gsang ba de kho na nyid kyi mchod sprin rgya mtshos mnyes parabs te thugs yid gcig 'dres kyi sgo nas byin rlabs zhugs pa kho nar 972

༄/ /rjebatsun bzangartsamadzam gsu pabadakarasadarwa /rag las la rje 'di nyid bla ma dang yi dam lhas rjes su bzung tshul yang spyir sku na phra mo'i dus nas bzung dngos dang nyams snang mi lam ci rigs par byin gyis brlabs pa'i lo rgyus smos kyis mi lang ba/ khyad par du kun mkhyen 'jigs med dbang pos sngon nas 'brel ba'i rten 'brel gyi sgo dang dgos dbang khyad par can gzigs te mkha' spyod ma'i be'u bum zhu dag byed rgyu gnang ba'i rkyen gyis sku 'phreng snga ma'i bag chags kyi nus pa brtas pas de'i sku dngabe'u bum gyi dpe sogs sgrub rgyu'i rtsol ba mdzad skabs lha bzo zhig gis rnal 'byor ma'i sku thang zhig khyer 'ongs nas phul te kho rang gar song cha med du gyur pas dpal te ru ga'i sgyu 'phrul zhig yin par nges pa rnyed cing / de rjes lcang skya rdo rje 'chang la de'i byin rlabs kyi bka' zhus pa'i tshe khyed kyi sku tshe gong ma'i yi dam thun mong ma yin pa'ang 'di nyid yin gsung nas dgyes pa chen pos smin byed dbang dang grol byed rim gnyis kyi gdams pa thugs kyi gces mdzod mtha' dag lhag lus med par pha nor bu la 'bog pa bzhin du rje nyid gcig pu la stsal cing / de nyid kyi bkas bskul te 'di skor gye man ngag 'ga' zhig stag phu rin po che las kyang gsan de'i skabs shin tu don med kyi mi tshang zhig nas mkha' spyod ma'i be'u bum gyi dpe 'bul mkhan yang byung ste phyis su dam ldan gyi bu slob nang ma 'ga' zhig la rje btsun ma'i sku dang glegs bam nged kyis phar tshol ma dgos par nged rang tshur btsal nas 'ongs pa yin gsungs te/ legs pa'i cha la rten 'brel thams cad 'grigs/ / phun sum tshogs pa rang gis byas pa yin/ / gsungs pa ltar chos dang chos bdag 'phrod pa'i rten 'brel rang 'grig lhun gyis grub pa 'di lta bu ni nyer mkho'i rgyu nor phran tshegs re dus thog tu byung ba la bsod nams kyi dpal chen por rlom pa dag gis cha tsam bsgrun du med pa'i ngo mtshar gyi gnas yin no/ / der ma 973

/ /gung thang bstan pa'izlaname'ig4 'bum/zad 'bras srung du bzhugs skabs mi nag cig gis khyed la sa skya nas kham pa bla mas bskur ba yin zhes mang thos klu sgrub rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i slob bshad kyi dpe zhig phul te de ma thag phyir log song ba la rgyu mtshan zhig 'dri dgos dgongs nas rjes bsnyegs pas gar song cha med cing srang dang rwa skor sogs su sus kyang ma mthong 'dug pa'ang sngon tshar chen bkra shis lhun por bzhugs skabs byung ba'i lo rgyus dang 'dra ste 'di dag rnams mtshon pa tsam yin gye/lha 'di dang chos 'di rje nyid kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i dngos skal du gyur tshul gyi gtan tshigs che mang la lcang skya rdo rje 'chang chen por mkha' spyod ma'i gdams pa zhu mkhan mang po la'ang ches 'di thu'u bkwan rin po che la zhus na khyad par zhig yod gsungs te dgongs gzhi zab par snang / der ma zad rje de nyid kyi drung nas bde mchog gi dbang gsan skabs gsang mtshan chos kyi rdo rjerabatags te 'di ma brjed pa gyis zhes yang yang gsungs pa la dpag na stabs 'grig tsam ma yin par gsung rdo rje'i rigs su nges pa bzhin yi dam lhas dngos su btags pa yin par mngon/ gzhan yang dus 'khor gyi dbang gsan skabs so shing gyen 'greng du gnas pa sogs chos zab mo gsan res bzhin gsan tshul 'dra'ang thob tshul mi 'dra ba re byung ba'i lo rgyus bgrang gis mi lang ngo / / gsang sngags kyi chos gang gsan pa thams cad kyang dus denas brtsams te lha sngags re re'ang ma lus par nyams su bzhes pa'i tshul nyid nas bka' chos sogs kyi skabs su gsang sngags zab mo'i chos 'di 'dra nyan pa lar snod zhabs rdol du ma song ba'i don gang thob pa de ma brjed pa tsam gyis mi chog de nyid kyi lha'i rnal 'byor dang bsgom bzlas sogs mdor bsdus pa re yin kyang ma chag pa zhig med mi rung du byed dgos zhes yang yang gsungs pas dpog par nus shing / rgyun gyi thugs dam nar ma'i rim 974

sa / /rje btsun sazangatsan mi cha ga ras ces/pa'ang thun dang por skyabs sems ngag byen rlabs lam khrid rgyas bsdus ci rigs rnal 'byor ma'i rim gnyis 'pho ba dang bcas pa lhag lha du ma'i bzlas bsgom brgya rtsa chu sbyin sogs dang / thun gnyis par mdo rgyud du ma lngags klog mtshan dang gzungs sngags zab mo sna tshogs sangs rgyas byang sems kyi bstod tshogs ci rigs/ phyi dro 'jigs byed dpa' gcig snying zhugs kyi rnal 'byor chos skyong so so'i gtor 'bul gcod dmigs za byed mkha' 'gro'i sbyin sreg bsngo ba'i rgyas 'debs rnams dang / snga phyi'i mtshams ci rigs par yan lag bdun pa maṇ+ḍal dang bcas pa sems bskyed thun drug gi rnal 'byor sgo drug pa'i gzungs ltung bshags dam tshig rdo rje dang rdo rje sems dpa'i bzlas bsgom rnams lan drug re chag med du mdzad cing / yar ngo mar ngo'i tshes bcu rnams la sgrub mchod bdag 'jug dang bcas pa/skabs skabs kyi dus gtor dang zhal 'don dmigs bsal can gyi rigs sogs mdor na nyi ma re re'i thugs dam gyi rim pa'ang gzhan zhig gis nyin mang po'i bar du spros pa gzhan med par chig dril du 'bad kyang 'grub dka' ba'i tshod du long de/ phyis sku khams ltems pa'i skabs shig zhabs 'brang ba rnams nas zhal 'don gyi rim pa cung zad bsdus su ma btang na sku gzugs la gnod tshul nan gyis zhus skabs de'i nang nas thor bu ba 'ga' zhig cha bges te gzhan mang po la 'don du bcug pa'ang tshar dka' ba'i tshod tsam byung snang /de'ang bsnyen grangs dang cho ga'i tshog ris tsam ma yin par nad kyi ting nge 'dzin gtso bor gyur pa'i steng du rgyud sde rang rang nas ji ltar 'byung ba bzhin gyi lag len cha phra mo tsam yang ris su ma bor ba dang khyad par sdom pa gsum gyi bcas mtshams la thugs dam gyi mthil du mdzad de/ tha na mchod ro rnying ba cung zad re gzhan gyi 'gom yug 'bog pa'i sar 'dor ba gzigs na'ang 975

༄/ /gung thangabastan pa'i name'i gsung 'bum/dbang rjes gnang la thob bya dang dam tshig la 'dor byar byed pa 'di tsho gsungs nas bkyon pa lta bu rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig cha phra mo tsam la'ang nyes ltung gis ma reg par mdzad pa ni rgyal kun dgongs pa gcig gis bsngags pa'i sgrub pa'i yang rtse yin no/ / rje nyid nas rgyun par bka' rtsom dang dbang khrid man ngag chos srid kyi don gcod sna tshogs pa sogs mdzad pa bsamagyis mi khyab pa'i ngang nas thugs dam de tsam mdzad pa ni rnal 'byor pa'i nus pas skad cig bskal par byin gyis rlobs pa lta bu bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i che bar mngon te/ snga sor sog yul du 'phrin las shin tu rgyas pas lugs gnyis kyi spros pa che skabs shig mo lung mkhan 'ga' zhig nas sku btagasabyas te mi dam chos srung sogs kyi bsnyen sgrub gal che ba'i rigs ma chag pa dgos tshul zhus pa la 'di tsho'i bsam par deng sang brel ba che bas gang yang 'don gin med mod bsam 'dug ste/ nga la nyin mtshan med pa'i brel ba ci tsam che'ang rang gi dge sbyor rnams ma chag pa byed lugs shig yod gsungs pa ni rje btsun mi la ras pas/ nga res 'ga' 'gro zhin 'gro zhing sgom/ / zhes sogs kyis 'gro 'dug nyal 'chag gi spyod lam ci byas kyang sgom du 'khyer nus pa'i man ngag yod par gsungs pa bzhin phyi nang gi rkyen cis kyang mi g.yo bar rdo rje'i rnal 'byor la brtan pa rnyed pa'i gdeng tshad dang /yon tan rin po che sdud par gsungs pa bzhin phyi rol gyi g.yeng ba ci tsam che'ang thabs shes zung 'brel gyi spyod pa las mi g.yel ba'i nang gi dben pa la gcig tu gzhol ba sems dpa' mchog gi rnam par thar pa yin no/ / der ma zad mdung nag 'jam dbyangs dgon du gcod kyi khrid dang bkra shis 'khyil du lam rim gyi khrid gnang skabs nam mkha' las stong pa nyid kyi sgra grags pa sogs dag pa'i snang ba ngo mtshar ba'i ngang du thugs 'byams kyang skabs thob 976

/ /rjebatsun bzangartsa kyinyis bdanarasadabyung/kyi gsung bshad sogs dkyus bzhin thogs pa med par stsal ba ni mnyam rjes ro gcig tu gyur ba'i che ba gzhan dang ma 'dres pa phal pa'i blo'i ra ba las 'das pa zhig go /de ltar rgyun du rdo rje'i rnal 'byor la gzhol bar mdzad pa'i 'bras rtags su nang nas rtogs pa'i klong rdol ba'i rang mdangs sngon gyi grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po rnams dang cha mthun pa'i mthu stobs nus pa mngon shes sgyu 'phrul sogs la 'dod dgur dbang 'byor pa'i tshul thor bu gong du song ba'i mdo lung tsam zhig 'og tu 'chad do/ /gnyis pa gzhan don phun sum tshogs pa'i 'phrin las kyis gdul bya bskyangs pa'i tshul la 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i sgo nas bstan 'gro'i don mdzad tshul dang / thugs rje byin rlabs kyi sgo nas bstan 'gro'i don mdzad tshul gnyis/ dang po ni gdul bya'ikhams dang bsam pa bag la nyal mtha' dag ji lta ba bzhin du gzigs shing chos rgyun gye ting nge 'dzin la mnga' 'byor cing mi brjed pa'i gzungs thob pa'i dbang gis gdul bya mchog dman gang yin kyang so so'i blo dang skal bar 'tshal pa'i gdams pa skabs su gang bab re stsal pa na nyan pa po mtha' dag gi rgyud la nges pa bde blag tu skyed cing / mdor bsdus te gsungs pa'i tshe don gyi gnad nang du ma tshang ba med pas 'di las rgyas pa dgos don mi 'dug snyam pa'i tshod lta bu dang mdo rgyud bstan bcos mtha' yas pa'i lung 'dren dri ma med pa'i rigs pa brgya phrag gi sgrub byed 'char sla zhing don dang 'byorapa'i dpe sogs shin tu spros te bshad pa rgyas par gnang ba'i dus da dung ngo mtshar ba'i bshad pa ji 'dra zhig 'ong snyam du phyi phyir spro ba 'phel ba las bshad pa mang ba'i skyon gyis nyog nyog por 'gro ba lta bu mi srid pa gang gsung thams cad bstan pa spyi la go ba ster phul che zhing gzhung don rgyud steng du sbyor tshul gtso bor mdzad pas gdul bya rnams kyi blo 'khul tshab che ba/977

༄/ /gung bang bstanapa'isgroname'i gsung 'bum/mdo sde rnams su rgyal ba'i gsung gi che ba brjod pa na gang nas bshad kyang 'brel ba ji tsam bshad ran pa zhes gsungs pa lta bu zhig yod pa ni gsung gi bdud rtsi dngos su nod pa'i dpyod ldan kun la nges pa bzhin yin la/bka' chos 'ga' zhig gi tshe nyan mkhan so so la don go lugs mi 'dra ba go tshulade ltar gyi lung dang rigs pa'i rgyab brten dang bcas pa mi mthun par byung ba mang la/ lan cig nom chi chos rje sogs 'ga' zhig bka' chos grol nas phan tshun 'phros pa byed tshe go tshul sna tshogs sgrub byed dang bcas pa gcig lasagacig bden lta bus mi mthun par byung ba na nom chi chos rjes nged tsho rang rang gis go ba ltar bzung na bzang bla ma'i gsung bsam mi khyab yin pas phan tshun bsdur nas gcig tu 'bab mi dgos byas 'dug pa ni dpyod ldan mkhas pa'i gtam du snang / dpal ldan dpa' pos/ phongs pa rnams kyi dbugs 'byin zhing / / bag med rnams ni skrag par mdzad/ / bde ba can dag skyo brjid pas/ / khyod gsung kun dang 'tsham par 'jug / ces gsungs pa bzhin rje 'dis chos kyi che ba dang phan yon sogs spro ba srings te gsungs pa'i tshe ci 'dra'i nyam thag sdug bsngal gyis non yod pa zhig yin kyang sems dga' lhang gis 'gro ba dang / chos dang mi mthun pa rnams kyi mtshang la rgol zhing nyes dmigs dmar 'byin du byas nas gsungs pa'i tshe shin tu dmu rgod bag yangs su spyod pa rnams kyang 'jigs chum gyis 'gro ba zhig yod pas mang du thos pa chen po mdo dbus thams cad 'grim pa 'ga' zhig gis kyang rje 'di'i gsung bshad thos te gsung rab kyi dgongs don thugs su chud dang 'di 'dra yod shas che na'ang slob ma blo mtho dman thams cad kyi rna bar skyel mkhas pa'i 'chad tshul 'di 'dra thos ma myong zer ba ni gzu bor gnas pa'i gtam mo/ / phyis su ma zad sngon sku na phra mo'i dus rje phur bu spyog pa'i 978

༄/ /chabatsotshosangachosakyinyima'igagangagatsosag khazadabyunganabaka' chos sogs la pheb bzhin pa'i skabs der yang bla mas gang gsungs thams cad cung zad kyang gra ma nyams par thugs su chud nas gzhan la ston pa la 'gran zla med pa thos pa 'dzin pa'i mchog lta bur yod pas/ de skabs kyi gra sa'i dpon slob dang dge bshes mang pos kyang gsung bshad ma nges pa rnams rje 'di la dri gtugs byed cing yid la 'jags pa'i phyir rje 'dir bskyar nas zhus pa'ang mang du byung ste skabs de'i rje phur bu sngog pa'i zhal slob phal mo che zhig rje 'di nyid kyi'ang slob mar gyur pa ni de dag gis bskul ba'i bslab bya nyams mgur zhal shes man ngag gi zin bris sogs gsung 'bum du bzhugs pa rnams bltas na gsal lo/ / mdor na theg pa chen po mdo sde rgyan las/ rgya che the tshom spong pa dang / / gzung 'os de nyid gnyis ston pa/ /'di ni byang chub sems dpa' yi/ / ston pa phun tshogs yin zhes bya/ /sems dpa' mchog gi ston pa ni/ / 'jam zhing rgyags bral mi skyo dang / /gsal zhing sna tshogs rigs pa dang / / go zhing zang zing med kun 'gro/ /rgyalasras tshig ni mi zhen pa/ / snyan cing legs bshad grags pa dang / / ci rigs pa dang zang zing med/ / ran cing de bzhin yangs pa yin/ / bstan dang de bzhin bshad pa dang / / theg dang mthun dang bde ba dang / /grags pa dang ni ci rigs dang / / nges par 'byung dang mthun pa'i phyir/ /de mdor sems dpa' mchog rnams kyi/ / yi ge phun tshogs yin zhes bya/ /zhes sogs bshad pa'i le'u'i skabs nas 'byung ba ltar gyi yon tan ma tshang ba med pa'i tshul re re bzhin gtan tshigs dang bcas te brjod par bya ba mang du yodakung mang gis dogs bas ma spros/ / rtsod pa'i yon tan yang chos grar pheb bzhin pa'i skabs der thad ga'i gzhung tshan re tsam la phur tshugs su byed pa ma yin par mdo sngags kyi gzhung lugs rab 'byams la sbyong ba dang /979
