༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/zab rgyas kyi chos bka' tshur gsan cing gzhan la spel ba sogs zhor gcig tu mdzad pa las chos 'grim sha stag rang zhig ma mdzad kyang chos grar pheb nas rtsod pa gnang ba'i tshe zla bo rnams nas mi gcig chos gcig gi tshul du nyin mtshan med par 'bad de go ba rnyed pa'i khul rnams kyang rje 'dis thal spyor re gnyis re tsam gyis phye ma'i 'ching bu bzhin btang ste ngo mtshar ba'i gnas la bkod tshul gong du brjod pa bzhin no/ / phyis su'ang go sa'i dbang gis rgol phyi rgol byas te dngos su rtsod pa mdzad pa med kyang de skabs ser 'bras dge gsum na smra ba'i khyu rgyan du rtsi ba'i dge bshes 'ga' zhig mdun du 'ongs par gzhung chen mo'i 'phros pa mdzad pa'i tshe dang por gzhung gi tshig zin blor nges pa'i steng nas thogs med du zhu ba'i tshul byed kyang / khungs btsal te dpyad pa zhib mor mdzad pa na pha rol po'i spobs pa snum zad kyi mar me bzhin je dma' je dmar song ste mthar lags so las zhu rgyu ma rnyed pa'i lo rgyus mthong chos su gyur pa mang ngo / / mdor na rtsod pa'i rnam dpyod mchog tu gyur tshul ni/ rkang rdeb lag deb dang rtags gsal mang ba kho na'i lag na med kyi/pha rol gyi dam bca'i steng du bab ste spyog gi gzer bkrol ba bzhin phyi rgol gyi dam bca' meg med du 'joms nus pa ni rtsod pa mkhas pa'i tshad yin te/dper na sngon kun tu rgyu sen rang gis rgol bar 'dod nas bcom ldan 'das kyi drung du song ste kho bo ni ci'ang mi bzod do zhes zhus pa la/ khyod kyis ci'ang mi bzod pa de'ang mi bzod dam gsung nas tshig gcig po des spobs pa phrogasas te btul ba dang / dpal ldan thal 'gyur pa rnams kyis rten 'brel gyi gtan tshigs gcig pus dngos por smra ba'i grub mtha'i rdzong bshigs pa lta bu dgag gzhag mdzad pa rnams ri gzar gyi rbab bzhin zlog tu med pa zhig yod pa ni gsung ngag rnams su de 'dra'i zur than thun yod pa la 980

༄/ /chubatsugablobazangachosakyinyis mdakaras ༄ nabaltas na'ang blo gros mdzangs pa rnams kyis shes par nus so/ / rtsom pa'i yon tan ni slob dpon tsan+d+ra go mis/ gang phyir mkhas pa'i las gsum las/ / rtsod 'chad dag la ma nges pa/ / srid phyir mi 'khrul rtsom pa ste/ /gsungs pa bzhin spyir mkhas pa'i bya ba 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi nang nas gtso bor gyur ba ni tshig dang don gyi cha la dgongs pa'i gnas las gzhan du nor 'khrul med pa dang yul dus de tsam ma yin par phyogs gzhan dang phyi rabs kyi gdul bya la phan pa rlabs che zhing yun ring bas zhal skyin lta bur gyur ba ni rtsom pa yin no/ / da lta rtsom pa'i khur 'dzin par rlom pa mang yang gzhung gi dka' gnad 'grel pa ma tshang pa kha skong ba 'thor ba sdud pa 'khrugs pa bsdeb pa sogs kyi dgos don ci'ang ma mthong bar mkhas pa snga ma'i gzhung gi dum bu re rdo chag bsgrig pa bzhin byas te mchod brjod dang sbyar byang tsam bcug pas btags zin 'thag pa bzhin dgos pa med cing gong 'og mtshams sbyor 'khrugs pas 'brel med 'ba' zhig 'gyur ba dang / la la lungadang rigs pa'i sgrub byed rnam dag sna gcig kyang spro rgyu med par btsan thabs kyis 'gal ba ltag sprod mang po don gcig tu nan gyis sbyar nas 'di kho na yin no zhes sngon med pa'i legs bshad chen por sgogs pa dang / phal mo che byang grol gyi gnad ci'ang ston rgyu med par snyan ngag mngon brjod kyi tshigs bcad rnam du ma re bsgrigs pa la dge dbang gnyis pa lta bu'i snyems pa 'chang ba las brjod bya mdo rgyud kyi dgongs pa dang 'brel zhing rjod byed snyan tshig gi lugasadang mi 'gal ba thub bstan khang bzang mdzes pa'i rgyan du gyur ba ni ches shin tu dkon la/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa 'di nyid kyis bka' rtsom mdzad pa thams cad slob dpon snga ma gcig nas gcig tu brgyud pa'i man dag dang ldan zhing 'phags bod kyi grub mtha' so so dang rgyud sde rnam bzhi rang 981

༄/ /gung tha bstan pa'izlaname' gsung 'bum/rang gi chos skad gzhan dang ma 'dres pa'i gtsang mar thon pa gzhung rgya chen po la go ba bog chod du ster zhing zab don gyi dka' gnad dang cho ga phyag len sogs kyi cha phra mo tshun chad legs par dmigs phyed pas go bde la 'dum che ba/ snyan ngag gi tshig rgyan mdzad pa rnams dpa'i nyams kyi steng nas don la nges pa lhang gis 'dren cing tshig gi zur re re'i 'ang nyams 'don tshul ngo mtshar ba du ma thon pa'i tshul gzhan las ches khyad par du gyur pa zhig yod pa ni dbyangs can mgrin par zhugs pa'i byin rlabs sam nges pa'i don du rang nyid sangs rgyas kun gyi gsung gi gsang ba'i ngo bo rdo rje chos kyi rol par nges pa'i rtags so/ / de'i dbang gis tha snyad rig pa lhur byed pa zhig gis bltas na gsung rtsom che chung thams cad snyan ngag gi gzhung dang dper brjod 'ba' zhig tu 'gro bas tshig gi steng nas ngo mtshar dang dga' ba skye/ nyams len la gzholab zhig gis bltas na gsung tshad mtha' dag kha nang du bskor te shes rgyud 'dul ba'i thabs nyes skyod kyi mtshang la rgol zhing shes rgyud btsan thabs kyis bcun nas yang dag pa'i lam du gzhug pa'i lam rim blo spyong 'ba' zhig tu yod/ bstan pa spyi la go ba 'tshol la 'dod pa rnams kyis bltas pa'i tshe mdo sngags rig gnas mtha' dag gi gnas tshul so so'i rgyu mtshan brgyud pa'i lo rgyus 'phros don dang bcas pa 'byams klas shing mtha' chod pas blo skyed can gye gzhung bshad kho nar yod/ tha na rang gzhan gyi don sgrub pa'i las sbyor la brtson pa zhig gis kyang zhi rgyas dbang drag gi las rab 'byams ji snyed cig sgrub 'dod na'ang de'i skor gyi man ngag mtha' dag tshang zhing gsal bas chu thag chod pa gzhan nas cung zad kyang kha skong mi dgos par lag tu blang chog pa'i gdams pa rgyal po'i dkor mdzod bzhin du lag mi thogs par yod/lo rgyus re gsungs pa'ang gzhan dang phar 'dres su ma song pas shin tu gsal 982

sa / /jebatsun tha bas lad+ma khanag bsakazhingago bde la rtsa khungs chod nges pa mig mthong lag zin lta bur yod pas dpyod shes pa zhig gis zhib mor brtags pa'i tshe tshig don kun gyi cha la thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos ngo mtshar can 'bur du dod pa ches mang ngo / /bka'atsom gyi gtso bor gyur pa ni thun mong ba'i dbang du byas na bstan pa spyi'i de nyid gtan la 'bebs pa grub mtha'i rnam gzhag dang lam rim gyi skor rnamasayin la/ khyad par du theg pa chen po'i sa lam gye rim pa rnams sa rgyan sbyar ba'i rnam bshad sogs kyis gtan la 'bebs shing / gzhon nu nor bzang gi rtogs brjod dang rje ngag dbang chos kyi rgya mtsho'i rnam thar lcang skya thams cad mkhyen pa'i rnam thar rnams kyis kyang rgyal sras kyi spyod pa phar phyin drug bsdu ba bzhi tshul khrims gsum sogs kyi sgo nas zab rgyas kyi lam la slob ba'i tshul tshang la ma nor ba shin tu rgyas par bstan pas/ skyes rabs so bzhi par/ bde bar gshegs gyur lam rnams gang yin bstan par 'gyur/gsungs pa bzhin theg pa mchog gi gdams pa'i snying po kho nar gnas so/ /thun mong ma yin pa rdo rje theg pa'i skor la yi dam gyi lha tshogs mtha' yas pa dang 'brel ba'i smin byed dang grol byed kyi man ngag dri ma med pa ches mang yang gdams ba'i bka' bab tu gyur pa rje btsun rnal 'byor ma dang dpal rta mchog rol pa gnyis ni rje ngag dbang chos kyi rgya mtsho sogs sku 'phreng gong ma rnams kyi dus nas bzung rang gi lha skal dang chos skal du gyur pa'i tshul bla ma dang yi dam gyi lha du mas lung bstan cing lha chos kyi rten 'brel rang 'grig tu gyur tshul zur tsam gong smos ltar dang / lan gcig mnal lam du tshar chen gyi garma mu tra yin zer ba'i btsun ma gdong dmar hur re ba zhig byung ba phyi nyin rnam pa de ji lta ba'i btsun ma zhig 'ongs nas 'jigs byed kyi rjes gnang zhus pa rjes sor lcang skya rdo rje 'chang la zhus pas de nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor ma 983

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i r+sā 4nga 'bum/yin par lung bstan pa lta bu dngos dang mnal lam du byon nas gsang ba zab mo'i gnas las brtsams pa'i gdams pa rdo rje'i glu'i tshul du gsungs pa'ang lan mang du byung pa sogs ma bu bzhin 'du 'bral med par bzhugs shing byin gyis brlabs pa'i mtshan ma mtha' yas par ma zad/ skal ba mchog tu gyur pa'i skyes bu mang por rje btsun rnal 'byor ma dang ngo bo dbyer med du shar ba'i lo rgyus kyang mang ste lang gru'i phyogs nas nyid kyi slob ma bla rgan zhig 'chi bar nye ba mdun du khyer 'ongs pa la 'pho ba'i spyan dmigs sogs mdzad de mtshams shig tu khyod kyis nga e shes par 'dug gsung ba la/ kho rang gi snang tshul bzhin khyer rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dmar mor 'dug zhus pa lta bu mthong tshul de 'dra byung ba ches mang ngo / / dpal rta mchog rol par yang sgu phreng sngon ma rnams nas bzung thun mong ma yin par 'brel ba che tshul rje ngag dbang chos kyi rgya mtsho'i rnam thar du gsal ba bzhin yin pas sku tshe 'dir yang dang po de la thugs dam cher mdzad rgyu ma byung skabs lcang skya rdo rje 'chang nas rje 'di nyid la lha de dang 'brel shin tu che bas 'bad dgos tshul gyi lung bstan nyid kyi mnal lam du byung lugs dang bcas nan tan du gsungs pas de nas bzung yi dam gyi lha'i gtso bor mdzad cing / phyis lan cig mnal lam du tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho'i drung nas dpal rta mchog rol ba'i dbang bzhi cha tshang ba snga phyi'i maṇ+ḍal dang bcas phyag len ji lta ba bzhi gsan pa zhig byung / de ni rmi lam gyi snang ba tsam ma yin par sa chen kun snying sogs kyi rnam thar las 'byung ba bzhin dbang bskur rnal mar 'gro bas byin rlabs nye brgyud kyi che ba bla na med pa yin no/ / der ma zad rta mgrin gyi chos skor bsgrigs pa'ang slob dpon a bh+ya dang grub chen nag po spyod pa sogs la yi dam gyi lhas gzhung rtsom par bskul ba bzhin lhag pa'i lhas rjes su gnang zhing 984

༄/ /rjebatsugablobangachos nyima'igagangagatsosamagakhasadabyunganabaskul ba'i mtshan ma rim par byung ba yin la/ der ma zad lan cig lho brag grub chen yang mnal lam du byon nas 'di'i chos skor la gzhan nas kha 'gengs tshul sogs kyang 'di bzhin byas na gzhan la phan pa'i rten 'brel gyi sgo khyad par can yod ces lung bstan tshul sogs gong du sgos zin pa bzhin no/de ltar na lha 'di gnyis kyi chos skor rnams ni sngags phyogs kyi bka' rtsom gtso boyin zhing de'i nang nas kyang rje btsun ma'i chos skor rnams bla ma dam pa gcig nas gcig tu brgyud pa'i byen rlabs kyi dad pa ma yal ba blo mchog dman so sos rgyas bsdus ji ltar yang nyams su blang chog pa'i dmigs pa yid la byed tshul dang bcas pa rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i lam gyi snying po rtsa bshad kyi rgyud don mkha' 'gro'i kha rlangs tho le ba rgyud don mngon du gyur pa'i grub chen rnamasakye snyan nas snyan du brgyud de 'ongs pa'i slob bshad kyi man ngag thun mong ma yin pa gegs sel bog 'byin dang bcas pa 'phags yul grub chen rnams dang dngos su mjal yang de las lhag par gsung du med pa'i gdams pakhyad par can zab cing brling la gnad shin tu 'dril ba lam bzang 'di nyid nyams su len par 'dod pa rnams kyi snying gi nor bu gcig pur yod do/ / rta mgrin gyi chos skor rnams kyang da lta dus kyi snyigs ma gdon gsum gyi 'tshe ba lhag par bdo pa'i skabs 'dir rang gzhan bstan 'gro'i don gang zhigasgrub pa la'ang med du mi rung ba dpa' bo g.yul du 'jug pa'i go mtshon lta bur yod pas 'azin las kyang rgya mtsho'i mtha'i bar la khyab gdal du gyur pa 'di bzhin yin no/ / bka' rtsom gang la'ang dgos nus khyad par can re med pa mi srid kyang re re bzhin smos kyis mi lang la 'dir don gnyer can rnamasakyis rtsar gcod bde ba'i phyir chos tshan gyi po ti'i grangs tsam smos na/bla chen byang chub sems dpa' dgongs pa rab gsal dang / rje ngag dbang 985

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i name'i gsung 'bum/chos kyi rgya mtsho ba/ lcang skya thams cad mkhyen pa rol pa'i rdo rje sogs kyi rnam thar gyi skor pod gnyis/ gzhon nu nor bzang dang mgrin sngon zla ba'i rtogs brjod/ dgon lung byams pa gling gi dkar chag 'phrin yig dang rtsigs logs su bris pa'i snyan tshig gi skor bcas pod gcig / grub mtha' thams cad kyi khungs dang 'dod tshul ston pa legs bshad shel gyi me long bod gcig / lam rim blo sbyong gi dmigs rim gsung mgur dang zhal gdams bslab bya bca' yig sa rgyan sbyor tshul bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang gsol 'debs sogs kyi 'grel pa zhabs brtan gsol 'debs dang myur 'byon gsol 'debs kyi skor bcas pod gcig / bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang bla ma yi dam bsrung ma ci rigs kyi gsol 'debs bstod pa rgyud sde ma nges pa'i yi dam sna tshogs kyi sgrub thabs rjes gnang dbang bskur sbyin sreg tshe sgrub nor sgrub char 'bebs sogs dang dkar chag skor tshad 'ga' zhig bcas pod gnyis/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i chos skor pod gcig /zab mo gcod kyi skor dang 'chi blu zlog chen yi dam srung ma yul lha gzhi bdag ci rigs kyi bsangs gsol du ma'i skor bcas bod gcig / mgon chos lha mo rnam sras lcam sring sku lnga dam can sogs chos skyong spyi sger gye gtor chog gi skor pod gcig / bcom ldan 'das khro bo'i rgyal po dpal rta mchog rol ba gsang sgrub kyi chos skor rnams phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa la pod gsum/rtsis kyi bstan bcos mkhas pa'i snying nor cha lag dang bcas pa pod gcig / gsung bka' rgya ma'i skor pod gcig bcas po ti bco lnga bzhugs so/ / de dag las rta mgrin chos skor du yig rnying sogs bla ma gong ma'i gsung mang du yod kyang rje nyid nas chos skor phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa yin pasagasung 'bum gyi grar bzhag pa ni sngon gyi be'u bum bsgrigs pa rnams kyi 986

༄/ /rjebatso'athazangachos nyima'ig4gtsolabadagarazadabyunganasrol yin la/ mgrin sngon zla ba'i rtogs brjod sogs nyid nas thugs gtsigs chen pos kun tu spel bar mdzad pa'i dgongs pa dang mthun par 'phrin las rgyas pa'i phyir grangs su bzhugs pa yin no/ / gnyis pa thugs rje byin rlabs kyi sgo nas bstan 'gro'i don mdzad tshul ni gdul bya so so'i skal ba bzhin du don sgrub pa la de'i don du gang 'gyur gzigs pa'i mngon shes thogs pa med pa dang / bstan 'gro'i don sgrub pa la nag po'i phyogs kyi mi dang mi ma yin gang gis kyang badzi bar mi nus pa'i mthu stobs nus pa la mnga' 'byor cing mdzad pa mtha' dag snying rje'i gzhan dbang du gyur pa med mi rung du dgos pas de thams cad bdag nyid chen po 'di la tshang bar mnga' ba'i tshul ni sbyin bdag so so la lo mang po'i bar du 'byung 'gyur gyi skyid sdug 'pho 'gyur sogs gang gsung thams cad rgya mtsho'i rlabs bzhin yol med du byung ba dang / gnas kyi brtag pa sogs zhus pa'i tshe sngar 'byon ma myong ba'i sa cha mang po'i dbyibs bkod dang 'phrod lam yong mi yong sogs gsung tshad ji bzhin thog tu khel zhing rgya bod kyi dus zir lta bu lo mang po'i sngon nas lung bstan pa dang res 'ga' thag ring po'i yul de dang de na de ring 'di bzhin byedakyin yod dam gsung ba 'ga' zhig gis sems la bzung ste rjes su dris pa'i tshe de kho na bzhin byung ba dang / skabs 'gar ri'i phar nang na 'grul mi 'ga' zhig 'ong gan yod pa glo bur du gzigs pa lta bus thugs 'ur ba'i tshul gyis 'di dang 'di 'ongs pa ci red gsung bas sku drung na yod pa rnams ha thang gis 'gro ba sogs gnas dang dus kyis bskal ba gang la'ang mngon shes kyis gzigs pa thogs pa med pa'i tshul nyin re bzhin bstan pa grangs kyis mi lang la gong du'ang brgya phrag cig smos zin pas 'dir mi spro'o/ / la la mngon shes dang ldan par grags kyang dpal mgon klu sgrub kyis shes rab 987

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgron me'i gsung 'bum/sdong bu las/ mkha' la skar mkhan dag gis rtsis byas na/ / zla ba dang ni skar ma'i lam rnams shes/ / khyim na mi dang khyim thab log pa dag / sna tshogs spyod pa de ni mthong ma gyur/ / gsungs pa bzhin rang gi dgos don mi mthong zhing don rtsa 'gang che ba'i rigs la phug rdug nas 'gro ba mang yang /rje 'di ni rang gzhan 'phral phugs gang gi don du'ang gsung tshad cha phra mo tsam yang bslu ba med cing / rang nyid dag pa'i zhing du 'byon pa'i lo zla tshes grangs tshun chad kyang bgrang bya mang po'i snga rol nas sgo sna tshogs pas gsungs pa ji bzhin gyur pa sogs ni mngon shes thogs pa med par ma zad skye 'chi la dbang thob pa'i mtshan ma'ang yin no/ / nus mthu thogs pa med pa'i tshul yang nges pa'i don du brtan g.yo'i dngos po mtha' dag lhan skyes bde ba'i ngo bor gcig tu sdom pa dpal he ru ka dang gnyis su mi phyed par ma zad/ da lta'igadul bya tha mal pa rnams kyi snang ngo dang mthun par yang nag phyogs kyi bdud rigs 'joms pa la rwa chen lo tsā sogs dang chos mtshungs te gdon 'dre'i 'tshe ba mang ba'i yul phyogs du mar bka' shog tshig bzhi pa re gnang ba sgo steng du btags pas nyer 'tshe zhi ba dang / yus gur gye dkor bdag gdug pa can bla sngags rus pa can mang por tho 'tsham pa zhig dpal rta mchog rol pa'i nga rgyal gyis tshegs med du btul ba dang / sog yul du zeng bo zer ba dam sri 'ug pa'i mgo can shin tu cho 'phrul che ba zhig tu skyes nas ho shus mang po phung bar byed pa la drag po'i las sbyor gyis tshar bcad pas mtshan mo 'ga' zhig gi rmi lam du mi nag can mang po bsad nas ro sbyin sreg gi thab tu spungs shing rje nyid kyis 'di ha ha rgod pa'i dur khrod yin gsung ba rmis te 'khor lo bde mchog gdod ma bzhi dang bcas pa khros pa'i rnam rol dpal mgon zhal yum bzhi dang bcas pa'i bzhugs gnas gtso bo dur khrod de nyid 988

sa / /rjebatsunarākhazang gagang2khu lad+madaganayang khanayin pas rmi lam der yang go rgyu chen po zhig yod par snang yul der nyer 'tshe'ang de nas mtshams chod pa byung / lan cig thu med pe zi'i rim gror las spyor zhig gnang ba'i tshe phyog4so so nas 'tshub ma mang po 'ongs te ho ma khung du zhugs pa dang la la'i mi lam du btson ma mang po khrid 'ongs nas sgrol brjas/ pe zi 'chi med rdo rje'i rim gror sbyin sreg cig gnang ba'i tshe'ang sprul zhig rang dbang med par thab kyi nang du zhugs nas tshigs shing sbyin bdagakhyang nad las grol ba sogs 'di 'dra'i lo rgyus ches mang la mi ma yin chung ngu'i rigs de dag tu ma zad snang srid dregs pa'i sde brgyad kyi khrod nadzab 'gyur shin tu che ba gza' bdud chen po'ang mnal lam du yang yang 'ongs nas dang por tho 'tsham pa'i tshul byas kyang lan cig rdo rje'i rnal 'byor brtan po'i sgo nas dam la btags pas de phyin chad 'jam mal gyis song /rgyal ba'i bstan srung chen po rnams kyis kyang 'phrin las bka' bzhin du bsgrubs te dang po pho brang la ma pheb gong du dpal ldan lha mos phyogs der 'byon rgyu'i skul ma dang de nas bstan 'gro'i don rlabs po che sgrub pa'i grogs ldan mdzad rgyu'i zhal bzhes gnang zhing / dam can rdo rje legs pas kyang bya khyung gi khrir pheb rgyu'i snyan gsan dang der 'phrin las sgrub pa'i dam bca' phul/ thugs dam pa 'ga' zhig gi rmi lam la'ang chos srung du mas rje 'di'i 'phrin las sgrub tshul dang phyogs kyi sde dgon so so'i yul lha gzhi bdag rnams kyis bsu skyel bsnyen bkur zhus pa'i mtshan ma byung ba ches mang yang da lta'i skye bo blo dman pa rnams kyi bsam tshod dang bstun nas zur tsam smos pa las grub pa'i 'khor los sgyur ba chen po 'di lta bu la ltos na de 'dra la ya mtshan mi che bas mang du ma bris so/ / de ltar mi mthun phyogs kyis badzi bar mi nus pa'i mthu stobs la dbang 'byor cing snying rje'i gzhan dbang du gyur pa'i mthus 989

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'isgroname'i gsung 'bum/mthong thos dran reg 'brel thogs kyi 'gro ba mtha' dag gang la gang phan gyi thabs tshul mtha' yas pa'i sgo nas nam yang bsnyel ba med par skyob par mdzad de nag phyogs kyi 'byung po ma rung bas gtses pa rnams srung ba rdo rje'i gur khang du bcug ste dbugs dbyung / bro nad drag pos zin te dus kyi srin po'i khar chud par nye ba mang po sman sbyor dang byin rlabs kyi sgo nas gso bar mdzad/ rgyal po'i chad pas phog pa sogs mgon med pa du ma btson 'don gyi dmigs pa sogs lan re tsam gyi sgo nas kyang 'jigs pa'i 'phrang las bsgral/ tha na dbus su grwa ba zhig chur rkyal te 'khyer la khad byung ba dang har chin gyi skyel mi pa ri ma ta rma chur gzings kyis bgrod pas nyen che bar byung ba de gnyi gas kyang rje 'di la gsol ba btab pas skad cig de nyid la gang nas 'ongs cha med pa'i btsun pa re glebs nas grogs byas te chu las bsgral pas de ma thag gar song cha med du gyur pa lta bu/ mdor na rgyal ba ma pham pas/ / gang dang gang la gang dang ni/ / gang tshe bya ba phan gyur ba/ /de dang de la der snang ngo / / gsungs pa bzhin thugs rje'i spyan gyis rnam pa kun tu gzigs te skal ba dang 'tsham par skyob pa'i 'phrin las dus las yol ba med par lhun gyis grub pa'i rang rtags su mngon/ de dag kyang skye bo phal pa'ingor mthun snang du grub pa'i skyob tshul tsam yin la/ dpal ldan bla ma nyid nas dang por gsung gi bdud rtsis bskyangs shing rjes su'ang sa mkhan mdzad pa'i bka' drin la brten nas rdo rje slob ma har chin wang rat+na sidhi dang btsun mo ma ṇi dhā rā/ nyid kyi mgron gnyer phun tshogs nang so sogs las dag mang po mkha' spyod rig pa 'dzin pa'i zhing du khrid pas mtshon bde nas bdebar 'gro ba'i byang chub kyi lam la sbyar ba'ang mtha' klas par gdon mi za'o/ / gzhan lta ci mtha' na mchod dpon 'jam dbyangs chos 'phel so na 990

༄/ /chubatsun ba4chos nyama'ig4bakhumapabadasasadabyunganab sngags dang sman gang gis kyang phan ma thogs par yod pa la nyin gcig bka' bkyon gyi tshul du 'gram lcag cig gnang bas gzhi med du dngas pa lta bu mdzad pa'i cha shas phra mo re'ang gzhan la phan pa'i rgyu 'ba' zhig tu 'gro ste drag zhan su la'ang ngo dga' zol 'jog gis bcos ma mi mdzad par de nyid la gang phan gyi thabs zhi drag gang zhig gnang dgos kyang de mdzad pa ma gtogs/nang du snying rje che ba'i nyams phyir mdon thabs kyis 'jam 'jam kho na mi mdzad pa ni po to pa'i rnam thar mdzes pa'i pad+mo las gzhan don min pa yid la mi dran yang / / thugs rje can du mngon mngon mi mdzad cing / / ci byed thams cad gzhan don nyid du mdzad/ / gsungs pa ji lta ba bzhin no/ /sngon rtogs ldan 'jam dpal rgya mtshos kyang sog bod kyi mi chen khengs dregs can mang por bka' bkyon 'ba' zhig gnang ba na lhag par dad cing bka' drin du rtsi ba byung tshul de nyid kyi rnam thar spyan snga blo gros rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa las byung ba bzhin rje 'dis kyang gong ma'i blon chen mes po tshangs pa lta bu'i mngon rlom can mang por yang bka' bkyon sogs mdzad pa la skyon du mi 'dzin par ma zad lhag par gus pa zhig yod pas chos blon gzhan 'ga' zhig gis 'di tsho bla ma sus kyang ma thul ba thu'u bkwan rin po ches zla gam gyis btul ba yin zhes rigs byed ma'i sgo nas btul bar gleng ba byung 'dug na'ang / gtso bo ni nang gi byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems kyi mthu yin par klong rdol grub pa'i dbang phyug gi zhal nas kyang / bla ma byams pa rin po che'i byang chub kyi sems de deng sang thu'u bkwan rin po che'i thugs rgyud la yod mod kyang yod pa'i rnam pa ci la ston gsung ba dang / lcang skya rol ba'i rdo rje sku na phra mo'i dus rje ngag dbang chos kyi rgya mtsho'i nang rten gyi gtso bor jo bo rje'i dbu na ba bzhugs tshul gyi mnal lam khyung ba sogs gung bsgrigs na 991

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'ithoname'i gsung 'bum/theg pa mchog gi rigs can rnams yid la dga' ba skyed pa'i ngo mtshar gyi gnas khyad par du 'phags pa zhig yod par mngon/ bdag nyid chen po rnamasakyis gzhan phan sgrub tshul ni gdul bya skal ba mi 'dra ba dang rjes su mthun par zhi bas 'dul ba la zhi ba drag bos 'dul ba la drag bo sogs gang 'tshamadu ston dgos pa yin gyi/ sgo gcig kho nas mi chog ste bstod pa brgya lngabacu bar/ khyod ni rngan then bgyid la skul/ / chom rkun bgyid pa tshar yang gcod/ / gya gyu can rnams rnal du 'god/ / dal bus 'gyid la gzhen skul 'debs/ / dul ba rnams ni lam la sbyor/ / dmu rgod rnams la btang snyoms mdzad/ / de slad skyes bu 'dul ba yi/ / kha lo sgyur ba bla med mchog / ces gdul bya mchog dman thams cad kyi kha lo bsgyur ba bla na med pa la de 'dra ba zhig dgos par gsungs shing / byang sa las kyang sems can don byed kyi tshul khrims la nan tur gye sgo nas byed tshul yang du ma zhig gsungs pa rnams kyi gnad rtogs dgos so/ de'i rgyu mtshan gyes sgon gsal las kyang / spyod pa'i mchog ste byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa gang min pa de la ni 'jig rten dang 'gal ba'am mi 'gal ba'ang rung / rnam pa gangadang gang gis sems can gyi don rdzogs par 'gyur ba'i rnam pa de dang desasngags pa rnams ci nus par rab tu 'jug pa ni byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa'o/ / zhes gsungs te dgag bya dang dgos pa'i gnad legs par rtogs shes pa zhig gis zhib tu dpyad na mdzad pa'i cha phra mo gsung gi zur tsam tshun chad kyang rnam pa 'jam tsub ji ltar snang yang don gyi 'bab sa gdul bya la 'phral yun du phan pa tshin gi bdud rtsi kho nar yod pas phya phyir yid ches kyi dad pa dang bka' drin rjes su dran pa'i gus pa skyed pa'i rgyur 'gyur te/bstod pa brgya lnga bcu pa las/ khyod kyi gsung ni rnam brtag na/ / gang zhig 992

sa / /che batshun tsha ste cu'i d+ma stokhag sdomana'ajam dang tsub pa dang / / gang yang de gnyis ldan pa dag / thams cad ro gcig nyid du 'gyur/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ / mdor na jo bo'i rnam tharalas/ bstan pa 'dzin skyong srung gsum la jo bo tsam ma byung byas kyang 'gal ba med pa yin te bsrung ba la rnal 'byor gyi stobs kyis bsrung ba dang /dbangaphyug gi stobs kyis bsrung ba dang / rigs pa'i stobs kyis bsrung ba dang / rigs kyi stobs kyis bsrung ba dang bzhi las jo bo ni bzhi ga'i sgo nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bsrung ba yin gsungs pa dang 'dra bar 'dren mchog thugs rje'i bdag nyid 'di'ang bka' sde snod gsum gyi dgongs pa 'chadartsod rtsom gsum gyis gtan la 'bebs pa dang / bslab gsum rim gnyis kyi nyams len la gzhol pas lung rtogs kyi bstan pa zung 'brel du 'dzin cing gdul bya'i snod dang 'tsham par rgyu bod hor gsum gyi 'dzin ma'i khyon mtha' dag tu spel/ gtsug lag khang dang dge 'dun gyi sde ches mang po gsar bskrun dang nyams pa gso bar mdzad cing gtan pa med pa'i mchod sbyin gyi sgo 'phar yang yang phyes te mtha' dbus kyi dge 'dun ris su ma chad pa la bsnyen bkur stob pa sogs bstan pa bstan 'dzin dang bcas pa chos sridaganyi ga'i sgo nas skyong bar mdzad/ bstan pa la log par 'khu ba'i mi dang mi ma yin gdug pa can rnams sgo sna tshogs pas bzlog ste blo bzang rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che 'di nyid srung bar byed pa khor yug gi ra ba bzhin du bzhugs pas bstan 'gro yongs kyi mgon dang skyabs dang gling dang dpung gnyenagacig pur gyur pa yin no/ / tshul de dag kyang tshur mthong gi snang ba la bsnyon med du grub pa'i mdzad pa'i cha shas rags pa tsam zhig sgro skur med paraspyo sdoms kyi tshul du bkod pa yin gyi/ 'phags chen dam pa nang phan tshun so so rang gi rig pa'i ye shes kyi spyod yul du gyur pazhi che ba brjod pa 993

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/rnams ni smra bsam gyi ra ba las 'das te/ dper na stag phu rin po ches rje 'di gsang ba'i bdag po'i rnam 'phrul chos rgyal ma shā ga'i skye ba yin par gsungs pa dang / dam pa 'ga' zhig ma cig lab sgron gyis/ zla ba rgyal mtshan mdo khams smad du 'byung / / zhes spyan ras gzigs kyi rnam 'phrul byang sems zla ba rgyal mtshan gyi skye mthar ngos 'dzin pa sogs 'phags pa rigs gsum mgon po dang ngo bor dbyer mi phyed pa'i tshul dang / yang stag phu rin po ches bskal ba bzang po'i sangs rgyas zla ba ltar shar ba zhes bya bar 'gyur tshul dang / ba ri rdo rje 'chang gis de bzhin gshegs pa sprin kun tu ston pa zhes bya bar lung bstan pa sogs mdor na zhing khams rab 'byams su sprul pa'i bkod pa mtha' yas pas la lar mos pa spyod pa dang lhag bsam ngag pa dang rnam par smin pa'i sa la gnas pa'i sems dpa'i tshul ci rigs pa 'dzin cing / 'ga' zhig tu gsar du mngon par sangs rgyas pa dang /'ga' zhig tu ring mo zhig nas sangs rgyas pa sogs gsang ba gsum gyi sgyu 'phrul nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i tshul rje bdag nyid chen pos/ la lar bltam zhing zhing gzhan du yang byang chub tshul ston ston pa khyod kyi sku yi ni/ / bkod pa mchog 'di 'di dang gzhan du ma lus 'gro kun kun mkhyen gyur kyang bajod mi nus/ / zhes gsungs pa bzhin yin te/ gong du mnyam rjes ro gcig pa'i tshul zur tsam smos pa de dag kyang bod snga ma rnams gnas 'gyur 'dres pa la mnyam rjes dbyer med du btags pa lta bu ma yin par shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i mdo sde sogs las 'byung ba bzhin chos thams cad rnam pa thams cad du mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya ba'i tshul yin pas bsam gyis mi khyab po/ / smras pa/ bshes gnyen gdengs can bdag pos yongs bzung bas/ / zad mtha' mi mngon lung rtogs nor bus 994

༄/ /rjebatsun0bzangachos nyima'ig4gsu pabadakurasadabyung/gtams/ / grags snyan 'phrin las rlabs kyi 'phreng bar bcas/ / rten cing 'brel 'byung rim pa lhun gyis grub/ / mkhas pa'i mdongs mtha' 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i 'brug sgras skyongs/ / dad ldan zhing sa byin rlabs thugs rje'i char gyis brlan/ / nag phyogs sder bcas mthu stobs nus pa'i thog gi gzhom/ / thub bstan bya ba'i lha lam yongs gang 'dren pa chos kyi sprin chen lags/ / tshad med thugs rje'i klung brgya 'khyil ba'i nang / / sgrib med mngon shes snang brnyan 'bum 'char zhing / / thogs med mthu dang nus pas rlabs 'phro ba/ / zla med bla ma chos kyi rgya mtsho che/ / bde ba'i 'khor lo gcig gi ngo bor brtan g.yo'i dngos po mtha' dag sdom/ / thabs shes 'khor lo gnyis kyi shing rtas yang dag lam gyi pha rol son/ / bshad sgrub 'khor lo gsum gyi rol pas rgyal bstan 'dzin skyong spel bar mdzad/ / theg mchog 'khor lo bzhi yi dpal la 'gro kun spyor mdzad skyabs kyi phul/ /mdor rgyas rim par brtsegs pa'i garnyo la/ / dgos don gser gyi rgyal mtshan mngon par mtho/ / mtshams sbyor dra bas 'brel zhing brgal lan gyi/ / dril chen gdangs snyan phyogs su 'khrol bas mdzes/ / shes byed lung gi sgra brgya kun nas rgod/ / sgrub byed rigs pa'i gru char lhug par 'bebs/ / gsal byed dpe yi klog 'phreng rnam 'gyur can/ / bshad pa'i sprin sngon thub bstan mkha' la mdzes/ / ma rtogs rmongs pa'i mun par 'phyan3mas spyi don snang bas blo mig phyes/ / log rtog nyam nga'i g.yang du lhung rnams tshig don zhags pas gyen du drangs/ / dka' gnad the tshom sgog gis bcings rnams stong thun gnad 'gag srol du btsud/ / ye ma khyod gsung don du mi 'gyur de ni bem po'i chos las ci/ / mkhas pa kun gyi ral pa'i skyed tshal na/ / rigs pa'i rtse dga' bgyid pa khyod gsung gis/ /995

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'ithonas gsung 'bum/dpal mo dri med lung gi rgyan 'phreng can/ / rab 'byams gzhung lugs kun dga'i grogs su gyur/ / rtog ge'i dam bca' lcags kyi ta la bdun/ / thal mar 'bigs pa dngos stobs rigs pa'i mda'/ / skyes thob blo gros rgyud las 'phos pa'i sgras/ / smra ngan glad 'gems ri bo ral ba bzhin/ / brgyud mar 'bab pa rigs pa'i nyag phran gyis/ / pha rol dam bca'i 'khri shing drungs 'byin pa'i/ srid sgrub rtsal gyis da lta'i rigs smra ba/ / phal cher byis pa'i mda' 'phong rtsed mor bsgrubs/ / zla shes bdud rtsi'i dzigs pa 'dzag pa yis/ / ku mu da tshal bzhad pa'i 'dzum dkar bzhin/ / khyod gsung gdams pa'i zil mngar myang ba yi/ / skal bzang 'dus tshogs kun dga'i spu long g.yo/ / de tshe khyod kyi grags pa snyan pa'i rnga/ / mgrin par 'chang ste phyogs brgyar brdung ba yi/ / slob ma yang slob mkha' 'gro dkar po'i sde/ / kun tu 'gro ba sprin gyi pho nya bzhin/ / che ba'i lha mchog te ru ka dpal dang / / bde ba'i mchog sbyin mkha' spyod dbang mo yis/ / rjes bzung lhan cig skyes dga'i bdud rtsi yis/ / rab myos dpa' bo grub pa'i gar stabs bsgyur/ / sgrib pa'i g.ya' dang bral ba'i mngon shes kyi/ / me long dngas pa'i ngos la dus gsum kun/ / ma 'dres gcig char bkra ba'i gzigs mo la/ / blo chen rgyal sras rnams kyang mtshar du 'dzin/ / nag phyogs mi dang mi man bsam spyor gyi/ / dug gi tsher ma stug por 'dzings pa'i tshal/ snying rje'i dud sprin klong nas mthu stobs kyi/ / byin za'i lce brgya g.yo bas ril gyis ming / / kun rtog spros pa g.yo byed sde dang bcas/ / sgra gcan lam du meg med bcom pa na/ / phyi rol 'tsho ba gdon gsum bdud kyi dpung / / mkha' la 'ja' bzhin yal ba smos ci 'tshal/ / li khri'i rdul 'phreng rdzogs pa'i nyin mor byed/ / kur gum 'od kyi thig les phyogs rnams 996

༄/ /༄tsotshos4chos 7'gasangagatsosagagasazadagagakun/ /dge legs dpal yon ri mo 'god byed na/ /rdo rje nyi ma khyod kyi dpe zlar 'os/ /mkhyen brtse nus gsum yu ba rab tu brtan/ /'chad rtsod ṭ+wāṃṭ+wāṃ ༵sum dīr+sha ṭ+wāṃ rlom sadi ṭ+wāṃ~X/ lu/sa sna didī ༈ / dh+ri~X norazhe dīdī /༷ /༷ dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum rmad du byung ba'i mdzad bzang 'dab brgya'i dga' tshal gyi cha tsam gtam du byas pa rtogs brjod pad+ma dkar po las/ gzugs sku'i bkod pa bsdusapa'i tshul gdung mchod kyi rim pa rnam thar gyi don bsdu ba dang bcas pa'i 'dab ma ste bcu bzhi pa'o/ /997

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgron me'i gsung 'bum/༄༅/ / 'dab ma bzu lnga pa/ slar yang 'dzum zhal mngon du gyur ba'i tshul/de nas rje btsun bla ma thugs rje'i bdag nyid chen po dang ldan pa de nyid kyi bka' 'bangs su gyur pa'i grwa slob sbyin bdag thams cad nas yang srid 'khrul ba med pa zhig myur du byon te zhal gyi dkyil 'khor mig gis bdud rtsir gyur pa'i dga' ston la longs spyod pa'i re ba skom pa chu tshol ba lta bu'i sgo nas gsol ba rtse gcig tu btab cing / mdo dbus rtsang gsum gyi lha bla ma ris med la lung bstan yang yang zhus te rim gro gang bab rnams gcig kyang ma lus par dngos dag gnad smin bsgrubs/ skyabs mgon de nyid chos srid kyi mdzad pa gang la'ang shin tu rlabs che zhing byed lugs hang 'gros su ma song bas cha mtha' dag la ljags bkod kyis zhib cha thon nges pa gzhan dang mi 'dra ba zhig yod pa'i spyan ltos kyis skabs 'di'i rim gro rnams sgrub tshul la'ang las byed so so nas skyo ngal med pas rung ba tshegs thon nges byung snang /'di skabs bsgrubs pa'i zhabs brtan gyi rim pa rags rim tsam phyogs bsdoms su bkod na/ bka' 'gyur tshar bdun/ bstan 'gyur tshar gnyis/ yum rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum so so nas brgya tshar re dang brgyad stong pa zur du tshar lnga bcu/ mdo sde bskal bzang / gser 'od/gzungs grwa lnga rnams brgya tshar re/ mtshan brjod 'bum phrag / bskal bzang rgyan phreng dang sangs rgyas mtshan 'bum/ bla mchod dang 'brel bar phur tshugs gsol 'debs rnams gang mang / dmigs brtse ma bye chen 998

༄/ / rjebatsug bzangachos nyima'ibagangagatsosabadakhazadabyungakaganyisadang 'bum ther nyer gcig / sa lam skabs gsum khri tsho gsum re/gnas brtan phyag mchod sum khri sum stong lhag / sman chog nyi khri sum stong dang gzungs 'bum ther lhag / smyung gnas tshar brgya nyi shu/ gsang 'jigs dus 'khor gsum dang lhag par bde mchog dang nā ro mkha' spyod kyi sgrub mchod bdag 'jug tshogs 'khor 'gro gang che/ bde mchog gi rtsa rgyud sum stong lhag dang de'i snying po bye ba'i sgo nas kha skong gi sbyin sreg gang 'grub/mkha' spyod ma'i snying po oṃ gsum ma bye chen gnyis dang 'ibum ther drug cu'i sgo nas kha skong gi sbyin sreg 'bum/ mkha' 'gro'i tshogs skor khri tshar/ dri med bshags rgyud stong tshar/ ya ma rā dzā bye chen gcig dang 'bum phrag bdun gyi sgo nas zhi rgyas dang lhag par drag po'i sbyin sreg gang mang / khro bcu'i sngags ring sum 'bum gyi sgo nas bgegs zhi ba'i sbyin sreg ci mang /rta mgrin gyi rtsa sngags bye chen gcig dang 'bum ther nyer gcig gi sgo nas zhi ba'i sbyin sreg 'bum dang dbang gi sbyin sreg ci 'grub tshogs brgya grangs gsog pa dang bcas/ seng gdong ma'i snying po bye chen bzhi dang 'bum ther dgu bcu'i sgo nas zlog pa bzhi 'bum dgu khri tsam/ gdugs dkar sum 'bum bdun khri lhag zlog chen tshar lnga dang bcas/ sher snying bzhi 'bum dgu khri lhag / sgrol ma 'bum phrag nyer bdun dang chig khri chig stong lhag /maṇ+ḍal bzhi chog bzhi stong drug brgya lhag / sgol dkar gyi tshe sgrub brgya tshar dang tshe lha gzhan gyi tshe sgrub gang lcogs/ tshe chog tshar bzhi brgya lhag / tshe gzungs ring po bye chen gnyis dang bdun khri lhag / rnam rgyal gzungs ring nyis 'bum bdun khri chig stong lhag / rnam rgyal stong mchod tshar bdun/rnam 'joms kyi gzungs ring thung sum 'bum/ khro bo spe brtsegs kyi sngags sum 'bum/ yig brgya 'bum sogs kyi sgo nas bum pa bsgrubs nas sku 999

༄/ /gung thang balhan pa'isgraname'i gsung 'bum/gdung dang mgon khang rnams su khrus gsol dang yul khrus lan mang / sgo drug pa'i gzungs 'bum/ dpal mgon gyi bskang bshags 'bum ther lnga dang nyi khri chig stong lhag / de'i sgo nas zhi ba'i gtor sgrub tshar gcig dang glo bur las bcol 'gro gang che/ mgon chos gnyi ga'i bskangs bshags chigakhri bdun stong re/ mgon po phyag drug pa'i zhi rgyas kyi gtor sgrub dang gtor chen tshar drug / drug cu pa gang 'grub lha mo'i bskang bshags drug khri sum stong bdun brgya tshogs 'khor stong rtsa gshegs gtor gang mang / phur bu spyog tu rdo rje sems dpa' dang dam tshig rdo rje'i bzlas pa'i rgyun/ dge tshogs gling du mtshan brjod rgyun chags dang / thar pa gling du sgo drug pa'i gzungs/ phyogs bcu'i mun sel rnams gtan chags kyi rgyun btsugs/sku gdung gi nye 'dabs su dge slong res lo ltar dbyangs can ma'i bsnyen mtshams yang yang gtong rgyu dang / zla ba byung ngo cog la sngon bsten 'das ma 'das kyi srung ma rnams kyi gsol mchod zur ba chag med/ dgos dbang gis skabs skabs su nyin mang por sbrel nas sgrub dgos pa sogs gong gsal sku rim de rnam grangs gsog par brel ba tsam ma yin par tshegs dang phyag rdzas la ma 'dzem pas dkon mchog gi mchod pa dang dge 'dun gyi bsnyen bkur gang gzab ngos gnad du 'gro nges pa byas/ gzhan yang sprul sku 'khrul bral myur gsal gyi don la dmigs nas mdo dbus rtsang gsum dang pho brang gi tsan dan jo bo ri bo rtse lnga'i 'jam dbyangs sogs gnas chen dang rten rnying rnams la sna lnga'i brgya mchod gang mang mang dang / khyad par du mar me'i mchod pa khri tshar re/ mchod pa de dag dang 'brel nas sgrol ma'i spyan sngar maṇ+ḍal bzhi chog dang / yi dam chos skyong gi spyan sngar rang rang gi cho ga dang bskang gso sogs rten dmigs bsal can rnams la de lugs dang / spyi khyab tu khrus 1000

ra / /che bathe gas d+ma'ad nachasadag/gsol bla mchod dang 'brel bar phur tshugs dang byur byon gyi gsol 'debs nan tan byas/ 'jam dbyangs kun gzigs kyi sku brnyan zhig bzhengs dgos pa hang chin ake lha rgyal rdo rjes dad moyokyis gser zangs kyi sku mi tshad tsam pa bzhengs shing / bla brang nas rdo rje sems dpa'i gser zangs kyi sku mi tshad tsam pa bzhengs te de gnyis la rim par 'jam dpal mtshan brjod grangs mang dang yig brgya 'bum lhag gis mtshon pa'i gzungs gzhug tshad ldan rab gnas bcas bsgrubs pa sogs bris 'bur gyi sku brnyan dang sku par yang mi nyung tsam bzhengs/ yang srid kyi skor rtsad gcod lugs rang 'dod kyi phyogs lhung du ma song bar bla ma dang dkon mchog la yid ches kyis blo bkal te sgo sna tshogs nas zhib dpyod kyis rtsad gcod lugs snga sor 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa rin po che'i sprul sku rtsad gcod skabs rje nyid nas gtso bor ljags bkod gnang ba'i phyag bzhes de ga gzu bo'i blos brtags na shin tu zhe gtsang zhing rtag thub par yod pas dpe srol de nyid gzhir bzhag /skyabs mgon mchog sprul rin po che blo bzang thub bstan 'jigs med nyi ma'i zhal snga nasaspyan dmigs nan tan gyi sgo nas brtag pa sogs thugs khur gtso bor bzhes te las byed rnams la de lugs kyi bka' khyab stsal/ nged dang khri chen dpal ldan grags pa'i sprul pa'i sku bcas nas kyang skabs su gang bab kyi 'char ston sogs grogs dan bgyis te thams cad 'dun pa gcig dril gyi sgo nas ngang bsrings te zhib dpyod byas par da lta'i sprul pa'i sku 'di pa gang ci'i rtags dang ya mtshan che zhing / rje gong ma'i gsung zur mang po dang lha bla ma'i lung pheb phal cher phyogs mthun tshab che bas khyad du thon par yod na'ang /7gong ma'i bkas bcad kyi phyag srol bzhin brtag sgril byed dgos la/brtag sgril byed rgyur gnyis nyung mthar dgos pas dogs gnas gzhan rnams 1001

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/kyi khrod nas rtags mtshan dang ngos 'dzin sogs cung mtho ba zhig dang gnyi ga zi lang am ban brgyud nas 7gong ma chen po'i snyan du gsol bar 7gong nas bod kyi jo bo'i mdun gyi bum par brtag sgril gyis thag chod cig ces pa'i bka' phebs/ de don bzhin zi lang am ban nas lha sa'i am ban la yi ge btang zhing de dang lhan du bla brang rang nas rgyal tshab rta tshag rin po cher brtag sgril gang zhib 'ong thabs kyi bkod khyab bka' drin skyong dgos tshul gyi zhu shog phul bas rta tshag rin po che nas kyang mgo 'dren dang bkod khyab gang drag gnang ste sa 'brug lo'i cho 'phrul zla ba'i tshes bco lnga'i nyin jo bo'i mdun du paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa/ rgyal tshab rta tshag rin po che/ am pan gnyis/ bka' blon bzhi bcas zhal 'dzom thog / rnam rgyal grwa tshang tshogs yongs kyis mchod 'bul dang gsol 'debs kyi zhal 'don gsungs pa'i mthar paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa sku dngos kyis mtshan byang bsgyur bar sprul sku 'di pa'i mtshan thon 'dug / de ltar rje gong ma'i zhal chem dang lha bla ma'i lung bstan jo bo'i mdun gyi brtag sgril rnams byed pa po gcig gi byed las kyis grub pa bzhin phyogs gcig tu mthun par byung ste grwa slob thams cad rang rang gi ngos nas g.yo zol med par blo 'gel nus na dkon mchog gi thugs rje ni nam yang bsru ba med pa'i tshul la yid ches gting nas 'drongs pas dga' dad gus gsum 'gran pa bzhin du 'phel bar gyur to/ / de nas sprul sku thag bcad pa'i gnas tshul lha sa'i am ban nas zi lang am ban dang / des 7'jam dbyangs gong ma chen por zhus pa'i phyir pheb kyi lan 'byor pa dang bstun sa ga zla ba'i tshes bcu dgu'i nyin dgon pa'i tshogs chen du skad snyan gyi mang ja btang thog bla ma dge 'dun la rgyu mtshan snyan 'bul zhus/ de ma thag dgon lung khri pa rgya tig zhabs drung rin po che 1002

༄/ /rjebatsugs 4chosaminyima'ig4ga muchadasasadabyunganadang rgyud pa bla ma sogs bla sprul du mas gtsos dgon ma lag gi bla spyi khag so so dang / bla brang gi gser khri sprul sku dang phyag mdzod chos rje ngo g.yog rnams sprulasku'i 'khrungs yul du phebs te/ zla ba lnga pa'i tshes bco lnga'i nyin sprul skurakha btags phul/ slar yang rgyud pa bla ma dang spyi khag gi mi rnams dang gserakhri sprul sku ngo g.yog gdan 'dren du song ste/ zla ba bdun pa'i tshes bzhi'i nyin mchog sprul rin po che nyid rab rgyas zhabs drung che chung sogs skya ser brgya phrag mang po'i 'khor dang bcas rab rgyas dgon pa nas tshur chibs kha bsgyur/ lam bar du yar klung ri dgon dang mchod rten thang ri dgon so sos tsha zhag gar bab kyi gra sgrig dang bsu skyel ser spreng gang rgyas kyis rang rangagi dgon par gdan drangs nas bsnyen bkur dang / lhag par mchod rten thang pas snga ma'i dge lam ltar tshogs dbus su chos khrir gdan drangs nas bla ma dge 'dun gyis brtan bzhugs kyi rten 'brel rgyas par bsgrigs pa sogs thog ma'i rten 'byung gi sgo 'phar yangs por byes shing / phan tshan gyi lam 'phrang 'ju lag gi chu'i zam pa rnams bcos pa dang / grwa pa gzhon pa rnams nas rang rtag gi la chu 'phrang gsum brgal bar du chibs skyel sri zhu bla na med pa zhus/ dgon lung gi khri gdan zur rnams kyis gtsos ma bu dgon yon mchod kyi chibs bsu ja thab du ma mu mthud pa dang mchod rdzas dang rol cha thogs pa'i dge 'dun mang gi ser sbreng / phyogs nas 'dus pa'i skya ser gyi khrom chen pos lung pa khol ba dang bcas zla ba de'i tshes bcu gnyis gza' skar 'phrod spyor shin tu phun sum tshogs pa'i nyin nyi shar 'brug gi dus su gdan sar 'byor te rje gong ma'i mi 'jigs seng ge'i khri la zhabs sen nye bar bkod cing / de ma thag tshogs dbus su spyan drangs nas bla ma dge 'dun gyis zhabs brtan gyi bden tshig gsungs pa dang chabs cig tu gzhi byes 1003

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'ithoname'i gsung 'bum/thams cad kyis khri 'bul bstar ba sogs rten 'brel sgo du ma nas bsgrigs/bla brang nas gzhi byes kyi mgron stong phrag du ma la dga' ston 'bul lan gang rgyasadang / yab yum la blu yon dang sku rgyab kyi mgron rnams la go bab kyi ster cha gang gzab bkyis/ ma 'gyang bar lcang skya thams cad mkhyen pa'i mchog sprul rin po che rgya nag nas rang yul du chibs kha bsgyur te rten 'brel rang 'grig tu byung bas bla brang du gdan drangs nas gsol ston 'bul ba dang chos 'brel zhus/ 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa sprul pa'i sku rin po cher sngar nas gdan 'dren gyi snyan gsan zhus yod pa bzhin/ zla ba dgu pa'i nang du chibs sgyur gnang bar khong gi mdun nas 'jigs byed dpa' bo gcig pa'i dbang dang / tshe lha gsum sogs lhag lha dang chos skyong 'ga' zhig gi rjes gnang gsan cing / lha bab dus chen gyi nyin dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa bzhes pas mtshan blo bzang 'jigs med chos kyi rgya mtshan zhes gsol/ de nyin sbyin bdag o thog pe li bsod nams rab rgyas dge 'dun gyis ched du mngags pa'i mi sna ca khir chi dang dem chi ngo g.yog 'byor nas dpon pos brtan bzhugs phul pa rang babs su stabs 'grigs pa ni mchod yon dam tshig gtsang ba'i mthus rten 'brel ma bsgrigs rang 'grigs su byung ba'o/ /de'i phyir lo dgu pa'i nyer gnyis la kho bo cag nas rab byung gi sdom pa bzhes pa'i mtshan blo bzang thub bstan chos kyi rgyal mtshan zhes gsol zhing thugs bzhed bzhin rdo rje 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum ma'i dbang dang lhag lha du ma'i rjes gnang lung khrid 'ga' zhig bcas phul/ de ltar sprul sku ngos 'dzin dang 7gong ma chen por zhu rgyu dbus nas thag gcod rgyu gdan sar pheb skor sogs bya byed kyi cha gang la'ang phyi nang gi nyer 'tshe phra mo tsam yang med cing /rten 'brel phun sum tshogs pa sgo mtha' dag nas rang 'grig tu byung ste mi 1004

༄/ /rjebatsun bzanga'༄41 ga khalamadakaraco rākhana'ajigs gdong lngas btags pa'i chos kyi khri la zhabs sen bkod nas gsan spyong sogs rnam par dkar ba'i mdzad 'phrin gyi 'jug pa yar tshes kyi zla ba dang dbyar gyi chu gter bzhin gong du 'phel bzhin par bzhugs pa 'di legs so/ / smras pa/ bkra shis dge mtshan chu gter 'khyil ba las ngo mtshar ltas kyi rlabs 'phreng 'phyur ba na/ / 'khrul bral bka' lung g.yas 'khyil dung gi sgras/ / skal bzang rna ba bdun rtsi'i gter du bsgrubs/ /btsan po'i lung gos bkod pa'i gzhan dbang dang / / rang 'dod g.yo sgyus bcos pa'i kun btags kyang / / ma yin yab rje'i yang srid 'khrul bral du/ / yongs su grub pa'i nges rnyed skal ba bzang / / srid zhi'i gdung sel nam mkha'i nor bu yi/ / mkhas btsun bzang pa'i 'phrin las 'od stong gis/ / 'dzam gling khor yug kun khyab bstan 'gro la/ / phan bde'i dga' ston snang ba deng nas spel/ / zhes rigs dang dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum rmad du byung ba'i mdzad bzang 'dab brgya'i dga' tshal gyi cha tsam gtam du byas pa rtogs brjod pad+ma dkar po las slar yang 'dzum zhal mngon du gyur pa'i tshul gyi 'dab ma ste bco lnga pa'o/ /dz+rīrdo ༷ṭ+wāṃ ༷ ༷/༵ ṭ+wāṃm/ tha'/k+ṣiṃ ṭ+wāṃ ṭ+wāṃdi ñtsā hūm̐ ñtsā mo hūṃ/ ༵ ༷ ༷ṭ+wāṃbye ṭ+wāṃsde bye bye sdisdi ṭ+wāṃ ༷ ngh+ru shaṃskyo / ni/ shaṃ bye ༷/ / khye sad sdiX shaṃ skyi l+lī 1005

༄khya/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/lor 'phyan pa'i 'gro kun byang chub mchog la sbyor mdzad pa/ / lha yi lha mchog ṭ+wāṃ ṭ+wāṃ ༷rdor+sha zlorje ṭ+wāṃX ༵ ༵ ༵ r+sha sna ṭ+wāṃ dī sngasna /'i gaṭ+wāṃ~X /kyi phu/ ljo dī dīdīdi t+t+waṃrji 'byung gnas yang dag lam gyi 'jug ngogs kun/ / nyi ltar gsal mdzad rig grol smra ba'i 'phags tshogs dge 'dun kun gyi gtso/ / ma lus skyabs gnas gcig bsdus bla ma mchog der slar yang phyag bgyid do/ / kun bzang dge ba'i spyod pa ma byā ga'i/ / 'khri shing skal ldan bung ba'i rol rtsed can/ / mngar bor 'thu ba phan dang bde ba'i gsung / / thar pa mngon 'dod dga' ba'i dpyid du 'bab/ / gang 'tsham skal ba ji bzhin mdo sngags kyi/ / legs bshad 'od non 'phreng ba 'bum spros te/ / thar 'dod yongs kyi blo gros mig 'byed pa'i/ / mgon po chos kyi nyi ma bsam zhing byerte/ /sdi/ /༷/ /rte ༷/ ṭ+wāṃng ngh+ru k+ṣiṃ bhe ṭ+wāṃbye bhe bye sdi rdoXshaṃ trī ṭ+wāṃXshaṃ bhe 'byams kun tu khyab/ / bla ma'i yon tan lhun po'i ngos yangs por/ / tshig don gom pa'i 'degs 'jog re res kyang / / thar pa rnam par rgyal ba'i khang bzang la/ / mngon par phyogs pa'i yid ni spro ba 'dzin/ / dper bya kun las 'das pa yon tan gyi/ / phung po gsang ba gsum gyi 'dab brgya'i tshal/ / kun mkhyen thugs dang brtan g.yo'i dkyil 'khor gyi/ / pha rol mtha' la 'gran pa lhur len te/ / ji snyed brjod pa tshig gi spros pa kun/ /byed pa gcig tu dril bas mtshon min yang / / cha tsam spel pa'i pad dkar chun po 'di/ / gzur gnas mkhas kun rna ba'i rgyan du mdzad/ / bstan 1006

༄/ /rjebatsug ba4cho minyima'igangagasumapad+madakarasadabyungakadang 'gro la sman pa'i dge legs kyi/ / 'phreng ba rgya cher spel la mngon dges pa'i/ / blo chen mchog tu spro ldan smin ma'i gzengs/ / mngon mthor btegs te lta ba'i 'os yin kyang / / dmapa'i mtshan nyid mi ldan bcos ma'i gsob/ / rmongs pa'i phugs su mngon rlom 'chang rnams la/ / grub pa'i drang srong dmod pa'i tshig mda' bzhin/ / gdung ba skyed pa las kyis nongs parazad/ / thar 'dod zhing sa'i dpyid du gyur pa 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i gru char ni/ / mkhyen brtse'i glog phreng dra bas 'khyud gang dus ston dga' ba'i mchog nyid de/ / bsod nams phung po lhun gyis rdzogs pa'i dpal 'byor sprin phung gtibs pa yang / / de yi mthun pa'i grogs su gleng la yangs pa'i blo ldan su zhig bshus/ / mos pa tha dad 'gro kun tshul gcig gis/ / rnam grol thar pa'i grong du khrid nus na/ / rgyal ba'i theg pa dman mchog drang nges kyi/ / chos sgo brgyad khri bzhi stong ci phyir phye/ / mkhas dang grub par rlom ༷dīrdo byeX /ṭ+wāṭ+wāṃ ba/ za/nga dre/ṭ+wāṃ'i 'aXṭ+wāṃrjo ༵sdu hūṃ nyi dī ṭ+wāṃ ༷ ṭ+wāṃsdi ṭ+wāṃrjirdo /ma'i/ dkyil 'khor ci yang mdzes/ / 'azin las 'dab ma bskyod pa'i 'thor rlung gis/ / yid srub gangs ri'i thor cog ltung byed cing / / bstan 'gro'i mkha' mtha' gzhal ba'i gzi 'bar ba/ / nges don mkha' lding dbang po khyod lags kyi/ / mkhyen brtse nus dang 'chad rtsod rtsom pa sogs/ / 'dab 'phreng blum bar gyur pa bya yi rigs/ / thub bstan lha lam gcod par mi nus te/ / rnye da bkur sa la lding ba'i mkha' lding yin/ / rab 'byams chos tshul gzigs pa mkhyen pa'i spyan/ / legs bshad gtam gyi dga' ston spro ba'i zhal/ / lus can tshim byed gtong ba yangs pa'i phyag / mi phyed rdo rje gsum gyi bdag nyid can/ / smra dbasgrub pa kho nas bzung bya ba/ / bstan 1007

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'izlaname'i gsung 'bum/la de yi phyogs las rnam brgal ba'i/ / chen po bstan 'dzin dam par bkur ba rnams/ / pad tshal rgyas byed bdud rtsi'i thig le bzhin/ / nyes skyod dug gi lo ma 'dzings pa la/ / yon tan sman gyi myu gur 'khrul ba yis/ / thar pa'i srog gi mchod sbyin la gzhol ba/ / de dag dran pa skyed pa'i gzungs 'di sgrubs/ / chos tshul pha mtha' yas pa'i kun gsal gyi/ / dbyings su go skabs yangs pa spobs pa'i sprin/ / gzhung lugs sgra brgyar rgod pa'i 'gyur khugs kyi/ / cha gcig rtogs pa brjod pa'i dbyings su ldir/ / mi zad gsang gsum sbrang char bcud kyis lce ba'i lhun stug rnam par bcas/ / rgyal kun mgrin dbyangs gcig pa'i kha sgo las 'ongs sgra brgyas phyogs kun 'gengs/ /yid ches snang ba sbyin byed tshad ma'i lung gi glog 'phreng do shal 'dzin/ /byin rlabs grib bsil snum pos 'gro kun gdung sel cho ga deng 'dir rdzogs/ / phyogs phyogs yon tan grags pa'i rlung 'gam dza bir dri bzhin zas can min/ / mkhas dang grub ba'i bden gtam rlung bskur tshangs pa'i 'ud kyis 'brid pa min/ / khengs dregs stobs 'byor snyems pa'i nga ro 'phrog byed 'jug pa'i gtam rgyud min/ / don med don log nyes pas ma reg 'chos skyob gnyis ldan gtam gyi phul/ / dge spyong tshogs kye bslab bya so sor thar/ / rgyal sras rgya mtsho'i 'jug ngogs theg pa che/ / rig 'dzin snying gi thig le bde chen dpyid/ / 'di ko theg gsum 'dul ba'i sde snod lags/ / srid zhi'i go las gcod pa drang po'i thig / bde gshegs gzhung lam gsal ba'i rin chen sgron/ / mos pa'i bsod nams rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i gzings/ / thugs bskyed rnga chen bskul ba'i dbyu gu'ang yin/ / yon tan mi zad sbyor ba brgya ldan rtogs brjod grub pa'i bcud len gyis/ / lkog mar srog phyin bstan 'gro'i bde skyid gzhon nu'i lang tshor 1008

༄/ /jebatsunamakha nyis gangag mapabadakaracadabyungakazhugs pa yis/ / bshad sgrub bya ba'i rol pa 'bum phrag sa gsum dga' ba'i zlosagar gyis/ / phug tshogs sde bzhi'i do rar rtsen pas rdzogs ldan nya bar mtshon gyur cig / ma drin mdza' bshes thugs rje'i bdag nyid des/ /'gro ba ma lus gnod pa'i tshogs spangs te/ / phan pa ma tshang med la sbyar ba yi/ / gzhan don dgongs pa ji bzhin 'grub gyur cig / khyad par blo bzang thub dbang gnyis pa yi/ / lung rtogs chos kyi 'khor los mnga' bsgyur te/ / phyogs dus kun las rnam par rgyal ba yi/ / dge mtshan sa gsumakun tu khyab gyur cig / gang gi gdams pa'i sa bon yongs bzung ba/ / skal ldan slob ma'i zhing sa ji snyed kun/ / lung rtogs yon tan snye ma g.yul za ba/ / kun bzang mchod pas mchog tu ldem gyur cig / zhabs sen zla ba tshes pa'i cod pan can/ / sa steng dbang phyug sbyin ba'i bdag po rnams/ / rnam smin yon tan brgyad kyis mngon mtho ba'i/ / nges legs lam gye gdang bu 'dzeg gyur cig / gsung rab mtha' dag mdo sngags lam gyi lus/ / gcig tu 'dril ba blo bzang rgyal ba'i bstan/ / tshang la ma nor thub dgongs yang snying 'di/ / phyogs dus kun tu dar zhing rgyas gyur cig / dus ring 'khor ba'i 'brog dgon nyam nga bar/ / kun sbyor rims kyis skam pa'i 'gro ba rnams/ / ha ri tsan dan chos kyi dga' tshal du/ /nyer zhi bdud rtsi'i bcud kyis gso gyur cig / mi zad srid pa'i tsha gdung 'jigs 'phrog pa/ / zhabs sen zla ba gsar ba'i thig le ni/ / byang chub mchog gi mthas gtugs tshe rabs kyi/ / 'phreng bar 'bral med spyi bos mchod gyur cig / lhan cig skyes dga'i rang mdangs dag pa'i khams/ /mkha' spyod rdo rje btsun mo'i grong mchog tu/ / dpa' bo'i dbang phyug mchog gis rjes bzung ste/ / gsang mtha'i lam bzang bde blag bgrod gyur 1009

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/cig / 'od gsal ye shes nyi ma 'bar ba'i gzis/ / phra rags srid pa'i 'khor lo mthar byas te/ / dag pa'i brtan g.yo rtsom pa'i dri bzhon mthus/ / dpal stug tshangs pa'i gzhal yas 'grub gyur cig / mdor na sku dang ye shes yon tan gyi/ / dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs pa bla ma lha'i/ / gong 'phang mngon du gyur nas mkha' mnyam 'gro/ / bde chen thar pa'i gling du 'khrid gyur cig / he ru ka dpal gdong ma bzhir bcas bde chen snying rjes khros pa las/ / ha ha rgod pa'i ngur khrod chen por yum bzhi bshan pa'i sde dang bcas/ / khros 'khrug rngam pa'i stabs kyis rol pa rdo rje nag po gdong bzhi pas/ / mdzad pa rmad byung grags pa'i ru mtshon rnam brgyar bsgrengs pa'i las 'di sgrubs/ / gtam 'di dge legs dbang gi rgyal po yis/ / yongs su gtams pa rgyal sras spyod pa'i gzings/ / skal ldan yid mtshor 'dod dgur dkri ba la/ / rab dkar mdzes pa'i ba dan nyid gyur cig / chos 'di 'bri mchod nyan dang klog pa sogs/ / chos spyod rnam bcus 'brel ba thogs pa kun/ / chos kyi rdo rjes 'bral med rjes bzung ste/ / chos kyi dga' bdes rtag tu rol gyur cig / bla ma yi dam rgyal ba rgya mtshos nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor kun khyab cing / / byang sems nyan rang mkha' 'gro chos srung bar snang gang ba mtha' dag gis/ / bden tshig snyan pa'i glu dbyangs dang bcas dge legs me tog char phab ste/ / don gnyis phun tshogs bkra shis rgya mtshos bstan dang 'gro kun skyong gyur cig /ces rigs dang dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum rmad du byung ba'i mdzad bzang 'dab brgya'i dga' tshal gyi cha tsam gtam du byas pa rtogs brjod pad+ma dkar po zhes bya ba 'di ni lung rtogs yon tan gyi mnga' bdag wang hu thog thu skal bzang ye shes dar rgyas/ bstan pa'i gsal byed gser khri 1010

da / /che badza gsazang dmakhangs dag sprul pa'i sku blo bzang thub bstan nyi ma sogs chos sde chen po dgon lung gi bla ma gdan zur sprul sku las sne mo rnams dang / bla ma'i zhabs 'debs tshul bzhin du sgrub pa la lhag bsam dang brtson 'grus mi dman pa phyag mdzod cho4rje phun tshogs bstan pas gtsosabla brang zhabs phyi kun gyis dang por bskul zhing / de nas mkhas btsun bzang po'iphan tan gyi gter mdzod sgo mang mkhan zur lha btsun blo bzang mthu stobs nyi ma/mdo sngags rig gnas rgya mtsho'i rgyan 'phreng 'dzin pa rong po bas pa sprul sku ngag dbang mi pham zla ba/ lha btsun zhabs drung ngag dbang bkra shis/ chos rje ngag dbang rin chen/ chos rje blo gros phun tshogs sogs gsung las skyes pa'i slob ma stod smad na bzhugs pa mang pos kyang dngos dang 'phrin yig ci rigs kyi lam nas bskul ba dang /rang nyid kyang dad pa'i yid kyis mtshams sbyar te bri bar brtsams pa las rnam thar thun mong ma yin pa'i sa bon zhal slob nang ma 'ga' zhig gis nan tan chen pos yang yang gsol ba btab pa'i ngor shin tu sbas pa'i tshul gyis 'ja' klong 'khyil bar rags rim zhig gnang 'dug na'ang / rnam thar thun mong ba'i sa bon dgung lo nyi shu'i bar mdorabasdus tsam dang / pho brang du lan gsum pa pheb skabs kyi sa bon dum bu rgyas tsam zhig gnyi ga rje nyid nas gnang 'dug pa ma gtogs/ stod cha gzhan rnams dang po nas ma thebs pa'am 'khyar nas mi 'dug la/ pi lig thu gu thi ngag dbang bstan 'phel phyag phyir bsdad pa phyin chad khong bla chen gyi zhabs 'bring phal mo che'i brtul zhugs dang mi 'dra bar bla ma'i rnam thar la rtsis su byed cing gsung zur phra mo tshun chad ma brjed par byas te slar de'i dgongs gzhi dang dgos pa gung bsgrigs nas dpyod tshul sogs rnam thar la rtog shes pa dang / phyogs zhen gyis 'ud btab pa'ang ma yin par mdzad pa gang bstan snang tshul de nyid sgro skur med par drang por bris shing / hang 'gros su ma song bar lo rgyus mtha' dag gong 'og ma 'dzol ba nor 'khrul med pa dngos dag tu snang la/ stod cha hor khungs su lus pa rnams kyang de skabs kyi grwa rigs sbyin bdag yul mi nyams can sogs la 'dri rtog / bka' rtsom rnams dang gzhan gyi lo rgyus ci rigs par go bsdur sogs sgo du ma nas yang yang zhun thar bcad de stod smad kyi 1011

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'isgran 'i gsung 'bum/sa bon cha mtshungs par byung ba'i thog mdzad pa'i spyi bab rang blos dpog tshod dang /mdzad pa thor bu rang gi mthong thos su gyur pa rnams kyis kyang kha bskangs shing /skabs gang 'os su dam pa snga ma'i rnam thar gyi dpe dang yid ches pa'i mdo rgyud bstan bcos kyi lung rigs lam dang 'brel ba'i gtan tshigs sogs ci rigs bkod/ rgyas bsdus kyang ha cang rgyas na da lta'i skye bo blo dang brtson 'grus zhan pa rnams dang po nas skyid lug par 'gyur bas tshig sna bstungs shing don tshan phyogs bsdebs kyis bsdu gang thub las/ la la mngon pa gong 'og gi 'dzig rten chags rim tshun chad skabs su bab ma bab thams cad bsres te pod chen por 'gro ba'i thabs byas pa lta bu min yang mdzad pa rlabs che ba dang sa bon zhib la rgya4pa'i dbang gis cung zad tshig tshogs che na'ang gzuraganas blo dang ldan pa rnams kyis brtags na dgos don che ba kho nar yod pas rjes 'jug bstan pa la bya ba bgyid par 'dod pa rnams kyi mig 'dren du bsams te dman lhag sgro skur sogs kyi skyon dang bral bar/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgronames rab byung bcu bzhi pa'i nang tshan na tshod ldan zhes pa shing mo phag gi lo cho 'phrul gyi zla ba'i yar tshes la rgyal pa'i lung giyozin pa'i chos gra chen po bkra shis 'khyil gye nye 'dabs dben gnas yid dga' chos 'dzin du rdzogs par sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni yig rigs du ma dang gtsug lag gi gzhung la blo gros kyi snang ba can sngags ram pa dkon mchog kun dgas bgyis pa 'di'ang bdag sogs lus can mtha' dag theg pa mchog gi bshesaganyen dam pas rjes su 'dzin pa dang blo bzang rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che phyogs dus kun tu dar zhing rgyas pa'i rgyur gyur cig / / /1012

spyi khyab jus 'god pa/ tsha lag tshe ring rgyal/ sgo za tho/ po ca shākhyazhu chen pa/ blo gros sbyin pa/ṣ+ṭha 11 za0 ༅rtsom sgrig 'gan 'khur pa/ 'brug mo skyid/mo zoza thatshodzamadzes cha jus 'god pa/ garma rdo rje tshe ring /zam yo1/ zo jo༄/ / gung thang bstan pa'i sgon me'i gsung 'bum/(ja)gung thang bstan pa'i sgron mes brtsams/tshemi rigs dpe skrun khang gis bskrun zhing 'grems spel byas/(pe cin ho phing li byang lam yang 14pa/ sbrag ang 1sa 13kha par yang grangam581༅509)pe cin kreng ta'o par khang nas par btab/2mabolo'i zla 1par par gzhi dang po bsgrigs/2 6lo'i ma par pe cin du par theng4dang po brgyab/deb tshad 85tsamabom11yo77 1 2 dpar shog 15 25dpar grangasas 1—2 sa deb rer sgor 1 50
